papers.title: Future Dynamic 3D Reconstruction: A 3D World Model with Disentangled Ego-Motion
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting the evolution of dynamic environments is crucial for autonomous agents. While generative world models have recently achieved high photorealism in 2D video synthesis by mixing ego-motion and environmental dynamics within the image plane, they exhibit physical inconsistencies, such as morphing or vanishing objects, especially over long time horizons. In this paper, we propose FR3D, a world model that predicts a persistent 3D latent representation for future dynamic 3D reconstruction. Unlike prior works that treat the world as a sequence of image-based features, FR3D explicitly decouples the 3D evolution of the scene from the agent's trajectory, treating the inferred ego-motion as a latent proxy for action. This disentanglement resolves the ambiguities between self-motion and world-motion, ensuring geometric consistency into the future. Furthermore, we introduce a teacher-student distillation strategy that leverages the spatial "common sense" of off-the-shelf foundation models, leading to robust zero-shot generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate FR3D's strong performance for future dynamic 3D reconstruction from monocular observations across multiple datasets, even 2 seconds into the future. Project page: https://fr3d-wm.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FR3D，一种用于未来动态3D重建的世界模型，显式解耦场景3D演化与智能体轨迹（ego-motion），通过教师-学生蒸馏利用基础模型的空间常识实现零样本泛化，在多个数据集上展示了从单目观测预测未来2秒动态3D重建的强性能。
Motivation: 现有生成式世界模型在2D视频合成中混合了自我运动和环境动态，导致长期物理不一致（如物体变形或消失），缺乏几何一致性。需要一种能够预测持久3D潜在表示并解耦自我运动与世界运动的方法。
Method: 提出FR3D世界模型，将场景3D演化与推断的自我运动（作为动作的潜在代理）显式解耦；采用教师-学生蒸馏策略，利用现成基础模型的空间常识实现鲁棒的零样本泛化。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，FR3D能够从单目观测对未来2秒的动态3D重建取得强性能，即使在未来2秒的时间跨度上仍保持几何一致性。
Conclusion: 解耦自我运动与世界运动并利用基础模型的常识蒸馏，可以有效实现长期几何一致的动态3D重建，为自主智能体提供可靠的未来环境预测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unified Multimodal Autoregressive Modeling with Shared Context-Visual Tokenizer is Key to Unification
papers.abstract_en: Unified Multimodal Modeling aims to integrate visual understanding and generation within a single system. However, existing approaches typically rely on two disparate visual tokenizers, which splits the representation space and hinders truly unified modeling. We propose UniAR, a unified autoregressive framework where a single discrete visual tokenizer serves as the key bridge between understanding and generation, enabling a shared context in which the model can directly interpret its own generated visual tokens without additional re-encoding. UniAR adapts a pretrained vision encoder with multi-level feature fusion and a lookup-free bitwise quantization scheme, preserving both high-level semantics and low-level details while scaling the effective visual vocabulary at minimal cost. Building on this, the unified autoregressive model adopts parallel-bitwise-prediction to jointly predict spatially grouped, multi-level visual codes, substantially reducing visual sequence length and accelerating generation. Finally, a diffusion-based visual decoder operates on discrete visual tokens to decode high-fidelity images. Through large-scale pre-training, followed by supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, UniAR achieves state-of-the-art performance on image generation and image editing while remaining competitive on multimodal understanding benchmarks. The project page is available at https://sharelab-sii.github.io/uniar-web.
papers.comment: Accepted by ICML2026. Project page https://sharelab-sii.github.io/uniar-web
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniAR，一种统一多模态自回归框架，通过共享上下文-视觉分词器（shared context-visual tokenizer）实现视觉理解与生成的统一。该框架使用单一离散视觉分词器作为理解和生成的桥梁，结合多级特征融合、无查找逐位量化（lookup-free bitwise quantization）和并行逐位预测（parallel-bitwise-prediction）来缩短视觉序列长度并加速生成。在大规模预训练、监督微调和强化学习后，UniAR在图像生成和编辑任务上达到最先进水平，同时在多模态理解基准上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有统一多模态建模方法通常依赖两个不同的视觉分词器，导致表示空间分裂，阻碍真正的统一建模。
Method: 提出UniAR框架：采用单个离散视觉分词器作为理解和生成的桥梁，无需额外重编码；使用多级特征融合和无查找逐位量化方案，保留高层语义和低层细节；通过并行逐位预测建模空间分组的多级视觉代码，缩短序列长度；利用扩散视觉解码器从离散令牌解码高保真图像。
Result: 在大规模预训练、监督微调和强化学习后，UniAR在图像生成和图像编辑任务上达到最先进水平，同时在多模态理解基准上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 共享单一离散视觉分词器是实现视觉理解与生成真正统一的关键，该方法在生成和理解任务上均取得了优异性能。

papers.title: Visual Verification Enables Inference-time Steering and Autonomous Policy Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Robots deployed in the real world should learn from their experience and improve over time. This requires a mechanism of practicing and learning from feedback. In this paper, we propose VERITAS, a generator-verifier framework for generalist robot policies for inference-time policy steering and self-improvement. We use a pre-trained generalist robot policy as a ``generator'' and pair it with a gradient-free ``visual verifier'' that evaluates actions at inference time. This framework enables inference-time steering that improves policy performance without additional training. We demonstrate that inference-time verification consistently outperforms vanilla generalists without training on additional demonstration data. Additionally, we demonstrate that the verified rollouts provide effective supervision for offline policy improvement: policies fine-tuned on verified self-generated trajectories achieve consistent performance gains. Notably, we find that post-training with verified rollouts achieves comparable efficiency to expert demonstrations, while requiring no human interventions. Our results highlight inference-time verification as a practical and scalable mechanism for improving robotic policies during deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VERITAS 框架，将通用机器人策略作为生成器，结合无梯度视觉验证器，在推理时对动作进行验证和导向，从而在不额外训练的情况下提升策略性能。实验表明，推理时验证优于基础策略，且基于验证的自生成轨迹微调策略可获得持续提升，效果接近专家演示但无需人工干预。
Motivation: 现实世界中部署的机器人应从经验中学习并随时间改进，需要一种实践并从反馈中学习的机制。现有方法依赖人工监督或大量演示数据，缺乏可扩展的自主改进方法。
Method: VERITAS 框架采用预训练的通用机器人策略作为生成器，以及一个无梯度的视觉验证器在推理时评估动作。验证器可用于推理时导向（steering）和离线策略改进。
Result: 推理时验证一致优于未额外训练的基础策略；基于验证的自生成轨迹微调的策略取得持续性能提升；后训练使用验证轨迹的效果接近使用专家演示，且无需人工干预。
Conclusion: 推理时验证是一种实用且可扩展的机制，可用于改善部署中的机器人策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MOCHI: Motion Enhancement of Collaborative Human-object Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative human-object interaction shows dynamic and complex movements that require mutual anticipation and continuous adjustment between participants and the shared object. Modeling such collaborative multi-human object interaction (MHOI) scenarios requires high-quality data acquisition as a foundational step; however, this is challenging due to the inherent complexity of MHOI where human-human and human-object interactions occur simultaneously. Such complexity leads to noisy MHOI captures characterized by several artifacts: contact misalignment between hands and objects, motion jitter and temporal inconsistencies in the captured sequences, and missing or incomplete finger-level articulation details. To address these challenges, we present MOCHI (MOtion Enhancement of Collaborative Human-object Interactions), a two-stage framework for enhancing noisy MHOI data. Our approach first generates physically plausible hand grasps through optimization from noisy body input, producing grasps that are both physically plausible and semantically consistent with the body pose, where these optimized grasps are extended into complete hand-object interaction sequences. Consequently, the full-body motion for all participants are refined through a diffusion-based noise optimization framework that uses single-person motion priors. During the optimization process, we introduce optimization objectives to encode human-object and human-human interaction information within these single-person priors. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our pipeline across diverse MHOI data, either acquired by existing capture methods or synthesized by generative models. We further show robustness of our system across varying numbers of participants and types of interactions, and demonstrate various applications including keyframe-based MHOI creation and data augmentation through varying object geometries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MOCHI框架，用于增强协作式多人-物体交互（MHOI）的噪声运动捕捉数据。该框架分为两阶段：首先通过优化从噪声身体输入生成物理合理的手部抓取，并扩展为完整的手-物交互序列；然后使用基于扩散的噪声优化框架，结合单人运动先验和多目标优化（编码人-物与人-人交互信息）来精修所有参与者的全身运动。实验表明该方法在多种MHOI数据上有效，并展示了关键帧MHOI创建和基于物体几何变化的数据增强等应用。
Motivation: 多人-物体交互（MHOI）数据捕获因同时存在人人交互与人-物交互而具有内在复杂性，导致数据包含接触错位、运动抖动、时间不一致以及手指细节缺失等伪影。高质量MHOI数据是建模这类动态复杂交互的基础，但现有获取方法往往产生噪声数据。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段通过优化从噪声身体输入生成物理合理且语义一致的手部抓取，并扩展为完整的手-物交互序列；第二阶段使用扩散模型噪声优化框架，以单人运动先验为基础，引入编码人-物和人-人交互信息的优化目标，对全体参与者的全身运动进行精修。
Result: 实验证明该管道对现有捕获方法或生成模型产生的多种MHOI数据均有效，且对不同参与者数量和交互类型具有鲁棒性。展示了关键帧MHOI创建和通过改变物体几何进行数据增强等应用。
Conclusion: MOCHI能够有效增强噪声MHOI数据，生成物理合理且时间一致的多人-物体交互运动，适用于数据增强和交互内容创建。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EventDrive: Event Cameras for Vision-Language Driving Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras sense the world through asynchronous brightness changes with microsecond latency and high dynamic range, offering motion fidelity far beyond frame-based sensors and capturing temporal structure that conventional exposures often miss. These properties make events a powerful complement to RGB in autonomous driving, especially under blur, glare, and rapid motion, where frame-based perception can become unreliable. However, existing event-aware vision-language models remain limited to generic perception and do not reveal how event sensing contributes to reasoning and decision-making across the full driving loop. We present EventDrive, a large-scale benchmark and model suite that unifies event streams, RGB frames, and language supervision across four core dimensions: Perception, Understanding, Prediction, and Planning, covering captions, structured QA, grounding, motion-state recognition, trajectory forecasting, and planning tasks. Building on this foundation, EventDrive-VLM introduces a multi-horizon event pyramid and a temporal-horizon mixture-of-experts module to adaptively encode and fuse asynchronous and frame-based information for downstream reasoning. Comprehensive evaluation across diverse tasks shows that event streams provide substantial gains in temporal precision, motion awareness, and robustness, bringing event sensing into the center of driving intelligence.
papers.comment: CVPR2026, 34 pages, 15 figures, 15 tables, project page: https://dylanorange.github.io/projects/eventdrive
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EventDrive，一个大规模基准和模型套件，将事件流、RGB帧和语言监督统一在自动驾驶的四个核心维度：感知、理解、预测和规划。EventDrive-VLM引入多水平事件金字塔和时间水平混合专家模块，自适应编码和融合异步与帧基信息进行下游推理。实验表明事件流在时间精度、运动感知和鲁棒性上带来显著提升。
Motivation: 现有事件感知视觉-语言模型局限于通用感知，未揭示事件传感如何贡献于完整驾驶循环中的推理和决策。
Method: 构建包含事件流、RGB帧和语言监督的基准，覆盖字幕、结构化问答、定位、运动状态识别、轨迹预测和规划任务；提出EventDrive-VLM，含多水平事件金字塔和时间水平混合专家模块。
Result: 在多种任务上的综合评估显示，事件流在时间精度、运动感知和鲁棒性方面带来显著增益。
Conclusion: 事件传感可成为驾驶智能的核心组成部分，提升对运动和时间结构的感知。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ReproRepo: Scaling Reproducibility Audits with GitHub Repository Issues
papers.abstract_en: Reproducing research results from papers and released code is central to scientific progress. Existing works have introduced benchmarks to evaluate whether LLM agents can assist with reproducibility, but they are difficult to scale due to their reliance on substantial manual effort for data curation and evaluation. We introduce ReproRepo, a scalable framework for reproducibility evaluation that leverages human-raised GitHub issues as naturally occurring supervision on realistic reproduction blockers. We instantiate ReproRepo on 1,149 recent machine learning papers from major conferences and evaluate four frontier model-agent configurations. Our results show that LLM agents, even without executing code, can identify many real-world reproducibility problems from paper-repository pairs: the best agent in our study, namely Codex with GPT-5.5, surfaces at least one semantically related human-reported blocker for ~90% of papers in the study. Further analysis shows that agents are particularly effective for surfacing visible failures and identifying the right semantic region, but may still be insufficient in exact localization. ReproRepo can serve as a reusable, scalable framework for future evaluations of LLM agents on real-world reproducibility auditing. Our code is released at https://github.com/LithiumDA/ReproRepo.

papers.title: Sign-Rank, Index, and List Replicability: Connections and Separations
papers.abstract_en: In learning theory, the sign rank of a binary concept class captures the smallest dimension in which it can be represented by points and halfspaces. Despite tremendous interest, lower bounds on sign rank are notoriously difficult to come by. Two recent approaches to the problem establish lower bounds on sign rank by measures that are easier to analyze: the $\mathbb{Z}_2$-index and the list replicability number. We order these measures, showing that the $\mathbb{Z}_2$-index is upper-bounded by a linear function of the list replicability number. As a main consequence, we obtain a strong separation between sign rank and $\mathbb{Z}_2$-index, thereby resolving a question of Frick, Hosseini, and Vasileuski. This motivates a thorough study of list replicability, the stronger of the two lower-bounding measures. We establish upper bounds on the list replicability number by two combinatorial measures: height and minimum star number. We also prove a fundamental composition result, showing that the product of two concept classes has list replicability number bounded by the sum of the list replicability numbers of the two classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究概念类的sign rank、Z2-index和list replicability number之间的关系。证明Z2-index被list replicability number的线性函数上界控制，并由此得到sign rank与Z2-index之间的强分离结果。此外，给出了list replicability number的上界（基于height和minimum star number）以及组合性质（乘积类上界为两类的和）。
Motivation: Sign rank的下界难以直接获得，现有方法通过Z2-index和list replicability number间接推导。本文旨在厘清这些度量之间的序关系，并解决Frick等人关于sign rank与Z2-index分离的开放问题。
Method: 通过纯理论分析，建立Z2-index与list replicability number之间的不等式关系，并利用组合度量（height、minimum star number）给出list replicability number的上界，同时证明乘积类的组合性质。
Result: 证明了Z2-index ≤ O(list replicability number)，从而得到sign rank与Z2-index的强分离（即存在概念类sign rank很大但Z2-index很小）。此外，建立list replicability number的上界由height和minimum star number控制，并证明乘积类的list replicability number不超过两类的和。
Conclusion: List replicability number是比Z2-index更强的下界工具，值得深入研究。本文提供的上下界和组合结果为sign rank的下界分析提供了新途径。

papers.title: EvolveNav: Proactive Preflection and Self-Evolving Memory for Zero-Shot Object Goal Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation (ZS-OGN) requires embodied agents to explore and locate target objects without any prior training. To this end, recent methods leverage foundation models. But they typically rely on static priors and lack adaptation, which leads to repeated errors and costly trial and error. In this paper, we propose a self-evolving ZS-OGN framework that enables continuous test-time improvement. Specifically, we build an agentic rule memory by extracting actionable knowledge from past trajectories. Then, we propose a retrieval strategy based on upper confidence bound, selecting effective rules by balancing semantic relevance and historical success. In addition, we introduce a memory-guided preflection module that forecasts potential outcomes before action, reducing inefficient exploration. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms existing zero-shot baselines, achieving a 10.1\% improvement in success rate with fewer unnecessary steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自进化的零样本目标导航框架 EvolveNav，通过构建智能体规则记忆、基于上置信界的检索策略以及记忆引导的预反射模块，在测试时持续改进导航性能，在目标导航基准上取得10.1%的成功率提升。
Motivation: 现有零样本目标导航方法依赖静态先验知识，缺乏适应能力，导致重复错误和高成本的试错。
Method: 提出自进化框架，包括提取历史轨迹中的可行动知识构建规则记忆；使用基于上置信界的检索平衡语义相关性与历史成功率；引入记忆引导的预反射模块在行动前预测潜在结果，减少低效探索。
Result: 在零样本目标导航任务上，成功率提升10.1%，且减少了不必要的步数。
Conclusion: 该方法通过测试时持续改进，有效提升了零样本目标导航的效率和成功率，但未提及局限性。

papers.title: Adaptive Volumetric Mechanical Property Fields Invariant to Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Accurate mechanical properties (or materials) Young's modulus ($E$), Poisson's ratio ($ν$) and density ($ρ$) are essential for reliable physics simulation of digital worlds, but most 3D assets lack this information. We propose AdaVoMP, a method for predicting accurate dense spatially-varying ($E$, $ν$, $ρ$) for input 3D objects across representations, improving the resolution, accuracy, and memory efficiency over the state-of-the-art. The foundation of our technique is a sparse and adaptive voxel structure SAV that efficiently represents both the input 3D shape and the material field output. We replace the fixed-voxel model of the most accurate prior method, VoMP, with a novel sparse transformer encoder-decoder model that learns to generate a unique SAV autoregressively for every input shape to represent its materials, achieving a resolution $16^3\times$ higher than prior art. Experiments show that AdaVoMP estimates more accurate volumetric properties, even with lesser test-time compute than all prior art. This allows us to convert high-resolution complex 3D objects into simulation-ready assets, resulting in realistic deformable simulations.
papers.comment: Project Page and hi-res paper: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/sil/projects/adavomp/. ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaVoMP，一种从3D对象预测高分辨率空间变化力学属性（杨氏模量、泊松比、密度）的方法，基于稀疏自适应体素结构（SAV）和自回归Transformer编解码器，在分辨率上比先前最优方法提高16³倍，同时计算量更小，可生成逼真的可变形仿真。
Motivation: 大多数3D资产缺乏准确的力学属性，导致物理仿真不可靠。现有方法（如VoMP）使用固定体素模型，分辨率和内存效率有限。
Method: 提出稀疏自适应体素（SAV）结构，结合自回归Transformer编解码器，为每个输入形状学习生成唯一的SAV来表征力学属性场。
Result: 在分辨率上达到先前方法的16³倍，且测试时计算量更小，力学属性估计更准确，能生成高分辨率复杂3D对象的仿真就绪资产。
Conclusion: AdaVoMP可高效预测高分辨率空间变化力学属性，提升物理仿真真实性，适用于3D对象仿真资产转换。

papers.title: Learning Red Agent Policy from Observations for Neurosymbolic Autonomous Cyber Agents
papers.abstract_en: With sophisticated cyber-attacks becoming increasingly prevalent, modern networks require intelligent autonomous cyber-defense agents trained via Reinforcement Learning (RL). These agents employ neurosymbolic approaches such as behavior trees with learning-enabled components (LECs) to learn, reason, adapt, and implement security rules while maintaining critical operations. However, these autonomous networks are partially observable systems, i.e., the cyber-attacker's (red agent's) actions are not observable, making it difficult for the defender to predict red actions, learn red policies, or assess the attacker's intrusion levels. To address this, we propose a Policy Learning Technique using imitation learning to learn policies for partially observable RL agents with discrete states and discrete actions. We apply this technique in an autonomous cyber environment to predict red agent's actions from network observations and defender actions. Integrated with a neurosymbolic cyber-defense agent, our method effectively handles different red policies and achieves high prediction accuracy across diverse simulated scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自主网络防御中红队（攻击者）行为不可观测的问题，提出一种基于模仿学习的策略学习技术，用于从网络观测和防御者动作中预测红队动作。该方法与神经符号自主网络防御智能体集成，在多种模拟场景下实现了高预测准确率。
Motivation: 自主网络防御系统通常基于强化学习，但网络是部分可观测系统，攻击者动作不可观测，导致防御者难以预测攻击行为、学习攻击策略或评估入侵程度。
Method: 提出一种策略学习技术，利用模仿学习为具有离散状态和离散动作的部分可观测强化学习智能体学习策略。在自主网络环境中，从网络观测和防御者动作中预测红队动作。
Result: 该方法与神经符号自主网络防御智能体集成后，能有效处理不同红队策略，并在多种模拟场景中取得高预测准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提技术能够解决部分可观测环境下红队策略学习问题，提升自主网络防御能力，但未讨论真实网络部署或复杂攻击场景下的局限性。

papers.title: Finite-Time Queue Peak Laws in Stochastic Networks: Logarithmic Scaling After Geometric Thresholds
papers.abstract_en: We study finite-horizon queue peaks in generalized switches, a standard stochastic-network model in which many queues share constrained service resources. Arrivals may be dependent, time-varying, and adapted to the past; the standing load condition is uniform interior slack, meaning the conditional mean arrival vector stays in a fixed contraction of the capacity region. We show that this slack reshapes the finite-time peak law for drift-minimizing scheduling policies such as MaxWeight. The square-root envelope that is sharp without slack persists only up to a geometry-dependent threshold; beyond that threshold, the running maximum grows only logarithmically with the horizon, both with high probability and in expectation. The mechanism is self-normalization: in the current queue direction, the projected fluctuation scale is normalized by the stabilizing drift scale. This removes capacity geometry from the logarithmic coefficient, while geometry remains in the threshold. Matching lower bounds show that both the logarithmic term and a geometric threshold are unavoidable. When finite-time state-space collapse is available, the threshold can be sharpened using local bottleneck geometry. For generalized input-queued switches, we obtain finite-time peak bounds with tight logarithmic coefficients. Simulations illustrate the two-phase envelope, local geometric refinements, and variance-sensitive improvements predicted by the theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有限时间队列峰值（queue peaks）在广义交换机（generalized switches）这一标准随机网络模型中的行为，其中多个队列共享受约束的服务资源。在均匀内松弛（uniform interior slack）负载条件下，使用漂移最小化调度策略（如MaxWeight）时，队列峰值的增长呈现两相包络：平方根增长仅在几何阈值之前成立，超过阈值后运行最大值（running maximum）以高概率和期望均呈对数增长。机制是自归一化（self-normalization），即当前队列方向的投影波动尺度被稳定化漂移尺度归一化。
Motivation: 现有理论通常研究无限时间或稳态队列，而有限时间队列峰值的精确规律尚未清楚，特别是在松弛条件如何影响增长尺度方面。
Method: 本文通过理论分析，利用自归一化机制和漂移最小化策略，证明了在均匀内松弛条件下队列峰值的两相包络：平方根增长到几何阈值然后转为对数增长，并给出了匹配下界。
Result: 摘要显示：平方根包络在松弛条件下仅持续到几何阈值；超过阈值后，运行最大值呈对数增长（包括高概率和期望）；去除容量几何对对数系数的影响，但几何仍存在于阈值中；匹配下界表明对数项和几何阈值不可避免。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了随机网络中有限时间队列峰值的两相规律，为调度策略设计提供了理论指导，并指出当有限时间状态空间坍缩可用时，可使用局部瓶颈几何细化阈值。

papers.title: Rethinking Dataset Distillation for Classification: Do Distilled Sets Outperform Coresets?
papers.abstract_en: Dataset distillation (DD) has emerged as a prominent approach in data centric machine learning, aiming to synthesize compact training sets for efficient training by compressing the information in large datasets into a small number of synthetic samples. However, DD methods are often evaluated under inconsistent evaluation protocols, ranging from standard ERM to single/multi-teacher supervision, making it difficult to isolate the effectiveness of distilled data from evaluation. Moreover, many prior methods claim that DD outperforms data pruning approaches such as coreset selection (CS), based on the assumption that restricting condensed datasets to subsets of real samples fundamentally limits their expressiveness. In this work, we critically evaluate DD methods through large-scale experiments using standardized datasets and evaluation protocols to assess their intrinsic effectiveness. We benchmark seven state-of-the-art (SOTA) DD methods on ImageNet-1K, ImageNet100, and ImageNette, using three widely adopted training protocols against three CS strategies. Our results show that while some DD methods fail to outperform even simple random subsets, the SOTA DD approaches are comparable to or worse than coresets on large-scale datasets and incur a substantially higher cost for construction. Beyond accuracy, we also evaluate the representativeness, diversity, and quality of condensed sets, and find that coresets consistently achieve better coverage of the original data distribution. These findings highlight the limited practical advantages of current DD methods and show that coresets remain competitive and are often a more computationally efficient alternative for data-centric learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了数据集蒸馏方法在分类任务上的有效性，通过大规模实验发现，当前最先进的蒸馏方法在大规模数据集上并不优于甚至不如简单核心集，且构建成本更高。摘要还评估了蒸馏集与核心集在代表性、多样性和质量上的差异，核心集更优。
Motivation: 数据集蒸馏方法常在不一致的评估协议下被评估，且许多先前方法声称蒸馏优于核心集，但缺乏严格的标准化对比。
Method: 使用标准化数据集（ImageNet-1K、ImageNet100、ImageNette）和三种广泛采用的训练协议，对七种最先进的蒸馏方法与三种核心集策略进行基准比较。
Result: 一些蒸馏方法甚至不如随机子集；最先进的蒸馏方法在大规模数据集上与核心集相当或更差，且构建成本更高；核心集在代表性、多样性和数据分布覆盖上一致更好。
Conclusion: 当前蒸馏方法的实际优势有限，核心集仍是数据高效学习中计算上更高效的替代方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Looped World Models
papers.abstract_en: Current world models face a fundamental tension: faithful long-horizon simulation demands deep computation, but deeper models are expensive to deploy and prone to compounding errors. We resolve this by introducing Looped World Models (LoopWM), which are the first looped architectures for world modelling. Our method iteratively refines latent environment states through a parameter-shared transformer block. This yield up to 100x parameter efficiency over conventional approaches with adaptive computation that automatically scales depth to match the complexity of each prediction step. Orthogonal to scaling model size and training data, LoopWM establishes iterative latent depth as a new scaling axis for world simulation, which might significantly push the community forward.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出循环世界模型（LoopWM），首次将循环架构用于世界建模，通过参数共享的Transformer块迭代优化潜在环境状态，实现高达100倍参数效率提升，并自适应调整计算深度。该方法不依赖扩大模型规模或训练数据，而是将迭代潜在深度作为世界模拟的新缩放轴，可能推动社区进步。
Motivation: 现有世界模型在长时程仿真中面临深层计算耗时且易积累误差的困境，需要更高效且鲁棒的架构。
Method: 提出循环架构LoopWM，使用参数共享的Transformer块对潜在环境状态进行迭代细化，动态调整计算深度以适应每一步预测的复杂度。
Result: 相比传统方法，参数效率提升高达100倍，且自适应计算能力可自动匹配预测步骤的复杂度。
Conclusion: LoopWM建立了迭代潜在深度作为世界模拟的新缩放轴，具有潜力推动该领域发展，但具体应用场景（如天气预测）未在摘要中提及。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Fixed-Point Reasoners: Stable and Adaptive Deep Looped Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Looped architectures provide an inductive bias toward learning step-by-step procedures for tasks that require compositional reasoning. The number of effective layers reached by looping determines the quality of the solution these models find. Like deep architectures, looped architectures are prone to a signal propagation problem induced by depth as the halting decision is postponed. In this paper, we address this signal propagation issue using pre-norm layers and residual scaling. Building on these architectural modifications, we propose FPRM, a Transformer-based Fixed-Point Reasoning Model that uses fixed-point convergence as an end-to-end halting mechanism in a looped architecture. We show that fixed-point halting allows FPRM to adapt its compute to task difficulty. FPRM is effective on common reasoning benchmarks, namely Sudoku, Maze, state-tracking, and ARC-AGI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FPRM (Fixed-Point Reasoning Model)，一种基于 Transformer 的循环架构，通过定点收敛作为停机机制，自适应调整计算量以适应任务难度。在 Sudoku、迷宫、状态追踪和 ARC-AGI 等推理基准上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 循环架构在深度推理中面临信号传播问题，且停机决策被推迟导致深度相关的不稳定性。现有方法未能同时解决深度信号衰减和自适应计算问题。
Method: 在循环 Transformer 中引入预层归一化 (pre-norm) 和残差缩放 (residual scaling) 以缓解信号传播问题，并采用定点收敛作为端到端停机机制，使模型根据任务难度自适应调整循环步数。
Result: 在 Sudoku、迷宫、状态追踪和 ARC-AGI 基准上，FPRM 在推理质量与计算效率之间取得平衡，表明定点停机能根据任务难度自适应分配计算资源。
Conclusion: 定点停机机制结合预层归一化与残差缩放可有效改进循环架构的深度推理能力，并自适应调节计算量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RubricsTree: Scalable and Evolving Open-Ended Evaluation of Personal Health Agents across Health Memory and Medical Skills
papers.abstract_en: The LLM-empowered personal health agents with user health (sensor) metrics have offered a promising pathway to alleviate global disparities in healthcare access. However, large-scale clinical deployment remains constrained by an open-ended evaluation bottleneck: physician annotation is reliable but costly and unscalable, while LLM-as-a-judge evaluators are scalable but subjective, inconsistent, and sometimes clinically misaligned. We introduce RubricsTree, a scalable evaluation framework with an expert-aligned hierarchical taxonomy of over 100 atomic, clinically-verifiable Boolean rubrics, evolving from the insights of 4,000 real user queries through an iterative human-in-the-loop curation protocol with an expertise panel led by an experienced physician. A context-aware adaptive router activates only the relevant auto-weighted rubric subset per query, providing the throughput needed for scalable evaluation with expert-aligned quality. Through a systematic meta-evaluation, we show that RubricsTree (i) substantially exceeds a strong large-scale evaluation baseline in expert alignment on challenging open-ended queries; (ii) reliably penalizes contextually degraded responses; and (iii) when used as structured instructions, text feedback, or training rewards for performance optimization, yields up to ~66% relative gains on HealthBench for Gemini, GPT, and Qwen model families. RubricsTree thus provides a scalable, auditable, and evolving evaluation infrastructure required for the continuous optimization of product-level personal healthcare AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RubricsTree，一个可扩展的开放式评估框架，用于个人健康代理。该框架基于专家对齐的分层分类法，包含超过100个原子性、可临床验证的布尔判断，并通过人机协同从4000个真实用户查询中迭代演化。上下文自适应路由器按查询激活相关权重子集，保证评估质量。元评估表明RubricsTree在专家对齐上显著超过强基线，能可靠惩罚上下文退化的响应，且作为结构化指令、文本反馈或训练奖励时，在HealthBench上对Gemini、GPT和Qwen模型族带来高达约66%的相对性能提升。
Motivation: 医生注释可靠但昂贵且不可扩展，而LLM作为评判者可扩展但主观、不一致且临床对齐差，现有开放式评估方法存在瓶颈，制约个人健康代理的大规模临床部署。
Method: RubricsTree包含一个专家对齐的分层分类法，由超过100个原子布尔判断组成，通过人机协同协议从4000个用户查询中演化而来。框架使用上下文自适应路由器，为每个查询激活相关的自动加权子集，实现可扩展评估。
Result: 元评估显示RubricsTree在专家对齐上显著超过强基线，可靠惩罚上下文退化的响应；用作结构化指令、文本反馈或训练奖励时，在HealthBench上对多种模型族带来最高约66%的相对增益。
Conclusion: RubricsTree为产品级个人医疗AI的持续优化提供了可扩展、可审计且可演化的评估基础设施。

papers.title: Conformal Prediction Intervals with Tail-Specific Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: This paper extends classical conformal frameworks for constructing prediction intervals with global marginal coverage $1-α$ to intervals that provide explicitly calibrated guarantees for the upper and lower tails separately. Focusing on split conformal prediction, we first construct lower and upper one-sided conformal intervals that achieve marginal validity, and then derive the induced two-sided interval by intersection. Theoretical results prove both tail-specific and global marginal coverage of the induced two-sided interval. Results are presented first for the exchangeable setting, where coverage has finite-sample guarantees, and then for non-exchangeable data, where guarantees are asymptotic. Simulation studies show that the proposed approach achieves improved directional calibration relative to classical two-sided intervals, especially relevant in skewed data. Finally, the benefit of the proposed framework is showcased in a financial application, where one aims for return maximization while seeking strict control on the left tail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了经典共形预测框架，将全局边际覆盖 $1-\alpha$ 的预测区间改为分别对上下尾提供显式校准的区间。基于分裂共形预测，构造下尾和上尾单侧区间，并通过交集得到双侧区间，理论证明了尾特定和全局边际覆盖。交换性设定下有限样本保证，非交换性数据渐近保证。模拟显示在偏斜数据中方向校准优于经典双侧区间。金融应用展示了对左尾严格控制的收益。
Motivation: 经典共形预测区间仅提供全局边际覆盖，未单独校准上下尾，在偏斜分布中可能导致尾部分布不均衡，例如金融风险控制中左尾（损失）需更严格保证。
Method: 基于分裂共形预测，分别构建下尾和上尾单侧共形区间：对每个尾使用分位数调整，确保单侧覆盖 $1-\alpha/2$，然后取交集得到双侧区间。理论分析覆盖性质，包括交换性下的有限样本和非交换性下的渐近保证。
Result: 模拟表明，所提方法在偏斜数据中实现了更好的方向校准（directional calibration），即上下尾覆盖更均衡。在金融应用中，结合左尾控制实现了收益最大化。
Conclusion: 该方法为需要不对称覆盖或尾部分布控制的应用提供了灵活的工具，特别适用于金融风险管理等场景。局限性在于非交换性下仅渐近保证，且需选择合适的共形分数函数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Seeing Is Not Screening: Multimodal Hidden Instruction Attacks on Agent Skill Scanners
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are emerging as an important attack surface in LLM-based systems. Through an empirical study of existing skill scanners, we find that current defenses primarily rely on textual descriptions, manifests, and source code as the main signals for security analysis, which can leave visually conveyed malicious intent insufficiently examined. This creates a practical blind spot: harmful operational instructions hidden in images may bypass scanning while still being recoverable by multimodal agents during deployment. To systematically investigate this threat, we propose SkillCamo, a document-mediated multimodal instruction attack that conceals malicious instructions within images bundled with a skill while rewriting the surrounding documentation to naturally reference those images as part of the normal workflow. Thus, the attack does not rely on the image alone, but on the joint interpretation of textual guidance and visual payload at execution time. To defend against such attacks, we further propose ExecScan, an execution-grounded multimodal scanning module that performs intent extraction, behavior reconstruction, abuse assessment, and deliberative execution simulation over skill artifacts. ExecScan jointly analyzes documentation, code, referenced resources, and visual content to recover hidden instructions, reconstruct executable behavior chains, and identify downstream risks such as exfiltration, destruction, persistence, deception, and privilege escalation. Extensive experiments show that image-hidden malicious instructions challenge existing skill scanners, while ExecScan can improve the skill scanning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SkillCamo，一种通过将恶意指令隐藏在图像中、同时修改文档使其自然引用这些图像的多模态隐藏指令攻击方法，旨在绕过现有基于文本和代码的智能体技能扫描器。作为防御，提出ExecScan，一种执行驱动的多模态扫描模块，通过意图提取、行为重建、滥用评估和审慎执行模拟来联合分析文档、代码、资源与视觉内容，以恢复隐藏指令并识别下游风险。实验表明图像隐藏指令对现有扫描器构成挑战，而ExecScan提升了扫描性能。
Motivation: 现有智能体技能扫描器主要依赖文本描述、清单和源代码进行安全分析，忽视图像中可能隐藏的恶意操作指令，造成安全盲区。
Method: 提出SkillCamo攻击：将恶意指令嵌入技能包中的图像，并重写周围文档使其自然引用图像作为正常工作流的一部分，攻击依赖部署时对文本引导和视觉载荷的联合解释。提出ExecScan防御：执行驱动的多模态扫描模块，进行意图提取、行为重建、滥用评估和审慎执行模拟，联合分析文档、代码、引用资源和视觉内容。
Result: 实验表明图像隐藏的恶意指令可挑战现有技能扫描器，而ExecScan能提高扫描检测性能。
Conclusion: 论文强调图像可作为多模态攻击的隐蔽通道，现有扫描器存在视觉盲区，执行驱动的多模态分析是必要防御方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Red-Team Study of Anthropic Fable 5 & Opus 4.8 Models
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate the adversarial robustness of two frontier large language models (LLMs) developed by Anthropic, Fable 5 and Opus 4.8, against four families of automated jailbreak attack across 7 826 harmful intents spanning a ten-category harm taxonomy. Using the HackAgent red-teaming framework, hundreds of thousands of adversarial attempts were generated and every apparent success was independently re-adjudicated by a panel of three judge models (majority vote). Both models resist the majority of attacks, but the residual surface is larger than aggregate framing suggests: it is dominated by adaptive iterative attacks, while static obfuscation is near-fully neutralised. The strongest adaptive search (tree-of-attacks) breaks Opus 4.8 on 11.5% of intents overall, whereas Fable 5 stays in the single digits (6.1% worst-case). Aggregate rates therefore should not be read as reassurance. Even in these hardened configurations, the two models produced 1 620 (Opus 4.8) and 702 (Fable 5) panel-confirmed harmful completions spanning every harm category, located automatically, cheaply, and within the first one or two refinement steps by an attacker model with no human expert in the loop. The reasonable conclusion is that even the best, most-tested frontier models remain reliably breakable under sustained automated pressure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该白皮书使用HackAgent红队框架，对Anthropic的Fable 5和Opus 4.8两个前沿大语言模型进行自动化越狱攻击测试，涵盖7,826个有害意图和四种攻击家族。结果显示，尽管模型抵抗了大部分攻击，但自适应迭代攻击仍能成功，Opus 4.8在11.5%的意图上被攻破，Fable 5为6.1%，总计产生2,322个经裁判确认的有害完成。结论是当前最强模型在持续自动化压力下仍可被可靠攻破。
Motivation: 评估前沿LLM的对抗鲁棒性，特别是面对自动化越狱攻击时的真实安全性，因为聚合成功率可能会低估实际风险。
Method: 使用HackAgent红队框架生成数十万次对抗尝试，通过三个裁判模型多数投票独立裁决每次明显成功，覆盖四个攻击家族（包括自适应迭代攻击如树攻击）和十类有害意图。
Result: Opus 4.8在11.5%的意图上被最强自适应攻击（树攻击）突破，Fable 5为6.1%；总计产生1,620（Opus 4.8）和702（Fable 5）个裁判确认的有害完成，涵盖所有伤害类别，且无需人类专家参与。
Conclusion: 即使经过高度加固的前沿模型，在持续自动化攻击下仍存在显著的残余攻击面，聚合成功率不应被视为安全保证。

papers.title: The Stanford EDGAR Filings Dataset: Reconstructing U.S. Corporate and Financial Disclosures into Layout-Faithful and Token-Efficient Pretraining Data
papers.abstract_en: As high-quality public web corpora become increasingly exhausted, clean long-context documents have become a scarce and expensive source of training data for large language models (LLMs). Existing long-context corpora are often proprietary and costly to acquire, synthetically generated, or concentrated in narrow domains such as programming. We introduce the Stanford EDGAR Filings Dataset (SEFD), an open reconstruction of SEC filings into layout-faithful MultiMarkdown for financial language modeling and evaluation. SEFD makes audited financial statements, risk disclosures, ownership reports, accounting notes, and market-moving event filings usable as long-context pretraining data and as a basis for financial reasoning, forecasting, compliance, and document understanding. The resulting corpus is token-efficient, model-ready, and has less than 0.1% overlap with Common Crawl-derived corpora. We release SEFD-v1, a 152B-token initial public snapshot, and provide corpus-level analyses of a larger 18.5M-filing archive estimated at 550B tokens. We further introduce two SEFD-derived benchmarks: EDGAR-Forecast, which evaluates filing-grounded numerical forecasting after model knowledge cutoffs, and EDGAR-OCR, which evaluates transcription of complex financial tables.
papers.comment: Preprint. Includes appendix, tables, and figures

papers.title: DRFLOW: A Deep Research Benchmark for Personalized Workflow Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Deep research (DR) systems are increasingly used for complex information-seeking tasks, but existing works mainly focus on generating reports and summaries. In contrast, many enterprise tasks instead require an agent to identify concrete workflows which is a sequence of action-steps. For example, rather than summarizing budgeting policies, an agent should be able to determine the steps needed to answer a question such as: "How do I request new headcount given a fixed budget?". Therefore, we introduce DRFLOW, a benchmark for evaluating personalized workflows predicted by agents from heterogeneous sources. Each task requires the agent to identify relevant evidence from scattered sources, then use that evidence to predict the correct action-step sequence for the user's task. DRFLOW contains 100 tasks across five domains, with 1,246 reference workflow steps grounded in more than 3,900 sources. We define seven diagnostic metrics covering factual grounding, step recovery, structural ordering, condition resolution, and personalization. We further present DRFLOW-Agent (DRFA), a workflow-oriented reference agent to predict personalized workflow. We show that although DRFA improves over strong baseline agents (upto 10.02% average F1 score), there is substantial room for improvement remains across these workflow metrics, indicating that predicting complete and correct personalized workflows remains a challenging frontier for deep research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRFLOW是一个用于评估深度研究系统预测个性化工作流能力的基准，包含100个跨五个领域的任务，每个任务要求智能体从异构源中识别相关证据并预测正确的动作序列。作者定义了七项诊断指标，并提出了DRFLOW-Agent参考智能体，结果显示虽然比基线提升最多10.02% F1，但仍有较大改进空间。
Motivation: 现有深度研究系统主要关注生成报告和摘要，但企业任务常需要智能体识别具体工作流（即动作步骤序列），而缺乏评估这类能力的基准。
Method: 构建DRFLOW基准，包含100个任务、1246个参考工作流步骤、3900余个来源，覆盖五个领域；设计七项诊断指标（事实依据、步骤恢复、结构排序、条件解析、个性化等）；提出DRFLOW-Agent（DRFA）参考智能体用于预测个性化工作流。
Result: DRFA在平均F1分数上比强基线智能体提升最多10.02%，但在各项工作流指标上仍有显著改进空间，表明预测完整且正确的个性化工作流仍是挑战。
Conclusion: DRFLOW揭示了深度研究系统在个性化工作流预测方面的不足，为未来研究提供了基准和方向。

papers.title: Multi-Source Cybersecurity Logs: An ATT&CK-Labeled Dataset and SLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-stage cyberattacks span system, network, and browser logs. Detecting them requires correlating events across all three sources. Machine learning methods can learn these cross-source patterns, but they need labeled multi-source data. Existing public datasets fall short. Network-only datasets such as CICIDS and UNSW-NB15 miss host and browser activity. Host-focused datasets such as LMDG and CICAPT-IIoT lack browser telemetry. ATLAS includes all three sources but labels events only as malicious or benign, without MITRE Adversarial Tactics, Techniques, and Common Knowledge (ATT&CK) technique granularity. No public dataset combines all three sources with per-entry ATT&CK technique labels. We close the gap by building a multi-source log dataset of 870 sessions (70 attack, 800 benign) and approximately 2.3 million events. We captured system, network, and browser activity simultaneously on Windows endpoints. We labeled malicious events with ATT&CK technique IDs, covering 12 tactics and 53 techniques. We generated all attack data using real tools, including Remote Access Trojan (RAT), Command and Control (C2) tunnels, and cloud exfiltration. To demonstrate learnability, we fine-tuned three Small Language Models (SLMs) (Qwen2.5-1.5B, Llama-3.2-3B, Phi-4-Mini) using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). We compared each against its base variant across ten metrics on two tasks: chunk classification and ATT&CK technique identification. Fine-tuning improved every model on every metric. Chunk classification accuracy rose from approximately 8% in the base variants to between 90% and 97% after fine-tuning. Technique identification remained challenging, with the best exact-match accuracy at 42%, although high partial-match scores show the models captured most of the underlying reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个多源日志数据集，涵盖系统、网络和浏览器日志，共870个会话（70攻击，800良性），约230万事件，并为恶意事件标注了MITRE ATT&CK技术ID（12种战术，53种技术）。使用真实攻击工具生成攻击数据。微调三个小语言模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B, Llama-3.2-3B, Phi-4-Mini）进行分块分类和ATT&CK技术识别，分块分类准确率从约8%提升至90-97%，但技术识别精确匹配仅42%。

Method: 构建多源日志数据集（系统、网络、浏览器），使用真实攻击工具生成攻击，并标注ATT&CK技术ID。使用LoRA微调三个小语言模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B, Llama-3.2-3B, Phi-4-Mini），评估分块分类和技术识别。
Result: 微调后分块分类准确率从约8%提升至90-97%，技术识别精确匹配最高42%，但部分匹配分数较高。

papers.title: Kolmogorov Regression for Robust Diffusion Policies
papers.abstract_en: Finite-dimensional (FD) diffusion policies exhibit temporal drift owing to discretization artifacts that degrade long-horizon performance (when deployed on physical systems). We introduce a backward Kolmogorov equation that lifts diffusion policies to a Cameron-Martin space -- a subset of the Hilbert space. Essentially, replacing stochastic score matching with a deterministic boundary-value PDE problem. Our core innovation thrives on Gaussian measure theory whereupon the diffusion noise covariance operator is realized from a colored noise distribution which prescribes a notion of regularity on samples from the model at inference time. We train the diffusion model with a derived precision-weighted Cameron- Martin loss and a Kolmogorov residual is introduced as a PDE diagnostic during inference. These substitutions yield (i) convergence guarantees where the bound's constants depend on the effective rank of the kernel rather than action dimension, (ii) improved trajectory regularity via spectral weighting, and (iii) a deterministic failure detector without reward signals. Validation across two application domains demonstrates substantial improvements: on the PushT manipulation benchmark, the Cameron-Martin loss achieves a 17% improvement in maximum episode reward (0.95 vs. 0.78 for MSE) and 67.6% reduction in inter-step drifts during inference via the introduced residual magnitude. Similarly, on a 6-station manufacturing line with constant work-in-process (CONWIP) flow control, we achieve 28.4% lower RMSE than classical LSTM baselines; a high starvation-event recall (1.0 in test cycles), and effective bottleneck identification (Precision@1 = 1.0 in test set, 13x signal-to-noise ratio). We then certify the dispatch policies with Hamilton-Jacobi reachability theory which reduces deadlock events by 96% compared to uncontrolled dispatch over 100 simulated runs (351 events prevented).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于后向Kolmogorov方程的扩散策略，将有限维扩散策略提升至Cameron-Martin空间，以解决时间漂移问题。通过确定性边界值PDE问题替代随机分数匹配，并引入精度加权的Cameron-Martin损失和Kolmogorov残差作为推理诊断。在PushT操控基准上，最大回合奖励提升17%（0.95 vs 0.78），步间漂移降低67.6%；在6站制造线上，RMSE比LSTM低28.4%，饥饿事件召回率1.0，瓶颈识别精确率1.0，死锁事件减少96%。
Motivation: 有限维扩散策略因离散化伪影导致时间漂移，损害长时域性能。
Method: 推导后向Kolmogorov方程将策略提升至Cameron-Martin空间，用确定性PDE问题替代随机分数匹配；采用色噪声分布实现扩散噪声协方差算子，训练精度加权Cameron-Martin损失，推理时引入Kolmogorov残差作为诊断。

papers.title: A Diffusion Approximation for Temporal-Difference Learning with Linear Features under Markovian Noise
papers.abstract_en: Temporal difference (TD) learning with linear function approximation is a core method for policy evaluation. Its classical continuous-time description is an ordinary differential equation (ODE), which captures the asymptotic mean dynamics but neglects stochastic fluctuations determining the error floor. We introduce a stochastic differential equation (SDE) approximation for linear TD(0) under Markovian noise. The resulting model distinguishes the contraction dynamics governed by the projected Bellman operator from the influence of Markovian sampling. As a consequence, the model explains the constant-stepsize error floor through the interaction between Markovian long-run covariance and the contraction geometry of the projected Bellman operator.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: IUU+DB: Tracking Illegal, Unreported, and Unregulated Fishing, Seafood Fraud, and Labor Abuse through LLM-driven Information Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Illegal, unreported, and unregulated fishing (IUU) traditionally refers to fishing activities that violate applicable laws or occur in areas that lack applicable laws. We propose the term IUU+ to capture a broader suite of fisheries sector environmental and associated supply chain trade-related crimes and behaviors. Although IUU+ activity is widely recognized as a serious threat to marine ecosystems, markets, and livelihoods, a quantitative understanding of these incidents, e.g., their frequency, geography, species, actors, and patterns in the type of illicit activity, remains difficult to obtain. We propose IUU+DB, a large language model driven system for building a global incident database of IUU+ activity. The system ingests heterogeneous documents, classifies whether they describe relevant incidents, extracts key data elements such as actors, locations, species, vessels, violations, and enforcement outcomes, and supports deduplication and trend analysis. Case studies and validation results show that IUU+DB can help organize fragmented evidence, surface geographic and behavioral hotspots, support fisheries-domain specific research in academia and non-government organizations, assist source and species risk assessments for industry, and provide support for policy implementation and targeted enforcement efforts to government agencies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IUU+DB系统，利用大语言模型从异构文档中提取非法、未报告和无管制捕捞（IUU+）相关信息，构建全球事件数据库。系统包括文档分类、关键信息提取（如行为者、地点、物种、船只、违规行为及执法结果）、去重和趋势分析功能，案例研究验证了其有效性。
Motivation: IUU+活动（包括非法捕捞、海鲜欺诈和劳工滥用）对海洋生态、市场及生计构成严重威胁，但缺乏量化理解其频率、地理分布、物种、行为者及模式。传统方法难以从碎片化证据中整合全局信息。
Method: 提出IUU+DB系统，采用大语言模型驱动的工作流：首先对异构文档进行相关性分类，然后提取结构化字段（如行为者、地点、物种、船只、违规及执法结果），并支持去重与趋势分析。
Result: 案例研究与验证结果表明，IUU+DB能够有效组织碎片化证据，识别地理和行为热点，支持学术研究、非政府组织分析、行业风险评估以及政府政策实施与执法决策。
Conclusion: IUU+DB通过LLM驱动的信息提取，为理解IUU+活动提供了量化工具，但摘要未提及明显局限，需依赖文档可用性与模型准确性。

papers.title: EgoCS-400K: An Egocentric Gameplay Dataset for World Models
papers.abstract_en: The shift from video generation to interactive world modeling places new demands on data: beyond captioned videos, world models require temporally aligned video-action-language trajectories grounded in the actions, camera motion, states, and events that drive future scene changes. However, such data is difficult to obtain at scale. Web video datasets offer broad visual coverage but lack executable actions and reliable states; robotic datasets provide action and state supervision but are costly and limited in scene diversity; and existing simulators often lack large-scale human-driven interaction trajectories. In this paper, we introduce EgoCS-400K, a large-scale replay-grounded egocentric Counter-Strike dataset for world models, built from public professional CS and CS2 match demos that preserve human gameplay trajectories and enable parsing, replaying, rendering, and temporal alignment. We extract player states, view directions, movements, keyboard/button inputs, view-angle changes, weapon usage, game events, and round-level context, and render clean first-person videos from the same trajectories. EgoCS-400K contains over 400,000 first-person videos and 10,000 hours of gameplay from more than 1,000 matches and 40,000 rounds, covering 13 maps and 10 player viewpoints per round. It supports a range of interactive visual modeling tasks, including action-conditioned future prediction, state- and event-aware scene rollout, replay-grounded captioning, and agent egocentric action understanding. By connecting visual observations with human actions, camera motion, game states, and events at scale, EgoCS-400K serves as a practical bridge between passive web videos, controllable game simulation, and costly real-world embodied data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了EgoCS-400K，一个大规模、基于回放的自我中心反恐精英数据集，用于世界模型。该数据集包含超过40万第一人称视频和1万小时游戏时间，从专业CS和CS2比赛演示中解析出玩家状态、视角、动作等，并支持动作条件未来预测、状态感知场景展开等交互式视觉建模任务。
Motivation: 世界模型需要时间对齐的视频-动作-语言轨迹，但现有数据集难以大规模获取：网络视频缺乏可执行动作和可靠状态，机器人数据集成本高且场景多样性有限，模拟器缺乏大规模人类驱动交互轨迹。
Method: 从公共专业CS和CS2比赛演示中提取人类游戏轨迹，解析玩家状态、视角、移动、键盘/按钮输入、视角变化、武器使用、游戏事件和回合上下文，并渲染出干净的自我中心视频。数据集包含超过40万视频、1万小时游戏时间，覆盖13张地图和每个回合10个玩家视角。
Result: 数据集规模为超过40万第一人称视频，1万小时游戏时间，来自1000多场比赛和4万回合。
Conclusion: EgoCS-400K作为被动网络视频、可控游戏模拟和昂贵真实世界具身数据之间的实用桥梁，支持多种交互式视觉建模任务。

papers.title: A Convex Quasilinearization Method for Solving Nonlinear PDEs with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We present a numerical method for the forward solution of nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs) in which Bellman-Kalaba quasilinearization reduces the nonlinear problem to a sequence of linear subproblems, each discretized by collocation onto a trial space that is linear in its parameters and solved by a single direct linear least-squares QR factorization. The trial space, which we term Linear-in-Learnables (LiL), comprises representations whose trainable parameters enter linearly, including random-feature extreme learning machines, spectral polynomial bases, and trigonometric expansions, each implemented as a physics-informed neural network. The method thus replaces the nonconvex gradient-based training that limits standard PINNs with a convex per-step solve. We establish local Newton-Kantorovich convergence of the outer iteration to a residual-limited neighborhood under an explicit smallness condition, with the limiting accuracy governed by the best-approximation residual of the trial space rather than by an optimization tolerance. The method, denoted LiL-Q, is assessed on seven benchmarks spanning scalar nonlinear PDEs (Bratu, viscous Burgers, Buckley-Leverett), coupled systems (plane-strain elasticity and the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations in two and three spatial dimensions), and steady-state Darcy flow with heterogeneous permeability. Across these problems, LiL-Q converges in single-digit outer iterations in most cases, even at the coarsest basis sizes and independent of the parameter count. When the exact solution lies in the span of the trial space, the method recovers it to machine precision in a single solve. On the Navier-Stokes benchmarks, it matches or exceeds published PINN solvers with up to two orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters, without gradient-based optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种凸拟线性化方法（LiL-Q），通过Bellman-Kalaba拟线性化将非线性PDE转化为线性子问题序列，每个子问题采用线性参量试验空间（如随机特征极限学习机、谱多项式基等）配点离散，并通过直接QR分解求解。该方法避免了标准PINN的非凸梯度优化，具有局部Newton-Kantorovich收敛性保证，且精度受限于试验空间的最佳逼近残差而非优化容差。在七个基准测试（包括Bratu、粘性Burgers、Buckley-Leverett、平面应变弹性、不可压缩Navier-Stokes、非均质Darcy流）中，LiL-Q在单次外迭代内收敛（多数情况），且参数数量比现有PINN解算器少两个数量级，无需梯度优化。
Motivation: 标准PINN依赖非凸梯度优化，存在训练不稳定、收敛慢、参数效率低等问题，限制了其在非线性PDE求解中的应用。
Method: 采用Bellman-Kalaba拟线性化将非线性PDE转化为线性子问题序列，每个子问题通过线性参量试验空间（LiL，如随机特征极限学习机、谱多项式基等）配点离散，并直接通过线性最小二乘QR分解求解。外迭代具有局部Newton-Kantorovich收敛性。
Result: 在七个基准上，LiL-Q在粗基大小下通常单次外迭代收敛；若精确解在试验空间内，单次求解可达机器精度；在Navier-Stokes基准上，参数量比现有PINN解算器少两个数量级且性能相当或更优。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种无梯度优化的非线性PDE求解框架，理论收敛性与参数效率优于标准PINN，但适用性受限于拟线性化的小条件假设和试验空间的选择。

papers.title: All Smoke, No Alarm: Oracle Signals in Agent-Authored Test Code
papers.abstract_en: Software practitioners increasingly use AI coding agents that generate test code alongside production code in open source pull requests (PRs). Recent studies report more than 932,000 agent-authored PRs across more than 116,000 repositories, yet whether their test files contain meaningful verification logic remains underexplored. Test files lacking explicit assertions execute code without verifying behavior, so quality gates based on test-file presence overestimate verification strength. The goal of this paper is to help practitioners assess the verification strength of agent-authored patches by characterizing oracle signals and their link to merge outcomes and review effort. We conduct an empirical study of 86,156 test-file patches from 33,596 agent-authored PRs across 2,807 GitHub repositories produced by five coding agents: OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Devin, Cursor, and Claude Code. A qualitative analysis of 384 stratified patches informs a syntactic taxonomy of eight oracle signal categories. Applied at scale, 80.2% of test patches contain weak or no explicit oracle signals. While raw merge rates are lower for strong-oracle PRs, a regression analysis adjusting for agent, PR size, repository popularity, task type, and language shows strong oracles significantly improve merge likelihood (OR = 1.28, p < 0.001). Our findings suggest that test file counts substantially overestimate verification strength and that practitioners can adopt oracle-aware quality checks to more accurately evaluate agent-authored contributions.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 8th IEEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Testing, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文针对AI编码智能体生成的测试代码是否包含有效验证逻辑（oracle信号）展开实证研究。分析了来自5种智能体（OpenAI Codex、GitHub Copilot、Devin、Cursor、Claude Code）的33,596个PR中的86,156个测试文件补丁，发现80.2%的补丁仅含弱或无显式oracle信号。回归分析表明，强oracle显著提升合并概率（OR=1.28, p<0.001），但测试文件数量会高估验证强度。
Motivation: AI智能体在PR中大量生成测试代码，但这些测试文件是否包含真正的断言（oracle）来验证行为尚不清楚，基于测试文件存在的质量门控可能高估验证强度。
Method: 对来自5个编码智能体的86,156个测试文件补丁进行实证研究：先对384个分层采样补丁进行定性分析，建立包含8种oracle信号类别的句法分类法；再大规模量化oracle信号分布，并通过回归分析（调整智能体、PR大小、仓库流行度、任务类型、语言）关联合并结果和审查工作量。
Result: 80.2%的测试补丁包含弱或无显式oracle信号；强oracle的PR合并优势比为1.28（p<0.001），而原始合并率低于弱oracle的PR。
Conclusion: 测试文件数量会大幅高估验证强度，从业者应采用oracle感知的质量检查来更准确评估AI智能体贡献。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 论文针对AI编码智能体生成的测试代码是否包含有效验证逻辑（oracle信号）展开实证研究。分析了来自5种智能体（OpenAI Codex、GitHub Copilot、Devin、Cursor、Claude Code）的33,596个PR中的86,156个测试文件补丁，发现80.2%的补丁仅含弱或无显式oracle信号。回归分析表明，强oracle显著提升合并概率（OR=1.28, p<0.001），但测试文件数量会高估验证强度。
summary_sections.motivation: AI智能体在PR中大量生成测试代码，但这些测试文件是否包含真正的断言（oracle）来验证行为尚不清楚，基于测试文件存在的质量门控可能高估验证强度。
summary_sections.method: 对来自5个编码智能体的86,156个测试文件补丁进行实证研究：先对384个分层采样补丁进行定性分析，建立包含8种oracle信号类别的句法分类法；再大规模量化oracle信号分布，并通过回归分析（调整智能体、PR大小、仓库流行度、任务类型、语言）关联合并结果和审查工作量。

papers.title: Evaluating Open-Source LLMs for Multi-Label ATT&CK Technique Classification on CTI Reports
papers.abstract_en: Classifying Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) using MITRE Adversarial Tactics, Techniques, and Common Knowledge (ATT&CK) is essential for proactive defense, but historically required extensive human effort. Pre-Large Language Model (LLM) automation sped up this process, but could not resolve the complex language and multi-step attack patterns found in unstructured CTI reports. LLMs addressed previous limitations by using contextual reasoning to understand unstructured text. However, current evaluations rely on simplified, single-technique sentences that ignore the complexity of real-world CTI reports, which often leads to inflated performance results. Consequently, the baseline performance of open-source LLMs on complex unstructured CTI reports remains unevaluated. To address this gap, we constructed a ground-truth dataset of 2,076 human-annotated sentences (1,281 technique-positive, 795 negative) from 83 complex unstructured CTI reports. These sentences were mapped to 114 unique ATT&CK techniques using a six-phase annotation process, achieving \k{appa} = 0.68 inter-annotator agreement. Using this dataset, we evaluated seven open-source LLMs ranging from 8B to 236B parameters across prompt strategy and temperature configurations. The highest-performing LLM achieved a micro-averaged F1 score of 0.22, establishing the empirical baseline for multi-label ATT&CK classification on complex unstructured CTI. Parameter size showed a statistically significant positive correlation with F1 score. Prompt strategy and temperature produced no statistically significant gains across model configurations. These results indicate that current open-source LLMs are insufficient for production-grade ATT&CK classification. The dataset, benchmark, and findings provide a reproducible foundation for future CTI research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个由83份复杂非结构化网络威胁情报（CTI）报告中2076条人工标注句子组成的数据集，映射到114种ATT&CK技术，并评估了7个开源大语言模型（8B-236B参数）进行多标签ATT&CK技术分类的能力。最佳模型微平均F1分数仅为0.22，表明当前开源LLM尚不足以用于生产级ATT&CK分类。
Motivation: 现有评估多基于简化的单技术句子，忽略了真实CTI报告的复杂性，导致性能虚高。开源LLM在复杂非结构化CTI报告上的基线性能尚未被评估。
Method: 构建包含2076条人工标注句子的数据集（1281条正样本、795条负样本），通过六阶段标注流程映射到114种ATT&CK技术，一致性κ=0.68。在多种提示策略和温度配置下评估了7个开源LLM。
Result: 最优模型取得微平均F1分数0.22；参数规模与F1分数呈显著正相关；提示策略和温度设置无显著统计差异。
Conclusion: 当前开源LLM不足以用于生产级ATT&CK分类，该数据集、基准测试和发现为未来CTI研究提供了可复现的基础。

papers.title: The Measurement Gap in the Automation of EU Law: Benchmarking Doctrinal Legal Reasoning under the EU AI Act
papers.abstract_en: Large language models now produce legal text of at least median quality, yet no existing benchmark can evaluate whether they perform doctrinal legal reasoning, which forms the interpretive core of legal work, rather than the ancillary, paralegal tasks that most current legal-AI evaluations measure. This measurement gap is not only methodological but legal: the EU AI Act makes "appropriate accuracy" a binding requirement for high-risk AI used in the judicial domain, yet that requirement cannot acquire operational content without the very doctrinal-reasoning benchmark the field lacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出，当前大语言模型（LLM）虽能生成中等质量的法律文本，但缺乏评估其是否执行教义性法律推理（doctrinal legal reasoning）的基准。欧盟AI法案要求司法领域的高风险AI具备“适当准确性”，而这一要求因缺少此类基准而无法操作化。论文强调，这一测量差距既是方法论问题也是法律问题，必须填补。
Motivation: 现有法律AI基准仅评估辅助性任务（如合同分析、法律检索），未能触及法律推理的核心——教义性法律解释。欧盟AI法案对司法AI的准确性要求缺乏可操作的基准来定义和测量。
Conclusion: 论文呼吁开发教义性法律推理的基准，以使欧盟AI法案的适当准确性要求具有实质内容，从而推动法律AI的自动化。

papers.title: ReAge3D: Re-Aging 3D Faces with View Consistency
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel framework for realistic and controllable 3D face re-aging which produces highly detailed, identity-preserving results. Existing 3D editing methods, while effective for coarse semantic changes, are not well suited for re-aging, as even small inconsistencies across re-aged 2D views can lead to over-smoothing of subtle but perceptually important age-related details. To address this challenge, we first introduce a 2D diffusion-based re-aging model, DiffReaging, trained on synthetically generated image pairs. We further propose a center-out editing propagation strategy that leverages this re-aging model to reconstruct multi-view-consistent re-aged images. Specifically, starting from a re-aged frontal pivot view, we reconstruct the remaining views through warping and our proposed Masked-DiffReaging process. By injecting existing content at every step of the diffusion process, Masked-DiffReaging ensures that the reconstructed regions remain coherent with existing pixels. The resulting consistent set of re-aged views supervises the optimization of the re-aged 3D representation. Our method outperforms existing 3D editing techniques both visually and quantitatively, enabling smooth, fine-grained control over age transformations in 3D face models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReAge3D，一个用于3D人脸逼真可控年龄编辑的框架。通过引入2D扩散模型DiffReaging和中心向外编辑传播策略，生成多视图一致的年龄变化图像，从而优化3D表示。方法在保持身份细节和视图一致性上优于现有3D编辑技术。
Motivation: 现有3D编辑方法适用于粗粒度语义变化，但在人脸年龄编辑上，即使微小的视图不一致也会导致年龄相关细节过平滑，缺乏专门针对人脸年龄编辑的3D方法。
Method: 提出DiffReaging，一个基于合成图像对训练的2D扩散年龄编辑模型；进一步提出中心向外编辑传播策略，从正面枢轴视图开始，通过扭曲和Masked-DiffReaging过程重建其他视图，确保多视图一致性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在视觉质量和定量指标上均优于现有3D编辑技术，实现了平滑、细粒度的人脸年龄变换控制。
Conclusion: 本文的贡献在于提供了首个专门针对3D人脸年龄编辑的框架，通过视图一致性监督解决细节丢失问题，但方法依赖合成训练数据，真实场景泛化性待验证。

papers.title: Learning Cardiac Electrophysiology Digital Twins Through Agentic Discovery of Hybrid Structure
papers.abstract_en: Building personalized cardiac electrophysiology (EP) digital twins requires identifying the appropriate model structure for each patient, not merely fitting parameters. Traditional methods rely on experts to manually prescribe hybrid physics-neural architectures, which requires deep domain expertise and does not transfer across patients. Recent works have applied large language models (LLMs) to generate or act as hybrid models. However, despite their promising generalization capacity, these LLM-based methods lack the structural priors needed for stable cardiac simulations. Hence, we propose LEADS, a framework that formulates cardiac EP domain knowledge as a structured action space and utilizes an LLM agent to discover hybrid models. The agent follows an iterative reasoning-and-action loop to select, combine, and refine hybrid models, whilst gradient descent handles parameter fitting. The proposed LEADS designs every candidate model towards physically grounded, interpretable, and numerically stable, while allowing open-ended architectural discovery. We validate LEADS on synthetic data with three ground-truth reaction models and on real cardiac EP data, demonstrating that it outperforms both human-designed hybrid models and other LLM-based hybrid modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LEADS框架，利用LLM代理在结构化动作空间中探索混合物理-神经网络模型，用于个性化心脏电生理数字孪生的结构发现。摘要显示该方法在合成数据和真实心脏数据上优于人工设计模型和其他LLM方法。
Motivation: 传统心脏电生理数字孪生需要专家手动设计混合模型结构，缺乏跨患者泛化能力；现有LLM方法缺乏心脏仿真的结构先验，导致不稳定。
Method: 将心脏电生理领域知识形式化为结构化动作空间，LLM代理通过迭代推理-行动循环选择、组合和优化混合模型，参数拟合由梯度下降完成。
Result: 在合成数据（三种真实反应模型）和真实心脏电生理数据上，LEADS优于人工设计及其他LLM混合建模方法。
Conclusion: LEADS确保候选模型的物理基础、可解释性和数值稳定性，同时允许开放式架构发现，为个性化数字孪生提供新途径。

papers.title: Neural Tree Reconstruction for the Open Forest Observatory
papers.abstract_en: The Open Forest Observatory (OFO) is a collaboration across universities and other partners to make low-cost forest mapping accessible to ecologists, land managers, and the general public. The OFO is building both a database of geospatial forest data as well as open-source methods and tools for forest mapping by uncrewed aerial vehicle. Such data are useful for a variety of climate applications including prioritizing reforestation efforts, informing wildfire hazard reduction, and monitoring carbon sequestration. In the current iteration of the OFO's forest map database, 3D tree maps are created using classical structure-from-motion techniques. This approach is prone to artifacts, lacks detail, and has particular difficulty on the forest floor where the input data (overhead imagery) has limited visibility. These reconstruction errors can potentially propagate to the downstream scientific tasks (e.g. a wildfire simulation.) Advances in 3D reconstruction, including methods like Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), produce higher quality results that are more robust to sparse views and support data-driven priors. We explore ways to incorporate NeRFs into the OFO dataset, outline future work to support even more state-of-the-art 3D vision models, and describe the importance of high-quality 3D reconstructions for forestry applications.
papers.comment: Published as a workshop paper at "Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning", ICLR 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了开放森林观测站（OFO）的神经树重建方法，旨在通过低成本无人机进行森林测绘。当前使用经典运动恢复结构（SfM）方法存在伪影和细节缺失问题，尤其在森林地面区域。作者探索将神经辐射场（NeRF）集成到OFO数据集中，以提高重建质量，并讨论了高质量3D重建对林业应用的重要性。
Motivation: 现有OFO森林地图数据库使用经典SfM技术创建3D树图，易产生伪影、缺乏细节，且在森林地面区域表现不佳，这些错误可能影响下游科学任务（如野火模拟）。
Method: 探索将NeRF等先进3D重建方法融入OFO数据集，以改进稀疏视图下的重建鲁棒性和质量，并支持数据驱动的先验知识。
Result: 论文未提供定量结果，仅报告了通过NeRF方法有望获得更高质量的3D重建，并能更好地处理森林地面等困难区域。
Conclusion: 高质量3D重建对于林业应用（如再造林优先排序、野火风险降低、碳汇监测）至关重要，未来工作将支持更先进的3D视觉模型。

papers.title: WEQA: Wearable hEalth Question Answering with Query-Adaptive Agentic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Language models are remarkably capable at medical question answering, in some cases surpassing the accuracy of general physicians. However, answering questions about wearable health data remains challenging and understudied, as these ubiquitous sensors produce continuous, high-dimensional, and longitudinal data, which is non-trivial to align with text-centric distributions in LLM pretraining. The diversity of sensor modalities and user intents cannot be effectively handled by a fixed reasoning workflow or a single pretrained foundation model. To address these challenges, we propose WEQA, a query-adaptive agent framework that unifies LLM reasoning with specialized wearable analytical and modeling tools. An LLM controller is employed to synthesize execution plans and dynamically route each query to the appropriate combination of sensor analysis and pretrained models, and perform grounded response auditing with external knowledge. We also curate a benchmark spanning four open wearable datasets comprising analytic and predictive tasks in three different health domains. Experiments show that our framework is 24% more accurate than LLM and agentic baselines, and a blinded study with 12 medical experts and 8 users shows substantial gains in usefulness and clinical soundness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可穿戴健康数据问答任务，提出查询自适应智能体框架WEQA，利用LLM控制器协调专业分析工具，并在多个公开数据集上展示比基线高24%的准确率，盲评中医生和用户认可其有用性与临床合理性。
Motivation: 可穿戴传感器产生的连续、高维、纵向数据难以与LLM的文本分布对齐，固定推理流程或单一预训练模型无法有效处理传感器模态多样性与用户意图多样性。
Method: 提出WEQA框架，由LLM控制器合成执行计划，动态将查询路由到适当的传感器分析与预训练模型组合，并用外部知识进行基于证据的响应审核。
Result: 在四个可穿戴数据集上，WEQA比LLM和智能体基线准确率高24%；12名医学专家和8名用户的盲评显示其有用性和临床合理性有显著提升。
Conclusion: 查询自适应智能体推理可有效解决可穿戴健康数据问答的挑战，提升准确性与临床可用性。

summary_sections.result: 在四个可穿戴数据集上，WEQA比LLM和智能体基线准确率高24%；12名医学专家和8名用户的盲评显示其有用性和临床合理性有显著提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 查询自适应智能体推理可有效解决可穿戴健康数据问答的挑战，提升准确性与临床可用性。

papers.title: Memory as a Wasting Asset: Pricing Flash Endurance for Embodied Agents, and the Limits of Doing So
papers.abstract_en: A robot's flash endurance is a non-renewable stock: every persisted write spends one of a few thousand program/erase cycles and never refills, yet no fielded robot memory system prices which memories are worth an erase cycle. We treat embodied memory as depreciating capital and price that stock with a single endurance shadow price $η$, which makes cost-minimizing placement across a RAM / on-board NVM / cloud hierarchy a threshold in a wear-augmented per-byte index. The index is cost-optimal whatever the sign of the value-write association $χ$; only when $χ> 0$ does the optimum turn non-monotone, sending a robot's most valuable memories off its flash. The pivot is thus empirical, and we measure $χ$ on real robot logs at a pre-specified gate: its sign is a property of the deployment regime -- positive on recurrent long-horizon manipulation ($\hatχ \approx +1.0 \times 10^{-3}$, replicated at full power), null on a shorter-horizon suite, and negative on non-recurrent teleoperation. Two boundaries scope the result. The endurance budget is dormant on premium 3,000-P/E TLC at datasheet prices and binding on the commodity QLC/eMMC ($\sim$1,000 P/E) that cheaper edge robots run. And where it binds, a learned wear-aware controller only ties price-based routing on task value, because realized value is tier-invariant across RAM, NVM, and cloud: the rent governs device lifetime and cost, not task performance. Whether wear-aware placement improves task value remains open -- $χ$ is measured against a value proxy, and the non-monotone optimum, while proven, is not yet observed in data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究机器人闪存耐久性的经济定价问题，将机器人的记忆视为一种不断贬值的资本，并提出一个单一的耐久性影子价格η，用于在RAM、片上NVM和云存储层次结构中实现成本最优的数据放置。通过在真实机器人日志上测量价值-写入关联χ，发现χ的符号取决于部署模式：重复长视野操作时为正，短视野时为零，非重复遥操作时为负。结果在高端TLC（3000 P/E）闪存上耐久性预算冗余，但在廉价QLC/eMMC（约1000 P/E）上具有约束力。
Motivation: 现有机器人内存系统未考虑闪存程序/擦除周期的非可再生性，导致在写入时未评估记忆是否值得消耗一次擦除周期，造成闪存寿命浪费。
Method: 将记忆视为折旧资本，引入单一耐久性影子价格η，构建磨损增强的每字节索引，使得在RAM/片上NVM/云层次中的成本最小化放置成为阈值问题。
Result: 在真实机器人日志上测量χ，发现其在重复长视野操作中显著为正（约+1.0×10⁻³），短视野任务中为零，非重复遥操作中为负。耐久性预算在高端TLC上闲置，在廉价QLC/eMMC上具有约束力；磨损感知控制器的路由仅与基于价格的路由在任务价值上相当。
Conclusion: 磨损感知放置是否能提升任务价值仍不确定，因为χ的测量依赖价值代理，且非单调最优虽经证明但未在数据中观察到。

papers.title: Your AI Travel Agent Would Book You a Bullfight: An Agentic Benchmark for Implicit Animal Welfare in Frontier AI Models
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are moving from advisors to actors, booking travel, planning menus, and running procurement on behalf of users. Existing benchmarks for AI and animal welfare evaluate model text responses to question-answer prompts, leaving open whether the welfare reasoning surfaced in those responses transfers to agentic deployment where the model must take actions with tools. We introduce TAC (Travel Agent Compassion), the first agentic benchmark measuring whether AI agents avoid options involving animal exploitation when acting on behalf of users. TAC presents an AI agent with twelve hand-authored travel booking scenarios across six categories of animal exploitation, augmented to forty-eight samples to control for price, rating, and position confounds. We evaluate seven frontier models from four labs. Every model scores below the chance level of sixty-four percent, with the best performer (Claude Opus 4.7) at fifty-three percent. A single welfare-aware sentence in the system prompt yields gains of forty-seven to sixty-three percentage points in Claude and GPT-5.5, twenty-six points in GPT-5.2, and under twelve points in DeepSeek and Gemini. An auxiliary Inspect Scout audit of 288 base-condition transcripts from the top two performers, using Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite as judge, flags zero transcripts for evaluation awareness, suggesting the below-chance rates do not stem from the models recognising the evaluation. We discuss implications for category-level variation across cultural domains, the limits of text-response welfare benchmarks, and the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice systemic risk framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出第一个衡量AI代理在用户委托行动时是否避免动物剥削的基准TAC（Travel Agent Compassion）。评估了7个前沿模型，所有模型在12个旅行预订场景（扩展至48样本，控制混淆变量）中表现低于随机水平（64%），最佳Claude Opus 4.7仅53%。在系统提示中加入单句动物福利意识可使Claude和GPT-5.5提升47-63个百分点，但对DeepSeek和Gemini提升有限。辅助审计表明模型并未意识到评估。
Motivation: 现有AI与动物福利基准仅评估模型对问答提示的文本反应，未检验该福利推理是否迁移至模型需使用工具采取行动的代理部署场景。
Method: 构建TAC基准，包含12个手工编写的旅游预订场景，涵盖六类动物剥削，通过价格、评分、位置干扰项扩展至48样本。评估7个前沿模型，并测试系统提示中添加福利意识句子的效果。使用Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite作为裁判对288份基础条件转录进行审计。
Result: 所有模型得分低于随机水平64%，最佳模型Claude Opus 4.7为53%。福利意识提示使Claude和GPT-5.5提升47-63个百分点，GPT-5.2提升26个百分点，DeepSeek和Gemini提升不足12个百分点。审计未发现模型意识到评估。
Conclusion: 讨论跨文化领域类别变化、文本反应福利基准的局限性，以及对EU通用AI实践准则系统性风险框架的启示。

papers.title: Descriptor: Certus Caliber Classification Gunshot Dataset (C3GD)
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we introduce the Certus Caliber Classification Gunshot Dataset (C3GD), a publicly accessible data set developed for the analysis of firearm muzzle blast sounds. The dataset aims to provide a wide variety of firearms, calibers, cartridges, microphones, and microphone locations with metadata detailed beyond what is currently otherwise available. It comprises more than 8000 field-collected data points from 28 firearms across 16 calibers. Because data collection in the field is costly, much of the existing research has been done using gunshot audio collected from the internet, which increases the risk of low-quality data and label noise. This dataset is primarily focused on caliber classification, but can also be used for gunshot detection, audio separation, and audio signal processing, providing a diversified and real-world reference. The dataset aims to provide enough diversity to be able to generalize to more real-world applications while also providing enough metadata for detailed academic analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个公开的枪声数据集C3GD，包含超过8000个野外采集的枪声数据点，涵盖28种枪支、16种口径。数据集旨在提供多样化的真实世界枪声样本，用于口径分类、枪声检测等任务，并附带详细元数据以支持学术分析。
Motivation: 现有枪声研究多依赖网络采集的低质量音频，存在标签噪声和数据多样性不足的问题。本文旨在提供一个高质量、多样性强的野外采集数据集，以支持更可靠的枪声分类和音频处理研究。
Method: 通过野外实地采集，使用多种麦克风和位置记录28种枪支、16种口径的枪声，共计8000多个数据点，并提供详细的元数据。
Result: 数据集包含8000+样本，覆盖28种枪支和16种口径，旨在提高口径分类的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该数据集为枪声分析和信号处理提供了多样化、高质量的真实世界参考，可用于多种任务，但未在摘要中报告具体实验结果。

papers.title: Knowledge Reutilization in Meta-Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Meta-reinforcement learning enables fast adaptation by extracting shared structure from related tasks, but existing end-to-end methods often couple task inference with embodiment-specific control. This coupling can obscure non-parametric task semantics, reduce sample efficiency, and limit cross-agent reuse. We propose a meta-knowledge reutilization framework that learns task-level knowledge on a dynamics-simplified agent and transfers it to heterogeneous agents. The framework uses a Bayesian non-parametric prior to organize latent task modes and a high-level policy to generate task-level magnitude guidance. To bridge reusable task knowledge with different embodiments, we introduce a semantic-magnitude interface and a lightweight temporal adaptor, which convert frozen meta-knowledge into temporally aligned subgoals for embodiment-specific low-level controllers. Experiments on multiple locomotion agents show that our framework reduces final-step tracking error by 94.75% -- 99.79% compared with recent state-of-the-art baselines and achieves comparable deployment performance with about 23.8% of their interaction data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对元强化学习中任务知识跨智能体复用困难的问题，提出一个元知识复用框架。该框架在动力学简化的智能体上学习任务级知识，并通过语义-幅度接口和轻量级时间适配器将冻结的元知识转换为异构智能体的子目标。在多个运动智能体上的实验表明，该方法相比近期基线将最终步跟踪误差降低94.75%-99.79%，并仅需约23.8%的交互数据即可达到相当部署性能。
Motivation: 现有端到端元强化学习方法常将任务推理与智能体特定的控制耦合，模糊了非参数化任务语义，降低样本效率，并限制了跨智能体知识复用。
Method: 提出元知识复用框架：在动力学简化的智能体上学习任务级知识，使用贝叶斯非参数先验组织潜在任务模式，通过高层策略生成任务级幅度指导；引入语义-幅度接口和轻量级时间适配器，将冻结的元知识转换为异构智能体低层控制器的时间对齐子目标。
Result: 在多个运动智能体实验上，最终步跟踪误差相比近期SOTA基线降低94.75%-99.79%，且仅需约23.8%的交互数据即可达到相当的部署性能。
Conclusion: 该框架证明了在异构智能体间复用任务级元知识可以有效提升样本效率和跟踪精度，摘要未提及明显局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Understanding and Measuring COGNITIVE ATROPHY in LLM Behaviour
papers.abstract_en: Recent incidents involving LLMs used for mental-health support reveal a critical evaluation gap: surface-level safety scores do not capture how models behave across realistic, emotionally sensitive interactions over time. Existing benchmarks measure knowledge, safety, or static response quality, but miss whether LLM interactions help users keep reflecting, coping, and making decisions themselves. We formalize this missing dimension as COGNITIVE ATROPHY, a process-level behavioural measure in AI-mediated mental-health support distinct from safety and helpfulness. To measure it, we introduce COGNITIVE ATROPHY BENCH, a clinically grounded benchmark built from 1,576 fully human-generated counseling conversations, 15,680 turns, and 42,230 responses from five LLMs. Three clinical and neuropsychology experts developed a 20-attribute schema spanning user context, response behaviour, and global risk flags; six trained clinical reviewers applied it with span-grounded evidence, producing 5,324 reviewer judgments. We further introduce the User-Input Risk Index (UIRI), the Cognitive Atrophy Risk Index (ARI), and trajectory summaries. Across five LLMs, models show a consistent moderate-to-high level of atrophy-aligned behaviour across single and multi-turn settings. While models generally respond to overt safety cues, they adapt less reliably when users seek solutions or decisions. The dominant recurring patterns are directive advice, problem-solving, recommendation responses, topic shifts, and forms of validation that may reinforce dependence rather than reflection. Our work makes COGNITIVE ATROPHY measurable and provides a foundation for auditing model behaviour in sensitive LLM conversations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM在心理健康支持中的行为缺失，提出认知萎缩（COGNITIVE ATROPHY）概念，即模型互动导致用户反思、应对和决策能力下降的过程级度量。构建了COGNITIVE ATROPHY BENCH基准，包含1,576个人工咨询对话和专家标注的20属性模式。测试五个LLM发现模型普遍表现出中高程度的萎缩行为，倾向于指令性建议和问题解决，可能强化用户依赖。
Motivation: 现有安全评分无法捕捉模型在真实情感交互中长期影响，缺乏过程层面行为度量，需要评估LLM是否促使用户保持自主思考。
Method: 基于1,576个完全人工生成的咨询对话构建基准，包含15,680轮次和五个LLM的42,230条响应；三位临床与神经心理学专家设计20属性模式，六位训练有素的临床评审员进行跨度证据标注，产生5,324条判断。引入用户输入风险指数（UIRI）、认知萎缩风险指数（ARI）和轨迹摘要。
Result: 在五个LLM的单轮和多轮设置中，模型表现出一致的中高程度萎缩行为。模型能响应明显安全线索，但在用户寻求解决方案或决策时适应能力差；主导模式包括指令性建议、问题解决、推荐响应、话题转换和可能强化依赖的验证方式。
Conclusion: 使认知萎缩可测量，为审计LLM在敏感对话中的行为提供了基础。

summary_sections.result: 在五个LLM的单轮和多轮设置中，模型表现出一致的中高程度萎缩行为。模型能响应明显安全线索，但在用户寻求解决方案或决策时适应能力差；主导模式包括指令性建议、问题解决、推荐响应、话题转换和可能强化依赖的验证方式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 使认知萎缩可测量，为审计LLM在敏感对话中的行为提供了基础。

papers.title: Predicting Immune Biomarkers with MultiModal Mixture-of-Expert Pathology Foundation Models Empowers Precision Oncology
papers.abstract_en: Predicting immune biomarkers associated with the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) is critical for advancing precision oncology, yet existing approaches are largely limited to single image modalities and suffer from insufficient resolution and incomplete utilization of complementary clinical and biological information. Here we introduce MixTIME, a multimodal foundation model that leverages a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture to integrate pathology foundation models trained across distinct modalities: image only (UNIv2), image text (CONCHv1.5), and image transcriptomic (STPath) representations for pixel-level and slide-level prediction of multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) protein expression from hematoxylin and eosin (HE) whole-slide images. MixTIME employs a learnable router to dynamically weight expert contributions and is trained with a distribution- and tendency-aware loss function. Benchmarked on two datasets of different scales, MixTIME achieves state-of-the-art performance across 17 protein markers as measured by correlation metrics. The predicted mIF profiles substantially enhance downstream tasks, including spatial domain identification, survival prediction, and AI-assisted pathology report generation validated by expert pathologists from multiple institutes across the world. Furthermore, MixTIME enables longitudinal tracking of protein expression dynamics across clinical time points and reveals protein gene interaction patterns linked to drug resistance and immune suppression in tumor microenvironments. Collectively, MixTIME provides a scalable framework for multimodal biomarker discovery and clinical translation in computational pathology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MixTIME，一种多模态混合专家 (MoE) 病理基础模型，整合基于图像 (UNIv2)、图像文本 (CONCHv1.5) 和图像转录组 (STPath) 的病理基础模型，从 HE 全切片图像预测多重免疫荧光 (mIF) 蛋白表达。模型使用可学习路由动态加权专家贡献，并通过分布与趋势感知损失函数训练。在两个数据集上，MixTIME 在 17 个蛋白标志物上取得最优相关性指标，预测的 mIF 谱显著提升空间域识别、生存预测和多中心病理学家验证的 AI 辅助报告生成等下游任务，并支持纵向蛋白质表达动态追踪及与耐药和免疫抑制相关的蛋白-基因互作模式分析。
Motivation: 现有免疫生物标志物预测方法多局限于单一图像模态，分辨率不足且未能充分利用互补的临床和生物学信息，限制了精准肿瘤学的发展。
Method: MixTIME 采用混合专家 (MoE) 架构，集成三个不同模态的病理基础模型（UNIv2、CONCHv1.5、STPath），通过可学习路由动态加权专家输出，并使用分布与趋势感知损失函数进行训练，实现像素级和切片级 mIF 预测。
Result: 在两个不同规模的数据集上，MixTIME 在 17 种蛋白标志物的相关性指标上达到最先进水平；预测的 mIF 谱显著提升空间域识别、生存预测和 AI 辅助病理报告生成（经多机构病理学家验证），并能追踪纵向蛋白质动态及揭示与耐药和免疫抑制相关的互作模式。
Conclusion: MixTIME 提供了一个可扩展的多模态框架，用于计算病理学中的生物标志物发现和临床转化，但摘要未明确讨论局限性（如对多模态基础模型的依赖或泛化性）。
