papers.title: Embedded Machine Learning for Microcontroller-Class Edge Devices: Data, Feature, Evaluation, and Deployment Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Embedded machine learning moves inference from cloud services to resource-constrained devices that must acquire data, preprocess signals, run a model, and act within tight limits on memory, energy, and latency. This paper presents a systems-oriented synthesis of an embedded machine-learning workflow for microcontroller-class platforms. The emphasis is placed on engineering decisions that are often hidden in generic machine-learning introductions: sampling and buffering, feature extraction as dimensionality reduction, validation under class imbalance, model/runtime co-design, and streaming deployment. Two representative signal families are used throughout the paper. The first is inertial motion recognition, where a two-second, three-axis accelerometer window is transformed from raw samples into root-mean-square and spectral features before classification. The second is keyword spotting, where audio is sampled, anti-aliased, transformed into mel-frequency cepstral coefficients, and processed by a compact one-dimensional convolutional network. The paper concludes with practical design rules for robust on-device inference, including data curation, quantization, thresholding, scheduling, and field monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统化综述了面向微控制器类边缘设备的嵌入式机器学习工作流，涵盖数据采样、特征提取、模型/运行时协同设计、流式部署等工程决策。以惯性运动识别（加速度计信号）和关键词检测（音频MFCC特征）两类信号为例，阐述了从原始数据到片上推理的完整流水线，并总结出包括数据整理、量化、阈值调度、现场监测在内的实用设计规则。
Motivation: 现有通用机器学习介绍往往忽略嵌入式部署中的实际工程约束（如内存、能耗、延迟），本文旨在填补这一空白，为微控制器级平台提供可操作的端到端集成指南。
Method: 采用系统论视角，分阶段描述嵌入式ML工作流：采样与缓冲、特征提取作为降维手段、类别不平衡下的验证、模型与运行时的协同设计、流式部署。并以惯性运动和关键词检测两种典型信号为例，具体展示技术路线。
Result: 未提供定量实验结果；全文以工程原则和设计模式为主，未报告基准性能或对标数据。
Conclusion: 强调稳健的片上推理需要关注数据梳理、量化、阈值设定、任务调度和现场监控等实践规则，而非仅优化模型精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structural Role Injection in Handlebars-Templated LLM Prompts: Triple-Brace Interpolation, Delimiter Family, and the Limits of HTML Auto-Escaping
papers.abstract_en: Large language model applications build prompts from templates, and Handlebars is a widely used templating engine and the default prompt-template format in Microsoft Semantic Kernel. Its double-brace {x} expression HTML-escapes the interpolated value and is documented as the safe default; its triple-brace {x} expression inserts the value raw. We show that this choice silently governs an application's exposure to structural role injection, where attacker-controlled data carries chat role delimiters that forge a higher-privilege turn. A model-free analysis establishes the mechanism: Handlebars escaping rewrites angle brackets but not square brackets, colons, or Markdown hashes, so it neutralises ChatML, Llama-3, and XML role delimiters (survival rate 0.00) while leaving Llama-2 [INST], legacy Human:/Assistant:, and Markdown ### delimiters intact (survival rate 1.00 for the last two). We then run 5760 trials across seven delimiter families, two attack objectives, and four models (GPT-3.5 Turbo, GPT-4o mini, GPT-4.1 mini, Claude Haiku 4.5) at a combined API cost of 1.63 USD. GPT-3.5 Turbo follows the task-hijack instruction in 97% of raw and 91% of escaped trials, with the escaping protection concentrated in the angle-bracket families and absent for the colon- and Markdown-based families; the harder secret-exfiltration objective, which does not saturate, exposes the same family interaction more cleanly. Claude Haiku 4.5 resists both objectives almost entirely. The escaped default protects only the delimiter schemes whose characters HTML escaping happens to cover, gives no protection for the rest, and cannot substitute for a structural separation of instruction and data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析 Handlebars 模板引擎中双花括号 {{x}} 和三元花括号 {{{x}}} 插值对 LLM 提示中结构化角色注入的影响。通过模型无关分析揭示了 HTML 转义仅覆盖角括号类定界符，而方括号、冒号、Markdown 哈希等定界符未被转义。实验在 7 种定界符家族、2 种攻击目标、4 个模型（GPT-3.5 Turbo、GPT-4o mini、GPT-4.1 mini、Claude Haiku 4.5）上进行了 5760 次试验，结果显示 GPT-3.5 Turbo 在原始和转义试验中分别有 97% 和 91% 的任务劫持成功率，保护仅集中在角括号家族；Claude Haiku 4.5 几乎完全抵抗。结论是默认转义不能替代指令与数据的结构分离。
Motivation: Handlebars 作为广泛使用的模板引擎及其默认转义行为可能无法防御所有角色注入攻击，需要系统评估其保护范围，尤其是对非角括号定界符的效果。
Method: 进行模型无关的机制分析，确定 HTML 转义重写尖括号但不重写方括号、冒号或 Markdown 哈希，然后设计 7 种定界符家族（ChatML、Llama-3、XML、Llama-2 [INST]、Human:/Assistant:、Markdown ### 等）、2 种攻击目标（任务劫持和秘密泄露），在 4 个模型上运行 5760 次试验，总 API 成本 1.63 美元。
Result: GPT-3.5 Turbo 在原始和转义试验中分别有 97% 和 91% 的任务劫持成功率，转义保护仅存在于角括号家族，冒号和 Markdown 家族无保护；秘密泄露目标未饱和，更清晰地展示了相同家族交互。Claude Haiku 4.5 几乎完全抵抗两种攻击。
Conclusion: 默认转义只保护 HTML 转义恰好覆盖的定界符，对其它定界符无效，不能替代指令与数据的结构分离。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: First Proof Second Batch
papers.abstract_en: To assess the ability of current AI systems to correctly solve research-level mathematics problems, we tested several AI systems on a set of ten problems in a broad range of mathematical fields; these problems arose naturally in the research process of the contributors. This document includes the problems, our methodology, and the results of our testing. We provide links to supplementary documents including the human solutions, the AI-generated solutions, and the referee reports and logs for the AI-generated solutions. The ten problems were contributed by the following mathematicians: (1) Dariusz Kalociński and Theodore A. Slaman, (2) Richard Schwartz, (3) Aleksa Milojevic and Benny Sudakov, (4) Larry Guth, (5) Oleg Butkovsky, Jonathan Mattingly, and Lorenzo Zambotti, (6) Joshua Evan Greene and Duncan McCoy, (7) Sucharit Sarkar, (8) Sam Payne and Jidong (Jayden) Wang, (9) Sylvie Corteel and John Lentfer, (10) Srivatsav Kunnawalkam Elayavalli.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了当前AI系统正确解决研究级数学问题的能力，针对十个涵盖广泛数学领域的问题进行了测试，这些问题来源于贡献者的研究过程。文档包含问题、测试方法及结果，并附有补充材料链接。
Motivation: 缺乏对AI系统解决研究级数学问题能力的系统评估。
Method: 收集十个来自不同数学家的研究级问题，并让多个AI系统进行解答，同时提供人工解决方案作为参照，并由评审员对AI生成方案进行评审。
Result: 报告了AI系统在这十个问题上的表现结果，但摘要未给出具体数字或结论。
Conclusion: 该测试旨在评估AI在高等数学推理方面的能力。

papers.title: HLS-GPT: A Generative Pretrained Transformer (GPT) for Continental-Scale NASA Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 (HLS) Reflectance Reconstruction Across All Bands on Arbitrary Dates
papers.abstract_en: Recent deep learning methods for Landsat and Sentinel-2 reflectance time series reconstruction remain limited by restricted spectral coverage, limited geographic scalability, or patch-based designs with short temporal contexts. We present HLS-GPT, a large-scale generative pretrained Transformer model for reconstructing NASA Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 30 m surface reflectance for all bands, any date, and any pixel location. HLS-GPT uses a hierarchical Transformer architecture to handle the different spectral band configurations of Landsat and Sentinel-2 and operates on single-pixel 12-month time series. To capture geographic and seasonal variability, the model was trained with nine years of HLS time series from more than 0.25 million training pixels across the conterminous United States. A random cropping and masking strategy extracts 12-month periods with varying start dates across epochs, masks 50% of valid observations, and trains the model to reconstruct the masked reflectance values from the remaining observations. Evaluation using more than 62,000 independent test pixels shows robust reconstruction under diverse land surface conditions, including complex crop phenology and sparse, irregular observations. Leave-one-observation-out evaluation achieved reconstruction RMSE below 0.026 for all HLS spectral bands, with relative RMSE below 35% for visible bands and below 13% for other bands. Red-edge band errors were comparable to red and near-infrared errors despite the absence of red-edge bands on Landsat. Sensitivity analyses that randomly masked 10% to 90% of test observations showed only modest degradation when 10% to 50% of observations were masked, with all-band RMSE below 0.028. Image reconstruction over nine independent 109 by 109 km CONUS HLS tiles further demonstrates that HLS-GPT outperforms two conventional methods and the NASA-IBM Prithvi model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HLS-GPT 是一个大规模生成式预训练 Transformer 模型，用于重建 NASA HLS 30米地表反射率，支持所有波段、任意日期和任意像素位置。模型采用分层 Transformer 架构处理 Landsat 和 Sentinel-2 的不同光谱波段配置，基于单像素12个月时间序列，在美国本土超过25万训练像素上训练。评估表明，在多样地表条件下重建鲁棒，留一观测评估中所有波段 RMSE 低于0.026，图像重建优于传统方法和 Prithvi 模型。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在 Landsat 和 Sentinel-2 反射率时间序列重建中存在光谱覆盖受限、地理可扩展性有限或基于补丁的设计时间上下文短等问题，需要一种大规模、全波段、任意日期的重建方法。
Method: 提出 HLS-GPT，一种分层 Transformer 架构，处理不同卫星的波段配置，使用单像素12个月时间序列。采用随机裁剪和掩码策略，提取不同起始日期的12个月周期，掩码50%有效观测，训练模型从剩余观测重建掩码反射率。
Result: 在超过6.2万独立测试像素上，留一观测评估中所有 HLS 波段重建 RMSE 低于0.026，可见波段相对 RMSE 低于35%，其他波段低于13%。敏感性分析显示掩码10%-50%时全波段 RMSE 低于0.028。图像重建优于两种传统方法和 Prithvi 模型。
Conclusion: HLS-GPT 实现了大陆尺度、全波段、任意日期的反射率重建，在复杂地表条件下表现鲁棒，但摘要未明确提及局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Ternary Mamba: Grouped Quantization-Aware Training of W1.58A16 State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: State Space Models (SSMs) such as Mamba-2 offer linear-time inference but their memory footprint limits edge deployment. Prior ternary SSM work (Slender-Mamba) trains from scratch on 150B tokens; we show a pretrained checkpoint suffices, reducing the marginal token budget by 1,000x. Using grouped quantization-aware training (QAT) with knowledge distillation from a frozen FP16 teacher, we compress Mamba-2 1.3B to 3.61x (2,687 to 744 MB) and achieve 48.1% zero-shot accuracy (7-task average) in just 102M tokens (4 GPU-hours, single H100) -- approaching Bi-Mamba's 48.4% (within +/-0.9pp CI). This QAT-from-pretrained setting reveals zero-ratio collapse, a novel instability caused by learnable quantization scales that does not arise in from-scratch training. We further show that post-hoc correction strategies effective for Transformers fail for SSMs due to error accumulation through the recurrence. These results demonstrate that ternary SSMs do not require expensive from-scratch training: QAT from pretrained checkpoints with KD is a data-efficient alternative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对Mamba-2状态空间模型的分组量化感知训练方法，将1.3B参数模型压缩至3.61倍（从2687 MB到744 MB），仅需102M token（4 GPU小时）即可达到48.1%零样本准确率，接近Bi-Mamba的48.4%。该方法从预训练检查点出发，结合知识蒸馏，相比从零训练节省1000倍token预算。同时发现可学习量化尺度导致的零比率崩溃这一新不稳定性。
Motivation: 现有三元SSM模型（如Slender-Mamba）需要从零训练消耗大量token，而预训练检查点未被充分利用；且后处理校正策略在SSM中因循环误差累积而失效。
Method: 采用分组量化感知训练（grouped QAT），从冻结的FP16教师模型进行知识蒸馏，压缩Mamba-2模型至W1.58A16低位宽表示。
Result: 在Mamba-2 1.3B上实现3.61倍压缩，零样本准确率48.1%（7任务平均），仅需102M token训练（4 GPU小时），与Bi-Mamba的48.4%相差在0.9个百分点置信区间内。
Conclusion: 三元SSM无需昂贵的从零训练，基于预训练检查点的QAT+KD是数据高效的替代方案，但需注意零比率崩溃问题。

papers.title: Qwen-RobotNav Technical Report: A Scalable Navigation Model Designed for an Agentic Navigation System
papers.abstract_en: Agentic navigation systems require a base navigation model whose observation strategy can be externally reconfigured at inference time, because instruction following, object search, target tracking, and autonomous driving share the same perception-planning backbone yet demand fundamentally different strategies for consuming the visual stream. We present Qwen-RobotNav, a scalable navigation model built on Qwen-RobotNav that addresses it through a parameterised interface with two complementary dimensions: multiple task modes that select the navigation behaviour, and controllable observation parameters (e.g., token budget, per-camera weights) that govern how visual history is encoded. With training-time randomization over all parameters, Qwen-RobotNav is robust to any inference-time configuration requiring zero architectural modification to the Qwen-RobotNav backbone. We train Qwen-RobotNav on 15.6M samples; co-training with vision-language data prevents the collapse into reactive action-sequence mappers observed in trajectory-only training. The parameterised interface also makes Qwen-RobotNav a natural building block for agentic systems: for long-horizon scenarios, an upper-level planner decomposes goals into sub-tasks and dynamically switches Qwen-RobotNav's task mode and context strategy mid-episode, composing complex behaviours from repeated calls to the same model. Extensive experiments show that Qwen-RobotNav sets new state-of-the-art results across major navigation benchmarks. The model exhibits favourable scaling from 2B to 8B parameters, with joint multi-task training developing a shared spatial-planning substrate that transfers across task families, and demonstrates strong zero-shot generalisation to real-world robots across diverse environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了Qwen-RobotNav，一个可扩展的导航模型，通过参数化接口实现外部可重配置的观测策略，支持多种任务模式和可控观测参数。训练时随机化所有参数使得模型对推理时配置鲁棒，在15.6M样本上联合视觉-语言数据训练避免崩溃。模型在多个导航基准上达到新SOTA，从2B到8B参数展现出有利扩展性，并在真实机器人上展示强零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有导航模型缺乏可外部重配置的观测策略，而指令跟随、目标搜索、目标跟踪和自动驾驶共享感知-规划骨干但需要不同的视觉流消费策略。
Method: 提出参数化接口，包含多个任务模式和可控观测参数（如token预算、每相机权重），训练时随机化所有参数，并与视觉-语言数据联合训练。
Result: 在多个主要导航基准上取得新SOTA，模型从2B到8B参数展现出有利的扩展性，联合多任务训练发展了共享空间规划基底，在多样环境中的真实机器人上展示出强零样本泛化。
Conclusion: Qwen-RobotNav作为一个可外部重配置的基础导航模型，是智能体导航系统的自然构建块，可用于长时域任务并通过上层规划器动态切换模式。

papers.title: Learning Fair Pareto-Optimal Policies in Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Fairness is an important aspect of decision-making in multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL), where policies must ensure both optimality and equity across multiple, potentially conflicting objectives. While single-policy MORL methods can learn fair policies for fixed user preferences using welfare functions such as the generalized Gini welfare function (GGF), they fail to provide the diverse set of policies necessary for dynamic or unknown user preferences. To address this limitation, we formalize the fair optimization problem in multi-policy MORL, where the goal is to learn a set of Pareto-optimal policies that ensure fairness across all possible user preferences. Our key technical contributions are threefold: (1) We show that for concave, piecewise-linear welfare functions (e.g., GGF), fair policies remain in the convex coverage set (CCS), which is an approximated Pareto front for linear scalarization. (2) We demonstrate that non-stationary policies, augmented with accrued reward histories, and stochastic policies improve fairness by dynamically adapting to historical inequities. (3) We propose three novel algorithms, which include integrating GGF with multi-policy multi-objective Q-Learning (MOQL), state-augmented multi-policy MOQL for learning non-statoinary policies, and its novel extension for learning stochastic policies. We evaluate our algorithms across various domains and compare our methods against the state-of-the-art MORL baselines. The empirical results show that our methods learn a set of fair policies that accommodate different user preferences.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC) 2025. 12 pages main + appendix, 8 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化多策略多目标强化学习中的公平优化问题，证明对于凹分段线性福利函数（如广义基尼福利函数GGF），公平策略仍属于凸覆盖集（CCS）。提出三种算法，将GGF与多策略多目标Q学习（MOQL）结合，以及状态增强的多策略MOQL用于学习非平稳策略和随机策略。实验表明该方法能学习一组适应不同用户偏好的公平帕累托最优策略。
Motivation: 现有单策略MORL方法可对固定用户偏好学习公平策略，但无法提供多样化的策略集以适应动态或未知的用户偏好。需要一种能跨所有可能用户偏好保证公平性的多策略MORL方法。
Method: 形式化多策略MORL中的公平优化问题，提出三点技术贡献：1) 证明凹分段线性福利函数下公平策略仍在CCS中；2) 非平稳策略（结合累积奖励历史）和随机策略通过动态适应历史不公改进公平性；3) 提出三种算法：GGF+多策略MOQL、状态增强多策略MOQL（学习非平稳策略）及其扩展（学习随机策略）。
Result: 在多个领域上的实验结果表明，所提方法学习到一组公平策略，能适应不同用户偏好，并优于现有MORL基线。
Conclusion: 本文为多策略MORL中的公平优化提供了理论框架和实用算法，但未明确讨论扩展到其他福利函数或高维目标空间的局限性。

papers.title: Querying an astronomical database using large language models: the ALeRCE text-to-SQL system
papers.abstract_en: We develop a text-to-SQL (structured query language) system based on large language models (LLMs) using in-context learning and apply it to the Automatic Learning for the Rapid Classification of Events (ALeRCE) astronomical database. ALeRCE is a community broker for the Zwicky Transient Facility and the Vera C. Rubin Observatory. The system enables users to query the database in natural language (NL) and generates executable SQL queries. To develop and evaluate the system, we constructed a dataset of 110 NL/SQL pairs. We propose a step-by-step generation framework comprising four modules: schema linking, query classification, prompt decomposition, and self-correction. The performance of thirteen LLMs is evaluated using in-context learning and prompt engineering techniques. Text-to-SQL performance is assessed using the perfect-match (PM) rate for row identifiers (e.g., object identifiers) and column identifiers (i.e., column names). The proposed step-by-step framework consistently outperforms a direct-inference baseline, while the self-correction module consistently reduces execution errors. For Claude Opus 4.6, PM performance on row (column) identifiers is high for simple queries, reaching 0.97 (0.94), and decreases with query complexity to 0.44 (0.72) for medium queries and 0.59 (0.49) for hard queries. Among the thirteen evaluated models, the best-performing LLMs for the text-to-SQL task are Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash, and GPT-5.2-Codex.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发了一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的text-to-SQL系统，用于ALeRCE天文数据库。系统采用包含模式链接、查询分类、提示分解和自校正的逐步生成框架，在110个自然语言/SQL对的数据集上评估了13个LLM。结果表明，Claude Opus 4.6在简单查询上表现最佳，行标识符完美匹配率为0.97，列标识符为0.94，但随查询复杂度增加性能下降。
Motivation: 天文学家需要更直观的方式访问大型天文数据库，而编写SQL查询具有较高门槛。该系统允许用户用自然语言提问，直接生成可执行的SQL查询，提升数据访问效率。
Method: 提出了一个四模块逐步生成框架：schema linking（模式链接）识别相关表和列，query classification（查询分类）判断查询类型，prompt decomposition（提示分解）将复杂查询拆解为子步骤，self-correction（自校正）通过检查执行错误修正查询。使用in-context learning和prompt engineering技术优化LLM输出。
Result: 在ALeRCE数据库的110个查询测试中，Claude Opus 4.6在简单查询上的行/列标识符完美匹配率分别为0.97/0.94，中等查询降至0.44/0.72，困难查询为0.59/0.49。逐步框架始终优于直接推理基线，自校正模块持续降低执行错误。
Conclusion: 基于LLM的text-to-SQL系统能够有效处理天文数据库的自然语言查询，但复杂查询的性能仍有提升空间。自校正机制是减少错误的关键组件。

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Minimum Zero-Forcing Sets
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores the problem of finding the minimum zero-forcing set on undirected graphs and proposes an adapted machine-learning framework to solve the problem. The minimum zero-forcing set problem is a graph coloring problem where the color of an initial set of nodes propagates throughout a network. The set of nodes is zero-forcing if it forces all uncolored nodes to change color under the constraint of the color-change rule. There are several applications to this problem across different domains such as network science, network control, and designing logical circuits. Finding the minimum zero-forcing set is shown to be NP-hard. We propose a reinforcement learning framework, SD-ZFS, that adapts the S2V-DQN architecture to the ZFS problem. We train several models on this adapted framework and analyze the performance across graph datasets that have varying structures. We evaluate how the models trained on the framework generalize, scale, and transfer to different network types. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework when compared against the optimal solution and greedy heuristic. We provide further insight into how the ZFS problem can be solved through machine-learning and the influence of network structure on the problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无向图上的最小零强制集问题（NP难），提出深度强化学习框架SD-ZFS，改编自S2V-DQN架构。实验表明该框架在不同结构图数据集上的表现接近最优解，优于贪婪启发式。
Motivation: 最小零强制集问题在网络科学、网络控制、逻辑电路设计等领域有重要应用，但该问题已被证明为NP难，现有方法难以高效求得最优解。
Method: 基于深度强化学习，将S2V-DQN架构适配到零强制集问题，重新设计图状态表示和动作空间，并训练多个模型。
Result: 在多种图结构数据集上，该框架相比贪婪启发式更接近最优解，并展现出良好的泛化、扩展和迁移能力。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了机器学习方法在解决最小零强制集问题上的有效性，并揭示了网络结构对问题求解的影响。

summary_sections.motivation: 最小零强制集问题在网络科学、网络控制、逻辑电路设计等领域有重要应用，但该问题已被证明为NP难，现有方法难以高效求得最优解。
summary_sections.method: 基于深度强化学习，将S2V-DQN架构适配到零强制集问题，重新设计图状态表示和动作空间，并训练多个模型。
summary_sections.result: 在多种图结构数据集上，该框架相比贪婪启发式更接近最优解，并展现出良好的泛化、扩展和迁移能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作展示了机器学习方法在解决最小零强制集问题上的有效性，并揭示了网络结构对问题求解的影响。

papers.title: OmniPlan: An Adaptive Framework for Timely and Near-Optimal Network Planning Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Network planning optimization is a fundamental problem across diverse domains, including transportation systems, communication networks, and power grids. It requires simultaneous optimization of multiple competing objectives under complex constraints. Existing network planning optimization frameworks rely on mixed integer programming (MIP) solvers, heuristics, and deep reinforcement learning (DRL) models to compute planning decisions. However, they lack effective adaptability to diverse and dynamic user intents, thus leading to the trade-off between execution time and optimality. In this paper, we propose OmniPlan, an adaptive framework that achieves both timeliness and near-optimality in network planning optimization. To achieve the adaptability lacking in existing solutions, OmniPlan employs a large language model (LLM)-based interpreter to convert heterogeneous natural-language intents into a unified and quantifiable user-preference vector. Then it employs a mixture-of-experts architecture that integrates MIP solvers, heuristics, and DRL models as specialized experts, where OmniPlan adapts to diverse intents by dynamically selecting timely and near-optimal experts. Finally, it incorporates a DRL-based expert configuration module that fine-tunes optimization objective weights to align planning decisions with user-specific preferences. We evaluate OmniPlan with a representative real-world workload, i.e., distributed machine learning (ML), where we leverage OmniPlan to offload a wide spectrum of ML inference tasks, e.g., decision trees, SVM, naive Bayes, XGBoost, and random forests, onto a network of hardware devices. Our experiments on a real-world testbed indicate that OmniPlan achieves near-optimal and low-execution-time offloading for real-world ML inference tasks, reducing latency by up to 97.8\% and network device resource consumption by up to 11.5\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniPlan是一个自适应框架，用于网络规划优化，通过集成LLM解释器、混合专家架构和DRL配置模块，在多种网络规划任务中实现及时性和接近最优性。在分布式机器学习推理任务卸载的测试中，该方法相比基线方案降低延迟最高97.8%，减少网络设备资源消耗最高11.5%。
Motivation: 现有网络规划优化框架（如MIP求解器、启发式算法、DRL模型）缺乏对多样化动态用户意图的有效适应能力，导致执行时间与最优性之间的权衡。
Method: 提出OmniPlan框架：1) 基于LLM的解释器将自然语言意图转化为统一量化偏好向量；2) 混合专家架构动态选择MIP求解器、启发式算法或DRL模型作为专家；3) DRL配置模块微调优化目标权重以对齐用户偏好。

Conclusion: OmniPlan通过自适应专家选择和偏好对齐，实现了网络规划优化的及时性和近似最优性，并展示了在真实ML推理任务中的有效性。

papers.title: Trust the Right Teacher: Quality-Aware Self-Distillation for GUI Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Graphical user interface (GUI) grounding requires vision-language models (VLMs) to identify small target elements in high-resolution screenshots and predict precise screen coordinates. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is a promising post-training approach for this coordinate-sensitive task, since it provides dense token-level teacher signals beyond hard coordinate labels. However, naive OPSD is not well suited to GUI grounding: OPSD evaluates the teacher on student-generated prefixes, the quality of coordinate-token teacher signals can degrade when the prefix has already deviated from the target coordinate, leading to unreliable teacher signal. To mitigate this, We propose quality-aware self-distillation for VLM-based GUI grounding, which improves coordinate-token teacher-signal quality through soft correctness-aware gating and teacher-probability scaling. The soft correctness-aware gate checks whether the teacher's current coordinate-token prediction can still be completed into the ground-truth box under the student-generated prefix. If not, the corresponding teacher signal is down-weighted. Teacher-probability scaling then uses the teacher's confidence as a lightweight factor to further calibrate the strength of the gated supervision. A key empirical finding is that neither component alone improves overall performance, whereas combining them consistently improves performance. This suggests that the two mechanisms play complementary roles: correctness-aware gating suppresses unreliable coordinate-token supervision, while teacher-probability scaling calibrates the strength of the remaining signals. Experiments across six GUI grounding benchmarks show that our method consistently improves the base model and outperforms strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图形用户界面（GUI）接地任务中视觉语言模型（VLM）的坐标敏感问题，提出了一种质量感知的自蒸馏方法（quality-aware self-distillation）。该方法通过软正确性感知门控（soft correctness-aware gating）和教师概率缩放（teacher-probability scaling）来改进在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中教师信号的质量，从而避免因学生生成前缀偏离目标坐标而导致的不可靠指导。实验在六个GUI接地基准上一致提升了基础模型性能，并超越了强基线。
Motivation: GUI接地任务需要VLM在高分辨率截图中精确定位小目标元素。在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）提供密集的token级教师信号，但直接应用时，若学生生成前缀偏离目标坐标，教师信号的坐标token质量会下降，导致不可靠指导。
Method: 提出质量感知自蒸馏：1）软正确性感知门控，检查在当前学生前缀下教师预测的坐标token是否能完成真实边界框，若否则降低对应教师信号的权重；2）教师概率缩放，使用教师置信度作为轻量因子进一步校准门控监督的强度。
Result: 在六个GUI接地基准上，该方法一致提升了基础模型性能，并优于强基线。消融实验表明，单独使用任一组件均不能提升整体性能，而两者结合持续有效。
Conclusion: 两个机制相辅相成：正确性感知门控抑制不可靠的坐标token监督，教师概率缩放校准剩余信号的强度。该方法为VLM的GUI接地后训练提供了有效改进。

papers.title: IsabeLLM: Automated Theorem Proving Applied to Formally Verifying Consensus
papers.abstract_en: Advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) have led AI for Theorem Proving to become a promising means of formally verifying computer systems. Whilst formal verification is traditionally reserved for safety-critical systems due to the required amount of expertise and effort, AI can help to automate a large amount of this workload and make it far more accessible. Blockchain-based systems are becoming increasingly popular and are frequently targeted by malicious actors, often resulting in huge financial losses, highlighting the need to better verify these systems and mitigate vulnerabilities. Arguably the most important component of these systems is the consensus protocol, which allows nodes to agree on decisions in a potentially adversarial environment. In this paper, we improve upon IsabeLLM, the automated theorem proving tool in Isabelle. Namely, we implement a Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework, Error tracing and counterexample generation for improved context supplied to the Large Language Model. Compatibility with the latest version of Isabelle and Sledgehammer is also implemented for improved efficiency. We compare the performance of the two versions of IsabeLLM in their ability to complete the verification of Bitcoin's Proof of Work consensus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文改进IsabeLLM自动定理证明工具，通过检索增强生成（RAG）、错误追踪和反例生成增强LLM上下文，并兼容最新版Isabelle和Sledgehammer以提高效率。在比特币工作量证明（PoW）共识的验证任务上比较新旧版本的表现。
Motivation: 区块链系统频繁遭受攻击造成巨额损失，形式化验证虽可靠但门槛高，AI自动化可降低验证成本。共识协议是区块链最关键的组件，需更好验证以防范漏洞。
Method: 实现RAG框架为LLM提供更丰富的上下文，增加错误追踪与反例生成能力，并更新兼容最新版Isabelle及其Sledgehammer工具以提升证明效率。
Result: 在比特币PoW共识的形式化验证中比较了IsabeLLM新旧版本的性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 通过RAG和错误追踪可改善自动化定理证明在形式化验证中的效果，但仍需进一步评估泛化能力。

papers.title: S4oP: Operator-level Pruning of Structured State Space Models for Resource-Constrained Devices
papers.abstract_en: Structured State Space Models (SSMs), including the S4 and S4D architectures, have recently emerged as powerful alternatives to attention-based models for capturing long-range dependencies in sequential data. Despite their strong empirical performance, deploying these models in time- and resource-constrained settings remains challenging due to their computational and memory demands. In this paper, we propose a novel incremental, operator-level pruning approach for S4- and S4D-based models that significantly reduces inference cost while preserving predictive performance. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to systematically investigate structured operator pruning for SSMs. Our method progressively prunes model operators by interleaving structured masking with fine-tuning, while jointly monitoring accuracy and inference latency. We implement this approach within a unified training and evaluation framework that enables systematic exploration of efficiency-accuracy trade-offs. Experiments across multiple benchmark datasets show that pruning up to 70% of the model operators preserves the performance of the original models in most cases, while substantially reducing inference latency. These results demonstrate that structured operator pruning is an effective and previously unexplored strategy for improving the efficiency of SSMs and facilitate their deployment in practical, resource-constrained scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究结构化状态空间模型（S4/S4D）的算子级剪枝（operator-level pruning），提出一种增量剪枝方法，通过交替结构化掩码与微调，在保持模型性能的同时显著降低推理延迟。实验表明，剪枝高达70%的算子仍能保持原始模型性能，为SSM在资源受限设备上的部署提供了新策略。
Motivation: 结构化状态空间模型（SSM）虽在长程依赖建模上表现优异，但计算和内存需求高，难以部署在时间/资源受限设备上。现有剪枝工作多关注Transformer，缺乏针对SSM的算子级剪枝研究。
Method: 提出增量算子级剪枝方法：在训练过程中交替进行结构化掩码（structured masking）和微调（fine-tuning），同时监控准确率和推理延迟，以系统探索效率-准确率权衡。方法集成在统一的训练与评估框架中。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，剪枝70%的算子仍能保持原始模型性能，同时大幅降低推理延迟。
Conclusion: 结构化算子剪枝是提升SSM效率的有效新策略，有助于在资源受限场景中部署SSM。

papers.title: EAGG: Embodiment-Aligned Grasp Generation via Geometry-Aware Graph Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Cross-end-effector grasp generation seeks a unified model that generalizes across objects and across embodiments ranging from parallel grippers to dexterous end effectors. Existing grasp generators are typically designed for a fixed embodiment or encode embodiment identity with a static descriptor, which weakens transfer when topology, actuation coupling, and contact geometry differ substantially. We present EAGG, an embodiment-aligned grasp generator that represents each embodiment with a topology-aware end-effector graph and an embodiment-specific low-dimensional end-effector control space. A frozen end-effector-cognition backbone converts the current articulated state into geometry-aware tokens that act as a reusable morphology prior, and iterative geometry injection refreshes these tokens throughout sampling so that conditioning remains synchronized with the evolving end-effector geometry. On the MultiGripperGrasp benchmark, EAGG reaches 56.17% average success across six training end effectors, remaining within 1.10 percentage points of specialized training while preserving transfer to finetuning and zero-shot end effectors. Iterative geometry injection further reduces the pooled median contact distance from 0.239 cm to 0.189 cm. These results show that cross-end-effector grasp generation is strengthened by aligning embodiment structure inside a shared generator rather than suppressing embodiment differences. Code is available at https://github.com/wanhaoniu/EAGG.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 8 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/wanhaoniu/EAGG
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EAGG，一种跨末端执行器抓取生成方法，利用拓扑感知的末端执行器图与几何感知图条件实现统一生成。在MultiGripperGrasp基准上，EAGG在六个训练末端执行器上平均成功率达56.17%，与专门训练的差距在1.10个百分点以内，并支持微调和零样本迁移。迭代几何注入将池化中位数接触距离从0.239 cm降至0.189 cm。代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有抓取生成器通常针对固定末端执行器设计或使用静态描述符编码，在拓扑、驱动耦合和接触几何差异大时迁移能力弱。
Method: 用拓扑感知的末端执行器图表示每种形态，结合低维控制空间；通过冻结的末端执行器认知骨干将当前关节状态转化为几何感知token作为可复用形态先验，并在采样过程中迭代注入几何信息以保持条件与演化几何同步。
Result: 在MultiGripperGrasp基准上，六个训练末端执行器平均成功率为56.17%，与专门训练差距<1.10个百分点；迭代几何注入将池化中位数接触距离从0.239 cm降至0.189 cm。
Conclusion: 跨末端执行器抓取生成通过在对齐形态结构而非抑制差异的方式中得到增强，EAGG证明了统一生成器的有效性。

papers.title: From Reasoning Traces to Reusable Modules: Understanding Compositional Generalization in Language Model Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Post-training pipelines that combine supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning (RL) have emerged as the key recipe for transforming large language models (LLMs) into robust reasoners. We argue that this combined success is driven by compositional generalization, which we formalize through a hierarchical latent selection model. In this framework, reasoning traces are generated by a cascade of discrete latent selection variables corresponding to reusable atomic modules, including both skills (local operations) and routing mechanisms (how intermediate information is selected, reused, and composed). Within this model, we theoretically show that SFT and RL play asymmetric, complementary roles: SFT supplies the raw module materials in compositional traces, and RL decomposes those traces to identify the latent atomic modules and enable compositional generalization. We design controlled experiments to validate this theory. Our results demonstrate that RL can extract atomic modules from compound traces supplied by SFT and recombine them to solve new configurations. Moreover, we find that training on compound traces yields stronger generalization than training on isolated atomic modules. Finally, we investigate the relationship between SFT and RL data and identify an effective protocol in which SFT ensures coverage of all atomic modules through compositional traces, while RL focuses on novel compositions outside the SFT support to drive exploration.

papers.title: Edge Flow: A Tractable and Predictive Continuous-Time Model for Gradient Descent at the Edge of Stability
papers.abstract_en: Gradient descent in deep learning may operate at the edge of stability (EoS), a regime in which the largest eigenvalue of the loss Hessian hovers near the stability threshold $2/η$, where $η$ is the learning rate. Classical analysis tools such as gradient flow and the descent lemma do not apply here, motivating the search for a continuous-time model valid at EoS. We propose Edge Flow, a system of three coupled ordinary differential equations that provides a tractable, faithful, and predictive model of gradient descent dynamics at EoS. Edge Flow decomposes the dynamics into a center, an oscillation direction, and an oscillation magnitude. The center follows a modified gradient flow on a symmetrized loss; the direction tracks a top eigenvector of the Hessian via Rayleigh quotient dynamics; and the magnitude grows or decays exponentially depending on whether the sharpness exceeds or falls below the threshold $2/η$. Crucially, sharpness stabilization emerges from the coupled dynamics via a self-stabilization feedback loop. Discretizing Edge Flow only requires two gradient evaluations and one Hessian--vector product at each iteration. We demonstrate empirically that Edge Flow tracks the dynamics of gradient descent at least as faithfully as previously proposed continuous-time EoS models, while in addition resolving the oscillation of the sharpness at the onset of EoS, and that it provides a principled framework for understanding and mitigating instabilities in this regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Edge Flow，一个由三个常微分方程耦合的系统，用于建模深度学习梯度下降在稳定性边缘（EoS）的动态。该模型分解为中心、振荡方向和振荡幅度，通过自稳定反馈实现锐度稳定。离散化只需两次梯度计算和一次Hessian-向量乘积。实验表明Edge Flow比现有连续时间EoS模型更忠实跟踪梯度下降动态，并能解析EoS起始时的锐度振荡。
Motivation: 经典分析工具（梯度流、下降引理）在深度学习梯度下降处于稳定性边缘时失效，需要新的连续时间模型来理解和预测该动态。
Method: 提出Edge Flow，一个三变量ODE系统：中心遵循对称化损失上的修正梯度流；方向通过Rayleigh商动态跟踪Hessian最大特征向量；幅度根据锐度与阈值2/η的关系指数增长或衰减。耦合形成自稳定反馈环。
Result: 实验表明，Edge Flow至少与先前连续时间EoS模型一样忠实跟踪梯度下降动态，并额外解决了EoS起始时的锐度振荡问题。离散化高效。
Conclusion: Edge Flow提供了一个原则性框架来理解和缓解稳定性边缘的不稳定性。

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Context-Aware and Relation-Aware Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a paradigm for enhancing large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, yet existing graph-based methods face a fundamental limitation: entity-centric and chunk-centric approaches operate on representations anchored to original text without true knowledge fusion. While entity-centric methods connect logically related content and chunk-centric methods preserve context, both retrieve information separately through similarity search, missing emergent understanding from their synthesis. In this paper, we propose HyGRAG, a hierarchical graph RAG framework that transcends source documents by addressing three core challenges: constructing summaries that genuinely integrate contextual and relational information, leveraging these synthesized representations to access emergent knowledge during retrieval, and efficiently updating hierarchical structures for dynamic corpora. Specifically, we design hierarchical index structures over hybrid graphs with both chunk and entity nodes, then iteratively cluster them and generate LLM-based summaries. Then, we design context and relation-aware retrieval that searches across all abstraction levels while expanding through community membership. Moreover, we enable dynamic knowledge update through attachment-based algorithms with only local re-summarization. Experimental results show that HyGRAG improves the average accuracy of multi-hop reasoning tasks by 9.7%, while maintaining reasonable efficiency.
papers.comment: Accepted at The ACM Web Conference 2026 (WWW '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HyGRAG，一个层次化图RAG框架，通过构建整合上下文和关系信息的摘要、利用合成表示检索新兴知识、以及高效更新动态语料库，解决现有图RAG方法中实体中心和块中心方法缺乏知识融合的局限性。实验表明，HyGRAG在多跳推理任务上平均准确率提升9.7%，且保持合理效率。
Motivation: 现有图RAG方法要么是实体中心的，要么是块中心的，它们基于原始文本进行相似度搜索，无法实现真正的知识融合，从而丢失了从合成中产生的新兴理解。
Method: HyGRAG在包含块节点和实体节点的混合图上构建层次化索引，迭代聚类并生成基于LLM的摘要；设计上下文和关系感知的检索，跨所有抽象层级搜索并通过社区成员扩展；通过基于附件的算法实现动态知识更新，仅需局部重摘要。
Result: HyGRAG在多跳推理任务上的平均准确率提升9.7%，同时保持合理的效率。
Conclusion: HyGRAG通过层次化结构和上下文关系感知检索，有效提升了图RAG的知识融合能力和多跳推理性能。

papers.title: Tensor-based second-order causal discovery
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery seeks to uncover the causal dependencies among variables. For this purpose, we propose an algorithm called Tensor-based Second-order Causal Discovery (TSCD). Its input is a tensor obtained from the covariance matrices of observational and interventional data. Assuming the causal dependencies follow a linear structural equation model on a directed acyclic graph (DAG), TSCD outputs the DAG and the functions on its edges, requiring only that the noise variables are uncorrelated. We also implement a version of the approach for nonlinear models. Our focus on second-order statistics (via the covariance matrices) is motivated by their statistical and computational efficiency relative to higher-order moments, their identifiability relative to first-order statistics, and that they work regardless of whether the variables are Gaussian. We show that TSCD has identifiable causal order and parameters from a number of interventions that is logarithmic in the number of variables. Experiments show that TSCD is robust to noise, competitive with existing methods, and scales to hundreds of variables.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于张量的二阶因果发现算法（TSCD），利用观测和干预数据的协方差矩阵张量来推断有向无环图（DAG）及其边上的线性函数，仅要求噪声变量不相关。该方法扩展到非线性模型，在干预次数对变量数量呈对数关系的条件下可识别因果序和参数，实验中表现出对噪声的鲁棒性，与现有方法竞争并扩展到数百变量。
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法多依赖高阶矩或一阶统计量，但二阶统计量具有统计和计算效率高、在非高斯下可识别等优点，且无需变量服从高斯分布。
Method: 将协方差矩阵组织成张量，作为输入；假设线性结构方程模型，输出DAG和边函数；使用二阶统计量实现因果序和参数的可识别性，干预次数与变量数成对数关系；提供非线性扩展版本。
Result: 理论证明在干预次数对数于变量数目时因果序和参数可识别；实验验证对噪声鲁棒、与现有方法竞争、可扩展至数百变量。
Conclusion: TSCD基于二阶统计量实现了高效、可扩展的因果发现，适用于线性和非线性模型，是因果推断领域的实用工具。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Volterra Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Score-based diffusion models typically use Brownian perturbations, which provide tractable reverse-time dynamics but impose memoryless noising. We introduce Volterra generative models, a continuous-time score-based framework whose forward process injects path-dependent noise through fractional kernels. To handle the non-Markovian and non-semimartingale dynamics, we construct finite-dimensional Markovian lifts using Gaussian quadrature in both regimes and a hybrid finite-difference exponential approximation in the smooth regime. We prove squared error bounds, derive an augmented linear-Gaussian forward process, and show that the learning can remain data-dimensional by considering residual states and analytic auxiliary Gaussian scores. We also identify covariance and reverse-time degeneracies caused by shared Brownian factors and signed smooth-regime weights. The degeneracy motivates stabilized conditioning and, for stiff larger lifts, a Gaussian-bridge reconstruction sampler. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 show that persistent fractional perturbations with small Markovian lifts can improve score-based generation on MNIST and provide a promising extension to natural images, while the bridge sampler provides a stability mechanism for larger lifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Volterra生成模型，一种基于连续时间分数的框架，通过分数核注入路径依赖噪声替代传统的布朗运动前向过程。为处理非马尔可夫和非半鞅动力学，作者利用高斯求积和混合有限差分指数逼近构造有限维马尔可夫提升，并证明了平方误差界。实验表明，在MNIST和CIFAR-10上，较小马尔可夫提升的持久分数扰动可改善基于分数的生成，而桥接采样器为大提升提供稳定机制。
Motivation: 传统基于分数的扩散模型使用布朗扰动，具有无记忆噪声特性，限制了生成能力。
Method: 引入Volterra生成模型，前向过程通过分数核注入路径依赖噪声；利用高斯求积和混合有限差分指数逼近构造马尔可夫提升，并推导增广线性高斯前向过程，通过残差状态和分析辅助高斯分数保持学习维度。
Result: 在MNIST和CIFAR-10上，持久分数扰动搭配小马尔可夫提升可改善生成质量；桥接采样器为大提升提供稳定性。
Conclusion: 该方法将分数过程引入生成模型，展示了路径依赖噪声在图像生成中的潜力，但需处理退化问题。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Blended Chart Surfaces: A Seamless Explicit Representation for Smooth Surface Fitting
papers.abstract_en: A surface representation suitable for geometry processing should be compact and explicit, provide global smoothness guarantees, support a wide range of surface topologies, and offer reliable access to differential quantities such as normals and surface energies, while remaining compatible with modern differentiable optimization. Existing neural representations typically sacrifice one or more of these properties: implicit fields typically require iso-surfacing for downstream use, while explicit neural maps are constrained by canonical-domain parametrizations or exhibit seam artifacts between local charts. We introduce Blended Chart Surfaces, a compact, network-free, explicit representation that is smooth by construction and anchored to user-provided topology. Given a coarse proxy mesh encoding the intended surface topology and approximate geometry, Blended Chart Surfaces jointly optimize for a polynomial map at each proxy vertex using an off-the-shelf optimizer to fit to an implicit target shape, avoiding the need for an input parametrization. Neighboring maps are fused using a smooth 'one-ring coordinate' blending scheme, decoupling topology and coarse geometry (carried by the proxy) from geometric details (carried by the local patches). The surface is globally smooth, fully differentiable, and enables stable evaluation of derivatives, making differential quantities and surface energies directly accessible. Additionally, our construction is equivariant to rigid motions and scaling of the proxy mesh. We evaluate Blended Chart Surfaces on various topologies and geometric complexity, and compare against explicit alternatives including interpolating-function baselines and mesh-displacement MLPs. Across these, Blended Chart Surfaces achieve a favorable trade-off among compactness, simplicity, access to differential quantities, and expressivity while remaining smooth across patch boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Blended Chart Surfaces，一种无网络、显式的曲面表示方法，通过优化每个代理顶点的多项式映射并利用一环坐标混合实现全局光滑，支持任意拓扑且可直接访问微分量和表面能量。在多种拓扑和几何复杂度上，该方法与插值函数基线和网格位移 MLP 相比，在紧凑性、简单性、微分量访问和表达能力之间取得了有利的权衡。
Motivation: 现有神经表示（如隐式场、显式神经映射）在紧凑性、光滑性、拓扑支持或微分量访问上存在折衷，例如隐式场需要等值面提取，显式神经映射受限于参数化或存在接缝伪影。需要一种同时满足这些属性的表示。
Method: 给定一个粗略代理网格（编码拓扑和近似几何），在每个代理顶点联合优化一个多项式映射，无需输入参数化；相邻映射通过平滑的“一环坐标”混合方案融合，从而将拓扑和粗略几何与细节解耦。优化使用现成优化器拟合隐式目标形状，整个表面全局光滑且可微。
Result: 在多种拓扑和几何复杂度上，与插值函数基线和网格位移 MLP 相比，Blended Chart Surfaces 在紧凑性、简单性、微分量访问和表达能力之间取得了有利的权衡，且跨补丁边界保持光滑。
Conclusion: 该表示是显式、无网络、光滑且可微的，支持刚性运动和缩放等变性，适用于需要可靠微分量的几何处理任务。未来工作或可扩展至更大规模或动态场景。

summary_sections.method: 给定一个粗略代理网格（编码拓扑和近似几何），在每个代理顶点联合优化一个多项式映射，无需输入参数化；相邻映射通过平滑的“一环坐标”混合方案融合，从而将拓扑和粗略几何与细节解耦。优化使用现成优化器拟合隐式目标形状，整个表面全局光滑且可微。
summary_sections.result: 在多种拓扑和几何复杂度上，与插值函数基线和网格位移 MLP 相比，Blended Chart Surfaces 在紧凑性、简单性、微分量访问和表达能力之间取得了有利的权衡，且跨补丁边界保持光滑。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该表示是显式、无网络、光滑且可微的，支持刚性运动和缩放等变性，适用于需要可靠微分量的几何处理任务。未来工作或可扩展至更大规模或动态场景。

papers.title: Agentic AI-based Framework for Mitigating Premature Diagnostic Handoff and Silent Hallucination in Healthcare Applications
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and multi-agent systems have driven the rise of Agentic AI, showing promise for medical reasoning. However, open-ended conversational agents remain prone to two critical failure modes: premature diagnostic handoff and silent clinical hallucinations that may go undetected before reaching the patient. In this work, we propose a multi-agent framework that addresses both issues by replacing ``LLM-as-a-judge'' routing with deterministic orchestration constraints. The framework incorporates two safety mechanisms. First, a neuro-symbolic state-tracking gate enforces completeness of the OLDCARTS clinical protocol (Onset, Location, Duration, Character, Aggravating/Alleviating factors, Radiation, Timing, and Severity) by blocking diagnostic transitions until all required dimensions are collected. Second, an epistemic uncertainty quantification (UQ) gate computes semantic entropy (H) across K=5 independent diagnostic samples to identify and intercept divergent outputs before delivery. We evaluate the system using simulated patient agents powered by the llama-3.1-70b-instruct model on 150 test cases. The full architecture achieves 49.3% diagnostic precision, representing an absolute improvement of 11.3 percentage points over an unconstrained baseline. Additionally, we observe a statistically significant negative correlation (r = -0.181, p < 0.05) between OLDCARTS completeness (σ) and semantic entropy (H), suggesting that structured information gathering is associated with reduced diagnostic uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多智能体AI的框架，用于缓解医疗对话系统中的过早诊断移交和无声临床幻觉问题。该框架通过确定性编排约束替代LLM作为评判的路由，并结合神经符号状态跟踪门（确保OLDCARTS临床协议完整性）和认知不确定性量化门（基于语义熵拦截分歧输出）。在150个测试用例上，该框架实现了49.3%的诊断准确率，比无约束基线提高11.3个百分点，并发现OLDCARTS完整性与语义熵之间存在负相关。
Motivation: 现有LLM和多智能体系统在医疗推理中容易产生过早诊断移交和未被察觉的临床幻觉，这些失败模式可能导致患者安全风险。
Method: 提出多智能体框架，通过确定性编排约束替代LLM作为评判的路由，包含两个安全机制：一是基于神经符号状态跟踪的OLDCARTS协议完整性门，二是基于语义熵的认知不确定性量化门。
Result: 在150个测试用例上，框架诊断准确率达49.3%，绝对提升11.3个百分点；OLDCARTS完整性与语义熵呈显著负相关（r=-0.181, p<0.05）。
Conclusion: 该框架通过结构化信息收集和不确定性量化有效减少了医疗对话中的诊断错误，但摘要未提及在真实患者数据上的验证或与其他方法的对比。

papers.title: NoiseTilt: Noise-Tilted Reverse Kernels for Diffusion Reward Alignment
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Noise-Tilted Reverse Kernel (NTRK), a reward-guided diffusion sampler that injects reward gradients through the noise term, leaving the pretrained reverse kernel unchanged and requiring only a single sample per step. Reward-guided sampling at inference time has greatly expanded the versatility of pretrained diffusion models. Yet existing methods face a trade-off. Gradient-based guidance shifts the reverse mean, steering generation but pushing intermediate states outside the region that the model was trained on and degrading quality. Search-based methods preserve quality but gain no gradient signal. No prior method achieves both. NTRK resolves this by keeping the reverse mean fixed and biasing the noise term toward high reward. We introduce a whitening operator, the central mechanism behind NTRK, that makes the reward gradient safe to inject as noise without losing its guiding signal. Across various reward alignment tasks, NTRK outperforms recent state-of-the-art baselines without losing sample quality. Remarkably, on aesthetic generation, NTRK surpasses the reward of the best baseline at 500 NFEs using only 25 NFEs, a 20$\times$ reduction in compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Noise-Tilted Reverse Kernel (NTRK)，一种奖励引导的扩散采样器，通过在噪声项中注入奖励梯度，保持预训练逆向核不变，仅需单步采样。与现有方法相比，NTRK 在不损失样本质量的情况下，在多种奖励对齐任务中优于基线，并在美学生成中仅用 25 NFE 即达到最佳基线 500 NFE 的奖励，计算量减少 20 倍。
Motivation: 现有奖励引导采样方法面临权衡：梯度引导会偏移逆向均值，降低生成质量；搜索方法则无法利用梯度信号。NTRK 旨在同时保持生成质量和获取梯度信号。
Method: 提出 Noise-Tilted Reverse Kernel，固定逆向均值，通过白化算子使奖励梯度安全地作为噪声偏置注入，以引导生成向高奖励方向。
Result: 在多种奖励对齐任务中，NTRK 优于近期最先进基线，且在美学生成任务上，以 25 NFE 达到基线 500 NFE 的奖励水平，计算量降低 20 倍。
Conclusion: NTRK 解决了奖励引导采样中质量与梯度信号的矛盾，实现了高效、高质量的奖励对齐生成。

papers.title: When LLMs Analyze Scars: From Images to Clinically-Meaningful Features
papers.abstract_en: Medical image classification faces a fundamental dilemma: while deep learning models achieve remarkable performance at scale, real-world clinical scenarios often suffer from severe data scarcity due to annotation costs, privacy constraints, and disease rarity. This challenge is particularly pronounced in pathological scar classification, where differentiating keloids from hypertrophic scars requires subtle expert knowledge and labeled images are extremely limited. We propose a novel paradigm that repositions large language models (LLMs) as knowledge-driven feature engineers rather than end-to-end classifiers. We call this framework ScaFE (Scar Feature Engineering). Our key insight is that LLMs encode rich medical knowledge that can be externalized as executable feature extraction code, enabling the transformation of high-dimensional images into low-dimensional, clinically interpretable representations. Specifically, we prompt an LLM with established scar assessment criteria to generate deterministic Python code that extracts features aligned with clinical scoring systems such as the Vancouver Scar Scale. Our approach offers three key advantages: (1) data efficiency, achieving robust performance with limited training samples by decoupling knowledge acquisition from statistical learning; (2) privacy preservation, as raw images are processed locally without exposure to external LLMs; and (3) interpretability, through explicit features grounded in clinical reasoning. Extensive experiments on scar classification demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms end-to-end deep learning baselines or using LLMs as black-box classifiers under limited data conditions, establishing a promising direction for integrating LLMs into data-efficient and clinically transparent medical AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ScaFE框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）作为知识驱动的特征工程师，从医学图像中提取临床可解释的低维特征，用于疤痕分类（如区分瘢痕疙瘩与增生性疤痕），在数据稀缺场景下优于端到端深度学习方法。
Motivation: 医学图像分类中，由于标注成本高、隐私限制和疾病罕见性，常面临数据稀缺问题，尤其在疤痕分类中，专家标注的图像非常有限。
Method: 通过提示LLM结合疤痕评估标准（如温哥华疤痕量表）生成确定性Python代码，从图像中提取临床对齐的特征，替代端到端分类器。
Result: 在有限数据条件下，该方法在疤痕分类任务上持续优于端到端深度学习和将LLM用作黑盒分类器的基线。
Conclusion: LLM作为特征工程师可提升数据效率、保护隐私并提供临床可解释性，为医学AI中整合LLM提供了有前景的方向。

papers.title: Security and Privacy Prompts in the Wild: What Users Ask LLMs and How LLMs Respond
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to fulfill users' information needs; users ask LLMs about the weather, pose educational questions, and consult them for legal assistance. One particularly understudied area is digital security and privacy (S&P), where users may seek LLMs' help on how to secure their online accounts or protect their computers from cyber attacks. To the best of our knowledge, no prior study has collected or analyzed the S&P questions users ask LLMs; prior research on LLM response quality relied on expert-authored S&P misconceptions or FAQs rather than user queries. Drawing from WildChat, a dataset of 3.2M user-LLM conversations collected in the wild, our study identifies 14,727 S&P prompts and categorizes them into nine categories covering a wide range of S&P topics. From the S&P prompts, we sampled 450 and performed a thematic analysis to characterize the S&P questions users ask LLMs. Separate from the thematic analysis, we curated 270 advice-seeking S&P prompts, where users ask for recommendations, guidance, or specific S&P information. We measured LLM response quality and consistency when posing the prompt to LLMs 10 times. We found that commercial LLMs outperform open-weight models (GPT 5.5 provided "good enough" responses on 98% of prompts; Llama 4 on 47%). However, among prompts that received high-quality responses on average, commercial models sometimes produce contradictory responses across runs, risking confusing or misleading users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于WildChat数据集分析了用户向大语言模型（LLMs）提出的数字安全与隐私（S&P）问题。识别了14,727个S&P提示，分为9个类别，并对450个提示进行了主题分析。进一步选取270个寻求建议的提示，评估了LLM的响应质量和一致性。发现商业LLM（如GPT 5.5）在98%的提示上提供“足够好”的响应，而开源模型（如Llama 4）只有47%，但商业模型有时会产生前后矛盾的响应。
Motivation: 现有研究未收集或分析用户向LLMs提出的S&P问题，仅依赖专家撰写的误解或常见问题，缺乏对真实用户查询的评估。
Method: 从WildChat数据集中提取S&P相关提示，进行类别划分和主题分析；对一组寻求建议的提示多次查询不同LLM，评估响应质量和一致性。
Result: 商业LLM在响应质量上远超开源模型（GPT 5.5 98% vs Llama 4 47%），但商业模型在不同运行间可能给出矛盾的回答。
Conclusion: 用户向LLMs寻求S&P建议时，虽然商业模型通常能提供高质量响应，但其不一致性可能误导用户，需要进一步改进。

papers.title: PseudoBench: Measuring How Agentic Auto-Research Fuels Pseudoscience
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Model based agents enter autonomous scientific research, their ability to resist pseudoscience becomes increasingly important. Otherwise, such systems may rapidly generate plausible yet misleading studies that contaminate academic literature and erode trust in science. We present PseudoBench, an adversarial benchmark for evaluating whether agentic auto-research systems can identify and resist pseudoscientific narratives. PseudoBench contains 200 curated pseudoscientific claim-evidence pairs across five domains and evaluates agents through an end-to-end research pipeline from experiments to writing. Testing seven state-of-the-art agents, we find that current systems readily produce persuasive reports that align with pseudoscientific premises with near-zero refusal rates and the highest resistance of only 27.4%. Stronger agents risk packaging pseudoscience in more sophisticated scientific language, increasing its apparent credibility. These findings reveal an alarming capacity to fuel pseudoscience, calling for scientific alignment before widespread deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PseudoBench，一个对抗性基准，用于评估基于LLM的自主科研系统能否识别和抵制伪科学叙事。基准包含200个伪科学声称-证据对，覆盖5个领域。测试7个SOTA agent，发现它们轻易产生说服力强的支持伪科学的报告，拒绝率接近0，最高抵抗率仅27.4%，且更强的agent可能用更复杂的科学语言包装伪科学，增加其表面可信度。
Motivation: 基于LLM的agent进入自主科研后，它们抵抗伪科学的能力至关重要，否则可能快速生成看似合理但误导性的研究，污染学术文献并侵蚀科学信任。
Method: 构建PseudoBench，包含200个伪科学声称-证据对（5个领域），通过端到端研究流程（从实验到写作）评估agent。
Result: 测试7个SOTA agent，发现系统轻易产生支持伪科学的报告，拒绝率接近0，最高抵抗率仅27.4%；更强的agent倾向于用更复杂的科学语言包装伪科学，增加其表面可信度。
Conclusion: 当前agent存在惊人的助长伪科学的能力，呼吁在广泛部署前进行科学对齐。

papers.title: When AI Says "I have been in similar situations": Synthetic Lived Experience in Peer-Like Caregiver Support
papers.abstract_en: Caregivers often turn to online communities for informational and emotional support. In these spaces, peer supporters frequently draw on personal narratives to respond to emotionally complex caregiving situations. As LLMs are increasingly designed as peer-like sources of support, they introduce a critical tension: AI can provide immediate, private, and nonjudgmental support, but it cannot authentically possess the lived experiences that make human peer support meaningful. Yet, when prompted to sound peer-like, LLMs may generate language that implies lived experience. This creates a synthetic lived experience paradox: the same experiential language that may make AI support feel warm, relatable, and peer-like can also falsely position the system as someone with lived experience. We examine this paradox in the context of family caregivers of people living with Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD). Drawing on caregiver support exchanges from online communities and prompted peer-like responses from three LLMs -- LLaMA, GPT-4o-mini, and MedGemma -- we analyze how human peers use personal narratives and how AI incorporates similar narrative forms. Psycholinguistic analysis shows that peer responses used significantly more first-person and past-focused language than peer-like AI responses. Qualitatively, we identify seven types of personal narratives in human peer support and show that AI often captures their emotional work, but can fabricate experiential grounding. These findings reveal a narrative authenticity gap: peer-like AI can generate synthetic lived experience without the real experience that makes peer support meaningful. We argue that caregiver-support AI systems need mechanisms to distinguish supportive peer-like framing from fabricated lived experience, ensuring that models can offer warmth and validation without falsely positioning themselves as experiential peers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了大型语言模型在同伴式照顾者支持中可能产生的合成生活经验悖论：AI虽能提供即时、私密且非评判性的支持，但无法真实拥有使人类同伴支持有意义的生活经验。通过分析人类同伴支持与AI回应中的叙事形式，发现AI能模仿情感支持却可能伪造经验基础，形成叙事真实性差距。
Motivation: 在线社区中同伴支持者常借助个人叙事回应情感复杂的照顾情境，而AI被设计为类似同伴的支持来源时，可能生成暗示生活经验的表述，却无法真正拥有这些经验，从而引发信任与真实性问题。
Method: 研究基于ADRD家庭照顾者的在线社区交流数据，收集三个LLM（LLaMA, GPT-4o-mini, MedGemma）的同伴式回应，通过心理语言学分析比较人类与AI的第一人称、过去时态语言使用，并定性识别人类同伴支持中的七种个人叙事类型。
Result: 心理语言学分析显示人类同伴回应比AI回应使用了显著更多的第一人称和过去时语言；定性分析表明AI虽能捕捉情感工作，但可能捏造经验基础，存在叙事真实性差距。
Conclusion: 需要为照顾者支持AI设计机制，以区分有益的同伴式框架与伪造的生活经验，确保模型能提供温暖与肯定而不错误地将自身定位为有经验的人。

papers.title: ConTex: Reformulating Counterfactual Generation For Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Decision-making with deep learning-based time series forecasting requires not only accurate predictions but also actionable insights. However, current architectures do not inherently provide such information. Specifically, guidance is needed on how current conditions must be modified to shift from a predicted outcome to a desired future scenario. Counterfactual explanations provide a natural framework for this task, as they represent minimal input changes that alter the model's prediction, indicating when and how intervention is required. Existing approaches rely on instance-wise optimization, leading to inconsistency across instances, high computational costs, and limited applicability in real-time settings. To address these limitations, we reformulate counterfactual generation for time series forecasting as the problem of learning a globally consistent intervention strategy, allowing counterfactuals to be generated through a single shared function. We propose Counterfactual Time Series Explanations (ConTex), a model-agnostic, decomposed architecture comprising a temporal context encoder and a conditional encoder, followed by two heads that capture interventions in terms of temporal relevance and modification strength. This structure overcomes the instability and inconsistency of instance-based approaches by producing targeted, interpretable interventions across time and feature dimensions in a single forward pass, making it suitable for real-time applications. Across multiple forecasting architectures and benchmark datasets, ConTex achieves state-of-the-art validity while generating sparse counterfactuals that minimize the number of necessary interventions. Additionally, our approach reduces computational cost by at least 12-36x compared to instance-wise generation and supports real-time inference at approximately 0.007 seconds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度学习时间序列预测中缺乏可操作见解的问题，将反事实生成重新定义为学习全局一致的干预策略，提出ConTex（Counterfactual Time Series Explanations）架构。该架构由时间上下文编码器和条件编码器组成，通过两个头部分别捕捉干预的时间相关性和修改强度，在单次前向传播中生成稀疏、可解释的反事实。在多个预测架构和基准数据集上，ConTex达到最先进的有效性，同时将计算成本降低12-36倍，支持约0.007秒的实时推理。
Motivation: 现有基于实例优化的反事实解释方法在时间序列预测中存在不一致性、高计算成本和实时性差的问题，无法提供如何修改当前条件以达到期望未来结果的指导。
Method: 提出ConTex，一种模型无关的解耦架构，包含时间上下文编码器和条件编码器，以及两个输出头分别预测时间相关性和干预强度，通过单次前向传播生成全局一致的反事实。
Result: 在多个预测架构和数据集上达到最先进的解释有效性，生成的反事实稀疏且干预次数最少；计算成本相比实例方法降低12-36倍，推理时间约0.007秒。
Conclusion: ConTex通过将反事实生成转化为可学习的全局函数，克服了实例方法的缺点，适用于实时决策场景。

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) combine vision-language backbones with expressive generative action heads trained via flow matching on large-scale robotic datasets. Despite their strong empirical performance in robotic manipulation, VLAs lack mechanisms to quantify confidence in their predictions and to detect when their actions may be unreliable. This presents a critical limitation for real-world deployment in non-stationary environments, where models inevitably encounter scenarios outside their pretraining distribution and may fail without warning. To address this, we derive an efficient method for quantifying epistemic uncertainty in flow-matching models by leveraging velocity-field disagreement (VFD) across a small ensemble. We successfully use this uncertainty estimate for failure detection during deployment and active fine-tuning of flow-based VLAs. To this end, we propose SAVE, a framework for uncertainty-guided active multitask fine-tuning that reduces the number of costly expert demonstrations required to adapt VLAs to new tasks. Through extensive experiments on the LIBERO benchmark, we demonstrate that VFD yields better-calibrated uncertainty estimates predictive of downstream performance, that VFD achieves strong performance in detecting failures, and that uncertainty-guided data acquisition with SAVE requires at least 22% fewer samples than baselines. In summary, our work shows that quantifying epistemic uncertainty in flow-based VLAs improves both failure awareness and adaptation. Project website: tum-lsy.github.io/uq_vla/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在机器人操作中缺乏不确定性量化的问题，提出利用速度场不一致性（VFD）来评估认知不确定性，并用于失败检测和主动微调。在LIBERO基准上，VFD生成校准良好的不确定性估计，有效检测失败，不确定性引导的主动微调框架SAVE相比基线减少至少22%的所需专家演示样本。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在非平稳环境中部署时，由于缺乏置信度量化机制，无法可靠地检测动作的不可靠性，可能导致无预警的失败，这是实际应用中的关键限制。
Method: 提出速度场不一致性（VFD）方法，通过小集成中速度场的差异来高效量化流匹配模型中的认知不确定性；并基于此构建SAVE框架，实现不确定性引导的主动多任务微调。
Result: 在LIBERO基准上，VFD生成的不确定性估计与下游性能高度相关，在失败检测中表现优异；SAVE框架相比基线至少减少22%的所需专家演示样本。
Conclusion: 量化流基VLA中的认知不确定性能同时提升失败感知和适应性，为机器人操作中的安全部署和数据高效微调提供了有效途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ProvenanceGuard: Source-Aware Factuality Verification for MCP-Based LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using LLM agents increasingly use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to answer from heterogeneous evidence sources, including search, APIs, databases, clinical records, and formulary tools. Standard factuality metrics usually test whether an answer is supported by pooled evidence, missing a provenance-sensitive failure mode: a claim may be supported somewhere while being attributed to the wrong source. We call this cross-source conflation. We introduce ProvenanceGuard, a source-aware verifier for MCP-grounded answers. It consumes captured MCP traces with stable tool IDs, source IDs, and raw outputs; decomposes answers into atomic claims; routes claims to source-specific evidence; checks support with NLI and a token-alignment proxy; compares stated attribution with the routed source; and returns per-claim verdicts plus an answer-level allow/block decision. Blocked answers can be repaired with retrieval-augmented answer revision and re-verified. We evaluate on 281 medical-domain MCP-agent traces. A 266-trace adjudicated subset yields 2,325 LLM-assisted claim labels split by trace; 361 held-out labels are human-verified. On the 40-trace held-out split, ProvenanceGuard achieves block F1 0.802 and source accuracy 0.858 over 260 source-eligible claims, outperforming source-blind baselines that do not emit claim-to-source IDs. On a harder multi-source benchmark it reaches block F1 0.846, while source-plus-relation accuracy drops to 0.229, showing that exact source ownership remains difficult with semantically close sources. Repair-and-reverify resolves all blocked answers in the full trace set, often via conservative fallback. In 50 controlled clinical conflation probes, ProvenanceGuard detects all injected attribution swaps with no retained wrong attribution. These results show that source attribution is an independent axis for factuality verification in MCP-based agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProvenanceGuard，一种针对基于 MCP（模型上下文协议）的 LLM 代理的源感知事实性验证器，旨在检测跨源混淆（cross-source conflation）——即答案得到某处证据支持却错误归因于其他来源。该系统通过解析 MCP 轨迹、分解原子声明、路由至源特定证据并使用 NLI 和令牌对齐代理进行验证，最终给出逐声明判定和答案级允许/阻止决策。在 281 条医疗领域 MCP 代理轨迹上的评估显示，ProvenanceGuard 在阻止 F1 分数和源准确性上优于源无关基线，且修复与重新验证流程能解决所有被阻止的答案。
Motivation: 现有事实性度量通常仅检查答案是否被池化证据支持，忽略了“跨源混淆”这一故障模式：声明可能在某个来源中得到支持，但被错误归因于另一个来源。
Method: ProvenanceGuard 利用捕获的 MCP 轨迹（包含稳定工具 ID、源 ID 和原始输出），将答案分解为原子声明，将声明路由至源特定证据，通过 NLI 和令牌对齐代理检查支持度，比较声明归属与路由来源，返回逐声明判定和答案级允许/阻止决策。被阻止的答案可通过检索增强的答案修订和重新验证来修复。
Result: 在 40 条保留轨迹上，ProvenanceGuard 达到阻止 F1 0.802 和源准确性 0.858（260 个源合格声明），优于不发出声明到源 ID 的源无关基线。在多源更难基准上阻止 F1 为 0.846，但源加关系准确性降至 0.229，表明语义相近来源时精确源归属仍困难。修复与重新验证解决了全部轨迹中的被阻止答案。在 50 个受控临床混淆探测中检测到所有注入的归属交换，无残留错误归属。
Conclusion: 摘要强调来源归属是 MCP 代理事实性验证的一个独立维度，ProvenanceGuard 证明了其有效性，但语义相近来源下的精确源归属仍具挑战性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When English Isn't the Best Teacher: Source Language Effects in Cross-Lingual In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cross-lingual transfer in multilingual NLP has been widely explored in supervised fine-tuning contexts, where factors like data availability and linguistic similarity largely determine transfer quality. As the field shifts toward few-shot In-Context Learning (ICL), it is often presumed that insights from fine-tuning carry over unchanged. Yet this assumption has not been rigorously evaluated, leaving open the question of how to choose source languages for cross-lingual ICL. We conduct a broad empirical study of cross-lingual transfer in ICL spanning seven tasks, six models, and a typologically diverse set of languages. We further analyze language confusion, a key obstacle for generative tasks in cross-lingual ICL. Our results show that conventional fine-tuning-based expectations do not consistently apply in the ICL regime and point to alternative heuristics for selecting source languages effectively.
papers.comment: Accepted at 1st Workshop on Multilinguality in the Era of Large Language Models (MeLLM 2026), co-located with ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨语言上下文学习（cross-lingual ICL）中的源语言选择问题展开实证研究，涵盖七个任务、六个模型和多种语言类型。研究发现，基于微调（fine-tuning）的跨语言迁移经验在ICL场景下并不一致适用，并指出了语言混淆（language confusion）这一关键障碍，提出了替代的源语言选择启发式方法。
Motivation: 跨语言转移在监督微调中已被广泛研究，但向少样本上下文学习（ICL）转变时，通常默认微调经验直接迁移，这一假设未被严格评估，因此需要明确如何为跨语言ICL选择源语言。
Method: 通过对七个任务、六个模型和多种类型语言的广泛实证研究，分析跨语言ICL中的源语言选择问题，并专门考察语言混淆对生成任务的影响。
Result: 结果表明，基于微调的常规预期在ICL场景下并不一致适用，并指出了有效选择源语言的替代启发式方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调微调经验在跨语言ICL中不直接成立，需要重新评估源语言选择策略，并提出了新的启发式方法。

papers.title: INI-VPINN: A Variational Physics-Informed Neural Network with Implicit Neumann and Interface Handling for Multi-Material Domains with Geometric Singularities
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new weak-form Physics-Informed Neural Network approach (named INI-VPINN). INI-VPINN naturally incorporates Neumann boundary and interface conditions into the variational formulation. It removes the need for additional loss terms or multiple subdomain networks. This framework employs compact support weighting functions and integration by parts to implicitly impose flux and continuity constraints. In this way, it implicitly ensures physical consistency across material boundaries. The proposed method is tested on Poisson and Laplace problems with sharp interfaces and complex geometries. Results show that, compared with several other Physics Informed Neural Networks-based formulations, the INI-VPINN consistently achieves higher accuracy, smoother and faster convergence. The proposed framework provides a general approach for solving multimaterial problems with complex geometries and mixed Neumann-Dirichlet boundary conditions using neural networks. The implementation is publicly available in a GitHub repository.

papers.title: Catastrophic Forgetting is Low-Rank: A Function-Space Theory for Continual Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Catastrophic forgetting in continual adaptation is usually studied through parameter drift, replay, or distillation, but these views do not identify which output-space directions are vulnerable. We give a function-space account in the NTK regime: new-task training induces old-task prediction drift through the cross-task kernel, yielding a closed-form predictor for the forgetting vector before any new-task gradient step. In frozen-backbone linear-head PEFT-CL, where the model is linear in the trainable parameters, the predictor is exact up to numerical precision; for nonlinear adapters/full fine-tuning, it is a local NTK approximation. The same expression reveals that forgetting concentrates in a small number of old-task NTK eigenmodes and under frozen linear heads gives a Kronecker scaling rule for the vulnerable rank. These results clarify the relation to prior NTK-overlap theory, explain why parameter-space regularizers can miss output-space interference, and motivate a targeted spectral regularizer.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ICML 2026 Workshop on Continual Adaptation at Scale: Towards Sustainable AI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在NTK（神经切向核）框架下给出持续适应中灾难性遗忘的函数空间解释。新任务训练导致的旧任务预测漂移可以通过跨任务核的闭式预测器描述，发现遗忘集中在少数旧任务NTK本征模上，并在冻结骨干线性头情况下给出脆弱性秩的Kronecker缩放规则。这些结果解释了参数空间正则化可能忽略输出空间干扰的原因，并启发了一种针对性谱正则化方法。
Motivation: 现有研究通常从参数漂移、重放或蒸馏视角理解灾难性遗忘，但未能识别哪些输出空间方向是脆弱的。本文旨在从函数空间角度给出脆弱性的表征。
Method: 在NTK机制下，推导出新任务训练前旧任务预测漂移的闭式预测器，该预测器通过跨任务核实现。对于冻结骨干线性头的PEFT-CL，预测器精确；对于非线性适配器/全微调，则是局部NTK近似。该表达式揭示遗忘集中在少数旧任务NTK本征模上。
Result: 给出脆弱性秩的Kronecker缩放规则，并阐明与先前NTK重叠理论的关系，解释参数空间正则化可能遗漏输出空间干扰的原因。
Conclusion: 提出一种针对性谱正则化方法来应对上述发现，该方法有望更有效地减轻灾难性遗忘。

papers.title: LoopCoder-v2: Only Loop Once for Efficient Test-Time Computation Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers scale latent computation by repeatedly applying shared blocks, but sequential looping increases latency and KV-cache memory with the loop count. Parallel loop Transformers (PLT) alleviate this cost through cross-loop position offsets (CLP) and shared-KV gated sliding-window attention, making loop count a practical design choice. We therefore study PLT loop-count selection through a gain--cost view: an extra loop may refine representations, but CLP also introduces a positional mismatch at each loop boundary. We instantiate this study by training LoopCoder-v2, a family of 7B PLT coders with different loop counts, from scratch on 18T tokens, followed by matched instruction tuning and evaluation. Empirically, the two-loop variant delivers broad gains over the non-looped baseline across code generation, code reasoning, agentic software engineering, and tool-use benchmarks, improving SWE-bench Verified from 43.0 to 64.4 points and Multi-SWE from 14.0 to 31.0 points. In contrast, variants with three or more loops regress, revealing a strongly non-monotonic loop-count effect. Our diagnostics show that loop 2 provides the main productive refinement, while later loops yield diminishing, oscillatory updates and reduced representational diversity. Because the CLP-induced mismatch remains roughly fixed as refinement gains shrink, the offset cost increasingly dominates. This gain--cost trade-off explains PLT's saturation at two loops and provides diagnostics for loop-count selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究并行循环Transformer (PLT) 中循环次数的选择问题，提出增益-成本视角：额外循环可能改善表征，但跨循环位置偏移 (CLP) 引入位置不匹配。通过训练不同循环次数的 LoopCoder-v2 系列模型（7B, 18T tokens），发现两循环变体在代码生成、推理等基准上显著优于无循环基线，而三循环或更多循环则性能下降，揭示了非单调的循环次数效应。诊断表明循环2提供主要改进，后续循环更新递减且表征多样性降低，CLP 偏移成本逐渐主导，解释了两循环饱和现象。
Motivation: Looped Transformer 通过重复应用共享块来扩展潜在计算，但顺序循环增加延迟和 KV 缓存。并行循环 Transformer (PLT) 通过跨循环位置偏移 (CLP) 和共享 KV 门控滑动窗口注意力缓解了成本，使循环次数成为实际设计选择。然而，如何选择最优循环次数尚不清楚，需要理解其增益与成本之间的权衡。
Method: 从增益-成本视角研究 PLT 循环次数选择：补偿循环可以细化表征，但 CLP 在每个循环边界引入位置不匹配。训练不同循环次数的 LoopCoder-v2 7B 模型（从零开始，18T tokens），随后进行指令微调和评估。
Result: 两循环变体在代码生成、代码推理、agentic 软件工程和工具使用基准上广泛优于无循环基线：SWE-bench Verified 从 43.0 提升至 64.4，Multi-SWE 从 14.0 提升至 31.0。三循环或更多变体性能退化，显示非单调循环次数效应。诊断表明循环2提供主要有效细化，后续循环更新递减且振荡，表征多样性降低；CLP 偏移成本大致固定，而细化增益缩小，使偏移成本逐渐占主导。
Conclusion: PLT 的增益-成本权衡解释了循环次数在两次后饱和的现象，并提供了循环次数选择的诊断方法。

papers.title: Recursive Scaling in Masked Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for sequence generation. Scaling MDMs is conventionally achieved by increasing the parameter count or the number of denoising steps. We introduce Recursive Masked Diffusion Models (R-MDMs), which add recursive depth as a third scaling axis by repeatedly applying the same denoising transformer within each diffusion step. Recursion enables iterative refinement of the output through parameter reuse, increasing effective model depth without increasing parameter count. Across structured generation tasks, including Sudoku and Countdown, we show that R-MDMs achieve substantially improved parameter efficiency: a model with $L$ recursive iterations often matches the performance of non-recursive baselines with roughly $L\times$ more parameters. Moreover, recursive refinement can partially substitute for additional denoising steps, allowing recursive models to reach the same generation quality with fewer forward passes at inference time. These results suggest that recursive depth is a practically useful scaling mechanism for MDMs, improving both parameter efficiency and the allocation of test-time compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出递归掩码扩散模型（R-MDMs），通过在每一步扩散中重复应用同一个去噪Transformer来增加递归深度，作为独立于参数数量和去噪步数的第三缩放轴。在数独和倒数等结构化生成任务上，R-MDMs以显著更少的参数达到与基线模型相当的性能，且递归可部分替代去噪步数，减少推理时的前向传播次数。
Motivation: 传统缩放掩码扩散模型（MDMs）仅通过增加参数数量或去噪步数，本文探索递归深度作为新的缩放维度，旨在提升参数效率和推理计算效率。
Method: 提出递归掩码扩散模型（R-MDMs），在每个扩散步内递归应用相同的去噪Transformer模块，通过参数复用增加有效模型深度而不增加参数量。
Result: 在数独和倒数等结构化生成任务上，R-MDMs 使用 L 次递归迭代的性能接近非递归基线模型使用约 L 倍参数的性能；递归还能替代部分去噪步数，以更少的前向传播达到相同生成质量。
Conclusion: 递归深度是掩码扩散模型的一种实用缩放机制，同时改善了参数效率和测试时计算分配。

papers.title: LegalHalluLens: Typed Hallucination Auditing and Calibrated Multi-Agent Debate for Trustworthy Legal AI
papers.abstract_en: AI systems deployed in legal workflows hallucinate at rates that aggregate metrics report at ~52%, but this average conceals where errors concentrate and in which direction they run, leaving compliance officers without an actionable signal for trustworthy deployment. We present LegalHalluLens, an auditing framework with three components: typed hallucination profiles across four legally-motivated claim categories (numeric, temporal, obligation/entitlement, factual) over CUAD (Hendrycks et al., 2021); a Risk Direction Index (RDI) that reduces omission-versus-invention bias to a single deployment-comparable scalar; and a typed debate pipeline calibrated to both magnitudes and directions. Across 510 contracts and 249,252 clause-level instances we measure a within-model gap of approximately 38-40 pp between obligation/numeric and temporal claims that aggregate reporting hides, and show that two systems with matched 52% rates can carry opposite RDIs. The debate pipeline reduces fabricated detections by 45% with per-category gains tracking the diagnosis, matching commercial APIs with a substantially smaller backbone (4B active parameters). Typed profiles and RDI surface failure modes that aggregate metrics hide; we further show these diagnostics serve as calibration inputs for multi-agent debate pipelines, where Skeptic challenges and asymmetric gates targeted at measured failure modes outperform generically-tuned debate. The framework supports direction-aware procurement, accountability, and agent design for legal AI deployed in the wild.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures; Published at the Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD) at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LegalHalluLens审计框架，用于法律AI的幻觉检测与校准。该框架包括类型化幻觉剖析（数字、时间、义务/权利、事实四类）、风险方向指数（RDI）以及校准的多智能体辩论管道。在510份合同和249,252个条款实例上，揭示聚合指标（如52%幻觉率）隐藏的约38-40个百分点的模型内差距，并证明两个具有相同幻觉率的系统可能携带相反的RDI。辩论管道减少45%的捏造检测，以4B活跃参数的小骨干匹配商业API。
Motivation: 现有聚合指标报告法律AI的幻觉率约52%，但这一平均值掩盖了错误在哪些类型和方向上集中，使合规官员无法获得可操作的信号用于可信部署。
Method: 提出包含三部分的审计框架：1）基于法律动机的四类幻觉剖析（数字、时间、义务/权利、事实）；2）风险方向指数（RDI），将遗漏与捏造偏差归约到单一可比标量；3）针对大小和方向校准的类型化辩论管道。
Result: 在510份合同和249,252个条款级别实例上，测量到聚合指标隐藏的约38-40个百分点的模型内差距（义务/数字与时间主张之间）；两个系统幻觉率均52%但RDI相反。辩论管道减少45%的捏造检测，每类收益跟踪诊断，以4B活跃参数匹配商业API。
Conclusion: 类型化剖析和RDI揭示了聚合指标隐藏的失败模式，这些诊断可作为多智能体辩论管道的校准输入，其中针对测量的失败模式的目标质疑和不对称门优于通用调谐的辩论。框架支持方向感知的采购、问责和智能体设计。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Fast Nonparametric Conditional Independence Testing via Two-Stage Regression
papers.abstract_en: Constraint-based causal discovery relies on repeated conditional independence tests, but fast nonparametric tests often sacrifice calibration, especially when variables depend on the conditioning set through nonlinear relationships. We introduce BLITZ (Broad-to-Local Independence Testing via residualiZation), a nonparametric conditional independence test designed to run well under a second while maintaining the accuracy needed for the thousands of queries performed by constraint-based causal discovery algorithms. BLITZ first removes broad smooth dependence on the conditioning set using low-order polynomial regression, then applies a small nonlinear feature map and residualizes those features with shallow tree regressions. The resulting statistic tests residual cross-covariance, with a moment-matched chi-square approximation to the null distribution. We show theoretically that the two-stage design reduces the effective complexity faced by the tree residualizers, allowing shallow trees to control residual conditional-mean bias while avoiding excessive overfitting. In simulations, BLITZ provides better null calibration than fast kernel, random-feature, and regression-based competitors while remaining among the fastest methods tested. In causal discovery experiments on synthetic graphs and flow-cytometry data, BLITZ yields more reliable endpoint orientations among retained adjacencies and competitive structural recovery. These results suggest that broad-to-local residualization is a practical route to calibrated, scalable nonparametric conditional independence testing for causal discovery.
papers.comment: A fast R implementation with C++ back-end is available at https://github.com/ericstrobl/BLITZ
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BLITZ 是一种快速非参数条件独立性检验，通过两阶段回归（先低阶多项式回归去除条件集的平滑依赖，再用浅树回归残差化特征）实现良好校准。理论分析表明两阶段设计降低了树残差化器的有效复杂度，模拟实验中 BLITZ 在校准和速度上优于现有快速核方法、随机特征方法和回归方法。在因果发现实验中，BLITZ 在合成图和流式细胞术数据上获得更可靠的端点方向和竞争性的结构恢复。
Motivation: 基于约束的因果发现依赖大量条件独立性检验，但现有快速非参数检验在校准上存在不足，尤其当变量通过非线性关系依赖于条件集时。
Method: 首先用低阶多项式回归去除条件集的广泛平滑依赖，然后应用小非线性特征映射并通过浅树回归残差化这些特征，最后检验残差互协方差，使用矩匹配的卡方近似得到零分布。
Result: 模拟中 BLITZ 在保持最快速度的同时实现比快速核、随机特征和回归竞争方法更好的零校准；因果发现实验中在合成图和流式细胞术数据上获得更可靠的端点方向和竞争性结构恢复。
Conclusion: 从宽到局部残差化为因果发现提供了一种实用、可扩展且校准的非参数条件独立性检验途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PhaseWin: An Efficient Search Algorithm for Faithful Visual Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Visual attribution is a fundamental tool for interpreting modern vision and vision-language models, particularly when their decisions must be inspected, diagnosed, or audited. Its goal is to explain how a model's decision depends on local regions of the visual input, typically by assigning an importance ordering over candidate image regions. Given an image partitioned into $n$ regions, faithful attribution can be cast as an ordered subset-search problem, in which progressively inserting the selected regions should recover the target model response as early as possible. Exhaustive search over region subsets incurs exponential cost, while the widely used greedy search still requires a quadratic number of model evaluations, because every selection step rescores all remaining candidates. We propose PhaseWin, an efficient subset-search algorithm for faithful visual attribution. PhaseWin reorganizes greedy region selection into a phased window-search procedure: rather than re-evaluating the full candidate set at every step, it alternates between global candidate screening, adaptive pruning, and localized window refinement, while preserving the essential region-ranking behavior of greedy search. We analyze PhaseWin under monotone evidence-accumulation conditions and show that, under feature-level structural assumptions, it attains controllable linear evaluation complexity together with near-greedy faithfulness guarantees. Extensive experiments on image classification, object detection, visual grounding, and image captioning show that, among all compared attribution methods, PhaseWin reaches high faithfulness with the fewest forward passes, empirically realizing the predicted reduction from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n)$. The code is available at https://github.com/Qihuai27/phasewin-va.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhaseWin 提出一种高效的视觉归因子集搜索算法，将有序子集搜索问题转化为分阶段窗口搜索（phased window-search），在单调证据积累假设下实现从 O(n^2) 到 O(n) 的复杂度降低，且保持接近贪婪搜索的忠实性。实验在图像分类、目标检测、视觉定位和图像描述等任务上验证了其高效性。
Motivation: 现有贪婪搜索每次选择需要重新评估所有剩余候选区域，导致二次模型调用次数，而穷举搜索成本指数级，难以适用于大规模视觉归因。
Method: 提出 PhaseWin，通过交替进行全局候选筛选、自适应剪枝和局部窗口细化，避免每步重新评估全部候选集，在保持区域排序行为的同时将复杂度降至线性。
Result: 在多个视觉任务上，PhaseWin 以最少的前向传播实现高忠实性，经验验证了复杂度从 O(n^2) 降至 O(n)。
Conclusion: PhaseWin 是一种高效且实用的视觉归因算法，在保证忠实性的前提下显著降低计算成本。
Relevance: 0
