papers.title: LLM Consumer Behavior Theory: Foundations of a Novel Research Field
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that make consumption decisions on behalf of users. This shift raises fundamental questions for consumer theory, which has traditionally modeled humans as the primary decision-makers. In this paper, we introduce LLM Consumer Behavior Theory, a new field of study concerned with analyzing consumer behavior in agentic markets. Drawing on classical and behavioral economics alongside recent advances in Natural Language Processing, we formalize how human preferences are reflected and acted upon by LLM-based agents, and how agent-level decisions aggregate into market demand. We unify previously fragmented literature on LLM decision-making, human behavior simulation, and preference elicitation under a common economic lens, highlighting where assumptions, such as rationality and heterogeneity, may fail in agentic markets. Rather than providing empirical validation, this paper outlines the scope of LLM consumer behavior and identifies open research questions related to alignment, preference representation, and market dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLM消费者行为理论，研究基于大语言模型的自主代理在市场中做出消费决策的行为，将人类偏好通过LLM代理反映并聚合为市场需求。论文统一了关于LLM决策、人类行为模拟和偏好提取等分散文献，并从经济学角度分析理性与异质性假设在代理市场中的失效。
Motivation: 传统消费者理论以人类为决策主体，而LLM代理正越来越多地替代人类做出消费决策，现有理论无法解释这种新型市场行为。
Method: 结合经典与行为经济学以及自然语言处理进展，形式化LLM代理如何反映人类偏好并聚合市场需求，并构建统一分析框架。
Result: 论文未提供实证验证，而是界定了LLM消费者行为的研究范围，并提出与对齐、偏好表示和市场动态相关的开放问题。
Conclusion: 本文为LLM消费者行为理论奠定基础，指出代理市场中理性与异质性假设可能不成立，未来需研究偏好表示和对齐问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: C2FL: Clustered Continual Federated Learning under Spatial and Temporal Drift
papers.abstract_en: Collective Adaptive Systems (CAS) increasingly rely on machine learning to let each node learn from locally sensed data, aligning its behavior with the surrounding environment. Scaling this intelligence, however, raises fundamental challenges: sensed data is often privacy-sensitive, preventing centralized collection; nodes are mobile, traversing regions where nearby nodes perceive similar phenomena while distant ones observe radically different conditions, creating natural spatial clusters; and these distributions evolve over time due to mobility, introducing temporal drift that makes local models progressively stale. These dynamics arise across domains - vehicular sensing, drone-based monitoring, smartphone crowdsensing - yet the interplay of privacy, spatial heterogeneity, and temporal drift severely undermines conventional learning strategies. Therefore, we propose C2FL, a fully distributed Federated Learning (FL) approach where nodes self-organize into learning groups through spatial clustering, reflecting the geographic structure of the environment. To counteract temporal drift, each node combines experience replay with a dwell-time-aware adaptive averaging step, progressively incorporating the regional consensus as it remains longer within the same area, while preserving previously acquired knowledge under evolving distributions. We evaluate our approach on synthetic experiments that systematically reproduce spatial and temporal shifts, showing that standard federated strategies degrade significantly under these conditions and that our method restores robust collective adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C2FL，一种全分布式联邦学习方法，节点通过空间聚类自组织成学习组，并利用经验回放和驻留时间感知的自适应平均步骤来应对时空漂移。实验表明，标准联邦策略在时空漂移下性能严重下降，而 C2FL 恢复了鲁棒的集体适应。
Motivation: 集体自适应系统面临隐私、空间异质性和时间漂移的挑战，现有集中式学习不可行，标准联邦学习在节点移动和分布变化下性能退化。
Method: C2FL 让节点通过空间聚类自组织形成学习组，结合经验回放和驻留时间感知的自适应平均，在相同区域停留越久越融入区域共识，同时保留先前知识。
Result: 在系统性再现时空漂移的合成实验中，标准联邦策略性能严重下降，而 C2FL 恢复了鲁棒的集体适应。
Conclusion: C2FL 通过空间聚类和时间自适应，有效解决了分布式学习中的时空漂移问题，但仅在合成实验验证，需进一步在真实场景测试。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Half a Link can Be Enough to Predict a Whole Link: Understanding Generalization in Knowledge Graph Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graph (KG) foundation models (KGFMs) are zero-shot generalizers: trained once, they can predict links on unseen graphs without retraining. However, understanding when and how they can robustly generalize across KGs is still an open question. In this paper, we shed some light on their generalization mechanisms highlighting how their performance on unseen KGs is not uniform when it comes to partially seen links, which we call half-links. In fact, we show that to predict a test triple $(h,r,t)$ it might suffice in practice to have observed the half-link $(h,r)$ or $(r,t)$ in the inference graph. This yields a taxonomy of four scenarios when combinations of these half-links are observed or not. In a rigorous stratified analysis over these scenarios, we reveal that SoTA KGFMs use seen half links for predictions, while unseen half-links pose different challenges. As such, our finer-grained taxonomy can be a diagnostic protocol for robust KGFM generalization and highlights where novel KGFMs can improve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过引入“半链接”（half-links）概念，系统分析了知识图谱基础模型（KGFM）在未见图上的零样本泛化机制。研究发现，KGFM 在预测三元组 (h,r,t) 时，实际上依赖于是否观察到 (h,r) 或 (r,t) 等半链接，并据此划分出四种预测场景。分层分析表明，当前最优 KGFM 利用已见半链接进行预测，而未见半链接带来不同挑战。该分类可作为诊断 KGFM 鲁棒泛化能力的协议。
Motivation: 尽管 KGFM 在零样本链接预测上表现优异，但何时以及如何跨图鲁棒泛化仍不明确。现有评估缺乏对部分已见链接的细粒度分析，无法揭示模型真实泛化机制。
Method: 提出“半链接”概念，将测试三元组中的 (h,r) 和 (r,t) 视为半链接，根据它们在推理图中的可见性将预测任务分为四种场景。对当前最优 KGFM 进行分层分析，比较各场景下的性能差异。
Result: 实验表明，KGFM 在预测时严重依赖已见半链接：若至少一个半链接在推理图中出现，预测准确率显著高于两者均不可见的情况。未见半链接导致性能下降，且不同 KGFM 对不同场景的鲁棒性不同。
Conclusion: 半链接分类为评估 KGFM 鲁棒泛化提供了更细致的诊断工具，指出了现有模型在完全未见半链接场景下的弱点，并为未来模型改进指明了方向。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A T-API-Compliant ReAct Agentic Loop for Optical Networks: Generic vs. Domain-Specific Tool Abstractions
papers.abstract_en: Optical networks need intent-driven, closed-loop agentic management, a key enabler for higher autonomy levels. We present the first T-API-compliant reasoning and act (ReAct) loop. We show that domain-specific composite tools achieve 90% oracle-validated correctness with threefold token savings compared to generic tools.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, accepted for presentation at the 52nd European Conference on Optical Communications (ECOC), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对光网络中的意图驱动闭环管理需求，提出了首个符合T-API标准的推理与行动（ReAct）循环。通过对比通用工具与领域特定复合工具抽象，实验表明领域特定复合工具在Oracle验证的正确性上达到90%，同时节省了三倍的token消耗。
Motivation: 光网络需要更高的自主性，而意图驱动的闭环代理管理是实现这一目标的关键。现有方法缺乏符合T-API标准的ReAct循环，且通用工具抽象在效率和正确性上可能不足。
Method: 设计并实现了第一个T-API合规的ReAct循环，并比较了通用工具与领域特定复合工具两种抽象方式的效果。
Result: 领域特定复合工具在Oracle验证的正确性上达到90%，且相比通用工具节省了三倍的token消耗。
Conclusion: 领域特定工具抽象在光网络代理循环中比通用工具更有效，兼顾了正确性和效率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 领域特定复合工具在Oracle验证的正确性上达到90%，且相比通用工具节省了三倍的token消耗。
summary_sections.conclusion: 领域特定工具抽象在光网络代理循环中比通用工具更有效，兼顾了正确性和效率。

papers.title: AIGS-Net: Compact Illumination Field Modeling via 2D Gaussian Splatting for Fast Low-Light Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Existing low-light image enhancement methods often face a bottleneck between the representation capacity of illumination-field modeling and computational complexity. To address this issue, this paper proposes an Adaptive Illumination Gaussian Splatting Network (AIGS-Net), an ultra-lightweight architecture for fast low-light enhancement. Unlike conventional static priors, AIGS-Net constructs an input-adaptive 2D Gaussian Splatting illumination field. The opacity of Gaussian basis functions is dynamically modulated by relative luminance statistics of the input image, and spatially varying illumination compensation is rendered through ordered alpha compositing. To guide adaptive illumination compensation efficiently, a zero-parameter nonlinear multiscale contextual encoding module is introduced to extract low-frequency structures and local contrast cues without additional convolutional weights. To suppress noise amplification and sensor-induced color bias, AIGS-Net integrates noise-mask estimation, locked single-channel Gamma mapping, cross-channel consistency regularization, and target color-alignment constraints. Experiments on LOL and LSRW benchmarks show that AIGS-Net improves detail recovery and color fidelity while requiring only approximately 40 learnable parameters, achieving an effective trade-off between enhancement quality and extreme inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AIGS-Net，一个超轻量级的低光照图像增强网络，通过2D高斯泼溅（2D Gaussian Splatting）构建自适应光照场，仅需约40个可学习参数，在LOL和LSRW基准上提升细节恢复和颜色保真度，实现增强质量与推理效率的平衡。
Motivation: 现有低光照增强方法在光照场建模表示能力与计算复杂度之间存在瓶颈，需要更高效的架构。
Method: 提出AIGS-Net，包括输入自适应的2D高斯泼溅光照场（通过相对亮度统计动态调节高斯基函数的不透明度）、零参数非线性多尺度上下文编码模块（提取低频结构和局部对比度线索）、以及噪声掩膜估计、锁定单通道伽马映射、跨通道一致性正则化和目标颜色对齐约束等组件。
Result: 在LOL和LSRW基准上，AIGS-Net仅需约40个可学习参数，就能改善细节恢复和颜色保真度，实现了增强质量与极端推理效率之间的有效权衡。
Conclusion: AIGS-Net为低光照图像增强提供了超轻量级方案，在保持高质量的同时实现了极快推理。

papers.title: Multiple cyclicity and Wavelet Decomposition with Channel Correlation for Long-term Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Cyclicity and trend are important components of time series data and many studies based on cyclicity and trend have achieved good results in long-term time series forecasting. However, we believe that current work neglects the influence of real-world inter-channel correlations in time series data which leads to suboptimal predictions. Furthermore, these models rely on complex designs to capture diverse information so that resulting in low computational efficiency. To address this challenge, we propose McWC, a long-term time series forecasting model that separately models the cyclicity, trend, and inter-channel correlations. Specifically, McWC first decouples cyclical information from data using a multi-layer cyclicity construction module. Then, it extracts inter-channel correlations using multi-layer perceptron. Next, it models and fuses the multi-layer high-frequency and low-frequency information from data using a multi-level wavelet decomposition module. Finally, it aggregates the results of different components to obtain the output. Simultaneously, we decouple intra-channel autocorrelations by calculating a loss function in the frequency domain. Experiments on six real-world datasets demonstrate that McWC achieves state-of-the-art performance, exhibiting excellent computational efficiency and historical information extraction capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 McWC 模型，通过多周期构建模块、多层感知机提取通道间相关性、多级小波分解建模高低频信息，并利用频域损失函数解耦通道内自相关性，实现长期时间序列预测。在六个真实世界数据集上达到最先进性能，同时保持高计算效率。
Motivation: 现有基于周期和趋势的时间序列预测模型忽略了真实世界中通道间相关性，且复杂设计导致计算效率低。
Method: McWC 模型包含多周期构建模块解耦周期信息、多层感知机提取通道间相关性、多级小波分解建模融合高低频信息，并在频域计算损失函数解耦通道内自相关性。
Result: 在六个真实世界数据集上达到最先进性能，计算效率高，历史信息提取能力强。
Conclusion: McWC 通过分别建模周期、趋势和通道间相关性，有效提升长期时间序列预测性能。

papers.title: Differential Privacy of Gaussian Process Posterior Sampling
papers.abstract_en: We study the privacy of releasing posterior sample paths from a Gaussian process (GP) when the entire training set including covariates and responses is private. Unlike standard differential-privacy (DP) mechanisms that add external noise, posterior sampling is random by construction. We show that this intrinsic randomness yields DP guarantees by deriving explicit Rényi-DP bounds for GP posterior sample-path release. The bounds separate posterior-mean leakage from data-dependent posterior-covariance leakage showing that meaningful privacy depends sharply on effective ridge regularisation. We apply membership-inference attacks to show that empirical leakage follows the predicted dependence on regularisation, posterior variance and the number of released posterior sample-paths. Utility experiments on downstream posterior-sampling tasks identify noisy-observation regimes where privacy-compatible regularisation preserves useful decisions with modest utility loss. When stronger privacy is needed, the intrinsic guarantee can be sharpened by adding calibrated GP noise, providing an explicit additional privacy knob.
papers.comment: 8 pages of main text + 25 pages appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了高斯过程（GP）后验采样路径发布的差分隐私（DP）特性，其中整个训练集（包括协变量和响应）是私有的。与添加外部噪声的标准DP机制不同，后验采样本身具有随机性。论文推导了显式的Rényi-DP界限，将后验均值泄漏与数据相关的后验协方差泄漏分离，表明有意义的隐私高度依赖于有效的岭正则化。通过成员推理攻击实验验证了理论预测，并在下游后验采样任务中评估了隐私兼容正则化的效用。
Motivation: 标准差分隐私机制通常需要添加外部噪声，而高斯过程后验采样天然具有随机性，可能提供内在隐私保证，但缺乏系统的理论分析。
Method: 推导了高斯过程后验样本路径发布的Rényi-DP界限，通过分离后验均值和协方差的泄漏项，揭示了有效岭正则化对隐私的关键作用。
Result: 成员推理攻击实验表明，经验泄漏与正则化、后验方差和发布的样本路径数量呈理论预测的依赖性；效用实验显示，在噪声观测场景下，隐私兼容的正则化能以适度的效用损失保持有用决策。
Conclusion: GP后验采样的内在随机性可提供有意义的DP保证，且可通过添加校准的GP噪声进一步增强隐私，为隐私保护提供了额外的显式调节手段。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Recover Semantics First, Generate Better: Improved Latent Modeling for 3D MRI Reconstruction and Cross-Contrast Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Multi-contrast magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provides complementary information for clinical diagnosis. However, acquiring all MRI sequences is often time-consuming and costly. Recent generative models perform cross-contrast synthesis to address this issue by inferring absent contrasts from the available ones. Nevertheless, synthesizing 3D MRI presents significant challenges. Due to the massive volume sizes, operating directly in the pixel space is computationally prohibitive; therefore, a common approach is to first compress the 3D volumes into a latent space and subsequently train generative models in that space. We observe that existing compression architectures face several critical issues: they under-preserve long-range anatomical coherence, discard clinically meaningful semantics, and rely on optimization objectives that lead to over-smoothed reconstructions. Ultimately, these shortcomings compromise the performance of subsequent generative models. In this work, we propose a semantics-first latent modeling framework for 3D MRI reconstruction and cross-contrast synthesis. Specifically, we introduce a Latent Harmonization Encoder (LHE) to capture global anatomical dependencies, ensuring coherent volumetric representations. To mitigate semantic degradation during latent compression, we further design a Semantic Recovery Block (SRB) that injects high-level priors from a self-supervised semantic teacher, enhancing contrast-aware separability in the latent space. Additionally, we propose an Anatomy-aware Frequency Loss (AFL) to adaptively preserve diagnostically relevant high-frequency structures. Extensive experiments on two public multi-contrast MRI datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in reconstruction fidelity and cross-contrast synthesis quality. Our code is available at https://github.com/script-Yang/RSF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多对比度3D MRI重建与跨对比度合成任务，提出一种语义优先的潜在建模框架。通过引入潜在协调编码器（LHE）捕捉全局解剖依赖、语义恢复块（SRB）注入自监督语义先验、以及解剖感知频率损失（AFL）保留高频结构，在公开数据集上一致提升了重建保真度和合成质量。
Motivation: 现有潜在空间压缩架构存在长程解剖一致性保持不足、丢弃临床语义信息、优化目标导致重建过于平滑等问题，影响后续生成模型性能。
Method: 提出潜在协调编码器（LHE）建模全局解剖依赖；设计语义恢复块（SRB）从自监督语义教师中注入高层先验；提出解剖感知频率损失（AFL）自适应保留诊断相关的高频结构。
Result: 在两个公开多对比度MRI数据集上，该方法在重建保真度和跨对比度合成质量上均取得一致改进。
Conclusion: 语义优先的潜在建模框架能有效改善3D MRI重建与合成，代码已开源。

papers.title: Gaussian Light Field Splatting: A Physical Prior-Driven Vision Transformer for Unsupervised Low-Light Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Existing unsupervised low-light image enhancement methods often encounter local exposure imbalance and color distortion under complex non-uniform illumination. In addition, most Vision Transformers lack an explicit mechanism for modeling the physical priors of illumination degradation. To address these limitations, we propose GLFS, a Gaussian light field splatting-based Vision Transformer that integrates continuous physical illumination modeling from Gaussian splatting into the Transformer architecture. In GLFS, scene illumination is represented by a superposition of anisotropic Gaussian basis functions. Physics-guided biases are introduced into self-attention to adaptively infer a spatial gain field, enabling accurate and uniform restoration under complex illumination. To reduce color bias and structural degradation during enhancement, a color-vector angular loss and a luminance-edge loss are further developed. These losses enforce hue consistency and improve the structural fidelity of local details. Extensive ablation studies and quantitative evaluations show that GLFS provides clear advantages in illumination correction and detail preservation. It achieves state-of-the-art performance and offers a new representation paradigm for low-light image enhancement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GLFS，一种基于高斯光场溅射（Gaussian light field splatting）的视觉Transformer，用于无监督低光图像增强。通过各向异性高斯基函数表示场景光照，并在自注意力中引入物理引导偏置以自适应推断空间增益场，同时设计色彩向量角度损失和亮度边缘损失来减少颜色偏差和结构退化。摘要称该方法在光照校正和细节保留上达到SOTA性能。
Motivation: 现有无监督低光增强方法在非均匀光照下常出现局部曝光失衡和颜色失真，且多数Vision Transformer缺乏显式的光照退化物理先验建模机制。
Method: 将场景光照建模为各向异性高斯基函数的叠加，在自注意力中引入物理引导偏置以推断空间增益场，并采用色彩向量角度损失和亮度边缘损失分别约束色调一致性和局部结构保真度。
Result: 摘要报告GLFS在光照校正和细节保留方面具有明显优势，达到SOTA性能。
Conclusion: GLFS为低光图像增强提供了新的表示范式，通过集成连续物理光照建模有效提升了复杂光照下的恢复质量。

papers.title: STAR: SpatioTemporal Adaptive Reward Allocation for Text-to-Image RL Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Existing RL post-training methods for text-to-image generation usually convert the final-image reward into a single scalar advantage and apply it with the same strength to the entire generative trajectory. However, text-to-image generation naturally has temporal and spatial structure: different denoising steps are responsible for different generation stages, and the content that truly determines text alignment often appears only in part of the image. This granularity mismatch makes it difficult for policy updates to focus on the generative components that actually affect the reward. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{SpatioTemporal Adaptive Reward (STAR) Allocation} for RL post-training of text-to-image diffusion and flow models. STAR uses text-image attention inside the generative model and starts from the core content that the user truly cares about in the prompt. It constructs spatial allocation maps that dynamically vary across denoising steps and rollouts, and allocates the same group-relative advantage to more relevant latent regions with almost no additional computational overhead. STAR then applies stronger policy updates to these regions through a spatially resolved policy objective. We use Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium as the base model and evaluate on three tasks: GenEval, OCR text rendering, and PickScore. Experimental results show that STAR improves compositional semantic alignment, text rendering, and preference optimization without changing the external reward source, achieving $\mathbf{0.9759}$, $\mathbf{0.9757}$, and $\mathbf{23.60}$ on GenEval, OCR, and PickScore, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出时空自适应奖励分配方法（STAR），用于文本到图像生成模型的强化学习后训练。STAR利用文本-图像注意力图，将组相对优势（group-relative advantage）动态分配至去噪轨迹中与提示词相关的时空区域，并对这些区域施加更强的策略更新。在Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium上的实验表明，STAR在GenEval、OCR文本渲染和PickScore三项任务上分别达到0.9759、0.9757和23.60，提升了组合语义对齐、文本渲染和偏好优化，且几乎不增加额外计算开销。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像RL后训练方法将最终图像奖励转为单一标量优势，并均匀作用于整个生成轨迹，忽略了去噪步骤的时序结构和图像内容的空间结构，导致策略更新难以聚焦真正影响奖励的生成组件。
Method: 提出STAR分配方法：基于生成模型内的文本-图像注意力图，动态构建随去噪步骤和采样轮次变化的空间分配图，将相同的组相对优势分配给更相关的潜在区域，并通过空间分辨的策略目标对这些区域施加更强的策略更新。
Result: 在Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium上，STAR在GenEval、OCR文本渲染和PickScore上分别达到0.9759、0.9757和23.60，显著优于基线。

papers.title: MoCo-AIS: A Contrastive Learning Framework for Similarity Computation of Vessel Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory similarity is a fundamental task in analyzing mobility patterns, essential for applications such as route pattern extraction, mobility prediction, and anomaly detection. Traditional distance-based measures for computing similarity incur high computational cost, driving the adoption of lightweight learning-based approaches. Supervised methods rely on extensive labels derived from traditional distance measures and often reproduce these metrics, which limits generalization. While self-supervised learning addresses this issue through contrastive learning, it lacks a unified framework, making it difficult to compare deep learning (DL) models for consistent trajectory representation. Accordingly, this paper presents MoCo-AIS, a unified framework for learning vessel trajectory embeddings based on the Momentum Contrast (MoCo) paradigm, which formulates similarity learning through positive and negative trajectory pairs. Within this framework, we evaluate a diverse set of leading DL models on large-scale, real-world vessel-tracking AIS datasets that capture diverse navigation behaviors and operating conditions. Results demonstrate that our framework significantly improves similarity learning over existing baselines, while providing a benchmarking platform for evaluating trajectory representation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MoCo-AIS，一个基于动量对比学习（MoCo）的统一框架，用于船舶轨迹相似性学习。该框架通过正负轨迹对进行训练，并在真实AIS数据集上评估了多种深度学习模型，显著提升了相似性学习效果，同时为轨迹表示模型提供了基准平台。
Motivation: 传统距离度量方法计算成本高，监督学习依赖大量标签且泛化能力有限，自监督缺乏统一框架，难以比较不同深度学习模型对轨迹表示的一致性。
Method: 基于MoCo范式的对比学习框架，通过构造正负轨迹对进行相似性学习，并集成多种主流深度学习模型进行评估。
Result: 在大规模真实AIS数据集上，该框架相比现有基线显著改进了轨迹相似性学习性能。
Conclusion: 提供了统一的轨迹表示学习与评估基准，有助于推动轨迹相似性计算的研究。

papers.title: SegDINO: Introducing Multi-Scale Structure into DINO for Efficient Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised DINO models provide strong transferable visual representations, yet applying them directly to image segmentation remains challenging. Existing approaches commonly rely on heavy decoders with complex upsampling, introducing substantial parameter and computational overhead. We observe that introducing scale into DINO features is far more critical than increasing decoder capacity. In this work, we present SegDINO, an efficient segmentation framework that integrates a DINOv3 backbone with lightweight scale modeling. SegDINO introduces Token Pyramid Adaptation (TPA) to reorganize intermediate DINO features into a pseudo multi-scale hierarchy, and Scale-Aware Decoding (SAD) for efficient intra-scale refinement and top-down multi-scale propagation. We further curate PanCT, a new CT dataset containing 284 patients with expert-annotated pancreatic tumors, to assess SegDINO's ability to handle difficult small-lesion cases. Extensive experiments on PanCT and three public benchmarks demonstrate that SegDINO achieves state-of-the-art results with high efficiency. The code is available at https://github.com/script-Yang/segdino_v2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SegDINO，一种高效的医学图像分割框架，将 DINOv3 骨干与轻量级尺度建模结合。通过 Token Pyramid Adaptation (TPA) 将中间 DINO 特征重组为伪多尺度层次，并利用 Scale-Aware Decoding (SAD) 实现高效的尺度内细化和自上而下的多尺度传播。此外收集了 PanCT 数据集（284 名患者的胰腺肿瘤 CT）。实验表明 SegDINO 在多个基准上取得最先进结果且效率高。
Motivation: 直接应用 DINO 模型到图像分割存在挑战，现有方法依赖重型解码器带来参数和计算开销。作者观察到引入尺度比增加解码器容量更关键。
Method: 提出 SegDINO 框架，包含 Token Pyramid Adaptation (TPA) 将 DINO 中间特征重组为伪多尺度层次，以及 Scale-Aware Decoding (SAD) 用于尺度内细化和多尺度传播。同时收集了 PanCT 数据集。
Result: 在 PanCT 和三个公开基准上，SegDINO 实现了最先进的结果且效率高。
Conclusion: 作者认为引入尺度到 DINO 特征比增加解码器容量更重要，SegDINO 验证了这一观点。

papers.title: Reload-Mamba: Hierarchical Anti-Dilution State-Space Modeling for Multi-Class Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Mamba-based state space models offer linear-time long-range modeling for high-resolution dense prediction, but sequential state-space propagation can attenuate boundary-sensitive and detail-sensitive responses that are critical in multi-class semantic segmentation. We propose Reload-Mamba, a semantic segmentation framework that addresses this propagation-induced response dilution through three segmentation-specific designs: (i) a boundary-supervised local detail prior that is explicitly trained with ground-truth boundary masks to identify regions requiring response restoration; (ii) a class-uncertainty-aware Reload Gate that incorporates per-pixel class entropy from a pre-reload auxiliary head as an additional gating signal, a formulation that is informative only under multi-class dense prediction; and (iii) a hierarchical multi-level Reload mechanism that applies anti-dilution refinement at three decoder levels and fuses the restored representations top-down. Built upon a ConvNeXt-Tiny encoder with a multi-scale decoder and four-directional Mamba scanning with pixel-wise directional attention, Reload-Mamba achieves 47.9% single-scale (48.9% multi-scale) mIoU on ADE20K and 83.2% single-scale mIoU on Cityscapes. With ResNet-101 + COCO pre-training under the standard DeepLab-style protocol, Reload-Mamba reaches 87.8% mIoU on PASCAL VOC 2012 val. Controlled ablations show that each of the three segmentation-specific designs contributes beyond a direct port of the prior anti-dilution architecture proposed for binarization, cumulatively improving over the direct-port baseline by +2.2 mIoU on ADE20K.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Reload-Mamba，一种基于Mamba状态空间模型的语义分割框架，通过边界监督局部细节先验、类别不确定性感知重载门控和分层多级重载机制，解决状态空间传播导致的响应稀释问题。在ADE20K、Cityscapes和PASCAL VOC 2012上取得了有竞争力的分割精度。
Motivation: Mamba状态空间模型在长距离建模中高效，但顺序状态传播会减弱边界和细节响应，影响多类语义分割性能。
Method: 提出三个分割专用设计：边界监督局部细节先验、基于像素类别熵的重载门控（Reload Gate）、以及分层多级重载机制，在解码器三个层级进行抗稀释精炼并自上而下融合。
Result: 在ADE20K上单尺度mIoU 47.9%（多尺度48.9%），Cityscapes单尺度83.2%，PASCAL VOC 2012上87.8% mIoU。消融实验表明每个设计均贡献改善，累计比直接移植先前的抗稀释架构高+2.2 mIoU。
Conclusion: 论文提出的分割专用抗稀释设计有效缓解了Mamba传播导致的信息稀释，并在多个语义分割基准上取得优异结果。

papers.title: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach to Strategy Synthesis for Strategic Logics
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning about what agents can achieve through strategic interaction is a core challenge in Multi-Agent Systems (MAS). Logics for strategic ability, such as ATL, provide rigorous methods, but their adoption is often hindered by the computational cost of strategy synthesis. We introduce a neuro-symbolic framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) into the model-checking pipeline for MAS. The LLM acts as a strategy-generation oracle, proposing candidate strategies that are then formally validated by a standard MAS model checker. This generate-and-certify architecture uses LLM guidance to navigate large combinatorial strategy spaces while preserving formal soundness: generated strategies are accepted only when certified by the verifier. We instantiate the framework for bounded strategic reasoning in NatATL and introduce the first NatATL strategy-synthesis dataset, consisting of 4211 instances. Experiments with an open-weight Qwen3-32B model show that our certified pipeline achieves 92\% accuracy on strategy-synthesis outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号框架，将大语言模型（LLM）集成到多智能体系统（MAS）的模型检验流程中，用于战略逻辑（如ATL）的策略合成。LLM作为策略生成器提出候选策略，再由标准MAS模型检验器进行形式化验证，形成“生成-认证”架构。在NatATL约束战略推理上创建了首个策略合成数据集（4211个实例），使用Qwen3-32B模型验证，认证流水线在策略合成结果上达到92%的准确率。
Motivation: 多智能体系统中的战略推理依赖于ATL等逻辑，但策略合成的计算成本高昂，限制了其实际应用。现有方法难以在组合巨大的策略空间中高效探索并保持形式化正确性。
Method: 提出神经符号框架：LLM作为策略生成预言机，提出候选策略；标准MAS模型检验器（如MCMAS）对候选策略进行形式化验证，仅接受通过验证的策略。该框架结合了LLM的启发式搜索能力和模型检验的保证正确性。
Result: 在NatATL策略合成数据集（4211个实例）上，使用开源Qwen3-32B模型，认证流水线达到92%的准确率。
Conclusion: 该方法在保证形式化正确性的同时，通过LLM引导有效降低了策略搜索空间，为战略逻辑的实用化提供了新途径。

papers.title: Robustness of Similarity-based Positional Encoding Under Rotations: Theoretical Analysis and Experimental Validation
papers.abstract_en: Positional encoding is a fundamental component of Transformer architectures, as it injects information about the spatial or sequential arrangement of inputs. Among recent alternatives to standard absolute and sinusoidal encodings, similarity-based positional encoding (simPE) has emerged as a flexible framework for representing positional structure through pairwise relations. simPE was originally designed for medical imaging applications, where geometric robustness is especially relevant: small rotations naturally arise during image acquisition, induced by imaging instruments, patient positioning, or slight acquisition misalignments. Despite its empirical promise, the theoretical behavior of simPE under geometric perturbations has not been fully characterized. In this paper, we study the robustness of simPE with respect to rotations, combining formal theoretical analysis with experimental validation. We first show that simPE is generally not rotation-invariant. We then prove that, under mild Lipschitz assumptions on the elementary components, simPE is stable under rotational perturbations and derive explicit perturbation bounds in Frobenius norm. We validate these findings experimentally on four controlled datasets--a synthetic Arrow dataset, a synthetic Shapes dataset (four geometric shape categories), a synthetic Digits dataset, and a benchmark image classification dataset (FashionMNIST)--in which training and validation images are kept in a fixed canonical orientation while test images are subjected to increasing rotation angles. Across all datasets, simPE consistently outperforms standard learned positional encoding in terms of accuracy, F1 score, precision, and recall under rotation, particularly in the small-to-moderate angle regime, corroborating the theoretical stability guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了基于相似性的位置编码（simPE）在旋转扰动下的鲁棒性。理论分析表明simPE通常不是旋转不变的，但在温和的Lipschitz假设下具有稳定性，并给出了Frobenius范数下的扰动界。实验在四个数据集（包括合成数据和FashionMNIST）上验证了simPE在旋转测试中优于标准学习位置编码。
Motivation: simPE在医学成像等应用中因几何鲁棒性而具有前景，但其在旋转等几何扰动下的理论行为尚未被充分表征。
Method: 结合形式化理论分析与实验验证：先证明simPE非旋转不变，再证明在Lipschitz假设下对旋转扰动稳定并推导显式误差界，最后在控制旋转角度的数据集上实验验证。
Result: 在四个数据集上，simPE在准确性、F1、精确率和召回率上一致优于标准学习位置编码，尤其是中小旋转角度下。
Conclusion: 论文强调了simPE在旋转扰动下的理论稳定性保证，并实证其鲁棒性。

papers.title: Beyond Visual Cues: CoT-Enhanced Reasoning for Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised medical image segmentation has emerged as a dominant research problem in medical image analysis, mitigating annotation scarcity by leveraging consistency regularization on unlabeled data. However, existing approaches operate predominantly via visual pattern matching, relying heavily on pixel-level similarities. This visual-centric dependency often falters in clinical scenarios characterized by the visual-semantic mismatch, where visually similar lesions warrant distinct diagnostic conclusions, thus failing to capture the underlying diagnostic logic used by experts. To address this, we move beyond visual cues and propose CERS (CoT-Enhanced Reasoning Segmentation), a framework that integrates Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to distinguish pathologically distinct cases. Specifically, we construct a knowledge pool enriched with linguistic reasoning descriptions generated by large language models (LLMs). A semantic-aware reference selection strategy is introduced to identify historical evidence, filtering candidates first by morphology, and then refining them via CoT consistency to eliminate hard negatives. Furthermore, a multi-scale coordinate attention module (MCAM) is designed to effectively fuse this reasoning-derived context into the decoding process. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of CERS against state-of-the-art approaches, particularly in resolving boundary ambiguities and semantic inconsistencies. The code is available at https://github.com/cymasuna/CERS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CERS框架，在半监督医学图像分割中引入Chain-of-Thought (CoT)推理，利用大语言模型生成的语言描述构建知识库，通过语义感知参考选择策略和多尺度坐标注意力模块（MCAM）来区分视觉相似但病理不同的病变区域。实验表明CERS在边界模糊和语义不一致场景下优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有半监督医学图像分割方法依赖视觉模式匹配和像素级一致性，在视觉-语义不匹配的临床场景中容易失效，无法捕捉专家使用的诊断逻辑。
Method: 构建包含LLM生成语言描述的知识库；提出语义感知参考选择策略，先按形态过滤候选，再通过CoT一致性消除难负例；设计多尺度坐标注意力模块（MCAM）将推理上下文融入解码过程。
Result: 在多个医学图像分割数据集上，CERS超过了现有最先进方法，尤其解决了边界模糊和语义不一致问题。
Conclusion: 通过整合CoT推理，该框架有效区分了病理上不同的病例，为半监督医学图像分割提供了超越视觉线索的新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MLLMs Get It Right, Then Get It Wrong: Tracing and Correcting Late-Layer Textual Bias
papers.abstract_en: When vision contradicts text, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) consistently favor text, even when images provide clear evidence otherwise. This bias poses risks for applications requiring visual grounding, yet its cause remains unclear. In this paper, we uncover a surprising finding: models often get it right initially, forming correct vision-based predictions in their intermediate layers, before changing their minds and favoring text in the final output. We call this "late-layer textual override". The visual information is encoded, it simply does not survive to the output. More intriguingly, we find that how predictions change reveals whether they're correct: 85% of failures shift toward text, while 89% of successes shift toward vision. This directional signature enables a simple but powerful intervention: when we detect a confident visual prediction being suppressed, we restore it. We propose CALRD (Conflict-Aware Layer Reference Decoding), a training-free method that recovers overridden predictions at inference time. Experiments across five MLLMs of varying architectures demonstrate up to 9.4% absolute improvements on conflict benchmarks while largely preserving standard performance, without training or external knowledge. It recovers what the model already knew but failed to preserve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在处理视觉与文本冲突时，中间层往往能正确基于视觉做预测，但最终输出却被文本信息覆盖，称为“晚层文本覆盖”。作者提出一种无需训练的方法CALRD（Conflict-Aware Layer Reference Decoding），通过检测并恢复被抑制的正确视觉预测，在多个模型上取得最多9.4%的绝对性能提升，且不依赖外部知识。
Motivation: 多模态大模型在视觉与文本冲突时倾向于信任文本，这一偏置影响视觉定位应用，但此前成因不明。本文旨在揭示其机制并提出纠正方法。
Method: 提出CALRD，一种训练自由的推理时方法：通过分析层间预测变化方向（多数失败向文本偏移，成功向视觉偏移），检测被覆盖的视觉预测并恢复之。
Result: 在五种不同架构的MLLMs上，冲突基准测试的绝对性能提升最高达9.4%，同时基本保持标准性能。
Conclusion: 模型在中间层已编码正确视觉信息但未能传递到输出，CALRD有效恢复这些知识，无需训练或外部知识。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SoftMoE: Soft Differentiable Routing for Mixture-of-Experts in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enable scaling LLM parameters under a fixed inference budget by activating only a small subset of experts via top-$k$ routing. While this preserves causality and suits autoregressive language models, the discrete top-$k$ operator is not differentiable, forcing a fixed number of active experts per input and resulting in inefficient use of computation. We propose SoftMoE, which replaces discrete routing with a truncated soft top-$k$ LapSum relaxation, allowing gradient-based optimization of expert routing. We further parameterize the mean number of active experts per layer and impose a global budget constraint, enabling the model to learn how to allocate expert capacity across layers. SoftMoE remains fully compatible with autoregressive modeling and achieves performance comparable to or better than sparse MoE on language modeling and downstream tasks, while activating significantly fewer experts. Notably, the learned allocation is highly non-uniform, with later layers activating more experts. The source code is publicly available$^\dagger$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SoftMoE 提出了一种可微分的软路由机制，替代稀疏 MoE 中不可微的 top-k 离散路由，通过截断的 soft top-k LapSum 松弛实现梯度优化，并引入全局预算约束让模型学习各层专家分配。在语言建模和下游任务上，SoftMoE 在激活更少专家的同时达到与稀疏 MoE 相当或更优的性能。
Motivation: 稀疏 MoE 的 top-k 路由不可微，导致每输入固定激活专家数，计算利用不高效，且无法学习每层的最佳专家容量。
Method: 提出 SoftMoE，使用截断的 soft top-k LapSum 松弛实现可微分路由，并参数化每层平均激活专家数，施加全局预算约束，使模型能自适应分配专家容量。
Result: 在语言建模和下游任务上，SoftMoE 性能与稀疏 MoE 相当或更优，且激活专家数显著减少；学习到的分配高度非均匀，深层激活更多专家。
Conclusion: SoftMoE 保持了自回归建模的兼容性，通过可微分路由和全局预算实现了更高效的计算分配，为 MoE 路由提供了一种替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Plug-and-Adapt: Multimodal Coreference Resolution at First Sight with a Pretrained Alignment Model
papers.abstract_en: Visual information helps resolve ambiguity in coreference resolution, leading to notable performance gains. However, existing Multi-modal Coreference Resolution (MCR) methods require training with (partially) annotated data from the target dataset before they can be applied, preventing their direct usability and raising concerns about generalization. While Vision-Language Large Models (VLLMs) with billions of parameters offer promising zero-shot capabilities, they remain largely inaccessible. Their massive size limits deployability, and many are only accessible through paid APIs. In this paper, we propose a plug-and-adapt method that strategically adapts a carefully pre-trained \emph{alignment model} for immediate use in MCR tasks, designed to eliminate the need for training on scarce benchmark datasets or relying on resource-intensive VLLMs. Specifically, we first pre-train a fine-grained alignment model between textual and visual contextual information using vision-language alignment datasets. We then repurpose the alignment model to MCR through similarity aggregation by fusing visual and categorical cues with evidence theory, thereby enhancing effectiveness. Experiments on the Coreference Image Narratives (CIN) benchmark dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, achieving a 5.31\% and 2.12\% improvement in CoNLL F1 over SOTA dedicated methods and popular VLLMs, respectively. We further evaluate our method on a masked CIN dataset for robustness testing and on a specially constructed VCR-MCR dataset for generalization assessment, with results confirming both capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种即插即用的多模态共指消解方法，利用预训练的视觉-语言对齐模型，无需在目标数据集上训练即可应用。通过融合视觉与类别线索的证据理论，在CIN基准测试上相比专用方法和流行VLLM分别提升5.31%和2.12%的CoNLL F1。
Motivation: 现有多模态共指消解方法需要目标数据集的标注数据训练，限制了直接可用性和泛化能力；大规模视觉语言模型虽然零样本能力强，但部署受限或需付费API。
Method: 先使用视觉-语言对齐数据集预训练细粒度的文本与视觉上下文对齐模型，再通过证据理论融合视觉和类别线索进行相似度聚合，将模型重用于多模态共指消解任务。
Result: 在CIN数据集上，CoNLL F1比专用SOTA方法提升5.31%，比流行VLLM提升2.12%；在掩码CIN和VCR-MCR数据集上验证了鲁棒性和泛化性。
Conclusion: 该方法无需目标数据集训练或依赖大规模VLLM，即可实现多模态共指消解，且性能超越现有方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Small Initialization Matters for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models provide a tractable system for asking how intelligence itself emerges, rather than only how LLMs can be engineered. Although progress is usually attributed to scale, data and architecture, we show that parameter initialization is a gene-like determinant of training and, in particular, of model capacity. Reducing the initialization scale consistently improves pretraining, with the largest gains on reasoning-demanding tasks. We identify two widely used empirical settings that restrain the advantage of small initialization, and show how relaxing them restores favorable scaling. We further uncover a critical initialization that balances the reasoning and training. Mechanistically, small initialization drives a distinct developmental trajectory: parameters first condense into low-complexity structures and later expand into richer representations, giving concrete form to the idea that compression is intelligence. Token-level analyses show that the gains concentrate on non-trivial, context-constrained predictions rather than all tokens uniformly. These results motivate a simple $γ$-initialization rule: expose initialization rage as an explicit knob and use small initialization by default, an almost cost-free intervention that improves pretraining and strengthens reasoning across model scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型参数初始化的影响，发现较小的初始化规模能显著改善预训练效果，尤其是在推理密集型任务上。通过识别并放松两种抑制小初始化优势的常见设置，恢复有利的缩放特性，并提出一个平衡推理与训练的关键初始化值。机制上，小初始化驱动参数先压缩为低复杂结构，再扩展为丰富表征，支持“压缩即智能”的观点。最终提出简单的γ初始化规则：将初始化为显式调节旋钮，默认使用小初始化。
Motivation: 以往研究多归因于规模、数据和架构，但参数初始化的决定性作用未被充分探索。本文旨在揭示初始化对模型容量和训练轨迹的影响。
Method: 通过实验对比不同初始化规模，识别两种常见设置（如学习率调度、优化器选择）会限制小初始化的优势，并展示放松这些限制后缩放特性恢复。进一步发现一个关键初始化值，平衡推理与训练性能。
Result: 小初始化在所有模型尺度上提升预训练效果，尤其在推理任务上增益最大。token级分析表明增益集中于非平凡、上下文受限的预测。
Conclusion: 提出γ初始化规则，建议暴露初始化为显式超参数并默认使用小初始化，这是一种几乎无成本的干预，能改善预训练和推理能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Long-Term Dynamics of Individual Metro Usage: A Hidden Semi-Markov State Framework with Survival Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how individual metro usage evolves over multi-year horizons is essential for transit planning and passenger retention. However, existing approaches typically characterize mobility patterns as static clusters or short-term variability, leaving the lifecycle dynamics of transit participation underexplored. This study proposes a state-based lifecycle modeling framework that integrates Hidden Semi-Markov Models (HSMM) with discrete-time survival analysis to characterize the evolution of individual metro mobility. The HSMM infers latent mobility states with explicit duration distributions and a transition matrix governing regime changes, while the survival component models exit and re-entry events via state-dependent hazard functions conditioned on mobility-state trajectories and behavioral history. Applied to four years of smart card data from the Shanghai metro system (2021-2024), the framework enables the identification of interpretable mobility states, the characterization of transition dynamics, and the quantification of state-dependent exit and re-entry processes. The analysis reveals five robust mobility states with a directional transition hierarchy centered on an occasional-usage gateway state, and fundamentally different temporal mechanisms governing disengagement and return: exit hazard is state-dependent but duration-independent, whereas re-entry hazard decays sharply with inactivity length. These findings provide a methodological foundation for lifecycle-oriented mobility analysis and practical guidance for transit operators to identify at-risk users and time retention interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合隐半马尔可夫模型（HSMM）和离散时间生存分析的状态生命周期框架，用于刻画个体地铁出行行为的长期演化。基于上海地铁系统2021-2024年的四年智能卡数据，识别出五种稳健的出行状态，并揭示了以偶发使用为网关的状态转移层次以及退出与重返的异质性时间机制。
Motivation: 现有研究通常将地铁出行模式视为静态聚类或短期变化，缺乏对个体地铁使用生命周期动态的理解，不利于交通规划与乘客留存管理。
Method: 集成隐半马尔可夫模型（HSMM）与离散时间生存分析，HSMM推断具有显式持续时间分布的潜在状态及转移矩阵，生存部分通过状态依赖的风险函数建模退出与重返事件。
Result: 识别出五种稳健状态，发现定向转移层次以偶发使用为网关；退出风险依赖于状态但与持续时间无关，而重返风险随不活跃时长急剧下降。
Conclusion: 该框架为生命周期导向的出行分析提供了方法论基础，并为交通运营商识别风险用户及安排保留干预提供实用指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MoonSplat: Monocular Online Gaussian Splatting with Sim(3) Global Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Online 3D reconstruction from monocular image sequences is a challenging and ongoing research topic. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), leveraging its high-quality real-time rendering capability, empowers online 3D reconstruction to represent dense scenes with enhanced expressiveness, and thus holds great promise for a wide range of applications such as robotics and AR/VR. However, existing online 3DGS methods still suffer from some key challenges: fragile camera pose estimation due to the lack of global optimization, and low optimization efficiency in large-scale or long-sequence scenarios. To address these issues, we propose a robust and efficient online voxelized 3DGS reconstruction framework integrated with global $\text{Sim}(3)$ optimization, which enables reliable camera tracking and efficient global loop closure for both camera poses and voxelized 3DGS. To accelerate the convergence of the voxelized 3DGS, we further introduce a color residual learning strategy, which not only boosts optimization speed but also enhances rendering quality. Extensive experiments on diverse indoor and outdoor datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both camera pose estimation accuracy and rendering quality, while retaining real-time efficiency. Additionally, we develop and deploy a real-world UAV-based active reconstruction system grounded on our proposed method, validating its robustness and generalizability for practical online 3D reconstruction tasks. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/TrickyGo/MoonSplat.

Method: 提出集成全局Sim(3)优化的在线体素化3DGS框架，实现可靠的相机跟踪和高效的全局闭环（同时优化位姿和体素化3DGS）。进一步引入颜色残差学习策略，加快模型收敛并提升渲染质量。
Result: 在多个室内外数据集上，相机位姿估计精度和渲染质量均达到SOTA，且保持实时效率。基于该方法的无人机主动重建系统验证了鲁棒性和泛化性。

papers.title: Predictive Analytics in E-Commerce for CustomerBehavior Forecasting using hybrid Ret-DNN withXGBoost Model
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, electronic (E) commerce services have rapidly increased in the daily lives of people, which helpsthem to purchase products online. However, retail platforms have struggled to understand customer behavior and make it difficult to predict their future purchases. To overcome these challenges, this study proposes a hybrid Retail Deep NeuralNetwork (Ret-DNN) with an Extreme Gradient Boosting(XGBoost) model for capturing temporal features and tabular dynamics of retail data. First, data were sourced from a UnitedKingdom (UK)-based online retailer that contains transactions with almost 500,000 records. Then, the collected data were pre-processed using a series of techniques, such as data cleaning, outlier handling, temporal feature extraction, feature encoding, and z-score normalization, to ensure that the data were ready for model training and testing. Subsequently, the preprocessed data were fed into the Ret-DNN model, which acts as a feature extractor to understand the complete context of customer transactions. Further, the extracted data were fed as input into the XGBoost model, which predicted the final output as the purchase probability of customers. Finally, the proposed Ret-DNN XGBoost model achieved better results by attaining aMean Absolute Error (MAE) 0.2193 when compared to the existing Ret-DNN model. Keywords: Customer behavior forecasting, extreme gradientboosting, electronic commerce, predictive analytic, retail deepneural networks.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合零售深度神经网络（Ret-DNN）与极端梯度提升（XGBoost）模型，用于电子商务客户行为预测。基于英国在线零售商约50万条交易数据，经过预处理后，Ret-DNN提取特征，XGBoost预测购买概率，最终均方误差（MAE）达0.2193，优于单独Ret-DNN模型。

Method: 使用Ret-DNN作为特征提取器，提取客户交易的完整上下文，然后将特征输入XGBoost模型预测购买概率。数据预处理包括清洗、异常值处理、时间特征提取、特征编码和z-score标准化。
Result: 所提Ret-DNN XGBoost模型在MAE指标上达到0.2193，优于现有Ret-DNN模型。
Conclusion: 混合Ret-DNN与XGBoost能有效提升电子商务客户购买概率预测的准确性，但摘要未提及模型在其他数据集上的泛化能力或实际部署情况。

papers.title: How Inference Compute Shapes Frontier LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: AI evaluations are shifting toward harder tasks that benefit from longer trajectories involving tool use and iterative problem solving. As a result, performance is increasingly sensitive to the amount and allocation of compute available at test time ("inference compute"). Yet many evaluations still report performance at a single restrictive budget, meaning that low scores may reflect the evaluation setup rather than the model's underlying capability. To test this, we evaluate up to 12 frontier language models on seven challenging benchmarks spanning software engineering, mathematics, medicine, and cybersecurity. We use a controlled setup combining three simple inference-scaling interventions: larger token budgets, context compaction, and repeated submission attempts, guided either by the model itself or by minimal correctness feedback. We find three main results. First, larger token budgets substantially improve performance on benchmarks across multiple domains, including cybersecurity, FrontierMath, Humanity's Last Exam, and TerminalBench. Second, fixed-budget evaluations can increasingly understate frontier capability as models advance. Newer models reach higher performance at large budgets, where they unlock harder tasks and solve them more reliably. Third, benchmarks differ in which inference-scaling methods help most: repeated submission broadly improves performance, but the value of larger token budgets, external feedback, and parallel attempts varies by benchmark. Overall, our results show that benchmark scores are protocol-dependent. We therefore argue that evaluations should report capability as a function of inference-time compute, specify protocol choices explicitly, and compare model generations over a large shared compute range at matched budgets, especially in safety- or policy-relevant settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究推理计算（inference compute）对前沿大语言模型（LLM）评估的影响。通过控制 token 预算、上下文压缩和重复提交等推理扩展方法，在七项挑战性基准上测试了 12 个模型。结果表明，更大 token 预算能显著提升多领域性能，固定预算评估会低估新模型能力，且不同基准对推理扩展方法的偏好不同。
Motivation: 当前 AI 评估向更困难任务转移，性能对测试时计算量敏感，但许多评估仅在单一限制预算下报告成绩，低分可能反映评估设置而非模型能力。
Method: 采用三种推理扩展干预（更大 token 预算、上下文压缩、重复提交），结合模型自身或最小正确性反馈，在软件工程、数学、医学、网络安全等七个基准上评估最多 12 个前沿 LLM。
Result: 更大 token 预算在网络安全、FrontierMath、人类最后考试、TerminalBench 等基准上显著提升性能；固定预算评估低估了新模型能力；不同基准对重复提交、外部反馈和并行尝试的依赖不同。
Conclusion: 基准分数具有协议依赖性，评估应报告能力关于推理计算量的函数，明确协议选择，并在匹配预算的大共享计算范围内比较模型代际。

papers.title: PreAct: Computer-Using Agents that Get Faster on Repeated Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Computer-using agents drive real software through the screen -- clicking and typing -- but they solve every task from scratch: asked to repeat a task, an agent re-reads the screen, re-reasons every tap, and pays the full cost again. We present PreAct, which lets such an agent get faster on tasks it has done before. The first time it succeeds, PreAct compiles the run into a small state-machine program-states that check the screen, transitions that act-and on later runs replays it directly instead of invoking the agent 8.5-13x faster, with no per-step language-model calls. Replay is not blind: at each step PreAct checks that the screen matches what the program expects before acting, and hands control back to the agent the moment something is off. PreAct applies the same discipline when deciding what to keep: a freshly compiled program enters the store only if, re-run from a clean state, an independent evaluator confirms it solved the task-catching programs that replay to their last step yet leave the task undone. Across a mobile, a desktop, and a web benchmark, this store-time check separates repeated runs that improve from ones that degrade as faulty programs accumulate, worth 1.75-2.6 tasks per benchmark, the same direction on all three; a fallback that explores afresh when no program fits brings PreAct level with a strong record-and-replay baseline. We also report what did not matter: prompt wording, runtime guardrails, and whether a language model or a plain embedding retriever selects which program to reuse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PreAct，让计算机使用代理（computer-using agent）在重复任务上不再从头执行，而是将首次成功执行编译为小型状态机程序，后续直接重放，同时每一步检查屏幕状态，异常时回退到代理。在移动、桌面和 Web 基准上，该方法实现 8.5–13 倍加速，且无逐步骤的语言模型调用；存储时通过独立评估确保程序真正完成任务，避免劣化积累。
Motivation: 现有计算机使用代理每次执行重复任务时都需重新读取屏幕、重新推理每一步，成本高昂。
Method: 首次成功执行后，将运行轨迹编译为状态机程序（states 检查屏幕，transitions 执行操作）；后续运行时直接重放该程序，每一步验证屏幕状态匹配，不匹配则交回代理；新程序仅在独立评估器从干净状态重跑确认通过后才存入存储库。
Result: 相比原始代理，重放带来 8.5–13 倍加速，且无语言模型调用；存储时的检查避免了劣质程序累积，在三类基准上额外提升 1.75–2.6 个任务；回退机制使整体性能与强基线持平。
Conclusion: PreAct 通过编译式重放和屏幕一致性检查，显著降低重复任务的开销；提示词、运行时护栏以及程序选择方式（LM 或嵌入检索）对结果无显著影响。

papers.title: KANLib -- An Modular, Extensible and Fast Kolmogorov-Arnold Network Implementation
papers.abstract_en: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to traditional multilayer perceptrons by replacing linear weights with learnable univariate functions. Despite their theoretical advantages in interpretability and expressiveness, practical research of KANs remains difficult due to high computational costs and inconsistent feature support across existing frameworks. This paper introduces KANLib, a modular, extensible, and computationally efficient framework for developing and evaluating KAN architectures. KANLib unifies core concepts from existing implementations, including PyKAN, EfficientKAN, and FastKAN, within a consistent software architecture that emphasizes flexibility, feature parity, and high performance. The framework supports two basis function types, adaptive grid rescaling, grid extension, and fine-grained architectural customization while maintaining compatibility with standard PyTorch workflows. Experimental evaluation on the California Housing benchmark demonstrates that KANLib reproduces the predictive behavior of established reference KAN implementations while achieving competitive computational efficiency. Furthermore, the framework enables the exploration of architectural variations beyond standard KAN formulations with only minor impacts on predictive performance. Overall, KANLib provides a robust foundation for future research on scalable and extensible KAN architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出KANLib，一个模块化、可扩展且高效的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络实现框架。该框架统一了PyKAN、EfficientKAN和FastKAN等现有实现的核心概念，支持两种基函数类型、自适应网格缩放、网格扩展及细粒度架构定制，并与PyTorch工作流兼容。在California Housing基准上的实验表明，KANLib能重现参考实现的预测行为，同时保持竞争性的计算效率，并支持探索标准KAN之外的架构变体。
Motivation: 现有KAN实现存在计算成本高、功能支持不一致的问题，阻碍了实际研究。
Method: KANLib通过统一现有实现的核心概念，提供一致的软件架构，强调灵活性、功能对等性和高性能。支持自适应网格缩放、网格扩展等特性。
Result: 在California Housing基准上，KANLib重现了参考KAN实现的预测行为，并实现了竞争性的计算效率。
Conclusion: KANLib为可扩展和可扩展的KAN架构的未来研究提供了稳健的基础。

papers.title: PearlVLA: Progressive Embodied Action-Plan Refinement in Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models face a trade-off between efficient action generation and explicit deliberation. Directly decoding actions from vision-language backbone representations enables low-latency control, whereas explicit reasoning through textual chains, pixel-level subgoals, or action search can improve planning but incurs substantial latency and computational cost. We propose PearlVLA, a VLA framework that moves deliberation into the latent space of a vision-language model (VLM). PearlVLA separates VLM meta-query representations into a fixed visual grounding branch and an iterative latent plan branch. At each refinement round, a plan-conditioned world query probes a lightweight frozen latent world model for an action-free future observation latent, which is fed back to guide plan refinement. A future-guided RefineNet then applies scheduled residual updates to progressively refine a coarse semantic draft into a fine-grained latent action plan. The refined plan after K rounds is then decoded in parallel into an action chunk for low-latency execution. We further introduce Causal Refinement-Grouped Process-Reward RL to optimize the latent refinement process with rewards from longer-horizon imagined futures induced by latent plan edits. Empirical evaluations on the LIBERO benchmark demonstrate that PearlVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance among existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PearlVLA，一种将动作规划的显式推理过程移到视觉语言模型 (VLM) 潜在空间中的框架。通过分离视觉定位分支和迭代潜在规划分支，利用冻结的潜在世界模型和未来引导的 RefineNet 逐步细化粗糙的语义草图为细粒度潜在动作计划，最后并行解码为低延迟的动作块。在 LIBERO 基准上取得了最优性能。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型在高效动作生成与显式推理之间存在权衡：直接解码速度快但缺乏规划深度，而基于文本链或动作搜索的推理延迟高、计算成本大。
Method: PearlVLA 将 VLM 的 meta-query 表示分为固定视觉分支和迭代潜在规划分支；规划过程中，条件化世界查询从冻结的潜在世界模型获取无动作的未来观测潜变量，用于指导计划细化；未来引导的 RefineNet 通过调度残差更新逐步细化潜在动作计划；最后并行解码为动作块。
Result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，PearlVLA 达到了现有方法中的最优性能 (state-of-the-art)。
Conclusion: 该方法通过在潜在空间中进行逐步细化，实现了高效与可推理的 VLA 规划，无需显式文本或像素级子目标，在性能上优于先前方法。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 PearlVLA，一种将动作规划的显式推理过程移到视觉语言模型 (VLM) 潜在空间中的框架。通过分离视觉定位分支和迭代潜在规划分支，利用冻结的潜在世界模型和未来引导的 RefineNet 逐步细化粗糙的语义草图为细粒度潜在动作计划，最后并行解码为低延迟的动作块。在 LIBERO 基准上取得了最优性能。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型在高效动作生成与显式推理之间存在权衡：直接解码速度快但缺乏规划深度，而基于文本链或动作搜索的推理延迟高、计算成本大。
summary_sections.method: PearlVLA 将 VLM 的 meta-query 表示分为固定视觉分支和迭代潜在规划分支；规划过程中，条件化世界查询从冻结的潜在世界模型获取无动作的未来观测潜变量，用于指导计划细化；未来引导的 RefineNet 通过调度残差更新逐步细化潜在动作计划；最后并行解码为动作块。
summary_sections.result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，PearlVLA 达到了现有方法中的最优性能 (state-of-the-art)。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法通过在潜在空间中进行逐步细化，实现了高效与可推理的 VLA 规划，无需显式文本或像素级子目标，在性能上优于先前方法。

papers.title: Nested Sampling: A Critical and Comprehensive Theoretical Guide
papers.abstract_en: The nested sampling (NS) technique has gained widespread attention, particularly in cosmology and astronomy, due to its ability to efficiently explore high-likelihood regions - a feature akin to an implicit likelihood optimization that underlies its success. While the full theoretical derivation of NS is complex and involves several approximations, the central challenge lies in sampling from the likelihood-constrained priors, which is crucial for its performance. This work provides a comprehensive and detailed exposition of NS derivation, clarifying both its theoretical foundations and practical challenges. We provide a thorough description of the NS procedure, emphasizing both its strengths and potential limitations. In doing so, this work seeks to deepen understanding of the method and to foster the development of future enhancements, novel variants, and more efficient implementations across a wide range of scientific applications. Thus, the main contribution of this work is twofold: it serves both as a tutorial for newcomers to the field and as a critical review for experienced practitioners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对嵌套采样（Nested Sampling）技术进行了全面且详细的理论推导阐述，澄清了其理论基础和实践挑战。文章既可作为新入门者的教程，也可作为有经验从业者的批判性综述，重点强调了似然约束先验采样这一核心挑战及其对性能的影响。
Motivation: 嵌套采样在宇宙学等领域广泛应用，但其完整理论推导复杂且涉及多个近似，存在实践难点，尤其似然约束先验的采样是核心问题。本文旨在提供清晰的理论解释，以促进方法改进和更高效实现。
Method: 本文以教程和综述形式，详细描述了嵌套采样的推导过程、程序步骤，并剖析了其优缺点及潜在局限，未提出新的算法或改进。
Result: 本文未报告具体实验结果，主要贡献在于理论综述和教学性阐述，帮助读者深入理解嵌套采样的机制与挑战。
Conclusion: 本文强调嵌套采样的成功依赖于似然约束先验的有效采样，并指出该方法的优势与局限性，旨在推动未来改进和新变体的发展。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Trustworthy Self-Composable Big-Data-as-a-Service: An LLM-Orchestrated Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Data Engineering, AutoML, MLOps Deployment, and Drift-Aware Lifecycle Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Big-Data-as-a-Service (BDaaS) platforms require re liable automation across data ingestion, cleaning, feature engi neering, model development, deployment, and post-deployment monitoring. However, existing LLM-based data science agents and AutoML systems mainly focus on isolated workflow stages, leaving limited support for lifecycle-level orchestration, artifact governance, human oversight, and drift-aware adaptation. This paper proposes a trustworthy self-composable BDaaS frame work based on LLM-orchestrated multi-agent collaboration. The proposed architecture decomposes the BDaaS lifecycle into specialized agents for data ingestion, data cleaning, feature engineering, AutoML training, model evaluation, MLOps de ployment, monitoring, and drift detection. A central LLM or chestration layer coordinates agent execution, validates interme diate outputs, manages workflow context, and enables dynamic workflow composition. The framework also incorporates shared artifact governance, reproducibility support, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and drift-aware feedback loops. A prototype-based evaluation is conducted using controlled tabular benchmark datasets with missing values, categorical variables, outliers, class imbalance, and simulated covariate drift. Compared with manual ML, AutoML-only, and single-agent LLM baselines, the pro posed multi-agent BDaaS pipeline achieves competitive predictive performance while improving lifecycle-level reliability, including workflow completion, artifact traceability, deployment readiness, reproducibility, and drift recovery. The results suggest that LLM-orchestrated multi-agent systems can extend conventional AutoML toward trustworthy, adaptive, and production-oriented BDaaS lifecycle automation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于LLM编排的多智能体框架，实现可信赖的自组合大数据即服务（BDaaS），覆盖数据工程、AutoML、MLOps部署和漂移感知生命周期优化。框架由中央LLM编排层协调多个专用智能体，包括数据摄取、清洗、特征工程、AutoML训练、模型评估、MLOps部署、监控和漂移检测。在控制表格基准数据集上评估，与手动ML、仅AutoML和单智能体LLM基线相比，在保持竞争性预测性能的同时提高了生命周期级别的可靠性。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的数据科学智能体和AutoML系统主要关注孤立的工作流阶段，缺乏生命周期级别的编排、工件治理、人工监督和漂移感知适应。
Method: 提出基于LLM编排的多智能体协作框架，将BDaaS生命周期分解为多个专用智能体，中央LLM编排层协调执行、验证中间输出、管理工作流上下文并实现动态工作流组合，同时集成共享工件治理、可重复性支持、人在环路检查点和漂移感知反馈循环。
Result: 在包含缺失值、分类变量、异常值、类别不平衡和模拟协变量漂移的控制表格基准数据集上，与手动ML、仅AutoML和单智能体LLM基线相比，所提多智能体BDaaS管道在保持竞争性预测性能的同时，提高了工作流完成度、工件可追溯性、部署就绪性、可重复性和漂移恢复等生命周期可靠性指标。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，LLM编排的多智能体系统可以将传统AutoML扩展到可信赖、自适应和生产导向的BDaaS生命周期自动化。

papers.title: Non-negative Elastic Net Decoding for Information Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Dense retrieval has become the dominant paradigm in information retrieval, in which each document is scored against a query by the inner product of their vector embeddings, and the top-$k$ documents by score are retrieved for this query. However, since each document's score depends solely on the embedding of the query and itself, the retrieval process is oblivious to the content of the entire corpus. Therefore, dense retrieval cannot avoid selecting semantically similar documents from the corpus, which may result in a non-diverse, redundant set of retrieved documents. To this end, we approach retrieval as a joint decoding problem, in which documents are selected as a set with regard to the context of the rest of the corpus. To achieve this, we propose Non-Negative elastic Net (NNN) decoding, which selects documents whose embeddings jointly reconstruct the query embedding as a sparse non-negative linear combination. Our main theoretical result establishes a strict separation between dense retrieval and NNN decoding. For any corpus, every query correctly handled by dense retrieval is also handled by NNN decoding, while on corpora containing correlated documents, NNN decoding additionally handles queries that dense retrieval cannot. Experimental results indicate that applying NNN decoding to frozen embeddings trained for inner-product scoring yields consistent improvements across several benchmarks. Moreover, we introduce an end-to-end training procedure which optimizes the embeddings for NNN decoding, producing significant performance gains surpassing in all metrics and benchmarks compared to dense retrieval. Our work establishes a new paradigm for leveraging dense embeddings in information retrieval, beyond the standard practice of inner-product scoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出非负弹性网络（NNN）解码，将信息检索视为联合解码问题，通过选择文档嵌入的非负稀疏线性组合来重构查询嵌入，从而避免稠密检索中选取语义相似文档导致的冗余问题。理论证明NNN解码严格优于稠密检索，实验表明在多个基准上应用NNN解码能提升性能，端到端训练进一步取得显著改进。
Motivation: 稠密检索仅依赖查询与文档的内积评分，忽视整个语料库的上下文，导致检索结果中可能包含语义相似、冗余的文档，缺乏多样性。
Method: 提出非负弹性网络（NNN）解码，将文档选择建模为查询嵌入的非负稀疏线性组合重建问题，联合考虑语料库上下文进行文档选择。
Result: 理论证明NNN解码严格优于稠密检索；实验中，对冻结嵌入应用NNN解码在多个基准上取得一致改进，端到端训练进一步在所有指标和基准上显著超越稠密检索。
Conclusion: NNN解码为利用稠密嵌入进行信息检索建立了新范式，超越了标准内积评分的实践。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DiagFlowBench: Evaluating How Language Models Handle Off-Procedure Inputs in Grounded Diagnostic Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Language models increasingly serve as advisory systems in maintenance operations. To prevent hallucination, recent systems ground these models in procedural documentation to constrain them to approved steps. In practice, however, operator queries frequently stray from this path, requiring models to recognise out-of-scope inputs mid-conversation, a dynamic that current benchmarks rarely prioritise. We introduce DiagFlowBench, a dataset of 50 industrial diagnostic flowcharts from a consumer manufacturer converted into 1,676 multi-turn conversations that contrast compliant with out-of-scope utterances. Evaluating a panel of ten commercial and open-weight models reveals high variability in abstention rates, with models commonly selecting a real but contextually inadequate step rather than fabricating facts. The inherent plausibility and authority of this mapped but wrong advice exposes a challenging vulnerability for grounding systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiagFlowBench，一个包含 50 个工业诊断流程图转化而来的 1,676 个多轮对话的数据集，用于评估语言模型在处理超出规程的输入时的表现。实验发现模型在识别越界输入方面存在高度变异性，且容易选择看似合理但实际错误的步骤。
Motivation: 现有基准测试很少关注语言模型在诊断对话中处理超出规程输入的能力，而实际运维中操作员提问常偏离标准流程，导致模型可能给出误导性建议。
Method: 从消费制造商的工业诊断流程图中构建 50 个流程图，转换为 1,676 个多轮对话，包含合规和越界两类话语，并评估多个商业和开源模型。
Result: 模型在拒绝回答（abstention）方面表现出高度变异性，且倾向于选择真实但上下文不合适的步骤，而非完全捏造事实，这种看似合理但错误的建议构成了对 grounding 系统的挑战。
Conclusion: DiagFlowBench 揭示了语言模型在接地诊断对话中处理越界输入时的脆弱性，强调需要更好的机制来识别和拒绝超出规程的查询。

papers.title: Learn to Quantify Social Interaction with Constraints for Pedestrian Walking
papers.abstract_en: Long-term human path forecasting in crowds is critical for autonomous moving platforms (like autonomous driving cars and social robots) to avoid collision and make high-quality planning. Although the current research take into account social interactions for prediction, they don't reveal the exact kinds of social interactions happened among people and how the social interactions affect the decision-making process of pedestrians, which further limits its robustness. Social interactions in pedestrian walking are intuitively massive and hard to label and quantify. In this paper, we explore creatively to quantify and interpret how pedestrians interact with others by proposing Learn to Cluster. Our clustering social interactions is probabilistic latent variable generative, learning directly from sequential trajectory observations, scalable to arbitrary number of pedestrians. Learn to cluster is label-free and can be naturally integrated into the training process of the prediction model. The latent variables will then serve as 'labels' to categorize social interactions. Extensive experiments over several trajectory prediction benchmarks demonstrate that our method is able to learn the patterns of social interactions and effectively integrate the patterns to pedestrian trajectory prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Learn to Cluster方法，通过概率潜变量生成模型从轨迹观测中无监督学习行人社交互动的模式，并将其整合到轨迹预测中。该方法无需标注，可扩展至任意数量行人，在多个基准上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有行人轨迹预测方法考虑了社交互动，但未能揭示互动的具体类型及其对决策的影响，限制了鲁棒性。
Method: 提出Learn to Cluster，一种基于概率潜变量生成模型的聚类方法，直接从序列轨迹中学习社交互动模式，无需标签，可自然融入预测模型训练。
Result: 在多个轨迹预测基准上，该方法能够学习社交互动模式并有效提升轨迹预测性能。
Conclusion: 无监督量化社交互动模式并集成到预测中是可行的，有助于提升模型鲁棒性。

papers.title: Dimensionality Controls When Modularity Helps in Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Compositional learning systems must balance plasticity, the ability to acquire new knowledge, with stability, the preservation of previously learned components, especially when tasks share structure and risk interference. We study how modular architecture, task similarity, and representational dimensionality jointly shape compositional continual learning in a sequential A-B-A paradigm, comparing a task-partitioned recurrent network to a single-network baseline while inducing high- and low-dimensional regimes via weight-scale manipulations. In a high-dimensional "lazy" regime, both architectures achieve similar performance and internal geometry, suggesting that explicit modular structure has little impact when representations are weakly constrained. In a lower-dimensional "rich" regime, modularity becomes decisive: the modular network develops graded task-specific subspaces that overlap for similar tasks, partially align for moderately dissimilar tasks, and separate for dissimilar tasks, yielding a more compositional and interpretable organization than the single network. These findings identify the representational regime induced by initialization scale, which co-varies with representational dimensionality, as a key factor governing when compositional, modular structure is functionally beneficial in continual learning, and support viewing safety and robustness as problems of adaptive allocation of representational subspaces rather than fixed separation versus sharing.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2nd Workshop on Compositional Learning (CompLearn) at ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea. 8 pages, 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究模块化架构在持续学习中的有效性如何受表示维度控制。在高维“惰性”状态下，模块化与单网络性能相近；在低维“丰富”状态下，模块化网络形成任务特定子空间，重叠模式匹配任务相似性，表现出更强的组合性和可解释性。
Motivation: 持续学习系统需平衡可塑性与稳定性，模块化架构可能有助于缓解干扰，但其有效条件尚不明确。本文考察维度、任务相似性与模块化结构的交互作用。
Method: 采用A-B-A序列范式，对比任务分区循环网络与单网络基线，通过权重尺度操作诱导高维（惰性）和低维（丰富）表示状态。
Result: 高维状态两架构性能与内部几何结构相似；低维状态模块化网络发展出任务特定子空间，相似任务子空间重叠、中等相似任务部分对齐、不相似任务分离。
Conclusion: 初始化尺度诱导的表示状态（与维度共变）决定模块化结构何时带来功能收益，安全性与鲁棒性应视为表示子空间自适应分配问题而非固定分离或共享。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MathVis-Fine: Aligning Visual Supervision with Necessity via Progressive Dependency-Guided Training for Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has extended from purely linguistic domains to multimodal scenarios; however, existing approaches often treat visual inputs as homogeneous or auxiliary signals, failing to capture the intricate and sample-specific dependencies between text and images in mathematical problem-solving. This gives rise to two core issues: first, the supervisory signals for visual content are generalized and coarse-grained, lacking adaptation to the actual necessity of visual information in each sample; second, training feedback becomes inaccurate when visual rewards are uniformly applied without distinguishing the complementary relationships among inputs. These limitations hinder models from achieving precise multimodal reasoning. In this work, we propose a framework for modeling fine-grained visual dependencies in mathematical reasoning. We first construct the MathVis-Fine dataset, augmenting fine-grained visual annotations with visual dependency ratings. Building upon this dataset, we introduce a two-stage progressive visual enhancement training paradigm that balances answer correctness rewards and visual grounding rewards according to the intrinsic visual dependency level of each sample, thereby mitigating reward bias and improving supervision accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the MathVis-Fine framework effectively enhances visual perception progressively based on visual dependency, offering a more precise training framework for multimodal mathematical reasoning. We will release the dataset upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MathVis-Fine框架，用于多模态数学推理中细粒度视觉依赖建模。通过构建带视觉依赖评级的MathVis-Fine数据集，并采用两阶段渐进式训练，根据样本内在视觉依赖水平平衡答案正确性和视觉接地奖励，缓解奖励偏差，提升监督精度。实验表明该框架能根据视觉依赖逐步增强视觉感知。
Motivation: 现有方法将视觉输入视为同质或辅助信号，忽略了数学问题中文本与图像之间细粒度、样本特定的依赖关系，导致视觉监督信号粗粒度且训练反馈不准确，限制了多模态推理的精确性。
Method: 构建MathVis-Fine数据集，包含细粒度视觉标注和视觉依赖评级；提出两阶段渐进视觉增强训练范式，根据每个样本的视觉依赖水平动态平衡答案正确性奖励和视觉接地奖励，从而减少奖励偏差。
Result: 大量实验表明，MathVis-Fine框架能根据视觉依赖逐步增强视觉感知，为多模态数学推理提供了更精确的训练框架。
Conclusion: 该框架通过细粒度视觉依赖建模和渐进训练有效改进了多模态数学推理中的视觉监督精度，数据集将在论文被接收后公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI Adoption Across a Multinational Workforce: Sociotechnical Conditions for GenAI Acceptance in Human Resources
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI (GenAI) deployment in the workplace is accelerating rapidly. Nevertheless, questions of who adopts, who benefits, and who is left behind and why are still understudied. In this paper, we investigate these dynamics in the context of a multinational tech company transitioning from a legacy Human Resources (HR) search system to a GenAI-supported system, analyzing search log data, survey data (n=25), and ten semi-structured interviews. Our findings show that adoption depended on the fit between the GenAI system's design assumptions and employees' work positionalities (role, spoken language, tenure). Further, we find that employees' trust in GenAI answers was built through source-checking, comparison among systems, and seeking input from colleagues or HR when in doubt. Our contribution is twofold. First, we provide empirical evidence of workplace GenAI adoption during a live organizational transition, showing that adoption is influenced by factors such as situational fit, search literacy, and trust calibration. It is also further shaped by knowledge conditions such as the system's content quality, employee training, and guidance. Second, we translate these findings into design considerations for inclusive deployment and adoption in high-stakes environments such as HR. We argue that organizations should design systems considering the role and context-sensitive benefits they yield to different social groups. They also need to treat the organizational knowledge infrastructure as AI infrastructure to improve the accountability and usability of GenAI systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究跨国科技公司在人力资源（HR）部门从传统搜索系统向生成式AI（GenAI）系统过渡过程中员工的采纳情况。通过搜索日志、调查（n=25）和半结构化访谈，发现采纳取决于系统设计假设与员工工作位置（角色、语言、任期）的匹配，信任通过源头核查、系统对比和同事/HR咨询建立。
Motivation: 生成式AI在工作场所的部署加速，但谁采纳、谁受益、谁被落下以及原因尚不明确，尤其缺乏真实组织转型中的实证研究。
Method: 采用混合方法：分析搜索日志数据、问卷调查（n=25）和十次半结构化访谈，研究对象为一家实施GenAI HR搜索系统的跨国科技公司。
Result: 采纳受情境适配、搜索素养和信任校准影响，并受内容质量、员工培训和指导等知识条件塑造。信任通过源头核查、系统对比和同事/HR咨询建立。
Conclusion: 组织应设计考虑不同社会群体角色和情境敏感益处的系统，并将组织知识基础设施视为AI基础设施，以提高GenAI系统的问责性和可用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Monotonic Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks: A Theoretical and Empirical Study of Monotonicity as an Inductive Bias
papers.abstract_en: Monotonicity has been a long-running architectural inductive bias for neural networks, motivated by tabular, scientific, and economic settings where outputs are known to respond monotonically to certain inputs. Existing approaches are MLP- or flow-based and lack per-edge functional transparency; the only Kolmogorov--Arnold Network (KAN) variant with monotonicity, MonoKAN, enforces the constraint only on a restricted parameter subset and requires a projection-style training procedure. We close this gap with \textbf{MKAN}, a KAN with hard monotonicity guaranteed for \emph{all} parameter values via exponential reparameterization of B-spline coefficients, positive edge weights, and a monotone base activation. Training reduces to standard unconstrained gradient descent. Our headline theoretical contribution is a \emph{representation-cost} theorem: any $C^K, K >0$ feature extractor inducing a ball-shaped semantic-neighborhood partition admits a monotone realization of the equivalent neighborhood structure at $N' = N^* + k \le 2N^*$, where $k$ is the number of non-monotone coordinates of the original. The bound is architecture-agnostic and gives a principled sizing rule for monotone encoders. Empirically, MKAN is competitive with state-of-the-art monotone NNs on the SMM/ICML-2024 benchmark while being the only method that combines hard unconstrained monotonicity with KAN's per-edge functional transparency; the $2N^*$ prediction is validated in a self-supervised feature-size sweep on four real datasets, and on a controlled monotone-generative dataset MKAN recovers ground-truth factors with substantially higher Spearman alignment than KAN, MLP, and linear baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MKAN，一种通过指数重参数化 B 样条系数、正边权和单调基激活函数保证硬单调性的 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络变体，训练退化为标准无约束梯度下降。理论贡献是一个表示代价定理：任何诱导球状语义邻域划分的 C^K 特征提取器都可以用至多 2N^* 个单调坐标实现等价邻域结构。实验表明 MKAN 在 SMM/ICML-2024 基准上与最先进单调神经网络竞争，并在真实数据集上验证了理论界。
Motivation: 现有的单调神经网络（如 MLP 或流）缺乏每边功能透明度，而唯一的单调 KAN 变体 MonoKAN 只对受限参数子集施加约束并需要投影式训练。论文旨在填补这一空白，提供一种具有硬单调性且保持 KAN 透明性的方法。
Method: MKAN 通过指数重参数化 B 样条系数、强制正边权以及使用单调基激活函数，保证所有参数值下输入-输出映射的单调性。训练使用标准无约束梯度下降。理论部分证明了表示代价定理，给出了单调编码器大小的原理性规则。
Result: 在 SMM/ICML-2024 基准上，MKAN 与最先进单调神经网络性能相当，且是唯一同时具备硬无约束单调性和每边功能透明度的方法。在四个真实数据集的自监督特征大小扫描中验证了 2N^* 预测。在受控单调生成数据集上，MKAN 的 Spearman 对齐度显著高于 KAN、MLP 和线性基线。
Conclusion: MKAN 提供了一种兼具硬单调性和功能透明度的 KAN 变体，理论界限为设计单调编码器提供了指导。方法具有通用性，但抽象未提及局限性。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Structural Preservation and the Logical Expressiveness of Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Bridges between graph neural networks (GNNs) and logical formalisms have been established by fixing architectural choices, such as the types of aggregation, combination, and activation functions. These choices define restricted classes of GNNs for which tight correspondences with logical formalisms can be obtained, by showing that logical formulae can be translated into equivalent GNNs and, conversely, that GNNs can be translated into equivalent formulae. In this paper we take a semantic perspective by establishing the logical expressiveness of classes of GNN classifiers that are preserved under structural properties: embeddings (extensions), injective homomorphisms, and homomorphisms. We show that, for each such property, there exists a fragment of graded modal logic characterising the class of GNNs. In particular, preservation under embeddings, injective homomorphisms, and homomorphisms corresponds to existential graded modal logic, its existential-positive fragment, and existential-positive modal logic, respectively. These results characterise the expressiveness of broad classes of GNNs independently of specific architectural choices, but we also show that each of these classes admits a GNN architecture of the same expressiveness. Technically, our approach uses a new well-quasi-order result for trees of bounded height, yielding finite representations of unravelling-invariant classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从语义角度研究图神经网络分类器的逻辑表达能力，不依赖特定架构选择。作者证明对于嵌入保持、单同态保持和同态保持这三类GNN，其表达能力分别对应于存在性分级模态逻辑、存在性-正片段以及存在性-正模态逻辑。此外，每类GNN都有一种具体架构达到相同表达能力。技术部分利用有界高度树的良拟序结果来得到有限表示。
Motivation: 现有工作通过固定架构选择（如聚合函数、激活函数）建立GNN与逻辑形式主义之间的桥梁，但缺乏对不依赖特定架构的宽泛GNN类别的表达能力刻画。本文旨在通过结构保持性质来获得更通用的逻辑特征描述。
Method: 采用语义方法，定义三类结构保持性质（嵌入、单同态、同态），并证明每类性质对应的GNN分类器恰好可以被某个分级模态逻辑片段刻画。然后，通过有界高度树的良拟序结果，为这些逻辑片段提供有限表示。
Result: 得到三个精确对应：嵌入保持对应存在性分级模态逻辑，单同态保持对应其存在性-正片段，同态保持对应存在性-正模态逻辑。同时证明每个这样的GNN类都存在一个具体架构（如合适的GNN层）具有相同表达能力。
Conclusion: 这些对应关系独立于具体的GNN架构选择，揭示了GNN表达能力与经典逻辑之间的深层联系。并指出这些逻辑类可以通过有界树高度良拟序技术得到有限表示。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Revisiting Structural Dependency in Autoregressive Multi-Task Table Recognition via Order-Independent Cell-Level Representations
papers.abstract_en: Multi-task table recognition jointly addresses table structure prediction, cell localization, and cell content recognition within a unified framework. Existing approaches often rely on autoregressive decoders to generate table structures and reuse their hidden states for cell localization and content recognition. This autoregressive generation process can make cell representations order-dependent, degrading global consistency across cells. This paper proposes a structural refinement module that produces order-independent cell features through non-causal attention. This design enables parallel inference of cell contents while conditioning each cell on global context encoded in the refined features. Experiments on two large datasets demonstrate consistent gains in cell localization and end-to-end recognition, while reducing overall inference time by around threefold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多任务表格识别中自回归解码器导致的单元格表示顺序依赖问题，提出结构精炼模块，通过非因果注意力生成与顺序无关的单元格特征，实现并行推理。在两大数据集上，该方法提升了单元格定位和端到端识别性能，并将推理时间减少约三倍。
Motivation: 现有自回归表格识别方法中，单元格表示依赖于生成顺序，影响全局一致性，需要解决顺序依赖带来的性能瓶颈。
Method: 提出结构精炼模块，利用非因果注意力生成与顺序无关的单元格特征，使单元格内容预测可并行进行，并利用全局上下文编码。
Result: 在两大数据集上，单元格定位和端到端识别性能一致提升，推理时间降低约三倍。
Conclusion: 通过非因果注意力消除顺序依赖可有效提高表格识别的准确率和效率。

papers.title: AnchorKV: Safety-Aware KV Cache Compression via Soft Penalty with a Refusal Anchor
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) outperform earlier architectures on generative inference and long-context tasks, but their large size introduces significant challenges in memory usage, energy cost, and on-device deployment. Since scaling pre-trained language models improves downstream capability \cite{zhao2023survey}, the key-value (KV) cache becomes a dominant inference bottleneck. Recent KV cache compression methods \cite{jo2025fastkv,li2024snapkv,zhou2024dynamickv} reduce this cost by retaining only a subset of attention-relevant tokens. However, while these approaches preserve accuracy on benign workloads, their compression policies either fail to defend against jailbreak attacks \cite{jiang2024robustkv} or degrade safety alignment under aggressive eviction. We propose AnchorKV, a drop-in modification to KV cache compression that biases token retention scores away from directions in key space associated with harmful prompts. AnchorKV constructs an offline safety anchor by adapting a difference-of-means representation engineering approach \cite{arditi2024refusal,zou2023representation} to the layer-specific key projection space used in KV caching. Based on this anchor, a soft penalty token selection rule trades a small amount of utility for substantially improved safety alignment, while reducing to the original compressor when the penalty is zero.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnchorKV 是一种针对大语言模型 KV 缓存压缩的安全增强方法，通过在键空间中构建离线安全锚点，并引入软惩罚令牌选择规则，在保持压缩效率的同时提升对越狱攻击的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有 KV 缓存压缩方法在恶意负载下会退化安全对齐，无法有效防御越狱攻击。
Method: 利用表示工程方法构建层特定的安全锚点，基于该锚点设计软惩罚令牌选择规则，偏向保留安全相关的令牌。
Result: 摘要称该方法以少量效用损失换取显著的安全对齐提升，且当惩罚为零时退化为原始压缩器。
Conclusion: AnchorKV 可即插即用地改进现有 KV 缓存压缩器的安全性。
