papers.title: StepGuard: Guarding Web Navigation via Single-Step Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Web navigation requires agents to follow natural language goals, interact with web pages, and produce accurate answers. While recent advances leverage vision-language models and reinforcement learning, existing methods still suffer from single-step fragility due to reward misalignment and error propagation. To tackle the reward entanglement, we design Dynamic Dual-Policy Optimization (DDPO), which dynamically switches between a navigation-first mode for exploration and an answer-first mode for question-answering to mitigate reward conflict. To calibrate the single-step error, we propose Confidence-Guided Adaptive Navigation Reflection (CANR), a mechanism that estimates per-step confidence, triggers reflection only when necessary, and uses contrastive rewards to encourage self-correction to calibrate the single-step inaccuracy. With the above as the main components, we finally develop our StepGuard, a new framework of Guarding Web Navigation via Single-Step Calibration. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves navigation and answer accuracy, setting new state-of-the-art performance on standard web navigation benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出StepGuard框架，针对web navigation任务中的单步脆弱性问题，设计了动态双策略优化（DDPO）和置信度引导的自适应导航反思（CANR）机制，在标准web navigation基准上取得了新的最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有web navigation方法因奖励错位和错误传播导致单步脆弱性，影响最终答案准确率。
Method: 提出DDPO在导航优先和回答优先模式间动态切换以缓解奖励冲突；CANR通过每步置信度估计触发必要反思，并利用对比奖励激励自我修正。
Result: 在标准web navigation基准上显著提升导航和答案准确率，达到新的最佳性能。
Conclusion: StepGuard通过单步校准有效降低了错误传播，为web navigation提供了更强的鲁棒性。

papers.title: A Quantitative Analysis of Multimodal Biomarkers in Alzheimer's Disease
papers.abstract_en: Despite increasing adoption of multimodal approaches in Alzheimer's Disease (AD) research -- aimed at integrating molecular, structural, clinical, and genetic biomarkers to enhance disease characterization -- the relationships among these modalities remain poorly understood. A systematic analysis of their dynamic interaction is essential for improving disease modeling, identifying redundant assessments, and reducing patient burden and acquisition costs. In this paper, we present a quantitative analysis of multimodal AD biomarkers by integrating tau-PET, structural MRI, cognitive scores (MMSE and CDR), and APOE4 data from 789 subjects drawn from the ADNI dataset. In our analyses, we (A) quantify cross-modal mutual information and explained variance to assess redundancy and predictive dependencies; (B) examine associations between tau topologies and structural atrophy across brain regions to select informative ROIs; (C) perform a statistical decomposition of the tau-cognition association into atrophy-related and atrophy-independent components; (D) and identify a dominant neurodegenerative trajectory that aligns with cognitive decline. This study provides a systematic characterization of cross-modal relationships, improving the interpretability and selection of biomarkers in AD. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/antonioscardace/Multimodal-AD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对阿尔茨海默病（AD）的多模态生物标志物进行定量分析，整合tau-PET、结构性MRI、认知评分（MMSE和CDR）及APOE4基因型数据，共789名受试者来自ADNI数据集。通过量化跨模态互信息和解释方差评估冗余性和预测依赖性，分析tau拓扑与脑区结构萎缩的关联，将tau-认知关联分解为萎缩相关与萎缩独立成分，并识别出一条与认知衰退一致的神经退行性主导轨迹。旨在提升疾病建模的准确性和生物标志物选择的效率。
Motivation: 多模态AD研究中，各模态（分子、结构、临床、遗传）之间的动态交互关系尚不明确，系统分析有助于改进疾病建模、识别冗余评估环节并降低患者负担和采集成本。
Method: 整合tau-PET、结构性MRI、MMSE/CDR认知评分及APOE4数据，进行四项分析：(A) 交叉模态互信息和解释方差量化；(B) tau拓扑与结构萎缩的区域关联性检验；(C) tau-认知关联的统计分解（萎缩相关与萎缩独立部分）；(D) 主导神经退行性轨迹的识别与认知衰退的对齐验证。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但指出量化了跨模态冗余性和预测依赖性，识别了tau拓扑与萎缩的关联区域，并分解了tau-认知关联，发现一条与认知衰退一致的神经退行性轨迹。
Conclusion: 本研究系统刻画了AD多模态生物标志物之间的跨模态关系，提升了生物标志物的可解释性和选择依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Meta-classification of one-class classification models using ranking correlation and nearest neighbor
papers.abstract_en: Machine Learning (ML) techniques have been applied to various problems. However, applying ML to ML models is an unexplored direction. For this purpose, this paper considers a meta-classification of one-class classification (OCC) models, because all ML models could be approximated as OCC models. The proposal represents OCC models as normality rankings and classifies them using nearest-neighbor and ranking-correlation metrics. The experiment classifies OCC models, where classes correspond to training datasets, algorithms, and hyperparameters. The proposal achieves high accuracy when class labels are datasets. Moreover, it can classify algorithms when the training datasets contain the same class. In addition, the discussion highlights that the classification of OCC models is essentially the classification of datasets that treats multiple samples as a single input. The experiment demonstrates the classification of datasets using sleeping records. The proposed method can provide a unified solution for classifying OCC models, datasets, and rankings. Source code is uploaded to the public repository https://github.com/ToshiHayashi/ClassOCC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种元分类方法，用于对一类分类模型（OCC）进行分类。将OCC模型表示为正常性排序，利用最近邻和排序相关度量进行分类。实验表明，该方法在根据训练数据集分类OCC模型时准确率高，也能分类算法。方法本质是将数据集分类问题转化为处理多个样本作为单一输入的分类问题。代码已公开。
Motivation: 将机器学习应用于机器学习模型本身是一个未充分探索的方向。本文通过元分类一类分类模型来探索这一方向，因为所有ML模型可近似为OCC模型。
Method: 将OCC模型表示为正常性排序（normality rankings），使用最近邻和排序相关度量（ranking-correlation metrics）对OCC模型进行分类。
Result: 根据数据集标签分类OCC模型时达到高准确率；当训练数据包含相同类别时，也能对算法进行分类。实验使用睡眠记录数据展示了数据集分类。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了分类OCC模型、数据集和排序的统一解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlowRAG: Synergizing Explicit Reasoning via Frequency-Aware Multi-Granularity Graph Flow
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) is effective for knowledge-intensive and multi-hop query tasks; however, many existing methods primarily seed entity-based graphs and rely on implicit semantic relevance propagation. This often (i) under-retrieves when user queries are abstract and semantically sparse at the entity level, and (ii) suffers from brittle multi-hop reasoning, where noisy activations can derail entity-to-entity transitions and corrupt the inferred relation chain, yielding unreliable conclusions. To this end, we propose \texttt{FlowRAG}, a semantic-aware retrieval framework that improves both semantic recall and explicit reasoning. Specifically, \texttt{FlowRAG} constructs a quad-level heterogeneous graph over passages, summaries, sentences, and entities, where summary nodes serve as a coarse semantic hub. At retrieval time, a dual-granularity activation module combines summary--query alignment with sentence-level matching to activate relevant entities under paraphrase and abstraction robustly. We then introduce a frequency-aware weighted flow module that routes relevance through entity--passage links weighted by within-passage term frequency, pruning noisy connections and extracting high-confidence reasoning paths as an explicit logic skeleton for generation. Extensive experiments show that \texttt{FlowRAG} obtains state-of-the-art performance on complex reasoning benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlowRAG，一种语义感知检索框架，通过构建四层异构图（篇章、摘要、句子、实体）和频率感知加权流模块，提升语义召回和显式推理能力，在复杂推理基准上取得最优结果。
Motivation: 现有基于图的检索增强生成（GraphRAG）方法在查询抽象、语义稀疏时容易出现检索不足，且多跳推理易受噪声影响导致结论不可靠。
Method: 构建四层异构图中，摘要节点作为粗语义枢纽；检索时采用双粒度激活模块结合摘要-查询对齐和句子级匹配；频率感知加权流模块通过篇章内词频加权实体-篇章链接，修剪噪声连接，提取高置信度推理路径。
Result: 在复杂推理基准上取得最优性能。
Conclusion: FlowRAG通过多粒度图和频率感知流改善了语义检索和显式推理的鲁棒性。

papers.title: A homotopy-type-theoretic generalization of neurosymbolic inference
papers.abstract_en: A wide range of neurosymbolic (NeSy) systems compute one functional: a belief-weighted sum of a logical quantity over a space of $σ$-structures, of which weighted model counting, fuzzy logic, and probabilistic logic are special cases. This account is built on sets, and a set deliberately forgets two things that are important for NeSy: when two $σ$-structures are the same up to a symmetry of the theory, and how many distinct proofs witness a query. Replacing the underlying sets by types, in the sense of homotopy type theory, preserves this information, and turns this functional into a belief-weighted homotopy cardinality, a notion of size that counts each object in inverse proportion to its symmetries. We develop the framework from scratch for NeSy systems, prove a conservativity theorem that recovers the classical functional when symmetries are trivial, and show that the symmetry our framework exposes is exactly the one behind reasoning shortcuts. The payoff is concrete: the shortcut-aware concept posterior that recent methods reach by ensembling or expressive density estimation is the only symmetry-invariant point of the confusion-set simplex, computable in closed form by averaging a single model over the symmetry group. On MNIST reasoning-shortcut benchmarks this single-model wrapper is better calibrated than a diversity-trained ensemble, while leaving label accuracy and identifiable concepts untouched. Code is freely available at https://github.com/bio-ontology-research-group/hott-nesy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于同伦类型论（homotopy type theory）的神经符号推理推广框架，将传统基于集合的加权模型计数、模糊逻辑等统一为信念加权同伦基数（belief-weighted homotopy cardinality），通过保留σ-结构的对称性和证明多样性，揭示推理捷径的对称性本质。在MNIST推理捷径基准上，该框架的单一模型比多样性训练集成具有更好的校准性能，同时保持标签精度和可识别概念不变。
Motivation: 现有神经符号系统基于集合论，忽略了理论对称性下σ-结构的等价性以及查询的多个证明，导致推理捷径等问题。
Method: 用同伦类型论替换底层的集合论，将神经符号推理中的泛函（加权逻辑量求和）转化为信念加权同伦基数，并开发完整的框架。
Result: 在MNIST推理捷径基准上，基于对称性平均的单一模型比多样性训练的集成模型具有更好的校准性能，同时保持标签精度和可识别概念不变。
Conclusion: 该框架恢复了经典推理作为特例，并表明对称性是推理捷径的根本原因，可通过对称性群平均以闭式求解。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 用同伦类型论替换底层的集合论，将神经符号推理中的泛函（加权逻辑量求和）转化为信念加权同伦基数，并开发完整的框架。
summary_sections.result: 在MNIST推理捷径基准上，基于对称性平均的单一模型比多样性训练的集成模型具有更好的校准性能，同时保持标签精度和可识别概念不变。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架恢复了经典推理作为特例，并表明对称性是推理捷径的根本原因，可通过对称性群平均以闭式求解。

papers.title: WallZero: Mastering the Game of WallGo with Strategic Analysis
papers.abstract_en: WallGo is a recently introduced strategic board game popularized by the 2025 Netflix series The Devil's Plan. Although played on a small 7 x 7 board, its combination of stone movement and wall placement yields high game-tree complexity and intricate strategic interactions. Despite its growing popularity, WallGo remains underexplored. This paper presents WallZero, an AlphaZero-based agent for the two-player WallGo setting. We introduce tailored action and feature designs to improve playing performance significantly. In the evaluation, WallZero defeats two professional Go players who participated in this study, securing on average 1.98x more territory per game. Beyond its strength, we use WallZero to assess game fairness and identify key strategies for mastering WallGo. Interestingly, our results show that the opening used in the Netflix series yields a more balanced game. Our code is available at https://rlg.iis.sinica.edu.tw/papers/wallzero.
papers.comment: Accepted by the Computers and Games conference (CG 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 WallZero，一个基于 AlphaZero 的智能体，用于双人版策略棋盘游戏 WallGo。通过定制的动作和特征设计，WallZero 在 7x7 棋盘上击败了两位职业围棋选手，场均控制区域是对手的 1.98 倍。此外，利用 WallZero 分析了游戏平衡性，发现 Netflix 剧集中使用的开局更加平衡。
Motivation: WallGo 是一种新兴的高复杂度策略游戏，但尚未被深入研究。本文旨在开发一个强 AI 智能体，并利用它分析游戏公平性和关键策略。
Method: 采用 AlphaZero 框架，并针对 WallGo 设计了适配的动作空间和特征表示。
Result: WallZero 击败了两名职业围棋选手，平均每局多控制 1.98 倍的领地。分析表明 Netflix 开局更平衡。
Conclusion: WallZero 展示了 AlphaZero 在 WallGo 上的有效性，并为游戏策略提供了见解。代码已开源。

papers.title: Qwen-RobotManip Technical Report: Alignment Unlocks Scale for Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models in language and multimodality achieve strong generalization by aligning heterogeneous data under a unified formulation and training at scale. In this report, we investigate whether this scaling recipe can be applied to robotic manipulation to achieve genuine generalization. This is challenging because, unlike text, manipulation data is heterogeneous by nature, expensive to collect, and narrow in diversity, making alignment and scale simultaneously difficult. We present Qwen-RobotManip, a generalizable Vision-Language-Action foundation model built on Qwen-VL. Qwen-RobotManip introduces a unified alignment framework across the representation, motion, and behavioral dimensions of manipulation, making large-scale multi-source training coherent rather than conflicting. This alignment capability in turn enables Qwen-RobotManip to absorb manipulation data at a scale that prior training regimes could not sustain. A human-to-robot synthesis pipeline converts egocentric hand demonstrations into robot trajectories across 15 platforms, and a rigorous curation pipeline harmonizes heterogeneous datasets. Using only open-source datasets and human videos without proprietary data collection, Qwen-RobotManip constructs a ~38,100-hour pretraining corpus and exhibits emergent generalization capabilities, including zero-shot instruction following, robustness to perturbations, reactive error recovery, and cross-embodiment transfer. We find that standard benchmarks fail to capture pretraining quality and instead adopt OOD settings including RoboCasa365, LIBERO-Plus, EBench, RoboTwin-Clean2Rand, RoboTwin-IF, and RoboTwin-XE. Qwen-RobotManip substantially outperforms prior state-of-the-art models, including $π$0.5, across all OOD settings, ranks 1st in RoboChallenge with a 20% relative improvement, and is validated on real-robot platforms including AgileX ALOHA, Franka, UR, and ARX.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Qwen-RobotManip，一个基于Qwen-VL的视觉-语言-动作基础模型，通过统一的对齐框架（表示、运动、行为维度）使得大规模多源训练变得一致。利用开源数据集和人类视频构建约38,100小时的预训练语料，在多个OOD基准（如RoboCasa365、LIBERO-Plus等）上显著超越先前SOTA（包括π0.5），在RoboChallenge中排名第一且相对提升20%。
Motivation: 尽管语言和多模态基础模型通过统一形式化和规模化实现强泛化，但机器人操作数据天然异构、昂贵且多样性有限，使得对齐和规模化同时困难。
Method: 提出统一对齐框架覆盖表示、运动和行为维度；使用人类到机器人的合成流水线将第一人称手部演示转换为15种机器人平台的轨迹，并设计严格的数据整理流水线协调异构数据集。
Result: 在RoboCasa365、LIBERO-Plus、EBench等OOD设置上大幅超越π0.5等先前SOTA；在RoboChallenge中排名第一，相对提升20%；并在包括AgileX ALOHA、Franka、UR、ARX等真实机器人平台上得到验证。
Conclusion: 对齐机制使得吸收大规模多源操作数据成为可能，从而解锁机器人操作基础模型的真实泛化能力。

papers.title: High-Fidelity 3D Geometric Reconstruction of Pelvic Organs from MRI: A Hybrid Deep Learning and Iterative Optimization Approach
papers.abstract_en: Patient-specific 3D reconstruction of pelvic organ geometry from MRI is important for pelvic floor modeling and downstream patient-specific analysis. However, while previous studies have focused primarily on either image segmentation or downstream use of 3D models, the reconstruction of high-fidelity, high-quality geometries remains labor-intensive and poorly standardized. The study introduced a hybrid deformable shape modeling framework that integrates deep learning prediction with iterative optimization for the reconstruction of the bladder, uterus, and rectum. The framework consists of three core components: a geometry-aware multi-level deep learning architecture that preserves topological consistency of pelvic organs; a two-stage amortized optimization training strategy that balances global shape capture and local surface refinement; and a holistic synergy mechanism--where iterative optimization provides supervision for deep learning during the training phase, and during inference, deep learning rapidly predicts the global organ morphology, followed by iterative optimization to refine local surfaces and mesh quality. This framework demonstrated marked superiority in geometric fidelity than current mainstream deep learning-based organ reconstruction models. For individual anatomical structures, the reconstructed 3D geometries for the bladder, rectum, and uterus achieved significantly lower Chamfer Distance values and higher Dice Similarity Coefficient scores. In addition, while maintaining high computational efficiency, the proposed architecture yielded superior overall volumetric mesh quality. At the patient level, the framework achieved higher mean values for the 10 worst elements for both minSICN and minSIGE compared to traditional geometric post-processing algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合变形形状建模框架，结合深度学习预测与迭代优化，从MRI中重建膀胱、子宫和直肠的高保真3D几何。该方法包含几何感知多级深度学习架构、两阶段摊销优化训练策略以及整体协同机制，在几何保真度上显著优于当前主流深度学习方法，并实现了更高的体积网格质量。
Motivation: 现有研究侧重于图像分割或3D模型的后续使用，但高保真、高质量的几何重建仍依赖人工且缺乏标准化，亟需自动化且标准化的重建方法。
Method: 提出混合框架，包含三个核心组件：保持拓扑一致的几何感知多级深度学习架构、兼顾全局形状与局部细化的两阶段摊销优化训练策略，以及训练时迭代优化为深度学习提供监督、推理时深度学习快速预测全局形态再经迭代优化细化局部表面和网格质量的整体协同机制。
Result: 在膀胱、直肠和子宫的3D几何重建上，获得了更低的Chamfer距离和更高的Dice相似系数；在保持高计算效率的同时，生成的整体体积网格质量优于传统几何后处理算法。
Conclusion: 该框架在骨盆器官MRI重建中实现了高几何保真度，有望为盆底建模和患者特异性分析提供标准化工具。

papers.title: Perceptual compensation for tonal context in self-supervised speech models
papers.abstract_en: This study examines the extent to which the wav2vec2.0 architecture exhibits evidence of compensation for phonological context. We conducted a pseudo-replication of a perceptional compensation experiment on Mandarin Chinese tones, and compared the embedding similarities and probing classifier outputs between a purely self-supervised pre-trained model and a model fine-tuned for Mandarin ASR. No evidence of compensation was found in the embedding similarities of the purely pre-trained model. Probing classifiers showed some evidence of compensation in addition to the expected layer-wise improvements in categorization, but failed to replicate human performance on isolated test syllables. Our findings contrast with previous reports of sensitivity to phonological structure emerging through pre-training alone, and suggest that supervised objectives may be necessary to encourage the abstraction of at least some types of phonological regularities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过伪复制实验，检验wav2vec2.0架构对普通话声调语境感知补偿的能力。对比纯自监督预训练模型与微调ASR模型，发现预训练模型嵌入相似度中没有补偿证据，而微调模型在分类器探针中显示出部分补偿，但未能复现人类在孤立音节上的表现。
Motivation: 先前研究表明自监督模型能习得音系结构敏感性，但未检验其对声调语境补偿的认知机制。本文旨在明确这种补偿是否需要监督信号。
Method: 采用感知补偿实验的伪复制范式，使用wav2vec2.0的预训练模型和微调ASR模型，通过嵌入相似度分析和探针分类器比较补偿效应。
Result: 纯预训练模型嵌入相似度无补偿证据；微调模型探针分类器显示部分补偿，但未能复现人类表现。
Conclusion: 监督目标可能对促进某些音系规律（如声调语境补偿）的抽象化是必要的，仅靠预训练无法充分实现。

papers.title: From Drift to Coherence: Stabilizing Beliefs in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are often hypothesized to perform implicit Bayesian inference, yet a key coherence condition, the martingale property of predictive beliefs, has been shown to fail in controlled synthetic in-context learning settings. We revisit this question in a more typical usage regime: generic multiple-choice question answering. Exploiting the discrete answer space, we compute exact predictive distributions and study belief dynamics induced by autoregressive answer resampling. We introduce prompted predictive resampling (PPR), where an LLM generates a sequence of answers to the same question. Empirically, PPR reveals early-stage belief drift, indicating martingale violations. However, after sufficient resampling steps, the belief process self-stabilizes and converges to a coherent predictive distribution. Based on this observation, we further propose (i) a seed-answer prompting strategy to accelerate stabilization, and (ii) a self-consistency loss that amortizes early-stage drift into the model via fine-tuning. Experiments on multiple-choice QA benchmarks show that our methods substantially reduce belief drift and improve predictive coherence without sacrificing accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在多项选择题回答中的信念动态，发现早期存在信念漂移（违反鞅性质），但通过自回归回答重采样后信念自稳定并收敛至连贯分布。基于此，作者提出种子答案提示策略加速稳定，以及自一致性损失通过微调将早期漂移分摊到模型中，在多项选择问答基准上减少了信念漂移并提升了预测连贯性而不牺牲准确率。
Motivation: 先前研究在受控合成情境下发现LLM的预测信念不满足鞅性质（连贯性条件），但该问题在更典型的使用场景（通用多项选择问答）中尚未被充分研究。
Method: 提出提示式预测重采样（PPR），让LLM对同一问题自回归生成一系列答案序列，计算精确预测分布并研究信念动态；进一步提出种子答案提示策略和自一致性损失微调方法。
Result: PPR显示早期信念漂移（鞅性质违反），但多次重采样后信念自稳定并收敛至连贯分布；所提方法在多项选择问答基准上显著降低信念漂移并提升预测连贯性，同时保持准确率。
Conclusion: LLM在多项选择问答中可通过自回归重采样自我纠正信念不连贯性，而种子提示和自一致性损失可加速此过程，为提升LLM预测可信度提供实用路径。

papers.title: Functional Equivalence in Attention: A Comprehensive Study with Applications to Linear Mode Connectivity
papers.abstract_en: Neural network parameter spaces are inherently non-injective, as distinct parameter configurations can realize identical functions through functional equivalence. While this symmetry is well understood in classical fully connected and convolutional models, it becomes substantially more intricate in modern attention-based architectures. Existing analyses of multihead attention have largely focused on the vanilla formulation, overlooking positional encodings that fundamentally reshape architectural symmetries. In this work, we provide a formal study of functional equivalence in Transformers with positional encodings. Focusing on the two most widely used variants--sinusoidal and rotary positional encodings (RoPE)--we show that sinusoidal encodings preserve the equivalence structure of vanilla attention, whereas rotary encodings significantly reduce the symmetry group, thereby enhancing expressivity. This offers a principled explanation for the growing prominence of RoPE in practice. We further examine how positional encodings affect linear mode connectivity, and through an alignment algorithm, empirically demonstrate that the presence and variability of connectivity across Transformer settings crucially depend on the positional encoding.
papers.comment: Published at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文正式研究了带有位置编码的Transformer中注意力机制的功能等价性。对正弦和旋转位置编码（RoPE）的分析表明，正弦编码保留原始等价结构，而旋转编码显著缩减对称群，从而增强表达性。通过对齐算法，实证了位置编码对线性模式连接性（linear mode connectivity）的关键影响。
Motivation: 现有的多注意力分析主要集中于vanilla形式，忽略了位置编码对架构对称性的重塑作用，而实际应用中位置编码广泛使用。
Method: 形式化定义并分析Transformer中功能等价性，分别处理正弦和旋转位置编码，并设计对齐算法评估线性模式连接性。
Result: 正弦编码保持vanilla注意力的等价结构；旋转编码大幅减小对称群，提升表达性。位置编码的存在和类型直接影响线性模式连接性的强弱。
Conclusion: 为RoPE在实践中日益流行提供了理论依据，并指出位置编码是影响Transformer线性模式连接性的核心因素。

papers.title: When Multiple Scripts Matter: Evaluating ASR in Clinical Settings
papers.abstract_en: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) in non-English clinical settings is challenged by multiscript variability, where the same term may appear in multiple valid orthographic forms. Conventional string-matching evaluation metrics often underestimate ASR performance by treating orthographic variants as errors. To address this issue, we introduce MultiClin, a clinical ASR benchmark designed to evaluate robustness to multiscript variability. Experiments across diverse ASR models show that multiscript-aware evaluation provides a fairer assessment of recognition quality than conventional single-reference evaluation. We further investigate the impact of script consistency during training and find that inconsistent script mappings increase orthographic uncertainty and hinder model convergence, with a balanced 50% mapping ratio producing the highest entropy. In contrast, script unification consistently yields the best ASR performance. Our dataset and code are publicly available at: https://github.com/aitrics-ronaldo/Interspeech_MultiClin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非英语临床环境中的自动语音识别（ASR）因多脚本变异性（同一术语存在多种有效拼写形式）而导致的评估不准确问题，提出了MultiClin基准，用于评估ASR对多脚本变异性的鲁棒性。实验表明，多脚本感知评估比传统单参考评估更公平。研究还发现，训练时脚本不一致会增加拼写不确定性并阻碍模型收敛，而脚本统一可获得最佳ASR性能。
Motivation: 传统字符串匹配评估指标将拼写变体视为错误，低估了ASR在临床多脚本环境中的实际性能，需要更公平的评估方法。
Method: 引入MultiClin临床ASR基准，通过多脚本感知评估替代单参考评估，并实验研究训练中脚本一致性对ASR性能的影响。
Result: 多脚本感知评估比传统单参考评估更公平；不一致的脚本映射会增加拼写不确定性，50%平衡映射比例导致最高熵，脚本统一获得最佳ASR性能。
Conclusion: 建议在临床ASR评估中使用多脚本感知指标，并在训练中保持脚本一致性以获得更好性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Human-in-the-Loop Atlas-Based 3D Asset Segmentation for Interactive Content Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Segmenting 3D assets into meaningful regions remains challenging, especially when segmentation criteria are application-dependent and require user control. We present a human-in-the-loop pipeline for generating a segmented 2D parameterized atlas from a 3D model for interactive media, game, and XR content workflows. Our method first selects a compact set of rendered views using a greedy set cover strategy over sampled surface points, and then supports interactive segmentation of these views with SAM~2 and Label Studio. The resulting masks are back-projected onto the model's UV parameterization to produce a unified segmented atlas that supports downstream production tasks such as segment-wise material assignment, style transfer, and semantic labeling. We assess the pipeline through a demonstration-based technical evaluation on eight cultural heritage objects. The results show that the approach can generate usable segmented atlases across diverse geometries while revealing recurring sources of manual correction, particularly fine structures, cavities, and weak appearance boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个人机交互的三维资产分割流程，从3D模型生成分割好的2D参数化图集（atlas），用于交互媒体、游戏和XR内容制作。该方法通过贪心集合覆盖策略选择渲染视图，支持使用SAM~2和Label Studio进行交互式分割，并将掩码反投影到UV参数化上生成统一的分割图集。在八个文化遗产物体上的技术评估表明该方法能生成可用的分割图集，但存在需要手动修正的常见问题，如精细结构、空洞和弱外观边界。
Motivation: 三维资产分割到有意义区域的准则往往依赖于具体应用且需要用户控制，现有方法缺乏灵活性和交互性。
Method: 提出一个人机交互流程：首先通过采样表面点上的贪心集合覆盖策略选择紧凑的渲染视图集，然后利用SAM~2和Label Studio对视图进行交互式分割，最后将掩码反投影到模型的UV参数化上，生成统一的分割图集。
Result: 在八个文化遗产物体上的技术评估显示，该方法能在不同几何体上生成可用的分割图集，但识别出需要手动修正的常见问题，包括精细结构、空洞和弱外观边界。
Conclusion: 该流程适用于下游生产任务，如按片段分配材质、风格迁移和语义标注，但需要进一步减少手动修正的需求。

papers.title: DecoSearch: Complexity-Aware Routing and Plan-Level Repair for Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in translating natural language to SQL, yet existing methods still falter on complex queries requiring multi-step, data-aware reasoning. We introduce DecoSearch, a training-free framework that addresses this by routing each query to the appropriate level of reasoning effort. A lightweight Schema Selector first prunes the full database schema to the relevant tables and columns. An LLM Judger then decides whether the question requires decomposition: straightforward questions follow a direct generation path and complex ones are escalated to a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of atomic sub-questions, each solved by a targeted SQL generation step. A RAG component grounds the decomposer with semantically similar training examples, and a Topology Refiner restructures the reasoning plan when execution failures signal a flawed decomposition rather than a fixable SQL error. DecoSearch achieves 70.53% execution accuracy on BIRD and 88.31% on Spider with a DeepSeek backbone, surpassing all training-free baselines while consuming an order of magnitude fewer tokens than competing methods. It also functions as a model-agnostic wrapper, consistently improving fine-tuned SQL generation backbones without any modification to the pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DecoSearch 是一个无需训练的文本到 SQL 框架，通过复杂度感知路由和计划级修复来提升 LLM 在复杂查询上的表现。摘要报告其在 BIRD 和 Spider 数据集上达到 70.53% 和 88.31% 的执行准确率，且相比竞争方法消耗少一个数量级的 Token。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 在需要多步、数据感知推理的复杂 SQL 查询上仍表现不佳，缺乏自动调整推理代价的机制。
Method: 框架包含模式选择器、LLM 判断器（决定是否分解问题）、DAG 分解执行、RAG 组件和拓扑重构器。当执行失败指示分解错误而非 SQL 错误时，拓扑重构器会重新规划推理计划。
Result: 在 BIRD 和 Spider 上以 DeepSeek 为骨干分别达到 70.53% 和 88.31% 的执行准确率，超越所有无训练基线，且 Token 消耗比竞争方法低一个数量级。
Conclusion: DecoSearch 可作为模型无关的包装器，在不改动原流程的前提下持续提升微调 SQL 生成骨干的性能。

papers.title: A Framework for Evaluating Agentic Skills at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills -- structured, reusable knowledge artifacts that augment LLM agent capabilities -- have been rapidly adopted in industry, yet their cross-domain impact and use across commercial and open-source models remain under-studied, and no reusable methodology exists for evaluating an individual skill. In this work, we present an evaluation framework that lets a skill author construct realistic tasks to rigorously assess the aspects of a skill that matter most to them, and that estimates skill utility by solving those tasks. Further, we apply our evaluation approach at scale to 500 real-world skills, generating 1,000 tasks derived from the skills' content, along with instruction-following and goal-completion scoring rubrics. Using these metrics, we evaluate how 19 agent-model configurations, both proprietary and open-source, perform on the tasks. Our results show that models vary widely in how closely they adhere to the instructions encoded in skills, leading to substantial differences in their performance gains. Furthermore, we show that access to a skill significantly changes model behavior compared to the no-skill setup, providing an essential mechanism for encoding opinionated workflows into LLM agents. We release our evaluation dataset to support future work on agent skills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个评估框架，允许技能作者构建真实任务来严格评估LLM代理技能，并估计技能效用。作者将该框架应用于500个真实世界的技能，生成1000个任务，并评估了19个代理模型配置（包括商业和开源）在任务上的表现。结果显示，模型在遵循技能指令方面差异很大，导致性能差异显著，并且技能访问显著改变了模型行为。
Motivation: 代理技能已被工业界广泛采用，但其跨领域影响和跨模型使用尚未得到充分研究，且缺乏可复用的单个技能评估方法论。
Method: 提出了一个评估框架，让技能作者构建真实任务，并生成指令遵循和任务完成评分标准；然后应用该框架对500个技能生成1000个任务，并评估19个代理模型配置。
Result: 模型在遵循技能编码的指令方面差异很大，导致性能增益显著不同；技能访问与无技能设置相比，显著改变了模型行为。
Conclusion: 技能为编码意见性工作流到LLM代理中提供了重要机制，作者发布了评估数据集以支持未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conservation Laws for Modern Neural Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Understanding gradient descent dynamics is key to explaining the success of over-parameterized models, where implicit bias manifests through conservation laws in gradient flow. While such laws are well understood for linear and ReLU networks, they remain largely unexplored for modern architectures. This work develops a unified framework to characterize conservation laws for contemporary models, including feedforward networks with GELU, SiLU, and SwiGLU activations, multihead attention with sinusoidal and rotary positional encodings, and Mixture-of-Experts architectures under diverse gating designs. Our theoretical findings are supported by experiments that validate the predicted invariants.
papers.comment: Published at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一框架，用于刻画现代神经网络架构（如GELU、SiLU、SwiGLU激活的前馈网络、多头注意力中的正弦和旋转位置编码、以及多种门控设计的混合专家模型）在梯度流中的守恒律。实验验证了理论预测的不变量。
Motivation: 梯度下降的隐式偏差通过梯度流中的守恒律体现，这在线性网络和ReLU网络中已有充分理解，但对于现代架构（如GELU、注意力机制、MoE）的守恒律仍然缺乏研究。
Method: 发展了一个统一的理论框架，推导并证明了多种现代神经网络结构在梯度流下的守恒律。
Result: 理论发现得到实验支持，验证了预测的不变量。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了现代神经网络梯度流守恒律的理论空白，为理解其训练动态提供了新视角。

papers.title: No-Free-Fairness: Fundamental Limits and Trade-offs in Learning Systems
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we establish a set of theoretical impossibility results, termed the No-Free-Fairness theorems, that identify three fundamental sources of disparity in learning systems. First, we show that when a task exhibits irreducible cost on a subgroup, any decision rule must trade off overall performance with disparity, yielding an inherent fairness--cost frontier. Second, we prove that even in ideal, noise-free settings where a perfectly fair and accurate solution exists, finite-sample learning alone induces nontrivial subgroup disparity, ruling out distribution-free fairness guarantees. More seriously, enforcing strict relative fairness creates a statistical bottleneck: achieving low cost may require exponentially many samples. Third, we show that limitations of the model class can independently induce disparity: if the model cannot represent accurate solutions for a subgroup, fairness remains unattainable regardless of data or training procedure. Overall, these results demonstrate that unfairness is not solely a consequence of biased data or suboptimal optimization, but arises from the intrinsic structure of decision problems, the constraints of finite data, and the expressivity of models. Our framework applies broadly beyond standard supervised learning, and suggests that achieving fairness requires explicit trade-offs and should be treated as a core design consideration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立了“无免费公平”定理，证明学习系统中的不公平性源于三个根本来源：任务本身的不可约成本、有限样本的统计瓶颈、以及模型表达能力的限制。这些结果说明不公平不仅是数据或优化问题，而是决策问题、数据约束和模型结构的内在产物。
Motivation: 现有研究通常将不公平归因于数据偏差或优化不足，但缺乏对不公平性根本来源的系统理论刻画。本文旨在揭示公平性内在的不可避性和权衡。
Method: 通过理论分析，从任务固有成本、有限样本学习和模型类表达能力三个角度推导出不可能性结果，建立公平性-性能前沿等概念。
Result: 证明任何决策规则都需要在总体性能与子组差异之间权衡；即使是完美公平且准确解存在的理想情况下，有限样本也会导致非平凡的不公平；强制公平会带来指数级样本复杂度；模型类不足会独立导致不公平。
Conclusion: 公平性应被视为核心设计考量，必须接受显式权衡，而非仅通过数据或算法调整即可解决。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文建立了“无免费公平”定理，证明学习系统中的不公平性源于三个根本来源：任务本身的不可约成本、有限样本的统计瓶颈、以及模型表达能力的限制。这些结果说明不公平不仅是数据或优化问题，而是决策问题、数据约束和模型结构的内在产物。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有研究通常将不公平归因于数据偏差或优化不足，但缺乏对不公平性根本来源的系统理论刻画。本文旨在揭示公平性内在的不可避性和权衡。
summary_sections.method: 通过理论分析，从任务固有成本、有限样本学习和模型类表达能力三个角度推导出不可能性结果，建立公平性-性能前沿等概念。
summary_sections.result: 证明任何决策规则都需要在总体性能与子组差异之间权衡；即使是完美公平且准确解存在的理想情况下，有限样本也会导致非平凡的不公平；强制公平会带来指数级样本复杂度；模型类不足会独立导致不公平。
summary_sections.conclusion: 公平性应被视为核心设计考量，必须接受显式权衡，而非仅通过数据或算法调整即可解决。

papers.title: Million-scale multimodal pollen microscopy with expert-guided foundation models
papers.abstract_en: Automated pollen identification from microscopy remains a bottleneck in aerobiology, palaeoecology and biodiversity monitoring, because scalable systems must generalise across specimen preparation, scanner settings and geographic origins while retaining palynological interpretability. To address this gap, we present a million-scale multimodal pollen microscopy resource, Pollen AI Atlas, assembled from pure-species whole-slide bright-field images spanning four geographic origins, four scanner settings and 46 taxon labels across 31 botanical families. Seeded by one manually selected exemplar per source slide, token-level mining and filtering produced 1,511,390 released grain detections with 99.6\% proposal precision in expert-curated test regions. Each detection was paired with machine-generated grain-level morphological captions from five open-weight vision-language models, guided by expert-verified palynological anchors, yielding structured descriptions of aperture systems, wall ornamentation, shape and size. Among the evaluated models, Gemma4 provided the most controlled primary caption set, combining tight length control, no leakage and the strongest text-retrieval performance. Baseline benchmarks with frozen visual features reached 88.16\% top-1 accuracy, while cross-regional retrieval showed that caption-derived text embeddings remained robust when image similarity degraded (mAP@20 0.811 versus 0.262). Released data, annotations, captions, splits, code, and weights provide a benchmark for pollen recognition, cross-regional domain adaptation and domain-specific multimodal microscopy learning.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 5 main figures, supplementary information included. Submitted to Scientific Reports

TL;DR: 本文构建了百万级多模态花粉显微镜资源 Pollen AI Atlas，包含来自四个地理来源、四种扫描仪设置、46个分类标签的纯种全切片明场图像。通过专家引导的视觉语言模型生成颗粒级形态描述，评估了五种开源模型，其中Gemma4在控制性和检索性能上表现最佳。基线达到88.16% top-1准确率，跨区域检索显示文本嵌入在图像相似性下降时仍保持鲁棒性。
Motivation: 自动花粉识别在空气生物学、古生态学和生物多样性监测中是瓶颈，现有系统难以在标本制备、扫描仪设置和地理来源变化下泛化，且缺乏可解释性。
Method: 从纯种全切片明场图像出发，通过单张人工挑选的种子图进行令牌级挖掘和过滤，获得151万余个花粉颗粒检测（专家验证区域提案精度99.6%）。每个检测配对由五个视觉语言模型生成的颗粒级形态描述，并由专家验证的花粉学锚点引导，形成结构化描述（孔径系统、壁纹饰、形状、大小）。
Result: 冻结视觉特征的基线达到88.16% top-1准确率；跨区域检索中，文本嵌入在图像相似性下降时保持鲁棒（mAP@20 0.811 vs 0.262）。Gemma4提供最可控的标题集，长度控制严格、无泄露、文本检索性能最强。
Conclusion: 释放的数据、注释、标题、分割、代码和权重为花粉识别、跨区域领域适应和特定领域多模态显微镜学习提供了基准。

papers.title: QueryMarket: Cost-Aware Online Active Learning in Data Markets
papers.abstract_en: Data acquisition is a major bottleneck for learning in real-time streams: analysts must decide on the fly which labels to purchase while respecting a rolling budget. However, existing online active learning rarely unifies pricing, information gain, and rolling budget constraints under concept drift. We introduce QueryMarket, a market-inspired framework that queries each incoming data point based on its estimated utility to the model and its price. Within this framework, we propose OVBAL (online variance-based active learning), which integrates data pricing with information-driven selection by estimating each sample's marginal utility via a D-optimality criterion with exponential forgetting and executing cost-aware purchases under rolling budget constraints. OVBAL yields a simple, fully online decision rule that adapts to nonstationary streams and heterogeneous label costs. Experiments on synthetic data and a real-world solar power generation forecasting task show that OVBAL is particularly effective under seller-centric pricing and yields a more favorable long-run error-cost trade-off in the real-world task under both pricing schemes.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QueryMarket框架，将数据定价、信息增益和滚动预算约束统一考虑，用于实时数据流中的在线主动学习。其中OVBAL算法通过D-最优性准则估计样本边际效用，并实现成本感知的标签购买。实验表明，在卖方可变定价场景下，OVBAL在合成数据和太阳能发电预测任务中取得了更优的长期误差-成本权衡。
Motivation: 现有在线主动学习很少同时考虑数据定价、信息增益和滚动预算约束，特别是在概念漂移场景下。
Method: 提出QueryMarket框架，并设计OVBAL算法，该算法通过指数遗忘的D-最优性准则估计每个样本的边际效用，在滚动预算约束下进行成本感知的购买决策。
Result: 实验表明，在合成数据和太阳能发电预测任务中，OVBAL在卖家可变定价场景下尤为有效，并在两种定价方案下均实现了更优的长期误差-成本权衡。
Conclusion: 本文的框架和算法能适应非平稳数据流和异构标签成本，为数据市场中的在线学习提供了有效方案。

papers.title: Continual Self-Improvement with Lightweight Experiential Latent Memories
papers.abstract_en: Large language models achieve strong reasoning performance by scaling inference-time compute, yet remain fundamentally stateless, discarding the rich, self-produced reasoning traces generated during this process. We investigate whether models can instead learn online from this experience, converting transient computation (reasoning traces) into persistent reusable knowledge, and without external supervision or access to future data. We show that In-Context Learning (ICL) over raw reasoning traces fails to generalize, reflecting a fundamental limitation of token-level reuse: individual traces lack the abstraction needed for transfer, even after refinement (e.g. self-reflection). In contrast, drawing inspiration from recent works on unsupervised reinforcement learning, we find that lightweight per-instance training with self-generated test-time signals (majority voting) as rewards yields substantial gains, often surpassing full-dataset offline training, motivating a shift from raw traces to learned latent representations. Building on this insight, we propose an online method that distills inference-time compute spent on encountered problems into compact modular latent memories capturing the underlying reasoning structure. These memories are stored and retrieved for future inputs, enabling continual improvement while avoiding catastrophic forgetting through modular design. Importantly, our method is highly efficient, parametrized as extremely lightweight soft prompt memories (~0.001% of model parameters) and trained with only a few gradient steps, yet achieving performance competitive with full parametric updates and offline training. Across challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, our approach significantly outperforms zero-shot and raw data ICL baselines, while transferring effectively across datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型能否在线从自生成推理痕迹中学习，将临时计算转化为持久可复用知识。实验表明，对原始推理痕迹的上下文学习无法泛化，而利用自生成测试时信号（多数投票）作为奖励进行轻量级逐实例训练，可获得显著提升，甚至超越全数据集离线训练。作者提出在线方法，将推理时间计算蒸馏为紧凑模块化潜在记忆，存储推理结构并支持持续改进，避免灾难性遗忘。该方法仅需极轻量软提示记忆（约模型参数的0.001%）和几个梯度步，性能与完整参数更新和离线训练相当。在数学推理基准上显著优于零样本和原始数据上下文学习基线，并能跨数据集迁移。
Motivation: 大语言模型在推理时通过扩展计算量获得强大性能，但本质上是无状态的，会丢弃自产生的推理痕迹。本文探究模型能否在线从这些经验中学习，将临时计算转化为持久可复用知识，且无需外部监督或未来数据。
Method: 提出在线学习方法，将推理时对已遇问题的计算过程蒸馏为紧凑模块化潜在记忆，捕捉推理结构。记忆以极轻量软提示形式存储（约模型参数的0.001%），通过自生成测试时信号（多数投票）作为奖励进行少量梯度步训练，支持模块化设计以避免灾难性遗忘。
Result: 在数学推理基准上，该方法显著优于零样本和原始数据上下文学习基线，性能与完整参数更新和离线训练竞争，并能跨数据集迁移。
Conclusion: 研究表明，从原始推理痕迹转向学习潜在表征（逐实例训练）比直接重用痕迹更有效；轻量级潜在记忆模块可实现高效的持续自我改进。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MaineCoon: Pursuing A Real-Time Audio-Visual Social World Model
papers.abstract_en: As an increasing majority of global video content is consumed on social platforms for interactive social purposes, video generation models built for social worlds are important but largely overlooked by previous studies. In this work, we define the position of social world models and build a prototype model as the first step towards this goal. While previous world models successfully simulate physical environments or gaming world exploration, they remain fundamentally detached from human-centric social dynamics. To bridge this gap as the first step to social world models, we present MaineCoon, the first real-time audio-visual autoregressive model that has 22B parameters and is capable of real-time streaming generation and sub-second interaction, with a record-breaking frame rate of up to 47.5 FPS, on a single GPU. To the best of our knowledge, MaineCoon is also the first real-time audio-visual generation model specifically optimized for social-interactive applications. To enable efficient and stable training, we introduce several novel techniques into MaineCoon, including self-resampling, cross-modal representation alignment, domain-aware preference optimization, and reinforced online-policy distillation (ROPD). We also design the first agentic streaming inference framework that supports thousand-second-scale or even longer generation while mitigating drift with agentic cache management and prompt planing. These innovations significantly accelerate training while optimizing real-time inference performance. We believe this work not only sets a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance benchmark for high-quality, low-latency, and long-horizon audio-visual autoregressive models, but also points out the paradigm shift desired for next-generation AI-native social platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MaineCoon，首个实时音频-视觉自回归模型，拥有 22B 参数，可在单 GPU 上以高达 47.5 FPS 的帧率进行流式生成和亚秒级交互。模型专为社交互动应用优化，引入了自重采样、跨模态表示对齐、领域感知偏好优化和强化在线策略蒸馏 (ROPD) 等技术，并设计了支持千秒级生成、通过智能缓存管理和提示规划缓解漂移的智能体流式推理框架。该模型在高质量、低延迟、长视界音视频自回归建模方面设立了新基准。
Motivation: 现有世界模型主要模拟物理环境或游戏世界，缺乏对以人为中心的社交动态的建模，而社交平台上的交互式视频内容需求日益增长。本文旨在填补这一空白，首次定义社交世界模型的概念并构建原型。
Method: 提出 MaineCoon 模型，采用自回归架构，集成自重采样、跨模态表示对齐、领域感知偏好优化和强化在线策略蒸馏 (ROPD) 等训练技术，并设计智能体流式推理框架，通过缓存管理和提示规划实现长序列生成。
Result: 模型在单 GPU 上达到 47.5 FPS 的实时生成帧率，支持千秒级连续生成，并在音频-视觉生成质量、延迟和长视界稳定性上超越现有方法，成为首个实时音视频社交世界模型。
Conclusion: MaineCoon 证明了将世界模型扩展到社交交互场景的可行性，其技术创新有望推动下一代 AI 原生社交平台的范式转变。

papers.title: Position: Coding Benchmarks Are Misaligned with Agentic Software Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents have become a major mode of software engineering, but the benchmarks we use to compare them were designed in a pre-agent era: they collapse model, harness, and environment into a single end-to-end score, typically computed against one reference solution, with no component-level signal for iteration. We argue that current coding benchmarks are misaligned with agentic software engineering. A coding agent in practice is not a model: it is a system harness -- a composite of models, harnesses, contexts, environments, and feedback signals, any one of which can move the benchmark score by margins comparable to those between adjacent model generations. We discuss three symptoms: (i) benchmark scores conflate the model with the rest of the harness; (ii) grading against a single reference solution penalises equally valid alternatives; and (iii) the absence of signal at the level of individual harness components makes the end-to-end system score difficult to iterate on.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文 (position paper)，指出当前代码基准 (coding benchmarks) 与智能体软件工程 (agentic software engineering) 不匹配。基准在设计时未考虑智能体 (agent) 的迭代特性，将模型、框架、环境等混为一谈，导致分数无法指导组件级改进。作者讨论了三个症状：分数混淆模型与框架、单一参考答案压制有效替代方案、缺乏组件级信号。
Motivation: 现有代码基准是在预智能体时代设计的，无法反映实际智能体软件工程中模型、框架、环境、反馈信号的协同作用，导致基准分数误导研究进展。
Method: 本文不提出新方法，而是通过分析三种症状（分数混淆、单一答案偏见、缺乏组件信号）来论证基准的错位，并建议重新设计能够分离组件贡献的基准。

Conclusion: 呼吁社区开发能够评估智能体软件工程中各个组件贡献的新基准，以更好地推动该领域发展。

papers.title: LiveStarPro: Proactive Streaming Video Understanding with Hierarchical Memory for Long-Horizon Streams
papers.abstract_en: Despite the remarkable progress of Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs), current online architectures still struggle to simultaneously process continuous video streams, decide autonomously when to respond, and preserve long-horizon contextual memory. These obstacles undermine real-time responsiveness and cause severe forgetting throughout prolonged interactions. In this work, we introduce LiveStarPro, a live streaming assistant that is designed for proactive video understanding over long-horizon streams. The design of LiveStarPro rests on three complementary components. The first component is Streaming Verification Decoding (SVeD), an inference framework that identifies the appropriate response timing through single-pass perplexity verification, thereby eliminating the dependency on explicit silence tokens. The second component is Streaming Causal Attention Masks (SCAM), a training strategy that enforces incremental video-language alignment over variable-length streams. The third component is Tree-Structured Hierarchical Memory (TSHM), a recursive memory architecture that organizes evicted historical information into event chains and consequently enables efficient retrieval from effectively unbounded video streams. To facilitate a comprehensive evaluation under realistic online conditions, we further present OmniStarPro, a large-scale benchmark that spans 15 diverse real-world scenarios and that extends to hour-scale streams for the assessment of long-term recall. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiveStarPro consistently surpasses existing methods, attaining a 28.9% improvement in semantic correctness and an 18.2% reduction in timing error, while its streaming key-value cache further yields a 1.58x inference speedup over the same model without caching. The model and the code are publicly available at https://github.com/sotayang/LiveStarPro.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiveStarPro，一个用于长时流媒体视频的主动理解直播助手。其核心包含三大组件：流式验证解码 (SVeD) 用于自主判定响应时机，流式因果注意力掩码 (SCAM) 用于增量视频-语言对齐，以及树状分层记忆 (TSHM) 用于高效检索任意长时间跨度的历史事件。作者还发布了大规模基准 OmniStarPro。实验表明，LiveStarPro 在语义正确性上提升 28.9%，时序误差降低 18.2%，并在带缓存的流式推理中实现 1.58 倍加速。
Motivation: 现有视频大语言模型 (Video-LLMs) 在线架构难以同时处理连续视频流、自主决定何时响应并保留长时上下文记忆，导致实时性差以及长时间交互中的严重遗忘。
Method: 提出三个互补组件：1) SVeD (Streaming Verification Decoding) 通过单遍困惑度验证决定响应时机，无需显式静默令牌；2) SCAM (Streaming Causal Attention Masks) 训练策略实现变长视频流的增量对齐；3) TSHM (Tree-Structured Hierarchical Memory) 将逐出的历史信息组织为事件链的递归记忆架构，实现无限视频流的高效检索。
Result: 在 OmniStarPro 基准上，LiveStarPro 语义正确性提升 28.9%，时序误差降低 18.2%；流式键值缓存使推理速度提升 1.58 倍。
Conclusion: LiveStarPro 通过主动响应机制和层次化记忆，显著改善长时流媒体视频理解的性能，代码和模型已开源。

papers.title: The Slop Paradox: How Synthetic Standardization Erodes Clinical Uncertainty and Cross-Modal Alignment in AI-Rewritten Radiology Reports
papers.abstract_en: AI-assisted clinical documentation tools increasingly summarize, standardize, and reformat radiology reports using large language models (LLMs). We present a controlled measurement of the resulting information degradation. Using 450 chest X-ray reports from the Indiana University dataset, we generate synthetic versions via three realistic LLM rewriting tasks: EHR summarization, standardized rewriting, and teaching case preparation. We measure entity erosion (via medical NER), hedging collapse (loss of clinical uncertainty language), and cross-modal alignment degradation (via BiomedCLIP image-text similarity). Our central finding is a dissociation between information loss and cross-modal fidelity. EHR summarization is the most destructive at the content level, eroding 51.4% of clinical entities and 43.7% of hedging language, yet it preserves image-text alignment almost entirely (a 2.5% drop). The two tasks meant to produce cleaner training data, standardized rewriting and teaching case preparation, do the reverse: they preserve more entities (26.8% and 29.3% eroded) but cause 14.9-16.5% alignment drops, six to seven times those of EHR summarization. We term this the slop paradox: rewriting that makes clinical text look cleaner for multimodal training is precisely what pulls it away from the image. Contrary to our pre-specified hypothesis, rare pathologies were not preferentially degraded: across nine rare-versus-common comparisons, no difference survived multiple-comparison correction, and nominal differences ran in the opposite direction (common > rare), so contamination is invisible to condition-specific monitoring. The dominant determinant of degradation is the type of AI rewriting task, not the clinical content. These findings bear on multimodal medical AI dataset construction and the governance of AI-assisted clinical documentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型 (LLM) 重写放射学报告带来的信息退化。使用 450 份胸部 X 光报告，通过三种重写任务（EHR 摘要、标准化重写、教学案例准备）生成合成版本，测量实体侵蚀、对冲语言丢失和跨模态对齐变化。发现 EHR 摘要虽然侵蚀了 51.4% 的临床实体和 43.7% 的对冲语言，但几乎未损害图像-文本对齐（仅下降 2.5%）；而标准化重写和教学案例准备保留了更多实体（分别侵蚀 26.8% 和 29.3%），却导致对齐下降 14.9%-16.5%。这种“slop paradox”表明，使临床文本看起来更干净的重写反而会使其偏离对应的图像。
Motivation: AI 辅助临床文档工具日益使用 LLM 总结、标准化和格式化放射学报告，但缺乏对由此造成的信息降解的受控测量。
Method: 基于 Indiana University 数据集中的 450 份胸部 X 光报告，设计三种 LLM 重写任务：EHR 摘要、标准化重写和教学案例准备。分别通过医疗命名实体识别 (NER) 衡量实体侵蚀，通过识别不确定性语言衡量对冲塌陷，以及通过 BiomedCLIP 图像-文本相似度衡量跨模态对齐退化。
Result: EHR 摘要内容层面破坏最严重，但跨模态对齐仅下降 2.5%；标准化重写和教学案例准备实体侵蚀较小（26.8% 和 29.3%），但导致对齐大幅下降 14.9%-16.5%。罕见病理并未被优先降解，多种比较无显著差异，且名义差异方向与假设相反（常见 > 罕见）。
Conclusion: 退化主要取决于 AI 重写任务的类型而非临床内容，这对多模态医疗 AI 数据集构建和 AI 辅助临床文档的治理具有重要意义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Blind Recovery of Latent Domains via Unsupervised Symmetry Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Primary motivation in blind inverse problems is to recover signals of interest from corrupted observations without knowing the obfuscating mechanism. Blind deconvolution is a prominent approach when the corruption is convolutional, but it is not applicable when general linear transformations obfuscate the domain structure. In this work, we propose an unsupervised framework for recovering latent domains and signals by discovering symmetries of the data distribution. Our framework models observations as linear measurements of signals sampled from a latent random field, and optimizes a shallow group-convolutional network by imposing stationarity and locality regularization at the model output. The model learns a latent symmetry action and an appropriate filter, thereby mapping unstructured observations to a symmetry-based representation that reveals latent signals. Experiments on stochastic processes, Ising models, shuffled and bit-scrambled images, and neural recordings show that the method recovers latent domains and signals from unstructured observations, suggesting symmetry discovery as a new direction for unsupervised structure learning and blind inverse problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个无监督框架，通过发现数据分布的对称性来从无结构的线性观测中恢复潜在域和信号。框架将观测建模为从潜在随机场采样的信号的线性测量，通过优化浅层群卷积网络并施加平稳性和局部性正则化，学习潜在的对称作用和滤波器，从而将无结构观测映射到基于对称性的表示。实验在随机过程、Ising模型、打乱图像和神经记录上验证了该方法。
Motivation: 现有的盲反卷积方法仅适用于卷积退化，不适用于一般线性变换掩盖域结构的情况。本文旨在解决从无结构观测中恢复潜在域和信号的盲逆问题，且无需知道退化机制。
Method: 提出一个无监督框架，将观测建模为从潜在随机场采样的信号的线性测量，使用浅层群卷积网络，通过施加平稳性和局部性正则化来学习潜在对称作用和滤波器，从而将无结构观测转化为基于对称性的表示。
Result: 在随机过程、Ising模型、打乱和位混淆图像以及神经记录上的实验表明，该方法能从无结构观测中恢复潜在域和信号。
Conclusion: 对称性发现为无监督结构学习和盲逆问题提供了新方向。

papers.title: MIVE: A Minimalist Integer Vector Engine for Softmax LayerNorm and RMSNorm Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of Large Language Models (LLMs) has intensified the need for specialized hardware accelerators that can satisfy stringent inference latency and power constraints. Although matrix multiplications dominate the overall computational workload, non-linear vector normalization operations, such as LayerNorm, RMSNorm and Softmax can become critical hardware bottlenecks. Existing accelerators typically implement these functions using dedicated hardware blocks, leading to duplicated resources and inefficient silicon utilization. To address this limitation, we propose a Minimalist Integer Vector Engine (MIVE), a programmable architecture capable of executing all three operations within a unified datapath. By exploiting common computational patterns across LayerNorm, RMSNorm and Softmax the proposed vector engine maximizes hardware sharing while reducing implementation overhead. Physical ASIC implementation results show that MIVE provides comprehensive multi-function support while achieving higher area and hardware efficiency than most state-of-the-art standalone accelerators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MIVE，一种极简整数向量引擎，通过统一数据路径加速LLM中的LayerNorm、RMSNorm和Softmax操作。该架构利用三种操作的共同计算模式最大化硬件共享，物理ASIC实现表明在多函数支持的同时，面积和硬件效率优于大多数现有独立加速器。
Motivation: LLM推理中矩阵乘法虽占主导，但LayerNorm、RMSNorm和Softmax等非线性归一化操作成为硬件瓶颈。现有加速器采用专用硬件块导致资源重复和硅利用率低效，亟需统一高效的加速方案。
Method: 提出可编程的MIVE架构，通过分析LayerNorm、RMSNorm和Softmax的公共计算模式，设计统一的整数向量数据路径，实现硬件资源共享，减少实现开销。
Result: 物理ASIC实现结果显示，MIVE能支持多种归一化函数，且面积效率和硬件效率均超过大多数现有独立加速器。
Conclusion: MIVE证明通过硬件共享统一加速多种非线性向量操作是可行的，可降低LLM推理加速器的硅开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On Response-Adaptive Targeting Strategies for Multi-Treatment Experiments
papers.abstract_en: Response-adaptive randomization (RAR) in clinical trials aims to improve ethical and statistical efficiency by dynamically allocating patients to treatments based on observed outcomes. While RAR based on a target optimal allocation have been extensively studied for two-arms settings, their extension to multi-treatment experiments ($K \geq 2$) remains theoretically fragmented, with most existing methods focusing on specific algorithms or restricted target allocations. In this paper, we introduce a unified framework for response-adaptive targeting, the $α$-Rebalancing Targeting Strategies ($α$RTS), which generalize the ERADE two-armed strategy of Hu et al. [2009]. We prove that all designs in this family share fundamental asymptotic properties: strong consistency, asymptotic normality of allocation proportions and treatment effect estimators, and asymptotic efficiency. To address sparse target regimes (where some treatments are asymptotically eliminated), we further propose $α$RTS with Forced Exploration, a variant that guarantees infinite sampling for all treatments while preserving the asymptotic guarantees. Extensive simulations illustrate the finite-sample behavior of $α$RTS variants in a 3-armed context, highlighting in particular the critical role of forced exploration in sparse settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多治疗实验（K≥2）中的响应自适应随机化（RAR）问题，提出统一的α-重平衡目标策略（αRTS）框架，推广了Hu等人[2009]的ERADE两臂策略。该框架下的所有设计均具有强相合性、分配比例和处理效应估计量的渐近正态性以及渐近效率。为解决稀疏目标场景（部分治疗被渐近淘汰），进一步提出带强制探索的αRTS变体，保证所有治疗无限采样同时保持渐近性。模拟实验在三臂场景下展示了αRTS变体的有限样本表现，强调了强制探索在稀疏设定中的关键作用。
Motivation: 响应自适应随机化在多臂治疗实验中扩展时，理论结果碎片化，现有方法多针对特定算法或受限目标分配，缺乏统一理论框架。
Method: 提出α-重平衡目标策略（αRTS），将ERADE两臂策略推广到多臂情形，并引入带强制探索的变体。
Result: 模拟实验表明，在三臂场景中，αRTS变体在有限样本下表现良好，强制探索在稀疏目标设定中显著影响性能。

papers.title: A Neuromorphic Trigger for Efficient Audio Event Detection
papers.abstract_en: Efficient processing of continuous audio streams remains a key challenge for real-time and resource-constrained systems. This paper introduces a neuromorphic trigger for audio event detection, based on a spiking neural network (SNN) that selectively gates input to downstream models. The proposed trigger acts as a low-cost front-end, identifying salient audio segments and forwarding only these to a more computationally intensive model for tasks such as classification. The trigger is implemented as a lightweight fully connected SNN and evaluated on two representative tasks: Anomalous Sound Detection (ASD) and Sound Event Detection (SED). For ASD, the trigger achieves a one-second segment-based F1 score of 0.97 on a class-agnostic form of the URBAN-SED dataset, demonstrating high reliability in identifying relevant audio regions. For SED, the trigger is combined with the Dang classifier on the DCASE 2017 Challenge Task 2 dataset, showing a potential $42.6\times$ reduction in FLOPs while reducing the lower bound of the event-based error rate from 0.41 to 0.25. These results highlight the potential of neuromorphic triggers as real-time, energy-efficient front-end filters, enabling substantial reductions in computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于脉冲神经网络（SNN）的神经形态触发器，作为音频事件检测的低成本前端，仅将显著音频段转发给下游计算密集型模型。在异常声音检测（ASD）和声音事件检测（SED）任务上验证，在URBAN-SED数据集上实现0.97的段级F1分数，在DCASE 2017挑战赛任务2数据集上结合Dang分类器可实现42.6倍FLOPs减少，并将事件错误率下界从0.41降低到0.25。
Motivation: 连续音频流的实时处理在资源受限系统中仍是关键挑战，现有方法常因处理全部输入导致高计算成本。
Method: 设计一个轻量级全连接SNN作为触发器，选择性门控输入，仅将检测到的显著音频段传递给下游分类模型。
Result: 在ASD任务上，触发器在URBAN-SED数据集达到0.97的段级F1；在SED任务上，结合Dang分类器实现42.6倍FLOPs减少，事件错误率下界从0.41降至0.25。
Conclusion: 神经形态触发器作为实时、节能的前端滤波器，可显著降低计算成本，适用于资源受限的音频事件检测场景。

papers.title: Talking to Your Data: Exploring Embodied Conversation as an Interface for Personal Health Reflection
papers.abstract_en: Personal health data from wearables are typically presented through dashboards of charts and summary statistics, requiring users to actively interpret patterns and implications. We explore an alternative interaction paradigm: engaging with personal health data through an embodied conversational agent that facilitates objective data reflection in dialogue with the user. We present a system that combines lightweight preprocessing of wearable data with a Unity-based embodied character. Internally, the system follows a dual-agent design in which an Observer agent extracts descriptive statistics and temporal trends, and a Presenter agent communicates these findings through "spoken statistics," intentionally refraining from clinical advice to isolate the impact of the interaction modality. We evaluate this approach through a simulated-self user study (N=5) using a within-subject design. Participants adopted health personas and goals derived from the LifeSnaps dataset to compare traditional dashboard exploration with embodied conversational reflection. Our evaluation focuses on perceived understanding, the specificity of generated actions, and the cognitive shift from passive viewing to active sensemaking. The paper contributes a functional prototype, a design pattern for objective health data narrative generation, and early empirical insights into how embodiment affects the interpretation of personal health metrics.
papers.journal_ref: Joint Proceedings of the ACM Intelligent User Interfaces (IUI) Workshops 2026, Paphos, Cyprus, July 13-16, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索了通过具身对话智能体与个人健康数据进行对话的交互方式，以促进客观数据反思。系统采用双智能体设计：Observer提取描述性统计和时间趋势，Presenter通过口语统计数据传达发现，避免临床建议。通过模拟自用户研究（N=5）比较传统仪表盘与具身对话反思，关注感知理解、行动特异性和认知转变。贡献包括功能原型、客观健康数据叙事生成设计模式及早期实证见解。
Motivation: 现有可穿戴健康数据通常以仪表盘图表和摘要统计呈现，用户需要主动解释模式，缺乏更自然的交互方式，难以促进深度反思。
Method: 构建了一个结合轻量级可穿戴数据预处理与Unity具身角色的系统。内部采用双智能体设计：Observer提取描述性统计和时间趋势，Presenter通过口语统计传达发现，避免提供临床建议以隔离交互方式的影响。通过模拟自用户研究（N=5，被试内设计）进行评估，参与者采用LifeSnaps数据集中的健康角色和目标。
Result: 研究聚焦于感知理解、生成行动的特异性以及从被动观看向主动意义构建的认知转变。提供了功能原型和初步实证结果，表明具身对话可能影响健康指标的解释。
Conclusion: 论文贡献了一个功能原型、一种用于客观健康数据叙事生成的设计模式，以及关于具身如何影响个人健康指标解释的早期实证见解。

papers.title: Symplectic Transversality and Endpoint Green Estimates for Finite-Horizon Pontryagin Systems
papers.abstract_en: We study horizon-uniform local branches of finite-horizon discrete-time Pontryagin boundary value systems after smooth control elimination. The central input is a two-point endpoint inverse for the linearization. We verify this inverse from scaled stable--unstable boundary transversality, prove the associated endpoint-corrected Green estimate, and combine it with weighted contractions to obtain existence, uniqueness, Lipschitz dependence, and first-order expansions with constants independent of the horizon. The framework covers smooth nonlinear endpoint maps, including the original Pontryagin rows that fix the initial state and couple the terminal costate to the terminal state. Symplectic and Riccati criteria verify the inverse hypothesis at the level of the matrix data; in particular, every stabilizable linear-quadratic system with invertible dynamics and definite weights is covered, including noncommuting coupled data. A numerical section illustrates the certificates and the horizon-uniform first-order expansion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有限时域离散时间Pontryagin边值系统在光滑控制消去后的时域一致局部分支。核心输入是线性化的两点端点逆，通过缩放稳定-不稳定边界横截性验证该逆的存在，并推导关联的端点修正格林估计。结合加权收缩方法，得到了存在唯一性、Lipschitz依赖及一阶展开，且常数与时间区间无关。框架覆盖了光滑非线性端点映射，包括固定初始状态并耦合终端协态与终端状态的原始Pontryagin行。辛和Riccati准则在矩阵数据层面验证了逆假设，特别地，所有具有可逆动力学和确定权重的可镇定线性二次系统均被覆盖，包括非交换耦合数据。数值部分展示了证书和时域一致一阶展开。
Motivation: 现有理论难以保证有限时域Pontryagin边值问题解的存在性和一致性，尤其是在长时间区间上常数依赖于时域。需要建立时域统一的局部分支理论。
Method: 提出基于线性化两点端点逆的方法，利用缩放稳定-不稳定边界横截性验证逆的存在，并推导端点修正格林估计，再结合加权收缩技术证明存在唯一性和光滑依赖性。
Result: 证明了存在唯一性、Lipschitz依赖及一阶展开，常数与时间区间无关；验证了所有满足辛和Riccati准则的可镇定线性二次系统均被覆盖。
Conclusion: 该框架为有限时域Pontryagin边值系统提供了时域一致的分析工具，适用于光滑非线性端点映射，数值例子验证了理论结果。

papers.title: A fairness-aware extension of Stochastic Multicriteria Acceptability Analysis for ranking
papers.abstract_en: Fairness has become a central concern in ranking problems involving individuals or social groups, particularly under the Responsible Artificial Intelligence agenda. In Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis, Stochastic Multicriteria Acceptability Analysis (SMAA) provides a robust framework for handling uncertainty and incomplete preference information, but it does not explicitly address fairness in the resulting rankings. This paper proposes SMAA-Fair, a fairness-aware extension of SMAA for ranking problems. The approach reweights the simulated rankings generated by SMAA according to their level of group fairness, so that fairer rankings contribute more strongly to the acceptability indices and central weights vector. The framework is independent of the aggregation model and can incorporate different fairness metrics. In this study, Statistical Parity, normalized discounted Kullback--Leibler divergence (rKL) and normalized discounted cumulative Kullback--Leibler divergence (nDKL) are adopted. Rankings are derived from the fairness-adjusted acceptability matrix using expected ranking and maximum acceptability ranking. We also derive the central weight according to the degree of fairness in the obtained rankings. Numerical experiments with synthetic and real data show that SMAA-Fair improves the representation of protected groups among favourable ranking positions, while preserving robustness to preference uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SMAA-Fair，一种公平感知的随机多准则可接受性分析（SMAA）扩展，用于排序问题。该方法根据群体公平性水平对SMAA生成的模拟排序进行重新加权，使得更公平的排序对可接受性指标和中心权重向量贡献更大。采用统计奇偶性、归一化折扣KL散度（rKL）和归一化折扣累积KL散度（nDKL）作为公平性度量，并通过期望排名和最大可接受性排名从公平性调整后的可接受性矩阵导出排名。合成和真实数据实验表明，SMAA-Fair改善了受保护群体在高排名位置的表示，同时保持对偏好不确定性的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有SMAA方法在处理多准则决策中的不确定性和不完整偏好信息时，未能显式考虑排序结果中的群体公平性，需要在负责任人工智能框架下将公平性纳入排序问题。
Method: 提出SMAA-Fair，通过对SMAA模拟排序施加公平性驱动的重新加权，使更公平的排序获得更高权重；采用统计奇偶性、rKL和nDKL作为公平性度量；利用公平性调整后的可接受性矩阵，通过期望排名和最大可接受性排名生成最终排序，并推导考虑公平性的中心权重向量。
Result: 数值实验（合成和真实数据）表明SMAA-Fair改善了受保护群体在高排名位置的表示，同时保持了对偏好不确定性的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该方法独立于聚合模型，可灵活融入不同公平性度量，并能为排序结果提供考虑公平性的中心权重解释。

papers.title: BrainWorld: A Structural-Prior-Conditioned Generative Model for Whole-Brain 4D fMRI Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Whole-brain 4D fMRI generation is valuable for modeling functional brain dynamics, yet existing fMRI foundation models mainly target representation learning and downstream prediction rather than conditional predictive generation. We introduce BrainWorld, a structural-prior-conditioned generative model for whole-brain 4D fMRI dynamics. BrainWorld uses sMRI as subject-level anatomical context to guide future fMRI generation, integrating structural information into the denoising process rather than treating it as a parallel modality. Evaluated on 22 datasets spanning diverse cohorts and brain states, BrainWorld generates stable 4D fMRI trajectories up to 400 frames, improves downstream performance through generated-example augmentation, and learns transferable multimodal representations that outperform baselines. Together, these results establish BrainWorld as a condition-aware generative framework for long-horizon brain dynamics modeling and multimodal representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BrainWorld，一种基于结构先验条件的生成模型，用于全脑4D fMRI动态生成。该模型将sMRI作为解剖上下文引导未来fMRI生成，整合结构信息到去噪过程。在22个数据集上评估，可生成长达400帧的稳定4D fMRI轨迹，通过生成样本增强提升下游性能，并学习可迁移的多模态表示。
Motivation: 现有fMRI基础模型主要关注表示学习和下游预测，缺乏条件预测生成能力，尤其是结合解剖结构先验的长期动态生成。
Method: BrainWorld采用结构先验条件生成框架，以sMRI作为主体级解剖上下文，将其融入去噪过程，而非作为平行模态，实现未来fMRI动态的条件生成。
Result: 在22个跨不同队列和脑状态的数据集上，BrainWorld可生成长达400帧的稳定4D fMRI轨迹，通过生成样本增强提升下游任务性能，并学习到优于基线的可迁移多模态表示。
Conclusion: BrainWorld作为条件感知生成框架，为长期大脑动态建模和多模态表示学习提供了有效方案，但摘要未明确提及局限。

papers.title: ED3R: Energy-Aware Distributed Disaster Detection Enabled by Cooperative Robotic Agents
papers.abstract_en: Robotics are expected to support environmental monitoring and natural disaster management, where decisions must be made under uncertainty, resource limitations, and strict operational constraints. In critical missions, such as wildfires, robotic agents must not only identify hazardous events with sufficient confidence, but also manage the energy cost and time until detection. This paper introduces ED3R, an energy-aware distributed framework for wildfire detection under uncertainty. ED3R enables hierarchical cooperative decision-making between a robot and a remote controller. The remote controller decides upon the robot's motion, while the robot senses the environment and decides where to execute the wildfire detection (onboard or remotely) and how. The common goal is to detect wildfires with a required confidence while minimizing the energy consumed by any robot operation. ED3R further integrates mechanisms to avoid nearby obstacles, prevent redundant exploration, enable adaptive early mission completion, and ensure feasibility through a custom penalty function. ED3R also introduces a forward-looking capability, enabled through distributed neural regression models that allow the agents to anticipate the future by evaluating candidate strategies before execution. The framework is evaluated through realistic robotics simulations, ablation studies, and baseline comparisons. Overall, ED3R achieves a mission success rate of up to 97.18%. Especially in the most demanding missions, it reduces energy consumption by up to 36.4% and detects wildfires up to 41% faster than baselines.

TL;DR: ED3R 是一种能量感知的分布式野火检测框架，通过层级协同决策（机器人端与远程控制器）在不确定环境下平衡检测置信度与能耗。框架引入分布式神经回归模型实现前向预判，并通过避障、减少冗余探索、自适应早期任务完成等机制提升效率。在仿真实验中，任务成功率最高达 97.18%，在最严苛任务中能耗降低 36.4%，检测速度提升 41%。

Method: 提出 ED3R 框架，采用层级协同决策：远程控制器规划机器人运动，机器人根据传感数据决定本地或远程执行检测。引入分布式神经回归模型预测未来状态，并通过自定义惩罚函数保证可行性，同时集成避障、减少重复探索和自适应提前完成机制。
Result: 在仿真评估中，ED3R 任务成功率最高达 97.18%；在最严苛任务中，相比基线，能耗降低 36.4%，检测速度提升 41%。
Conclusion: ED3R 在不确定环境下通过能量感知与协同决策有效提升野火检测性能，未来可扩展至其他灾害场景。

papers.title: Shattering the Autoregressive Curse: Dynamic Epistemic Entropy Orchestrated Erasable Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Although reinforcement learning (RL) has expanded the cognitive boundaries of large language models (LLMs), it often remains vulnerable to the autoregressive curse in long-horizon logical reasoning: small epistemic perturbations introduced early in generation can propagate irreversibly along the Markov decision process flow, triggering cascading failures that drive the reasoning trajectory toward collapse. To overcome this autoregressive cascade, in which a single early mistake can compromise all subsequent reasoning steps, we propose dynamic epistemic entropy orchestrated erasable reinforcement learning ($\text{E}^3\text{RL}$). $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ eliminates reliance on external signals by grounding the model's endogenous local autoregressive cross-entropy as an intrinsic coordinate of epistemic uncertainty. By introducing segment-level adaptive dynamic thresholds and advantage allocation, $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ enables the model to precisely excise localized logical defects while reusing historical key-value (KV) cache streams, thereby endowing the reasoning process with a self-healing capability. We train $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ on the DeepMath-103k dataset. Experimental results show that $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ reshapes the exploration efficiency of long-sequence reasoning and improves sample efficiency while maintaining linear memory overhead. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks such as AIME, $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ achieves substantial performance gains, with the 4B and 8B parameter models surpassing previous state-of-the-art (SOTA) results by 5.349\% and 6.514\%, respectively. These findings suggest that $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ shatters the autoregressive curse in long-sequence reasoning and establishes a theoretical and systems-level foundation for the next generation of self-healing artificial general intelligence (AGI).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动态认知熵编排的可擦除强化学习（E³RL），解决大语言模型在长序列推理中的自回归诅咒问题。通过将内生交叉熵作为认知不确定性坐标，并引入分段自适应动态阈值和优势分配，模型能够精准切除局部逻辑缺陷并复用KV缓存，实现自我修复能力。在DeepMath-103k数据集上训练，在AIME等数学推理基准上，4B和8B模型分别超越此前SOTA 5.349%和6.514%，且内存开销线性。
Motivation: 现有强化学习在长时域逻辑推理中易受自回归诅咒影响——早期微小认知扰动沿马尔可夫链不可逆传播，导致推理轨迹级联崩溃。
Method: 提出E³RL框架，使用模型内生的局部自回归交叉熵作为认知不确定性的内在坐标，无需外部信号。通过分段自适应动态阈值和优势分配，允许模型精准切除逻辑缺陷并重用历史KV缓存流，赋予推理过程自愈能力。
Result: 在AIME等数学推理基准上，4B和8B参数模型分别超越此前SOTA 5.349%和6.514%。同时提升长序列推理的探索效率和样本效率，保持线性内存开销。
Conclusion: E³RL击碎了自回归诅咒，为下一代自愈式通用人工智能奠定了理论和系统基础。

papers.title: ActWorld: From Explorable to Interactive World Model via Action-Aware Memory
papers.abstract_en: Interactive world models aim to simulate environment dynamics under real-time user actions. However, their action vocabulary is largely confined to navigation: most actions correspond to motion (e.g., walk, turn, look around), while interaction with objects in the scene (e.g., pick up plates, open doors, or trigger physical responses) is either absent, restricted to game domains, or relegated to prompt-to-full-video scenarios. The resulting worlds are visually explorable but not truly actionable. In this work, we present ActWorld, an interactive world model that extends prior navigation-centric generators to support mid-rollout object interaction within a chunk-autoregressive framework. We argue that the navigation-interaction gap stems from two bottlenecks. First, a data bottleneck: the lack of human-object interaction data with accurate, dense labels. Second, a memory bottleneck: recency-biased history compression in existing world models discards the event-transition frames that causally determine subsequent object states, leading to an action-forgetting pathology. On the data side, we construct a 100K interaction video dataset, each annotated with per-chunk captions via chain-of-thought reasoning. On the model side, we introduce a hierarchical action-aware memory design that routes history compression by interaction importance, complemented by a persistent memory bank that maintains event-update and object-identity tokens across long rollouts. Experiments show that ActWorld supports both flexible navigation and rich object interaction within a single model, substantially improving interaction fidelity over navigation-only baselines without sacrificing viewpoint control. Project page is available at https://interactwm.github.io/ActWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ActWorld，一种交互式世界模型，能够在 chunk-autoregressive 框架中支持 rollout 过程中的物体交互（如拾取盘子、开门等），而非仅限于导航。作者认为导航-交互差距源于数据瓶颈（缺乏密集标注的人-物交互数据）和记忆瓶颈（现有模型的重编码偏向近期帧，丢弃了因果决定物体状态的事件过渡帧）。通过构建 100K 交互视频数据集（每段带有链式推理的 chunk 级标注）和引入分层动作感知记忆机制（按交互重要性路由历史压缩，并维护持久记忆银行），ActWorld 在单个模型内同时实现灵活导航和丰富物体交互，在交互保真度上显著优于仅导航的基线。
Motivation: 现有交互式世界模型的动作词汇局限于导航（行走、转身、环视），缺乏与场景中物体的实时交互能力（如捡起盘子、开门），导致世界虽可探索但不可真正操作。
Method: 提出 ActWorld，采用 chunk-autoregressive 框架，通过构建 100K 交互视频数据集（含链式推理 chunk 级标注）和分层动作感知记忆设计（按交互重要性对历史压缩路由，并利用持久记忆银行维护事件更新和物体身份令牌）来解决数据与记忆瓶颈。
Result: 摘要报告 ActWorld 在单个模型中同时支持灵活导航和丰富物体交互，在交互保真度上显著优于仅导航的基线，且不牺牲视角控制。
Conclusion: 通过解决数据与记忆瓶颈，可以将导航为中心的世界模型扩展为支持实时物体交互的交互式世界模型。

papers.title: LongWebBench: Evaluating Structural and Functional Webpage Generation in Long-Horizon Settings
papers.abstract_en: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promising progress in generating webpages from visual inputs, yet existing evaluations mainly focus on short, single-screen, and largely static webpages. We introduce LongWebBench, a benchmark for evaluating long-horizon webpage generation from both structural and functional perspectives. LongWebBench contains 490 real-world long webpages for structural fidelity evaluation and 507 goal-oriented interaction tasks over 129 webpages for functional evaluation. It employs two complementary protocols: a multi-dimensional VLM-based metric for assessing long-range structural coherence, and a DOM-augmented agent-based pipeline for end-to-end functional verification. We further examine the automatic evaluation protocols through human agreement analysis. Experiments with state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary VLMs under single-image and multi-image settings reveal that structural fidelity degrades as webpage length increases, while visually plausible generations often fail to support executable multi-step interactions. These results highlight the need to evaluate long webpage generation beyond visual similarity, with executable interaction as a core criterion. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/zheny2751-dotcom/LongWebBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了LongWebBench基准，用于评估长上下文网页生成的结构和功能。包含490个真实长网页用于结构评估，以及507个目标导向交互任务用于功能评估。实验发现，随着网页长度增加，结构保真度下降，视觉上合理的生成往往无法支持可执行的交互。
Motivation: 现有VLM网页生成评估主要关注短、单屏、静态网页，缺乏对长期、可交互网页的评估。
Method: 构建LongWebBench，包含结构评估和功能评估两部分。结构评估使用多维度VLM指标，功能评估使用DOM增强的基于智能体的端到端验证流程。
Result: 实验表明，随着网页长度增加，结构保真度下降；视觉合理的生成往往无法支持多步交互。
Conclusion: 需要在视觉相似性之外，以可执行交互作为核心标准来评估长网页生成。

papers.title: GSPan: A Continuous Gaussian Primitive Representation for Arbitrary-Scale Pansharpening
papers.abstract_en: Pansharpening aims to generate high-resolution multispectral (HRMS) images by fusing low-resolution multispectral (LRMS) and panchromatic (PAN) observations. Most existing deep learning methods treat pansharpening as fixed-grid prediction, which limits scale adaptation. To address this, we propose GSPan, a framework that introduces 2D Gaussian Splatting (GS) into pansharpening. Instead of directly predicting pixels, GSPan represents band-wise residual details as continuous and learnable 2D Gaussian primitives. We design a Dual-Stream Hierarchical Interaction (DSHI) architecture with a Spatial-Spectral Interactive Attention (SSIA) module to estimate these primitives from complementary PAN and MS observations. The predicted primitives are rendered as a residual detail field and injected into the upsampled MS image. This continuous representation allows GSPan to render fused images on arbitrary target sampling grids without scale-specific retraining. It further enables a Scale-Decoupled Asymmetric Inference (SDAI) strategy, which estimates primitives at a reduced resolution and renders the fused image at the target resolution for efficient large-scene pansharpening. Experiments on QuickBird, GaoFen-2, WorldView-3, and WorldView-3-4K datasets show that GSPan delivers state-of-the-art fusion performance. Moreover, SDAI markedly accelerates inference, achieving a favorable trade-off between computational efficiency and fusion quality. Our results demonstrate the potential of continuous Gaussian residual representations as a flexible and scale-decoupled alternative to fixed-grid prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出GSPan，将2D高斯溅射(Gaussian Splatting)引入全色锐化，用连续可学习的2D高斯基元表示残差细节，实现任意尺度融合而无需逐尺度重新训练。设计双流分层交互架构和空间-光谱交互注意力模块估计基元，并采用尺度解耦非对称推理加速大场景处理。在QuickBird、GaoFen-2、WorldView-3等数据集上达到最优融合性能。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法将全色锐化视为固定网格预测，限制了尺度自适应性，无法灵活处理任意缩放比。
Method: 提出GSPan框架，用2D高斯基元表示波段残差细节，通过双流分层交互架构和空间-光谱交互注意力从PAN和MS观测中估计基元，并渲染为残差细节场注入上采样MS图像。支持任意采样网格渲染，并引入尺度解耦非对称推理策略。
Result: 在QuickBird、GaoFen-2、WorldView-3和WorldView-3-4K数据集上达到最先进融合性能；非对称推理显著加速，实现计算效率与融合质量的良好平衡。
Conclusion: 连续高斯残差表示可成为固定网格预测的灵活、尺度解耦替代方案，展示了在全色锐化中的潜力。

summary_sections.result: 在QuickBird、GaoFen-2、WorldView-3和WorldView-3-4K数据集上达到最先进融合性能；非对称推理显著加速，实现计算效率与融合质量的良好平衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 连续高斯残差表示可成为固定网格预测的灵活、尺度解耦替代方案，展示了在全色锐化中的潜力。

papers.title: Heterogeneous SAR-optical fusion for near-real-time land use and land cover mapping under cloud contamination: A novel framework and global benchmark dataset
papers.abstract_en: Optical remote sensing imagery is frequently degraded by cloud and cloud-shadow contamination, which limits its reliability for near-real-time land use and land cover (LULC) mapping. Although synthetic aperture radar (SAR) can provide cloud-penetrating structural information, existing SAR-optical fusion methods often assume reliable optical observations and insufficiently address the semantic uncertainty introduced by cloud contamination. To address this issue, we propose CloudLULC-Net, an end-to-end heterogeneous SAR-optical fusion framework that directly predicts LULC maps from cloud-contaminated Sentinel-2 imagery and temporally adjacent Sentinel-1 SAR observations. The proposed network incorporates optical reliability modulation to suppress unreliable optical responses, heterogeneous information adaptive aggregation to model high-order spatial-channel interactions between optical and SAR representations, and a unified semantic mapping transformer to organize fused features in a LULC-oriented latent space. A semantic anchor-guided optimization strategy is further introduced to improve the consistency of intermediate semantic representations. To support this task, we construct CloudLULC-Set, a large-scale benchmark dataset containing 40,223 curated SAR-optical-label triplets with pixel-level LULC annotations across diverse geographic regions and cloud conditions. Experimental results show that CloudLULC-Net achieves an OA of 86.60%, an F1-score of 83.29%, and an mIoU of 73.51%, outperforming representative heterogeneous reconstruction-first and end-to-end SAR-optical mapping methods. Comparisons with existing global LULC products and analyses under different cloud-cover levels further demonstrate the robustness and practical value of CloudLULC-Net for target-date LULC mapping in cloud-prone regions.The project is publicly available at: https://github.com/RSIIPAC/CloudLULC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对云污染导致光学遥感图像可靠性下降的问题，提出CloudLULC-Net异构SAR-光学融合框架，用于近实时土地利用与土地覆盖(LULC)制图。该网络包含光学可靠性调制、异质信息自适应聚合、统一语义映射Transformer和语义锚点引导优化策略。同时构建了包含40,223个三元组的全球基准数据集CloudLULC-Set。实验表明，CloudLULC-Net在测试集上达到OA 86.60%、F1 83.29%、mIoU 73.51%，优于现有方法，在不同云覆盖率下鲁棒性良好。
Motivation: 光学遥感图像常因云和云影污染而质量下降，影响近实时LULC制图的可靠性。现有SAR-光学融合方法假设光学观测可靠，未能充分处理云污染带来的语义不确定性。
Method: 提出端到端异构SAR-光学融合框架CloudLULC-Net，包括光学可靠性调制(抑制不可靠光学响应)、异质信息自适应聚合(建模光学与SAR表征的高阶空间-通道交互)、统一语义映射Transformer(在LULC导向潜空间组织融合特征)，并引入语义锚点引导优化策略提升中间语义表征一致性。同时构建大规模基准数据集CloudLULC-Set。
Result: CloudLULC-Net在测试集上取得OA 86.60%、F1 83.29%、mIoU 73.51%，优于代表性异构重建优先和端到端SAR-光学映射方法。在不同云覆盖率及与现有全球LULC产品对比中均表现出鲁棒性和实用性。
Conclusion: CloudLULC-Net为云污染区域的近实时LULC制图提供了有效方案，其稳健性和实际价值得到实验验证。
