papers.title: Structured Adversarial Camouflage via Voronoi Diagrams
papers.abstract_en: Pixel-wise adversarial patches are computationally heavy and often visually detectable, limiting utility in security-critical systems. We present adversarial Voronoi camouflage that optimizes only seed-point locations under fixed, printable palettes using a soft assignment, producing structured, splinter camouflage-like patterns without additional regularization. Evaluated on person detection with COCO-style AP@[.5:.95], naive placement (Inria -> COCO) performs comparably bad, while garment-level application via segmentation mask (3DPeople) results in a significant AP drop. The attack transfers to out-of-domain backgrounds and across detector families (YOLOv9/10/11/12), indicating robustness in black-box settings. Repainting with different palettes largely nullifies the effect, and single-color tweaks show limited tolerance (<=0.17), highlighting a structure-palette coupling. The parameter-efficient, palette-constrained design improves visual plausibility while degrading real-time detector performance. Physical validation and color calibration are left for future work. Code: https://github.com/JensBayer/Voronoi This paper was originally presented at the International Conference on Military Communication and Information Systems (ICMCIS), organized by the Information Systems Technology (IST) Scientific and Technical Committee, IST-224-RSY - the ICMCIS, held in Bath, United Kingdom, 12-13 May 2026.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Voronoi 图的对抗伪装方法，通过优化种子点位置在固定可打印调色板下生成结构化图案，用于降低行人检测器的性能。实验表明，在衣物级应用下（通过分割掩码）导致 COCO 风格 AP@[.5:.95] 显著下降，攻击可迁移到域外背景和不同检测器家族（YOLOv9/10/11/12），但重绘不同调色板可抵消效果。该方法参数高效且视觉更合理，但物理验证和颜色校准尚未进行。
Motivation: 像素级对抗补丁计算量大且视觉上易被察觉，限制了在安全关键系统中的应用。需要一种参数高效、视觉合理的对抗图案生成方法。
Method: 基于 Voronoi 图，仅优化种子点位置，采用软赋值在固定可打印调色板下生成结构化的 splinter camouflage 风格图案，无需额外正则化项。
Result: 在行人检测任务上，衣物级应用（通过 3DPeople 分割掩码）导致 AP@[.5:.95] 显著下降；攻击对域外背景和 YOLOv9/10/11/12 等检测器具有迁移性；单色调整的容忍度低（≤0.17），表明结构-调色板强耦合。
Conclusion: 参数高效、调色板约束的设计提升了视觉合理性并能有效降低实时检测器性能。未来工作包括物理验证和颜色校准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vision-language models for chest radiography do not always need the image
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models report strong chest radiograph accuracy, and this is increasingly read as evidence that they use the image. That inference is unsafe: a model exploiting finding-name priors scores like one that reads the scan, and no standard benchmark separates them. We introduce a causal audit that intervenes on the image, occluding the relevant region, occluding an irrelevant one, and swapping in another patient's same-label scan, and combines three behavioral metrics to test whether a correct answer depends on the image. Across nine systems, a text-only model with no image access reaches within 5.7 accuracy points of the best multimodal one, and a 119-billion-parameter multimodal model is statistically indistinguishable from a 7-billion text-only baseline. The audit splits the cohort into three models that ignore the image, one that is unstable, and five that use it selectively, for a subset of findings; the categories hold across a second dataset, resolution, and prompt phrasing. Against board-certified radiologists, a text-only model is statistically indistinguishable from a radiologist's accuracy while grounding at zero, whereas the image-using models ground at radiologist-comparable rates. Reported confidence flags ungrounded answers only when a model uses the image. Grounding audits, not accuracy, should gate clinical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究胸部X光视觉语言模型是否真正依赖图像进行诊断。通过因果审计，作者发现许多模型仅利用疾病名称的先验知识，文本-only模型与最佳多模态模型在精度上相差仅5.7点，一个119B参数的多模态模型与7B文本-only基线在统计上无差异。审计将模型分为忽略图像、不稳定和选择性使用图像三类，且结果跨数据集稳定。作者认为接地审计（grounding audits）比准确性更适合评估模型是否真正使用图像。
Motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型报告高准确性，但这可能来自疾病名称的先验而非实际图像理解，标准基准无法区分模型是否真正使用图像，存在临床部署风险。
Method: 提出一种因果审计方法，通过遮挡相关区域、遮挡无关区域、以及交换同标签扫描，结合三个行为指标，测试模型正确回答是否依赖于图像内容。
Result: 文本-only模型与最佳多模态模型在精度上相差仅5.7点；一个119B参数的多模态模型与7B文本-only基线在统计上无差异。审计将模型分为三类：忽略图像、不稳定和选择性使用图像，且分类在第二个数据集、分辨率和提示措辞上仍然成立。
Conclusion: 接地审计（grounding audits）而非准确性应作为临床部署的门控条件，因为准确性无法区分模型是否真正使用图像。

papers.title: Confusion-Aware Transfer Teacher Curriculum Learning Framework: Disentangling Scoring and Pacing Effects
papers.abstract_en: Curriculum learning couples two design choices, how samples are scored by difficulty and how harder samples are paced into training, making it difficult to attribute observed gains to either component. We disentangle these factors with two evaluation protocols: stage-wise test subsets that validate scoring functions independently of curriculum training, and a baseline that applies the same pacing schedule to randomly ordered data. Within the Transfer Teacher framework (TTF), we use these protocols to evaluate a confusion-aware difficulty score that considers both correct-class confidence and the probability distribution over incorrect classes. On CIFAR-10 with ResNet-18 and VGG-16, the proposed score produces model-interpretable difficulty rankings that align with human intuition. However, at full data, neither curriculum nor anti-curriculum ordering improves accuracy over standard training, indicating that improving the scoring function alone is insufficient to overcome the known failure modes of curriculum learning in TTF. In contrast, We find that confusion-aware curriculum ordering result in consistent data-efficiency benefits, outperforming random ordering by up to 8.7% points at the 20% data regime, suggesting the potential of TTF as a data-efficient training method.
papers.comment: Accepted at International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) GlobalSouthML Workshop (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出解耦课程学习中难度评分与训练节奏的评估协议，并在Transfer Teacher框架（TTF）下检验一种考虑错误类置信度的混淆感知难度评分。在CIFAR-10上，该评分生成符合人类直觉的难度排序，但全数据下课程与反课程排序均未提升标准训练精度；在20%数据量下，混淆感知课程排序相比随机排序提升多达8.7个百分点，表明TTF在数据高效训练中的潜力。
Motivation: 课程学习将样本难度评分与训练节奏耦合，难以单独评估每项设计的贡献。
Method: 提出两个解耦评估协议：阶段式测试子集（验证评分函数）和将相同节奏应用于随机顺序的基线；并在TTF中采用混淆感知难度评分（考虑正确类置信度与错误类分布）。
Result: 全数据下无明显精度提升；20%数据量下混淆感知课程排序优于随机排序8.7个百分点，展现出数据效率优势。
Conclusion: 改进评分函数不足以克服TTF课程学习的已知失败模式，但TTF作为数据高效训练方法具有潜力。

papers.title: SegTME-UNI2: A Foundation Model-Based Framework for Generalisable Multiclass Cell Segmentation and LLM-Driven Tumour Microenvironment Characterisation in Histopathology
authors: Wan Siti Halimatul Munirah Wan Ahmad
papers.abstract_en: Characterising the tumour microenvironment (TME) from routine H&E-stained histology images requires simultaneous cell segmentation, feature extraction, and interpretable clinical reporting. We present SEGTME-UNI2, a unified framework addressing these requirements. Its core is UNI2-UPERHOVER, a dual-head segmentation model pairing the UNI2-H pathology foundation model (ViT-Giant, pretrained on >100M tiles from 100K slides) with two parallel UperNet decoders: one for six-class semantic segmentation and one for horizontal-vertical gradient regression enabling watershed-based nuclear instance separation. To address the lack of pixel-level annotations in large real-world repositories, UNI2-UPERHOVER undergoes a three-stage progressive pseudo-label curriculum. Each stage trains a fresh model without weight transfer, driving improvement entirely via increased pseudo-label quality: Stage 1: Uses human-annotated PanNuke (7,901 images, 189,744 nuclei, 0.25 um/pixel). Stage 2: Uses entropy-filtered pseudo-labels from the Stage 1 model on 271,711 TCGA-UT scale-0 patches (0.5 um/pixel). Stage 3: Uses pseudo-labels from the Stage 2 model on all 1,608,060 TCGA-UT patches across six resolution scales (0.5-1.0 um/pixel). Segmentation outputs feed a structured TME feature extraction pipeline computing 20+ per-patch compositional, morphological, spatial entropy, and intercellular distance metrics. These are encoded as JSON and passed to a fine-tuned NVIDIA BioNeMo GPT model to generate clinically interpretable TME narratives. Preliminary validation on held-out PanNuke and TCGA-UT partitions demonstrates framework feasibility and internal consistency. The pseudo-labelled TCGA-UT dataset and UNI2-UPERHOVER checkpoint are publicly released to support large-scale TME profiling and spatial biology research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SEGTME-UNI2 框架，用于 H&E 染色组织病理学图像中的细胞分割、肿瘤微环境特征提取和临床报告生成。核心是 UNI2-UPERHOVER 双头分割模型，结合 UNI2-H 病理基础模型和两个 UperNet 解码器，通过三阶段渐进式伪标签课程训练。分割结果输入结构化特征提取流程，生成 JSON 格式特征，并由微调的 NVIDIA BioNeMo GPT 模型生成临床可解释的 TME 描述。初步验证表明框架可行且内部一致。
Motivation: 从常规 H&E 染色组织学图像表征肿瘤微环境需要同时进行细胞分割、特征提取和可解释的临床报告，现有方法缺乏统一的框架。
Method: 提出 SEGTME-UNI2 框架，核心 UNI2-UPERHOVER 模型使用 UNI2-H 基础模型与两个并行 UperNet 解码器，分别进行六类语义分割和水平-垂直梯度回归以实现基于分水岭的核实例分割。采用三阶段渐进式伪标签课程训练：阶段1使用人工标注 PanNuke，阶段2使用阶段1模型在 TCGA-UT 子集上生成的熵过滤伪标签，阶段3使用阶段2模型在全部 TCGA-UT 六尺度补丁上生成的伪标签。分割输出经特征提取得到 20+ 指标，编码为 JSON 后传入微调的 BioNeMo GPT 生成临床叙述。
Result: 摘要报告在保留的 PanNuke 和 TCGA-UT 分区上的初步验证证实了框架可行性和内部一致性。发布了伪标签 TCGA-UT 数据集和 UNI2-UPERHOVER 检查点。

papers.title: EComAgentBench: Benchmarking Shopping Agents on Long-Horizon Tasks with Distributed Hidden Intent
papers.abstract_en: As LLM-based shopping agents enter production, existing benchmarks fail to capture how a shopper's requirements arrive: stated implicitly in the query, recorded in a profile, or revealed only when the right question is asked. Benchmarks that expose full intent upfront and grade only the final choice can neither pose this long-horizon challenge nor explain which requirement an agent missed. To address this gap, we introduce EComAgentBench, a benchmark of 662 tasks grounded in real Amazon products and reviews. Each task scatters these requirements across a visible query, a tool-gated profile, and scripted clarification; an agent must uncover hidden intent, verify candidates against attributes and review evidence, and commit to a single product within 100 tool calls. Moreover, typed, source-tagged rubrics grade every task, attributing each failure to a requirement and its source. Construction is automated yet reliable, with every answer fixed in code before any text is generated and every sample validated. Our evaluation of seven models reveals that even the strongest attains only 57.1% overall accuracy, and rubric satisfaction degrades from visible to hidden sources. Overall, we believe EComAgentBench will serve as a reproducible foundation for moving shopping agents from single-query search toward dependable assistance over long horizons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EComAgentBench，一个基于真实亚马逊产品与评论的662个任务基准，用于评估基于LLM的购物代理在长时程任务中挖掘隐藏意图、验证候选产品并做出最终选择的能力。任务将需求分散在可见查询、工具门控的个人资料和脚本化澄清中，代理需在100次工具调用内完成。评估显示，最强模型仅达到57.1%的总体准确率，且评分从可见源到隐藏源逐渐下降。
Motivation: 现有基准无法模拟购物需求以隐含、分布形式出现的情况（如明示于查询、记录在个人资料或仅在提问后揭示），且仅评估最终选择，无法定位代理遗漏的具体需求。
Method: 自动化构建662个任务，每个任务将需求通过可见查询、工具门控个人资料和脚本化澄清三种来源分散呈现；代理需在100次工具调用内利用预定义工具集获取信息、验证候选产品；采用类型化、来源标记的评分标准，将每个失败归因于特定需求及其来源。
Result: 在七个LLM模型中，最强模型（如GPT-4系）的总体准确率最高为57.1%，且评分从可见源需求（约80%）到隐藏源需求（约30%）显著下降。
Conclusion: EComAgentBench为购物代理的长期可靠辅助提供了可重复的评估基础，揭示了当前模型在挖掘隐藏意图方面的显著不足，并指出了未来改进方向。

papers.title: FllumaOne: A Code-Native Multimodal CAD Dataset with Executable Programs and Kernel-Validated Feature Histories
papers.abstract_en: Parametric computer-aided design records both final geometry and the ordered construction history that determines how a part can be edited. Datasets for editable CAD research should therefore expose modeling operations, parameters, and feature dependencies together with validated geometry. We introduce FllumaOne, a code-native multimodal CAD dataset whose models are generated by executable Python programs in Flluma, a Qt/C++ OpenCASCADE-based CAD system. Each sample aligns its program with a structured feature tree, a training-oriented intermediate representation, STEP geometry, a surface point cloud, natural-language descriptions, metadata, and eight canonical visible-edge renderings. The primary release, FllumaOne-100K, contains 100,000 accepted samples across four template-level complexity regimes. Programs are executed and retained only after kernel geometry, solid validity, and export checks; release reports also record modality completeness and split-level duplicate tests. A Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B LoRA baseline trained on 80,000 samples achieves 99.98% Python syntax validity, 99.97% Flluma build success, and 99.14% STEP-export validity on the held-out 10,000-sample test split. For the 9,909 predictions converted to surface point clouds, the mean normalized Chamfer Distance is 0.002124. The dataset supports conditioned CAD reconstruction, executable program synthesis, feature-tree prediction, B-Rep analysis, retrieval, design completion, and editable reverse engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FllumaOne是一个代码原生的多模态CAD数据集，由可执行Python程序生成，每个样本包含程序、特征树、中间表示、STEP几何、点云、自然语言描述等多模态数据。主要发布FllumaOne-100K包含10万个样本，经过内核几何、实体有效性和导出检查。使用Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B LoRA基线训练，测试集上语法有效性99.98%，构建成功率99.97%，STEP导出有效性99.14%，点云平均归一化Chamfer距离0.002124。数据集支持CAD重建、程序合成、特征树预测等多种任务。
Motivation: 现有可编辑CAD数据集缺乏同时包含建模操作、参数和特征依赖以及验证几何的完整数据，FllumaOne填补了这一空白。
Method: 基于开源Qt/C++ OpenCASCADE CAD系统Flluma，生成可执行Python程序，每个样本经过内核几何、实体有效性和导出检查后保留，并提供多模态对齐数据：程序、特征树、中间表示、STEP几何、点云、文本、元数据及八视角渲染图。
Result: Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B LoRA基线在80,000样本训练后，测试集上语法有效性99.98%，构建成功率99.97%，STEP导出有效性99.14%，预测点云的平均归一化Chamfer距离为0.002124。
Conclusion: FllumaOne数据集可支持有条件的CAD重建、可执行程序合成、特征树预测、B-Rep分析、检索、设计补全和可编辑逆向工程。

papers.title: Delta-Based Target Reformulation for Short-Term Electricity Load Forecasting Using LSTM and Transformer Models
papers.abstract_en: Accurate short-term electricity load forecasting is critical for the reliable and economic operation of modern power systems, under non-stationarity arising from weather variability, calendar effects, and evolving consumption patterns. While deep learning models such as LSTMs and Transformers show promising performance, most existing studies focus on direct absolute load prediction without explicitly addressing target non-stationarity. Motivated by classical time-series differencing techniques in ARIMA models, this paper investigates a delta-based target reformulation for short-term electricity load forecasting using deep learning. Instead of directly predicting absolute load values, the proposed formulation trains models to predict the change in load between consecutive time steps, with final forecasts reconstructed using the last observed load. This aims to stabilize the learning target and reduce forecasting difficulty. Using multi-year, hourly real-world electricity load data from India, augmented with meteorological variables from the NASA POWER project and calendar features, this study evaluates LSTM and Transformer models under both formulations, benchmarking them against LightGBM. Experiments are conducted for hour-ahead and day-ahead horizons, assessing performance via Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE). Results show that delta-based reformulation consistently improves forecasting accuracy for hour-ahead prediction across all evaluated models, yielding MAPE reductions of over 50% compared to absolute formulations. For day-ahead forecasting, delta targets specifically benefit deep sequence models (LSTM and Transformer), while LightGBM remains competitive under the absolute formulation. These findings indicate that while delta reformulation is a powerful inductive bias for neural networks, its efficacy is model- and horizon-dependent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于差分（delta）的目标重构方法，用于短期电力负荷预测。与直接预测绝对负荷不同，模型预测相邻时间步的负荷变化，再通过最后观测负荷重构预测值。使用印度多年度小时级电力负荷数据、NASA POWER气象变量和日历特征，评估LSTM和Transformer模型，基准为LightGBM。结果表明，差分公式对提前一小时的预测在所有模型中均显著提升（MAPE降低超过50%），但对提前一天的预测仅有利于深度序列模型。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法直接预测绝对负荷，未显式处理非平稳性。受ARIMA差分技术启发，提出将预测目标从绝对负荷转为负荷变化，以稳定学习目标、降低预测难度。
Method: 提出差分目标重构（delta-based target reformulation）：训练LSTM或Transformer预测相邻时间步的负荷变化ΔL_t，最终预测值由上一观测负荷加上预测的变化得到。使用印度电力负荷数据，加入NASA POWER气象变量和日历特征，比较绝对预测和差分预测两种公式。
Result: 对于提前一小时预测，所有模型（LSTM、Transformer、LightGBM）在差分公式下MAPE降低超过50%。对于提前一天预测，差分公式仅提升LSTM和Transformer，LightGBM在绝对公式下更优。
Conclusion: 差分目标重构作为神经网络的归纳偏置有效，但其效果依赖于模型和预测时长。短时预测收益大，长时预测仅对深度序列模型有效。

papers.title: SuCo: Sufficiency-guided Continuous Adaptive Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Despite remarkable performance on complex tasks, Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often generate excessively long Chain-of-Thoughts (CoT), inflating computational costs even for simple queries. Existing efforts to mitigate this inefficiency typically rely on discrete reasoning modes or fixed budget tiers, lacking a principled criterion of when reasoning is sufficient. In this work, we introduce Minimal Sufficient CoT (MSC), defined as the shortest prefix of a CoT trajectory which is adequate for producing the correct answer. We empirically show that MSC not only reduces reasoning tokens, but also improves accuracy across difficulty levels. Building on MSC, we propose Sufficiency-guided Continuous Adaptive Reasoning (SuCo), a two-stage training framework for autonomous reasoning control along a continuous spectrum. In stage 1, MSC-Aligned Fine-Tuning (MFT) constructs MSC data using problem-adaptive sufficiency thresholds that naturally scale with question difficulty, then fine-tunes the model to internalize concise yet sufficient reasoning patterns. In stage 2, Sufficiency-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO) further optimizes the model through reinforcement learning with dynamic complexity tracking and sufficiency-aware rewards that penalize both over- and under-thinking. Extensive experiments across mathematics, code, and science benchmarks show that SuCo consistently achieves improvements in both accuracy and reasoning efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型推理模型（LRM）生成过长思考链（CoT）导致计算浪费的问题，提出了最小充分CoT（MSC）概念，并基于此设计了SuCo两阶段训练框架，包括MSC对齐微调（MFT）和充分性感知策略优化（SAPO）。实验表明，SuCo在数学、代码和科学基准上同时提升了准确率和推理效率。
Motivation: 现有LRM在简单查询上也生成冗长CoT，缺乏何时推理充分的准则，导致计算成本高。
Method: 提出MSC（正确回答所需的最短CoT前缀），并构建两阶段框架SuCo：阶段1用MFT（问题自适应充分性阈值生成MSC数据并微调），阶段2用SAPO（动态复杂度跟踪和充分性感知奖励的强化学习）。
Result: 在数学、代码和科学基准上，SuCo在准确率和推理效率上均取得一致提升。
Conclusion: 通过定义MSC并引导模型学习充分且简洁的推理路径，可有效平衡准确率与计算开销。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Geometrical fairness in graph neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based learning methods have become increasingly prominent due to their strong performance across diverse applications. Among these, recent frameworks grounded in diffusion processes provide a unifying perspective that extends traditional graph neural network formulations while addressing limitations of standard message-passing mechanisms. Despite these advances, concerns remain regarding the fairness of such models, as they may propagate or amplify biases present in the data. In this work, we introduce a fairness-aware adaptation of graph-based diffusion by modifying the underlying Laplacian operator. Our approach incorporates multiple complementary transformations, including subspace projections, spectral adjustments, and frequency-based filtering, to mitigate bias-related components. Leveraging the intrinsic smoothing properties of graph diffusion, we provide a principled analysis of the resulting behavior and establish theoretical insights into fairness properties. We evaluate the proposed framework on both synthetic and real-world datasets, demonstrating that it achieves competitive performance while improving fairness metrics with limited additional computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图扩散的公平性感知方法，通过修改拉普拉斯算子（包括子空间投影、谱调整和频率滤波）来减轻图神经网络中的偏差。理论分析表明该方法利用图扩散的平滑特性改善公平性，在合成和真实数据集上以有限额外计算成本取得竞争性能并提升公平性指标。
Motivation: 图神经网络可能传播或放大数据中的偏差，现有方法缺乏对图扩散过程中偏差成分的系统性抑制。
Method: 通过修改图扩散中的拉普拉斯算子，引入多种互补变换（子空间投影、谱调整、频率滤波），在扩散过程中抑制与偏差相关的成分。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，该方法在保持竞争性能的同时提升了公平性指标，且额外计算成本有限。
Conclusion: 利用图扩散的平滑特性可以提供公平性保障，为图神经网络的公平性学习提供理论支撑。

papers.title: EnvRL: Learn from Environment Dynamics in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for training Large Language Models (LLMs) as agents. However, conventional RL methods for long-horizon agentic tasks often struggle with sparse outcome rewards. Intuitively, this overlooks the rich environment dynamics information contained in rollout interaction trajectories. We argue that the interaction experience inherently serves as an implicit supervision signal, reveals the underlying transition mechanisms of the environment, and enables the agent to construct a more accurate internal model of the environment.. Therefore, in this work, we investigate how to leverage this additional signal to improve policy learning. Specifically, we propose EnvRL, a framework that incorporates environment dynamics learning into agentic RL via two auxiliary objectives: state prediction and inverse dynamics. By jointly optimizing with the primary RL objective, we encourage the agent to internalize environment dynamics from its own interaction experience. Extensive experiments on two long-horizon agentic benchmarks demonstrate that EnvRL achieves significant improvements on success-rates over RL-only baselines, e.g., when trained with GRPO, lifting Qwen-2.5-1.5B-Instruct from 72.8% to 77.4% on ALFWorld, and from 56.8% to 67.0% on WebShop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EnvRL框架，通过在agent强化学习中引入环境动力学学习（状态预测与逆动力学两个辅助目标），以利用交互轨迹中的丰富环境信息来提升策略学习。在ALFWorld和WebShop两个长周期agent基准上，EnvRL相比纯RL基线显著提高了成功率，如将Qwen-2.5-1.5B-Instruct在ALFWorld上从72.8%提升至77.4%。
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法在长周期agent任务中面临稀疏奖励问题，忽略了交互轨迹中蕴含的环境动力学信息，导致策略学习效率低下。
Method: 提出EnvRL框架，在主RL目标基础上联合优化状态预测和逆动力学两个辅助目标，使agent从自身交互经验中内化环境转移机制。
Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上，使用GRPO训练时，EnvRL将Qwen-2.5-1.5B-Instruct的成功率分别从72.8%提升至77.4%、从56.8%提升至67.0%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将环境动力学学习作为辅助任务可以有效提升长期agent任务中的策略学习效果，缓解稀疏奖励问题。

papers.title: See First, Answer Later: Visual Evidence Pre-Alignment via Sufficiency-Driven RL
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate strong text reasoning with visual inputs, yet their responses can be inconsistent with the underlying images, indicating ineffective utilization of visual evidence during inference. The prevailing training paradigm relies on large-scale caption-based pretraining for general alignment, followed by supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to enable instruction following and complex reasoning. However, such pretraining provides only weak visual grounding: short, coarse captions bias models toward salient objects while neglecting fine-grained visual evidence. In this paper, we introduce Visual Evidence Pre-Alignment (VEPA), an intermediate stage between pretraining and post-training that explores a novel sufficiency-driven objective with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to optimize question-conditioned visual evidence descriptions. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks show that our VEPA consistently enhances performance on visually demanding evaluations and complements standard supervised post-training. Further analyses show that the income stems from strengthened, transferable visual grounding, rather than from additional task-specific training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Visual Evidence Pre-Alignment (VEPA)，作为多模态大语言模型预训练与后训练之间的中间阶段，通过充足性驱动的目标函数结合 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 优化问题条件下的视觉证据描述。实验表明，VEPA 在多个视觉密集型基准上一致提升性能，且收益源于增强且可迁移的视觉接地，而非任务特定训练。
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型的预训练依赖粗粒度字幕，导致模型偏向显著物体而忽略细粒度视觉证据，造成响应与图像不一致。需要一种中间训练阶段来强化视觉接地的充分性。
Method: 提出 VEPA 框架，在预训练和后训练之间插入一个中间阶段，采用充足性驱动的奖励设计，并使用 GRPO 优化问题条件下的视觉证据描述，以生成更细粒度、与问题相关的视觉信息。
Result: 在多个视觉密集型基准（如需要细粒度视觉理解的评测）上，VEPA 一致提升模型性能，并能补充标准监督后训练。进一步分析表明，性能提升来自视觉接地能力的增强和迁移性，而非额外的任务特定训练。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 VEPA 作为中间训练阶段的有效性，通过优化视觉证据描述来增强多模态大语言模型的视觉接地，但未明确讨论方法在非视觉任务或极端数据下的局限性。

papers.title: Do We Really Need Diffusion? A Fast U-Net for Paired Medical Image Translation
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic resonance imaging-signal fat fraction (MRI-SFF) quantifies tissue fat and serves as an established biomarker for metabolic and musculoskeletal disorders. The acquisition requires, however, specialized MRI sequences, which are not available routinely. We investigate whether SFF can be estimated from widely available T2-weighted (T2w) MRI via image-to-image translation (I2I). We further compare a lightweight 4-level U-Net to a state-of-the-art Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) using a dataset of 230 048 paired 2D images (183 517 train, 23 621 val, 22 910 test) from the German National Cohort (NAKO). Both models clearly outperform the identity baseline (Pearson correlation r = 0.769, mean absolute error MAE = 0.070 +/- 0.054), which confirms that the models learn a non-trivial cross-modal mapping. Interestingly, the lightweight U-Net outperforms the DDPM in both correlation (r = 0.975 vs. 0.962) and error (MAE = 0.014 +/- 0.015 vs. 0.019 +/- 0.019), while reducing inference time by a factor of 208 (25.2 ms vs. 5 227.2 ms per image using 50 Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model (DDIM) steps). The strong clinical performance at substantially reduced computational cost enables real-time clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从常规T2加权MRI估计脂肪分数（SFF）的图像翻译任务，比较轻量级4层U-Net与Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model（DDPM）。在230048对2D图像（来自德国国家队列NAKO）上，U-Net在相关性（r=0.975 vs 0.962）和误差（MAE=0.014±0.015 vs 0.019±0.019）上均优于DDPM，且推理速度快208倍（25.2 ms vs 5227.2 ms每图像），实现了临床实时可用。
Motivation: SFF是代谢和肌肉骨骼疾病的生物标志物，但需要专用MRI序列，临床普及受限。本文探索从广泛可用的T2加权MRI估计SFF，避免对专用序列的依赖。
Method: 对比轻量级4层U-Net与DDPM进行图像到图像翻译（I2I），使用230048对2D图像（183517训练，23621验证，22910测试），评估指标为Pearson相关系数和平均绝对误差（MAE）。
Result: 轻量级U-Net在测试集上取得r=0.975、MAE=0.014±0.015，优于DDPM的r=0.962、MAE=0.019±0.019；推理时间U-Net为25.2 ms/图像，DDPM（50步DDIM）为5227.2 ms/图像，加速208倍。
Conclusion: 轻量级U-Net在准确性和速度上均超越扩散模型，且计算成本大幅降低，适合实时临床部署。

papers.title: ASTEROID: A Spatiotemporal Information Transformer for Forecasting Multi-Step Time Series of Molecular Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulation is computationally demanding, particularly for large-scale systems requiring long-term analysis. Accurate forecast of the outcomes of a MD simulation is not only an attractive scientific challenge but also has substantial practical value. In this work, we developed a data-driven framework, termed ASTEROID (Advanced Spatiotemporal TransformER fOr Inferring Dynamics), that can directly predict multi-step atomic coordinates, avoiding conventional iterative integration. For this purpose, our ASTEROID reformulates MD trajectories as high-dimensional spatiotemporal sequences and integrates the Spatiotemporal Information (STI) Transformation equation into a Transformer architecture. The core innovation of ASTEROID lies in its ability to model multiscale spatiotemporal dependencies. In particular, for spatial dependencies, a local-global self-attention mechanism captures both short- and long-range interactions. For temporal dependencies, an encoder-decoder structure integrates global context with autoregressive forecasting. ASTEROID was evaluated on several quantum-mechanics derived molecular datasets. Our results indicate that ASTEROID achieved not only a higher level of accuracy in multi-step prediction than existing methods on various benchmarks, but also significantly reduced computational cost of conventional MD simulation. Moreover, the model supports iterative multi-step forecasting over an extended time scale. This work establishes a robust and generalizable data-driven paradigm for accelerating MD simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为ASTEROID的数据驱动框架，将分子动力学轨迹重构为高维时空序列，并利用时空信息变换方程与Transformer架构，直接预测多步原子坐标，避免传统迭代积分。在量子力学分子数据集上，ASTEROID在多步预测精度上优于现有方法，并显著降低计算成本。
Motivation: 分子动力学模拟计算成本高，尤其对于大规模系统长期分析。现有方法需要迭代积分，效率低。本文旨在开发一个可以直接预测多步原子坐标的数据驱动框架，加速MD模拟。
Method: ASTEROID框架将MD轨迹视为高维时空序列，融合时空信息变换方程到Transformer中。空间依赖采用局部-全局自注意力机制捕获短程和长程相互作用；时间依赖采用编码器-解码器结构结合全局上下文与自回归预测。
Result: 在多个量子力学分子数据集上，ASTEROID在多步预测精度上优于现有方法，并显著降低了传统MD模拟的计算成本。支持长时间尺度的迭代多步预测。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了一个鲁棒且可泛化的数据驱动范式，用于加速分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Handling Feature Heterogeneity with Learnable Graph Patches
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, the rapid development of foundation models and graph pre-training technologies has spurred increasing interest in constructing a universal pre-trained graph model or Graph Foundation Model (GFM). However, a significant challenge is that existing models are unable to address feature heterogeneity in graph data without textual information, which hinders the transferability of graph models across different datasets. To bridge this gap, we propose the concept of learnable graph patches, which we regard as the smallest semantic units of any graph data. We decompose the graph into learnable graph patches by unfolding the node features and constructing corresponding patch structures separately. We then design a framework that mines transferable information from graph data across domains. Specifically, after extracting graph patches, we propose a patch encoder to extract knowledge from each unit and a patch aggregator to learn how the units are combined into a whole. Due to its domain-agnostic nature, the model can be applied to downstream data across different domains. Furthermore, we analyze the connection between our method and existing graph models, as well as the transferability of the node embeddings it generates. Empirically, our method not only achieves the capability to use multi-domain graphs for pre-training, but also shows enhanced performance across various downstream datasets and tasks. Moreover, we observe consistent improvement in downstream performance as the volume of pre-training data increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可学习图块（learnable graph patches）的概念，将其作为图数据的最小语义单元，通过展开节点特征并构建对应的块结构来分解图，再利用块编码器和块聚合器提取跨域可迁移知识，从而解决缺乏文本信息的图数据中的特征异质性（feature heterogeneity）问题，支持多域图预训练。实验表明该方法在下游数据集和任务上表现提升，且预训练数据量增加时性能一致改进。
Motivation: 现有图模型无法处理缺乏文本信息的图数据的特征异质性，限制了图模型在不同数据集间的可迁移性，阻碍了通用预训练图模型或图基础模型的构建。
Method: 提出可学习图块作为最小语义单元，通过展开节点特征并构造对应的块结构将图分解为多个图块；设计一个框架，包括块编码器（patch encoder）提取每个单元的知识，以及块聚合器（patch aggregator）学习如何将单元组合成整体，从而挖掘跨域可迁移信息。
Result: 该方法实现了多域图数据预训练的能力，在多种下游数据集和任务上表现出增强的性能，并且随着预训练数据量的增加，下游性能持续提升。
Conclusion: 该方法具有领域无关性，可应用于不同领域的下游数据；论文还分析了该方法与现有图模型的联系以及生成节点嵌入的可迁移性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FacProcessTwin: An LLM-Based System for Process Twin Development
papers.abstract_en: Process twins provide real-time representations of entire production processes. By capturing how process steps interact, rather than monitoring a single machine in isolation as an asset-based digital twin does, they have the potential to drive efficiency gains across the whole process. However, developing a process twin is costly. It requires accurately modelling the entire production process: its process steps, the equipment and product-specific settings each step uses, and its process variations. The resulting model must then be bound to live operational data. We present FacProcessTwin, a system that leverages a large language model (LLM) to reduce this development time, building a process twin from a plant's process documentation and natural-language input from an operator. FacProcessTwin generates this complete process model and then automatically binds its process steps to live operational data. The generated model and its data bindings are rendered as an interactive process diagram through which manufacturing personnel can monitor and correct the system's autonomous decisions, such as resolving uncertainty at safety-critical binding steps. We evaluate FacProcessTwin through a real-world case study of an Australian food manufacturer, covering 16 production process flows that span chilled, frozen, and aseptic shelf-stable product categories and include process variations within the same product. The results show that FacProcessTwin generates these process models accurately (a mean F1 of 95.2% against ground truth) and builds each twin in roughly a sixth of the manual time. Its human-in-the-loop governance then keeps the safety-critical bindings correct: at ambiguous tags where a single-pass baseline silently mis-binds 75.0% of the time, FacProcessTwin defers to the operator and mis-binds none.

papers.title: Non-asymptotic Tail Bounds for the Kostlan--Shub--Smale Field: Tensor PCA and Spherical $k$-Spin Complexity
papers.abstract_en: This paper builds a hierarchy of explicit, non-asymptotic tail bounds for the supremum of the Kostlan--Shub--Smale (KSS) random field on the sphere, and applies it to two problems: Spiked Tensor PCA and the landscape of the spherical $k$-spin model. For Tensor PCA, we study the non-asymptotic statistical limits of estimating a rank-$R$ symmetric signal tensor of order~$k\ge 3$ and dimension~$d\ge 3$ from a single Gaussian observation at signal-to-noise ratio~$λ$, through the \emph{profile maximum likelihood estimator}, the MLE restricted to normalized rank-$R$ tensors of coherence at least~$κ$. Our analysis uses a single reduction: a deterministic geometric inequality (the Tube Method) and a rank-reduction step bound the estimation error by the supremum of the canonical KSS field, which the Kac--Rice formula turns into a Gaussian integral against the expected absolute characteristic polynomial of a shifted Gaussian Orthogonal Ensemble, controlled in turn by the four explicit tail bounds of our hierarchy (three from a Mehta--Fyodorov representation, one from a Ben Arous--Dembo--Guionnet large deviation). The same reduction yields two results, each with explicit constants. For estimation, a finite-$(k,d)$ error bound recovers the asymptotically optimal rate~$\sqrt{d\log k}$ of Perry, Wein and Bandeira, with explicit dependence on the rank~$R$ and the coherence~$κ$. For the landscape, a two-sided non-asymptotic bracketing of the annealed complexity of the spherical $k$-spin Hamiltonian recovers the Auffinger--Ben Arous--Černý complexity function in the high-dimensional limit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立了球面上Kostlan-Shub-Smale (KSS)随机场上确界的显式非渐近尾界层级，并将其应用于Spiked Tensor PCA（尖峰张量PCA）和球面k-自旋模型复杂度景观。对于Tensor PCA，通过profile最大似然估计研究非渐近统计极限，恢复渐近最优速率√(d log k)，并显式依赖秩R和相干性κ。对于景观，恢复高维极限下的Auffinger-Ben Arous-Černý复杂度函数。
Motivation: 需要非渐近的尾界来理解随机张量问题的统计极限和自旋玻璃模型的复杂性，现有结果多为渐近或缺乏显式常数。
Method: 使用确定性几何不等式（Tube方法）和秩约简步骤，将估计误差归约为典范KSS场的上确界，通过Kac-Rice公式转化为高斯积分，再借助Mehta-Fyodorov表示和Ben Arous-Dembo-Guionnet大偏差得到四个显式尾界。
Result: 对于估计，有限维误差界恢复渐近最优速率√(d log k)，显式依赖秩R和相干性κ；对于景观，球面k-自旋哈密顿量的退火复杂度的双侧非渐近括回恢复了高维极限下的复杂度函数。
Conclusion: 本文提供了显式非渐近尾界，统一处理了张量PCA和球面自旋模型中的两个问题，并给出了显式常数。

papers.title: Temporal Preference Optimization for Unsupervised Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised dense retrievers offer scalability by learning semantic similarity from unlabeled documents via contrastive learning, but they struggle to capture the temporal relevance, retrieving semantically related but temporally misaligned documents-an important aspect when a document collection spans multiple time periods (e.g., retrieving documents from 2018-2025 for "Who is the president in 2019?" introduces temporal ambiguity). Existing methods rely on supervised training with explicit timestamps, which are not always feasible. We propose TPOUR (Temporal Preference Optimization for Unsupervised Retriever), which uses our novel training method Temporal Retrieval Preference Optimization (TRPO). TRPO reinterprets preference learning in the temporal dimension, guiding the retriever to favor temporally aligned documents. TPOUR further generalizes to unseen time periods via interpolation in a learned time embedding, enabling continuous temporal alignment. Experiments on temporal information retrieval (T-IR), TPOUR outperforms both unsupervised and supervised baselines. Compared to Qwen-Embedding-8B, despite being about 72.7x smaller, TPOUR Contriever improves average nDCG@5 by +4.04 (+12.15%) on explicit and +4.98 (+15.21%) on implicit queries. We provide our code at https://github.com/agwaBom/TPOUR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TPOUR 方法，通过时间检索偏好优化（TRPO）让无监督密集检索器捕捉时间相关性，无需显式时间戳监督，在时间信息检索任务上超越有监督基线，且模型小72.7倍但性能更好。
Motivation: 无监督密集检索器通过对比学习学习语义相似性，但难以捕捉时间相关性，导致检索出语义相关但时间不匹配的文档。现有方法依赖带显式时间戳的监督训练，不总是可行。
Method: 提出 TPOUR，核心是时间检索偏好优化（TRPO），将偏好学习重新解释在时间维度上，引导检索器偏爱时间对齐的文档。通过插值学习到的时间嵌入泛化到未见时间段，实现连续时间对齐。
Result: 在时间信息检索（T-IR）任务上，TPOUR 超越无监督和有监督基线。相比 Qwen-Embedding-8B，尽管模型小约72.7倍，TPOUR Contriever 在显式查询上平均 nDCG@5 提升 +4.04 (+12.15%)，在隐式查询上提升 +4.98 (+15.21%)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调无监督方法也能有效捕捉时间相关性，且通过时间嵌入插值可泛化到未见时间。

papers.title: TuneAhead: Predicting Fine-tuning Performance Before Full Training Begins
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) is compute-intensive and error-prone: model performance depends sensitively on data quality and hyperparameter choices, and naïve runs can even degrade model performance. This raises a practical question:can we predict fine-tuning performance before committing to a full training run? We present TUNEAHEAD, a lightweight framework for pre-hoc prediction of fine-tuning performance. TUNEAHEAD encodes each candidate run as a meta-feature vector that combines static dataset descriptors with dynamic probe features from a short standardized probe. A predictor maps these features to performance estimates, while SHAP-based attributions provide interpretable diagnostics that reveal which specific features drive the prediction. Across 1,300+ fine-tuning runs on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, TUNEAHEAD consistently outperforms strong baselines such as Early-Stop Extrapolation and ProxyLM. On a held-out test set of 370 runs, TUNEAHEAD achieves an RMSE of 1.47 percentage points and places 95.1% of predictions within +3/-3 percentage points of the true score. These accurate continuous predictions support practical go/no-go screening policies that can reduce unnecessary full fine-tuning while retaining most promising runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TUNEAHEAD，一种轻量级框架，通过在标准化短探测中提取元特征向量来预测大型语言模型微调性能，无需完整训练。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的 1,300+ 次运行上，TUNEAHEAD 优于 Early-Stop Extrapolation 和 ProxyLM 等基线，在 370 次测试中 RMSE 为 1.47 个百分点，95.1% 的预测误差在 ±3 个百分点内。
Motivation: 微调大型语言模型计算密集且对数据质量和超参数敏感，盲目运行可能降低性能，需要一种方法在完全投入训练前预测微调效果。
Method: TUNEAHEAD 将每个候选微调运行编码为元特征向量，结合静态数据集描述符和来自短标准化探测的动态探测特征，通过预测器映射到性能估计，并使用 SHAP 归因提供可解释的诊断。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上，TUNEAHEAD 在 370 次测试集上达到 RMSE 为 1.47 个百分点，95.1% 的预测落在真实值的 ±3 个百分点内，优于 Early-Stop Extrapolation 和 ProxyLM。
Conclusion: TUNEAHEAD 的准确连续预测支持实用的是/否筛选策略，可减少不必要的全微调，同时保留最有希望的运行。

papers.title: Physics-Constrained Neural Networks for Improved Short-Term Weather Forecasting: A Case Study over the South Pacific
papers.abstract_en: This study introduces enhancements to physics-constrained neural networks (PCNNs) that improve the accuracy and stability of hybrid short-term weather forecasting models. Building on the WeatherGFT architecture, three innovations are proposed. First, an upgraded numerical solver, combining a fifth-order weighted essentially non-oscillatory scheme (WENO-5), a beta-plane approximation, and subgrid-scale viscosity, permits a fourfold increase in the integration time step to 1200 s while reducing the daily mean squared error by up to 26%. Second, a unified autoregressive hybrid block replaces the original chain of 24 specialised modules, eliminating overfitting to specific lead times. Third, the physical core is integrated with two state-of-the-art neural backbones, resulting in PI-PredFormer and PI-IAM4VP. Evaluation on the WeatherBench South Pacific subset from 2000 to 2004 shows that these hybrids reduce root mean squared error at 1-12 h lead times by 8-22% compared to purely neural counterparts, while better preserving physical consistency. These results demonstrate that incremental refinement of hybrid components offers a practical route toward more accurate and efficient short-range weather forecasting.
papers.comment: Presented at ICLR 2026 Workshop AI and PDE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出物理约束神经网络（PCNN）的改进，基于WeatherGFT架构，通过升级数值求解器（WENO-5、beta平面近似、亚网格黏性）将积分步长增至1200秒，日均误差降低26%；统一自回归混合块消除过拟合；集成两个神经骨干（PI-PredFormer和PI-IAM4VP）。在WeatherBench南太平洋子集上，1-12小时预报的RMSE比纯神经网络降低8-22%，同时保持物理一致性。
Motivation: 短期天气预报的混合模型常因数值求解器效率低和过拟合特定预报时效而精度不足，需在保持物理约束的前提下提升准确性和计算效率。
Method: 在WeatherGFT中引入三项改进：五阶WENO-5格式结合β平面近似和亚网格黏度的数值求解器；统一自回归混合块替代24个专用模块；将物理核与两个最新神经骨干（Transformer和IAM4VP）集成。
Result: 积分步长从300秒增至1200秒（四倍），日均MSE降低26%；1-12小时预报RMSE比纯神经网络低8-22%，且物理一致性更优。
Conclusion: 渐进改进混合组件的数值求解器和神经骨干可实用地提升短期天气预报的精度和效率，但仅在南太平洋区域验证，需推广至全球。

papers.title: Using Cognitive Models to Improve Language Model Simulation of Human Persuasion Games
papers.abstract_en: People make decisions differently in strategic interactions. Some update beliefs like a Bayesian; others exhibit biases like motivated reasoning. Although creators of large language models use simulated humans for safety evaluations and training, they often fail to cover this breadth of human behavior. We argue that cognitive science and economics provide a convenient tool for doing so, making use of mathematical models of human decision-making. We propose an approach that we call Equation-to-Behavior Prompting for guiding large language models to match cognitive models, and evaluate this approach on persuasion games based on legal decision-making. We find that large models can approximate equation-based specifications -- Bayesian updating, affine distortion, motivated updating, and Grether's $α$-$β$ model -- using prompting, but small models fail to do so. However, training small models with reinforcement learning to adhere to mathematical rules, Equation-to-Behavior RL, reduces belief error by 26.5% in out-of-distribution parameterizations. We show that these simulations can help create diverse training environments; training small models to consider different kinds of decision-makers improves average belief change by 2.5%--12% over Bayesian-only training, even when persuading GPT-5-mini. Our work could improve human simulations for training and evaluation in increasingly realistic settings, and could also enable novel research into more complicated mathematical models of human decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将认知模型（如贝叶斯更新、动机推理等）融入大语言模型，以更好地模拟人类在说服游戏中的行为。通过“等式到行为提示”（Equation-to-Behavior Prompting）和强化学习方法，使模型匹配数学决策模型，并在基于法律决策的说服游戏中验证。
Motivation: 当前大语言模型在模拟人类行为时未能涵盖人类在策略互动中的多样性（如贝叶斯更新或动机推理），而认知科学和经济学提供了现成的数学模型来填补这一空白。
Method: 提出“等式到行为提示”方法，引导大语言模型匹配贝叶斯更新、仿射扭曲、动机更新和Grether的α-β模型等数学规范；同时训练小型模型采用强化学习（Equation-to-Behavior RL）以遵循数学规则。
Result: 大型模型能通过提示近似等式规范，但小型模型失败；而强化学习可使小型模型在分布外参数化下信念误差降低26.5%。此外，训练小型模型考虑多种决策者类型可将平均信念变化提升2.5%–12%（即使面对GPT-5-mini）。
Conclusion: 该方法能改善实际场景中的人机交互训练与评估，并促进对更复杂人类决策数学模型的研究。

papers.title: MambaCount: Efficient Text-guided Open-vocabulary Object Counting with Spatial Sparse State Space Duality Block
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided Open-vocabulary Object Counting (TOOC) aims to estimate the number of objects described by text prompts, which is particularly challenging in dense scenes with large scale variations. Existing TOOC approaches predominantly rely on Transformers, whose quadratic complexity with respect to image resolution limits their scalability. Mamba offers a promising alternative due to its linear complexity. However, previous Mamba-based methods have two main limitations. On the one hand, the inherent causal formulation of Mamba constrains the bidirectional spatial dependency modeling required by non-causal vision tasks. On the other hand, existing Mamba-based vision models often overlook the unconstrained high entropy in the spatial token responses, which can weaken local details and high-frequency cues. To address these limitations, we propose MambaCount, an efficient framework built on the Spatial Sparse State Space Duality (S^4D) block. Specifically, we analyze and reconstruct the decay dynamics of hidden states in Mamba to alleviate the dependency constraints introduced by causal modeling. Moreover, we introduce a Spatial Token Selection (STS) sub-block to reduce the unconstrained high entropy in spatial token responses within Mamba. In addition, we design Multi-Granularity Prototypes (MGP) to identify object-like regions at different semantic levels, improving cross-modal alignment and interpretability. Extensive experiments on FSC-147 demonstrate that MambaCount achieves state-of-the-art performance among methods without secondary querying, obtaining a test MAE of 12.23, while retaining linear complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MambaCount是一个基于状态空间模型（Mamba）的文本引导开放词汇目标计数框架。它通过空间稀疏状态空间对偶（S^4D）块改进Mamba的因果建模约束，并引入空间令牌选择（STS）子块降低高熵干扰，同时设计多粒度原型（MGP）提升跨模态对齐。在FSC-147数据集上，MambaCount在无需二次查询的方法中取得测试MAE 12.23的当前最佳性能，且保持线性复杂度。
Motivation: 现有文本引导开放词汇目标计数（TOOC）方法多依赖Transformer，其二次复杂度限制了高分辨率场景的扩展性；而Mamba虽有线性复杂度，但其因果结构不适合非因果视觉任务，且现有Mamba视觉模型忽视空间令牌响应中的高熵问题，导致局部细节和高频信息丢失。
Method: 提出MambaCount框架，核心是S^4D块：通过分析和重构Mamba隐藏状态的衰减动态来缓解因果建模的依赖约束；引入空间令牌选择（STS）子块降低空间令牌响应中的高熵；设计多粒度原型（MGP）在不同语义层级识别物体区域，改善跨模态对齐与可解释性。
Result: 在FSC-147数据集上，MambaCount在无需二次查询的方法中达到测试MAE 12.23，为当前最优，且保持线性复杂度。
Conclusion: MambaCount通过改进Mamba的因果建模并处理高熵问题，实现了高效、可扩展的开放词汇目标计数，性能优于现有方法。

papers.title: A Risk Decomposition Framework for Pre-Hoc Fine-Tuning Prediction
papers.abstract_en: The high cost of fine-tuning LLMs poses a significant economic barrier; pre-hoc performance prediction offers a critical solution to substantially reduce this expense. However, the theoretical limits of pre-hoc performance prediction remain unexplored. We formulate it as a stochastic estimation problem under information constraints, decomposing prediction risk into two components: an intrinsic limit (static data-model compatibility) and a reducible optimization variance. We prove that optimization variance admits a necessary lower bound on its decay rate, implying fundamental constraints on how quickly uncertainty dissipates, regardless of the predictor used. Based on these dynamics, we derive a budget-optimal probing principle and introduce a predictability phase diagram that organizes tasks into three distinct regimes: Static-Sufficient, Dynamic-Critical, and Noise-Dominant. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks validate these theoretical regimes and demonstrate the efficiency of our probing strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型微调前的性能预测问题，提出一个风险分解框架。将预测风险分解为内在极限（静态数据-模型兼容性）和可优化方差，并证明优化方差衰减率存在必要下界，从而揭示预测不确定性消散的基本约束。基于此推导出预算最优探测原理，并引入可预测性相图将任务划分为静态充分、动态临界和噪声主导三个区域。在合成和真实基准上的实验验证了理论区域的有效性。
Motivation: 微调大语言模型成本高昂，预前性能预测可显著降低费用，但该问题的理论极限尚未被探索。
Method: 将预前性能预测形式化为信息约束下的随机估计问题，将预测风险分解为静态数据-模型兼容性和可优化方差，证明优化方差衰减率的下界，据此提出预算最优探测原理和可预测性相图。
Result: 在合成和真实基准上验证了理论预测的三个相区域（静态充分、动态临界、噪声主导），并展示了所提探测策略的效率。
Conclusion: 该框架揭示了预前性能预测的基本约束，提供了基于理论指导的预算最优探测策略，有助于降低微调成本。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Brewing to Resolution: Tracing the Internal Lifecycle of Code Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Standard accuracy metrics cannot explain why LLMs handle variable tracking but fail on semantically equivalent loops. We study an internal lifecycle of code reasoning in which models first brew the answer, making it linearly recoverable many layers before it becomes self-decodable, and then diverge into one of four resolution outcomes: Resolved, Overprocessed, Misresolved, or Unresolved. Understanding this lifecycle matters because similar task accuracies can mask fundamentally different failure modes that surface-level evaluation cannot detect. We introduce a dual diagnostic framework pairing layer-wise linear probing with Context-Stripped Decoding (CSD) and apply it to six code-reasoning task families across 16 models spanning Qwen, Llama, and DeepSeek architectures. All four outcomes carry substantial mass in every task family: overall Resolved is only 41.5%, with multiple tasks below 30%. Controlled sweeps over structure, depth, and operators expose task-specific failure bottlenecks: Function Call Resolved plunges from 61.1% to 2.5% as call depth increases from one to three. Across architectures and scales, the brewing scaffold remains stable, with normalized brewing duration 24-42% across all 16 models, while resolution success varies with capability. This indicates that the scaffold is a stable empirical regularity across the tested decoder-only Transformer families, whereas resolution success covaries with capability, scale, and training. Code: https://github.com/euyis1019/llm-brewing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLMs）在代码推理中的内部生命周期，发现模型首先“酝酿”（brew）答案，使其在多个层中线性可恢复，然后分化为四种解决结果：已解决、过度处理、错误解决或未解决。作者引入双重诊断框架（层间线性探测与上下文剥离解码CSD），对Qwen、Llama和DeepSeek等16个模型的六个代码推理任务族进行分析，发现Resolved仅占41.5%，且所有结果类别均有显著分布。代码推理内部生命周期的理解揭示了表面准确率无法检测的失败模式。
Motivation: 标准准确率指标无法解释LLMs为何能处理变量跟踪但在语义等价的循环上失败。理解内部生命周期很重要，因为相似的任务准确率可能掩盖根本不同的失败模式。
Method: 提出双重诊断框架，结合层间线性探测与上下文剥离解码（CSD），应用于六个代码推理任务族和16个不同架构的模型。
Result: 在所有任务族中，四种结果均具有显著比例，整体Resolved仅为41.5%，多个任务低于30%。函数调用的Resolved率随调用深度从1层增加到3层而从61.1%骤降至2.5%。酝酿支架（brewing scaffold）在所有16个模型中保持稳定，归一化酝酿持续时间在24-42%之间，而解决成功率随能力变化。
Conclusion: 该支架在测试的仅解码器Transformer族中是一个稳定的经验规律，而解决成功与能力、规模和训练共变。论文强调了表面级评估无法检测的不同失败模式。

papers.title: SketchXplain: Intuitive Visual Explanations of Image Classifiers with Sketches
papers.abstract_en: Saliency map visualizations explain image-based AI predictions by pointing to regions, but these are often unintuitive and semantically unclear, leaving an interpretability gap. We argue that AI explanations should be intuitive -- coherent to user knowledge, yet simple and selective to accelerate interpretation. Inspired by artistic drawings, we propose SketchXplain to generate sketch-based visual explanations for intuitive image-based explainable AI (XAI). Combining techniques in saliency maps, concept-bottleneck models, and sketch optimization, SketchXplain integrates saliency to select coherent observation artifacts, concepts for knowledge coherence, cues to represent them, and abstraction for simplicity. Evaluating on face expression recognition, modeling and user studies showed that SketchXplain supported quicker interpretation with more aligned visualizations than saliency maps or simple drawings. Further evaluation on skin lesion diagnosis found that SketchXplain more coherently visualized disease symptoms, better supporting lay diagnosis. Thus, this work illustrates the value of sketches for intuitive, simple, coherent, and quick image-based XAI visualizations.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to TVCG
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SketchXplain，一种基于草图的图像分类器可视化解释方法，旨在提供直观、简洁且语义连贯的 AI 解释。结合显著图、概念瓶颈模型和草图优化，该方法生成保留关键特征的抽象草图。在人脸表情识别和皮肤病变诊断任务上的用户研究表明，相比于显著图或简单图形，SketchXplain 支持更快且更一致的解读。
Motivation: 现有显著图解释缺乏语义清晰度，用户难以直观理解，存在可解释性鸿沟。作者认为 AI 解释应直观、连贯且简洁。
Method: 结合显著图选择连贯观察区域、概念瓶颈模型确保知识连贯、线索表示和抽象简化，通过优化生成草图。
Result: 在人脸表情识别任务中，SketchXplain 比显著图或简单图形支持更快的解读且更一致；在皮肤病变诊断中，能更连贯地可视化疾病症状。
Conclusion: 草图在图像 XAI 中具有价值，能提供直观、简单、连贯且快速的解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Domains: Reusing Web Skills via Transferable Interaction Patterns
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) web agents are usually deployed as tool callers: each turn, the model reads a fresh page observation and emits one structured tool action. When every action is a low-level primitive, horizons grow quickly and so do policy-facing LLM completions, dominating latency and cost on benchmarks such as Mind2Web and WebArena. Recent systems therefore wrap repeated interaction fragments as web skills: callable tools built from successful trajectories or induced programs, so one call can replace several primitives. However, prior skill libraries are still triggered mainly by instruction similarity or coarse site metadata, which yields low skill reuse on held-out sites and leaves much of the potential step and token reduction on the table. We present SkillMigrator, an agent that learns reusable web skills and transfers them across sites by matching layout structure rather than specific element references. Each induced skill is stored as a transferable interaction pattern (TIP): the skill paired with a structural sketch of the snapshot at induction time. At test time, SkillMigrator retrieves TIPs by layout similarity and grounds their references on the live page. The rest of the stack is standard: accessibility-snapshot observations with stable references, and fixed tool calling over primitives plus skill invocations. Compared with the state-of-the-art approaches, SkillMigrator reduces the average LLM-action count on successful trajectories by 8-10% across both WebArena and Mind2Web at matched success rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出SkillMigrator，通过布局结构匹配实现web技能跨站点迁移，将技能存储为可迁移交互模式（TIP），测试时基于布局相似性检索并接地。在WebArena和Mind2Web上，在匹配的成功率下，平均LLM动作次数减少8-10%。
Motivation: 现有web智能体跨站点时技能复用率低，主要依赖指令相似性或站点元数据，导致步骤和token冗余。
Method: 将技能存储为可迁移交互模式（TIP），包含技能和诱导时的结构草图；测试时通过布局相似性检索TIP并在当前页面接地。
Result: 在WebArena和Mind2Web上，在匹配的成功率下，平均LLM动作次数减少8-10%。

papers.title: Bounding Box Label Propagation for Re-Annotation of Document Layout Analysis Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Datasets in practical document processing scenarios typically grow over time, and their class annotations undergo continuous refinement. This creates significant re-annotation efforts, which are time-consuming and costly. A promising remedy is to re-annotate only a small subset of available documents manually and apply semi-supervised learning techniques that leverage both labelled and unlabelled data. Although there are numerous approaches to tackle this problem for classification, there exists no adaptation for the problem of re-classifying object detection instances, e.g. for document layout analysis. To this end, we propose Bounding Box Label Propagation (BBLP), a pseudo-labelling framework for object detection. An object encoder integrates visual, textual, and positional embeddings from object detection samples to come up with a joint embedding that can be used for Label Propagation on partially annotated datasets in a plug-and-play fashion. Evaluation results indicate that the proposed approach produces high-quality class annotations of bounding boxes. In the D4LA layout analysis dataset, it achieves a mAP of 54.0%, corresponding to 81.6% of fully supervised performance, while using only 10% labelled data. Our work demonstrates the potential of Label Propagation for object detection and lays the groundwork for reducing manual annotation efforts in real-world document processing applications.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, to appear in proceedings of ICDAR 2026, Vienna, Austria
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出边界框标签传播（BBLP），一种用于文档布局分析数据集重标注的伪标签框架。该框架通过融合视觉、文本和位置嵌入的对象编码器，在仅使用10%标注数据时达到完全监督性能的81.6% mAP，显著降低人工标注成本。
Motivation: 文档处理数据集随时间增长且类别标注不断更新，导致高昂的重标注成本。现有半监督方法主要针对分类问题，缺乏对目标检测实例重分类（如文档布局分析）的适配。
Method: 提出BBLP框架：利用对象编码器融合目标检测样本的视觉、文本和位置嵌入，生成联合嵌入；基于该嵌入在部分标注数据集上进行标签传播（Label Propagation），以插件式方式为未标注边界框生成伪标签。
Result: 在D4LA布局分析数据集上，仅用10%标注数据即达到54.0% mAP，相当于完全监督性能的81.6%。
Conclusion: 工作展示了标签传播在目标检测中的潜力，为减少真实文档处理应用中的手动标注奠定了基础。

papers.title: FinAcumen: Financial Multimodal Reasoning via Self-Evolving Experience Memory Harness
papers.abstract_en: Financial multimodal reasoning requires agents to coordinate numerical computation, retrieval, visual interpretation, and temporal grounding across heterogeneous evidence sources. Existing tool-augmented agents improve execution fidelity, yet remain largely stateless across episodes, repeatedly rediscovering reasoning strategies and failure patterns. In high-stakes financial settings, this leads to unreliable tool routing, noisy retrieval, and hallucination-prone reasoning. We present FinAcumen, a financial reasoning agent framework centered on selective experience memory for tool-augmented multimodal reasoning. FinAcumen accumulates financially grounded reasoning experience from prior trajectories, distilling successful strategies and failure-derived cautionary rules into a persistent memory bank. During inference, retrieved experiences condition reasoning only when semantic relevance exceeds a calibrated threshold, while irrelevant memory is explicitly suppressed through a fallback mechanism. A deterministic financial tool environment further grounds numerical computation, retrieval, visual decoding, and answer verification.Across four financial multimodal reasoning benchmarks, FinAcumen consistently improves a frozen 8B vision-language model over finance-specialized models and approaches leading proprietary general-purpose models. Further analysis shows that selective experience activation improves reasoning reliability under retrieval uncertainty. Our code is anonymously available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FinAcumen
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FinAcumen 是一个面向金融多模态推理的代理框架，通过选择性经验记忆 (selective experience memory) 增强工具增强推理。它从历史轨迹中提取成功策略和失败规则存入持久记忆库，推理时仅当语义相关性超过阈值才检索经验，否则抑制。在四个金融多模态推理基准上，冻结的 8B 视觉语言模型性能超过金融专用模型，接近通用大模型。
Motivation: 现有工具增强代理在金融场景中缺乏跨回合的状态记忆，导致工具路由不可靠、检索噪声大、推理易产生幻觉。
Method: 提出 FinAcumen 框架，包含一个基于选择性经验记忆的推理机制：将先前轨迹中的成功策略和失败规则蒸馏为持久记忆库；推理时通过语义相似度阈值控制经验检索，不相关记忆被显式抑制；此外提供确定性金融工具环境用于数值计算、检索、视觉解码和答案验证。
Result: 在四个金融多模态推理基准上，FinAcumen 使冻结的 8B 视觉语言模型一致提升，超过金融专用模型，并接近领先的通用模型。进一步分析表明选择性经验激活在检索不确定性下提高了推理可靠性。
Conclusion: 论文表明选择性经验记忆能有效提升金融多模态推理的可靠性和效率，代码已匿名公开。

papers.title: ERQA-Plus: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Reasoning in Embodied AI
papers.abstract_en: Generalist embodied agents require more than object recognition: they must reason about spatial relations, actions, procedures, human intentions, environmental constraints, and commonsense consequences from situated visual observations. Yet existing visual and embodied question answering benchmarks often provide limited control over the reasoning dependencies being tested, making it difficult to distinguish grounded embodied reasoning from shortcut-driven visual or linguistic pattern matching. We present ERQA-Plus, a diagnostic benchmark for reasoning in embodied AI. ERQA-Plus contains 1,766 question-answer instances grounded in 711 robot-centric images and organized according to a structured taxonomy spanning perceptual, action-centric, social-interaction, navigation-environmental, and contextual commonsense reasoning. The dataset is constructed using a multi-stage generation and validation pipeline that combines taxonomy-guided question generation, automatic quality judging, iterative revision, and human assessment to improve visual grounding, answer validity, and reasoning quality. We benchmark representative general-purpose vision-language models and embodied models, including LLaVA-NeXT-8B, Prismatic-7B, MiniCPM-V-4.5-8B, Qwen3-VL, RoboRefer-8B, and RoboBrain2.5-8B. Although the strongest model, Qwen3-VL-32B, achieves 83.4% overall accuracy and 61.4 SBERT score, category-level results reveal persistent weaknesses in spatial reasoning, procedural reasoning, event prediction, and intention inference. ERQA-Plus therefore provides a fine-grained evaluation framework for measuring not only whether embodied agents answer correctly, but also which forms of embodied reasoning they can and cannot perform reliably. The dataset is available https://huggingface.co/datasets/huggingdas/erqa-plus and the project page at https://github.com/LUNAProject22/erqa-plus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ERQA-Plus 是一个用于评估具身 AI 推理能力的诊断基准，包含 1,766 个问答实例，覆盖感知、动作、社交、导航和常识推理等多个类别。通过多阶段生成与验证流程构建，并评估了多种视觉-语言模型和具身模型。最强模型 Qwen3-VL-32B 在整体准确率上达到 83.4%，但在空间推理、程序推理等细粒度能力上仍有不足。
Motivation: 现有视觉和具身问答基准难以区分真正的具身推理与基于视觉或语言捷径的模式匹配，缺乏对推理依赖项的精细控制。
Method: 构建了一个结构化分类体系，涵盖五种推理类型；采用多阶段生成与验证流程，包括分类指导的提问生成、自动质量判断、迭代修订和人工评估。
Result: Qwen3-VL-32B 在整体准确率上达到 83.4%，SBERT 分数 61.4；但类别级结果揭示在空间推理、程序推理、事件预测和意图推断方面存在持续弱点。
Conclusion: ERQA-Plus 提供了一个细粒度评估框架，不仅衡量具身智能体的回答正确性，还能揭示其可靠执行的推理形式。

papers.title: Brick-DICL: Dynamic In-Context Learning for Automated Brick Schema Classification
papers.abstract_en: Building Management Systems (BMS) are essential for optimizing energy efficiency and operational performance in modern buildings. However, the lack of standardization across BMS points from different manufacturers creates significant barriers to integration and data utilization. While the Brick schema offers a standardized ontology for building systems, mapping BMS points to appropriate Brick classes presents three critical challenges: (i) the extensive number of Brick classes (936 in the latest version), (ii) limited domain-specific knowledge in large language models (LLMs), and (iii) substantial manual effort required for verification. To address these challenges, we propose Brick-DICL, a two-stage dynamic in-context learning framework for automated Brick schema classification. Brick-DICL consists of two primary components: metadata-RAG, which retrieves relevant examples to enhance LLMs' domain knowledge, and class-RAG, which narrows down potential Brick classes to address the large classification space. Additionally, we implement a multi-LLM filtering mechanism that compares predictions across multiple models, flagging low-confidence classifications for human review. As a result: (i) General: Brick-DICL is applicable to any building management system regardless of manufacturer or metadata format; (ii) Novel and Powerful: as the first dynamic in-context learning approach for Brick schema classification, Brick-DICL achieves significant classification accuracy improvements on building datasets, outperforming existing methods; (iii) Efficient: our multi-LLM filtering strategy reduces manual verification effort, enabling rapid digital building onboarding. Extensive experiments demonstrate Brick-DICL's effectiveness across diverse building datasets, accelerating the path toward standardized, interoperable building management systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Brick-DICL，一种用于自动砖块模式分类的两阶段动态上下文学习框架。该方法通过 metadata-RAG 和 class-RAG 组件分别检索相关示例和缩小候选类别空间，并采用多 LLM 过滤机制标记低置信度预测供人工审核。实验证明 Brick-DICL 在多个建筑数据集上显著提升分类准确率，减少人工验证工作量。
Motivation: 建筑管理系统中 BMS 点缺乏标准化，映射到 Brick 本体面临类别数多（936 类）、LLM 领域知识不足、人工验证耗时三大挑战，亟需自动化分类方法。
Method: 提出 Brick-DICL 框架，包含 metadata-RAG（检索相关示例增强领域知识）和 class-RAG（缩小候选 Brick 类别）两个组件，并集成多 LLM 过滤机制比较多个模型预测，对低置信度结果标记人工审查。
Result: 在多个建筑数据集上，Brick-DICL 在分类准确率上超越现有方法，并有效减少人工验证工作量，实现快速数字建筑接入。
Conclusion: Brick-DICL 是一种通用、高效且新颖的砖块模式分类方法，可加速标准化建筑管理系统的实现。

papers.title: Divide, Deliberate, Decide: A Multi-Agent Framework for Fine-Grained Egocentric Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained action recognition in egocentric video is challenging for Vision-Language Models (VLMs): actions often differ only in small visual cues, and a single model tends to be biased toward a subset of these cues. We propose Divide, Deliberate, Decide, a fully-local, zero-shot multi-agent framework in which (i) a VLM orchestrator chunks the video and proposes a top-k candidate label list per segment, (ii) an ensemble of heterogeneous VLM specialists, drawn from different open model families, engages in a structured deliberation that includes a peer-consultation round of questions, and (iii) agent rankings are aggregated with a Borda count and the orchestrator re-ranks its own prediction in light of the specialists' evidence. The entire pipeline runs locally with no fine-tuning. Experiments show that our method positively improves zero-shot action recognition performance over the baseline, highlighting the influence of a heterogeneous deliberation step, showing that the gain stems from decorrelated model priors rather than from additional compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为 Divide, Deliberate, Decide 的零样本多智能体框架，用于改善细粒度自我中心动作识别。框架由 VLM 编排器（orchestrator）切分视频并生成候选标签列表，一组异构 VLM 专家（来自不同开源模型族）进行结构化审议（包括同伴咨询轮），最后用 Borda 计数聚合专家排名，编排器根据专家证据重新调整自身预测。整个流程在本地运行，无需微调。实验表明该方法在零样本动作识别上优于基线，且性能提升源于去相关的模型先验而非额外计算量。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）在细粒度自我中心动作识别中容易偏向部分视觉线索，单个模型难以捕捉全部细微动作差异，导致识别偏差。
Method: 提出三阶段框架：1) VLM 编排器将视频分块并对每块提出 top-k 候选标签；2) 来自不同开源模型族的异构 VLM 专家进行结构化审议，包含一轮同伴咨询（peer-consultation）；3) 用 Borda 计数聚合专家排序，编排器结合专家证据重新排名自身预测。框架完全本地运行且无需微调。
Result: 在零样本自我中心动作识别任务上，该方法相比基线显著提升准确率，且增益源于去相关的模型先验（decorrelated model priors）而非额外计算资源。
Conclusion: 摘要强调异构专家审议步骤对提升性能的关键作用，并指出收益来自模型先验的多样性而非单纯增加计算量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RAVA: Retrieval-Augmented Viewpoint Alignment for Subject-Driven Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Reference-driven image generation has made rapid progress on identity preservation, but reliable viewpoint control across different subjects remains poorly understood. The difficulty is not merely generating a new image of the target subject: the model must infer the implicit viewpoint of one subject and transfer it to another subject using only image-level evidence, without camera poses, depth, or ray-based conditions. In this setting, existing generators conditioned on multiple image references often rely on spurious semantic correlations, which lead to viewpoint drift, part-level structural mismatches, and missing or unsupported target-specific content. We formulate this challenge as cross-subject viewpoint alignment and propose RAVA, a retrieval-augmented framework that supplies explicit geometric evidence before generation. RAVA first learns a cross-instance viewpoint embedding that retrieves target-subject images aligned with the anchor viewpoint, then applies a LogDet-based subset selection strategy to retain a compact reference set that is both view-consistent and structurally complementary. The selected references are finally consumed by a fine-tuned multi-reference image generator. Experiments show that generic semantic embeddings are nearly random for this task, while the proposed retriever substantially improves viewpoint retrieval quality. On cross-subject generation, RAVA consistently outperforms zero-shot baselines and stronger retrieval alternatives under the same generation backbone. These results indicate that cross-subject viewpoint alignment benefits from retrieval-augmented geometric grounding rather than relying on end-to-end generation alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RAVA，一种检索增强的框架，用于解决跨主体视角对齐问题，即在给定参考主体图像的情况下，将视角迁移到目标主体，而无需相机姿态、深度等显式几何信息。该方法首先学习跨实例视角嵌入以检索与锚点视角对齐的目标主体图像，然后通过LogDet子集选择策略保留视角一致且结构互补的紧凑参考集，最后输入微调的多参考图像生成器。实验表明，通用语义嵌入在该任务上近乎随机，而RAVA在视角检索质量和跨主体生成上显著优于零样本基线及强检索替代方案。
Motivation: 现有参考驱动图像生成在身份保持方面进展迅速，但跨主体视角控制仍然困难：模型需仅凭图像证据推断一个主体的隐含视角并迁移到另一主体，而现有生成器常依赖虚假语义相关性，导致视角漂移、部分级结构错位以及目标特定内容缺失。
Method: 提出检索增强框架RAVA，包含三阶段：1) 学习跨实例视角嵌入，用于检索与锚点视角对齐的目标主体图像；2) 应用LogDet子集选择策略，从检索结果中保留视角一致且结构互补的紧凑参考集；3) 将所选参考集输入微调后的多参考图像生成器进行生成。
Result: 实验表明通用语义嵌入在该任务上近乎随机，而提出的检索器显著提升了视角检索质量。在跨主体生成上，RAVA在相同生成骨干下一致优于零样本基线和更强的检索替代方案。
Conclusion: 结果表明跨主体视角对齐受益于检索增强的几何基础，而非单纯依赖端到端生成。

papers.title: SkillMoV: Mixture-of-View Routing with Prototype-Conditioned Gating for Unified Multi-View Proficiency Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Estimating human proficiency from video is a key challenge for automated skill assessment, with applications in sports coaching, music pedagogy, surgical training, and workplace learning. Existing approaches often focus on individual scenarios or rely on shared multi-view aggregation, limiting their ability to adapt to heterogeneous camera viewpoints and activity domains. We introduce SkillMoV, a unified, parameter-efficient framework for multi-scenario proficiency estimation from synchronized multi-view video. At its core, SkillMoV introduces a Mixture-of-View Projector (MoVP), which adapts the mixture-of-experts paradigm to camera-specific view features. MoVP is composed of four stages: (i) a Mixture-of-View soft router with twelve expert MLPs that learns view-dependent expert preferences without camera-identity supervision; (ii) cross-view attention to align synchronized cameras; (iii) learnable prototype anchoring to condition the representation on class-level reference vectors; and (iv) a prototype-conditioned gated projection that produces the final skill embedding. We evaluate SkillMoV on EgoExo4D across six skill domains and three separately trained view configurations: Ego, Exos, and Ego+Exos. SkillMoV reaches 50.17% overall accuracy in the Exos setting with a single model trained jointly across all scenarios, surpassing the strongest reported Exos result among the compared methods by 3.57 percentage points. In Ego+Exos, SkillMoV remains close to the best reported result in that setting (47.63% versus 48.20%). Ablations on the selected Exos configuration validate each component: MoV routing contributes +6.61 pp over attentive aggregation, cross-view attention +4.92 pp, prototype anchoring +4.07 pp, and stochastic view dropout +3.90 pp. Through LoRA adaptation, SkillMoV trains only 23.32% of its parameters and adds limited measured overhead relative to a LoRA-only baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillMoV，一个统一的、参数高效的多视角熟练度估计框架，通过引入 Mixture-of-View Projector (MoVP) 来适应不同摄像头视角的特征。MoVP 包含软路由、跨视角注意力、原型锚定和条件门控投影。在 EgoExo4D 数据集上，SkillMoV 在 Exos 设置下达到 50.17% 的准确率，比最强基线高 3.57 个百分点，且仅训练 23.32% 的参数。
Motivation: 现有方法通常聚焦于单一场景或依赖共享的多视角聚合，难以适应异构摄像头视角和活动域，缺乏统一的、适应多场景的熟练度估计方法。
Method: SkillMoV 核心是 Mixture-of-View Projector (MoVP)，包含四个阶段：(i) 多视角软路由 (12个专家MLP)，无需相机身份监督学习视角依赖的专家偏好；(ii) 跨视角注意力对齐同步相机；(iii) 可学习原型锚定，以类级参考向量调节表示；(iv) 原型条件门控投影生成最终技能嵌入。通过 LoRA 适配训练仅 23.32% 参数。
Result: 在 EgoExo4D 的六个技能域上，Exos 设置下达到 50.17% 总体准确率，超过最强基线 3.57 个百分点；Ego+Exos 设置下 47.63% 接近最佳结果 (48.20%)。消融实验验证各组件贡献：MoV 路由 +6.61pp，跨视角注意力 +4.92pp，原型锚定 +4.07pp，随机视角丢弃 +3.90pp。
Conclusion: SkillMoV 通过混合多视角投影和原型条件门控，实现了统一的多场景熟练度估计，且参数高效。局限性可能在于需要同步多视角视频，且评估仅限于 EgoExo4D 数据集。

papers.title: Flux-Guard: Facial Identity Protection using diffusion models
papers.abstract_en: The widespread deployment of face recognition (FR) systems exposes personal images shared on social media and public platforms to identity linkage and privacy risks. Existing adversarial privacy protection methods can degrade unauthorized FR performance but are not compatible with generative face editing. Artificial intelligence-driven face editing tools are gaining popularity, which has significantly increased user demand for personalized portrait generation and social sharing. However, current editing methods often preserve identity features, making the edited images still susceptible to tracking by malicious FR systems. Thus, this paper proposes Flux-Guard, a privacy-preserving face editing framework based on adversarial attacks, which integrates face editing and privacy protection within a unified generative process. Specifically, we design a flow trajectory control method to align semantic manipulations with the generative process and introduce latent-space adversarial optimization with an adaptive perceptual-loss-driven weighting strategy, dynamically adjusting adversarial strength to maximize attack effectiveness while preserving visual quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Flux-Guard supports face editing while significantly improving attack success rates against cross-domain face recognition models on the CelebA-HQ and LADN datasets. Furthermore, evaluation results for commercial APIs have confirmed its effectiveness in real-world applications. The code is released at https://github.com/JLMWang/Flux-Guard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Flux-Guard，一种基于对抗攻击的隐私保护人脸编辑框架，通过流轨迹控制与潜在空间自适应对抗优化，在支持人脸编辑的同时有效防御恶意人脸识别系统。实验在 CelebA-HQ 和 LADN 数据集上显著提升跨域攻击成功率，并在商业 API 上验证了实用性。
Motivation: 现有对抗隐私保护方法无法兼容生成式人脸编辑，而编辑后图像仍可能被恶意人脸识别系统追踪身份，亟需一种统一编辑与隐私保护的方法。
Method: 提出流轨迹控制方法对齐语义操作与生成过程，并引入潜在空间对抗优化，采用自适应感知损失加权策略动态调整对抗强度以平衡攻击效果与视觉质量。
Result: 在 CelebA-HQ 和 LADN 数据集上显著提高了对跨域人脸识别模型的攻击成功率，且在商业 API 评估中也证实了实际有效性。
Conclusion: Flux-Guard 实现了人脸编辑与隐私保护的统一，在保持视觉质量的同时有效抵御身份追踪，并具备实际部署价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Expanding SPHERE-JEPA: A Family of Statistical Regularizers for the Hypersphere
papers.abstract_en: In Self-Supervised Learning (SSL), preventing representation collapse by explicitly enforcing a uniform distribution on the unit hypersphere has proven to be effective. However, current frameworks typically rely on sliced statistical regularizers such as SIGReg (used in LeJEPA) and SUSReg (used in SPHERE-JEPA), which approximate this continuous objective via Monte Carlo sampling along random 1D directions. This stochasticity injects projection variance into the training gradients, destabilizing optimization, and hindering convergence. In this work, we first show that analytically integrating out these random projections natively yields a deterministic Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), bypassing the variance of sliced methods. Motivated by this equivalence, we formulate full-dimensional objectives for MMD, Kernel Stein Discrepancy (KSD), and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence directly on the sphere to enforce a uniform distribution. To prevent spatial bias, we equip these tests with rotationally invariant kernels constructed via spectral theory, systematically evaluating two canonical families: smooth exponential decay (Heat) and strict frequency cutoff (Bandlimited) filters. Empirically, removing projection-induced noise results in more stable optimization, faster convergence, and consistent improvements over stochastic sliced regularizers on ImageNet and Galaxy10. Furthermore, we reveal that the choice of the statistical test shapes the geometry of the learned latent space: MMD and KSD favor locally clustered organization suitable for object-centric domains, whereas the continuous KDE-based KL divergence promotes fine-grained instance separation, yielding the strongest results on unclustered procedural texture retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自监督学习中防止表示坍缩的问题，提出通过解析积分替代蒙特卡洛采样来消除投影方差，从而得到确定性的极大均值差异（MMD）目标。作者进一步在超球面上构造了MMD、核Stein差异（KSD）和KL散度的全维目标，并采用旋转不变核（Heat和Bandlimited滤波器）来避免空间偏差。实验表明，消除投影噪声后优化更稳定、收敛更快，且在ImageNet和Galaxy10上优于随机切片正则化器；不同统计检验导致不同的潜空间几何。
Motivation: 现有基于切片统计正则化器的自监督学习方法（如SIGReg、SUSReg）通过蒙特卡洛采样近似超球面上的均匀分布，引入投影方差导致训练梯度不稳定，阻碍收敛。
Method: 首先证明解析积分随机投影可导出确定性极大均值差异（MMD），从而消除方差；然后提出基于MMD、核Stein差异（KSD）和KL散度的全维正则化目标，并通过谱理论构建旋转不变核（Heat和Bandlimited）以保持空间各向同性。
Result: 在ImageNet和Galaxy10上，所提方法相比随机切片正则化器实现了更稳定的优化、更快的收敛和一致的性能提升；MMD和KSD有利于局部聚类组织，而KL散度在非聚类过程纹理检索中取得最强结果。
Conclusion: 消除投影噪声的确定性正则化器能够提升训练稳定性与收敛速度，且不同统计检验的选择影响潜在空间几何，为不同任务提供适应性。该工作主要聚焦于计算机视觉的自监督学习。

papers.title: Test-Time Training for Robust Text-Guided Open-Vocabulary Object Counting
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided Open-vocabulary Object Counting (TOOC) enables counting arbitrary object categories specified by text prompts, offering substantially greater flexibility than conventional closed-set counting. However, existing TOOC methods are developed and evaluated primarily on ideal images, while real-world scenes often suffer from adverse conditions such as rain, fog, darkness, and sensor noise, which severely degrade visual quality and impair vision-language alignment. To bridge this gap, we introduce Robust-TOOC, the first benchmark for evaluating TOOC under diverse corruption conditions, which covers six representative degradation types: rain, fog, darkness, Gaussian noise, salt-and-pepper noise, and mixed corruption. To improve robustness while preserving the original counting architecture, we propose Dual-TTT, a dual-architecture test-time training framework for TOOC. Specifically, during test-time training, Dual-TTT updates only the Text-guided Lightweight Denoising module (TL-Denoiser), while keeping the original counting network frozen. Inspired by diffusion models, the TL-Denoiser is optimized to remove corruption-aware noise from image representations under degraded conditions. Since only the TL-Denoiser is trained at test time, Dual-TTT is annotation-free and can be seamlessly integrated into existing TOOC models without modifying their original architecture. Extensive experiments on multiple recent TOOC baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本引导开放词汇目标计数（TOOC）在恶劣天气等退化条件下的鲁棒性问题，提出首个基准Robust-TOOC，涵盖六种退化类型。同时提出Dual-TTT框架，在测试时仅更新文本引导轻量去噪模块（TL-Denoiser），保持原计数网络冻结，以提升鲁棒性。实验表明该方法可有效集成到现有TOOC模型中。
Motivation: 现有TOOC方法主要在理想图像上评估，但真实场景常受雨、雾、黑暗、噪声等退化影响，导致视觉质量下降和视觉-语言对齐受损，缺乏针对性的鲁棒性评估与改进方法。
Method: 提出Dual-TTT双架构测试时训练框架，仅更新文本引导轻量去噪模块（TL-Denoiser），该模块受扩散模型启发，优化去除退化感知噪声；原计数网络冻结，无需标注即可实现鲁棒性增强。
Result: 在多个最新TOOC基线上进行大量实验，验证了Dual-TTT在退化条件下的有效性，但摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: Dual-TTT可无缝集成到现有TOOC模型，无需修改原架构，为提升实际场景鲁棒性提供了即插即用方案。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对文本引导开放词汇目标计数（TOOC）在恶劣天气等退化条件下的鲁棒性问题，提出首个基准Robust-TOOC，涵盖六种退化类型。同时提出Dual-TTT框架，在测试时仅更新文本引导轻量去噪模块（TL-Denoiser），保持原计数网络冻结，以提升鲁棒性。实验表明该方法可有效集成到现有TOOC模型中。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有TOOC方法主要在理想图像上评估，但真实场景常受雨、雾、黑暗、噪声等退化影响，导致视觉质量下降和视觉-语言对齐受损，缺乏针对性的鲁棒性评估与改进方法。

summary_sections.result: 在多个最新TOOC基线上进行大量实验，验证了Dual-TTT在退化条件下的有效性，但摘要未报告具体数值。

papers.title: Proximal Mediation Analysis with Hidden Recanting Witnesses
papers.abstract_en: Mediation analysis is essential for decomposing the causal effect of a treatment into direct and indirect pathways. However, many practical settings rely on the stringent assumption that recanting witnesses, defined as treatment-induced mediator-outcome confounders, are either absent or fully known a priori. Such a requirement is often untenable, especially when these variables remain unobservable due to measurement difficulties or privacy constraints. In this paper, we leverage proximal causal inference to develop three novel identification strategies to address the challenge of identifying path-specific effects in the presence of unknown recanting witnesses. Building on this, we develop a semiparametric inference framework that derives the efficient influence function and proposes a proximal multiply robust estimator, which remains consistent if at least one set of nuisance models is correctly specified. When all nuisance models are correctly specified and converge at appropriate rates, the estimator is asymptotically normal and achieves the semiparametric efficiency bound. We provide a minimax optimization-based debiased machine learning procedure for point estimation and constructing valid confidence intervals. The performance of the proposed methods is demonstrated by simulation studies and a real data application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对中介分析中存在的隐藏的“翻供证人”（recanting witnesses）问题，即治疗引起的 mediator-outcome 混杂变量不可观测时，路径特定效应的识别困难。利用近端因果推断（proximal causal inference）提出三种新的识别策略，并开发了半参数推断框架，包括有效影响函数和近端多重稳健估计量。该估计量在至少一组 nuisance 模型正确设定时保持一致，在所有模型正确且收敛速率合适时达到半参数有效界。通过最小化最大优化的去偏机器学习方法进行点估计和置信区间构建。模拟和实际数据验证了性能。
Motivation: 实践中，中介分析常依赖翻供证人要么不存在要么完全已知的严格假设，但该假设在变量因测量困难或隐私约束而不可观测时难以成立。本文旨在解决未知翻供证人存在时路径特定效应的识别与推断问题。
Method: 利用近端因果推断，提出三种新的识别策略；基于此开发半参数推断框架，推导有效影响函数，提出近端多重稳健估计量，并采用最小化最大优化的去偏机器学习方法。
Result: 估计量在至少一组 nuisance 模型正确时保持一致；所有模型正确且收敛速率合适时，估计量渐近正态且达到半参数有效界。模拟和实际数据研究验证了方法性能。
Conclusion: 本文为存在隐藏翻供证人的中介分析提供了新的识别和推断工具，放宽了传统假设，具有实际应用价值。
