papers.title: When the Next Step Is Not One Step: Distribution-Aware Execution Modeling for Concurrent Go Programs
papers.abstract_en: Training a model to predict the next step in a concurrent program is harder than it looks: two runs of the same program from the same trace prefix can produce different next events, both valid, because the scheduler is nondeterministic. A model trained against a single label is learning to guess one outcome of a random process. We turn this around and use the nondeterminism as a training signal. We run each program many times, aggregate the observed next events into an empirical distribution, and fine-tune a 7B model to match that distribution with a KL objective. On 798 held-out predictions drawn from real production Go bugs (CockroachDB, Kubernetes, gRPC, etcd), fine-tuning on fewer than a thousand traces reaches 36.2% accuracy, ahead of Gemini 3.5 Flash used zero-shot (34.8%) and the same model without fine-tuning (28.6%). Distribution training matches cross-entropy on accuracy (35.8% vs. 36.2%) while reducing Expected Calibration Error from 0.205 to 0.169. We also derive a formal goroutine-leak signature for a class of select-blocked goroutines where P(GoUnblock)=0 holds by scheduler semantics, not by learning. We release the dataset, trained adapters, and all tooling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对并发Go程序中下一步事件预测的困难，利用调度器的非确定性，多次运行程序聚合观测到的next events的经验分布，微调7B模型使其匹配该分布。在真实生产Go bug的798个held-out预测上达到36.2%准确率，优于Gemini 3.5 Flash零样本(34.8%)和未微调模型(28.6%)。分布训练在保持准确率的同时降低了期望校准误差(ECE)。还推导了select-blocked goroutine的泄漏签名。
Motivation: 训练模型预测并发程序的下一步很困难，因为同一前缀的两次运行可能产生不同的有效下一事件，而基于单一标签的训练是在猜测随机过程的一个结果。
Method: 提出分布感知的执行建模方法：多次运行程序，聚合观察到的next events得到经验分布，然后使用KL散度目标微调7B模型以匹配该分布。
Result: 在798个来自真实生产Go bug（CockroachDB、Kubernetes、gRPC、etcd）的held-out预测上，微调少于一千个traces达到36.2%准确率，超过Gemini 3.5 Flash零样本(34.8%)和未微调模型(28.6%)。分布训练相比交叉熵训练准确率相当(35.8% vs 36.2%)，但将期望校准误差(ECE)从0.205降低到0.169。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用非确定性作为训练信号可以提高预测准确率和校准，并发现由调度器语义保证的goroutine泄漏签名。作者发布了数据集、适配器和工具。

papers.title: LLM-as-Judge in Education: A Curriculum-Grounded Marking Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI and large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to question generation and automated assessment. However, deploying LLMs in preparation for high-stakes exams requires more than prompt engineering; it demands software pipelines that systematically ground model outputs in authorised curriculum artefacts and marking guidelines issued by education authorities. This paper presents a curriculum-grounded, configurable LLM-as-Judge pipeline for question-level marking, co-developed with an industrial partner, to support exam preparation for university admission. The pipeline identifies the relevant topics, subtopics, and cognitive demand of a question, and assembles verifiable and authorised context to support LLM judgement. Curriculum intent is operationalised through concrete syllabus artefacts, including prescribed verbs and outcomes, performance band descriptors, glossary definitions, and marking-guideline principles. A staged LLM workflow is employed to first generate question-specific rubrics, capturing structured expectations of performance, and then derive and evaluate marking criteria used to allocate marks to student responses. This design improves consistency, transparency, and alignment with official marking practices. Preliminary evaluation shows that the proposed LLM-as-Judge pipeline delivers marking outcomes comparable to human tutors, while yielding justifications that are more traceable to authorised curriculum artefacts and marking standards. The pipeline has also been integrated into an online study platform, where early deployment data provide initial insights into operational usage and manual overrides.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于课程标准的LLM评分管道，用于大学入学考试题目的自动评分。该管道通过识别问题的主题、子主题和认知需求，组装可验证的课程标准上下文，分阶段生成题目特定的评分标准和评分准则，最终分配分数。初步评估显示其评分结果与人类导师相当，且提供的理由更可追溯至官方课程标准和评分指南。该管道已集成到在线学习平台并获得初步运营数据。
Motivation: 高利害考试中LLM的部署需要系统性地将模型输出与官方课程标准和评分指南对齐，而简单的提示工程难以保证一致性和可追溯性。
Method: 构建可配置的LLM-as-Judge管道：先识别题目相关的课程主题、子主题和认知需求，再通过分阶段LLM工作流生成题目特定的评分标准和评分准则，最后基于这些标准对学生的回答进行评分。
Result: 初步评估表明，该管道的评分结果与人类导师具有可比性，且其评分理由比传统方法更能够追溯到官方课程标准与评分标准。
Conclusion: 该管道提高了评分的一致性、透明度和与官方评分实践的对齐，并已实际部署于在线学习平台，未来可进一步优化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reconfigurable Computing Challenge: Transformer for Jet Tagging on Versal AI Engines
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based models achieve strong performance for jet tagging at the CERN LHC, but deploying them in low-latency, resource-constrained trigger systems is challenging. We present an initial implementation of a quantized, integer-only transformer for jet tagging on the AMD Versal AI Engine (AIE), mapping dense and multi-head attention (MHA) layers to AIE tiles. The main contribution is a reusable software framework that represents transformer layers as composable AIE building blocks and automatically generates the corresponding Vitis graph code from a high-level Python model description. This framework provides a foundation for future research and is released as open-source software at https://github.com/KastnerRG/particle_transformer_aie.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE 34th Int. Symp. on Field-Programmable Custom Computing Machines (FCCM), Atlanta, GA, USA, 2026, pp. 307-310

papers.title: A Bayesian Boolean Matrix Factorization with Application to Copy Number Analysis in Cancer
papers.abstract_en: Binary data factorization is common, but real-valued methods ignore discreteness and yield hard-to-interpret factors. Boolean Matrix Factorization (BooMF) instead decomposes a binary matrix into two lower-rank binary matrices via logical AND and OR, expressing the data as a Boolean disjunction of interpretable patterns. In cancer genomics, BooMF can reveal coordinated feature changes that may drive tumor evolution, unlike rotational or additive decompositions. Most existing BooMF methods are heuristic, greedy, sensitive to initialization, prone to local optima, and do not support principled model selection or uncertainty quantification. We introduce Bayesian Boolean Matrix Factorization (BBMF), a fully conjugate generative model with sparsity-inducing priors. It enforces Boolean constraints, yields interpretable latent factors with coherent uncertainty quantification, and admits Gibbs sampling with closed-form full conditionals. Because cancer evolution often involves widespread, near-simultaneous chromosome-number changes (e.g., whole-genome duplication followed by instability and selection), Boolean factorizations capture these patterns more naturally than additive models. Applied to arm-level copy-number alteration data in multiple myeloma, where entries indicate presence/absence of chromosomal-arm amplifications, BBMF finds a small set of interpretable bicliques linking patient subsets to recurrently co-altered chromosomal arms, providing a compact, biologically meaningful summary of tumor heterogeneity and demonstrating BBMF's utility for uncovering discrete latent structure in complex binary data.

TL;DR: 本文提出贝叶斯布尔矩阵分解（BBMF），一种基于共轭生成模型和稀疏先验的二进制矩阵分解方法，通过逻辑AND/OR操作生成可解释的潜因子，并提供不确定性量化。应用于多发性骨髓瘤的拷贝数变异数据，BBMF能够识别出与患者子集和染色体臂共变化相关的可解释双派对，为肿瘤异质性提供紧凑的生物意义总结。
Motivation: 现有布尔矩阵分解方法多采用启发式或贪心算法，对初始化敏感、易陷入局部最优，且缺乏模型选择和不确定性量化。在癌症基因组学中，二进制数据因子化需要兼顾离散性和可解释性，但实值方法无法满足。
Method: 提出一种全共轭生成模型，结合稀疏诱导先验，通过吉布斯采样实现闭式全条件更新，强制满足布尔约束，产生具有一致性不确定性的可解释潜因子。
Result: 在骨髓瘤臂级拷贝数变异数据上，BBMF能够识别出一小组可解释的双派对，将患者子集与反复共变的染色体臂联系起来，提供肿瘤异质性的紧凑总结。
Conclusion: BBMF为复杂二进制数据中的离散潜在结构发现提供了一种贝叶斯框架，具有可解释性和不确定性量化能力，在癌症基因组学中展示了实用性。

papers.title: Online LLM Selection via Constrained Bandits with Time-Varying Demand
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in edge-cloud inference systems to handle diverse user tasks with heterogeneous accuracy, latency, and cost profiles. Selecting the appropriate LLM for each incoming task is critical for ensuring service quality and efficient resource utilization. However, model heterogeneity, stochastic and unknown performance characteristics, and time-varying task demands make static selection strategies inadequate. Real-world deployments often impose hard resource budgets such as monetary expenditure limits, along with soft service-level requirements such as latency guarantees. These constraints introduce additional challenges for online decision-making. We formulate this problem as a constrained stochastic bandit learning task, where the learner sequentially selects models under both packing-type (hard) and covering-type (soft) constraints, while adapting to time-varying task demand. The learner operates without access to the underlying reward, cost, or latency distributions and must rely on partial feedback. We develop a novel online learning algorithm that leverages confidence-bound estimates and demand predictions to balance reward maximization with long-term constraint satisfaction. We provide theoretical guarantees showing sublinear regret and sublinear covering constraint violations compared to an offline benchmark with full information. Experimental results on synthetic workloads demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our approach in dynamic, resource-constrained environments.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures with multiple subfigures, 1 table, submitted for possible journal publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线大语言模型（LLM）选择问题，将其建模为具有时变需求的约束随机赌博机学习任务。学习者需在未知奖励、成本和延迟分布下，同时满足硬资源预算和软服务等级约束。作者提出一种利用置信界估计和需求预测的在线学习算法，并证明其相对于全信息离线基准具有次线性遗憾和次线性覆盖约束违反。合成实验验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有LLM选择策略因模型异构性、随机性能和时变需求而无法满足实际部署中的硬预算与软约束。
Method: 将问题形式化为带资源约束的随机赌博机，设计在线算法，结合置信界估计和需求预测以平衡奖励最大化与长期约束满足。
Result: 理论上证明了次线性遗憾和次线性约束违反；合成实验表明方法在动态资源受限环境中具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 所提算法能有效适应时变需求并保证长期约束满足，适用于边缘-云推理系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPHINX: First Explain, Then Explore
papers.abstract_en: Generating adversarial driving scenarios is critical for evaluating and improving autonomous vehicle decision-making systems in simulation. Recent approaches, such as ChatScene and LLM-Attacker, rely primarily on the prior knowledge of Large Language Models and Vision-Language Models to generate driving scenarios procedurally. We argue that adversarial scenes should be generated based on the failure diagnosis (e.g., indecisiveness, multi-frame inconsistency) of the driving policy to specifically address the policy's weaknesses instead of relying on prior assumptions. In this paper, we propose SPHINX, a closed-loop framework for adversarial scenario synthesis guided by a simple principle: first explain, then explore. Beyond blindly exploring the scenario space, SPHINX leverages explainable artificial intelligence methods to analyze the policy, identifying key visual concepts and their influence on policy outputs, and the uncertainty of the decisions. Given the interpretable evidence extracted from the policy's own decision process, we use a vision language model to rationalize and criticize failure modes of the current policy. These critics are then used to generate targeted adversarial scenarios for policy retraining and improvement. We demonstrate that SPHINX can highlight an interpretable account of policy failures while other adversarial scene generation cannot. Across the evaluated benchmarks and test suites, SPHINX can be applied to diverse state-of-the-art autonomous vehicle architectures and yields consistent robustness improvements over existing scenario-generation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SPHINX，一个闭环框架，用于生成针对自动驾驶策略弱点的对抗性驾驶场景。它通过可解释人工智能分析策略的决策过程，识别关键视觉概念和不确定性，然后利用视觉语言模型生成目标性场景进行策略重训练。
Motivation: 现有对抗场景生成方法（如ChatScene、LLM-Attacker）主要依赖大语言模型的先验知识，而不是基于驾驶策略自身的故障诊断。作者认为应基于策略的失败模式（如优柔寡断、多帧不一致）来生成场景，以针对性改善弱点。
Method: SPHINX采用'先解释，后探索'原则：先通过可解释人工智能提取策略决策中的关键视觉概念和不确定性证据，再由视觉语言模型推理和批评失败模式，最后生成目标对抗场景用于策略重训练。
Result: SPHINX能提供可解释的策略失败描述，而其他方法不能。在多个基准测试中，SPHINX适用于多种自动驾驶架构，并比现有场景生成方法带来一致的鲁棒性提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SPHINX通过基于策略自身失败诊断的对抗场景生成，提升了自动驾驶系统的鲁棒性，且具有可解释性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GeneralVLA-2: Geometry-Aware Reconstruction and Governed Memory for Robot Planning
papers.abstract_en: Generalist vision-language-action systems need object-centric 3D evidence and reusable manipulation experience to plan reliable robot trajectories. GeneralVLA provides a hierarchical interface for converting language and RGB-D observations into 3D end-effector paths, but two bottlenecks remain. First, monocular SAM3D-style object reconstruction can hallucinate pose and unseen geometry, while manipulation benefits from stable object shape when calibrated multi-view observations are available. Second, the original KnowledgeBank mainly retrieves semantically similar snippets and appends new knowledge, which makes it difficult to control memory quality, conflicts, confidence, and geometric relevance. To address the first challenge, we introduce GeoFuse-MV3D, a geometry-prior-guided MV-SAM3D reconstruction branch that verifies external geometry cues with input-view masks, applies soft visual-hull support, performs axis-wise refinement, and fuses only geometry while preserving appearance. To address the second challenge, we upgrade KnowledgeBank into a governed long-term memory system with explicit quality, confidence, lifecycle, verifier, and conflict metadata, together with precision-oriented retrieval. Finally, we evaluate the reconstruction branch on GSO-30 and the memory module on Terminal-Bench 2.0 and SWE-Bench Verified; GeoFuse-MV3D improves over the MV-SAM3D baseline by reducing CD and LPIPS by 2.20% and 2.02% while increasing PSNR and SSIM by 2.36% and 1.03%, and KnowledgeBank improves over ReasoningBank by 4.53% on Terminal-Bench SR and 3.73% on SWE-Bench resolve rate, while reducing AS by 4.95% and 5.65%, respectively. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/GeneralVLA-2. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/GeneralVLA-2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeneralVLA-2 改进视觉-语言-动作系统在机器人规划中的瓶颈：一是通过几何先验引导的多视图重建分支 GeoFuse-MV3D 解决单目重建的幻象问题；二是将 KnowledgeBank 升级为可控长期记忆系统，加入质量、置信度和冲突管理等元数据。实验表明 GeoFuse-MV3D 在 GSO-30 上优于 MV-SAM3D 基线，KnowledgeBank 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 和 SWE-Bench Verified 上提升了任务成功率。
Motivation: 机器人规划需要稳定的三维物体表示和可复用的操作经验，但现有系统存在两个瓶颈：单目重建可能产生姿态和几何幻象，且记忆系统缺乏对质量、冲突和几何相关性的控制。
Method: 提出 GeoFuse-MV3D 重建分支，利用几何先验（外部几何线索与输入视角掩膜验证、软视觉外壳支持、逐轴精炼）仅融合几何信息而保持外观；升级 KnowledgeBank 为可控长期记忆系统，显式管理质量、置信度、生命周期、验证器和冲突元数据，并采用精度导向检索。
Result: GeoFuse-MV3D 在 GSO-30 上相对 MV-SAM3D 基线降低 CD 2.20%、LPIPS 2.02%，提升 PSNR 2.36%、SSIM 1.03%；KnowledgeBank 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上比 ReasoningBank 提升 SR 4.53%，在 SWE-Bench Verified 上提升 resolve rate 3.73%，并分别降低 AS 4.95% 和 5.65%。
Conclusion: 论文强调通过几何先验约束重构和可控记忆管理能提升机器人规划的可靠性，但评估限于特定基准，且依赖多视图输入。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decoding Hidden Deception in Reasoning LLMs: Activation Explainers for Deception Auditing
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs acquire stronger reasoning capabilities, deceptive behavior becomes an increasingly serious safety concern. Existing deception monitors either score visible transcripts or derive scalar probe scores from representation vectors, leaving little inspectable evidence about why a response is suspicious. We introduce STATEWITNESS, an activation explainer for deception auditing. A separate decoder reads a target model's hidden states, then answers natural-language queries or emits structured reports about them. We evaluate STATEWITNESS on two target reasoning LLMs across seven deception datasets. STATEWITNESS reaches 0.916 mean AUROC, a relative gain of 11.6% over the best black-box text monitor and 25.0% over the best activation-probe baseline under the same evaluation protocol. When combined with existing monitors, STATEWITNESS reduces missed deceptive examples in simple threshold ensembles. Beyond scalar detection, the decoder returns query-level answers, schema reports, and token- or sentence-level evidence traces for human inspection. We view this interface as a potential building block for broader interpretability and alignment tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STATEWITNESS，一种针对推理LLM的激活解释器，用于欺骗审计。它通过读取目标模型的隐藏状态，回答自然语言查询或生成结构化报告，以提供可检查的欺骗证据。在七个欺骗数据集上，STATEWITNESS达到0.916平均AUROC，相比最佳黑盒文本监控器提升11.6%，相比最佳激活探针基线提升25.0%。
Motivation: 现有欺骗监控器要么对可见文本评分，要么从表示向量中提取标量探针分数，缺乏关于响应为何可疑的可检查证据。需要一种能提供可解释证据的欺骗审计方法。
Method: STATEWITNESS使用一个独立的解码器读取目标模型的隐藏状态，然后回答自然语言查询或发出结构化报告。它支持查询级答案、模式报告以及令牌级或句子级证据痕迹，便于人工检查。
Result: 在七个欺骗数据集上，STATEWITNESS的平均AUROC为0.916，相对最佳黑盒文本监控器提升11.6%，相对最佳激活探针基线提升25.0%。与现有监控器结合时，在简单阈值集成中减少遗漏的欺骗示例。
Conclusion: STATEWITNESS提供了超越标量检测的可解释证据，可作为更广泛的可解释性和对齐工具的基础模块。

papers.title: Theoretical Grounding of Out-Of-Distribution Detection With Reinforcement Learning Optimizer
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in dynamic open-world environments requires a model to continually adapt to evolving data distributions while generalizing to covariate-shifted inputs and rejecting semantic-shifted OOD examples. Most existing OOD detection methods optimize only the current-step objective and do not explicitly account for how post-deployment environment changes affect future OOD behavior. In this paper, we establish a theoretical grounding for dynamic OOD detection using a reinforcement learning (RL)-guided optimizer that explicitly favors updates that reduce the semantic OOD false positive rate over time. We develop a novel augmented optimizer that uses an RL-guided correction term on top of standard gradient descent (GD) and show its improvement over both future-domain generalization and semantic-OOD rejection. We analyze temporal error decomposition in terms of model-change and environment-change generalization errors and develop a new theoretical framework for comparing the generalization errors under both GD and RL-guided optimizers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为动态开放环境下的分布外（OOD）检测建立了理论基础，提出了一种基于强化学习（RL）引导的优化器，该优化器在标准梯度下降（GD）上增加了RL引导的校正项，以长期降低语义OOD的假阳性率。作者分析了时间误差分解，并提出了一个新的理论框架，比较GD和RL引导优化器下的泛化误差。
Motivation: 现有OOD检测方法仅优化当前步目标，未考虑部署后环境变化对未来OOD行为的影响，缺乏动态适应性的理论支撑。
Method: 提出一种增强型优化器，在标准GD基础上引入RL引导的校正项，显式偏好能降低语义OOD假阳性率的更新方向，并建立时间误差分解理论框架。

Conclusion: 该工作为动态OOD检测提供了理论奠基，但摘要未涉及具体实验或数值结果。

papers.title: Multi-Adapter PPO: A Cross-Attention Enhanced Wavelength Selection Framework for LIBS Quantitative Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy (LIBS) quantitative analysis faces critical challenges in wavelength selection due to high-dimensional spectral data and the fundamental trade-off between prediction accuracy and feature efficiency. This paper presents a novel Multi-Adapter PPO framework that transforms wavelength selection into a reinforcement learning problem, leveraging cross-attention mechanisms and multiple specialized adapters to capture complex spectral relationships. Our approach outperforms traditional Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) by an average of 28.4\% in comprehensive score and 45.2\% in prediction accuracy across steel and coal datasets. The proposed method demonstrates superior performance in balancing prediction accuracy with feature efficiency, achieving state-of-the-art results in LIBS quantitative analysis while maintaining interpretability and computational efficiency. We released our code and dataset here: https://github.com/Hflying/MAPPO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LIBS定量分析中高维光谱数据波长选择的难题，提出一种基于多适配器PPO的强化学习框架，利用交叉注意力机制和多个专用适配器捕获复杂光谱关系。在钢和煤数据集上，该方法在综合评分上平均优于传统粒子群优化（PSO）28.4%，预测精度提升45.2%。方法在平衡预测精度与特征效率方面表现优异，同时保持可解释性和计算效率。
Motivation: LIBS定量分析中，高维光谱数据的波长选择面临预测精度与特征效率的根本权衡，传统方法如PSO效果有限。

Result: 在钢和煤数据集上，综合评分平均比PSO提升28.4%，预测精度提升45.2%。

papers.title: StereoFactory: A Unified Merging Framework for Robust Stereo Matching
papers.abstract_en: Stereo matching has advanced through foundation models trained on large-scale datasets, yet this paradigm suffers from a scalability bottleneck: incorporating new data requires costly joint retraining. Model merging offers a scalable post-hoc alternative by integrating knowledge from specialized models after source checkpoints are available. However, existing merging methods typically retain all available models or rely on greedy inclusion, which can preserve harmful task-vector interference. We propose StereoFactory, a coarse-to-fine evolutionary framework for adaptive model merging. Stage~1 employs a genetic algorithm to search the combinatorial space of model subsets, determining which models should participate. Stage~2 addresses module-level knowledge specialization (different functional modules exhibit distinct preferences for knowledge sources) through CMA-ES optimization of architecture-adaptive routing over the selected task vectors, with optional module-level scaling. Experiments across two architectures and four benchmarks demonstrate that StereoFactory consistently achieves the best four-benchmark average under the same checkpoint pool, reducing the average error from 3.80 to 3.30 on NMRF and from 2.88 to 2.19 on FoundationStereo relative to the strongest controlled baseline. The post-hoc search requires only 2.7--3.7\% of the corresponding joint-retraining wall-clock time. Analysis reveals that knowledge contributions are inherently module-specific, and selected subsets can transfer across architectures with minimal degradation. Code will be publicly released upon acceptance at: https://github.com/XiandaGuo/StereoFactory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StereoFactory，一种粗到细的进化框架，用于自适应模型合并，解决立体匹配中基础模型因新数据需联合重训练的可扩展性瓶颈。通过两阶段搜索（遗传算法选择模型子集 + CMA-ES优化路由权重），在多个基准上降低误差，且仅需联合重训练2.7-3.7%的时间。
Motivation: 立体匹配的基石模型在增加新数据时需昂贵联合重训练，现有模型合并方法保留所有模型或贪婪选择，可能保留有害任务向量干扰。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用遗传算法搜索模型子集组合空间；第二阶段通过CMA-ES优化架构自适应路由，对所选任务向量进行模块级知识整合与缩放。
Result: 在两个架构四个基准上，StereoFactory在相同检查点池下取得最佳平均性能，将NMRF误差从3.80降至3.30，FoundationStereo误差从2.88降至2.19，搜索时间仅为联合重训练的2.7-3.7%。
Conclusion: 知识贡献具有模块特异性，所选子集可跨架构迁移且性能下降极小。代码将开源。

papers.title: AIPatient Arena: EHR-grounded evaluation of large language models in end-to-end clinical consultation workflows
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for use in clinical consultation tasks, yet most medical evaluations remain static, single-turn, or narrowly outcome-based, limiting their ability to reflect the sequential, uncertain, and interactive nature of real-world care. Here, we propose AIPatient Arena, an EHRs-grounded evaluation framework for assessing the clinical utility of LLMs across eight dimensions of clinical competence. The framework integrates EHR data into patient-specific knowledge graphs, enabling multi-turn physician-patient interactions. We applied AIPatient Arena on a primary cohort of 437 patients and two out-of-distribution validation cohorts of 119 and 67 patients. We observe that LLMs performed well in medical interview questioning skills (QS; mean scores, 4.43-4.99/5), ethical and professional conduct (ET; 4.38-4.93/5), and clarity and transparency of clinical explanations (EX; 3.80-4.72/5). Performance was moderate in information integration (II; 3.19-4.21/5) and medication safety and justification (MS; 3.13-3.78/5), but persistent weaknesses were observed in handling of ambiguous patient responses (HR; 2.57-3.32/5), information coverage (IC; 2.08-3.02/5), and diagnostic accuracy and reasoning (Dx; 2.63-3.55/5). Process-based evaluation revealed recurrent interaction failures, including repetitive questioning, omission of past medical history, and inadequate handling of uncertainty. Richer conversational context improved diagnostic reasoning but yielded limited gains in treatment planning. These findings indicate that final-answer accuracy alone is insufficient for evaluating clinical readiness and highlight the importance of assessing how models gather, interpret, and communicate information throughout a consultation. AIPatient Arena provides an EHR-grounded framework for workflow-oriented pre-deployment evaluation of medical LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AIPatient Arena，一个基于电子健康记录（EHR）的评估框架，用于评估大型语言模型在临床咨询中的多轮交互能力。在437名患者的主队列和两个外部验证队列（119和67名患者）上测试，发现LLMs在问诊技巧、伦理道德方面表现良好，但在处理模糊回答、信息覆盖、诊断准确性方面存在持续弱点。
Motivation: 现有医学评估多基于静态、单轮或狭窄的结局指标，无法反映真实临床咨询的序列性、不确定性和交互性。
Method: 提出AIPatient Arena框架，将EHR数据整合到患者特定知识图谱中，实现多轮医患交互评估，涵盖八个临床能力维度。
Result: 在三个队列上，LLMs在问诊技巧（QS）得分4.43-4.99/5，伦理道德（ET）4.38-4.93/5，解释清晰度（EX）3.80-4.72/5；中等水平在信息整合（II）3.19-4.21/5和用药安全（MS）3.13-3.78/5；弱项在模糊回答处理（HR）2.57-3.32/5，信息覆盖（IC）2.08-3.02/5，诊断准确性（Dx）2.63-3.55/5。
Conclusion: 最终答案准确性不足以评估临床就绪度，需要评估模型在整个咨询过程中如何收集、解释和沟通信息。AIPatient Arena提供了面向工作流程的部署前评估框架。

papers.title: ReRAM-aware Model Finetuning addressing I-V Non-linearity and Retention Errors
papers.abstract_en: Traditional CPU, GPU, and NPU architectures are increasingly limited by the von Neumann bottleneck. While In-Memory Computing (IMC) using ReRAM crossbar arrays offers a high-density, energy-efficient alternative, its practical deployment is constrained through their non-idealities. Existing hardware-aware training frameworks often require training from scratch, which is computationally prohibitive for modern large-scale models. In this work, we propose a finetuning-based hardware-aware training algorithm that enables robust DNN deployment on ReRAM with minimal training overhead. Our approach mitigates I-V non-linearity by applying a range-shrunk sinh transformation and incorporates retention errors directly into a regularization loss during the finetuning process. We evaluate our framework across models and tasks such as image classification and question-answering (QA). Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves similar accuracy on large-scale models like ResNet18 and DeiT-Tiny as the base model. In-case of ImageNet for MobileNetV3 families the technique has only less than 2% accuracy degradation. Further, applying the technique on the SQuAD v2 dataset results in only 1 point degradation of F-1 score.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables, with appendix (5 pages, 9 figures)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于微调的硬件感知训练算法，用于解决ReRAM交叉阵列中的I-V非线性和保留误差问题，无需从头训练。该方法通过范围收缩的双曲正弦变换缓解I-V非线性，并将保留误差作为正则化损失加入微调过程。在ImageNet上对MobileNetV3系列模型，准确率下降低于2%；在SQuAD v2数据集上F1分数仅下降1点。
Motivation: 传统硬件感知训练需要从头训练，计算开销大，不适合现代大规模模型。ReRAM的非理想特性（I-V非线性和保留误差）阻碍其实际部署。
Method: 提出微调框架：对权重进行范围收缩的sinh变换以补偿I-V非线性；将保留误差建模为额外正则化项加入损失函数，在微调过程中优化。
Result: 在ResNet18、DeiT-Tiny等模型上达到与基准模型相近的准确率；ImageNet上MobileNetV3系列准确率下降<2%；SQuAD v2上F1分数仅降1点。
Conclusion: 基于微调的硬件感知训练可高效提升ReRAM部署鲁棒性，且精度损失极小，适用于多种任务和模型架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Perron--Frobenius Operator Matching for Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Perron--Frobenius Operator Matching (PFOM), a generative framework that matches density evolution via the integral PF operator, subsuming flow, diffusion, and jump models. We prove that among Bregman divergences, only Kullback--Leibler divergence preserves equality between density-level and sample-conditioned objectives, yielding a practical loss equivalent to Koopman path matching. We further develop Nesterov-accelerated training and sampling that stabilize discretization and accelerate convergence. %On Gaussian mixtures and two-moons, PFOM achieves faster KL/$W_2$/MMD decrease and improved wall-clock efficiency with empirical validation. PFOM unifies operator-theoretic identification with modern generative modeling and opens paths to adaptive dictionaries and high-dimensional applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Perron-Frobenius Operator Matching (PFOM) 生成框架，通过积分 PF 算子匹配密度演化，统一了流、扩散和跳跃模型。证明在 Bregman 散度中仅 KL 散度保持密度级与样本级目标的一致性，并开发了 Nesterov 加速训练与采样方法。
Motivation: 现有生成模型（如流、扩散、跳跃模型）缺乏统一的算子理论视角，且训练和采样效率有待提升。
Method: PFOM 框架利用 Perron-Frobenius 算子的积分形式匹配密度演化，通过 KL 散度等价于 Koopman 路径匹配损失，并采用 Nesterov 加速技术改进训练与采样。
Result: 在高斯混合和双月数据集上，PFOM 实现更快的 KL/W_2/MMD 下降和更优的时钟时间效率。
Conclusion: PFOM 统一了算子理论识别与现代生成建模，为自适应字典和高维应用开辟路径。

papers.title: CheckMIABench: Firm Foundations For Membership Inference Attacks on Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) are a canonical way to assess a machine learning model's privacy properties. Although several attempts have been made to evaluate MIAs on language models, the extant literature has suffered numerous difficulties in constructing clean evaluations to test new techniques. In particular, subtle distribution shifts between member and non-member sets can undermine the statistical validity of MIAs; recent work has underscored this by showing that "blind" methods with no access to the underlying model can perform far better than published methods on the same benchmarks. This paper constructs a benchmark for principled evaluation of MIAs against LLMs, by leveraging the insight that training data before and after a fixed point during training are drawn from the same distribution. Therefore, all open-source models with intermediate checkpoints and public training data can be converted into MIA testbeds. We apply our framework to a half-dozen published attacks on the Pythia and OLMo family of models, from 70M to 7B parameters. To facilitate further privacy research, we open-source a modular library for designing and implementing attacks in this setting: https://github.com/safr-ai-lab/pandora_llm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于对大型语言模型进行成员推理攻击（MIA）评估的标准化基准。核心思路是利用训练过程中固定时间点前后的数据来自同一分布这一特性，将带有中间检查点的开源模型转换为MIA测试平台。作者在Pythia和OLMo系列模型（70M至7B参数）上评估了六种已有攻击方法，并开源了模块化库。
Motivation: 现有针对语言模型的MIA评估存在构造困难，成员与非成员集之间的分布偏移会损害统计有效性，甚至盲法方法表现优于已发表方法，亟需更干净的基准。
Method: 基于训练过程中固定时间点前后的数据来自同一分布的洞见，利用开源模型的中间检查点和公开训练数据构建MIA测试平台，并开源模块化攻击实现库。
Result: 在Pythia和OLMo系列模型（70M至7B参数）上评估了六种已发表的攻击方法，揭示了当前评估中的问题。

papers.title: WeaveLA: Event Driven Cross-Subtask Latent Memory Weaving for Repetitive Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have achieved remarkable single-step manipulation, yet they remain brittle precisely where each stage depends on what was just completed. The core issue is structural: short-window VLAs lack an explicit channel for rouxting information across sub-task boundaries, and existing memory-augmented variants either write at every frame, retrieve from demonstration-time stages, or fire at sub-goal events without performing an explicit sub-task-to-sub-task hand-off into the action expert. We identify the sub-goal completion event as the natural temporal unit for cross-subtask memory hand-off, and present WeaveLA (Weave Latent memory for Vision-Language-Action policies), a cross-subtask memory interface that, on top of a frozen VLA backbone, compresses each completed segment into latent tokens via query-driven attention pooling and routes them directly into the action-generation path of the next sub-task. This event-triggered, action-side design preserves the base policy's short-window interface while adding a lightweight cross-subtask channel. Through stratified evaluation on RoboMME with a $π_{0.5}$ backbone, WeaveLA's gains land exactly where the channel is needed: on the hardest repetition slice (SwingXtimes, $N{=}3$), success rises from $0\%$ to $47.8\%$, while single-execution episodes remain unchanged. Per-episode paired analysis confirms the gains are confined to tasks whose causal structure requires cross-subtask information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WeaveLA，一种事件驱动的跨子任务潜在记忆接口，用于重复机器人操作中的视觉-语言-动作策略。该方法在冻结的 VLA 骨干上，通过查询驱动的注意力池化将每个已完成子段压缩为潜在令牌，并直接路由到下一子任务的动作生成路径。在 RoboMME 上使用 π0.5 骨干的评估显示，在最具挑战性的重复操作切片中成功率从 0% 提升至 47.8%，而单次执行任务保持不变。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 策略在单步操作上表现良好，但缺乏明确的跨子任务信息路由通道，导致在依赖先前步骤的重复任务中表现脆弱。
Method: 提出 WeaveLA，利用子目标完成事件触发跨子任务记忆传递：通过查询驱动的注意力池化将完成段压缩为潜在令牌，并直接注入下一子任务的动作专家路径，同时保持基础的短窗口 VLA 骨干不变。
Result: 在 RoboMME 上使用 π0.5 骨干的实验中，在 SwingXtimes（N=3）重复切片上，成功率从 0% 升至 47.8%，而单次执行任务的成功率未受影响。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，WeaveLA 的事件触发设计使得跨子任务信息只在需要时传递，且增益集中在因果结构依赖先前信息的任务上。

papers.title: ResAware: Cross-Environment Website Fingerprinting via Resource-Privileged Distillation
papers.abstract_en: While Website Fingerprinting (WF) attacks achieve high accuracy in controlled laboratory settings, they often degrade substantially in real-world environments due to spatio-temporal drift, browser heterogeneity, proxy obfuscation and etc. This limitation stems from their sole reliance on low-level traffic features that are noisy and highly sensitive to environmental perturbations. To address this problem, we propose \textbf{ResAware}, a cross-environment resource-aware distillation framework under a \textit{training-rich/inference-poor} asymmetric setting. Specifically, ResAware trains a teacher model on resource-level features, and then distills the resulting privileged knowledge into a student model through heterogeneous knowledge distillation. At deployment time, the student model performs inference using only encrypted traffic, incurring zero additional cost. We evaluate ResAware on a large-scale dataset collected over five months from six globally distributed vantage points, comprising more than $160{,}000$ paired samples. The results show that ResAware significantly enhances the cross-environment robustness of diverse WF baselines. Under a 150-day temporal drift, for example, ResAware improves the F1-score of Var-CNN from $72.77\%$ to $81.49\%$ and the open-world $TPR@1\%FPR$ from $22.40\%$ to $27.20\%$. Our results demonstrate that resource-level supervision improves WF robustness without expanding online observation capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ResAware，一种基于资源特权知识蒸馏的跨环境网站指纹识别（WF）框架，解决实验室高精度模型在实际环境中因时间漂移、浏览器异构、代理混淆等导致的性能下降问题。ResAware 利用资源级特征训练教师模型，并通过异构知识蒸馏将特权知识传递给学生模型，部署时学生仅使用加密流量进行推理。在五个月跨度、六个全球观测点收集的超过16万对样本上，ResAware 显著提升了多种 WF 基线模型的跨环境鲁棒性，例如在150天时间漂移下将 Var-CNN 的 F1 分数从72.77%提升至81.49%。
Motivation: 现有网站指纹识别攻击在实验室环境下精度高，但在真实环境中因时空漂移、浏览器差异、代理混淆等退化严重，原因是它们仅依赖低层流量特征，这些特征噪声大且对环境扰动敏感。
Method: 提出 ResAware，在“训练丰富/推理贫乏”的非对称设定下，使用资源级特征训练教师模型，再通过异构知识蒸馏将特权知识传递给学生模型；部署时学生模型仅使用加密流量，无额外开销。
Result: 在五个月、六个全球观测点收集的16万对样本上，ResAware 提升了多种 WF 基线的跨环境鲁棒性，例如150天时间漂移下 Var-CNN 的 F1 分数从72.77%提升至81.49%，开放世界 TPR@1%FPR 从22.40%提升至27.20%。
Conclusion: 资源级监督能够在不扩展在线观测能力的情况下提升 WF 鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AUTOGATE: Automated Clock Gating via Toggling-Aware LLM-based RTL Rewriting
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grain clock gating (FGCG) is among the most effective techniques for reducing dynamic power, yet current FGCG optimization flows remain largely manual. Recent LLM-based RTL optimization approaches remain limited by two key drawbacks: (1) the inability to process long waveform traces spanning millions of cycles, and (2) the difficulty of scaling optimization to large hierarchical codebases while preserving correctness. In this work, we present AUTOGATE, the first agentic framework for industry-grade RTL power optimization, enabling workload-aware clock-gating optimization across large hierarchical codebases. AUTOGATE introduces a Machine Learning (ML)-LLM co-design that bridges waveform-level analysis and RTL rewriting. Specifically, we design an ML-based clustering algorithm that distills raw toggling traces into compact, structured representations that guide LLM-based RTL rewriting. This enables accurate identification and application of clock-gating opportunities without requiring LLMs to directly process raw waveform data. To enhance scalability, AUTOGATE employs a hierarchical multi-agent architecture that decomposes large designs into independently optimizable modules, enabling coordinated optimization across deep design hierarchies. We evaluate AUTOGATE on a diverse set of designs ranging from small RTL designs to large industrial-grade codebases. Experimental results show that AUTOGATE consistently reduces dynamic power relative to baselines. Across the small-design suite, AUTOGATE reduces dynamic power by 49.31% on average. On industry-scale designs, it achieves 19.34% and 7.96% dynamic power reductions on NVDLA and BlackParrot, respectively, and up to 6.86% on highly optimized proprietary production designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AUTOGATE 是一个用于工业级 RTL 功耗优化的自动化框架，通过 ML-LLM 协同设计实现工作负载感知的时钟门控优化，无需 LLM 直接处理原始波形数据，并在小规模设计和工业级设计上分别实现了平均 49.31% 和高达 19.34% 的动态功耗降低。
Motivation: 细粒度时钟门控 (FGCG) 是降低动态功耗的有效技术，但现有流程高度依赖人工；基于 LLM 的 RTL 优化方法无法处理数百万周期的长波形迹线，也难以在保持正确性的同时扩展到大型层次化代码库。
Method: 提出 AUTOGATE，一个基于多智能体架构的框架，其中 ML 聚类算法将原始翻转迹线蒸馏为紧凑的结构化表示，以指导 LLM 驱动的 RTL 重写；层次化多智能体架构将大型设计分解为可独立优化的模块，实现跨深层次设计层次的协调优化。
Result: 在小规模设计集上平均降低动态功耗 49.31%；在工业级设计上，对 NVDLA 和 BlackParrot 分别降低 19.34% 和 7.96%，对高度优化的专有生产设计降低高达 6.86%。
Conclusion: AUTOGATE 证明了 ML-LLM 协同设计在工业级 RTL 功耗优化中的有效性，实现了工作负载感知的自动时钟门控优化，无需 LLM 直接处理原始波形数据。

papers.title: Operator Boosting Produces Pareto-Efficient PDE Surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators are widely used as surrogate solution maps for partial differential equations (PDEs), but full-size models can be costly to store, deploy, and evaluate in many-query scientific workflows. This work introduces Operator Boosting, a stagewise residual-learning framework for constructing compact neural-operator surrogates directly, rather than training a large model and compressing it afterward. Starting from the empirical mean predictor in normalized output coordinates, the method trains a sequence of tiny same-family neural operators on residual fields and incorporates each correction through validation-selected shrinkage. We instantiate the framework with Fourier neural operators (FNOs), DeepONets, and convolutional neural operators (CNOs), and compare boosted tiny stacks against full-size monolithic baselines across one-, two-, and three-dimensional PDE benchmarks from PDEBench, APEBench, and The Well. Across 30 dataset-architecture pairs, 21 show positive mean accuracy gains and 17 have positive confidence intervals, while all boosted stacks reduce trainable parameter count by approximately 72-95%. Best-model comparisons show empirical Pareto improvements on 7 of 10 completed PDE benchmarks, including two-dimensional Navier-Stokes, shallow-water dynamics, Darcy flow, one-dimensional transport and reaction systems, and three-dimensional compressible Navier-Stokes. These results show that Operator Boosting often improves the empirical accuracy-parameter Pareto frontier of neural PDE surrogates, while also exposing PDE- and architecture-dependent regimes where residual boosting fails to offset compression.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Preprint submitted to Elsevier
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Operator Boosting 框架，通过分阶段残差学习直接构建紧凑的神经算子代理模型，替代先训练大模型再压缩的范式。在从 PDEBench、APEBench 和 The Well 选取的 30 个数据集-架构对中，该方法在大多数情况下提升了准确率，同时将可训练参数减少约 72-95%，并在 7 个 PDE 基准上实现了经验帕累托改进。
Motivation: 全尺寸神经算子模型在科学计算中存储、部署和评估成本高昂，现有方法需要先训练大模型再压缩，不直接且可能损失精度。
Method: 提出 Operator Boosting 框架：从归一化输出坐标的经验均值预测器开始，在残差场上训练一系列同族小神经算子，并通过验证集选择的收缩参数整合每次修正。实例化使用 FNO、DeepONet 和 CNO 三种架构。
Result: 在 30 个数据集-架构对中，21 个显示出平均准确率提升，17 个置信区间为正；所有增强堆栈的可训练参数减少 72-95%。在 10 个 PDE 基准中，7 个（包括二维 Navier-Stokes、浅水动力学、达西流、一维输运和反应系统、三维可压缩 Navier-Stokes）实现了经验帕累托改进。
Conclusion: Operator Boosting 通常能改善 PDE 代理的经验准确率-参数帕累托边界，但也揭示了残差增强在某些 PDE 和架构下无法补偿压缩的局限性。

papers.title: Can LLMs Be CEOs? Benchmarking Strategic Resource Reallocation with Multi-Role Agent Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating the decision-making capabilities of large language models (LLMs) is a growing research priority, yet existing benchmarks focus on isolated cognitive tasks such as reasoning, knowledge retrieval, and economic rationality in stylized settings. These evaluations overlook the defining challenge of real executive decision-making: integrating conflicting recommendations from specialized stakeholders under information asymmetry, organizational constraints, and temporal dependencies. We introduce \textsc{CEO-Bench}, a multi-agent benchmark that evaluates LLMs on CEO-level strategic resource reallocation -- the process of redirecting capital across business units in a multi-round, constraint-rich organizational environment. In \textsc{CEO-Bench}, LLM agents receive conflicting advice from four role-conditioned C-suite advisors (CFO, CTO, COO, CMO), each with private signals and distinct priorities, and must synthesize these into a concrete allocation plan evaluated along four dimensions: role integration, conditional boldness, history-sensitive judgment, and plan validity. Experiments across five frontier models on 13 scenarios reveal that all models achieve high structural validity but diverge sharply on strategic calibration -- the hardest capability layer. We identify systematic failure modes including single-advisor capture, conservative default under ambiguity, and historical amnesia, and uncover a structural integration-boldness tradeoff: models that engage more deeply with conflicting perspectives tend to produce less decisive action. These findings delineate the current capability boundary of LLMs as organizational decision-makers and inform the design of future AI-assisted executive systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CEO-Bench，一个多智能体基准，用于评估 LLM 在 CEO 级别的战略资源重新分配决策能力。LLM 代理需要综合四位 C 级顾问（CFO、CTO、COO、CMO）的冲突建议，在多方信息不对称和组织约束下制定资本分配计划。实验发现前沿模型在结构有效性上表现良好，但在战略校准上差异显著，并识别出单顾问捕获、模糊下保守默认和历史遗忘等系统故障模式。
Motivation: 现有基准侧重孤立认知任务，忽视了现实高管决策中整合冲突信息、处理组织约束和时间依赖性的核心挑战。
Method: 设计多轮约束丰富的组织环境，LLM 代理接收四位角色化 C 级顾问的冲突建议（各有私人信号和优先事项），需合成具体分配计划，从角色整合、条件大胆性、历史敏感性判断和计划有效性四个维度评估。

papers.title: Dissecting model behavior through agent trajectories
papers.abstract_en: AI agent performance is not just a modeling problem, it is fundamentally a systems problem. The advanced capabilities of models are realized through agent harnesses. Therefore, a gap between model assumptions and harness behavior can easily prevent the model's full capabilities from translating into agent performance. We formalize this as the `intent-execution' gap: the mismatch between what the model intends and what the harness executes, and vice versa. We argue that minimizing this intent-execution gap is as important as other aspects of harness design such as tools and execution loops. To illustrate the impact of this harness-model alignment, we develop a simple and customizable harness called `Simple Strands Agent' (SSA). SSA aims to find the bulk of common patterns which generalize across different model families (such as Claude, Gemini, GPT, Grok, Qwen), as well as a small number of model-specific preferences. We make two contributions: (i) we $\textbf{reproduce or improve on the pass@1}$ performance reported by diverse model-provider families on popular agentic benchmarks (SWE-Pro, SWE-Verified and Terminal-Bench-2), and (ii) building on an $\textbf{analysis of 138k trajectories generated by SSA}$, we look beyond the $\texttt{pass@1}$ numbers which tend to be relatively even across frontier models. By representing agent trajectories in code state-spaces, we observe model-level differences in problem-solving behavior. Finer-grained metrics such as edit frequency, testing activity, and phase-transitions reveal how individual models allocate effort across different stages of autonomous problem solving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“意图-执行差距”（intent-execution gap）概念，指模型意图与agent夹具（harness）执行之间的不匹配。作者开发了名为Simple Strands Agent (SSA)的简单可定制夹具，在SWE-Pro、SWE-Verified和Terminal-Bench-2等流行agent基准上复现或改进了pass@1性能。基于SSA生成的138k轨迹，通过代码状态空间表示，观察到不同模型（如Claude、Gemini、GPT、Grok、Qwen）在问题解决行为上的细粒度差异，如编辑频率、测试活动和相位转换。
Motivation: AI agent性能不仅是建模问题，更是系统问题。模型能力通过agent夹具实现，但模型假设与夹具行为之间的差距会抑制模型潜力。因此需要形式化并最小化该意图-执行差距。
Method: 开发Simple Strands Agent (SSA)夹具，用于捕捉跨模型家族的通用模式及少数模型特定偏好。通过分析138k轨迹，在代码状态空间中表征agent行为，并引入编辑频率、测试活动、相位转换等细粒度指标。
Result: 在SWE-Pro、SWE-Verified和Terminal-Bench-2基准上复现或改进pass@1性能；细粒度分析揭示了不同模型在问题解决行为中的差异。
Conclusion: 最小化意图-执行差距与工具和执行循环等夹具设计同等重要。轨迹分析比单一pass@1指标更深入揭示模型行为差异。

papers.title: MapSatisfyBench: Benchmarking Satisfaction-Aware Map Agents through Behavior-Grounded Implicit Decision Factors
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are increasingly integrated into map services. Since map services are embedded in everyday-life scenarios rather than professional task settings, users often express their needs informally, resulting in underspecified queries with many unspoken needs, namely, implicit decision factors that are critical for user satisfaction. Although clarification is an effective way to mitigate this issue, it increases user burden in daily interaction, and a capable agent should first proactively recover such factors from available information sources. However, evaluating this ability is challenging. The first challenge is to determine which implicit decision factors are suitable for evaluation. A factor is evaluable only if it affects user acceptance and can be recovered from information available to the agent before it responds. Second, user satisfaction cannot be reliably represented by a single reference answer, requiring a benchmark that converts satisfaction-relevant factors into objective and quantifiable evaluation targets. To address these challenges, we propose a restore-identify-filter framework that reconstructs complete user needs from behavior-chain evidence, identifies implicit decision factors, and retains only those supported by pre-query evidence. Building on this methodology, we construct MapSatisfyBench from large-scale, real-world anonymized user data and annotate ground truth from five dimensions and enables full-chain evaluation of satisfaction-aware map agents. Experiments show that current agents generally perform well on explicit task completion, but remain limited in satisfying implicit decision factors and proactively acquiring the evidence needed for satisfaction-aware decisions. These findings establish MapSatisfyBench as a benchmark for shifting map-agent evaluation from task completion toward satisfaction-aware spatial decision making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MapSatisfyBench基准，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能地图代理在满足用户隐含决策因素（implicit decision factors）方面的能力。该基准基于真实用户数据，从五个维度标注用户满意度，并支持全链路评估。实验表明，当前代理在显式任务完成上表现良好，但在隐含决策因素满足方面存在不足。
Motivation: 地图服务中的用户查询往往非正式且隐含大量未表达的需求（隐含决策因素），现有评估仅关注显式任务完成，无法衡量用户满意度。需要一个能客观量化满意度相关因素的基准。
Method: 提出一个恢复-识别-过滤框架（restore-identify-filter framework），从行为链证据中重构用户完整需求，识别隐含决策因素，并保留仅由查询前证据支持的因素。基于此构建MapSatisfyBench，从五个维度标注真实用户数据的满意度真值。
Result: 实验显示，当前智能代理在显式任务完成上表现良好，但在满足隐含决策因素和主动获取满意度所需证据方面能力有限。
Conclusion: MapSatisfyBench将地图代理的评估从任务完成转向满意度感知的空间决策。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Credibility-Weighted Pricing of Autonomous Vehicle Liability Under Operational Design Domain Shift
papers.abstract_en: Automated Driving System deployments create a foundational ratemaking challenge: sparse experience, shifting operational design domains, and non-stationary risk across software releases. We propose a hierarchical Bayesian credibility framework pooling across cities, software versions, and territories via a learned ODD-similarity kernel, nesting Buhlmann-Straub as a limiting case. Demonstrated on 648 verified-engaged Waymo crashes across four U.S. metros from the NHTSA Standing General Order database against 116 million matched miles, city-aggregate credibility weights are moderate (0.12-0.46), partial pooling decisively outperforms no pooling, and a power analysis shows the learned kernel's advantage becomes detectable at approximately twelve deployed cities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶系统部署中的费率制定挑战（稀疏经验、操作设计域变化、非平稳风险），提出一个层次贝叶斯可信度框架，通过学习的ODD相似性核（ODD-similarity kernel）在城市、软件版本和区域之间进行部分池化，将Bühlmann-Straub模型作为极限情况。在Waymo的648起确认介入碰撞数据和1.16亿匹配里程上的实验表明，城市层面的可信度权重适中（0.12-0.46），部分池化显著优于无池化，且功效分析显示学习核的优势在约12个部署城市时变得可检测。
Motivation: 现有费率制定方法难以处理自动驾驶系统的稀疏经验、非平稳风险以及操作设计域（ODD）的不断变化，需要一种能够跨城市和软件版本进行有效信息共享的定价框架。
Method: 提出层次贝叶斯可信度框架，利用学习的ODD相似性核来度量不同城市/版本之间的相似性，从而实现部分池化。该框架嵌套Bühlmann-Straub模型作为特例。
Result: 在Waymo数据集上，城市聚合可信度权重为0.12-0.46，部分池化明显优于无池化。功效分析表明，当部署城市数量达到约12个时，学习核的优势变得可检测。
Conclusion: 该框架能够有效利用跨城市和软件版本的有限数据，为自动驾驶责任保险提供更合理的费率制定依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Machine-Learned Comorbidity Index
papers.abstract_en: Traditional comorbidity scores (e.g., Charlson and Elixhauser) are widely used for risk adjustment and patient stratification, but they have two key limitations: (i) they are largely mortality-centric and do not align well with other clinical outcomes, and (ii) their linear, rule-based structure cannot capture nonlinear, outcome-specific risk relationships. We propose a Machine-Learned Comorbidity Index (MLCI) that maps diagnosis codes to a single scalar by maximizing the normalized Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (nHSIC) between the learned score and multiple clinical outcomes. MLCI captures nonlinear risk-outcome dependence and is supported by a theory that characterizes when a unified, informative admission-level ordering can be achieved across outcomes. Empirical results on multiple benchmark electronic health record (EHR) datasets show that MLCI outperforms strong baselines across multiple evaluation metrics.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026), Seoul, South Korea. 35 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种机器学习驱动的共病指数（MLCI），通过最大化标准化希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（nHSIC）将诊断代码映射为单一标量，以捕获非线性风险-结果依赖关系，并在多个EHR数据集上优于传统基线。
Motivation: 传统共病评分（如Charlson和Elixhauser）主要基于死亡率，且为线性规则结构，无法捕捉非线性、结果特异的风险关系，限制了其在其他临床结局中的应用。
Method: 提出MLCI，通过学习诊断代码到标量的映射，最大化学习得分与多个临床结局之间的nHSIC，从而实现非线性依赖捕获，并具有理论支持。
Result: 在多个基准EHR数据集上，MLCI在多个评估指标上优于强基线。
Conclusion: MLCI提供了一种统一、信息丰富的入院级别排序，可跨不同临床结局使用，弥补了传统方法的局限。

papers.title: MODE-RAG: Manifold Outlier Diagnosis and Energy-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: While Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (M-RAG) enhances Large Vision-Language Models, it remains highly susceptible to cross-modal hallucinations, causal fabrications, and sycophancy. Furthermore, existing mitigation pipelines often face an intervention paradox: static rules tend to unnecessarily disrupt accurate generations, whereas leaving the multi-modal reasoning completely unguided allows existing mismatches to cascade into severe logical fabrications. To quantify and mitigate these hallucinations, we propose a Multi-Agent system, MODE-RAG, driven by Variational Free Energy (VFE) and internal attention states to dynamically gate interventions. High-risk queries are routed to five stage-specific agents, integrating Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) for rigorous causal derivation and logit perturbations to penalize sycophancy. Dedicated Correction and Overseer agents ensure formatting stability and perform post-hoc factual verification. To objectively evaluate our approach, we introduce ModeVent, a challenging subset derived from the MultiVent dataset. Extensive experiments indicate that our system effectively reduces hallucination rates and logical fabrication, significantly improving the robustness of M-RAG systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MODE-RAG，一个基于变分自由能（VFE）和内部注意力状态的多智能体系统，用于动态门控干预以减少多模态RAG中的跨模态幻觉、因果捏造和谄媚。系统引入蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）进行因果推导，并通过logit扰动惩罚谄媚。同时提出ModeVent子集用于客观评估。实验表明该方法有效降低了幻觉率和逻辑捏造。
Motivation: 多模态RAG易受跨模态幻觉、因果捏造和谄媚影响，现有缓解管道存在干预矛盾：静态规则不必要地中断准确生成，而完全无引导的多模态推理导致不匹配级联成严重逻辑捏造。
Method: 提出多智能体系统MODE-RAG，通过变分自由能（VFE）和内部注意力状态动态门控干预。高风险查询路由至五个阶段特定智能体，集成蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）进行因果推导，并通过logit扰动惩罚谄媚。使用修正智能体和监督智能体确保格式稳定和事后事实验证。
Result: 摘要报告系统有效降低幻觉率和逻辑捏造，显著提升M-RAG系统的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 本文通过基于能量（VFE）的动态干预方法缓解多模态RAG中的多种幻觉，并引入ModeVent基准进行评估。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 本文通过基于能量（VFE）的动态干预方法缓解多模态RAG中的多种幻觉，并引入ModeVent基准进行评估。

papers.title: AnnotateAnything: Automatic Annotation of 3D Assets for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Simulation enables scalable robot data collection, but raw 3D assets provide only geometry, lacking the semantic, interactive, and physical knowledge needed to specify where and how robots should act. In this work, we present AnnotateAnything, a general automatic annotation framework that converts passive 3D assets into manipulation-ready assets with structured, diverse, and executable manipulation labels. AnnotateAnything is built around two complementary pipelines. First, a unified visual-language annotation pipeline using vision-language reasoning to infer object semantics, interaction constraints, and 3D-grounded cues, providing human-prior guidance for identifying meaningful interaction regions. Second, a fully automatic and massively parallel physics annotation pipeline grounds these priors in each asset's geometry and physical constraints through candidate generation, geometry optimization and trajectory generation. This pipeline produces diverse and executable action annotations, including grasp poses, dexterous contacts, articulation waypoints, insertion directions, hanging affordances, and navigation targets. Using the generated annotations, we further build an asynchronous parallel simulation data-collection system across diverse objects, tasks, and robot embodiments. Experiments demonstrate that AnnotateAnything achieves superior annotation efficiency, data-collection efficiency, and task success rates over existing annotation and data-generation pipelines, while also supporting downstream tasks such as affordance detection, robotic VQA, and visual instruction finetuning. We provide project materials on the project page and plan to release the full code, annotations, and benchmark to facilitate future research. Videos, code, demo assets, and annotations are provided in supplementary materials Project page: https://tourmaline-caramel-169490.netlify.app.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnnotateAnything，一种自动将 3D 资产转换为可操作标注的通用框架，包含视觉-语言标注和物理标注两条互补流水线，生成抓取姿态、灵巧接触、关节路径、插入方向、悬挂功能和导航目标等多样的动作标注。实验表明其在标注效率、数据收集效率和任务成功率上优于现有方法，并支持下游任务如可供性检测、机器人 VQA 和视觉指令微调。
Motivation: 原始 3D 资产仅包含几何信息，缺乏语义、交互和物理知识，无法直接用于指定机器人如何与环境交互，限制了仿真数据收集的可扩展性。
Method: 构建两条流水线：1) 视觉-语言标注流水线，利用视觉-语言推理推断对象语义、交互约束和 3D 接地线索；2) 全自动并行物理标注流水线，通过候选生成、几何优化和轨迹生成将先验锚定到几何和物理约束中，产生多样可执行的动作标注。
Result: AnnotateAnything 在标注效率、数据收集效率和任务成功率上超越现有标注和数据生成流水线；生成的标注可用于可供性检测、机器人 VQA 和视觉指令微调等下游任务。
Conclusion: AnnotateAnything 作为通用自动标注框架，能将静态 3D 资产转化为支持多样机器人操作任务的标注，未来计划发布完整代码、标注和基准以推动研究。

papers.title: Toward Controllable Catalyst Inverse Design via Large-Scale Autoregressive Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Inverse design of heterogeneous catalysts remains challenging because catalyst surfaces exhibit substantial structural complexity with coupled surface-adsorbate interactions across a vast chemical space that is difficult to explore efficiently through conventional screening alone. Although machine learning-based high-throughput screening has accelerated catalyst discovery, its efficiency inevitably declines as the search space grows, motivating the development of generative models that can directly construct catalysts with target properties. Here, we present a conditional catalyst generative model based on the Generative Pretrained Transformer architecture with a numerical embedding layer that enables the generation of catalyst structures conditioned on both categorical and continuous properties within a single autoregressive framework. The model was pretrained on 133 million catalyst structures and subsequently fine-tuned on approximately 460,000 optimized structures with associated categorical properties and binding energies for conditional generation. The resulting model achieved 98% structural validity, 95% optimization validity, and high categorical condition fidelity, with a 93 % joint match rate for adsorbate type and composition. For binding energy conditioning, the match rate of approximately 20% represents a four-fold improvement over the baseline training distribution, and the generated distributions shift systematically toward the target values, enabling a 1.5 to 4-fold improvement in screening efficiency for reaction-targeted catalyst discovery without additional fine-tuning. These results show that large-scale autoregressive pre-training, combined with explicit property conditioning, provides a practical route toward controllable catalyst generation and accelerated catalysts discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对异相催化剂逆设计中结构复杂、搜索空间大的问题，提出基于GPT架构的条件催化剂生成模型。模型通过数值嵌入层在单一自回归框架中同时处理类别和连续属性条件，在1.33亿催化剂结构上预训练，并在约46万优化结构上微调。生成的结构有效性达98%，优化有效性95%，吸附质与组成联合匹配率93%；对于结合能条件，匹配率约20%，相比基线提升4倍，筛选效率提升1.5-4倍。
Motivation: 异相催化剂逆设计面临表面结构复杂、耦合作用多、化学空间巨大的挑战，传统高通量筛选效率随搜索空间增大而下降，亟需能直接生成目标属性催化剂的生成模型。
Method: 基于Generative Pretrained Transformer架构，引入数值嵌入层，使模型能在单一自回归框架中同时以类别属性（如吸附质类型）和连续属性（如结合能）为条件生成催化剂结构。模型先在1.33亿催化剂结构上预训练，后在约46万优化结构及其属性上微调。
Result: 生成的结构有效性98%，优化有效性95%，吸附质与组成联合匹配率93%；结合能条件匹配率约20%（较基线提升4倍），生成分布系统性地向目标值偏移，使反应靶向催化剂筛选效率提升1.5-4倍。
Conclusion: 大规模自回归预训练结合显式属性条件化，为可控催化剂生成和加速发现提供了实用途径。

papers.title: Incumbent Advantage: Brand Bias and Cognitive Manipulation Dynamics in LLM Recommendation Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming a major way for consumers to find products, but we do not yet understand how brands compete in this new channel. We study brand dynamics in LLM recommendations using skincare products -- a category where consumers cannot easily judge quality before buying and must rely on brand reputation -- across three commercial LLMs (GPT-4o-mini, Claude Sonnet, Gemini 3 Flash), with a robustness check on search goods. In three experiments, we find: (1) a Conditional Monopoly where well-known brands get recommended 100% of the time (IAI = 10.0) when all products have the same specifications, but this dominance disappears with less than a +0.1-star rating advantage for a competitor; (2) authority-style marketing language, including fabricated clinical-evidence claims, breaks this monopoly at a Bias Surplus Value equal to +0.17 rating points, with each model responding differently; and (3) a social dilemma in multi-brand GEO competition: when all brands adopt the same optimization strategy, individual payoff falls from +0.802 to +0.007 in our payoff proxy, and non-participating brands receive zero recommendations in our tests. Our results suggest that generative engine optimization (GEO) should be studied not only as a security risk, but also as an emerging marketing practice that shapes market competition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过护肤品类别在三个商业LLM（GPT-4o-mini、Claude Sonnet、Gemini 3 Flash）中的推荐实验，研究品牌动态。发现知名品牌在相同规格下获得100%推荐（条件垄断），但竞争对手仅需+0.1星优势即可打破垄断；权威式营销语言（含虚构临床证据）可打破垄断，其偏差剩余价值相当于+0.17评分点；多品牌GEO竞争时个体收益从0.802降至0.007，未参与品牌获得零推荐。
Motivation: LLM正成为消费者发现产品的主要渠道，但品牌如何在这一新渠道中竞争尚不明确。
Method: 使用三种商业LLM（GPT-4o-mini、Claude Sonnet、Gemini 3 Flash），以护肤品（经验品）为实验品类，并辅以耐用品（搜寻品）进行稳健性检验，设计三项实验分析品牌推荐率、营销语言影响及多品牌GEO竞争。
Result: （1）相同规格下知名品牌获得100%推荐（IAI=10.0），竞争对手低于+0.1星优势时垄断消失；（2）权威式营销语言（含虚构临床证据）可打破垄断，偏差剩余价值约+0.17评分点，不同模型响应不同；（3）多品牌GEO竞争存在社会困境：所有品牌采用相同优化策略时个体收益从+0.802降至+0.007，未参与品牌获得零推荐。
Conclusion: 生成引擎优化（GEO）不仅应被视为安全风险，还应被视为一种影响市场竞争的新兴营销实践。

papers.title: Contact-Based Fringe Projection Profilometry for High-Resolution 3-D Surface Measurement of Reflective and Transparent Objects
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a contact-based 3-D surface measurement method based on a Digital Fringe Projection (DFP) system, belonging to the vision-based tactile sensing family pioneered by the commercially successful GelSight sensor. Such sensors have proven effective for robotic fingertip manipulation and contact sensing. However, because GelSight employs photometric stereo with RGB LEDs, it does not measure absolute depth directly but instead infers it by integrating estimated surface gradients, which can accumulate reconstruction errors; in addition, it becomes increasingly difficult to calibrate as the sensing area grows, and its depth accuracy is challenged on highly reflective or transparent objects. To overcome these drawbacks, we propose a fringe-projection-based contact measurement technique that performs triangulation-based 3-D reconstruction on a coated silicone contact surface, providing dense per-pixel surface geometry and full-field 3-D shape measurement over the contact region. By integrating high-accuracy digital fringe projection into the sensor, our approach simplifies calibration over larger areas and enhances depth precision for complex surfaces. Experimental results, including a direct comparison with a GelSight Mini sensor, a sphere-fitting accuracy evaluation, and an uncertainty analysis, confirm that the proposed method significantly improves the accuracy and stability of structured-light-based 3-D measurements, allowing reliable reconstruction of objects with diverse optical properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于数字条纹投影（DFP）的接触式3D表面测量方法，属于视觉触觉传感家族。该方法在涂覆硅胶的接触面上进行三角测量重建，提供密集的逐像素表面几何和全场3D形状，克服了GelSight传感器在绝对深度测量、大面积校准和反射/透明物体上的局限性，显著提高了精度和稳定性。
Motivation: 现有GelSight等视觉触觉传感器采用光度立体技术，不能直接测量绝对深度，通过积分表面梯度会累积重建误差，且随着传感面积增大校准困难，在反射或透明物体上深度精度不足。
Method: 将高精度数字条纹投影集成到接触式传感器中，对涂覆硅胶的接触表面投影条纹并进行三角测量，实现基于结构光的3D重建，简化了校准过程。
Result: 实验包括与GelSight Mini传感器的直接比较、球面拟合精度评估和不确定性分析，证实该方法显著提高了基于结构光的3D测量的精度和稳定性，能够可靠重建具有不同光学特性的物体。
Conclusion: 本文方法为反射和透明物体的高分辨率3D表面测量提供了一种精度更高、校准更简单的接触式解决方案。

papers.title: Spatio-Temporal Fusion Model for Standard View Classification of Echocardiographic Videos
papers.abstract_en: Automated classification of standard echocardiographic views is crucial for efficient clinical workflow but faces three main challenges. First, publicly available datasets are scarce and limited in scale and view coverage. Second, the performance of some modern video-level architectures for echocardiographic view classification remains underexplored. Third, some view categories exhibit highly similar spatial appearances, making single-frame features insufficient for discrimination, while heterogeneous frame quality complicates robust temporal information fusion. To address these challenges, we release the Echocardiographic Videos of Nine Views (EV9V) dataset, comprising 5,138 videos, 910,579 frames, and 9 standard views, which is, to the best of our knowledge, the largest publicly available echocardiography video dataset. Using EV9V, we systematically benchmark representative video classification architectures, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), and Transformers. Furthermore, we propose a Spatio-Temporal Fusion Model (STFM), an efficient dual-stream CNN-LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) framework that jointly captures spatial anatomical structures and temporal cardiac dynamics. The proposed framework leverages uncertainty-aware learning to preferentially sample representative video segments during training and evidence-based fusion during inference, improving robustness to variations in frame quality across echocardiographic videos. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance across diverse video classification models, validating the effectiveness of uncertainty-aware spatio-temporal learning for echocardiographic view classification. The code is available at https://github.com/bgx666/stfm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布了目前最大的公开超声心动图视频数据集EV9V，包含5138个视频、9个标准视图；系统比较了CNN、RNN和Transformer等视频分类架构；提出时空融合模型STFM，采用双流CNN-LSTM框架，结合不确定性感知学习和证据融合，提升对帧质量变化的鲁棒性。实验表明该方法在多种视频分类模型上具有竞争力。
Motivation: 超声心动图标准视图分类面临公开数据集稀缺、现代视频架构探索不足、相似视图空间特征难区分以及帧质量不一致导致时序融合困难等挑战。
Method: 发布EV9V数据集（5138视频，9视图）；提出STFM，一种双流CNN-LSTM框架，训练时利用不确定性感知学习优选代表性视频片段，推理时采用证据融合机制。
Result: 在EV9V上对多种视频分类模型进行基准测试，STFM达到竞争性能，验证了不确定性感知时空学习的有效性。
Conclusion: 不确定性感知的时空融合方法能有效处理超声心动图视频中的视图分类任务，代码已开源。

summary_sections.method: 发布EV9V数据集（5138视频，9视图）；提出STFM，一种双流CNN-LSTM框架，训练时利用不确定性感知学习优选代表性视频片段，推理时采用证据融合机制。
summary_sections.result: 在EV9V上对多种视频分类模型进行基准测试，STFM达到竞争性能，验证了不确定性感知时空学习的有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 不确定性感知的时空融合方法能有效处理超声心动图视频中的视图分类任务，代码已开源。

papers.title: UoU: A Universal Fingerprint Foundation Model Based on Large-Scale Unsupervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Fingerprint recognition is still dominated by task-specific pipelines, where enhancement, structural parsing, alignment, and matching are optimized in isolation. Although effective in narrow settings, this design limits representation reuse across sensors, qualities, and downstream applications. We therefore present UoU, short for ``a \textbf{U}niversal fingerprint foundation model based \textbf{o}n large-scale \textbf{U}nsupervised learning,'' which reframes fingerprint feature extraction as a domain-specific foundation-model problem. UoU is organized around a multi-level representation hierarchy spanning image restoration, structural fields, semantic tokens, point-level biometric entities, and compact global descriptors. Its training recipe combines a supervised cold start on precise annotations, large-scale weakly supervised refinement, and large-scale unsupervised consolidation, with the latter two stages iterated during large-scale training so that weak supervision broadens semantic coverage while unsupervised learning stabilizes correspondences, invariances, and representation geometry. Rather than treating fingerprint imagery as generic texture, UoU exploits domain-specific symmetries and intermediate structure, including orientation flow, periodic ridge patterns, sparse biometric entities, and spatial equivariance. The framework is intentionally architecture-agnostic: while the present study includes an initial transformer-based structured-prediction instantiation, the broader design supports multi-task learning, scalable model configurations, and downstream specialization for matching, alignment, enhancement, registration, and related fingerprint applications. This paper presents the technical motivation, system design, and validation protocol of UoU, and part of the baseline implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/XiongjunGuan/UoU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UoU，一个基于大规模无监督学习的通用指纹基础模型，通过多层级表示层次（包括图像恢复、结构场、语义令牌、点级生物实体和紧凑全局描述符）统一指纹特征提取。训练采用监督冷启动、弱监督精调和无监督巩固的迭代流程，利用指纹领域特有的对称性和中间结构（如方向流、周期脊模式）。该框架架构无关，支持多任务学习和下游应用，并提供了基线开源实现。
Motivation: 现有指纹识别依赖独立优化的任务特定流水线（增强、结构解析、对齐、匹配），限制了表征在不同传感器、质量和下游应用中的复用。
Method: 构建多层级表示层次（图像恢复、结构场、语义令牌、点级生物实体、全局描述符）；训练结合监督冷启动、大规模弱监督精调和大规模无监督巩固，后两阶段迭代进行以拓宽语义覆盖并稳定对应关系、不变性和表征几何。
Result: 论文展示了技术动机、系统设计和验证协议，并公开了部分基线实现。
Conclusion: UoU 将指纹特征提取重新定义为领域特定的基础模型问题，并验证了其通用性和可扩展性。

papers.title: MorphStrata: Layer-Specific Perturbations for Generating Morphence Students in Time-Series Moving Target Defense
papers.abstract_en: Time-series forecasting models remain vulnerable to gradient-based adversarial attacks while existing defense mechanisms typically incur a trade-off in robustness for bounded response and compute cost. The problem is pronounced in Moving Target Defense where maintaining multiple randomized model instances substantially exacerbates the training overhead. In this work, we introduce MorphStrata, a student generation strategy with selective, layer-specific stochastic noise injection that extends the traditional Morphence defense. MorphStrata uses a Transformer backbone as the teacher and perturbs randomly selected architectural blocks to create structured heterogeneity across student models in response to varied data distributions and threat models. We evaluate against vanilla Transformer and Morphence backbones on a suite of benchmarks including the Jena Climate, Electricity Load Diagrams, and Appliances Energy Prediction using FGSM, BIM and PGD attacks across multiple attack strengths. Across datasets and attack regimes, the proposed ensemble maintains comparable adversarial RMSE. Specifically, for high entropy, periodic datasets as in the case of the AEP data, MorphStrata achieves the lowest RMSE across all attacks and perturbation budgets, improving over the static baseline by up to 24.11% and 97.97% under FGSM and BIM respectively at an epsilon value of 0.5 over 30 randomized trials. Targeting the layers to generate MorphStrata students accounts for less than 1% increase in train-times over the Morphence MTD baseline for most of the experiments, while accounting for double digit gains in adversarial RMSE reduction. We also observe a positive correlation between higher pairwise L2 distance (among generated students) and overall defense effectiveness. In summary, MorphStrata maintains adversarial robustness as an MTD defense at marginal cost deltas when compared to existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MorphStrata，一种在时间序列移动目标防御中生成学生模型的策略，通过对 Transformer 骨干网的选择性、层特定随机噪声注入来创建结构异质性，以对抗梯度攻击。在多个数据集和攻击方法下，该方法在保持可比对抗 RMSE 的同时，训练开销增加小于 1%，并在高周期数据集上取得显著提升。
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测模型易受梯度攻击，而移动目标防御因维护多个随机模型实例导致计算开销大，需在鲁棒性与成本间权衡。
Method: MorphStrata 使用 Transformer 作为教师，随机扰动选定架构块以生成异构学生模型，形成集成防御。
Result: 在 Jena Climate、Electricity Load Diagrams、Appliances Energy Prediction 等基准上，对抗 FGSM、BIM、PGD 攻击，MorphStrata 保持可比 RMSE；在 AEP 数据集上，与静态基线相比，FGSM 下 RMSE 降低 24.11%，BIM 下降低 97.97%。
Conclusion: MorphStrata 以边际成本提升移动目标防御的对抗鲁棒性，且学生模型间的 L2 距离与防御效果正相关。

papers.title: LADBench: A Benchmark for Logical Fault Detection in Images
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual question answering and semantic grounding, but their capacity for autonomous logical reasoning remains underexplored. Existing anomaly benchmarks emphasize visual errors or direct prompting rather than the physical and social common sense needed for open-world deployment. To address this, we introduce LAD-bench, a benchmark of more than 1,000 curated synthetic images with logical anomalies across four domains: Residential, Urban, Collaborative, and Nature. We further propose a Tiered Prompting Protocol based on progressive disclosure, which measures how much explicit assistance a model needs to localize and reason about a logical fault. Evaluating leading foundation models reveals substantial weaknesses: even the best achieves only 70.11% overall accuracy, showing that implicit logical fault detection remains unsolved. Crucially, models often fail to identify anomalies even after receiving explicit hints in deeper tiers. By surfacing these limitations in sequential multimodal reasoning, LAD-Bench offers a rigorous framework for advancing the safety, reliability, and cognitive alignment of autonomous visual systems. Dataset and Code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SahasraK/LADBench
papers.comment: Accepted to the IEEE International Conference on Development and Learning (ICDL 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAD-bench，一个包含超过 1000 张合成图像的逻辑异常基准，涵盖住宅、城市、协作和自然四个领域，并引入分级提示协议 (Tiered Prompting Protocol) 来评估模型在逐步提示下的异常定位与推理能力。评估表明，最佳模型（大型视觉语言模型）的总体准确率仅为 70.11%，且即使在深层提示下仍常无法识别异常，揭示了现有模型在隐含逻辑故障检测方面的显著缺陷。
Motivation: 现有异常检测基准多关注视觉错误或直接提示，缺乏对物理和社会常识逻辑推理的评估，不适用于开放世界部署。
Method: 构建包含 1000 多张合成图像的数据集，覆盖四个领域；提出分级提示协议，通过渐进式信息披露测量模型需要多少显式帮助才能定位和推理逻辑故障。
Result: 评估多个基础模型，最佳准确率仅 70.11%，且模型在深层提示后仍常无法识别异常，表明隐含逻辑故障检测问题尚未解决。
Conclusion: LAD-Bench 通过揭示多模态顺序推理中的局限性，为提升自主视觉系统的安全性、可靠性和认知对齐提供了严格框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Edit3DGS: Unified Framework for Dynamic Head Editing via 2D Instruction-Guided Diffusion and 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: We present Edit3DGS, a unified framework for dynamic 3D head editing that integrates 2D instruction-guided diffusion with 3D Gaussian splatting. Unlike prior approaches that separately address frame-based edits or static 3D reconstruction, our method couples semantic controllability in the image domain with photorealistic, temporally consistent 3D representations. Given an input video, editable facial regions are masked and modified using a text-conditioned diffusion model to support fine-grained operations such as expression transformation, attribute modification, and appearance refinement. The edited frames are then aggregated through 3D Gaussian splatting to produce a coherent, high-fidelity avatar that preserves both identity and motion dynamics. To enforce consistency, Edit3DGS incorporates multi-view batch editing and lightweight inpainting strategies that recover lost expressions across timesteps. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework enables controllable, artifact-free head editing with smooth temporal transitions, offering practical applications in virtual avatars, immersive communication, film production, and interactive media.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Edit3DGS，一个将2D指令引导扩散与3D高斯溅射相结合的动态3D头部编辑统一框架。该方法通过文本条件扩散模型对视频中的人脸区域进行细粒度编辑（如表情变换、属性修改、外观优化），并通过3D高斯溅射重建出保真且时间一致的3D头像。实验表明该框架支持可控、无伪影的头部编辑，具有平滑的时间过渡。
Motivation: 现有方法分别处理基于帧的编辑或静态3D重建，缺乏既能保持语义可控性又能生成时间一致的动态3D头像的统一方案。
Method: 集成2D指令引导扩散与3D高斯溅射：输入视频后，先对人脸区域进行掩码并通过文本条件扩散模型编辑，再通过3D高斯溅射聚合编辑帧，并引入多视图批量编辑和轻量级修补策略以保持时间一致性。
Result: 实验表明Edit3DGS能实现可控、无伪影的头部编辑，具有平滑的时间过渡，适用于虚拟头像、沉浸式通信、影视制作和交互媒体。
Conclusion: Edit3DGS提供了一种统一的动态3D头部编辑框架，能够结合2D扩散模型的语义控制与3D高斯溅射的逼真重建。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Silhouette-Guided Animal Art
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI has advanced the ability to render photorealistic or artistic images, yet it remains limited in a key aspect of human creativity: interpreting ambiguous shapes. This phenomenon, rooted in pareidolia, allows humans to perceive meaningful forms in random patterns such as clouds, stones, or leaves. To computationally replicate this imaginative process, we introduce Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Visual-RAG), a framework that generates animal art directly from natural silhouettes. Our method retrieves structurally similar animal shapes from a curated corpus of 28,586 high-quality silhouettes and uses them as reference exemplars to guide diffusion-based generation with ControlNet and IP-Adapter. Ablation studies confirm that shape Context with RANSAC provides the most accurate alignment, while removing shape standardization reduces the inlier ratio to just 13.4\%, underscoring the importance of structural fidelity in Visual-RAG. A user study with 12 participants evaluated the outputs in terms of aesthetics, silhouette fidelity, and overall impression. Results reveal that while Visual-RAG provides plausible interpretations, challenges remain in achieving high perceptual impact. This work lays the foundation for computational pareidolia, showing how machines can contribute to the early stages of imaginative discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Visual-RAG 框架，从自然剪影生成动物艺术。该方法从包含 28,586 个高质量剪影的语料库中检索结构相似的动物形状，作为扩散模型（ControlNet 和 IP-Adapter）的参考。消融实验表明，使用 RANSAC 的形状上下文对齐最为准确，移除形状标准化会将内点比率降至 13.4%。12 名参与者的用户研究评估了输出在美学、剪影保真度和整体印象方面的表现，结果显示虽然 Visual-RAG 提供了合理的解释，但在实现高感知影响方面仍存在挑战。
Motivation: 现有生成式 AI 在渲染逼真或艺术图像方面取得进展，但在理解模糊形状（空想性错觉）方面仍有限，而人类能从云、石头等随机图案中感知有意义的形式。论文旨在计算化地复制这种想象过程。
Method: 提出 Visual-RAG 框架，通过检索与输入自然剪影结构相似的动物形状作为参考样例，引导基于扩散模型的生成（使用 ControlNet 和 IP-Adapter）。使用 RANSAC 进行形状上下文对齐，并采用形状标准化确保结构保真度。
Result: 消融实验显示，移除形状标准化后内点比率降至 13.4%，表明结构保真度在 Visual-RAG 中的重要性。用户研究（12 人）表明，输出在美学和剪影保真度方面尚可，但感知冲击力不足。
Conclusion: 该工作为计算空想性错觉奠定基础，展示了机器在想象发现早期阶段的贡献，但当前方法在生成高感知影响的图像方面仍有挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CIAN: Multi-Stage Framework for Event-Enriched Image Captioning via Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Event-enriched image captioning describes not only visible content but also the broader context of events, including timing, location, and participants, capabilities missing in most pixel-bound models. We propose the Contextual Image-Article Narrator (CIAN), a multi-stage framework that enriches captions with external narratives. CIAN retrieves relevant articles using SigLIP, summarizes them to guide a Narrative Generation stage with a LoRA-fine-tuned Qwen model, and applies N-Gram-based Refinement for fluency and coherence. On the OpenEvents-V1 benchmark, CIAN achieves high retrieval performance (mAP 0.979) and improves caption quality, increasing CIDEr from 0.030 to 0.094. These results highlight the effectiveness of retrieval-augmented reasoning combined with linguistic refinement for generating context-aware, human-like captions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CIAN（Contextual Image-Article Narrator），一个多阶段框架，通过检索外部文章（使用 SigLIP）并利用 LoRA 微调的 Qwen 模型生成叙事，再经 N-Gram 精炼，实现事件增强的图像描述。在 OpenEvents-V1 基准上，检索 mAP 达 0.979，CIDEr 从 0.030 提升至 0.094。
Motivation: 现有图像描述模型仅描述像素可见内容，缺乏对事件上下文（时间、地点、参与者）的表达能力。
Method: CIAN 包含三个阶段：1）利用 SigLIP 检索相关文章；2）LoRA 微调 Qwen 模型进行叙事生成；3）N-Gram 精炼提升流畅性和连贯性。
Result: 在 OpenEvents-V1 上，检索 mAP 达 0.979，CIDEr 从 0.030 提升至 0.094，表明检索增强推理与语言精炼可生成上下文感知的描述。
Conclusion: 摘要强调检索增强生成与语言精炼结合能有效生成类人且上下文丰富的图像描述。

papers.title: Impact of Hand Impairment and Occlusions on Hand Pose Estimation Accuracy in Augmented Reality Applications
papers.abstract_en: Mixed reality applications can be designed for hand rehabilitation. Augmented reality (AR) head mounted displays (HMDs) specifically allow for ecologically valid tasks because individuals can see their real environment and interact with real objects while receiving additional cues on the HMD. While these applications rely on accurate hand pose estimation, there is a gap in investigating the influence of hand impairment or occlusion from real-object interactions on pose estimation accuracy. Further, comparisons between AR HMD predictions and state-of-the-art pose estimation methods have not been established. The current study assessed pose estimation accuracy of the HoloLens 2 HMD and state-of-the-art pose estimation algorithms (WiLoR, HaMeR, WildHands, and MediaPipe) while individuals with cervical spinal cord injury (cSCI; n = 13, Neurological Level of Injury: C3-C6; American Spinal Injury Association Impairment Scale: A-D) and 15 uninjured controls interacted with clear and opaque objects. Ground truth estimates of 3D joint positions were generated via triangulation from a multi-camera setup. Pose estimation accuracy did not differ between the cSCI and uninjured control groups suggesting that 3D joint predictions from the HoloLens 2 and pose estimation algorithms can generalize to populations with hand impairment. Further, clear objects provided a small accuracy advantage over opaque objects (0.1 mm) and predictions from both WiLoR and HaMeR were slightly more accurate than the HoloLens 2 (2 mm). Overall, these results suggest that the HoloLens 2 may be viable for hand rehabilitation applications and the dataset generated can be used to refine pose estimation methods for hand-impaired populations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了HoloLens 2和四种姿态估计算法（WiLoR、HaMeR、WildHands、MediaPipe）在手部障碍和遮挡条件下的手部姿态估计精度，研究对象包括13名颈髓损伤患者和15名健康对照组。结果表明，组间精度无显著差异，透明物体比不透明物体精度高约0.1毫米，WiLoR和HaMeR比HoloLens 2精度高约2毫米，说明HoloLens 2可用于手部康复应用。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对手部障碍或真实物体交互遮挡对手部姿态估计精度影响的评估，且未比较AR头戴显示器与主流算法的精度。
Method: 使用多摄像头三角测量生成3D关节位置真值，让被试与透明和不透明物体交互，比较HoloLens 2和四种算法的预测精度。
Result: cSCI组与对照组精度无差异；透明物体比不透明物体精度高0.1毫米；WiLoR和HaMeR比HoloLens 2精度高约2毫米。
Conclusion: HoloLens 2在手部康复应用中可行，所生成数据集可用于改进针对手部障碍人群的姿态估计方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bounded Difference Concentration for Infinitely Exchangeable Sequences with Applications to AI Benchmark Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: We consider the concentration properties of functions of infinitely exchangeable random variables. By conditioning on the de Finetti directing measure, we show that the deviation of any function with bounded-difference constants $c_1, \dots, c_n$ decomposes into a conditional sampling fluctuation and a latent mixture fluctuation. When this latent mixture is $σ_{\mathrm{mix}}^2$-subgaussian, we establish a concentration inequality with an effective variance proxy of $\frac{1}{4}\sum_i c_i^2 + σ_{\mathrm{mix}}^2$. Crucially, we demonstrate that for zero-sum linear contrasts, such as the difference between a subsample mean and a full population mean, the latent mixture term cancels exactly. This cancellation yields a tight, mixture-free Hoeffding-type bound that provides a direct de Finetti mechanism for the infinite-extendibility limit of recent finite-exchangeable concentration results. We apply this framework to quantify uncertainty in composite AI benchmarks, such as MMLU, where question items naturally exhibit exchangeable dependence across domains. Our results provide both a domain-stratified hierarchical model for bounding the uncertainty of accuracy scores, and a distribution-free, cost-saving statistical guarantee for accurately estimating full benchmark scores from random subsets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无限可交换随机变量函数的集中性质，通过de Finetti测度分解，建立了有效方差为1/4∑c_i^2+σ_mix^2的集中不等式，并证明零和线性对比中潜变量项抵消，得到无混合的Hoeffding型界。该框架用于量化复合AI基准（如MMLU）的不确定性，提供分层模型和分布自由的统计保证。
Motivation: AI基准测试中问题项具有可交换依赖性，现有集中不等式忽略了潜变量波动，导致不确定性估计不准确。
Method: 利用de Finetti定理，将函数偏差分解为条件采样波动和潜变量混合波动；对潜变量施加次高斯条件，得到集中不等式；对于零和线性对比，证明潜变量项精确抵消，导出紧的Hoeffding型界。
Result: 建立了有效方差为1/4∑c_i^2+σ_mix^2的集中不等式；零和对比下获得无混合的Hoeffding界；应用于MMLU等基准，提供了域分层模型和子集估算全集的统计保证。
Conclusion: 理论框架为可交换随机变量函数的集中性提供了新刻画，可减少AI基准不确定性评估的计算成本。
Relevance: 0
