papers.title: Martingale Doppelgänger-Eval: An Identification Framework for Auditing Candlestick Understanding in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Martingale Doppelgänger-Eval, a public shadow-market benchmark for auditing whether vision-language models (VLMs) use candlestick evidence rather than extrapolate past trends. The central difficulty is identification: on real market histories, chart evidence and trend are strongly coupled, so an observational score cannot determine whether a fluent technical-analysis narrative is grounded in local visual evidence. We prove this limitation formally: no evaluation functional computed from observational chart--label data can distinguish a grounded responder from a trend-shortcut responder under strong coupling, whereas matched evidence interventions separate the same responders at an exponential rate and trend--label swaps provide an independent shortcut stress test. The benchmark therefore evaluates frozen VLMs on rendered OHLCV charts under four controlled mechanisms: a martingale-null market, injected-alpha counterfactual pairs, trend-confounder swaps, and regime shifts. A structural behavioral model identifies null-market bias, trend sensitivity, evidence sensitivity, prompt/renderer fragility, and evidence faithfulness; the accompanying statistical toolkit provides minimum detectable effects, block-aware sequential testing for metered APIs, and an overlap-weighted artifact check. Across frozen commercial and open VLMs, the identified regression assigns large positive coefficients to past trend but evidence coefficients that are zero or opposite to the rule-implied sign. Matched-pair analyses show that models either ignore injected candlestick semantics or move opposite to the rule-implied direction conditional on responding. The benchmark isolates a failure mode that standard observational chart benchmarks cannot detect and gives a reusable audit template for time-series imagery with controllable label mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 Martingale Doppelgänger-Eval，一个用于审计视觉语言模型（VLM）是否真正理解K线图证据而非依赖趋势的公开影子市场基准。作者形式化证明，在真实市场历史中图表证据与趋势强耦合，观测分数无法区分基于证据的响应与基于趋势捷径的响应，而设计的匹配证据干预能以指数速率区分它们。基准包含鞅零市场、注入alpha的反事实对、趋势混杂交换和制度转换四种控制机制，并结合结构行为模型和统计工具。实验发现，商业和开源VLM的回归系数对过去趋势为正，而对证据系数为零或与规则隐含符号相反，匹配对分析表明模型忽略或反向使用K线语义。
Motivation: 标准观测性基准无法区分VLM是否真正使用K线证据还是通过外推历史趋势来生成技术分析描述，因为市场历史中图表证据与趋势高度耦合，导致识别困难。
Method: 构建 Martingale Doppelgänger-Eval 基准，包含四种控制机制：鞅零市场（martingale-null market）、注入alpha的反事实对、趋势混杂交换（trend-confounder swaps）和制度转换（regime shifts）。配套结构行为模型识别空市场偏差、趋势敏感度、证据敏感度、提示/渲染脆弱性和证据忠实度，并提供最小可检测效应、分块顺序测试和重叠加权伪影检查等统计工具。
Result: 在冻结的商业和开源VLM上，识别回归显示过去趋势的系数大且为正，但证据系数为零或与规则隐含符号相反；匹配对分析表明模型要么忽略注入的K线语义，要么在条件响应时朝与规则隐含方向相反的方向移动。
Conclusion: 该基准隔离了标准观测性图表基准无法检测的失败模式，并为具有可控标签机制的时间序列图像提供了可复用的审计模板。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Feynman Kac Reweighted Schrödinger Bridge Matching for Surface-Based Tau PET Harmonization
papers.abstract_en: Tau PET imaging is central to tracking Alzheimer's disease progression, but systematic differences between scanners, protocols, and radiotracers across sites introduce nonbiological variability that inflates biomarker variance, reduces sensitivity to disease effects, and can bias downstream clinical assessments. Harmonization methods aim to remove these site-induced shifts while preserving biologically meaningful signal, yet existing approaches struggle when source and target cohorts differ in subgroup composition, risking conflation of site effects with biological variation such as tau-positivity status. We propose the Feynman Kac Reweighted Schröodinger Bridge Matching (FKRSBM) model to address this problem. Rather than routing data through a Gaussian noise prior as in diffusion-based methods, FKRSBM learns a direct stochastic transport process between source and target distributions via entropy-regularized optimal transport. To enforce biologically consistent transport, FKRSBM incorporates a subgroup-aware endpoint proposal derived from a Feynman Kac reweighting of the reference bridge measure, implemented entirely through stratified importance sampling at the data level and requiring no changes to the underlying bridge-matching solver or network architecture. For surface-based neuroimaging, FKRSBM employs a spherical convolutional backbone operating on cortical meshes to perform vertex-level harmonization. We evaluate the method on tau PET SUVR maps, harmonizing PI-2620 data from the HABS-HD cohort into the AV-1451 domain of ADNI. Compared against ComBat, CycleGAN, a diffusion-based method (DF), and unregularized Diffusion Schröodinger Bridge Matching (DSBM), FKRSBM achieves superior distributional alignment, reduced tau-positivity sign mismatch, stronger APOE subgroup alignment, and improved downstream disease classification performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Feynman Kac Reweighted Schrödinger Bridge Matching (FKRSBM)模型，用于Tau PET成像的跨站点标准化，消除扫描仪、协议和示踪剂差异引起的非生物变异，同时保留生物信号。该方法通过学习源分布和目标分布之间的直接随机传输过程，结合子群感知端点提议和分层重要性采样，在皮质表面网格上进行顶点级标准化。在PI-2620到AV-1451的标准化任务中，FKRSBM在分布对齐、tau阳性符号匹配、APOE子群对齐和下游疾病分类上优于ComBat、CycleGAN、扩散方法和未正则化DSBM。
Motivation: 现有标准化方法在源和目标队列存在子群组成差异时，容易将站点效应与生物变异（如tau阳性状态）混淆，导致生物标记方差增大、对疾病效应敏感性降低。
Method: 提出FKRSBM模型，通过熵正则化最优传输学习源分布到目标分布的直接随机传输过程；利用Feynman Kac重加权参考桥测度生成子群感知端点提议，通过分层重要性采样实现，无需修改底层桥匹配求解器或网络架构；在表面神经成像中使用球形卷积骨干在皮质网格上进行顶点级标准化。
Result: 在Tau PET SUVR标准化任务中，将HABS-HD队列的PI-2620数据标准化到ADNI的AV-1451域，FKRSBM在分布对齐、减少tau阳性符号不匹配、强化APOE子群对齐和改善下游疾病分类性能方面均优于ComBat、CycleGAN、扩散方法和未正则化DSBM。
Conclusion: FKRSBM通过子群感知的随机传输过程，有效实现了跨站点Tau PET标准化，减少非生物变异同时保持生物信号，提高下游分析可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generalization Guarantees for Multi-Input Neural Operator Learning in Sobolev Spaces
papers.abstract_en: We develop approximation and generalization error estimates for multi-input neural operators, with the output error measured in Sobolev norms. In contrast to standard operator-learning settings with a single input function, our framework allows multiple input functions defined on possibly different domains, with different dimensions and Sobolev regularities. The derived rates explicitly quantify the contribution of each input space to the final error bound. In particular, in the balanced regime, the approximation and generalization rates are governed by the interaction between the input dimensions, regularities, and Sobolev orders, while the dependence on the model complexity retains a \(\log\log/\log\)-type structure. Our analysis provides a general theoretical framework for multi-input operator learning, including Sobolev training, and is applicable to operator learning problems arising from partial differential equations and scientific computing.

Motivation: 现有算子学习理论通常针对单一输入函数，而许多实际问题涉及多个输入函数，例如不同来源的数据。需要理论框架来理解多输入情况下的学习误差。
Method: 作者在Sobolev范数下分析多输入神经算子的近似和泛化误差，推导了误差界，并显式刻画了每个输入空间的影响。
Result: 近似和泛化速率在平衡状态下由输入维度、正则性和Sobolev阶的相互作用决定，模型复杂度的依赖保持log-log/log结构。
Conclusion: 该理论框架适用于多输入算子学习，包括Sobolev训练，可应用于偏微分方程和科学计算中的算子学习问题。

papers.title: A Closer Look at Failure Modes in Temporal Understanding of Large Audio-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) achieve strong performance on a variety of audio understanding tasks but continue to struggle with temporal reasoning, a fundamental capability central to human auditory perception. Understanding the causes of these failures remains challenging as existing benchmarks report performance gaps without probing underlying mechanisms. To address this, we introduce a benchmark with 1,657 questions across three foundational tasks designed specifically for mechanistic analysis. Examining model outputs across varying input settings (behavioral analysis) reveals that models often under-utilize audio when textual cues are available. We also provide the first causal mechanistic analysis of temporal reasoning failures in LALMs. Comparing attention upweighting against scaling, we find that redistributing attention across audio tokens is more effective than increasing audio attention. Targeting task-relevant tokens yields further gains. These findings suggest that modality imbalance alone cannot explain failures. Attention scaling at bottleneck layers improves accuracy from 55.9% to 59.1% without fine-tuning, demonstrating a promising direction for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在时间推理任务上的失败模式进行机制分析。作者构建了一个包含1657个问题的基准测试，通过行为分析和因果机制分析发现模型在文本线索可用时倾向于忽略音频信息，且注意力重分配比单纯增加音频注意力更有效。在瓶颈层进行注意力缩放可在不微调的情况下将准确率从55.9%提升至59.1%。
Motivation: 现有LALMs在时间推理任务上表现不佳，但理解其失败原因仍具挑战性，因为现有基准只报告性能差距而不深入机制。
Method: 提出包含1657个问题的基准测试，涵盖三项基础任务；通过行为分析（改变输入设置）和因果机制分析（比较注意力上调权重与缩放）来探究失败模式。
Result: 注意力重分配比增加音频注意力更有效；在瓶颈层进行注意力缩放（不微调）将准确率从55.9%提升至59.1%。
Conclusion: 模态不平衡不能完全解释时间推理失败；注意力缩放为后续工作提供了有前景的方向。

papers.title: L-Proto: Language-Aware Episodic Prototypical Training for Multilingual Speaker Verification
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual speaker verification remains challenging because language-dependent acoustic variability causes speaker identity to become entangled with linguistic characteristics, degrading generalization across languages. In multilingual training, embeddings often encode language cues with speaker identity, causing speakers to form language-specific clusters. We propose L-Proto, a language-aware episodic prototypical training strategy that constructs language-consistent episodes. By sampling speakers from a single language per episode, L-Proto reduces language-driven variation during training and encourages embeddings to focus more directly on speaker identity. Experiments on the TidyVoice Challenge benchmark demonstrate consistent performance improvements over conventional fine-tuning and random episodic sampling across multiple backbone architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 L-Proto，一种语言感知的情景原型训练策略，通过在每个 episode 内仅采样同一语言的说话人来减少语言驱动变异，使嵌入更专注于说话人身份。在 TidyVoice Challenge 基准上，该方法在多个骨干网络上均优于传统微调和随机情景采样。
Motivation: 多语言说话人验证中，语言依赖的声学变异导致说话人身份与语言特征纠缠，降低跨语言泛化能力。
Method: 提出语言感知的情景原型训练（L-Proto），在训练时构造语言一致的 episode，即每个 episode 只包含同一语言的说话人样本，从而减少语言变化对嵌入的影响。
Result: 在 TidyVoice Challenge 基准上，该方法在多个骨干网络上均取得一致的性能提升，优于传统微调和随机情景采样。
Conclusion: 语言一致的 episode 训练能有效解耦语言和说话人信息，提升多语言场景下的验证性能。

papers.title: Memory-Efficient Meta-Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Safety-Critical Control in Adversarial Spacecraft Proximity Operations
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) require controllers that guarantee safety under thrust constraints while minimizing fuel expenditure. Input-constrained control barrier functions (ICCBFs) provide a control method for nonlinear systems with actuation constraints that construct a forward-invariant safe set. Previous work has shown that learning class-$\mathcal{K}$ functions defining the ICCBF recursion via meta reinforcement learning (meta-RL) yields a robust, non-greedy approach to safety-critical control in RPO. This paper extends that framework further by investigating the performance of three recurrent network architectures (Long Short Term Memory (LSTM), Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), Selective State Space Model (Mamba)) and two training algorithms (Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Soft Actor Critic (SAC)) to identify the best setup for tuning ICCBF class-K functions via meta-RL. In addition to cooperative test cases, performance is evaluated in the presence of adversarial behavior where the target spacecraft behaves in a way that worsens the safety of the chaser spacecraft. Results indicate that state space models such as Mamba when used with PPO achieve superior task completion, safety, and fuel-savings compared to other architectures, across all cooperative and uncooperative scenarios tested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究航天器交会对接中的自适应安全关键控制，利用元强化学习调整输入约束控制屏障函数中的类-𝒦函数。测试了三种循环网络架构（LSTM、GRU、Mamba）和两种训练算法（PPO、SAC），并在对抗性目标航天器行为下评估性能。结果表明，Mamba与PPO组合在任务完成、安全性和燃料节省方面优于其他方案。
Motivation: 航天器交会对接需要在推力约束下保证安全并最小化燃料消耗，现有方法难以同时满足这些要求，且对抗性场景下安全挑战更大。
Method: 基于输入约束控制屏障函数（ICCBFs）的框架，通过元强化学习（meta-RL）学习定义ICCBF递归的类-𝒦函数。比较LSTM、GRU、Mamba三种循环架构与PPO、SAC两种训练算法的组合。
Result: 在合作与非合作（对抗性）场景下，Mamba结构与PPO算法结合在任务完成率、安全性和燃料节省上均优于其他架构。
Conclusion: 状态空间模型Mamba与PPO的组合为航天器交会对接中的自适应安全控制提供了一种高效且鲁棒的方案，尤其在对抗性目标行为下表现突出。

papers.title: Amortized Probabilistic Retrieval of Atmospheric CO2 from OCO-2 Spectra Using Deep Learning with Laplace Approximations and Normalizing Flows
papers.abstract_en: Space-based monitoring of atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO2) is essential for constraining the global carbon budget. NASA's Orbiting Carbon Observatory-2 (OCO-2) estimates column-averaged dry-air mole fractions of CO2 (XCO2) using high-resolution spectra. However, current operational retrieval algorithms are computationally expensive and do not properly quantify uncertainties. We present a novel deep learning framework that addresses these challenges. Due to the difficulties of ground-truth data for real satellite observations, we develop and validate our approach using a high-fidelity simulation dataset. This dataset, created to support OCO-2 uncertainty quantification (UQ), incorporates realistic forward model errors. Our architecture encodes spectral bands using a multi-branch neural network and estimates posteriors of the full CO2 column or desired summaries thereof using two scalable UQ methods: Laplace approximations and normalizing flows. Our approach has five key advantages relative to operational "full-physics" solvers: (1) Amortization: Inference is orders of magnitude faster, enabling real-time processing of massive data streams; (2) Model error robustness: By training on simulations that explicitly include model discrepancies, our method accounts for systematic errors often neglected by standard inversions; (3) Point estimate accuracy: We achieve superior predictive accuracy compared to baseline methods; (4) Improved UQ: The probabilistic outputs yield better-calibrated uncertainty estimates; and (5) Non-Gaussian posteriors: When utilizing normalizing flows, our framework successfully models complex, asymmetric posterior distributions, overcoming the limitations of the Gaussian assumption. These results suggest that simulation-based deep learning is a viable path toward next-generation operational processing systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度学习的摊销概率检索框架，用于从 OCO-2 卫星光谱中反演大气 CO2 柱浓度。该框架使用多分支神经网络编码光谱，并采用拉普拉斯近似或标准化流量化后验不确定性。在高保真模拟数据集上验证了五个优势：推理速度快若干数量级、对模型误差具有鲁棒性、点估计精度更高、不确定性校准更好、并能建模非高斯后验分布。
Motivation: 当前 OCO-2 操作反演算法计算成本高且无法合理量化不确定性，限制了实时处理大规模数据流的能力。
Method: 构建多分支神经网络编码多个光谱波段，采用两种可扩展的不确定性量化方法——拉普拉斯近似和标准化流——来估计全 CO2 柱或所需摘要的后验分布。训练时使用了包含真实前向模型误差的高保真模拟数据集。
Result: 相比标准全物理反演器，该方法实现了数量级级别的推理加速，在点估计精度上优于基线方法，并输出校准更好的概率不确定性估计；使用标准化流时还能成功建模非对称后验分布。
Conclusion: 基于模拟的深度学习为下一代操作化处理系统提供了可行路径，尤其在摊销推理和鲁棒不确定性量化方面具有显著优势。

papers.title: Enhancing Pathological VLMs with Cross-scale Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Pathological images are inherently multi-scale, requiring pathologists to integrate evidence from global tissue architecture at low magnification to cellular morphology at higher magnification for accurate diagnosis. While existing pathological datasets for vision-language model (VLM) include various scales, they often lack an explicit cross-scale reasoning objective. This limitation prevents VLMs from capturing essential cross-scale representations and learning evidence-based reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce the first cross-scale training and evaluation paradigm that formulates pathology interpretation as multi-magnification reasoning. However, creating such a task reveals a critical challenge: multi-image visual question answering (VQA) is prone to text-only shortcuts, which allow models to guess answers using magnification-dependent artifacts rather than visual evidence. To address this, we propose a leakage-aware curation pipeline that combines adversarial text-only screening with constraint-guided question design. Using this pipeline, we construct Scale-VQA, a high-quality benchmark with 4,685 multiple-choice questions grounded in 2,537 pathology images across multiple magnification levels. Finally, we present ScaleReasoner-R1, a model trained via reinforcement learning to optimize performance on the cross-scale VQA task. ScaleReasoner-R1 achieves state-of-the-art performance on our cross-scale reasoning benchmark and generalizes to SOTA performance on established single-scale benchmarks. Findings suggest that even the limited cross-scale supervision can significantly improve pathological understanding. The code and demos will be open-sourced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对病理图像多尺度推理的缺失，提出首个跨尺度训练与评估范式，构建Scale-VQA基准（包含2,537张多倍率病理图像上的4,685道多选题），并训练ScaleReasoner-R1模型。该模型在跨尺度推理基准上达SOTA，并泛化至现有单尺度基准也取得SOTA。

Method: 提出泄漏感知的 curation pipeline，结合对抗性文本筛选和约束引导的问题设计，构建Scale-VQA基准；采用强化学习训练ScaleReasoner-R1模型以优化跨尺度VQA性能。
Result: ScaleReasoner-R1在跨尺度推理基准上取得SOTA，并泛化至现有单尺度基准也达到SOTA性能。
Conclusion: 有限的跨尺度监督也能显著改善病理图像理解；代码和演示将开源。

papers.title: Attention Alignment Between Humans and Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual perception depends on top-down goals and bottom-up sensory mechanisms. Vision-language models implement both, allowing us to treat each component as a separable hypothesis about what drives where we look. We compared spatial attention maps from six vision-language models against human fixation heatmaps recorded on 200 images during two tasks (general description and social captioning). The six models spanned a 2$\times$2 factorial of CNN vs.\ ViT encoders crossed with LSTM vs.\ Transformer decoders, plus Molmo 7B-D and Qwen3.5 9B. We found that both decoder and encoder architecture shaped alignment, but decoder choice dominated. LSTM vs.\ Transformer decoders increased alignment by 40--50 percentage points (80--87\% vs.\ 40--59\% of the human noise ceiling). In contrast, CNN vs.\ ViT encoders contributed a secondary 5--20 point advantage depending on decoder family, with CNN-LSTM the most aligned model overall (85--87\%). Despite their alignment advantage, LSTM-decoder attention maps were spatially diffuse and minimally task-differentiated; ViT-Transformer, the weakest in alignment, showed the sharpest spatial concentration and strongest task differentiation. A hemispatial-neglect simulation confirmed that ablating attention impacted LSTM decoders more than Transformer decoders. In an exploratory extension using TRIBE-simulated synthetic neural responses, fixation alignment and neural relevance dissociate: CNN-Transformer attention maps better predicted synthetic brain activity despite lower fixation alignment, with attention maps best predicting early visual cortex. Together, top-down and bottom-up components trade off what they predict in behavioral and synthetic neural data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了六种视觉语言模型（VLMs）的空间注意力图与人类在两项任务中的注视热力图。发现解码器架构比编码器架构对对齐影响更大：LSTM 解码器使对齐达到人类噪声上限的80-87%，而 Transformer 解码器仅为40-59%。但 LSTM 解码器的注意力图更分散且任务区分度低；ViT-Transformer 对齐最差但注意力最集中、任务区分最强。注意力消融实验表明 LSTM 解码器受影响更大。在 TRIBE 模拟神经响应中，CNN-Transformer 注意力图虽行为对齐低，但能更好预测脑活动。
Motivation: 视觉感知受自上而下目标和自下而上感觉机制共同影响，VLMs 同时实现这两部分，但尚不清楚哪一部分更能解释人类注视位置。
Method: 将六种 VLMs（CNN/ViT 编码器 × LSTM/Transformer 解码器的 2×2 因子设计，外加 Molmo 7B-D 和 Qwen3.5 9B）的注意力图与 200 张图像上两种任务（一般描述和社会性描述）的人类注视热力图进行对比。
Result: 解码器架构主导对齐：LSTM 解码器对齐比 Transformer 解码器高 40-50 个百分点（80-87% vs 40-59% 的人类噪声上限）；编码器仅贡献 5-20 个百分点优势，CNN-LSTM 整体对齐最好（85-87%）。LSTM 解码器注意力更分散且任务区分弱，ViT-Transformer 最集中且任务区分强。注意力消融对 LSTM 解码器影响更大。
Conclusion: VLMs 的自上而下（解码器）和自下而上（编码器）组件在预测行为和神经数据上存在权衡：解码器驱动行为对齐但注意力分散，编码器驱动神经对齐但行为对齐低。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Discrete Autoregressive Transformer for Generative Mechanism Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Planar path synthesis requires mechanisms whose coupler curves match a prescribed trajectory; the mapping from curve to linkage is inherently one-to-many across four-, six-, and eight-bar topologies. We address this design problem with simulation-grounded evaluation on a curated corpus of over one million mechanisms, reporting Chamfer distance and dynamic time warping after forward kinematics and geometric alignment. We formulate synthesis as conditional autoregressive sequence modeling: joint coordinates are uniformly quantized to tokens and generated by a decoder-only transformer with a variational-autoencoder (VAE) latent of the target curve and an explicit mechanism-type token. Training combines token cross-entropy with a Gaussian-smoothed bin auxiliary loss that respects ordinal structure among bins. At inference, a bounded latent-noise schedule decodes all mechanism types at each noise level; we retain the top five candidates by geometric error, yielding diverse accurate families without dataset lookup. On held-out tests, aggregate mean Chamfer distance is $0.0132$ and mean dynamic time warping is $0.153$; a latent $k$-nearest-neighbor baseline that conditions on training-set neighbor latents in VAE space achieves matched-topology mean Chamfer distance $0.0071$ and mean dynamic time warping $0.117$ using the same decoder.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种离散自回归变压器（discrete autoregressive transformer）用于生成机构综合（mechanism synthesis），将平面路径综合问题转化为条件自回归序列建模。通过在包含超过一百万机构的模拟数据集上训练，模型输出量化后的关节坐标token，并引入VAE潜在变量和目标曲线与机构类型条件。实验显示该方法在Chamfer距离和动态时间规整上取得良好结果，且能生成多样化的准确机构族。
Motivation: 平面路径综合中从曲线到连杆的映射是内在的一对多，现有方法可能无法有效探索多种拓扑结构（四杆、六杆、八杆），需要一种能生成多样且准确机构的方法。
Method: 将关节坐标均匀量化成token，使用decoder-only transformer进行自回归生成，条件包括目标曲线的VAE潜在变量和显式的机构类型token。训练结合token交叉熵损失和高斯平滑的bin辅助损失（保留bin的序结构）。推理时采用有限潜在噪声调度，在不同噪声水平下解码所有机构类型，保留几何误差最小的前五个候选。
Result: 在保留测试集上，平均Chamfer距离为0.0132，平均动态时间规整为0.153。作为对比，一个基于VAE空间潜在k近邻的基线方法在匹配拓扑时达到平均Chamfer距离0.0071和平均动态时间规整0.117。
Conclusion: 本文证明离散自回归序列建模与VAE条件可用于机构综合，生成多样且准确的机构候选，无需数据库查找。

papers.title: Where Should Action Generation Begin? A Learnable Source Prior for Generative Robot Policies
papers.abstract_en: Generative robot policies typically begin action generation from an observation-independent standard Gaussian distribution, leaving the choice of source distribution underexplored. This work asks a simple question: where should action generation begin? We propose LeaP, a Learnable source Prior that replaces the standard Gaussian with a proprioception-conditioned diagonal Gaussian over action chunks. Parameterized by a lightweight MLP, LeaP jointly predicts the mean and state-adaptive variance of the source distribution, while keeping the downstream generator architecture and inference solver unchanged. This design provides an observation-informed yet stochastic initialization, allowing the generator to focus on precise action refinement rather than transporting samples from an uninformed noise source. On 15 RoboTwin manipulation tasks, LeaP achieves an average success rate of 81.6%, outperforming four representative baselines -- including deterministic-source methods, a no-prior counterpart, and a diffusion-bridge policy -- by 6.5 to 25.5 percentage points. The same prior consistently improves both flow-matching and diffusion-bridge generators, while using fewer parameters and converging faster. The advantage carries over to real-world deployment, where LeaP attains the best performance. These results suggest that the source distribution is an independent and reusable design axis for generative robot policies, complementary to the choice of generative dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可学习的源先验（LeaP），用于生成式机器人策略中的动作生成。该方法将标准高斯分布替换为基于本体感知的对角高斯分布，通过轻量级MLP预测均值和状态自适应方差，保持下游生成器和推理求解器不变。在15个RoboTwin操作任务上，LeaP平均成功率达81.6%，优于四种基线方法6.5-25.5个百分点，并能在真实部署中取得最佳性能。结果表明源分布是生成式机器人策略中独立且可复用的设计维度。
Motivation: 现有生成式机器人策略通常从与观测无关的标准高斯分布开始动作生成，忽略了对源分布的选择，导致生成器需要将样本从不含信息的噪声源传输到目标动作。
Method: 提出LeaP，一个可学习的源先验，用本体感知条件对角高斯分布替代标准高斯分布。该先验由轻量级MLP参数化，联合预测源分布的均值和状态自适应方差，不改变下游生成器架构和推理求解器。
Result: 在15个RoboTwin操作任务上，LeaP平均成功率达81.6%，比确定性源方法、无先验方法和扩散桥策略等四种基线高出6.5-25.5个百分点。该先验一致提升了流匹配和扩散桥生成器，且参数更少、收敛更快，在真实部署中也取得最佳性能。
Conclusion: 源分布是生成式机器人策略中一个独立且可复用的设计维度，与生成动力学选择互补。LeaP通过观测信息且随机的初始化，使生成器专注于精确的动作细化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Graph Neural Networks for Semi-Supervised Image Classification with Multi-Feature Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Feature extraction involves the identification and extraction of salient characteristics or patterns, including edges, textures, shapes, and color attributes. Contemporary feature extractors predominantly leverage deep learning architectures, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (VITs). The availability of diverse feature extractors in the literature provides a wide range of feature representations. Features extracted from an image depend on the specific application, the chosen extractor, and its configuration. Therefore, integrating complementary information by combining distinct extractors offers a promising way to enhance performance. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), particularly Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs), have emerged as powerful and widely adopted approaches for semi-supervised image classification, as they effectively leverage both labeled and unlabeled data while exploiting the underlying graph structures that capture relationships among samples. This study proposes a novel approach for GNNs in scenarios where labeled data is scarce, by integrating diverse sets of feature and graph representations derived from various extractors in classification scenarios. Experimental investigations were conducted, encompassing combinations of distinct feature and graph extractors, as well as rank aggregation strategies. The primary contributions of this work are underscored by the experimental findings, which demonstrate that the strategic combination of feature and graph representations, coupled with the application of manifold learning for graph processing, leads to significant improvements in classification accuracy across the majority of experimental conditions. Furthermore, the utilization of rank aggregation techniques to integrate features from different extractors was shown to enhance classification accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的半监督图像分类方法，通过融合多种特征提取器（如CNN、ViT）得到的特征和图表示，结合流形学习和排序聚合技术，在标注数据稀缺的场景下提升分类准确率。
Motivation: 现有特征提取器多样且互补，但缺乏有效融合多种特征表示以提升半监督图像分类性能的方法。
Method: 采用图卷积网络（GCN）作为基础，整合多个特征提取器的输出，利用流形学习处理图结构，并通过排序聚合策略融合不同特征。
Result: 实验表明，策略性组合特征和图表示以及应用排序聚合能显著提升大多数实验条件下的分类准确率。
Conclusion: 融合多特征和图表示结合流形学习与排序聚合是改善半监督图像分类的有效途径。

papers.title: Treatment Response Optimized Clinical Decision Support AI System via Digital Twin Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Clinical decision support AI systems (CDSASs) must adapt to evolving patient conditions in real-time while adhering to strict safety constraints. We present an online adaptive framework that integrates Treatment Effect (TE) estimation to quantify clinical benefits, a patient Digital Twin (DT) to simulate treatment trajectories, and Reinforcement Learning (RL) for sequential decision-making. The AI system is initially trained on historical medical records and operates in a continuous learning loop. To ensure safety, a rule-based module monitors vital signs and blocks contraindicated treatments. Cases with strong internal model disagreement are flagged for clinician review, simulated in our experiments via a pre-trained outcome model. We validate our framework using both a synthetic clinical simulator and a real-world ovarian cancer dataset from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). In both simulated and clinical settings, our method demonstrated superior effectiveness and stability in recommending treatments compared to standard computational baselines. Furthermore, the AI system maintains low latency and requires expert consultation for only a minority of cases in our experimental validation, demonstrating its potential as a safe, clinician-supervised tool for personalized medicine that continuously improves through practical use.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Conference (EMBC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个在线自适应框架，结合治疗效果估计、患者数字孪生和强化学习，用于临床决策支持。系统在历史数据上预训练，持续学习，并带有安全规则模块和不确定情况下的临床医生审查机制。在合成模拟器和TCGA卵巢癌数据集上验证，相比基线方法在治疗推荐上表现更优。
Motivation: 临床决策支持系统需要实时适应患者病情变化，同时满足安全约束，现有方法在动态性和安全性方面存在不足。
Method: 集成治疗效果估计（量化临床益处）、患者数字孪生（模拟治疗轨迹）和强化学习（序贯决策），结合规则模块监控生命体征并阻止禁忌治疗，对模型内部分歧大的案例标记为需要临床医生审查。
Result: 在合成临床模拟器和真实卵巢癌数据集（TCGA）上，该方法在治疗推荐的有效性和稳定性方面优于标准基线。同时延迟低，仅少数案例需要专家会诊。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了作为安全的、临床医生监督的个性化医疗工具的前景，通过实际使用持续改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bridging Spatial And Frequency Views For Disaster Assessment: Benefits And Limitations
papers.abstract_en: Rapid assessment of building damage from satellite imagery is essential for effective disaster response and recovery. While most deep learning methods rely on spatial-domain features, frequency-domain representations can capture complementary structural cues such as debris patterns and collapse-induced textures. This study presents a controlled comparison of spatial-domain, frequency-domain, and dual-domain deep learning approaches for multi-class building damage classification using post-disaster imagery from the xView2 (xBD) dataset. To ensure fairness, all models are built on an EfficientNet-B0 backbone and trained under identical settings, differing only in their input representations and fusion strategies. Performance is evaluated using accuracy, macro F1-score, per-class metrics, and confusion matrices. Results show that dual-domain models provide measurable improvements over single-domain approaches. The dual spatial configuration achieves the highest test accuracy (0.4688) and lowest loss, while the spatial-only model attains the best macro F1-score (0.4254), indicating more balanced class performance. In contrast, frequency-only models perform worst and exhibit overfitting, suggesting limited generalization. Despite these gains, all models struggle to detect subtle damage levels, particularly the Minor class, due to class imbalance and fine-grained visual ambiguity. While dual-domain approaches improve detection of severe damage, challenges remain. These findings highlight the benefits and limitations of hybrid representations and motivate future work on data balancing, advanced fusion, and regularization.

TL;DR: 本文对比了空间域、频域及双域深度学习模型在卫星图像建筑损坏分类中的表现，基于xView2数据集和EfficientNet-B0骨干网络。双域模型在准确率上优于单域模型，但频域模型过拟合严重，所有模型对轻微损坏（Minor类）识别困难。
Motivation: 灾害响应中需要快速评估建筑损坏，现有方法多依赖空间特征，而频域特征可提供补充结构信息，但缺乏系统比较。
Method: 以EfficientNet-B0为骨干，构建空间域、频域（离散余弦变换）和双域（空间+频域融合）三类模型，在xView2数据集上采用相同训练设置进行多分类对比。
Result: 双域模型达到最高测试准确率0.4688，空间域模型获得最佳宏F1分数0.4254，频域模型表现最差且过拟合。所有模型对Minor类识别困难。
Conclusion: 双域表示可提升严重损坏检测，但受限于类别不平衡和细粒度视觉模糊，未来需关注数据平衡、先进融合与正则化。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: The Discrete-Log Clock: How a Transformer Learns Modular Multiplication
papers.abstract_en: When small transformers grok modular multiplication, prior work reports that the learned embedding has a "dense" Fourier spectrum requiring all frequencies. This contrasts with modular addition, where only a sparse set of key frequencies suffices. We show this density is an artifact of analyzing in the wrong basis. The natural Fourier transform for multiplication is not the standard additive DFT but the multiplicative character transform, which decomposes functions on the multiplicative group $(\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z})^*$ into its irreducible representations. Applying this transform to a grokked transformer trained on $a \cdot b \bmod 113$, we find the embedding spectrum becomes highly sparse (Gini coefficient 0.58 vs. 0.07 in the additive basis) with only 4 key frequencies carrying significant energy. Furthermore, 96.9% of MLP neurons are cleanly tuned to a single multiplicative frequency, and neuron activation heatmaps reveal 2D-periodic structure when reordered by the discrete logarithm. These results demonstrate the transformer reduces multiplication to addition in discrete-log space, implementing a "Discrete-Log Clock" algorithm analogous to Nanda et al.'s Clock algorithm for addition. The methodology generalizes: matching the analysis basis to the algebraic structure of the task reveals interpretable structure where standard tools see noise.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究小规模Transformer在学会模乘（modular multiplication）后的内部表征。与模加法不同，模乘的嵌入在标准傅里叶变换下呈现密集频谱，但作者指出这是分析基的错误。使用乘法特征变换（character transform）后，嵌入频谱变得高度稀疏（基尼系数从0.07升至0.58），仅需4个关键频率。96.9%的MLP神经元对应单一乘法频率，且神经元激活热图按离散对数重排后呈现二维周期结构，表明Transformer实现了类似Nanda等人加法时钟算法的“离散对数时钟”机制。该方法将分析基与任务代数结构匹配，即可揭示标准工具看似噪声下的可解释结构。
Motivation: 已有工作发现模乘任务中学习到的嵌入具有“密集”傅里叶谱，这与模加法的稀疏模式形成对比，需要解释这一差异。
Method: 使用乘法特征变换（multiplicative character transform）替代标准加性DFT，将函数在乘法群上的不可约表示分解，并分析在模113上训练的Transformer嵌入。
Result: 在模113乘法上，嵌入频谱基尼系数从加性基下的0.07升至特征基下的0.58，仅4个关键频率携带主要能量；96.9%的MLP神经元调节到单一乘法频率；激活热图重排后显示二维周期结构。
Conclusion: 匹配分析基与任务的代数结构（乘法群）可揭示Transformer内部的稀疏、可解释表征，而标准工具则显示噪声。该发现表明Transformer将乘法转化为离散对数空间中的加法。

papers.title: SoK: AI-Augmented Binary Reversing
papers.abstract_en: Binary reversing is fundamental to software understanding, vulnerability discovery, malware investigation, and firmware auditing. However, it remains inherently challenging due to the irreversible loss of semantic information during compilation. Recent advances in machine learning, large language models (LLMs), and agentic AI systems have accelerated the adoption of AI-augmented binary reversing. Yet, the resulting body of work has become increasingly fragmented across reversing domains, artifact representations, learning approaches, and evaluation practices. This paper presents the first comprehensive systematization of knowledge on AI-augmented binary reversing. We analyze 144 research papers published since 2015, and organize them into 22 binary reversing domains according to the inference tasks. We further introduce a unified taxonomy spanning conventional and AI-augmented reversing pipelines. Our taxonomy connects traditional analysis techniques, binary-derived artifacts, representation strategies, learning paradigms, and downstream inference tasks, while clarifying the emerging roles of LLMs and agentic AI systems. By establishing a common vocabulary and structured framework, we provide a holistic view of the field's evolution over the past decade. Our study reveals common structures underlying seemingly disparate approaches, highlights persistent technical challenges and evaluation gaps, and identifies promising opportunities for future research. Collectively, these insights clarify the current state of the field and provide a foundation for the next generation of reliable and scalable AI-augmented binary reversing systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是首篇对AI增强二进制逆向进行系统化知识梳理的综述。作者分析了2015年以来144篇论文，将其按推理任务归纳为22个二进制逆向领域，并提出了一个统一分类法，涵盖传统分析技术、二进制衍生工件、表示策略、学习范式及下游推理任务，同时阐明了LLM和智能体AI系统的新兴角色。该综述揭示了不同方法背后的共同结构，指出了持久的技术挑战和评估缺口，并识别了未来研究机会。
Motivation: 二进制逆向因编译过程中语义信息的不可逆丢失而固有困难，且近年来AI增强技术的应用日益增多，但相关工作在逆向领域、工件表示、学习方法和评估实践上日益碎片化，缺乏系统化梳理。
Method: 对2015年以来144篇论文进行系统分析，将其归入22个二进制逆向领域，并构建统一分类法，连接传统分析技术、二进制衍生工件、表示策略、学习范式和下游推理任务，特别突出了LLM和智能体AI的角色。
Result: 揭示了不同方法背后的共同结构，指出了持久的技术挑战和评估缺口，并识别了未来研究机会。
Conclusion: 该研究为该领域提供了整体演化视图，为开发下一代可靠且可扩展的AI增强二进制逆向系统奠定了基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Damage Adaptation in Seconds for Architected Materials
papers.abstract_en: Adaptation to damages and in-situ physical repairs is essential for long-term robot autonomy, yet challenging outside of narrowly defined and well-anticipated bounds. In this work we proprioceptively adapt to catastrophic damage in soft-actuated systems in under one minute. Architected materials are well equipped for adaptation: actuator failure occurs gradually rather than acutely, and damage can be described in a low-dimensional, discrete coordinate space. Surprisingly, latent damage representations plus a simple yet robust ensemble method is sufficient for adapting to unseen damage in real-time. Moreover, we identify conditions under which exponential sample complexity collapses to linear sample complexity for learned representations of architected materials, a concrete advantage over rigid components or continuum soft mechanisms. We demonstrate LEAP, our method for adaptive proprioception, via a tracing task for a 6DoF soft wrist based on Handed Shearing Auxetic (HSA) actuators. Our algorithm is able to adapt to cuts, burns, and actuator repairs, enabling simulation-free real-time adaptation that is critical for realizing the promise of soft robots outside the lab. Videos and more information are available at https://murpheylab.github.io/leap.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LEAP方法，利用潜损伤表示和集成学习，在软体驱动系统中实现秒级损伤适应，无需仿真。该方法在6自由度软腕上验证了切割、烧伤和修复后的自适应追踪任务，并揭示了指数样本复杂度可降为线性的条件。
Motivation: 机器人长期自主需要适应损伤和原位物理修复，但现有方法局限于狭窄且预先定义的范围，缺乏实时性。
Method: 通过低维离散坐标空间的潜损伤表示结合简单鲁棒的集成学习方法，实现实时自适应本体感知（LEAP）。
Result: 在6自由度HSA软腕的追踪任务中，算法能在数秒内适应切割、烧伤和致动器修复，实现无仿真实时适应。
Conclusion: 软体结构的损伤适应具有几何级数样本复杂度优势，LEAP方法为软体机器人走出实验室提供了实时适应途径。

papers.title: NarrativeWorldBench: A Frontier-Saturated Benchmark and a Latent World Model for Long-Horizon Co-Creative Audio Drama
papers.abstract_en: Long-form serialized audio drama, with arcs that run for 200 to 800 episodes, is a major creative medium and a setting where frontier large language models (LLMs) fail. We benchmark 21 models, spanning classical, fine-tuned, open-frontier, closed-frontier, and reasoning tiers, on a uniform set of structural narrative metrics. All closed-frontier systems saturate at a plot-beat F1 in the band [0.78, 0.81] and collapse by about -0.20 F1 at horizon h=200. We introduce NarrativeWorldBench, an open benchmark of nine narrative-structure metrics evaluated across horizons h in {10, 20, 50, 100, 200}, with cross-lingual evaluation across four Indic languages (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi). We introduce N-VSSM, a Narrative Variational State-Space Model that maintains a structured 256-dimensional latent world state over more than 200 episodes via a Mamba-2 backbone with an event-conditioned posterior and an 8B decoder. N-VSSM holds plot-beat F1 >= 0.84 across all horizons at 4x lower compute than the closed-frontier band. A learned Cultural Transfer Function lifts cross-language fidelity by +0.20 to +0.23 Likert points. In a within-subjects writer study (n = 12 professional authors, 240 trials), N-VSSM is preferred over Claude Opus 4.5 on long-arc consistency 71% of the time and rated +1.3 Likert points higher on controllability.
papers.comment: 10 pages. Accepted to the ICML 2026 Workshops on High-dimensional Learning Dynamics (HiLD) and Culture x AI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NarrativeWorldBench，一个用于长范围协同创作音频剧的叙事结构基准，包含9个指标和4种印度语言的跨语言评估。同时提出 N-VSSM，一种叙事变分状态空间模型，基于 Mamba-2 骨干和事件条件后验，在200集以上保持情节节拍 F1 >= 0.84，计算量仅为封闭前沿模型的1/4。在专业作者研究中，N-VSSM 在长期一致性上优于 Claude Opus 4.5。
Motivation: 长序列音频剧（200-800集）是重要创意媒介，但当前前沿大语言模型在此场景中表现不佳，缺乏统一的叙事结构评估基准和高效的长范围生成模型。
Method: 提出 NarrativeWorldBench 基准，包含9个叙事结构指标，评估跨21个模型和4种印度语言；提出 N-VSSM，使用 Mamba-2 骨干维护256维潜在世界状态，结合事件条件后验和8B解码器，并引入文化转移函数提升跨语言保真度。
Result: 封闭前沿模型在情节节拍 F1 上饱和于[0.78,0.81]区间，在200集后下降约0.20 F1；N-VSSM 在所有范围内保持 F1 >= 0.84，计算量低4倍，跨语言保真度提升0.20-0.23 Likert点；在12位专业作者的240次试验中，N-VSSM 在长期一致性上被选中的比例为71%，可控性评分高1.3 Likert点。
Conclusion: N-VSSM 在长范围音频剧生成中优于当前最强封闭前沿模型，且效率更高，但基准和模型目前仅覆盖有限的语言和指标。

papers.title: Visuals Lie, Consistency Speaks: Disentangling Spatial Attention from Reliability in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Foundation Models are increasingly used as reasoning agents, making reliability, knowing when a model may hallucinate, critical. A common intuition, which we call the Attention-Confidence Assumption, holds that reliability follows from "structural" visual perception: tight attention on relevant regions should signal a trustworthy answer, while scattered attention signals confusion. We challenge this through the VLM Reliability Probe (VRP), a systematic cross-family study of reliability signals in contemporary Vision-Language Models (VLMs). We introduce structural-attention metrics, cluster counts (C_k) and spatial entropy (H_s), to quantify the visual encoder's gaze, and track its evolution (Delta H_s) across layers. This reveals a "Symbolic Detachment": models often "Early Lock" visual features only to diffuse attention later, severing early perception from final generation. Contrary to the grounding hypothesis, we find a "Cluster Failure": spatial attention has near-zero correlation (R approx 0.001) with accuracy. Instead, reliability is a phenomenon of generation dynamics and internal-state distributions. Self-Consistency, the agreement rate across sampled reasoning paths, is the dominant predictor of truth (R = 0.429). Scaling causal interventions exposes a sharp architectural divergence: LLaVA locks its prediction in a fragile late-stage bottleneck, whereas PaliGemma and Qwen2-VL distribute reliability globally, staying resilient even when ~50% or more of their most predictive layer is destroyed. For current VLMs, reliability signals are detached from visual grounding maps and are best inferred from generation-time dynamics and hidden-state probes.
papers.comment: 16 pages. Accepted to the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Multimodal Intelligence. Code: https://github.com/itsloganmann/VLM-Reliability-Probe
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了视觉语言模型中“注意力越集中，模型越可靠”的常见直觉。通过VLM可靠性探针(VRP)跨系列研究，发现空间注意力与准确性几乎无关(R≈0.001)，而生成过程中的自我一致性才是可靠性的主导预测因子(R=0.429)。研究还揭示了不同架构在可靠性上的根本差异。
Motivation: 现有直觉(Attention-Confidence Assumption)认为视觉注意力集中程度与模型可靠性直接相关，但这一假设缺乏系统验证。
Method: 提出VLM Reliability Probe (VRP)，引入结构注意力指标(聚类计数C_k、空间熵H_s)及其跨层演化(ΔH_s)，并结合自我一致性和因果干预分析。

Conclusion: 当前VLM的可靠性信号与视觉空间注意力脱钩，应从生成动态和隐藏状态探针中推断。

papers.title: TerraTransfer: Learning End-to-End Driving Policies Without Expert Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving has achieved state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks and real-world deployments. Its standard training recipe, however, is expensive across all stages: collecting and labeling millions of driving frames is costly, and closed-loop RL on images is bottlenecked by the per-step cost of photorealistic rendering plus a forward pass through a large vision backbone. Self-play in vectorized simulators changes the economics: millions of rollout steps per second, and a state distribution naturally rich in collisions, near-misses, and recoveries that no driving log contains. Our approach exploits this asymmetry by decoupling learning to drive from learning to see. We pretrain a single policy by self-play, then align its latent space with a pretrained vision backbone, through the action KL divergence and a batch-relational low-rank structural loss. The action target comes from the self-play policy, so alignment never supervises against a logged trajectory: a paired dataset of (image, scene-state) frames suffices, with no need for the curated expert demonstrations that imitation pretraining is built on. On photorealistic 3D Gaussian splatting closed-loop scenarios, the resulting end-to-end policy matches or exceeds prior end-to-end methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TerraTransfer，一种不依赖专家演示的端到端自动驾驶训练方法。通过将学习驾驶与学习视觉解耦，先自博弈预训练一个策略，然后将其潜在空间与预训练的视觉主干对齐，使用动作KL散度和批量关系低秩结构损失。在逼真的3D高斯泼溅闭环场景中，该端到端策略匹配或超越之前的端到端方法。
Motivation: 标准端到端自动驾驶训练昂贵，需要大量标注数据和闭环RL的昂贵渲染成本。自博弈在向量化模拟器中高效，但需要将视觉能力迁移到真实世界。
Method: 先自博弈预训练一个驾驶策略（在向量化模拟器中），然后通过动作KL散度和批量关系低秩结构损失，将策略的潜在空间与预训练的视觉主干对齐，无需专家演示或轨迹日志，仅需成对的（图像，场景状态）数据。
Result: 在逼真的3D高斯泼溅闭环场景中，该方法匹配或超越之前的端到端方法。
Conclusion: 通过解耦驾驶学习和视觉学习，可以降低数据需求并实现高效训练，无需专家演示。

papers.title: Improving and Evaluating Hand-Object Interaction Detection
papers.abstract_en: Understanding hands and the objects they interact with, both directly and through tools, is a key step for tasks ranging from action perception to 3D reconstruction and robotics. Our paper provides several contributions to the Hand-Object Interaction (HOI) understanding literature: (1) HOI-DETR, a new framework that introduces hand-object and object-object interactions to the Co-DETR architecture to produce a state-of-the-art method; (2) a comprehensive HOI evaluation suite of 4 diverse datasets, including a video benchmark derived from the HD-EPIC dataset and fresh annotations that improve the Hands23 benchmark and (3) a trained checkpoint that significantly improves the state of the art across Hands23, HOIST, FineBio, and HD-EPIC, including mAP gains of over 20 percentage points on Hands23 and FineBio. Our ablations confirm the contributions of each model component.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HOI-DETR 框架，通过将手-物和物-物交互引入 Co-DETR 架构，显著提升了手-物交互检测性能。在 Hands23、HOIST、FineBio 和 HD-EPIC 四个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在 mAP 上取得了超过 20 个百分点的提升，消融实验验证了各组件贡献。
Motivation: 理解手与物体（包括工具）的交互对于动作感知、3D 重建和机器人等任务至关重要，现有方法在检测精度和泛化性上仍有不足。
Method: 提出了 HOI-DETR 框架，将手-物和物-物交互融入 Co-DETR 架构；此外构建了包含四个数据集的综合评估套件，并基于 HD-EPIC 推出了视频基准和标注改进。
Result: 在 Hands23、HOIST、FineBio 和 HD-EPIC 上均达到最先进水平，其中在 Hands23 和 FineBio 上的 mAP 提升超过 20 个百分点。
Conclusion: 消融实验确认了每个模型组件的有效性，表明所提出的交互引入方式能够显著提升检测性能。

papers.title: Model Validation of Agentic AI Systems: A POMDP-Based Framework for Belief-State, Forecast, and Policy Validation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic artificial intelligence systems introduce a new class of model risk. Unlike traditional predictive models, autonomous agents continuously acquire information, form beliefs regarding latent states of the environment, generate forecasts, select actions, and adapt their behavior over time. Existing validation methodologies focus primarily on predictive accuracy and therefore provide limited insight into the quality of the underlying decision process. This paper proposes a model validation framework for agentic AI based on Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs). The framework decomposes autonomous decision making into information, beliefs, forecasts, actions, and utility, allowing each component to be validated independently. Large language models (LLMs) are formalized as approximate Bayesian filtering operators, and a model-risk taxonomy is developed encompassing state-space, filtering, forecast, policy, utility-specification, and parameter risks. The model risk validation methodology is demonstrated through a portfolio-management case study in which an agent infers latent market regimes from market and macroeconomic information, generates belief-conditioned forecasts, and constructs portfolios using a Black--Litterman framework. Empirical validation combines performance analysis, belief calibration diagnostics, coverage tests, ablation studies, and parameter-sensitivity analysis. The results indicate that latent-state inference contributes independently to decision quality and that the principal conclusions remain robust across a broad range of parameter values. The principal contribution of the paper is a practical framework for extending established model risk management concepts to autonomous AI systems and providing a rigorous foundation for their validation, governance, and monitoring.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Source code available from https://github.com/mfrdixon/agentic-AI-as-POMDP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自主AI系统引入的新型模型风险，提出基于部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）的模型验证框架。该框架将自主决策分解为信息、信念、预测、动作和效用，允许独立验证各组件，并将大语言模型形式化为近似贝叶斯滤波算子。通过投资组合管理案例研究，展示了潜在状态推断对决策质量的独立贡献，且结论在广泛参数范围内保持稳健。
Motivation: 现有模型验证方法主要关注预测精度，无法评估自主AI系统决策过程的质量，缺乏针对信念状态、预测和策略的验证框架。
Method: 提出基于POMDP的验证框架，将决策分解为信息、信念、预测、动作和效用，并开发了包括状态空间风险、滤波风险、预测风险、策略风险、效用规范风险和参数风险的模型风险分类法。在投资组合管理中，代理从市场信息推断潜在市场状态，生成信念条件预测，并采用Black-Litterman框架构建组合，通过性能分析、信念校准诊断、覆盖率测试、消融研究和参数敏感性分析进行实证验证。
Result: 案例研究表明，潜在状态推断独立贡献于决策质量，且主要结论在广泛参数范围内保持稳健。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个将已建立的模型风险管理概念扩展到自主AI系统的实用框架，为其验证、治理和监控奠定了严格基础。

papers.title: MeiBRD: Meta-Learning Intraoperative Biomechanical Residual Deformation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate intraoperative liver registration is challenging due to substantial soft-tissue deformation yet sparse intraoperative measurements. Biomechanical models regularize this ill-posedness with prior knowledge but exhibit persistent prediction bias due to simplifying assumptions, while data-driven learning solutions struggle with data efficiency, generalization, and physical plausibility. We propose a hybrid registration framework that adapts a biomechanical prior using sparse intraoperative correspondences. Rather than learning a full deformation field, we learn a residual deformation function that corrects linear biomechanical predictions, modeled as a graph neural diffusion function with geometry-aware attention over the 3D liver mesh. To enable long-range information transfer of sparse observations, we take a novel perspective of sparse intraoperative measurements as \textit{context} samples where input-output pairs of the residual deformation function are fully observed, casting the problem into learning-to-learn this residual function from intraoperative context samples with feedforward meta-learners. Experiments on a deformable liver phantom dataset demonstrate improved registration accuracy and generalization compared to rigid, biomechanical, and data-driven baselines, particularly for out-of-distribution geometries and deformations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合框架MeiBRD，将生物力学先验与元学习结合，用于校正术中肝脏配准的残差变形。该方法通过图神经扩散函数学习残差变形，将稀疏术中测量视为上下文样本，利用前馈元学习器进行学习。在变形肝体模数据集上，该方法在配准精度和泛化性上优于刚性、生物力学和数据驱动基线。
Motivation: 术中肝脏配准因软组织大变形和稀疏测量而具有挑战性，生物力学模型存在预测偏差，数据驱动方法数据效率低且泛化性差。
Method: 提出混合配准框架，将生物力学预测与基于图神经扩散的残差函数结合，通过几何注意力机制在3D肝脏网格上传播信息，并利用元学习从稀疏术中对应点中学习该残差函数。
Result: 在变形肝体模数据集上，与刚性、生物力学和数据驱动基线相比，配准精度和泛化性均有提升，尤其对分布外几何和变形。
Conclusion: 该混合框架有效结合物理先验和稀疏数据，提高了术中配准的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Performance-Driven Environment Abstraction with Multi-Timescale Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study performance-driven environment abstraction for decision-making in large Markov decision processes. Rather than preserving geometric or topological structure, we seek abstractions that directly optimize decision quality. We model abstraction as a controlled approximation obtained by aggregating the state space and enforcing a shared action distribution within each aggregated state. For a fixed partition, we establish a performance guarantee that separates value-function approximation error from the loss introduced by action sharing. Guided by this analysis, we develop a multi-timescale reinforcement learning framework that jointly adapts the policy and a tree-structured environment abstraction. The resulting algorithm refines and coarsens regions of the state space based on Q-value discrepancies, balancing performance against abstraction size and complexity. Empirical results demonstrate substantial state compression, improved sample efficiency, and faster replanning compared to actor-critic baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大规模马尔可夫决策过程中性能驱动的环境抽象方法，通过聚合状态空间并强制共享动作分布，直接优化决策质量。提出多时间尺度强化学习框架，联合调整策略和树结构抽象，根据Q值差异细化或粗化状态空间区域，平衡性能与抽象复杂度。实验表明，该方法相比演员-评论家基线实现了显著的状态压缩、样本效率提升和更快的重新规划。
Motivation: 现有环境抽象方法多保留几何或拓扑结构，而非直接优化决策质量，本文旨在通过可控近似直接提升决策质量。
Method: 提出多时间尺度强化学习框架，联合自适应策略和树结构环境抽象。基于固定划分的性能保证（分离值函数近似误差与动作共享损失），算法根据Q值差异细化或粗化状态空间区域。
Result: 实验结果表明，与演员-评论家基线相比，该方法实现了显著的状态压缩、改进的样本效率和更快的重新规划。
Conclusion: 论文强调通过性能驱动的抽象，在保持决策质量的同时压缩状态空间，显著提升样本效率和规划速度。

papers.title: Contactless Respiratory Monitoring on Heterogeneous Mobile Robots: A Multimodal Edge-Computing Framework
papers.abstract_en: Respiratory-rate (RR) monitoring is a critical component of remote triage and victim assessment in emergency response, disaster recovery, and infectious-disease scenarios, where minimizing physical contact can reduce responder risk and improve operational safety. However, field deployment of contactless RR monitoring remains challenging due to variable illumination, posture changes, platform heterogeneity, and the impracticality of wearable sensors in hazardous environments. In this paper, we present a modality-adaptive contactless RR monitoring framework for heterogeneous mobile robots with onboard edge computing. The proposed system combines brightness-adaptive sensor selection across RGB, thermal, near-infrared (NIR), and low-light cameras, keypoint-guided chest ROI extraction for posture-robust monitoring, and a signal-quality-index (SQI)-based filtering mechanism for reliable respiratory estimation. We implement and evaluate the framework on three robotic platforms spanning quadruped and wheeled locomotion and multiple edge-computing architectures. Experiments conducted across diverse lighting conditions, subject poses, and robot-to-subject distances demonstrate that the framework generalizes across platforms without per-platform algorithmic retuning, while revealing modality-specific operational boundaries. RGB provides the broadest coverage up to 8m, NIR remains effective up to 6m, thermal is reliable only at short range, and low-light sensing supports monitoring in complete darkness up to 8m. Overall, the results demonstrate the feasibility of multimodal contactless RR monitoring on mobile robots and support its use as a foundation for autonomous triage and victim assessment in hazardous search-and-rescue settings.

TL;DR: 本文针对应急响应和灾难救援中非接触式呼吸监测的部署挑战，提出一种模态自适应的边缘计算框架，集成RGB、热成像、近红外和低光相机，基于关键点引导的胸部ROI提取和信号质量指数滤波，在四足和轮式机器人平台上验证了跨平台泛化能力，并揭示了各模态的操作边界。
Motivation: 在紧急响应、灾难恢复和传染病场景中，非接触式呼吸率监测对减少接触风险至关重要，但现有方法因光照变化、姿势变化、平台异构性以及可穿戴传感器不适用而难以现场部署。
Method: 提出一种模态自适应框架，包含亮度自适应传感器选择（RGB/热/NIR/低光）、关键点引导的胸部ROI提取（姿态鲁棒）和基于信号质量指数（SQI）的滤波机制，在三个异构机器人平台（四足和轮式）及多种边缘计算架构上实现。
Result: 实验表明框架无需逐平台算法调优即可泛化；RGB有效距离达8米，NIR达6米，热成像仅短距可靠，低光在完全黑暗下可达8米。
Conclusion: 该工作证明了在移动机器人上实现多模态非接触式呼吸监测的可行性，可作为危险搜索救援中自主分诊和受害者评估的基础。

papers.title: Implicit vs. Explicit Prompting Strategies for LVLMs in Referential Communication
papers.abstract_en: Two recent studies (Jones et al. (2026); Zeng et al. (2026)) reach apparently contradictory conclusions about whether LVLMs can coordinate on efficient referring expressions. We control for task differences between the studies while directly comparing their prompting styles. We replicate the finding that models can coordinate efficient referring expressions when explicitly prompted to do so, suggesting that other task differences are not responsible for divergent results. However, we also find that the same models fail to infer the need for communicative efficiency from a more implicit prompt, highlighting critical differences between how humans and AI systems communicate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在参考交流中的显式与隐式提示策略。研究发现，在显式提示下模型能够协调出高效的指称表达，但隐式提示下模型无法推断沟通效率需求，揭示了人类与AI系统在交流方式上的关键差异。
Motivation: 两个近期研究得出关于LVLM能否协调高效指称表达的看似矛盾的结论，本文旨在通过控制任务差异并直接比较提示风格来厘清这一矛盾。
Method: 直接比较显式与隐式两种提示风格，同时控制两个研究之间的任务差异，以复现先前结果。
Result: 复现了显式提示下模型能协调高效指称表达的结果，但隐式提示下模型未能推断出沟通效率需求。
Conclusion: 显式与隐式提示策略导致模型表现不同，凸显了人类与AI系统在交流中的根本差异。

papers.title: Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Qwen-RobotWorld, a language-conditioned video world model for embodied intelligence. With natural language as a unified action interface, it predicts physically grounded future visual trajectories from current observations across robotic manipulation, autonomous driving, indoor navigation, and human-to-robot transfer. This unified formulation provides three promising application directions: synthetic data generation for policy training augmentation, scalable virtual environments for policy evaluation, and language-guided planning signals for downstream robot control. This is achieved through a three-part design: a) Double-Stream MMDiT with MLLM Action Encoding, where a 60-layer double-stream diffusion transformer couples frozen Qwen2.5-VL semantics with video-VAE latents through layer-wise joint attention; b) Embodied World Knowledge (EWK), an 8.6M video-text corpus (200M+ frames) with action-language mapping over 20+ embodiments and 500+ action categories; and c) General+Expert Progressive Curriculum, a two-stage training strategy that first learns general visual priors and then injects embodied specialization under a shared language interface. Extensive results show strong competitiveness: ranks 1st overall on EWMBench and DreamGen Bench, outperforms all open-source models on WorldModelBench and PBench. Additional zero-shot analyses on RoboTwin-IF benchmark further support robust generalization and multi-view consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Qwen-RobotWorld，一个基于语言条件的视频世界模型，通过自然语言作为统一动作接口，预测机器人操作、自动驾驶、室内导航和人-机器人迁移等场景中物理上合理的未来视觉轨迹。模型采用60层双流扩散Transformer（双流MMDiT）结合Qwen2.5-VL语义编码，在8.6M视频文本语料库（EWK）上通过两阶段渐进课程训练（先学习通用视觉先验，再注入具身专有知识）。在多个基准上排名第一，包括EWMBench、DreamGen Bench、WorldModelBench和PBench，并在RoboTwin-IF上展示了零样本泛化与多视图一致性。
Motivation: 现有世界模型缺乏统一的语言界面，难以在多种具身任务（如操作、驾驶、导航）中实现泛化，且缺乏大规模、多动作类别的训练数据。
Method: 三部分设计：a) 双流MMDiT（Double-Stream MMDiT with MLLM Action Encoding），60层双流扩散Transformer通过逐层联合注意力融合冻结的Qwen2.5-VL语义与视频VAE潜变量；b) 具身世界知识（Embodied World Knowledge, EWK），包含8.6M视频文本对（2亿+帧），涵盖20+种实体和500+动作类别，并建立动作-语言映射；c) 通用+专家渐进课程（General+Expert Progressive Curriculum），两阶段训练：先学习通用视觉先验，再在共享语言接口下注入具身专有能力。
Result: 摘要报告在EWMBench、DreamGen Bench、WorldModelBench和PBench上均排名第一（超越所有开源模型）；在RoboTwin-IF零样本评估中展现鲁棒泛化和多视图一致性。
Conclusion: 语言条件视频世界模型可通过统一语言界面实现多种具身任务的泛化，并为策略训练的数据增强、虚拟环境评估和语言引导规划提供实际应用方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Integrated Marketing Attribution: A Bayesian Framework for Privacy-Safe Granular Measurement Anchored in MMM
papers.abstract_en: Retail marketing measurement increasingly requires granular campaign-level insights without relying on user-level tracking. However, the two dominant approaches, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), often produce fragmented insights. MMM is privacy-safe and robust for channel-level planning but is too coarse for campaign optimization, while MTA provides granular attribution but has become less reliable under increasing privacy restrictions. We propose Integrated Marketing Attribution (IMA), a unified framework that combines MMM with channel specific Bayesian attribution models to derive campaign-level effects from aggregated data. By leveraging MMM-informed priors, IMA delivers granular, privacy-safe attribution while preserving consistency with MMM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出集成营销归因（IMA）框架，将营销组合建模（MMM）与特定渠道的贝叶斯归因模型相结合，从聚合数据中推导出广告活动级别的效果，无需用户级追踪。IMA利用MMM先验信息，提供细粒度、隐私安全的归因，同时保持与MMM的一致性。
Motivation: 零售营销测量需要在无用户级追踪下获得细粒度活动洞察，但现有MMM和MTA方法分别存在过粗和隐私不可靠的问题。
Method: 提出集成营销归因（IMA）统一框架，结合MMM与渠道特异性贝叶斯归因模型，通过MMM信息先验从聚合数据导出活动级效果。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，但框架声称能提供细粒度、隐私安全的归因，且与MMM一致。
Conclusion: IMA框架在隐私限制下结合MMM的稳健性与MTA的粒度，为零售营销测量提供统一方案。

papers.title: Infant Spontaneous Movement Noise Improves Exploration in Deep RL
papers.abstract_en: Exploration in deep reinforcement learning (RL) is commonly implemented as temporally uncorrelated white noise. However, recent works show that temporally correlated colored noise can improve exploration efficiency by producing smooth trajectories with better coverage of the state space. We inquire whether action noise inspired by infant spontaneous movements can also improve exploration in deep RL. We find that the power spectral densities of babies' end-effector velocities follow a colored noise process where the spectral exponent increases with age. Inspired by this developmental pattern, we introduce a mechanism that progressively increases the temporal auto-correlation of exploration noise during RL training, matching the infant statistics. Experiments across several RL environments show that infant-inspired noise produces structured exploratory behavior and can improve learning efficiency compared to conventional exploration strategies. These findings suggest that human motor and cognitive development can provide useful guidance for designing learning mechanisms in artificial agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/trieschlab/baby-noise-rl.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted at IEEE ICDL 2026. Cite as: F. M. López, M. R. Ernst, F. Cruz, M. Hoffmann, and J. Triesch, "Infant Spontaneous Movement Noise Improves Exploration in Deep RL", in 2026 IEEE International Conference on Development and Learning (ICDL). IEEE, 2026, pp. 1-6
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受婴儿自发运动噪声启发，提出一种在深度强化学习中逐步增加探索噪声时间相关性的方法。实验表明，这种婴儿噪声能在多个环境中产生结构化探索行为，并提升学习效率，优于传统白噪声或有色噪声策略。
Motivation: 现有深度强化学习探索噪声多为时间不相关的白噪声，而婴儿运动噪声具有随年龄增加时间相关性的特点，可能更有效地覆盖状态空间。
Method: 通过分析婴儿端部速度的功率谱密度，发现其符合随年龄指数增加的有色噪声过程，据此设计训练中逐步提高探索噪声时间相关性的机制。
Result: 在多个强化学习环境中，婴儿噪声策略相比传统探索策略提高了学习效率。
Conclusion: 人类运动发育模式可为人工智能探索机制设计提供启发。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kairos: A Native World Model Stack for Physical AI
papers.abstract_en: World models are transitioning from passive visual generators to foundational, operational infrastructure for Physical AI: they must natively acquire world knowledge from heterogeneous experience, maintain persistent states over long horizons, and execute efficiently within real deployment constraints. We introduce Kairos, a native world model stack designed around these requirements. (1) Kairos learns the world by pioneering a Native Pre-training Paradigm governed by a Cross-Embodiment Data Curriculum, which organizes open-world videos, human behavioral data, and robot interactions into a progressive developmental pathway. (2) Kairos maintains the world by unified world understanding, generation, and prediction within a Native Unified Architecture equipped with Hybrid Linear Temporal Attention, where sliding-window attention captures local dynamics, dilated sliding windows capture mid-range dependencies, and gated linear attention maintains persistent global memory. We establish formal theoretical bounds demonstrating that this temporal factorization strictly limits error accumulation, mathematically guaranteeing state propagation across extended horizons. (3) Kairos runs the world by incorporating a Deployment-Aware System Co-Design to support low-latency rollout generation on server and consumer-grade hardware for real-world observation-action-feedback loops. Experiments on embodied world-model, long-horizon, and action-policy benchmarks show that Kairos achieves top level performance while offering a strong efficiency-capability trade-off. Together, these results position Kairos as a cohesive operational foundation for future self-evolving physical intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kairos是一个为物理AI设计的原生世界模型栈，提出了跨实体数据课程的本机预训练范式、混合线性时间注意力的统一架构以及部署感知的系统协同设计。实验表明其在具身世界模型、长时域和行动策略基准上取得了顶级性能。
Motivation: 现有世界模型多作为被动视觉生成器，缺乏从异构经验中获取世界知识、维持长时域持久状态并满足部署约束的能力。
Method: 提出三步方法：(1) 通过跨实体数据课程进行本机预训练；(2) 采用混合线性时间注意力（滑动窗口、膨胀滑动窗口、门控线性注意力）实现统一的世界理解、生成与预测，并有理论误差界保证；(3) 部署感知系统协同设计以支持低延迟推演。
Result: 在具身世界模型、长时域和行动策略基准上达到顶级性能，并展现出强效率-能力权衡。
Conclusion: Kairos作为一个凝聚的操作基础，为未来自演化的物理智能提供了可能性。

papers.title: PermaVid: Consistent Video Generation Across Edits via Disentangled Context Memory
papers.abstract_en: Consistent video generation under editing operations requires persistence: when edits modify scene appearance or layout, subsequent generations should remain coherent across time and viewpoints. However, existing memory designs struggle to maintain long-term consistency after such modifications, as stored contexts may become outdated or invalid. To address this, we propose PermaVid, a novel framework built upon a multi-modal context memory that disentangles spatial context into semantic appearance and geometric structure, together with an edit-aware memory update and retrieval strategy that keeps memory evolution aligned with subsequent observations. Specifically, we develop two complementary memory banks: an RGB context memory that captures appearance-aware observations while implicitly encoding geometry, and a depth context memory that preserves geometry-only structure disentangled from semantics. Building on this design, we introduce a memory-guided video generation model that performs multi-modal feature fusion under reference conditions drawn from mixed-modality memory contexts. Experiments demonstrate that our method maintains strong long-term semantic and structural consistency after edits, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

papers.title: Scalable and Interpretable Representation Alignment with Ordinal Similarity
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating representation similarity is fundamental to representation learning. However, existing metrics suffer from significant limitations: they lack interpretability due to shifting baselines, lack robustness to outliers, and are computationally intractable for large datasets, forcing reliance on heuristic approximations. To address this, we develop an ordinal-similarity framework, instantiated by the Triplet (TSI) and Quadruplet (QSI) Similarity Indices, which measure alignment by quantifying the consistency of ordinal relationships. We theoretically demonstrate this formulation is inherently interpretable, robust to outliers, and computationally efficient. Finally, we establish a formal equivalence between TSI and local neighborhood alignment, measured by Mutual Nearest Neighbors. Empirically, we validate these properties and show that ordinal similarity offers a scalable approach to measuring alignment, enabling practitioners to better understand and design representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于序数相似性的表示对齐框架，通过三元组相似性指数（TSI）和四元组相似性指数（QSI）度量表示间的对齐程度。理论证明该方法具有内在可解释性、对离群值鲁棒且计算高效，并建立了TSI与互近邻局部对齐的等价关系。实验验证了这些性质，表明序数相似性是一种可扩展的对齐度量方法。
Motivation: 现有表示相似性度量存在可解释性差（基线漂移）、对离群值不鲁棒、在大数据集上计算困难等问题，迫使依赖启发式近似。
Method: 提出序数相似性框架，通过量化序数关系的一致性来度量对齐，具体实例化为三元组相似性指数（TSI）和四元组相似性指数（QSI）。
Result: 理论表明该框架具有内在可解释性、对离群值鲁棒且计算高效；实验验证了这些性质，并展示了可扩展性。
Conclusion: 序数相似性为表示对齐提供了一种可解释、鲁棒且可扩展的度量，有助于更好地理解和设计表示。

papers.title: Medical Heuristic Learning: An LLM-Driven Framework for Interpretable and Auditable Clinical Decision Rules
papers.abstract_en: Predictive modeling for clinical tabular data is central to clinical decision support and therefore requires not only strong predictive performance but also transparent decision logic. Although deep learning and tree-based ensemble methods can achieve high accuracy, their black-box nature remains a major obstacle to clinical deployment. This challenge is further compounded by common characteristics of medical data, including limited sample sizes, severe class imbalance, and feature evolution arising from changes in diagnostic criteria and clinical documentation. To address these issues, we propose Medical Heuristic Learning (MHL), an instantiation of the learning-beyond-gradients paradigm for clinical tabular prediction. Instead of relying on neural network weight updates, MHL uses a large language model (LLM)-driven workflow that integrates statistical probes, medical knowledge probes, rule synthesis, and code-level iterative refinement to optimize a deterministic and executable decision system. The resulting model is expressed not as opaque parameters, but as versioned pure-Python decision rules that are explicitly interpretable, fully auditable, and clinically grounded. MHL also supports continual learning by starting from previously validated rules and iteratively revising them using updated feature information under data drift or feature evolution. Comprehensive experiments on medical datasets show that MHL achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods while maintaining strong behavior in small-sample and highly imbalanced settings. The results further indicate that this explicit rule update mechanism can help alleviate catastrophic forgetting under feature evolution. Overall, these findings suggest that non-gradient-based heuristic systems offer a transparent and adaptable alternative for high-stakes clinical decision support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出医学启发式学习（MHL）框架，利用大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的工作流，通过统计探针、医学知识探针、规则合成和代码级迭代优化，生成可解释、可审计的确定性决策规则，用于临床表格数据预测。实验表明，MHL在性能上与现有方法相当，并在小样本和严重类别不平衡场景下表现稳健，同时支持连续学习以应对特征演变。
Motivation: 临床表格数据预测需要高预测性能和透明决策逻辑，但深度学习和树集成方法因黑盒特性难以部署，且医疗数据存在样本量小、类别不平衡、特征演变等问题。
Method: MHL采用学习超越梯度范式，使用LLM驱动的工作流，结合统计探针、医学知识探针、规则合成和代码级迭代优化，生成版本化的纯Python决策规则，并支持基于规则更新的连续学习。
Result: 在多个医疗数据集上，MHL取得了与现有最优方法相当的预测性能，并在小样本和高不平衡场景下保持强行为，同时通过显式规则更新缓解了特征演变下的灾难性遗忘。
Conclusion: 非梯度启发式系统为高风险临床决策支持提供了透明且可适应的替代方案。

papers.title: DynFS-MoE: Dynamic Functional-Structural Mixture-of-Experts for Post-Traumatic Epilepsy Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Post-traumatic epilepsy (PTE) is a severe complication of traumatic brain injury (TBI), yet early identification remains challenging due to the complex structural and functional alterations it induces in the brain. To address this, we propose a dynamic multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that integrates functional and structural MRI through time-aware functional-structural encoding and class-conditioned expert routing. Within this framework, modality-specific and cross-modal experts learn complementary representations, while a Modality-Class MoE (MCoE) module dynamically dispatches expert weights according to each classification objective. Experimental results across three binary classification tasks demonstrate that the framework consistently outperforms static fusion baselines, and high-interpretability analyses further reveal meaningful region-of-interest (ROI) interactions. This dynamic multimodal expert framework effectively captures class-dependent brain interaction patterns and provides an interpretable approach for PTE diagnosis and risk stratification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个动态多模态MoE框架DynFS-MoE，用于创伤后癫痫（PTE）诊断。该框架通过时间感知的功能-结构编码和类别条件专家路由整合功能MRI与结构MRI，并引入Modality-Class MoE模块动态分配专家权重。实验在三个二分类任务上优于静态融合基线，可解释性分析揭示了有意义的感兴趣区域（ROI）交互。
Motivation: 创伤后癫痫（PTE）是创伤性脑损伤的严重并发症，早期识别困难，因为脑部结构和功能改变复杂。
Method: 提出动态多模态MoE框架，包含时间感知功能-结构编码和类别条件专家路由；框架内模特异和跨模态专家学习互补表示；Modality-Class MoE（MCoE）模块根据分类目标动态分配专家权重。
Result: 在三个二分类任务上，框架一致优于静态融合基线，高可解释性分析揭示了有意义的ROI交互。
Conclusion: 该动态多模态专家框架有效捕获类别依赖的脑交互模式，为PTE诊断和风险分层提供可解释方法。

papers.title: MASCOT-Android: A Curated Dataset and Automated Collection Pipeline for Android Malware Source Code Specimens
papers.abstract_en: Compared with binaries and decompiled code, malware source code more directly reflects the attackers' original intent. However, the scarcity of source code and the high cost of manual review make such datasets difficult to build and maintain. We propose MASCOT-Android, a curated dataset of Android malware source code and an automated collection framework for scalable malware source code discovery on GitHub. A key finding of our work is that repository-level documentation alone provides a strong signal for malware source code collection. Our model extracts character-level TF-IDF features from 8,772 malware and 25,747 benign README documents and trains a LinearSVC classifier to distinguish malware repositories. This README-only model achieves an accuracy of 96.28\% and an FPR of 1.06\% in local evaluation. In addition, the model outputs confidence scores, allowing users to adjust the decision threshold to balance FPR and coverage, which is practical in real-world malware source code collection.

papers.title: Mind-Studio: Executable World Models with Lookahead Evaluation for Partially Observable Games
papers.abstract_en: World-model synthesis aims to turn interaction experience into an internal model of environment dynamics. Existing symbolic approaches often fit observed transitions or mixtures of local rules, but they do not produce a complete executable program that can run independently of the real environment. We present Mind-Studio, a framework that synthesizes executable pygame-style world models from state-action-next-state trajectories using large language models. Mind-Studio combines entropy-selected traces with a lightweight game skill file containing object, action, and static scene information extracted from screenshots. We evaluate synthesis quality with a K-step lookahead fidelity protocol that compares generated world-model rollouts against Real-ALE rollouts from the same state. On Montezuma's Revenge, Mind-Studio improves chosen-action next-state prediction from 0.3% for PoE-World to 48.7% while verifying 5 of 8 subgoals; across Alien, Assault, and Skiing, it achieves stronger branch-level fidelity than prior learned lookahead sources.

Motivation: 现有符号世界模型方法仅拟合观察到的转换或局部规则，无法生成独立于真实环境的完整可执行程序。
Method: 结合熵选择轨迹和轻量级游戏技能文件（含从截图提取的对象、动作和静态场景信息），使用大语言模型合成可执行的pygame风格世界模型。评估采用K步前瞻保真度协议，比较生成的世界模型滚动与真实ALE滚动。

papers.title: GOOSE-M2F: Adapting Mask2Former for High-Fidelity, Long-Tailed Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation in Unstructured Outdoor Terrain
papers.abstract_en: We present GOOSE-M2F, a task-specific adaptation of Mask2Former for the GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation (FGSS) Challenge at ICRA 2026. The GOOSE benchmark spans 64 fine-grained classes across unstructured outdoor terrain with a severely long-tailed distribution, where rare classes occupy fewer than 50 pixels per image. We extend the Swin-Large Mask2Former baseline with three targeted contributions: (1) 200 object queries to eliminate representational saturation; (2) a Feature Refinement Module (FRM) combining ASPP-lite and CBAM dual-attention; and (3) an Auxiliary Supervision Head that delivers direct per-pixel gradients for rare classes. A multi-stage training strategy pairs Distribution-Balanced loss, Rare-Class Copy-Paste augmentation, dynamic IoU-aware re-weighting, and EMA. At inference, a dense sliding-window engine with 2D Gaussian kernel blending and 4-scale TTA adds +10.57%. GOOSE-M2F achieves 70.08% Official Composite mIoU (63.55% fine, 76.61% coarse), placing 3rd on the GOOSE 2D FGSS leaderboard. papers.title: Control-Plane Placement Shapes Forgetting: An Architectural Study of Agent Memory Across Thirteen System Configurations
papers.abstract_en: Where an LLM sits in an agent memory pipeline -- between the recall plane that retrieves stored facts (extensively benchmarked) and the control plane that mutates them via supersede, release, purge (largely untested) -- shapes which forgetting failure modes the system recovers. Comparing thirteen system configurations on a 385-case adversarial surface, we observe three placement regimes with partly complementary coverage: deterministic primitives suffice for lexical/temporal categories but fail canonicalization (5% on identifier-obfuscation, 0% on cross-lingual); inscribe-time LLM recovers canonicalization (100%) but cannot help intent-aware deletion (0% on prefix-collision and compound-fact); a mutation-time hook recovers intent-aware deletion (78-85%) and brightens nearly all categories simultaneously (91.7-93.2% overall, $0.17 per 385-case run, 2.3s/case mutation latency vs. 64-191ms/case deterministic, recall path unchanged). We expose the trade-off via ForgetEval, a 1000-case templated suite plus a 385-case adversarial layer (132 hand-crafted + 253 LLM-drafted oracle-validated) scored by deterministic substring match, paired with a six-method Adapter Protocol with honest N/A scoring that lets heterogeneous memory stores enter in 130 lines. Admission is corroborated by 10-annotator IAA (Fleiss' kappa = 0.958) and a 77-case external-authored subset (four blind contributors) that replicates the canonicalization asymmetry and amplifies the joint-placement lift (+27.8 pt). Production failures are predominantly forgetting failures rather than recall failures, yet existing benchmarks measure only recall. ForgetEval and all adapters are released under MIT.
papers.comment: 25 pages including appendices. Code, benchmark, and adapters released under MIT at https://github.com/deeplethe/lethe
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM在智能体记忆管道中的放置位置——位于检索平面（recall plane）与控制平面（control plane）之间——如何影响系统的遗忘故障模式。通过13种系统配置在385个对抗性案例上的对比，发现了三种放置机制及其互补覆盖范围：确定性原语处理词汇/时间类别但规范化为0%；写入时LLM恢复规范化但无法处理意图感知删除；变异时钩子恢复意图感知删除并整体提升至91.7-93.2%，代价是延迟增加。作者发布了包含1000个模板案例和385个对抗性案例的ForgetEval基准套件，并提供六种适配器协议。
Motivation: 现有记忆系统基准仅测量检索（recall）性能，但生产故障主要是遗忘（forgetting）而非检索失败，且控制平面对记忆的修改（替代、释放、清除）尚未被系统测试。
Method: 设计ForgetEval基准（1000个模板案例 + 385个对抗性案例），并提出六种适配器协议，允许异构记忆存储以130行代码接入。通过13种系统配置比较三种放置机制：确定性原语、写入时LLM、变异时钩子。
Result: 确定性原语在词汇/时间类别的遗忘故障上表现良好，但规范化失败（标识符混淆5%，跨语言0%）；写入时LLM恢复规范化（100%），但意图感知删除失败（前缀冲突和复合事实0%）；变异时钩子恢复意图感知删除（78-85%），整体准确率91.7-93.2%，每次运行成本0.17美元，变异延迟2.3秒/案例。
Conclusion: 智能体记忆管道中控制平面的放置位置决定了遗忘故障的覆盖范围，联合使用多种放置机制可以显著提升性能（+27.8百分点），现有基准仅测量检索而忽略了更常见的遗忘问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Koshur Diacritizer: A Byte-Level Sequence-to-Sequence Model for Kashmiri Diacritic Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Kashmiri, an Indo-Aryan language written in a modified Perso-Arabic script, frequently omits diacritic marks in digital text, creating ambiguity and challenging downstream NLP applications. We present Koshur Diacritizer, a ByT5-small byte-level sequence-to-sequence model for restoring diacritics in Kashmiri text. To support this task, we release a publicly available dataset of 23.7k aligned undiacritized diacritized Kashmiri sentence pairs. The proposed framework combines script-aware normalization, alignment validation, and skeleton-preserving inference to ensure reliable restoration while maintaining the original base-letter sequence. Experimental results on a held-out test set achieve a DERm of 0.2012 and a WER of 0.2159. Additionally, evaluation by a native Kashmiri linguistic expert yields a mean accuracy of 77.5%. The dataset, model, and source code are publicly released to provide a reproducible baseline for Kashmiri diacritic restoration and future low-resource language research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Koshur Diacritizer，一个基于 ByT5-small 的字节级序列到序列模型，用于恢复克什米尔语（Kashmiri）文本中缺失的变音符号。作者发布了包含 23.7k 句对的公开数据集，并采用脚本感知规范化、对齐验证和骨架保留推理策略。在保留测试集上取得 DERm 0.2012 和 WER 0.2159，母语专家评估准确率 77.5%。数据集、模型和代码已开源。
Motivation: 克什米尔语数字文本常省略变音符号，导致歧义并影响下游 NLP 应用，因此需要可靠的变音符号恢复工具。
Method: 采用 ByT5-small 字节级序列到序列模型，结合脚本感知的规范化、对齐验证和骨架保留推理，确保在恢复的同时保持原基本字母序列。
Result: 在保留测试集上 DERm 为 0.2012，WER 为 0.2159；母语语言学家评估平均准确率为 77.5%。
Conclusion: 本文为克什米尔语变音符号恢复提供了可复现的基线，并通过公开资源促进低资源语言研究。

papers.title: EHRNote-ChatQA: A Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Multi-Turn Clinical Question Answering over Longitudinal Discharge Summaries
papers.abstract_en: Discharge summaries are crucial clinical documents containing the context of a patient's overall hospital stay, and are routinely reviewed by medical experts for patient readmission, ongoing care, and diagnostic decision-making. When reviewing them, medical experts often must iteratively synthesize information across multiple summaries while verifying the evidence supporting each answer. Although large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for clinical question answering, existing benchmarks do not sufficiently reflect this setting: they often evaluate exam-style medical knowledge or focus on single-turn question answering with limited evidence-grounding evaluation. We introduce EHRNote-ChatQA, the first benchmark for evidence-grounded multi-turn clinical question answering over patients' multiple discharge summaries. Built from de-identified MIMIC-IV discharge summaries, EHRNote-ChatQA contains 967 patient-level multi-turn samples spanning one to five notes and 16,072 medical-expert-verified QA pairs (8,036 content questions, each paired with an evidence-grounding question) across eight clinical categories. The benchmark is constructed through an expert-informed pipeline combining discharge-summary structuring schema, expert-curated multi-turn QA templates, and LLM-based generation, followed by review and revision of every single QA sample by 11 medical experts. Benchmarking 22 open- and closed-source LLMs reveals several challenges, including that LLMs struggle more with evidence grounding than content answering, multi-turn errors compound across turns, and single-turn clinical QA performance does not reliably transfer to this setting. These findings establish EHRNote-ChatQA as a rigorous and practical benchmark for evaluating clinical QA systems. The dataset will be made publicly available through PhysioNet credentialed access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EHRNote-ChatQA 是一个针对患者多次出院小结的、基于证据的多轮临床问答基准。构建自 MIMIC-IV 数据集，包含 967 个患者级多轮样本和 16,072 个医疗专家验证的 QA 对。对 22 个开源和闭源 LLM 的基准测试表明，模型在证据接地方面比内容回答更困难，多轮错误会累积，且单轮临床问答性能不能可靠迁移到该设置。
Motivation: 现有临床问答基准多为单轮或考试式医学知识问答，缺乏对多次出院小结中证据接地的多轮对话场景的评估。
Method: 通过专家主导的流程构建：出院小结结构化模式、专家策划的多轮问答模板、基于 LLM 生成，并由 11 位医学专家审核每个样本。
Result: 22 个 LLM 的测试显示，证据接地任务比内容回答更难，多轮对话中错误累积，单轮性能不能可靠预测多轮表现。
Conclusion: EHRNote-ChatQA 是一个严格且实用的临床问答系统评估基准，数据集将通过 PhysioNet 凭证访问公开。
