papers.title: CyberEvolver: Structured Self-Evolution for Cybersecurity Agents On the Fly
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are increasingly used for cybersecurity tasks, but most existing systems rely on fixed, human-designed scaffolds that struggle to adapt across diverse targets and failure modes. We introduce \textsc{CyberEvolver}, a self-evolving cybersecurity agent framework that iteratively revises its own scaffold based on experience from failed execution attempts. Self-evolution in cybersecurity is challenging because the space of possible scaffold changes is largely unstructured, execution feedback is sparse and often obscured by the environment, and low-diversity updates can cause errors to compound over repeated iterations. \textsc{CyberEvolver} addresses these challenges with a four-layer evolvable agent architecture that decomposes scaffold optimization into structured components, a trace-to-diagnosis mechanism that converts noisy execution logs into actionable revision signals, and a population-based beam search strategy that preserves diverse agent variants during evolution. We evaluate \textsc{CyberEvolver} on CTF challenges, vulnerability exploitation, and penetration-testing tasks using four open-source LLMs. Across these settings, \textsc{CyberEvolver} improves the seed agent's success rate by $13.6$\,\% on average, and outperforms six human-designed cybersecurity agents as well as two self-improvement methods adapted from other domains. These results suggest that scaffold self-evolution is a promising direction for building adaptive LLM agents for security testing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自进化的网络安全Agent框架CyberEvolver，通过从失败执行中迭代修订scaffold来适应多样目标和失败模式。包含四层可进化架构、trace-to-diagnosis机制和基于种群的波束搜索策略。在CTF、漏洞利用和渗透测试任务中，使用四个开源LLM评估，平均提升种子Agent成功率13.6%，并优于六个手工设计的Agent和两种跨域自改进方法。

Result: 在CTF、漏洞利用和渗透测试中，使用四个开源LLM，平均提升种子Agent成功率13.6%，优于六个手工Agent和两个自改进方法。
Conclusion: 结果表明scaffold自进化是构建自适应安全测试LLM Agent的有前途方向。

papers.title: Any2Any: Efficient Cross-Embodiment Transfer for Humanoid Whole-Body Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Whole-body tracking (WBT) models have become a key foundation for humanoid robots, enabling them to imitate diverse motions with high fidelity. Training such models from scratch requires large-scale data and computation, making rapid deployment on new humanoid platforms costly. This raises a natural question: Can pretrained WBT models transfer across embodiments with minimal adaptation? To answer this question, we propose Any2Any, a paradigm that efficiently transfers an existing WBT specialist to a new humanoid embodiment with only a small amount of data and compute. Any2Any first performs kinematic alignment between source and target humanoids, aligning their input and output spaces so that the pretrained source policy can be meaningfully reused on the target embodiment.Any2Any then performs dynamics adaptation by applying lightweight parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) components to selected dynamics-sensitive modules, preserving useful behavioral priors while enabling targeted adaptation to the target robot. Extensive experiments on multiple humanoid platforms and pretrained backbones show that Any2Any substantially accelerates convergence and reduces training cost compared with training from scratch, while achieving competitive or superior tracking performance. Notably, using only 1% of the compute and data required for full training, Any2Any successfully transfers Sonic models pre-trained on Unitree G1 to LimX Oli and LimX Luna. These results suggest that pretrained WBT specialists can be efficiently reused across embodiments, providing a scalable path toward deploying humanoid whole-body control on new robots.

papers.title: Are Frontier LLMs Ready for Cybersecurity? Evidence for Vertical Foundation Models from Dual-Mode Vulnerability Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate whether frontier LLMs are ready for cybersecurity through a dual-mode benchmark: white-box function-level vulnerability detection (VulnLLM-R, across C/Java/Python) and black-box web application security testing (five production-style applications with 118 ground-truth vulnerabilities across 20+ CWE families, which we will open-source). We test six frontier models (GPT-5.4, Codex~5.3, Claude Opus~4.7, Sonnet~4.6, Gemini~3.1~Pro and Gemini~3~Flash) and two domain-specialized models across four testing paradigms. Our findings are sobering: (1)~every frontier model produces 10-50% false positive rates in white-box detection, systematically over-predicting vulnerabilities; (2)~in black-box testing, frontier models achieve only 4-8% ground-truth coverage, improving to just 10-19% even with external security tools (Playwright MCP, Burp Suite MCP); (3)~structured penetration-testing methodology encoded in domain-specialized agents raises per-family detection above 50%, demonstrating that methodology, not scale, is the primary lever; and (4)~a domain-specialized defense model achieves the highest precision (0.904) and lowest false positive rate (9.7%) among all models, on a single GPU. We identify the absence of structured security testing traces end-to-end request/response sequences, failure-heavy data, and multi-step attack chains as the fundamental training data bottleneck, and propose self-play security testing as a data generation strategy. Our results make the case for vertical foundation models purpose-built for cybersecurity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过双模式基准测试（白盒漏洞检测与黑盒Web应用安全测试）系统评估前沿大模型在网络安全任务中的表现。测试了GPT-5.4、Claude等6个前沿模型和2个领域专用模型，发现前沿模型假阳性率高、漏洞覆盖率低，而编码领域专用方法的模型性能显著更好。研究指出缺乏结构化安全测试数据是训练瓶颈，并提出自博弈安全测试作为数据生成策略，最终论证构建专用垂直基础模型的必要性。
Motivation: 当前缺乏系统性基准评估前沿LLM在网络安全任务中的真实能力，现有测试不足以揭示模型在复杂安全场景中的局限性。
Method: 构建双模式基准：白盒函数级漏洞检测基准VulnLLM-R（覆盖C/Java/Python），以及黑盒Web应用安全测试基准（5个生产级应用，118个真实漏洞，涵盖20+ CWE类别）。在四种测试范式下评估6个前沿模型和2个领域专用模型。
Result: 前沿模型在白盒检测中假阳性率达10-50%；黑盒测试中仅覆盖4-8%的真实漏洞，使用外部安全工具后提升至10-19%；而采用结构化渗透测试方法的领域专用agent将每类漏洞检测率提升至50%以上；领域专用防御模型在单GPU上达到最高精度0.904，最低假阳性率9.7%。
Conclusion: 前沿LLM在网络安全任务中表现不足，缺乏结构化安全测试数据是根本瓶颈，应发展以网络安全为中心的垂直基础模型。

papers.title: Rethinking Cross-Layer Information Routing in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a de facto backbone of modern visual generation, and nearly every major axis of their design -- tokenization, attention, conditioning, objectives, and latent autoencoders -- has been extensively revisited. The residual stream that governs how information accumulates across layers, however, has been directly inherited from the original Transformer. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical analysis of cross-layer information flow in DiTs, jointly along depth and denoising timestep, and identify three concrete symptoms of traditional residual addition, namely monotonic forward magnitude inflation, sharp backward gradient decay, and pronounced block-wise redundancy. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose Diffusion-Adaptive Routing (\textsc{DAR}), a drop-in residual replacement that performs \emph{learnable, timestep-adaptive, and non-incremental} aggregation over the history of sublayer outputs. Moreover, the proposed \textsc{DAR} is compatible with many modern Transformer enhancement methods, such as REPA. On ImageNet $256\times256$, \textsc{DAR} improves SiT-XL/2 by $2.11$ FID ($7.56$ vs.\ $9.67$) and matches the baseline's converged quality with $8.75\times$ fewer training iterations. Stacked on top of REPA, it yields a $2\times$ training acceleration in the early stage, suggesting cross-layer information routing as an underexplored design axis in diffusion modeling, one that operates orthogonally to existing representation-alignment objectives. Beyond pretraining, \textsc{DAR} can also be applied during the fine-tuning stage of large-scale T2I models and preserves high-frequency details during Distribution Matching Distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析了扩散变换器（DiT）中跨层信息流动的问题，识别了传统残差连接的三个症状：单调的前向幅度膨胀、尖锐的反向梯度衰减和明显的块级冗余。提出可学习的、时间步自适应的非增量聚合方案 DAR，在 ImageNet 256x256 上使 SiT-XL/2 的 FID 从 9.67 降至 7.56，并实现 8.75 倍的训练加速。
Motivation: 传统 DiT 直接继承 Transformer 的残差连接，但该设计在扩散模型中存在信息流动问题，尚未被系统诊断。
Method: 提出 Diffusion-Adaptive Routing (DAR)，一个可插入的残差替换模块，对子层输出历史进行可学习、时间步自适应且非增量的聚合。
Result: DAR 在 ImageNet 256x256 上将 SiT-XL/2 的 FID 从 9.67 提升至 7.56，并以 8.75 倍更少的训练迭代达到基线收敛质量；结合 REPA 可带来 2 倍早期训练加速。
Conclusion: 跨层信息路由是扩散模型中尚未充分开发的设计轴，与已有的表示对齐目标正交，并可应用于大规模文生图模型的微调和分布匹配蒸馏。

papers.title: Remote sensing data imputation using deep learning for multispectral imagery
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing techniques have been increasingly utilised in aquatic applications in recent years. A common challenge in using optical satellite data is the presence of missing observations due to cloud cover. These data gaps can lead to missed detection of critical events, such as algal blooms, in lakes of high interest to water authorities. As a result, enhancing the completeness of optical satellite datasets is crucial for improving the monitoring and prediction of algal blooms. In this study, we compared a traditional data imputation method (i.e., linear interpolation) with deep learning models for reconstructing missing spectral bands across four lakes with historical records of algal blooms. The deep learning models adopted include CNN-based architectures (i.e., CNN, Inception Resnet, and Autoencoder) and CNN-LSTM-based architectures (i.e., CNN-LSTM, Resnet-LSTM, and Autoencoder-LSTM). Our results demonstrated that deep learning models substantially outperformed the baseline linear interpolation method in imputing spectral band values within artificially masked regions. Among these models, CNN delivered the best performance across most lakes. Furthermore, we evaluated the performance of algal bloom indices (i.e., Green/Red and NDCI) derived from the imputed imagery by comparing them with the observed data. Our results demonstrate that deep learning models are effective for imputing missing data in PlanetScope SuperDove imagery, enabling more reliable applications in water monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了线性插值与深度学习模型（CNN、Inception Resnet、Autoencoder及结合LSTM的变体）在多光谱遥感图像缺失波段重建中的表现。实验基于四个历史藻华湖泊的PlanetScope SuperDove影像，结果表明深度学习模型显著优于线性插值，其中CNN在多数湖泊中表现最佳。基于插值图像计算的藻华指数（Green/Red和NDCI）与观测数据一致，验证了深度学习在水监测中恢复缺失数据的有效性。
Motivation: 光学卫星数据因云覆盖导致观测缺失，可能错过藻华等关键事件，影响水质监测与预测。现有线性插值方法精度有限，需更有效的数据插补技术。
Method: 采用CNN、Inception Resnet、Autoencoder等纯CNN架构，以及CNN-LSTM、Resnet-LSTM、Autoencoder-LSTM等混合架构，对多光谱波段进行逐像素重建，并与线性插值基线对比。
Result: 深度学习模型在人工掩膜区域的光谱波段插补上显著优于线性插值；CNN在四个湖泊中多数取得最佳性能；基于插补图像计算的藻华指数与真实观测值吻合。
Conclusion: 深度学习模型可用于PlanetScope SuperDove影像的缺失数据插补，为水环境监测提供更完整的时间序列，但需进一步验证在不同传感器和气候条件下的泛化性。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Flash-GRPO: Efficient Alignment for Video Diffusion via One-Step Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization has emerged as essential for aligning video diffusion models with human preferences, but faces a critical computational bottleneck: training a 14B parametered model typically demands hundreds of GPU days per experiment. Existing efficiency methods reduce costs through sliding window subsampling training timesteps, but fundamentally compromise optimization, exhibiting severe instability and failing to reach full trajectory performance. We present Flash-GRPO, a single-step training framework that outperforms full trajectory training in alignment quality under low computational budgets while substantially improving training efficiency. Flash-GRPO addresses two critical challenges: iso-temporal grouping eliminates timestep-confounded variance by enforcing prompt-wise temporal consistency, decoupling policy performance from timestep difficulty; temporal gradient rectification neutralizes the time-dependent scaling factor that causes vastly inconsistent gradient magnitudes across timesteps. Experiments on 1.3B to 14B parameter models validate Flash-GRPO's effectiveness, demonstrating substantial training acceleration with consistent stability and state-of-the-art alignment quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频扩散模型对齐中GRPO训练的计算瓶颈，提出Flash-GRPO单步策略优化框架，通过等时分组（iso-temporal grouping）消除时间步混杂方差，以及时间梯度修正（temporal gradient rectification）平衡梯度大小，在1.3B至14B参数模型上实现训练加速、稳定性和对齐质量提升。
Motivation: 现有GRPO对齐视频扩散模型需要数百GPU天训练14B参数模型，而滑动窗口子采样等效率方法会损害优化稳定性，无法达到完整轨迹性能。
Method: 提出Flash-GRPO单步训练框架，包含两个关键组件：等时分组（iso-temporal grouping）强制提示间时间一致性，解耦策略性能与时间步难度；时间梯度修正（temporal gradient rectification）消除不同时间步梯度大小不一致的问题。
Result: 在1.3B至14B参数模型上的实验表明，Flash-GRPO在低计算预算下实现了显著的训练加速、一致的稳定性和最先进的对齐质量。
Conclusion: Flash-GRPO通过单步优化在效率和对齐质量上超越完整轨迹训练，为视频扩散模型对齐提供了高效的解决方案。

papers.title: Learning to Decide with AI Assistance under Human-Alignment
papers.abstract_en: It is widely agreed that when AI models assist decision-makers in high-stakes domains by predicting an outcome of interest, they should communicate the confidence of their predictions. However, empirical evidence suggests that decision-makers often struggle to determine when to trust a prediction based solely on this communicated confidence. In this context, recent theoretical and empirical work suggests a positive correlation between the utility of AI-assisted decision-making and the degree of alignment between the AI confidence and the decision-makers' confidence in their own predictions. Crucially, these findings do not yet elucidate the extent to which this alignment influences the complexity of learning to make optimal decisions through repeated interactions. In this paper, we address this question in the canonical case of binary predictions and binary decisions. We first show that this problem is equivalent to a two-armed online contextual learning problem with full feedback, and establish a lower bound of $Ω(\sqrt{|H| \cdot |B| \cdot T} )$ on the expected regret any learner can attain, where $H$ and $B$ denote the sets of human and AI confidence values. We then demonstrate that, under perfect alignment between AI and human confidence, a learner can attain an expected regret of $O(\sqrt{|H| \cdot T\log T})$ and, when $\sqrt{|H|} = O(\log T)$ and $B$ is countable, a non-trivial generalization of the Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz inequality improves the regret bound to $O(\sqrt{T\log T})$. Taken together, these results reveal that alignment can reduce the complexity of learning to make decisions with AI assistance. Experiments on real data from two different human-subject studies where participants solve simple decision-making tasks assisted by AI models show that our theoretical results are robust to violations of perfect alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在AI辅助决策中，人类与AI置信度之间的对齐如何影响学习最优决策的复杂度。在二元预测和二元决策的设定下，作者将问题建模为具有完全反馈的双臂在线上下文学习问题，并给出遗憾下界。理论证明完美对齐能降低学习复杂度，并通过真实人类实验验证了鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有研究表明AI辅助决策的效用与AI置信度和人类置信度之间的对齐程度正相关，但并未阐明这种对齐对通过反复交互学习最优决策的复杂度的影响。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 将问题转化为具有完全反馈的双臂在线上下文学习问题，推导期望遗憾的下界，并分析在完美对齐条件下的上界改进，利用Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz不等式的推广得到更紧的界。
Result: 理论证明下界为Ω(√(|H|·|B|·T))，完美对齐下界可改进为O(√(|H|·T log T))，当√|H|=O(log T)且B可数时进一步改进为O(√(T log T))。真实人类实验表明结果对偏离完美对齐具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了人机置信度对齐能够降低学习最优决策的复杂度，对设计更高效的AI辅助决策系统具有理论指导意义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Attention Sinks in Diffusion Transformers: A Causal Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Attention sinks -- tokens that receive disproportionate attention mass -- are assumed to be functionally important in autoregressive language models, but their role in diffusion transformers remains unclear. We present a causal analysis in text-to-image diffusion, dynamically identifying dominant attention recipients per timestep and suppressing them via paired, training-free interventions on the score and value paths. Across 553 GenEval prompts on Stable Diffusion~3 (with SDXL corroboration), removing these sinks does not degrade text-image alignment (CLIP-T) or preference proxies (ImageReward, HPS-v2) at $k{=}1$; only under stronger interventions ($k\!\geq\!10$) does HPS-v2 exhibit a metric-dependent boundary, while CLIP-T remains robust throughout. The perceptual shifts induced by suppression are nonetheless \emph{sink-specific} -- $\sim\!6\times$ larger than equal-budget random masking -- revealing an empirical dissociation between trajectory-level perturbation and \emph{semantic alignment} in diffusion transformers. \footnote{Code available at https://github.com/wfz666/ICML26-attention-sink.}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对文本到图像扩散模型（Diffusion Transformers）中的注意力沉没（attention sinks）进行因果分析。通过动态识别每个时间步的 dominant 注意力接收者，并在分数和价值路径上施加无需训练的成对干预，发现移除这些沉没在 k=1 时不会降低文本-图像对齐（CLIP-T）或偏好代理（ImageReward, HPS-v2）。仅在更强干预（k≥10）下 HPS-v2 出现指标依赖边界，而 CLIP-T 始终健壮。抑制引起的感知变化是沉没特异的，比等预算随机掩蔽大约 6 倍，表明扩散 Transformer 中轨迹级扰动与语义对齐之间存在经验分离。
Motivation: 注意力沉没在自回归语言模型中被认为功能重要，但其在扩散Transformer中的作用尚不清楚。本文旨在通过因果分析揭示其在文本到图像扩散中的实际影响。
Method: 提出一种动态识别每个时间步主导注意力接收者的方法，并对分数和价值路径进行成对抑制干预，该干预无需训练，同时观察下游指标变化。
Result: 在Stable Diffusion 3的553个GenEval提示上（SDXL作为验证），弱干预（k=1）下文本-图像对齐和偏好代理无退化；强干预（k≥10）时HPS-v2出现指标依赖边界，而CLIP-T始终稳健。抑制引起的感知变化比随机掩蔽大约6倍，显示沉没特异性。
Conclusion: 注意力沉没在扩散Transformer中的语义对齐作用有限，其抑制主要引起轨迹级扰动而非语义退化，提示沉没的功能角色可能与语言模型不同。

papers.title: Mental Health AI Safety Claims Must Preserve Temporal Evidence
papers.abstract_en: The safety of mental health AI is often judged at the wrong temporal scale. Current evaluations typically score isolated responses, endpoint outcomes, or aggregate dialogue quality, while clinically consequential failures may arise from the order and accumulation of interactions themselves, including delayed escalation, repeated reinforcement, dependency formation, failed repair, and gradual deterioration across turns. This paper argues that this mismatch is not merely a limitation of evaluation coverage but a source of invalid safety conclusions. We introduce Temporal Safety Non-Identifiability, a formal account of why safety properties that depend on sequence, timing, accumulation, or recovery cannot be certified by protocols that discard those features. From this formalization, we develop SCOPE (Safety Claims Over Preserved Evidence) as a general principle for aligning safety claims with the evidence an evaluation actually retains, and instantiate it as SCOPE-MH, a mental-health instantiation of this reporting standard. We operationalize SCOPE-MH through a proof-of-concept on the AnnoMI dataset of expert-annotated motivational interviewing conversations, which reveals mechanisms of failure that per-turn behavior scoring does not represent. We propose SCOPE-MH as a diagnostic complement to existing evaluation infrastructure and argue that evaluation preserving temporal evidence is necessary, not optional, for safety-critical mental health AI deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出当前心理健康AI的安全性评估通常基于孤立响应或最终结果，忽略了交互顺序、累积效应等时间特征，导致无效的安全结论。作者提出时间安全不可识别性（Temporal Safety Non-Identifiability）形式化定义，并开发了SCOPE-MH报告标准，在AnnoMI数据集上验证了逐轮行为评分无法捕捉的失败机制。
Motivation: 现有心理健康AI安全评估在错误的时间尺度上进行，忽视交互序列中的临床关键失败模式（如延迟升级、依赖形成），导致安全结论无效。
Method: 形式化时间安全不可识别性，提出SCOPE（Safety Claims Over Preserved Evidence）原则，并实例化为SCOPE-MH，通过AnnoMI数据集上的专家标注动机访谈对话进行概念验证。
Result: 概念验证表明，逐轮行为评分无法表示交互序列中的失败机制，SCOPE-MH可作为现有评估基础设施的诊断补充。
Conclusion: 在安全关键的心理健康AI部署中，保留时间证据的评估是必要的而非可选的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DVD: Discrete Voxel Diffusion for 3D Generation and Editing
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Discrete Voxel Diffusion (DVD), a discrete diffusion framework to generate, assess, and edit sparse voxels for SLat (Structured LATent) based 3D generative pipelines. Although discrete diffusion has not generally displaced continuous diffusion in image-like generation, we show that it can be an effective first-stage prior for sparse voxel scaffolds. By treating voxel occupancy as a native discrete variable, DVD avoids continuous-to-discrete thresholding and provides a simple framework for voxel generation, uncertainty estimation, and editing. Beyond quality gains, DVD provides more interpretable generation dynamics through explicit categorical modeling. Furthermore, we leverage the predictive entropy as a robust uncertainty metric to identify ambiguous voxel regions and complicated samples, facilitating tasks such as data filtering and quality assessment. Finally, we propose a lightweight fine-tuning strategy using block-structured perturbation patterns. This approach empowers the model to inpaint and edit voxels within a single sampling round, requiring negligible auxiliary computation and no additional model evaluations. Code is available at https://github.com/TeCai/DVD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出离散体素扩散（DVD）框架，用于SLat（结构化潜在）三维生成流程中稀疏体素的生成、评估和编辑。通过将体素占用视为原生离散变量，避免了连续到离散的阈值化，并支持不确定性估计和编辑。利用预测熵作为鲁棒的不确定性度量，提出轻量级微调策略实现单轮采样内的体素修复和编辑。
Motivation: 现有离散扩散方法在图像类生成中未取代连续扩散，但本文探索其在稀疏体素支架作为第一阶先验的有效性，并解决连续到离散阈值化问题。
Method: DVD框架直接对体素占用进行离散扩散建模，利用预测熵作为不确定性度量，并采用块结构扰动模式的轻量级微调策略实现单轮采样编辑。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称在体素生成、不确定性估计和编辑方面取得质量提升，且编辑需极少辅助计算和无额外模型评估。
Conclusion: 离散扩散可作为稀疏体素生成的有效先验，提供更可解释的生成动态和鲁棒的不确定性度量，便于数据过滤和质量评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Life Gives You BC, Make Q-functions: Extracting Q-values from Behavior Cloning for On-Robot Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Behavior Cloning (BC) has emerged as a highly effective paradigm for robot learning. However, BC lacks a self-guided mechanism for online improvement after demonstrations have been collected. Existing offline-to-online learning methods often cause policies to replace previously learned good actions due to a distribution mismatch between offline data and online learning. In this work, we propose Q2RL, Q-Estimation and Q-Gating from BC for Reinforcement Learning, an algorithm for efficient offline-to-online learning. Our method consists of two parts: (1) Q-Estimation extracts a Q-function from a BC policy using a few interaction steps with the environment, followed by online RL with (2) Q-Gating, which switches between BC and RL policy actions based on their respective Q-values to collect samples for RL policy training. Across manipulation tasks from D4RL and robomimic benchmarks, Q2RL outperforms SOTA offline-to-online learning baselines on success rate and time to convergence. Q2RL is efficient enough to be applied in an on-robot RL setting, learning robust policies for contact-rich and high precision manipulation tasks such as pipe assembly and kitting, in 1-2 hours of online interaction, achieving success rates of up to 100% and up to 3.75x improvement against the original BC policy. Code and video are available at https://pages.rai-inst.com/q2rl_website/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Q2RL 算法，从行为克隆（BC）策略中提取 Q 函数（Q-Estimation），并通过 Q-Gating 在 BC 和强化学习（RL）策略之间切换，实现高效的离线到在线学习。在 D4RL 和 robomimic 基准的操控任务上，Q2RL 优于现有离线到在线学习方法，并在机器人本体上仅需 1-2 小时在线交互即可学习鲁棒策略，成功率达 100%，比原始 BC 策略提升 3.75 倍。
Motivation: 行为克隆（BC）在机器人学习中表现优异，但缺乏自我驱动的在线改进机制。现有离线到在线学习方法常因离线数据与在线学习间的分布不匹配，导致策略遗忘已学的良好动作。
Method: 提出 Q2RL 算法，包含两部分：1）Q-Estimation：利用少量环境交互步骤从 BC 策略中提取 Q 函数；2）Q-Gating：根据 Q 值切换 BC 和 RL 策略的动作，收集样本用于 RL 策略训练。
Result: 在 D4RL 和 robomimic 操控任务上，Q2RL 在成功率和收敛时间上优于现有离线到在线学习基线。在机器人本体上，仅需 1-2 小时在线交互即可学习接触丰富、高精度的操控任务（如管道组装和套件装配），成功率达 100%，比原始 BC 策略提升 3.75 倍。
Conclusion: Q2RL 是一种高效的离线到在线学习方法，适用于机器人本体 RL 设置，能够通过少量在线交互显著提升 BC 策略的性能。

papers.title: Learn-To-Learn on Arbitrary Textual Conditioning: A Hypernetwork-Driven Meta-Gated LLM
papers.abstract_en: Conventional LLMs may suffer from corpus heterogeneity and subtle condition changes. While finetuning can create the catastrophe forgetting issue, application of meta-learning on LLMs is also limited due to its complexity and scalability. In this paper, we activate the meta-signal of $β$ within the SwiGLU blocks, resulting in a meta-gating mechanism that adaptively adjusts the nonlinearity of FFN. A hypernetwork is employed which dynamically produces $β$ on textual conditions, providing meta-controllability on LLMs. By testing on different condition types such as task, domain, persona, and style, our method outperforms finetuning and meta-learning baselines, and can generalize reasonably on unseen tasks, condition types, or instructions. Our code can be found in https://github.com/AaronJi/MeGan.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为MeGan的超网络驱动元门控机制，通过在SwiGLU块中注入元信号β，使大语言模型能够根据文本条件（如任务、领域、人物角色、风格）自适应调整FFN的非线性。该方法避免了微调的灾难性遗忘和元学习的扩展性问题，在多种条件类型上超越微调和元学习基线，并能合理泛化到未见任务或指令。
Motivation: 传统LLM面临语料异质性和条件变化敏感问题，微调导致灾难性遗忘，而元学习应用于LLM因复杂性和可扩展性受限，需要一种更可控且高效的适应方法。
Method: 在SwiGLU模块中引入元信号β，形成元门控机制以动态调整前馈网络的非线性；使用超网络根据文本条件实时生成β，实现对LLM的元可控性。
Result: 在任务、领域、人物、风格等不同条件类型上，该方法优于微调和元学习基线，并能合理泛化到未见任务、条件类型或指令。
Conclusion: 提出的超网络驱动元门控机制能有效提升LLM对任意文本条件的适应能力，且泛化性良好。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Weisfeiler Lehman Test on Combinatorial Complexes: Generalized Expressive Power of Topological Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Topological neural networks have emerged as effective tools for modeling higher-order relational structures beyond pairwise graphs, including hypergraphs, simplicial complexes, and cell complexes. However, existing Weisfeiler-Leman type expressivity analyses are typically developed on different structural domains and rely on domain-specific neighborhood systems, making their expressive powers difficult to compare within a common formalism. In this paper, we introduce the Combinatorial Complex Weisfeiler-Leman (CCWL) framework, a unified expressive power refinement defined on combinatorial complexes. By exploiting the ability of combinatorial complexes to represent both set-type relations and part-whole hierarchies, CCWL performs topological color refinement through four structural neighborhoods: boundary, co-boundary, lower adjacency, and upper adjacency. We show that, under specified lifting maps, CCWL can simulate several domain-specific WL-type refinements, thereby providing a common theoretical baseline for analyzing topological message passing. We further study the neighborhood sufficiency problem and prove that, under explicit coverage conditions, a reduced refinement using only lower- and upper-adjacent bridge information preserves the distinguishing power of the full four-neighborhood CCWL refinement. Guided by this theoretical result, we instantiate the reduced refinement as the Combinatorial Complex Isomorphism Network (CCIN). Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that CCIN achieves competitive performance against representative graph and topological neural network baselines. Ablation studies and resource-efficiency analyses further support the effectiveness of the proposed lower/upper-neighborhood design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出组合复形Weisfeiler-Lehman (CCWL)框架，统一了不同拓扑结构（超图、单纯复形、细胞复形）上WL测试的表达性分析。CCWL利用组合复形表示集合关系和部分-整体层次，通过四种邻域（边界、共边界、下邻接、上邻接）进行拓扑颜色细化，并证明在特定覆盖条件下，仅使用下邻接和上邻接的简化版本保持区分能力，进而实例化为组合复形同构网络（CCIN）。实验表明CCIN在合成和真实基准上与代表性图及拓扑神经网络性能相当。
Motivation: 现有拓扑神经网络的Weisfeiler-Lehman表达性分析依赖于特定领域的邻域系统，难以在统一形式下比较其表达能力。
Method: 提出CCWL框架，在组合复形上定义四种结构邻域（边界、共边界、下邻接、上邻接）进行拓扑颜色细化，并证明在满足覆盖条件时，仅使用下/上邻接桥信息的简化版本保持完整区分能力，进而设计CCIN网络。
Result: CCIN在合成和真实基准上与代表性图及拓扑神经网络基线取得竞争性性能；消融和资源效率分析支持所提出的下/上邻域设计的有效性。
Conclusion: CCWL为分析拓扑消息传递提供了统一的理论基线，简化版本CCIN在保持表达能力的同时提高了效率。

papers.title: NeuroClaw Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Agentic artificial intelligence systems promise to accelerate scientific workflows, but neuroimaging poses unique challenges: heterogeneous modalities (sMRI, fMRI, dMRI, EEG), long multi-stage pipelines, and persistent reproducibility risks. To address this gap, we present NeuroClaw, a domain-specialized multi-agent research assistant for executable and reproducible neuroimaging research. NeuroClaw operates directly on raw neuroimaging data across formats and modalities, grounding decisions in dataset semantics and BIDS metadata so users need not prepare curated inputs or bespoke model code. The platform combines harness engineering with end-to-end environment management, including pinned Python environments, Docker support, automated installers for common neuroimaging tools, and GPU configuration. In practice, this layer emphasizes checkpointing, post-execution verification, structured audit traces, and controlled runtime setup, making toolchains more transparent while improving reproducibility and auditability. A three-tier skill/agent hierarchy separates user-facing interaction, high-level orchestration, and low-level tool skills to decompose complex workflows into safe, reusable units. Alongside the NeuroClaw framework, we introduce NeuroBench, a system-level benchmark for executability, artifact validity, and reproducibility readiness. Across multiple multimodal LLMs, NeuroClaw-enabled runs yield consistent and substantial score improvements compared with direct agent invocation. Project homepage: https://cuhk-aim-group.github.io/NeuroClaw/index.html
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuroClaw是一个面向神经影像学（neuroimaging）的领域专用多智能体研究助手，直接在原始数据上操作，支持多种模态（sMRI、fMRI、dMRI、EEG）和BIDS元数据，结合工程化环境管理和三层技能/智能体层次结构，以提升可执行性和可重复性。同时引入NeuroBench系统级基准，评估可执行性、人工制品有效性和可重复性就绪度。实验表明，NeuroClaw在多个多模态大语言模型上相比直接智能体调用能带来一致且显著的分数提升。
Motivation: 神经影像学研究面临异质模态、长多阶段流程和持续的可重复性风险，现有通用AI系统难以直接处理这些挑战。
Method: 提出NeuroClaw平台，包含：1）直接操作原始神经影像数据，利用数据集语义和BIDS元数据；2）端到端环境管理（固定Python环境、Docker、自动安装工具、GPU配置）；3）三层技能/智能体层次（用户交互、高层编排、底层工具技能）以分解复杂流程为安全可重用单元。同时构建NeuroBench基准进行评估。
Result: 在多个多模态大语言模型上，NeuroClaw相比直接智能体调用在可执行性、人工制品有效性和可重复性就绪度上取得一致且显著的分数提升。
Conclusion: NeuroClaw通过领域专用设计和系统化工程管理有效提升了神经影像学研究的可重复性和可审计性，NeuroBench为类似系统提供了标准化评估框架。

papers.title: DPRM: A Plug-in Doob h transform-induced Token-Ordering Module for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models generate without a fixed left-to-right order, leaving token ordering as a central algorithmic choice. Existing systems mainly use random masking or confidence-driven ordering, which respectively suffer from train--test mismatch and myopic exploration. We introduce DPRM (Doob -transform Process Reward Model), a plug-in token-ordering module that keeps the host architecture, denoising objective and supervision unchanged, and modifies only the ordering policy. DPRM starts from confidence-driven ordering and gradually shifts to process-reward-guided ordering through online estimates. We characterize the exact DPRM policy as a reward-tilted Gibbs reveal law, prove convergence of its stagewise Soft-BoN approximation, show that the online bucketized controller tracks the exact DPRM score at empirical-Bernstein rates, and establish a sample-complexity advantage under tractable optimization assumptions. Across nine hosts covering language reasoning, test-time scaling, protein, single-cell, molecular, DNA, text-to-image generation, and VQA, DPRM order variants improve several language, DNA, and multimodal settings while also identifying boundary cases where confidence-only ordering or task-specific utilities are preferable. Code is available at: https://github.com/DakeBU/DPRM-DLLM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DPRM，一个即插即用的令牌排序模块，通过 Doob h 变换将置信度驱动排序逐步过渡到过程奖励引导排序，用于改进扩散语言模型的生成顺序。理论证明了策略的 Gibbs 揭示律、Soft-BoN 近似收敛性以及在线追踪的统计性质。在语言推理、蛋白质、DNA、文本到图像等多个任务上验证了效果。
Motivation: 现有扩散语言模型的令牌排序策略（随机掩码、置信度驱动）存在训练-测试不匹配或短视探索问题，需要一种不改变主架构和训练目标的通用排序改进模块。
Method: DPRM 基于 Doob h 变换，从置信度驱动排序开始，通过在线估计逐步过渡到过程奖励引导排序；策略形式化为奖励倾斜的 Gibbs 揭示律，并采用分阶段 Soft-BoN 近似和桶化控制器实现。
Result: 在 9 种宿主模型（包括语言推理、测试时扩展、蛋白质、单细胞、分子、DNA、文本到图像生成和 VQA）上，DPRM 改进了多个语言、DNA 和多模态设置，同时识别出置信度排序或任务特定效用更优的边界情况。
Conclusion: DPRM 作为通用排序模块可提升扩散语言模型性能，但存在置信度驱动排序更优的边界场景，需根据任务选择。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Characterizing Admissible Objective Functions for Hierarchical Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical clustering is a fundamental task in data analysis, but classical methods have long lacked a principled objective function. Dasgupta [STOC 2016] took an important step toward addressing this gap by proposing a well-motivated objective function for cluster trees. Cohen-Addad et al. [J. ACM 2019] subsequently introduced the notion of admissibility: an objective function is admissible if, whenever the input similarity matrix admits generating trees, its minimizers are precisely those generating trees. They also gave a necessary and sufficient condition for admissibility within a family of objective functions based on aggregate intercluster similarity. We refer to this family as sum-type objective functions. However, apart from Dasgupta's original objective function, no explicit admissible objective functions in this family were provided. In this paper, we study admissible objective functions for hierarchical clustering in two directions. For sum-type objective functions, we give a complete characterization when the scaling function is a symmetric polynomial of degree at most two, and we derive sufficient conditions for degree-three polynomials. We also show that the recursive sparsest cut algorithm achieves an O$(φ)$-approximation ratio for the admissible objective functions covered by our characterization, where $φ$ is the approximation factor of the sparsest cut subroutine. We then introduce max-type objective functions, where cluster interaction is measured by maximum, rather than aggregate, intercluster similarity. For this class, we characterize which objective functions are admissible for arbitrary symmetric scaling functions and give a complete characterization when the scaling function is a symmetric polynomial of degree at most two.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures. Minor correction to abstract metadata. Manuscript unchanged from v2. Submitted to Discrete Applied Mathematics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究层次聚类的可容许目标函数，针对 sum-type 目标函数，当缩放函数为不超过二次的对称多项式时给出完整可容许性刻画，对三次多项式给出充分条件；同时证明了递归最稀疏割算法对文中刻画的可容许目标函数能达到 O(φ) 近似比。引入 max-type 目标函数，并给出其可容许性的完整刻画。
Motivation: 经典层次聚类方法长期缺乏原则性目标函数，Dasgupta 提出首个目标函数后，Cohen-Addad 等引入可容许性概念，但除原始函数外尚无显式可容许函数。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 对 sum-type 目标函数，利用对称多项式理论刻画可容许性；对 max-type 目标函数，通过最大簇间相似度定义，并分析任意对称缩放函数下的可容许性条件。
Result: 对于 sum-type，完整刻画了二次对称多项式可容许性，给出三次多项式的充分条件；递归最稀疏割算法达到 O(φ) 近似比。对于 max-type，完全刻画任意对称缩放函数的可容许性，并完整刻画二次对称多项式。
Conclusion: 本文在 sum-type 和 max-type 两个方向上深化了对层次聚类可容许目标函数的理解，提供了显式刻画和近似算法保证。

papers.title: Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems move from generating text to accomplishing goals through sustained interaction, the ability to model environment dynamics becomes a central bottleneck. Agents that manipulate objects, navigate software, coordinate with others, or design experiments require predictive environment models, yet the term world model carries different meanings across research communities. We introduce a "levels x laws" taxonomy organized along two axes. The first defines three capability levels: L1 Predictor, which learns one-step local transition operators; L2 Simulator, which composes them into multi-step, action-conditioned rollouts that respect domain laws; and L3 Evolver, which autonomously revises its own model when predictions fail against new evidence. The second identifies four governing-law regimes: physical, digital, social, and scientific. These regimes determine what constraints a world model must satisfy and where it is most likely to fail. Using this framework, we synthesize over 400 works and summarize more than 100 representative systems spanning model-based reinforcement learning, video generation, web and GUI agents, multi-agent social simulation, and AI-driven scientific discovery. We analyze methods, failure modes, and evaluation practices across level-regime pairs, propose decision-centric evaluation principles and a minimal reproducible evaluation package, and outline architectural guidance, open problems, and governance challenges. The resulting roadmap connects previously isolated communities and charts a path from passive next-step prediction toward world models that can simulate, and ultimately reshape, the environments in which agents operate. Code and resources are available at: https://github.com/matrix-agent/awesome-agentic-world-modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种“层级×法则”分类法，将智能体世界模型的能力分为三级（预测器、模拟器、进化器）并识别四种支配性法则（物理、数字、社会、科学）。基于此框架综述了400余篇工作，总结了100多个代表性系统，涵盖基于模型的强化学习、视频生成、Web/GUI智能体、多智能体社会模拟及科学发现。文章提出了以决策为中心的评估原则与可复现评估包，并勾勒了架构指南、开放问题和治理挑战。
Motivation: 当前AI系统从文本生成转向通过持续交互实现目标，环境动力学建模成为关键瓶颈，但“世界模型”在不同社区含义各异，缺乏统一框架来梳理能力层级与适用法则。
Method: 构建“层级×法则”分类学：L1预测器学习单步局部转移算子，L2模拟器组合为多步动作规划，L3进化器能自主修正模型；同时划分物理、数字、社会、科学四种法则域，并分析各层级-法则组合下的方法、失败模式与评估实践。
Result: 综述了超过400篇工作，归纳了100多个代表性系统，覆盖模型强化学习、视频生成、GUI智能体、社会模拟和科学发现；提出了决策导向的评估原则与可复现评估包。
Conclusion: 该路线图连接了先前孤立的社区，为从被动预测向能够模拟乃至重塑环境的世界模型发展提供了路径。局限性在于框架的广度可能导致深度不足，且主要依赖文献综述而非实验验证。

papers.title: Dissociating Decodability and Causal Use in Bracket-Sequence Transformers
papers.abstract_en: When trained on tasks requiring an understanding of hierarchical structure, transformers have been found to represent this hierarchy in distinct ways: in the geometry of the residual stream, and in stack-like attention patterns maintaining a last-in, first-out ordering. However, it remains unclear whether these representations are causally used or merely decodable. We examine this gap in transformers trained on the Dyck language (a formal language of balanced bracket sequences), where the hierarchical ground truth is explicit. By probing and intervening on the residual stream and attention patterns, we find that depth, distance, and top-of-stack signals are all decodable, yet their causal roles diverge. Specifically, masking attention to the true top-of-stack position causes a sharp drop in long-distance accuracy, while ablating low-dimensional residual stream subspaces has comparatively little effect. These results, which extend to a templated natural language setting, suggest that even in a controlled setting where the relevant hierarchical variables are known, decodability alone does not imply causal use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer在Dyck语言（平衡括号序列）任务中层级表示的因果使用与可解码性之间的关系。通过探针和干预实验，作者发现深度、距离和栈顶信号均可解码，但只有遮蔽注意力的真实栈顶位置会显著影响长距离准确度，而低维残差流子空间的消融影响较小。结论强调可解码性不等于因果使用。
Motivation: 尽管已有工作发现Transformer在层级结构任务中可以通过残差流几何和堆栈式注意力模式表示层级，但尚不清楚这些表示是否被因果使用，还是仅仅可解码。
Method: 在Dyck语言上训练Transformer，利用探针和干预方法分别检查残差流和注意力模式中层级信息的可解码性和因果作用。
Result: 深度、距离和栈顶信号均可解码；但遮蔽注意力的真实栈顶位置导致长距离准确度显著下降，而消融低维残差流子空间对性能影响不大。该结果也扩展到模板化自然语言场景。
Conclusion: 即使在已知相关层级变量的受控设置中，可解码性本身并不暗示因果使用。

papers.title: Curiosity-Critic: Cumulative Prediction Error Improvement as a Tractable Intrinsic Reward for World Model Training
papers.abstract_en: Local prediction-error-based curiosity rewards focus on the current transition without considering the world model's cumulative prediction error across all visited transitions. We introduce Curiosity-Critic, which grounds its intrinsic reward in the improvement of this cumulative objective, and show that it admits a tractable per-step surrogate: the difference between the current prediction error and the asymptotic error baseline of the current state transition. We estimate this error baseline online with a learned critic co-trained alongside the world model; since the critic only has to learn how hard a transition is to predict, its estimate of the irreducible noise floor converges well before the world model saturates, redirecting exploration toward learnable transitions. The reward is higher for learnable transitions and collapses toward zero for stochastic ones, thereby separating epistemic (reducible) from aleatoric (irreducible) prediction error online. Prior prediction-error curiosity formulations, from Schmidhuber (1991) to learned-feature-space variants, emerge as special cases corresponding to specific approximations of this error baseline. Experiments on a stochastic grid world show that Curiosity-Critic outperforms prediction-error, visitation-count, and Random Network Distillation methods in training speed and final world model accuracy.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Workshop on Epistemic Intelligence in Machine Learning (EIML@ICML 2026). Code: https://github.com/vinbhaskara/Curiosity-Critic
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Curiosity-Critic，一种基于累积预测误差改进的内在奖励，用于世界模型训练。该方法通过一个学习到的批评家估计当前状态转换的渐近误差基线，从而区分可减少的认知误差与不可减少的偶然误差，鼓励探索可学习的转换。实验表明在随机网格世界中优于预测误差、访问计数和随机网络蒸馏（RND）方法。
Motivation: 现有基于局部预测误差的好奇心奖励仅考虑当前转换，忽略世界模型在所有已访问转换上的累积预测误差。
Method: 提出Curiosity-Critic，其内在奖励基于累积预测误差的改进，并推导出可计算的每步代理：当前预测误差与渐近误差基线之差。该基线通过一个与世界模型联合学习的批评家在线估计。
Result: 在随机网格世界实验中，Curiosity-Critic在训练速度和最终世界模型准确性上优于预测误差、访问计数和随机网络蒸馏（RND）方法。
Conclusion: 该方法有效分离了认知误差和偶然误差，并具有理论上的普适性，先前的好奇心奖励公式是其在特定近似下的特例。

papers.title: Conditional Attribution for Root Cause Analysis in Time-Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Root cause analysis (RCA) for time-series anomaly detection is critical for the reliable operation of complex real-world systems. Existing explanation methods often rely on unrealistic feature perturbations and ignore temporal and cross-feature dependencies, leading to unreliable attributions. We propose a conditional attribution framework that explains anomalies relative to contextually similar normal system states. Instead of using marginal or randomly sampled baselines, our method retrieves representative normal instances conditioned on the anomalous observation, enabling dependency-preserving and operationally meaningful explanations. To support high-dimensional time-series data, contextual retrieval is performed in learned low-dimensional representations using both variational autoencoder latent spaces and UMAP manifold embeddings. By grounding the retrieval process in the system's learned manifold, this strategy avoids out-of-distribution artifacts and ensures attribution fidelity while maintaining computational efficiency. We further introduce confidence-aware and temporal evaluation metrics for assessing explanation reliability and responsiveness. Experiments on the SWaT and MSDS benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently improves root-cause identification accuracy, temporal localization, and robustness across multiple anomaly detection models. These results highlight the practical utility of conditional attribution for explainable anomaly diagnosis in complex time-series systems. Code and models are available at: https://github.com/dfki-av/Conditional-Attribution-for-Root-Cause-Analysis-in-Time-Series-Anomaly-Detection.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECML PKDD. 16 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables, and an appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列异常检测中的根因分析问题，提出一种条件归因框架，通过检索与异常观测上下文相似的代表性正常实例进行解释，避免了不现实的扰动和分布外伪影。在SWaT和MSDS基准上，该方法提升了根因定位的准确性和鲁棒性，并引入了置信度感知和时间评估指标。
Motivation: 现有解释方法依赖不现实的特征扰动，忽略时间和跨特征依赖，导致归因不可靠。
Method: 提出条件归因框架，在VAE隐空间和UMAP流形嵌入中检索与异常观测上下文相似的代表性正常实例，实现保持依赖且操作上有意义的解释。
Result: 在SWaT和MSDS基准上，该方法一致提升了多种异常检测模型的根因识别准确率、时间定位和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 条件归因能有效提升复杂时间序列系统中异常诊断的可解释性和实用性。

papers.title: Do We Still Need Humans in the Loop? Comparing Human and LLM Annotation in Active Learning for Hostility Detection
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-tuned LLMs can annotate thousands of instances at low cost. This raises two questions for active learning (AL): can LLM labels replace human labels within the AL loop, and does AL remain necessary when entire corpora can be cheaply labeled? We investigate both on a new dataset of 277,902 German political TikTok comments (25,974 LLM-labeled, 5,000 human-annotated), comparing LLM and human annotation across seven conditions, four encoders, and 10 random seeds. Under a two-question interface that mirrors the human annotation task, LLM annotation at scale outperforms human-supervised classifiers at roughly one-tenth the cost (\$28 for GPT-5.2 Batch API vs. \$316 for Prolific). The advantage holds for both a closed-source (GPT-5.2) and an open-weight (Qwen3.5-122B-10B) LLM, is robust under soft-label evaluation, and is unlocked specifically by the two-question decomposition; a holistic single-prompt baseline only ties with human supervision. AL provides no reliable advantage over random sampling under either LLM annotator. However, error structure varies sharply: only GPT-5.2 under the two-question interface produces classifiers with near-human FP/FN balance, while other LLM variants over-flag border-control and economic competition discourse. We release the dataset and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究指令微调的大语言模型能否替代人类在主动学习（AL）中的标注角色，以及当低成本批量标注可行时AL是否仍有必要。基于27.8万条德国政治TikTok评论的新数据集，比较了七种条件、四种编码器和10个随机种子。结果显示，采用与人类标注任务相同的两问题接口（two-question interface），大规模LLM标注的性能优于人类监督分类器，成本仅为人类的三分之一（GPT-5.2 Batch API 28美元 vs Prolific 316美元）。该优势在闭源（GPT-5.2）和开源（Qwen3.5-122B-10B）大模型上均成立，且由两问题分解所解锁；而主动学习在两种LLM标注器下均无可靠优势。但错误结构差异显著：仅GPT-5.2结合两问题接口实现了接近人类的假阳性/假阴性平衡。数据集和代码已发布。
Motivation: 主动学习中人类标注成本高，指令微调的LLM可以低成本标注大量数据，因此需要探究LLM标签能否替代人类标签，以及当整个语料库可廉价标注时主动学习是否仍有必要。
Method: 提出一个两问题接口来模拟人类标注任务，比较GPT-5.2和Qwen3.5-122B-10B两种LLM在不同条件下的标注效果，并与人类监督分类器、主动学习策略进行对比。
Result: 两问题接口下，LLM标注在性能上超越人类监督分类器，成本仅为其十分之一（28美元 vs 316美元）；该优势在闭源和开源模型上均成立，且被两问题分解所解锁。主动学习相比随机采样无可靠优势。误差结构方面，仅GPT-5.2两问题接口接近人类假阳性/假阴性平衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在特定接口下LLM可以替代人类标注，且主动学习优势不明显；但模型选择与接口设计对误差分布有重要影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Generalized Sinkhorn Algorithm for Mean-Field Schrödinger Bridge
papers.abstract_en: The mean-field Schrödinger bridge (MFSB) problem concerns designing a minimum-effort controller that guides a diffusion process with nonlocal interaction to reach a given distribution from another by a fixed deadline. Unlike the standard Schrödinger bridge, the dynamical constraint for MFSB is the mean-field limit of a population of interacting agents with controls. It serves as a natural model for large-scale multi-agent systems. The MFSB is computationally challenging because the nonlocal interaction makes the problem nonconvex. We propose a generalization of the Hopf-Cole transform for MFSB and, building on it, design a Sinkhorn-type recursive algorithm to solve the associated system of integro-PDEs. Under mild assumptions on the interaction potential, we discuss convergence guarantees for the proposed algorithm. We present numerical examples with repulsive and attractive interactions to illustrate the theoretical contributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种广义Sinkhorn算法用于求解均场薛定谔桥问题（MFSB），该问题涉及设计最小努力控制器引导具有非局部相互作用的扩散过程在固定时间内从一种分布到达另一种分布。作者推广了Hopf-Cole变换，并基于此设计了Sinkhorn型递归算法来求解相关的积分-偏微分方程组。在相互作用势的温和假设下，讨论了算法的收敛保证，并通过排斥和吸引相互作用的数值例子展示了理论贡献。
Motivation: MFSB问题计算上具有挑战性，因为非局部相互作用导致问题非凸。现有方法难以高效求解此类大规模多智能体系统的调控问题。
Method: 提出Hopf-Cole变换的推广形式，将MFSB问题转化为一组积分-偏微分方程，进而设计Sinkhorn型递归算法进行数值求解。
Result: 在排斥和吸引相互作用的数值示例中验证了算法的有效性，表明该算法能够收敛到正确解。
Conclusion: 所提算法为求解均场薛定谔桥问题提供了通用框架，具有理论收敛保证，适用于大规模多智能体系统。

papers.title: From Paper to Program: Knowledge Externalization for AI-Assisted Quantum Many-Body Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can write scientific code, but direct paper-to-program translation remains fragile when correctness depends on tacit conventions in the literature. We identify this bottleneck as \textbf{knowledge externalization}: converting implicit computational assumptions -- index conventions, gauge choices, fermionic signs, contraction order, and memory constraints -- into an explicit technical specification before implementation. We evaluate a multi-stage, human-in-the-loop workflow that inserts such a specification, with validation and stop gates, between theory extraction and code generation. The workflow is tested on two algorithmically distinct quantum many-body tasks: variational sweep-based Density-Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG) from a pedagogical review and constructive Pfaffian conversion of Hartree--Fock--Bogoliubov states to matrix product states from the five-page Letter by Jin et al., Phys. Rev. B 105, L081101 (2022), for which no public code is available. For DMRG, all 16 specification-guided model pairings in a $4\times4$ grid satisfy physics-validation criteria, compared with 6/13 direct attempts. A prose-specification ablation indicates that externalized content, not \LaTeX{} formatting, is the essential ingredient. For Pfaffian-MPS, the workflow succeeds in 11/26 archived attempts, whereas direct prompting yields zero audited passes. Cross-specification transfer is asymmetric: non-GPT specifications implemented by GPT~5.5 pass 4/4, while GPT~5.5 specifications implemented by weaker models fail 4/4, indicating a residual implementation-model bottleneck. The resulting \emph{Paper-to-Program Many-Body} skill provides an auditable protocol for AI-assisted implementation of many-body algorithms and for diagnosing where externalization succeeds or fails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出从论文到程序的知识外化（knowledge externalization）方法，将隐式计算假设转化为显式技术规范，用于AI辅助的量子多体代码生成。在DMRG和Pfaffian-MPS两个任务上测试，相比直接翻译，引入规范显著提高了正确率，且跨模型迁移存在不对称性。
Motivation: 论文到程序的直接翻译常因文献中隐式约定（如索引约定、规范选择、费米子符号等）而失败，现有方法缺乏对这些知识的外化步骤。
Method: 提出多阶段人机协同工作流，在理论提取和代码生成之间插入显式技术规范，包含验证和停止门控。在DMRG和Pfaffian-MPS任务上通过语言模型配对实验评估。
Result: DMRG任务中，规范指导的16/16对通过物理验证，直接尝试仅6/13；Pfaffian-MPS任务中，规范工作流11/26通过，直接提示0/26。跨规范实验显示非GPT规范由GPT 5.5实现全部通过，但GPT 5.5规范由弱模型实现全部失败。
Conclusion: 知识外化是AI辅助量子多体代码生成的关键瓶颈，所提协议可审计地诊断外化成功与否，但存在实现模型瓶颈。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SCC-Loc: A Unified Semantic Cascade Consensus Framework for UAV Thermal Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal Thermal Geo-localization (TG) provides a robust, all-weather solution for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-denied environments. However, profound thermal-visible modality gaps introduce severe feature ambiguity, systematically corrupting conventional coarse-to-fine registration. To dismantle this bottleneck, we propose SCC-Loc, a unified Semantic-Cascade-Consensus localization framework. By sharing a single DINOv2 backbone across global retrieval and MINIMA$_{\text{RoMa}}$ matching, it minimizes memory footprint and achieves zero-shot, highly accurate absolute position estimation. Specifically, we tackle modality ambiguity by introducing three cohesive components. First, we design the Semantic-Guided Viewport Alignment (SGVA) module to adaptively optimize satellite crop regions, effectively correcting initial spatial deviations. Second, we develop the Cascaded Spatial-Adaptive Texture-Structure Filtering (C-SATSF) mechanism to explicitly enforce geometric consistency, thereby eradicating dense cross-modal outliers. Finally, we propose the Consensus-Driven Reliability-Aware Position Selection (CD-RAPS) strategy to derive the optimal solution through a synergy of physically constrained pose optimization. To address data scarcity, we construct Thermal-UAV, a comprehensive dataset providing 11,890 diverse thermal queries referenced against a large-scale satellite ortho-photo and corresponding spatially aligned Digital Surface Model (DSM). Extensive experiments demonstrate that SCC-Loc establishes a new state-of-the-art, suppressing the mean localization error to 9.37 m and providing a 7.6-fold accuracy improvement within a strict 5-m threshold over the strongest baseline. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/FloralHercules/SCC-Loc.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to IEEE J-STARS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCC-Loc，一个统一的语义级联共识框架，用于无人机热成像地理定位。通过共享DINOv2主干网络进行全局检索和MINIMA_RoMa匹配，减少了内存占用并实现了零样本高精度绝对位置估计。方法包括语义引导视口对齐(SGVA)、级联空间自适应纹理结构滤波(C-SATSF)和共识驱动可靠性感知位置选择(CD-RAPS)三个组件。在自建Thermal-UAV数据集上，平均定位误差降至9.37 m，在5-m阈值下比最强基线提升7.6倍。
Motivation: 现有方法在热成像和可见光之间的跨模态差异导致严重特征模糊，破坏了传统的由粗到细的配准流程，需要实现GNSS拒止环境下的鲁棒定位。
Method: 提出SCC-Loc框架，使用单个DINOv2主干网络进行全局检索和匹配，并包含三个组件：SGVA模块自适应优化卫星裁剪区域；C-SATSF机制强制几何一致性；CD-RAPS策略通过物理约束位姿优化得到最优解。
Result: 在自建Thermal-UAV数据集上，平均定位误差为9.37 m，5-m阈值下精度比最强基线提升7.6倍，达到新SOTA。
Conclusion: 该框架通过语义级联共识有效解决了跨模态地理定位中的特征模糊问题，代码和数据集已开源。

papers.title: QoS-Aware Token Scheduling and Private Data Valuation for Multi-Modal Agentic Networks
papers.abstract_en: In agentic systems, human-generated data records anchor the value of AI services. Yet cloud compute pipelines centralize processing on remote servers. Data centralization reduces personal data sovereignty and may potentially degrade the quality of service (QoS). Meanwhile, user contributions are diverse in quantity and quality: decentralized records can be biased, noisy, and heterogeneously distributed. To address the data challenge, we study fair token allocation and private data valuation for decentralized and resource-constrained agentic systems. Our approach embeds multi-modal representations in a shared semantic space and releases differentially private (DP) prototypes to preserve utility while reducing semantic leakage. With the DP guarantee, we design a fair token allocation scheme that rewards effective contributions and remains robust to data heterogeneity and AI resource scarcity. Extensive simulations demonstrate improved contribution-based fairness and QoS compared to standard benchmarks. The improved resistance to image reconstruction attacks indicates enhanced privacy for multi-modal personal data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究去中心化多模态代理系统中的公平令牌分配与私有数据估值问题。提出将多模态表示嵌入共享语义空间，并发布差分隐私（DP）原型以保持效用并减少语义泄露。在DP保证下，设计一种公平令牌分配方案，奖励有效贡献并对数据异质性与AI资源稀缺具有鲁棒性。仿真表明，该方法在基于贡献的公平性和服务质量（QoS）上优于标准基准，并增强了对图像重建攻击的隐私保护。
Motivation: 现有代理系统通常集中处理数据，降低个人数据主权并可能恶化QoS。同时，用户贡献在数量和质量上多样，去中心化数据存在偏差、噪声和异质分布。需要一种方法在保护隐私的同时实现公平的资源分配和贡献评估。
Method: 将多模态表示映射到共享语义空间，并发布差分隐私原型以减少语义泄露。基于DP保证设计公平令牌分配方案，奖励有效贡献，并对数据异质性和资源稀缺具有鲁棒性。
Result: 仿真结果展示了改进的基于贡献的公平性和QoS，以及增强的对图像重建攻击的抵抗力，表明隐私保护提升。
Conclusion: 该方法能够在去中心化、资源受限的代理系统中兼顾隐私、公平和QoS，尤其适用于多模态个人数据场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Combating Data Laundering in LLM Training
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc unauthorized-training data detection for large language models (LLMs) typically assumes a query-with-originals regime: rights holders query a target LLM with raw proprietary data and assess whether the model assigns them stronger memorization-based detection signals, e.g., higher confidence or lower loss, than held-out non-training reference texts. We show that this regime becomes brittle under data laundering, where the target LLM is trained on semantics-preserving but stylistically or structurally transformed surrogates of proprietary data to obfuscate provenance. Since training-time exposure occurs in the laundered form, memorization signals may no longer appear on the originals, collapsing the candidate-reference signal separation that standard detectors rely on. We counter this threat by studying laundering-aware detection with raw proprietary data, a held-out reference corpus, and query access to the target LLM, while the laundering transformation is undisclosed. Since exact recovery of the laundered corpus is infeasible, we infer a detection-useful synthesis process via an auxiliary LLM that maps originals into training-like queries. To make this search tractable, we introduce Synthesis Data Reversion (SDR), which constrains the unbounded space of natural-language transformations through a goal-details abstraction: a high-level transformation goal, e.g., "lyrical rewriting", and fine-grained details, e.g., "with vivid imagery". SDR identifies the most likely goal and iteratively refines details so synthesized queries elicit stronger target-model detection signals. Evaluated on the MIMIR benchmark against diverse laundering practices and target LLM families (Pythia, Llama2, and Falcon), SDR consistently restores detection signals, offering a practical auditing layer against data laundering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭露在大语言模型（LLM）训练中，数据清洗（data laundering）攻击可绕过基于记忆的标准后验检测：攻击者对原始专有数据进行语义不变但风格或结构变换的清洗，使得检测信号（如高置信度或低损失）不再出现在原始数据上。为此，作者提出合成数据还原（Synthesis Data Reversion, SDR）方法，在未知清洗变换的情况下，通过辅助LLM将原始数据映射为训练类查询，并利用目标-细节抽象约束搜索空间，恢复检测信号。在MIMIR基准测试中，SDR在多种清洗实践和目标LLM族（Pythia、Llama2、Falcon）上一致恢复了检测信号。
Motivation: 现有后验训练数据检测假设查询-原始数据模式，但在数据清洗攻击下，模型对原始数据的记忆信号消失，导致检测失效。急需一种能对抗未知清洗变换的检测方法。
Method: 提出合成数据还原（SDR），通过辅助LLM将原始数据映射为训练类查询；引入目标-细节抽象（如“抒情重写”+“生动意象”）约束自然语言变换的无限空间，迭代精炼细节以最大化目标模型的检测信号。
Result: 在MIMIR基准上，针对Pythia、Llama2和Falcon等目标LLM，SDR一致恢复了检测信号，表明该方法能有效对抗数据清洗。
Conclusion: SDR提供了一种实用的审计层，用于检测LLM训练中的数据清洗攻击，但依赖辅助LLM和查询访问，且可能受限于变换的多样性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fluently Lying: Adversarial Robustness Can Be Substrate-Dependent
papers.abstract_en: The primary tools used to monitor and defend object detectors under adversarial attack assume that when accuracy degrades, detection count drops in tandem. This coupling was assumed, not measured. We report a counterexample observed on a single model: under standard PGD, EMS-YOLO, a spiking neural network (SNN) object detector, retains more than 70% of its detections while mAP collapses from 0.528 to 0.042. We term this count-preserving accuracy collapse Quality Corruption (QC), to distinguish it from the suppression that dominates untargeted evaluation. Across four SNN architectures and two threat models (l-infinity and l-2), QC appears only in one of the four detectors tested (EMS-YOLO). On this model, all five standard defense components fail to detect or mitigate QC, suggesting the defense ecosystem may rely on a shared assumption calibrated on a single substrate. These results provide, to our knowledge, the first evidence that adversarial failure modes can be substrate-dependent.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the authors due to an implementation bug discovered in the main experimental pipeline. The bug affects the main results, and therefore the empirical claims and conclusions of the paper are no longer supported
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一个反例：在标准PGD攻击下，脉冲神经网络物体检测器EMS-YOLO的检测数量保持70%以上，但mAP从0.528骤降至0.042。作者将此现象称为质量崩溃（Quality Corruption, QC），并发现仅在EMS-YOLO中出现，而标准防御组件均未能检测或缓解。这是首次证明对抗失败模式可依赖于具体模型基底。
Motivation: 现有对抗鲁棒性监测与防御方法默认物体检测器的准确性下降时检测数量也随之下降，但该假设未被验证。本文旨在检验这一假设并揭示基底依赖的失败模式。
Method: 在四种SNN架构和两种威胁模型（l-infinity和l-2）下，通过PGD攻击测试目标检测器，并对比检测数量与mAP的变化，识别出计数保持但精度崩溃的QC现象。
Result: 仅在EMS-YOLO上观察到QC：检测数量保持70%以上，mAP从0.528降至0.042；其他三个SNN检测器未出现；五种标准防御组件均无法检测或缓解QC。
Conclusion: 首次提供证据表明对抗失败模式可以是基底依赖的，现有防御生态可能基于特定基底（如传统CNN）的假设校准，需重新审视。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SP-GCRL: Influence Maximization on Incomplete Social Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Influence maximization (IM) in real platforms is challenged by incomplete, noisy social graphs and non-stationary diffusion dynamics. We propose SP-GCRL, a social-propagation-aware graph contrastive reinforcement learning framework that learns end-to-end seed selection under partial observability.We first introduce a social-propagation-aware nonlinear diffusion function to model reinforcement/diminishing effects and probability drift under repeated exposure; we then construct dual structural views and perform contrastive learning to obtain node representations robust to missing edges and weak ties, while replacing expensive strategy metrics with a GAT-based regression surrogate to improve efficiency and scalability; finally, we use DDQN to learn an end-to-end seed selection policy on top of these representations. Experiments on multiple real-world networks show that SP-GCRL achieves significant gains over heuristic and learning-based baselines across budgets and topologies, while maintaining strong large-scale scalability.
papers.comment: Accepted by DASFAA 2026. The first two authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SP-GCRL 框架，针对不完整社交图上的影响力最大化问题，结合社交传播感知的非线性扩散函数、图对比学习和 DDQN 进行端到端种子选择。在多个真实网络上，该方法在预算和拓扑变化下优于启发式和基于学习的基线，并保持大规模可扩展性。
Motivation: 真实平台中的影响力最大化任务面临社交图不完整、含噪声以及传播动态非平稳的挑战，现有方法难以处理部分可观测性下的种子选择。
Method: 提出社交传播感知的非线性扩散函数建模重复暴露下的增强/衰减效应和概率漂移；构建双结构视图进行对比学习以获得对缺失边和弱连边鲁棒的节点表示，并用 GAT 回归代理替代昂贵的策略指标；最后在表示之上使用 DDQN 学习端到端种子选择策略。
Result: 在多个真实世界网络上的实验表明，SP-GCRL 在不同预算和拓扑下相比启发式和基于学习的基线取得了显著提升，同时保持大规模可扩展性。
Conclusion: SP-GCRL 有效解决了不完整社交图上的影响力最大化问题，但摘要未明确提及局限性或未来工作。

papers.title: Membership Inference Attacks against Large Audio Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We present the first systematic Membership Inference Attack (MIA) evaluation of LALMs. Using Multi-modal Blind Baselines based on textual, spectral and prosodic features, we demonstrate that common audio datasets exhibit near-perfect train/test separability (AUC ~ 1.0) even without model inference, thus MIA may primarily detect distribution shift. We therefore introduce a blind-baseline protocol to control for this confound. Under this protocol, we identify that the distribution-matched datasets enable reliable MIA evaluation without distribution-shift artifacts. We benchmark multiple MIA methods and conduct modality disentanglement experiments on these datasets. The results reveal that LALM memorization is cross-modal, arising only from binding a speaker's vocal identity with its text. These findings establish a principled standard for auditing LALMs beyond spurious correlations. Our codebase is available at https://github.com/snooow1029/ALM_MIA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统评估了大型音频语言模型（LALM）的成员推理攻击（MIA）。研究发现，常用音频数据集即使不进行模型推理也能实现近乎完美的训练/测试分离（AUC ~1.0），表明MIA可能主要检测分布偏移。作者提出盲基线协议来控制这一混淆因素，并在分布匹配的数据集上评估多种MIA方法，通过模态解耦实验揭示LALM的记忆是跨模态的，仅源于说话者语音身份与文本的绑定。
Motivation: 现有MIA研究主要针对文本或图像模型，缺乏对LALM的系统评估，且MIA结果可能被数据集分布偏移混淆。
Method: 引入多模态盲基线（基于文本、频谱和韵律特征），提出盲基线协议；在分布匹配的数据集上基准测试多种MIA方法，并进行模态解耦实验。
Result: 常用音频数据集存在分布偏移，导致MIA AUC接近1.0；在分布匹配数据集上，LALM的记忆是跨模态的，仅来自语音身份与文本的绑定。
Conclusion: 本文建立了审计LALM的标准化协议，避免伪相关的影响。

papers.title: DiffAttn: Diffusion-Based Drivers' Visual Attention Prediction with LLM-Enhanced Semantic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Drivers' visual attention provides critical cues for anticipating latent hazards and directly shapes decision-making and control maneuvers, where its absence can compromise traffic safety. To emulate drivers' perception patterns and advance visual attention prediction for intelligent vehicles, we propose DiffAttn, a diffusion-based framework that formulates this task as a conditional diffusion-denoising process, enabling more accurate modeling of drivers' attention. To capture both local and global scene features, we adopt Swin Transformer as encoder and design a decoder that combines a Feature Fusion Pyramid for cross-layer interaction with dense, multi-scale conditional diffusion to jointly enhance denoising learning and model fine-grained local and global scene contexts. Additionally, a large language model (LLM) layer is incorporated to enhance top-down semantic reasoning and improve sensitivity to safety-critical cues. Extensive experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that DiffAttn achieves state-of-the-art (SoTA) performance, surpassing most video-based, top-down-feature-driven, and LLM-enhanced baselines. Our framework further supports interpretable driver-centric scene understanding and has the potential to improve in-cabin human-machine interaction, risk perception, and drivers' state measurement in intelligent vehicles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiffAttn，一个基于扩散模型的驾驶员视觉注意力预测框架。该框架将任务建模为条件扩散-去噪过程，采用 Swin Transformer 编码器与特征融合金字塔解码器，结合多尺度条件扩散以增强局部和全局场景建模，并引入大语言模型层提升语义推理能力。在四个公开数据集上，DiffAttn 取得了最先进的性能，超越了多种基于视频、自上而下特征和 LLM 增强的基线方法。
Motivation: 驾驶员视觉注意力为预测潜在危险和决策控制提供关键线索，其缺失会危及交通安全。现有方法在建模驾驶员注意力模式上存在不足，需要更准确的预测模型来提升智能车辆的安全性和人机交互能力。
Method: 提出 DiffAttn 框架，将驾驶员注意力预测视为条件扩散-去噪过程。编码器采用 Swin Transformer 捕捉局部和全局特征；解码器设计特征融合金字塔实现跨层交互，并结合密集多尺度条件扩散来增强去噪学习。此外，集成大语言模型层以实现自上而下的语义推理，提升对安全关键线索的敏感性。
Result: 在四个公开数据集上的实验表明，DiffAttn 达到了最先进性能，超越了大多数基于视频、自上而下特征驱动和 LLM 增强的基线方法。
Conclusion: 该框架支持可解释的驾驶员中心场景理解，有望改善智能车辆中的座舱人机交互、风险感知和驾驶员状态测量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Overcoming the Incentive Collapse Paradox
papers.abstract_en: AI-assisted task delegation is increasingly common, yet human effort in such systems is costly and typically unobserved. Recent work by Bastani and Cachon (2025); Sambasivan et al. (2021) shows that accuracy-based payment schemes suffer from incentive collapse: as AI accuracy improves, sustaining positive human effort requires unbounded payments. We study this phenomenon in a budget-constrained principal-agent framework with strategic human agents whose output accuracy depends on unobserved effort. Our first contribution is a general impossibility result showing that incentive collapse is not merely a limitation of simple linear payments, but arises for any payment rule based only on observed task accuracy.To overcome this barrier, we propose a sentinel-auditing payment mechanism that enforces a strictly positive and controllable level of human effort at finite cost, independent of AI accuracy. Building on this incentive-robust foundation, we develop an incentive-aware active statistical inference framework that jointly optimizes (i) the auditing rate and (ii) active sampling and budget allocation across tasks of varying difficulty to minimize the final statistical loss under a single budget. Experiments demonstrate improved cost-error tradeoffs relative to standard active learning and auditing-only baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI辅助任务委托中的激励崩溃问题，证明任何基于任务准确率的支付规则都无法避免激励崩溃，并提出哨兵审计支付机制来在有限成本下维持可控的人力努力水平，进一步构建了激励感知的主动统计推断框架以优化审计率和采样的联合决策。
Motivation: 现有基于准确率的支付方案会导致激励崩溃：随着AI准确率提升，维持人力正努力需要无界支付，这在实际中不可行。
Method: 提出哨兵审计支付机制，通过随机审计与惩罚来强制人力努力保持在严格正的水平，且成本与AI准确率无关；在此基础上建立激励感知的主动统计推断框架，联合优化审计率、主动采样和预算分配。
Result: 实验表明该方法在成本-误差权衡上优于标准主动学习和纯审计基线。
Conclusion: 哨兵审计支付机制可以打破激励崩溃的限制，实现有限成本下的人力努力可控，为激励鲁棒的AI辅助任务委托提供理论基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating Interactive 2D Visualization as a Sample Selection Strategy for Biomedical Time-Series Data Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable machine-learning models in biomedical settings depend on accurate labels, yet annotating biomedical time-series data remains challenging. Algorithmic sample selection may support annotation, but evidence from studies involving real human annotators is scarce. Consequently, we compare three sample selection methods for annotation: random sampling (RND), farthest-first traversal (FAFT), and a graphical user interface-based method enabling exploration of complementary 2D visualizations (2DVs) of high-dimensional data. We evaluated the methods across four classification tasks in infant motility assessment (IMA) and speech emotion recognition (SER). Twelve annotators, categorized as experts or non-experts, performed data annotation under a limited annotation budget, and post-annotation experiments were conducted to evaluate the sampling methods. Across all classification tasks, 2DV performed best when aggregating labels across annotators. In IMA, 2DV most effectively captured rare classes, but also exhibited greater annotator-to-annotator label distribution variability resulting from the limited annotation budget, decreasing classification performance when models were trained on individual annotators' labels; in these cases, FAFT excelled. For SER, 2DV outperformed the other methods among expert annotators and matched their performance for non-experts in the individual-annotator setting. A failure risk analysis revealed that RND was the safest choice when annotator count or annotator expertise was uncertain, whereas 2DV had the highest risk due to its greater label distribution variability. Furthermore, post-experiment interviews indicated that 2DV made the annotation task more interesting and enjoyable. Overall, 2DV-based sampling appears promising for biomedical time-series data annotation, particularly when the annotation budget is not highly constrained.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Computers in Biology and Medicine (Elsevier)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了三种样本选择策略（随机采样、最远优先遍历、基于交互式2D可视化的方法）在生物医学时间序列数据标注中的效果，涉及婴儿运动评估和语音情绪识别任务。12名标注者参与实验，结果表明2D可视化方法在聚合标注时表现最佳，但在标注预算有限时个体标注者间的标签分布变异性较大，导致分类性能下降。随机采样在不确定标注者数量和专业水平时是最安全的选择。
Motivation: 可靠的机器学习模型依赖准确标注，但生物医学时间序列数据标注困难。现有样本选择算法的研究缺乏真实人类标注者的实验证据，因此需要比较不同方法在实际标注场景中的效果。
Method: 对比了三种采样方法：随机采样（RND）、最远优先遍历（FAFT）和基于图形用户界面的2D可视化（2DV）方法，后者允许标注者探索高维数据的互补二维投影。实验涵盖婴儿运动评估和语音情绪识别各两个分类任务，由12名专家和非专家标注者在有限标注预算下完成标注。
Result: 在聚合所有标注者的标签时，2DV在所有分类任务中表现最佳；在婴儿运动评估中，2DV最有效捕获稀有类，但导致更大的标注者间标签分布变异性，使得基于个体标注者标签训练的模型分类性能下降，此时FAFT更优；对于语音情绪识别，2DV在专家中优于其他方法，在非专家中表现相当。失败风险分析显示RND在标注者数量或专业水平不确定时最安全。
Conclusion: 2DV采样在生物医学时间序列数据标注中具有潜力，尤其当标注预算不极度受限时；但需注意其标签分布变异性带来的风险。未来可优化可视化界面以降低标注者间一致性差异。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond MACs: Hardware Efficient Architecture Design for Vision Backbones
papers.abstract_en: Vision backbone networks play a central role in modern computer vision. Enhancing their efficiency directly benefits a wide range of downstream applications. To measure efficiency, many publications rely on MACs (Multiply Accumulate operations) as a predictor of execution time. In this paper, we experimentally demonstrate the shortcomings of such a metric, especially in the context of edge devices. By contrasting the MAC count and execution time of common architectural design elements, we identify key factors for efficient execution and provide insights to optimize backbone design. Based on these insights, we present LowFormer, a novel vision backbone family. LowFormer features a streamlined macro and micro design that includes Lowtention, a lightweight alternative to Multi-Head Self-Attention. Lowtention not only proves more efficient, but also enables superior results on ImageNet. Additionally, we present an edge GPU version of LowFormer, that can further improve upon its baseline's speed on edge GPU and desktop GPU. We demonstrate LowFormer's wide applicability by evaluating it on smaller image classification datasets, as well as adapting it to several downstream tasks, such as object detection, semantic segmentation, image retrieval, and visual object tracking. LowFormer models consistently achieve remarkable speed-ups across various hardware platforms compared to recent state-of-the-art backbones. Code and models are available at https://github.com/altair199797/LowFormer/blob/main/Beyond_MACs.md.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出MACs（乘加操作数）不能准确预测视觉骨干网络在边缘设备上的实际执行时间，通过实验对比常见架构设计的MAC计数与执行时间，识别出影响效率的关键因素。基于这些洞察，提出LowFormer视觉骨干家族，其中包含轻量级注意力模块Lowtention，在ImageNet分类、目标检测、语义分割等多个下游任务中实现显著加速，并在边缘GPU和桌面GPU上均取得速度优势。
Motivation: 现有研究常用MACs作为效率指标，但MACs无法反映真实硬件执行时间，尤其在边缘设备上。论文旨在揭示MACs的局限性并探索真正影响硬件效率的设计因素。
Method: 通过对比常见架构设计元素的MAC计数与实际执行时间，分析导致效率低下的关键因素；基于这些洞察设计LowFormer，其宏观和微观设计均经过优化，核心是提出了轻量级多头自注意力替代方案Lowtention，并针对边缘GPU设计了专用版本。
Result: LowFormer在ImageNet上取得优于现有骨干网络的分类结果，并在多个硬件平台（边缘GPU、桌面GPU）上实现显著速度提升，在目标检测、语义分割、图像检索、视觉目标跟踪等下游任务中也表现出广泛适用性。
Conclusion: LowFormer提供了一种硬件高效的视觉骨干设计范式，代码和模型已开源，可广泛应用于多种视觉任务。

papers.title: Decidable By Construction: Design-Time Verification for Trustworthy AI
papers.abstract_en: A prevailing assumption in machine learning is that model correctness must be enforced after the fact. We observe that the properties determining whether an AI model is numerically stable, computationally correct, or consistent with a physical domain do not necessarily demand post hoc enforcement. They can be verified at design time, before training begins, at marginal computational cost, with particular relevance to models deployed in high-leverage decision support and scientifically constrained settings. These properties share a specific algebraic structure: they are expressible as constraints over finitely generated abelian groups $\mathbb{Z}^n$, where inference is decidable in polynomial time and the principal type is unique. A framework built on this observation composes three prior results (arXiv:2603.16437, arXiv:2603.17627, arXiv:2603.18104): a dimensional type system carrying arbitrary annotations as persistent codata through model elaboration; a program hypergraph that infers Clifford algebra grade and derives geometric product sparsity from type signatures alone; and an adaptive domain model architecture preserving both invariants through training via forward-mode coeffect analysis and exact posit accumulation. We believe this composition yields a novel information-theoretic result: Hindley-Milner unification over abelian groups computes the maximum a posteriori hypothesis under a computable restriction of Solomonoff's universal prior, placing the framework's type inference on the same formal ground as universal induction. We compare four contemporary approaches to AI reliability and show that each imposes overhead that can compound across deployments, layers, and inference requests. This framework eliminates that overhead by construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战机器学习中模型正确性必须事后验证的假设，指出模型在数值稳定性、计算正确性和物理域一致性等方面的属性可在设计时（训练前）以极低计算成本验证。这些属性具有共同的代数结构：可表示为有限生成阿贝尔群上的约束，推理在多项式时间内可判定且主类型唯一。框架组合了三种先前成果：维度类型系统、程序超图（推断Clifford代数等级并导出几何积稀疏性）和自适应域模型架构。作者声称该组合产生新的信息论结果：阿贝尔群上的Hindley-Milner类型推断在可计算限制下计算Solomonoff通用先验的最大后验假设。
Motivation: 现有AI可靠性方法（如事后验证、运行时监控）在部署、层间和推理请求上叠加开销，且无法保证设计时正确性。本文旨在通过构造性验证消除这些开销。
Method: 提出一个基于有限生成阿贝尔群约束的框架，组合三种组件：携带任意标注作为持久codata的维度类型系统；从类型签名推断Clifford代数等级及几何积稀疏性的程序超图；通过前向模式coeffect分析和精确正数累积保持不变性的自适应域模型架构。
Result: 作者声称该框架使属性在设计时即可验证，且类型推断与通用归纳具有相同形式基础。同时对比了四种当代AI可靠性方法，指出每种方法都会在部署、层间和推理请求上叠加开销，而本框架通过构造消除了这些开销。
Conclusion: 本文强调通过将验证前移到设计时，可以在不增加运行时开销的情况下保证AI模型的数值稳定性、计算正确性和物理一致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Multimodal Fusion for Time Series: Text Modalities Need Constrained Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal learning have motivated the integration of auxiliary modalities such as text or vision into time series (TS) forecasting. However, most existing methods provide limited gains, often improving performance only in specific datasets or relying on architecture-specific designs that limit generalization. In this paper, we show that multimodal models with naive fusion strategies (e.g., simple addition or concatenation) often underperform unimodal TS models, which we attribute to the uncontrolled integration of auxiliary modalities which may introduce irrelevant information. Motivated by this observation, we explore various constrained fusion methods designed to control such integration and find that they consistently outperform naive fusion methods. Furthermore, we propose Controlled Fusion Adapter (CFA), a simple plug-in method that enables controlled cross-modal interactions without modifying the TS backbone, integrating only relevant textual information aligned with TS dynamics. CFA employs low rank adapters to filter irrelevant textual information before fusing it into temporal representations. We conduct over 20K experiments across various datasets and TS/text models, demonstrating the effectiveness of the constrained fusion methods. Code is available at: https://github.com/seunghan96/cfa.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现多模态时间序列预测中，简单融合文本等辅助模态常导致性能不如单模态模型，原因是未受约束的融合引入了无关信息。为此提出受约束融合方法，并设计了即插即用的受控融合适配器（CFA），通过低秩适配器过滤无关文本信息后再融入时间表示。在20K+实验上证明受约束融合方法优于朴素融合。
Motivation: 现有多模态时间序列预测方法改进有限，且朴素融合策略（如加法、拼接）常使模型性能下降，缺乏对辅助模态信息引入的约束。
Method: 提出受控融合适配器（CFA），采用低秩适配器过滤与时间序列动态不相关的文本信息，在无需修改时间序列主干网络的情况下实现受控跨模态交互。
Result: 在多种数据集和时间序列/文本模型上的20K+实验表明，受约束融合方法一致优于朴素融合，CFA提升了预测性能。
Conclusion: 受约束融合是提升多模态时间序列预测的有效策略，CFA作为轻量插件可推广到不同架构。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: ThinkJEPA: Empowering Latent World Models with Large Vision-Language Reasoning Model
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in latent world models (e.g., V-JEPA2) has shown promising capability in forecasting future world states from video observations. Nevertheless, dense prediction from a short observation window limits temporal context and can bias predictors toward local, low-level extrapolation, making it difficult to capture long-horizon semantics and reducing downstream utility. Vision--language models (VLMs), in contrast, provide strong semantic grounding and general knowledge by reasoning over uniformly sampled frames, but they are not ideal as standalone dense predictors due to compute-driven sparse sampling, a language-output bottleneck that compresses fine-grained interaction states into text-oriented representations, and a data-regime mismatch when adapting to small action-conditioned datasets. We propose a VLM-guided JEPA-style latent world modeling framework that combines dense-frame dynamics modeling with long-horizon semantic guidance via a dual-temporal pathway: a dense JEPA branch for fine-grained motion and interaction cues, and a uniformly sampled VLM \emph{thinker} branch with a larger temporal stride for knowledge-rich guidance. To transfer the VLM's progressive reasoning signals effectively, we introduce a hierarchical pyramid representation extraction module that aggregates multi-layer VLM representations into guidance features compatible with latent prediction. Experiments on hand-manipulation trajectory prediction show that our method outperforms both a strong VLM-only baseline and a JEPA-predictor baseline, and yields more robust long-horizon rollout behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ThinkJEPA，一种结合视觉语言模型（VLM）与 JEPA 风格潜在世界模型的框架。通过双时间路径：密集 JEPA 分支捕获细粒度运动，均匀采样 VLM 思维分支提供长程语义指导，并引入层次化金字塔表示提取模块以对齐 VLM 指导特征。在手部操作轨迹预测任务上，该方法优于纯 VLM 基线和 JEPA 预测基线。
Motivation: 潜在世界模型（如 V-JEPA2）从短观测窗口做密集预测易偏向局部低层外推，难以捕获长程语义；VLM 虽提供语义但稀疏采样且语言输出瓶颈不适用于密集预测。需结合二者优势。
Method: 采用双时间路径：密集 JEPA 分支建模细粒度运动与交互，均匀采样 VLM 思维分支以大步长提供知识丰富指导；提出层次化金字塔表示提取模块，聚合 VLM 多层表示以适配潜在预测任务。
Result: 在手部操作轨迹预测上，ThinkJEPA 超越强 VLM 基线和 JEPA 预测基线，并产生更鲁棒的长程推演行为。
Conclusion: VLM 引导的 JEPA 框架能有效融合密集动态建模与长程语义指导，提升潜在世界模型在复杂交互任务中的预测性能与鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating Uplift Modeling under Structural Biases: Insights into Metric Stability and Model Robustness
papers.abstract_en: In personalized marketing, uplift models estimate the incremental effect of an intervention by modeling how customer behavior would change under alternative treatments using counterfactual analysis. However, real-world marketing data often exhibit various biases, such as selection bias, spillover effects, measurement error, and unobserved confounding. These biases can adversely affect both the accuracy of uplift estimation and the validity of evaluation metrics. Despite the importance of bias-aware assessment, there remains a lack of systematic studies evaluating how different models and metrics perform under such biased conditions. To bridge this gap, we design a systematic benchmarking framework. Unlike standard predictive tasks, real-world uplift datasets inherently lack counterfactual ground truth. This limitation renders the direct validation of evaluation metrics infeasible and prevents the precise quantification of biases. Therefore, a semi-synthetic approach serves as a critical enabler for systematic benchmarking. This approach effectively bridges the gap by retaining real-world feature dependencies while providing the ground truth needed to isolate structural biases. Our investigations reveal that (i) uplift targeting and prediction can manifest as distinct objectives, where proficiency in one does not ensure efficacy in the other; (ii) while many models exhibit inconsistent performance under diverse biases, TARNet shows notable robustness, providing insights for subsequent model design; (iii) the stability of evaluation metrics is linked to their mathematical alignment with the ATE, suggesting that ATE-approximating metrics yield more consistent model rankings under structural data imperfections. These findings suggest the need for more robust uplift models and evaluation metrics under real-world data imperfections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了uplift模型在存在选择偏差、溢出效应、测量误差和未观测混杂等结构偏差下的表现。通过半合成数据框架，揭示了提升目标与预测目标可能不一致，以及TARNet在多种偏差下表现稳健，而评估指标的稳定性与其数学上与ATE的近似程度相关。
Motivation: 现实营销数据常存在多种偏差，影响uplift估计和评估指标的有效性，但缺乏系统性研究评估不同模型和指标在偏差条件下的表现。
Method: 设计系统化基准框架，采用半合成方法保留真实特征依赖性并提供反事实真值，以隔离结构偏差，评估多种uplift模型和评估指标。
Result: 发现提升目标与预测目标可能不一致；多数模型在不同偏差下表现不一致，但TARNet表现出显著稳健性；评估指标的稳定性与其数学上近似ATE的程度相关。
Conclusion: 需要更鲁棒的uplift模型和评估指标以应对现实数据的不完美。

papers.title: Parallelizing Tool Execution and LLM Generation for Low-Latency Agent Serving
papers.abstract_en: LLM-powered agents execute tasks through a sequential loop of model generation and tool execution. Today's serving systems serialize this loop, leaving tool latency exposed on the task critical path. This paper presents PASTE, a tool-aware agent-serving system that predicts concrete future tool invocations from recurring agent patterns and executes them speculatively while the LLM is still generating. PASTE isolates speculative results until confirmed by the LLM and jointly schedules tool execution and returning LLM sessions to avoid shifting bottlenecks to the GPU. Across deep research, coding, and scientific-agent workloads, PASTE reduces average task completion time by 43.5% and lowers observed tool latency by 1.8x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PASTE 系统，通过预测 LLM 代理中的工具调用模式并投机并行执行，减少任务关键路径上的工具延迟。在深度研究、编码和科学代理工作负载上，平均任务完成时间降低 43.5%，工具延迟降低 1.8 倍。
Motivation: 当前 LLM 代理服务系统串行执行模型生成和工具调用，导致工具延迟暴露在关键路径上，影响任务完成效率。
Method: PASTE 利用代理模式预测未来的工具调用，在 LLM 仍在生成时投机执行，并通过隔离投机结果和联合调度工具执行与 LLM 会话来避免 GPU 瓶颈。
Result: 在深度研究、编码和科学代理工作负载上，平均任务完成时间降低 43.5%，工具延迟降低 1.8 倍。
Conclusion: PASTE 证明了通过投机并行执行工具调用可以有效降低 LLM 代理服务的延迟。
