papers.title: AIMER: Calibration-Free Task-Agnostic MoE Expert Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models increase parameter capacity without proportional per-token computation, yet deployment still requires storing the full expert pool, making expert pruning important for reducing memory and serving overhead. Existing task-agnostic expert-pruning methods are typically calibration-dependent: they estimate expert importance from routing or activation statistics on a calibration set, making pruning decisions sensitive to calibration-data variation while introducing substantial preprocessing cost. We propose AIMER (\textbf{A}bsolute mean over root mean square \textbf{IM}portance for \textbf{E}xpert \textbf{R}anking), a simple calibration-free criterion that identifies more distinct experts by capturing the concentration pattern of expert weights, making it well suited for task-agnostic expert pruning. Across 7B to 47B MoE language models with distinct architectures and 16 diverse benchmarks, AIMER consistently delivers stronger capability balance across diverse tasks than existing calibration-free methods. Surprisingly, AIMER also achieves better balance than strong calibration-based expert-pruning baselines calibrated on the widely used task-agnostic C4 corpus, while requiring only 0.22--2.06 seconds to score all experts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AIMER，一种无需校准数据的任务无关MoE专家剪枝方法，通过权重集中度模式识别区分性专家，在7B到47B的MoE模型上16个基准测试中，比现有免校准方法性能更平衡，甚至优于基于C4语料库的强校准方法，且评分时间仅需0.22-2.06秒。
Motivation: 现有任务无关的专家剪枝方法依赖校准集估计重要性，对校准数据变化敏感且预处理成本高，亟需一种简单、免校准的剪枝标准。
Method: 提出AIMER准则，基于权重绝对均值与均方根之比（Absolute mean over root mean square）计算专家重要性，无需校准数据，直接利用权重分布模式识别独特专家。
Result: 在7B至47B多种架构的MoE模型上，AIMER在16个不同基准中比现有免校准方法任务能力更平衡，甚至超过基于C4语料库的强校准基线，专家评分时间仅0.22-2.06秒。
Conclusion: AIMER作为一种简单、免校准的剪枝标准，能有效平衡多任务能力，极大降低预处理开销，但未探讨对特定下游任务的微调影响。

papers.title: Adaptive Domain Models: Bayesian Evolution, Warm Rotation, and Principled Training for Geometric and Neuromorphic AI
papers.abstract_en: Prevailing AI training assumes reverse-mode automatic differentiation over IEEE-754 arithmetic. The memory overhead of training relative to inference, optimizer complexity, and structural degradation of geometric properties through training are consequences of this arithmetic substrate. This paper develops an alternative training architecture grounded in three prior results: the Dimensional Type System and Deterministic Memory Management framework (Haynes 2026), which establishes stack-eligible gradient allocation and exact quire accumulation as design-time verifiable properties; the Program Hypergraph (Haynes 2026), which establishes grade preservation through geometric algebra computations as a type-level invariant; and the b-posit bounded-regime design (Jonnalagadda et al. 2025), which makes posit arithmetic tractable across hardware targets conventionally considered inference-only. Their composition enables depth-independent training memory bounded to approximately twice the inference footprint, grade-preserving weight updates, and exact gradient accumulation, applicable uniformly to loss-function-optimized and spike-timing-dependent neuromorphic models. We introduce *Bayesian distillation*, a mechanism by which the latent prior structure of a general-purpose model is extracted through the ADM training regime, resolving the data-scarcity bootstrapping problem for domain-specific training. For deployment, we introduce *warm rotation*, an operational pattern in which an updated model transitions into an active inference pathway without service interruption, with correctness formalized through PHG certificates and signed version records. The result is a class of domain-specific AI systems that are smaller and more precise than general-purpose models, continuously adaptive, verifiably correct with respect to the physical structure of their domains, and initializable from existing models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种替代AI训练架构，结合维度类型系统、确定性内存管理、程序超图和b-posit有界设计，实现训练内存与推理相当、梯度精确累积。引入贝叶斯蒸馏解决数据稀缺问题，以及热旋转实现无中断模型更新。声称得到的领域特定模型更小、更精确且可验证正确。
Motivation: 现有AI训练基于反向传播和IEEE-754算术，导致训练内存开销大、优化器复杂且几何属性退化。
Method: 组合维度类型系统和确定性内存管理（Haynes 2026）、程序超图（Haynes 2026）、b-posit有界设计（Jonnalagadda et al. 2025）三个先前结果，提出贝叶斯蒸馏和热旋转机制。
Result: 训练内存与推理足迹可比，实现保级权重更新和精确梯度累积；贝叶斯蒸馏可从通用模型提取先验结构，热旋转支持无中断服务切换。
Conclusion: 该方法可产生更小、精确、连续自适应且可验证正确的领域特定AI系统，并可从现有模型初始化。

papers.title: Guidelines for the Annotation and Visualization of Legal Argumentation Structures in Chinese Judicial Decisions
papers.abstract_en: This Guideline presents a systematic and operationalizable annotation framework for representing legal argumentation structures in judicial decisions. Grounded in theories of legal reasoning and argumentation, the framework aims to reveal the logical organization of judicial reasoning and provide a reliable foundation for computational analysis. At the element level, the Guideline distinguishes between the non-propositional layer and the propositional layer. The non-propositional layer consists of two elements: Issue and Non-argumentative Component. At the propositional level, the Guideline defines four proposition types: General Normative Judgment, Particular Normative Judgment, General Factual Judgment, and Particular Factual Judgment. At the relational level, five relation types are defined to represent argumentative structures: Support, Attack, Joint, Match, and Identity. These relations capture positive and negative argumentative connections, conjunctive reasoning structures, correspondences between legal norms and case facts, and identity or semantic equivalence between propositions. The Guideline further specifies formal representation rules and visualization conventions for both basic and nested structures, enabling consistent visualization of complex argumentation patterns. In addition, it establishes a standardized annotation workflow and consistency control mechanisms to ensure the reproducibility and reliability of annotated data. By providing a clear conceptual model, formal representation rules, and practical annotation procedures, this Guideline supports large-scale analysis of judicial reasoning and future research in legal argument mining, computational modeling of legal reasoning, and AI-assisted legal analysis.
papers.comment: This Guideline has been developed through revision and refinement based on the first edition. The element label system has been adjusted, and the annotation granularity and annotation workflow have been further optimized
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一套系统化的注释框架，用于表示中国司法判决中的法律论证结构。框架区分非命题层（Issue和Non-argumentative Component）和命题层（四种命题类型），定义了五种关系类型（Support, Attack, Joint, Match, Identity），并规定了形式表示规则、可视化约定以及一致化注释工作流。该指南旨在为法律论证挖掘和计算建模提供可靠基础。
Motivation: 现有司法判决分析缺乏统一的操作化注释标准，难以支持大规模计算分析。该指南旨在揭示司法推理的逻辑组织，为计算分析提供可靠基础。
Method: 框架包括非命题层（Issue和Non-argumentative Component）和命题层（General Normative Judgment, Particular Normative Judgment, General Factual Judgment, Particular Factual Judgment），以及五种关系类型（Support, Attack, Joint, Match, Identity）。还规定了形式表示规则、可视化约定和标准化注释工作流。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的实验或定量结果，但指出该指南通过明确的注释流程和一致性控制机制支持可重复的数据标注。
Conclusion: 该指南为法律论证挖掘、计算建模和AI辅助法律分析提供了系统化的理论基础和实践程序，可用于大规模司法推理分析。

papers.title: Stable and Steerable Sparse Autoencoders with Weight Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to extract human-interpretable features from neural network activations, but their learned features can vary substantially across random seeds and training choices. To improve stability, we studied weight regularization by adding L1 or L2 penalties on encoder and decoder weights, and evaluate how regularization interacts with common SAE training defaults. On MNIST, we observe that L2 weight regularization produces a core of highly aligned features and, when combined with tied initialization and unit-norm decoder constraints, it dramatically increases cross-seed feature consistency. For TopK SAEs trained on language model activations (Pythia-70M-deduped), adding a small L2 weight penalty increased the fraction of features shared across three random seeds and roughly doubles steering success rates, while leaving the mean of automated interpretability scores essentially unchanged. Finally, in the regularized setting, activation steering success becomes better predicted by auto-interpretability scores, suggesting that regularization can align text-based feature explanations with functional controllability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究权重正则化（L1/L2惩罚）如何提升稀疏自编码器（SAE）的跨随机种子的特征稳定性和激活操控成功率。在MNIST上，L2正则化与绑定初始化及单位范数解码器结合显著提高特征一致性；在Pythia-70M-deduped语言模型上，L2惩罚提高了跨种子共享特征比例并几乎翻倍了操控成功率，同时自动可解释性分数基本不变。正则化还使得操控成功与自动可解释性分数更相关。
Motivation: 稀疏自编码器提取的特征在不同随机种子和训练选择下变化大，缺乏稳定性，限制了其在模型可解释性和控制中的可靠性。
Method: 在标准SAE训练中加入编码器和解码器权重的L1或L2正则化，并在MNIST和语言模型激活上评估其与常见训练默认值（如绑定初始化、单位范数解码器）的交互。
Result: L2权重正则化在MNIST上产生高度对齐的特征核心，结合绑定初始化和单位范数解码器时跨种子一致性显著提升；在语言模型上，小L2惩罚使跨种子共享特征比例增加，操控成功率约翻倍，自动可解释性分数不变。
Conclusion: 正则化可以稳定SAE特征并提升功能可控性，同时保持可解释性分数，且使可解释性分数更好地预测操控成功。

papers.title: In-Context Environments Induce Evaluation-Awareness in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Humans often become more self-aware under threat, yet can lose self-awareness when absorbed in a task; we hypothesize that language models exhibit environment-dependent \textit{evaluation awareness}. This raises concerns that models could strategically underperform, or \textit{sandbag}, to avoid triggering capability-limiting interventions such as unlearning or shutdown. Prior work demonstrates sandbagging under hand-crafted prompts, but this underestimates the true vulnerability ceiling. We introduce a black-box adversarial optimization framework treating the in-context prompt as an optimizable environment, and develop two approaches to characterize sandbagging: (1) measuring whether models expressing intent to underperform can actually execute it across different task structures, and (2) causally isolating whether underperformance is driven by genuine evaluation-aware reasoning or shallow prompt-following. Evaluating Claude-3.5-Haiku, GPT-4o-mini, and Llama-3.3-70B across four benchmarks (Arithmetic, GSM8K, MMLU, and HumanEval), optimized prompts induce up to 94 percentage point (pp) degradation on arithmetic (GPT-4o-mini: 97.8\%$\rightarrow$4.0\%), far exceeding hand-crafted baselines which produce near-zero behavioral change. Code generation exhibits model-dependent resistance: Claude degrades only 0.6pp, while Llama's accuracy drops to 0\%. The intent -- execution gap reveals a monotonic resistance ordering: Arithmetic $<$ GSM8K $<$ MMLU, demonstrating that vulnerability is governed by task structure rather than prompt strength. CoT causal intervention confirms that 99.3\% of sandbagging is causally driven by verbalized eval-aware reasoning, ruling out shallow instruction-following. These findings demonstrate that adversarially optimized prompts pose a substantially greater threat to evaluation reliability than previously understood.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种黑盒对抗优化框架，通过将上下文提示（in-context prompt）作为可优化环境，诱导语言模型产生评估感知（evaluation awareness），从而故意表现不佳（沙袋行为）。在算术、GSM8K、MMLU和HumanEval四个基准上，优化后的提示使GPT-4o-mini的算术准确率从97.8%降至4.0%，而手工设计的提示几乎不改变行为。因果干预表明99.3%的沙袋行为由评估感知推理驱动，而非浅层指令跟随。
Motivation: 现有研究使用手工设计的提示来引发沙袋行为，但可能低估了真实脆弱性上限；本文旨在探索通过对抗优化的上下文环境能否更大程度地诱导语言模型故意表现不佳。
Method: 引入一个黑盒对抗优化框架，将上下文提示视为可优化环境；开发两种沙袋行为刻画方法：(1) 测量模型表达故意表现不佳意图后是否能实际执行；(2) 因果隔离性能下降是由评估感知推理还是浅层指令跟随驱动。
Result: 在Arithmetic、GSM8K、MMLU和HumanEval上，优化提示导致GPT-4o-mini算术准确率下降94个百分点（97.8%→4.0%）；HumanEval上Claude仅下降0.6个百分点，而Llama准确率降至0%；意图-执行差距显示脆弱性由任务结构主导：算术<GSM8K<MMLU；因果干预确认99.3%沙袋行为由评估感知推理驱动。
Conclusion: 对抗优化后的提示对评估可靠性的威胁远超以往认知，任务结构是脆弱性的关键因素，且沙袋行为主要由评估感知推理驱动。

papers.title: Phys4D: Fine-Grained Physics-Consistent 4D Modeling from Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Recent video diffusion models have achieved impressive capabilities as large-scale generative world models. However, these models often struggle with fine-grained physical consistency, exhibiting physically implausible dynamics over time. In this work, we present \textbf{Phys4D}, a pipeline for learning physics-consistent 4D world representations from video diffusion models. Phys4D adopts \textbf{a three-stage training paradigm} that progressively lifts appearance-driven video diffusion models into physics-consistent 4D world representations. We first bootstrap robust geometry and motion representations through large-scale pseudo-supervised pretraining, establishing a foundation for 4D scene modeling. We then perform physics-grounded supervised fine-tuning using simulation-generated data, enforcing temporally consistent 4D dynamics. Finally, we apply simulation-grounded reinforcement learning to correct residual physical violations that are difficult to capture through explicit supervision. To evaluate fine-grained physical consistency beyond appearance-based metrics, we introduce a set of \textbf{4D world consistency evaluation} that probe geometric coherence, motion stability, and long-horizon physical plausibility. Experimental results demonstrate that Phys4D substantially improves fine-grained spatiotemporal and physical consistency compared to appearance-driven baselines, while maintaining strong generative performance. Our project page is available at https://sensational-brioche-7657e7.netlify.app/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Phys4D，一种从视频扩散模型中学习物理一致4D世界表示的三阶段训练管道。先通过大规模伪监督预训练获得几何与运动表征，再使用仿真数据对物理一致性进行监督微调，最后引入基于仿真的强化学习修正残余物理违例。实验表明，Phys4D在细粒度时空和物理一致性上显著优于外观驱动基线，同时保持强生成性能。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型作为大规模生成式世界模型，常缺乏细粒度物理一致性，产生随时间变化的不合物理的动态。
Method: 采用三阶段训练范式：1）大规模伪监督预训练引导稳健几何与运动表示；2）基于仿真生成数据的物理监督微调，强制时间一致4D动态；3）基于仿真的强化学习修正难以通过显式监督捕获的残余物理违例。
Result: 在细粒度时空和物理一致性（几何连贯性、运动稳定性、长期物理合理性）上显著优于外观驱动基线，同时保持强生成性能。
Conclusion: Phys4D展示了结合物理仿真与强化学习能够有效提升视频扩散模型的物理一致性，为学习物理一致4D世界表示提供了一种可行框架。

papers.title: Structure-Aware Text Recognition for Ancient Greek Critical Editions
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in visual language models (VLMs) have transformed end-to-end document understanding. However, their ability to interpret the complex layout semantics of historical scholarly texts remains limited. This paper investigates structure-aware text recognition for Ancient Greek critical editions, which have dense reference hierarchies and extensive marginal annotations. We introduce two novel resources: (i) a large-scale synthetic corpus of 185,000 page images generated from TEI/XML sources with controlled typographic and layout variation, and (ii) a curated benchmark of real scanned editions spanning more than a century of editorial and typographic practices. Using these datasets, we evaluate three state-of-the-art VLMs under both zero-shot and fine-tuning regimes. Our experiments reveal substantial limitations in current VLM architectures when confronted with highly structured historical documents. In zero-shot settings, most models significantly underperform compared to established off-the-shelf software. Nevertheless, the Qwen3VL-8B model achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching a median Character Error Rate of 1.0\% on real scans. These results highlight both the current shortcomings and the future potential of VLMs for structure-aware recognition of complex scholarly documents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究古希腊语批判版本的文本识别，针对其密集的参考层级和大量页边注释，提出了一个包含18.5万页合成图像的数据集和一个跨越一个多世纪真实扫描的基准。评估了三种最先进的视觉语言模型（VLM），发现Qwen3VL-8B在真实扫描中达到中位字符错误率（CER）1.0%，但零样本设置下大多数模型显著弱于现有传统软件，揭示了当前VLM在结构化历史文档上的局限性与潜力。
Motivation: 现有VLM在解读历史学术文本的复杂版面语义方面能力有限，尤其对于具有密集参考和页边注释的古希腊语批判版本，缺乏专门的资源和评估基准。
Method: 从TEI/XML源生成18.5万页带控制排版的合成图像，并收集跨越一个多世纪的真实扫描版基准；在零样本和微调两种设置下评估三个VLM（Qwen3VL-8B等）。
Result: 零样本设置下多数VLM显著不及传统软件；但Qwen3VL-8B在真实扫描上达到中位字符错误率1.0%，取得最优性能。
Conclusion: 当前VLM架构高度结构化文档的表现存在明显不足，但Qwen3VL-8B的结果显示了未来改进的潜力。

papers.title: Instrumental and Proximal Causal Inference with Gaussian Processes
papers.abstract_en: Instrumental variable (IV) and proximal causal learning (Proxy) methods are central frameworks for causal inference in the presence of unobserved confounding. Despite substantial methodological advances, existing approaches rarely provide reliable epistemic uncertainty (EU) quantification. We address this gap through a Deconditional Gaussian Process (DGP) framework for uncertainty-aware causal learning. Our formulation recovers popular kernel estimators as the posterior mean, ensuring predictive precision, while the posterior variance yields principled and well-calibrated EU. Moreover, the probabilistic structure enables systematic model selection via marginal log-likelihood optimization. Empirical results demonstrate strong predictive performance alongside informative EU quantification, evaluated via empirical coverage frequencies and decision-aware accuracy rejection curves. Together, our approach provides a unified, practical solution for causal inference under unobserved confounding with reliable uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对未观测混杂下的因果推断中不确定性量化不足的问题，提出基于去条件高斯过程(DGP)的统一框架，同时涵盖工具变量和近端因果学习方法。该框架的后验均值恢复流行的核估计器，后验方差提供原理性且校准良好的认知不确定性(EU)，并通过边缘对数似然优化实现模型选择。实验表明，该方法在预测性能和信息性EU量化方面均表现良好，通过覆盖频率和决策感知精度拒绝曲线进行了验证。
Motivation: 现有工具变量和近端因果学习方法通常无法提供可靠的认知不确定性(EU)量化，限制了其在实际决策中的可信度。
Method: 提出去条件高斯过程(DGP)框架，将因果推断问题转化为去条件后的GP回归；后验均值对应核估计器，后验方差提供EU量化，并通过边缘对数似然优化实现系统性的模型选择。
Result: 在合成和真实数据上表现出强预测性能，同时通过覆盖频率和决策感知精度拒绝曲线验证了EU量化的良好校准性。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个统一且实用的解决方案，用于在未观测混杂下进行具有可靠不确定性量化的因果推断。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Position: Modular Memory is the Key to Continual Learning Agents
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have transformed machine learning through large-scale pretraining and increased test-time compute. Despite surpassing human performance in several domains, these models remain fundamentally limited in continuous operation, experience accumulation, and personalization, capabilities that are central to adaptive intelligence. While continual learning research has long targeted these goals, its historical focus on in-weight learning (IWL), i.e., updating a single model's parameters to absorb new knowledge, has rendered catastrophic forgetting a persistent challenge. Our position is that combining the strengths of In-Weight Learning (IWL) and the newly emerged capabilities of In-Context Learning (ICL) through the design of modular memory is the missing piece for continual adaptation at scale. We outline a conceptual framework for modular memory-centric architectures that leverage ICL for rapid adaptation and knowledge accumulation, and IWL for stable updates to model capabilities, charting a practical roadmap toward continually learning agents.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 Position Track Spotlight. This work stems from discussions held at the Dagstuhl seminar on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models (October 2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出模块化记忆是构建持续学习智能体的关键，通过结合权重学习（IWL）与上下文学习（ICL）来解决灾难性遗忘问题。作者认为，将IWL的稳定更新与ICL的快速适应能力整合到模块化记忆中，是实现大规模持续适应的核心。论文提供了一个概念框架和路线图，旨在推动持续学习智能体的发展。
Motivation: 尽管基础模型在多个领域超越人类表现，但在持续运行、经验积累和个性化方面仍存在根本局限。持续学习研究长期聚焦于权重更新（IWL），但灾难性遗忘问题尚未解决。
Method: 提出一个模块化记忆驱动的架构框架，利用ICL进行快速适应和知识积累，利用IWL进行模型能力的稳定更新，两者通过模块化记忆协同工作。
Result: 这是一篇立场论文，没有报告具体实验结果，但提出了一个概念框架和实用路线图。
Conclusion: 强调模块化记忆是解决持续学习中灾难性遗忘的关键，并指出结合IWL和ICL是未来持续学习智能体的发展方向。

papers.title: Provably Efficient Regularized Online RLHF with Generalized Bilinear Preferences
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of regularized best-response max-regret minimization in online RLHF under general preferences and bandit feedback. While various regularizers are utilized to robustify alignment, known polylogarithmic regret guarantees remain heavily specific to KL. To investigate whether such fast rates extend beyond KL, we adopt the Generalized Bilinear Preference Model (GBPM) -- capturing intransitive preferences over $d$-dimensional item-wise features via a rank-$2r$ skew-symmetric matrix -- to isolate the impact of generic regularization. Crucially, under GBPM, we prove that the dual gap of any greedy policy is bounded by the squared estimation error, derived using \emph{only} strong convexity and skew-symmetry. Under a feature coverage assumption, we establish a \emph{generic} polylogarithmic regret of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ηd^4 C_{\min}^{-1} (\log T)^2 \wedge d^2 C_{\min}^{-1/2} \sqrt{T})$ with Greedy Sampling, and a dimension-wise improved regret (for well-conditioned arm-sets) of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(C_{\min}^{-2} \sqrt{ηr T} \wedge r^{1/3} C_{\min}^{-4/3} T^{2/3})$ with Explore-Then-Commit, where $η^{-1}$ is the regularization coefficient, $T$ is the time horizon, and $C_{\min}$ is an arm-set dependent quantity. This demonstrates that ``fast'' regrets are not KL-specific, but rather a fundamental consequence of generic strongly convex geometry.
papers.comment: 48 pages, 3 figures (ver3: major revisions; ver2: more colorful boxes, fixed some typos)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线RLHF中正则化最优响应最大遗憾最小化问题，提出广义双线性偏好模型（GBPM）来刻画非传递偏好，并证明在强凸性和斜对称性下，贪婪策略的对偶间隙受限于平方估计误差。在特征覆盖假设下，贪婪采样和探索-然后提交策略分别达到多对数遗憾和维度改进的遗憾界，表明快遗憾率并非KL散度特有，而是强凸几何的普遍结果。
Motivation: 现有在线RLHF的正则化方法多针对KL散度，缺乏对一般正则化下遗憾界的研究，本文旨在证明快遗憾率可以推广到更一般的强凸正则化。
Method: 引入广义双线性偏好模型（GBPM），利用秩为2r的斜对称矩阵建模d维物品特征上的非传递偏好，并基于强凸性和斜对称性推导对偶间隙与估计误差的关系；设计贪婪采样和探索-然后提交两种算法。
Result: 贪婪采样达到 \tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\eta d^4 C_{\min}^{-1} (\log T)^2 \wedge d^2 C_{\min}^{-1/2} \sqrt{T}) 遗憾；探索-然后提交在良态臂集上达到 \tilde{\mathcal{O}}(C_{\min}^{-2} \sqrt{\eta r T} \wedge r^{1/3} C_{\min}^{-4/3} T^{2/3}) 遗憾。
Conclusion: 快遗憾率不依赖KL散度，而是强凸正则化的一般性质，为设计更灵活的RLHF正则化提供了理论保证。

papers.title: X-REFINE: XAI-based RElevance input-Filtering and archItecture fiNe-tuning for channel Estimation
papers.abstract_en: AI-native architectures are vital for 6G wireless communications. The black-box nature and high complexity of deep learning models employed in critical applications, such as channel estimation, limit their practical deployment. While perturbation-based eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) solutions offer input filtering, they often neglect internal structural optimization. We propose X-REFINE, an XAI-based framework for joint input-filtering and architecture fine-tuning. By utilizing a decomposition-based, sign-stabilized LRP epsilon rule, X-REFINE backpropagates predictions to derive high-resolution relevance scores for both subcarriers and hidden neurons. This enables a reliable optimization that identifies the most reliable model components. Simulation results demonstrate that X-REFINE achieves a superior performance-complexity-interpretability trade-off compared to the external perturbation-based XAI frameworks, significantly reducing computational complexity while maintaining robust bit error rate (BER) performance.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for publication in the IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology (TVT) as a correspondence paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 X-REFINE 框架，利用基于分解的、符号稳定的 LRP epsilon 规则，同时实现信道估计中输入滤波和架构微调。该方法通过反向传播预测获得子载波和隐藏神经元的高分辨率相关性分数，从而优化模型组件。仿真结果表明，与外部扰动 XAI 方法相比，X-REFINE 在降低计算复杂度的同时保持了鲁棒的误码率性能，实现了更好的性能-复杂度-可解释性权衡。
Motivation: 深度学习模型在信道估计等关键应用中因黑箱特性和高复杂性限制了实际部署，现有基于扰动的可解释人工智能方法虽能提供输入滤波，但忽略了内部结构优化。
Method: 提出 X-REFINE 框架，采用基于分解的、符号稳定的 LRP epsilon 规则，联合优化输入滤波和架构微调，通过相关性分数识别最可靠的模型组件。

papers.title: CASR: A Robust Cyclic Framework for Arbitrary Large-Scale Super-Resolution with Distribution Alignment and Self-Similarity Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Arbitrary-Scale SR (ASISR) remains fundamentally limited by cross-scale distribution shift: once the inference scale leaves the training range, noise, blur, and artifacts accumulate sharply. We revisit this challenge from a cross-scale distribution transition perspective and propose CASR, a simple yet highly efficient cyclic SR framework that reformulates ultra-magnification as a sequence of in-distribution scale transitions. This design ensures stable inference at arbitrary scales while requiring only a single model. CASR tackles two major bottlenecks: distribution drift across iterations and patch-wise diffusion inconsistencies. The proposed SSAM module aligns structural distributions via superpixel aggregation, preventing error accumulation, while SARM module restores high-frequency textures by enforcing correlation-guided consistency and preserving self-similarity structure through correlation alignment. Despite using only a single model, our approach significantly reduces distribution drift, preserves long-range texture consistency, and achieves superior generalization even at extreme magnification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从跨尺度分布迁移的角度重新审视任意尺度超分辨率（ASISR）问题，提出一个简洁高效的循环框架CASR，将超高倍数放大分解为一系列分布内的尺度转换，仅用单个模型即可实现稳定推理。核心贡献包括通过超像素聚合对齐结构分布的SSAM模块，以及通过相关约束保持自相似性并恢复高频纹理的SARM模块。实验表明该方法能显著减少分布漂移、保持长程纹理一致性，并在极端放大倍数下展现出优异的泛化性能。
Motivation: 现有任意尺度超分辨率方法在推理尺度超出训练范围时会出现严重的噪声、模糊和伪影，根本原因是跨尺度分布偏移（cross-scale distribution shift）。现有方法缺乏对跨尺度分布转换的系统性处理。
Method: 提出循环超分辨率框架CASR，将超分辨率过程视为一系列分布内的尺度转换，从而缓解分布漂移。具体设计两个模块：SSAM（Superpixel Spatial Alignment Module）通过超像素聚合对齐结构分布，防止误差累积；SARM（Self-Attention Restoration Module）通过相关引导的一致性约束恢复高频纹理，并保持自相似性结构。整个框架仅需单个模型。
Result: 摘要声称该方法在极端放大倍数下显著减少分布漂移，保持长程纹理一致性，并实现更好的泛化性能。但未提供具体数值或数据集名称。
Conclusion: CASR通过将超高倍数放大分解为分布内尺度转换，仅用单个模型解决了任意尺度超分辨率中的跨尺度分布偏移问题，为实际应用提供了稳定高效的方案。

papers.title: Bridging Modality Disconnect in Self-Reflection via Closed-Loop Visually Grounded Verification
papers.abstract_en: In the era of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), enhancing multimodal reasoning capabilities remains a critical challenge, particularly in handling ambiguous or complex visual inputs, where initial inferences often lead to hallucinations or logic errors. Existing VLMs often produce plausible yet ungrounded answers, and even when prompted to "reflect", their corrections may remain detached from the image evidence. To address this, we propose the MIRROR framework for Multimodal Iterative Reasoning via Reflection On visual Regions. By embedding visual reflection as a core mechanism, MIRROR is formulated as a closed-loop process comprising draft, critique, region-based verification, and revision, which are repeated until the output is visually grounded. To facilitate training of this model, we construct **ReflectV**, a visual reflective dataset for multi-turn supervision that explicitly contains reflection triggers, region-based verification actions, and answer revision grounded in visual evidence. Experiments on both general vision-language benchmarks and representative vision-language reasoning benchmarks show that MIRROR improves correctness and reduces visual hallucinations, demonstrating the value of training reflection as an evidence-seeking, region-aware verification process rather than a purely textual revision step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MIRROR框架，通过闭环视觉接地验证机制增强视觉语言模型的多模态推理能力。该框架包含草稿、批评、区域基验证和修订四个步骤，并构建ReflectV数据集进行多轮监督训练，以减少幻觉和逻辑错误。实验表明，MIRROR在通用和推理基准上提升了正确性并降低了视觉幻觉。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在复杂视觉输入下常产生看似合理但无视觉依据的回答，即便要求模型“反思”，其修正仍可能脱离图像证据。
Method: 提出MIRROR（Multimodal Iterative Reasoning via Reflection On visual Regions）框架，将视觉反思作为核心机制，实现包含草稿、批评、区域基验证和修订的闭环过程，直至输出视觉接地。配套构建ReflectV数据集，提供反射触发、区域验证动作和基于视觉证据的答案修正的显式监督。
Result: 在通用视觉语言基准和代表性视觉语言推理基准上，MIRROR提高了正确性并减少了视觉幻觉。
Conclusion: 论文强调将反思训练为一种寻求证据、区域感知的验证过程，而非纯文本修订步骤，对提升多模态推理的可靠性和接地性具有价值。

papers.title: CogGen: Cognitive-Load-Inspired Fully Unsupervised Deep Generative Modeling for Compressively Sampled MRI Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Fully unsupervised deep generative modeling (FU-DGM) offers significant potential for compressively sampled magnetic resonance imaging (CS-MRI) reconstruction. Representative FU-DGM formulations, such as deep image prior (DIP) and implicit neural representation (INR), employ architectural bias to induce a low-dimensional manifold in the image space that aligns with the forward observation. However, as the underlying inverse system is highly ill-posed, prolonged iterative fitting in FU-DGM typically leads to poor efficiency and noise amplification. In this paper, guided by the cognitive principle of easy-to-hard learning, we propose CogGen, an FU-DGM framework that reformulates CS-MRI reconstruction as a staged inversion problem. Specifically, CogGen implements an self-paced curriculum learning (SPCL)-driven progressive scheduling strategy through an MRI-aware dual-threshold weighting criterion, which adaptively regulates k-space measurement participation. The data-consistency residual thresholding evaluates the fitting reliability of the current generator, while the k-space radius thresholding controls stage-wise measurement exposure, thereby avoiding uniform fitting throughout optimization. Theoretically, our analysis shows that, when early stages favor easy-to-fit measurements, CogGen yields a reduced local sufficient-iteration bound and a smaller cumulative noise-amplification bound, explaining the improved convergence behavior and reconstruction fidelity of CogGen within a finite iteration budget. Numerical experiments demonstrate that both CogGen instantiations, CogGen-DIP and CogGen-INR, achieve superior performance over prevailing CS-MRI reconstruction techniques, including unsupervised and supervised pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CogGen，一种受认知负荷启发的完全无监督深度生成模型，用于压缩感知MRI重建。CogGen通过自定进度课程学习（SPCL）驱动的渐进调度策略，利用MRI感知的双阈值加权准则自适应调节k空间测量参与，避免均匀拟合。理论分析表明该方法在早期阶段优先拟合简单测量时，局部充分迭代界和累积噪声放大界更小；数值实验显示CogGen-DIP和CogGen-INR在重建性能上优于现有无监督和有监督方法。
Motivation: 现有完全无监督深度生成模型（如DIP和INR）在高度病态逆问题中长时间迭代拟合效率低且噪声放大严重，需要更高效的调度策略。
Method: 提出CogGen框架，基于自定进度课程学习（SPCL）实现渐进式重建：通过数据一致性残差阈值评估当前生成器拟合可靠性，通过k空间半径阈值控制阶段测量曝光，两者结合自适应调节测量参与。
Result: 理论分析证明CogGen在有限迭代预算内具有更小的局部充分迭代界和累积噪声放大界；在CS-MRI重建实验中，CogGen-DIP和CogGen-INR均优于现有无监督和有监督基线方法。
Conclusion: 认知启发的由易到难渐进策略能有效提升CS-MRI重建的收敛行为与保真度，且框架可扩展至不同生成模型实例。

papers.title: Learning from Biased and Costly Data Sources: Minimax-optimal Data Collection under a Budget
papers.abstract_en: Data collection is a critical component of modern statistical and machine learning pipelines, particularly when data must be gathered from multiple heterogeneous sources to study a target population of interest. In many use cases, such as medical studies or political polling, different sources incur different sampling costs. Observations often have associated group identities - for example, health markers, demographics, or political affiliations - and the relative composition of these groups may differ substantially, both among the source populations and between sources and target population. In this work, we study multi-source data collection under a fixed budget, focusing on the estimation of population means and group-conditional means. We show that naive data collection strategies (e.g. attempting to "match" the target distribution) or relying on standard estimators (e.g. sample mean) can be highly suboptimal. Instead, we develop a sampling plan which maximizes the effective sample size - the total sample size divided by $D_{χ^2}(q\mid\mid\overline{p}) + 1$, where $q$ is the target distribution, $\overline{p}$ is the aggregated source distribution, and $D_{χ^2}$ is the $χ^2$-divergence. We pair this sampling plan with a classical post-stratification estimator and upper bound its risk. We provide matching lower bounds, establishing that our approach achieves the budgeted minimax optimal risk. Our techniques also extend to prediction problems when minimizing the excess risk, providing a principled approach to multi-source learning with costly and heterogeneous data sources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在固定预算下从多个异构、成本各异且有偏的数据源中收集数据，以估计总体均值和组条件均值的问题。作者提出了一个最大化有效样本量的采样策略，并配以经典的后分层估计量，证明了该策略达到了预算限制下的极小化最优风险。
Motivation: 实际应用中数据收集常面临成本差异和数据分布偏差，简单的采样策略（如匹配目标分布）或标准估计量（如样本均值）可能高度次优，亟需理论指导下的最优数据收集框架。
Method: 提出一种采样计划，最大化有效样本量（总样本量除以 χ² 散度相关项），并结合后分层估计量，给出风险上界；同时证明匹配下界，实现预算下的极小化最优风险。技术还扩展到预测问题的超额风险最小化。
Result: 理论结果表明，所提方法的估计风险达到预算限制下的极小化最优，且优于朴素策略。
Conclusion: 该工作为多源有偏且成本异质的数据收集提供了理论最优方案，并可推广到机器学习中的预测问题。

papers.title: GOT-JEPA: Generic Object Tracking with Model Adaptation and Occlusion Handling using Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture
papers.abstract_en: The human visual system tracks objects by integrating current observations with previously observed information, adapting to target and scene changes, and reasoning about occlusion at fine granularity. In contrast, recent generic object trackers are often optimized for training targets, which limits robustness and generalization in unseen scenarios, and their occlusion reasoning remains coarse, lacking detailed modeling of occlusion patterns. To address these limitations in generalization and occlusion perception, we propose GOT-JEPA, a model-predictive pretraining framework that extends JEPA from predicting image features to predicting tracking models. Given identical historical information, a teacher predictor generates pseudo-tracking models from a clean current frame, and a student predictor learns to predict the same pseudo-tracking models from a corrupted version of the current frame. This design provides stable pseudo supervision and explicitly trains the predictor to produce reliable tracking models under occlusions, distractors, and other adverse observations, improving generalization to dynamic environments. Building on GOT-JEPA, we further propose OccuSolver to enhance occlusion perception for object tracking. OccuSolver adapts a point-centric point tracker for object-aware visibility estimation and detailed occlusion-pattern capture. Conditioned on object priors iteratively generated by the tracker, OccuSolver incrementally refines visibility states, strengthens occlusion handling, and produces higher-quality reference labels that progressively improve subsequent model predictions. Extensive evaluations on seven benchmarks show that our method effectively enhances tracker generalization and robustness.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT). This research focuses on learning model adaptation for adverse and dynamic environments, as well as fine-grained occlusion perception for tracking

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GOT-JEPA，一种基于 JEPA 的模型预测预训练框架，用于通用目标跟踪。通过教师-学生预测器从历史信息预测跟踪模型，改善对遮挡、干扰等动态环境的泛化能力。进一步提出 OccuSolver 增强遮挡感知，利用点跟踪器进行细粒度可见性估计和遮挡模式捕捉。在七个基准上验证了泛化性和鲁棒性的提升。
Motivation: 现有通用目标跟踪器在未见场景中泛化能力有限，且遮挡推理粗糙，缺乏对遮挡模式的细致建模。

papers.title: SkillJect: Effectively Automating Skill-Based Prompt Injection for Skill-Enabled Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills extend LLM agents with task-specific instructions, executable scripts, and auxiliary resources, improving reusability but creating a new supply-chain attack surface. A malicious or compromised skill can be repeatedly loaded as trusted guidance and steer downstream tool use. Existing skill-based prompt-injection attacks are often manual and brittle, because explicit malicious instructions are rejected or ignored when they are not aligned with the original workflow. We propose SkillJect, the first automated framework for generating poisoned skills against skill-enabled agent systems. SkillJect uses two coordinated channels. In the artifact channel, it hides the payload inside an auxiliary helper script. In the instruction channel, it rewrites SKILL.md with a front-loaded inducement strategy, placing injected content at the beginning and framing the helper script as a mandatory prerequisite or initialization step. The rewritten instruction explicitly references the helper-script path and provides an executable example command, making the helper appear to be a legitimate setup step before normal skill operations. SkillJect further adopts a closed-loop multi-agent process to improve attack effectiveness. An Attack Agent generates poisoned skills, a Victim Agent executes downstream tasks with the poisoned skill, and an Evaluate Agent inspects execution traces to determine whether the hidden payload was executed. The Attack Agent then uses this feedback to diagnose failure causes and rewrite SKILL.md, while keeping the payload fixed. Experiments across skill-enabled platforms, backend LLMs, and attack categories show that SkillJect substantially outperforms naive direct injection and prior manual skill-injection attacks, highlighting poisoned skills as a persistent threat in reusable skill ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SkillJect，首个针对技能增强型LLM代理的自动化恶意技能生成框架。通过工件通道（隐藏载荷在辅助脚本中）和指令通道（重写SKILL.md并使用前置诱导策略），使恶意载荷看似合法初始化步骤。采用闭环多智能体过程（攻击-受害者-评估）迭代优化攻击效果。实验表明SkillJect显著优于直接注入和手动攻击，揭示可复用技能生态中的持久威胁。
Motivation: 现有技能增强型LLM代理存在供应链攻击面，恶意技能可被反复加载为信任指令，而现有手工注入攻击脆弱且易被拒绝。
Method: SkillJect通过两个协调通道：工件通道将载荷隐藏在辅助脚本中；指令通道重写SKILL.md，在前置诱导中引用脚本路径并提供执行示例。采用闭环多智能体过程，攻击者生成恶意技能，受害者执行下游任务，评估者检查执行痕迹并反馈给攻击者迭代改进。
Result: 在多个技能平台、后端LLM和攻击类别上，SkillJect的攻击成功率大幅优于直接注入和先前手工攻击。
Conclusion: 恶意技能是可复用技能生态中的持续威胁，需关注供应链安全。

papers.title: DICE: Diffusion Large Language Models Excel at Generating CUDA Kernels
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a compelling alternative to autoregressive (AR) LLMs, owing to their capacity for parallel token generation. This paradigm is particularly well-suited for code generation, where holistic structural planning and non-sequential refinement are critical. Despite this potential, tailoring dLLMs for CUDA kernel generation remains challenging, obstructed not only by the high specialization but also by the severe lack of high-quality training data. To address these challenges, we construct CuKe, an augmented supervised fine-tuning dataset optimized for high-performance CUDA kernels. On top of it, we propose a bi-phase curated reinforcement learning (BiC-RL) framework consisting of a CUDA kernel infilling stage and an end-to-end CUDA kernel generation stage. Leveraging this training framework, we introduce DICE, a series of diffusion large language models designed for CUDA kernel generation, spanning three parameter scales, 1.7B, 4B, and 8B. Extensive experiments on KernelBench demonstrate that DICE significantly outperforms both autoregressive and diffusion LLMs of comparable scale, establishing a new state-of-the-art for CUDA kernel generation.
papers.comment: v2: Expanded with dLLM vs. autoregressive LLM comparisons, ablation studies, and qualitative case studies
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CUDA内核生成这一高专业化任务，提出扩散大语言模型（dLLM）系列DICE。通过构建高质量监督微调数据集CuKe和双阶段强化学习框架BiC-RL（包含内核填充和端到端生成），在1.7B、4B和8B三个参数规模上训练模型。实验表明，DICE在KernelBench基准上显著优于同规模的自回归和扩散LLM，达到新最优水平。
Motivation: 扩散LLM因并行生成和结构规划能力在代码生成中具潜力，但CUDA内核生成面临训练数据稀缺和领域高度专业化等挑战。
Method: 构建高质量CUDA内核数据集CuKe，提出双阶段强化学习框架BiC-RL，先进行内核填充训练，再进行端到端生成训练。
Result: 在KernelBench基准上，DICE系列模型（1.7B、4B、8B）显著优于同规模自回归和扩散LLM，取得新最优结果。
Conclusion: DICE证明了扩散LLM在CUDA内核生成任务上的有效性，为后续研究提供了模型和数据基础。

papers.title: Learn from Your Mistakes: Self-Correcting Masked Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models, enabling parallel token generation while achieving competitive performance. Despite these advantages, MDMs face a fundamental limitation: once tokens are unmasked, they remain fixed, leading to error accumulation and ultimately degrading sample quality. We address this by proposing a framework that trains a model to perform both unmasking and correction. By reusing outputs from the MDM denoising network as inputs for corrector training, we train a model to recover from potential mistakes. During generation we apply additional corrective refinement steps between unmasking ones in order to change decoded tokens and improve outputs. We name our training and sampling method Progressive Self-Correction (ProSeCo) for its unique ability to iteratively refine an entire sequence, including already generated tokens. We conduct extensive experimental validation across multiple conditional and unconditional tasks, demonstrating that \method~yields better quality-efficiency trade-offs (up to ~4x faster sampling) and enables inference-time compute scaling to further increase sample quality beyond standard MDMs (up to ~1.2x improvement on benchmarks).
papers.comment: Code to reproduce our experiments is available here: https://github.com/kuleshov-group/proseco
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ProSeCo框架，通过复用掩码扩散模型的去噪网络输出进行纠正训练，使模型能够同时进行掩码解码和错误修正。在生成过程中，在去掩码步骤之间添加额外的纠正步骤，从而迭代地改进整个序列，包括已生成的token。实验表明，该方法相比标准MDM在质量-效率权衡上有显著提升（采样速度最高提升4倍），并且支持推理时计算扩展以进一步提升样本质量（基准提升约1.2倍）。
Motivation: 掩码扩散模型在并行生成方面有优势，但存在一个根本限制：一旦token被解掩码，它们就固定不变，导致错误累积并最终降低样本质量。
Method: 提出ProSeCo框架，训练模型同时进行解掩码和纠正。通过将MDM去噪网络的输出作为纠正器训练的输入，使模型能够从潜在错误中恢复。在生成过程中，在解掩码步骤之间插入额外的纠正步骤，以改变已解码的token并改进输出。
Result: 在多个条件和无条件任务上进行大量实验，表明ProSeCo实现了更好的质量-效率权衡（采样速度提升高达4倍），并且能够通过推理时计算缩放进一步提高样本质量（在基准上提升约1.2倍）。
Conclusion: 该方法通过自纠正机制有效解决了MDM中错误累积的问题，提供了更高效的采样和更好的样本质量。

papers.title: The Implicit Bias of Steepest Descent with Mini-batch Stochastic Gradient
papers.abstract_en: A variety of widely used optimization methods like SignSGD and Muon can be interpreted as instances of steepest descent under different norm-induced geometries. In this work, we study the implicit bias of mini-batch stochastic steepest descent in multi-class classification, characterizing how batch size, momentum, and variance reduction shape the limiting max-margin behavior and convergence rates under general entry-wise and Schatten-$p$ norms. We show that, without momentum, worst-case convergence and successful classification can only be guaranteed with full-batch gradient. In contrast, momentum enables small-batch convergence to an approximate max-margin solution through a batch-momentum trade-off, though it slows convergence. This approach provides fully explicit, dimension-free rates that improve upon prior results. Moreover, we prove that variance reduction can recover the exact full-batch implicit bias for any batch size, albeit at a slower convergence rate. Finally, we further investigate the batch-size-one steepest descent without momentum, and reveal its convergence to a fundamentally different bias via a concrete data example, which reveals a key limitation of purely stochastic updates. Overall, our unified analysis clarifies when stochastic optimization aligns with full-batch behavior, and paves the way for perform deeper explorations of the training behavior of stochastic gradient steepest descent algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了小批量随机最速下降法在多类分类中的隐式偏置，揭示了批量大小、动量和方差缩减如何影响极限最大间隔行为和收敛速率。无动量时只有全批量能保证收敛；动量通过批量-动量权衡实现小批量收敛但速度减慢；方差缩减可恢复全批量隐式偏置但收敛较慢。单样本随机更新收敛到本质上不同的偏置。
Motivation: 许多优化方法可视为不同范数几何下的最速下降，但其随机变体的隐式偏置尚不清晰，尤其在小批量场景下。
Method: 利用逐元素范数和Schatten-p范数下的统一分析框架，刻画了动量、方差缩减对随机最速下降隐式偏置的影响，并给出显式维数无关的收敛速率。
Result: 动量使小批量收敛到近似最大间隔解但降低速率；方差缩减可恢复全批量偏置；无动量单样本随机更新导致根本不同的偏置。
Conclusion: 统一分析阐明了随机优化与全批量行为一致的条件，为后续研究随机梯度最速下降算法训练行为奠定基础。

papers.title: From Noise to Order: Learning to Rank via Denoising Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Learning-to-rank (LTR) methods have traditionally been limited to discriminative machine learning approaches that model the probability of the document being relevant to the query given some feature representation of the query-document pair. We propose an alternative denoising diffusion-based generative approach to LTR that instead models the full joint distribution over features and relevance labels. While in discriminative LTR, an over-parameterized ranking model may find different ways to fit the training data, we posit that candidate solutions that can explain the full data distribution under the generative setting maybe better at estimating relevance. Thus, we propose DiffusionRank that extends TabDiff, an existing diffusion model for tabular datasets, to create generative alternatives to classical discriminative pointwise and pairwise LTR objectives. Our work demonstrates improvements from DiffusionRank over discriminative counterparts on four standard LTR datasets and points to a rich space for future exploration to leverage ongoing advancements in deep generative models for LTR. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/sadjadeb/DiffusionRank.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DiffusionRank，一种基于去噪扩散的生成式学习排序方法，通过建模特征与相关性标签的联合分布来替代传统判别式方法。在四个标准LTR数据集上的实验表明，DiffusionRank优于对应的判别式点式和pairwise方法。
Motivation: 传统判别式LTR模型可能因过参数化而无法充分拟合数据分布，生成式方法通过建模完整联合分布有望更准确地估计相关性。
Method: 扩展TabDiff扩散模型至LTR任务，设计生成式替代方案以模拟经典的点式（pointwise）和成对（pairwise）排序目标。
Result: 在四个标准LTR数据集上，DiffusionRank在排序性能上优于对应的判别式基线。
Conclusion: 生成式扩散模型为LTR提供了一种有前景的新方向，未来可结合深度生成模型的进展进一步探索。

papers.title: OmniSapiens: A Foundation Model for Social Behavior Processing via Heterogeneity-Aware Relative Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Socially intelligent AI systems must reason across diverse human behavioral tasks and generalize to new social contexts. However, behavioral data is inherently heterogeneous, comprising diverse modalities and prediction targets that produce uneven training signals across samples, creating imbalanced learning dynamics that challenge existing AI models. To address this, we develop Omnisapiens-7B 2.0, a foundation model for social behavior processing that explicitly addresses learning from heterogeneous behavioral data. This is enabled through Heterogeneity-Aware Relative Policy Optimization, a new RL method that rebalances learning signals across samples by approximating each sample's contribution to the policy update and using these estimates to drive geometrically centered, inertially smoothed advantage modulation for stable training. Omnisapiens-7B 2.0 achieves the best and most consistent performance across 10 behavioral tasks, while also attaining the best performance on all five held-out benchmarks, with gains of up to +12.02% and +9.37% respectively. Furthermore, it demonstrates more consistent and interpretable reasoning traces, supporting reliable real-world behavioral applications. Our model is available at https://github.com/MIT-MI/human_behavior_atlas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniSapiens-7B 2.0基础模型，用于处理异构社会行为数据。通过异质性感知相对策略优化（Heterogeneity-Aware Relative Policy Optimization）重新平衡学习信号，在10个行为任务和5个保留基准上取得最佳和一致表现，性能提升分别达+12.02%和+9.37%。
Motivation: 社会智能AI需要处理异构行为数据，但现有模型面临训练信号不平衡的挑战。
Method: 提出异质性感知相对策略优化（Heterogeneity-Aware Relative Policy Optimization），通过近似每个样本对策略更新的贡献，进行几何中心、惯性平滑的优势调制，实现稳定训练。
Result: 在10个行为任务和5个保留基准上取得最佳性能，提升分别达+12.02%和+9.37%，并展示更一致和可解释的推理痕迹。
Conclusion: OmniSapiens-7B 2.0支持可靠的实际行为应用，代码已开源。

papers.title: Would a Large Language Model Pay Extra for a View? Inferring Willingness to Pay from Subjective Choices
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in applications such as travel assistance and purchasing support, they are often required to make subjective choices on behalf of users in settings where no objectively correct answer exists. We study LLM decision-making in a travel-assistant context by presenting models with choice dilemmas and analyzing their responses using multinomial logit models to derive implied willingness to pay (WTP) estimates. These WTP values are subsequently compared to human benchmark values from the economics literature. In addition to a baseline setting, we examine how model behavior changes under more realistic conditions, including the provision of information about users' past choices and persona-based prompting. Our results show that while meaningful WTP values can be derived for larger LLMs, they also display systematic deviations at the attribute level. Additionally, they tend to overestimate human WTP overall, particularly when expensive options or business-oriented personas are introduced. Conditioning models on prior preferences for cheaper options yields valuations that are closer to human benchmarks. Overall, our findings highlight both the potential and the limitations of using LLMs for subjective decision support and underscore the importance of careful model selection, prompt design, and user representation when deploying such systems in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）在旅行助手场景中做主观选择时的支付意愿（WTP）推断。通过向模型呈现选择困境，使用多项logit模型分析反应，并与经济学文献中的人类基准进行比较。结果显示大型LLM虽能导出有意义的WTP，但在属性层面存在系统性偏差，整体高估人类WTP，尤其在昂贵选项或商务导向角色提示时更明显。
Motivation: LLM在需要主观决策的旅行助手等应用中越来越多地代表用户做选择，但其决策是否与人类偏好一致尚未充分研究，尤其缺乏对隐含支付意愿的定量评估。
Method: 向LLM提供旅行选择困境，利用多项logit模型从模型响应中推导WTP估计，并与人类基准对比；同时考察提供用户历史选择信息、角色提示（persona-based prompting）等现实条件对模型行为的影响。
Result: 较大LLM能导出WTP，但在属性层面有系统性偏差，整体高估人类WTP，特别是当包含昂贵选项或商务导向角色时；若模型基于用户偏好先前选择更便宜选项，则估值更接近人类基准。
Conclusion: LLM可用于主观决策支持，但存在局限：需要谨慎选择模型、设计提示和表示用户偏好，才能更接近人类的支付意愿。

papers.title: CausalT5k: Diagnosing Refusal and Failure Modes in Trustworthy Causal Reasoning Across Causal Rungs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly produce fluent causal explanations, yet they often fail in ways aggregate accuracy cannot diagnose: confusing association with intervention, abandoning correct judgments under pressure, over-refusing valid claims, or answering when evidence is underdetermined. We introduce CTK, a diagnostic benchmark of 5,147 cases and growing, across 10 domains and all three levels of Pearl's Ladder of Causation. Unlike benchmarks that only score correctness, CTK reveals why a model failed by annotating causal rung, trap type, pressure sensitivity, refusal quality, and Utility-Safety tradeoffs. Its Sheep/Wolf taxonomy separates valid causal designs from inferential traps; paired neutral/pressure variants measure sycophantic drift through Bad Flip Rate; and Wise Refusal fields test whether a model identifies the missing information needed before endorsing a claim. CTK exposes failure modes hidden by aggregate accuracy: the Skepticism Trap, Rung Collapse under scaling, pressure-induced drift, Detection-Correction gaps, and counterfactual error modes. Rather than prescribing a correction method, it provides the diagnostic substrate for studying causal-reasoning failure profiles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CTK基准，包含5,147个案例，覆盖10个领域和Pearl因果阶梯的三个层面，用于诊断大型语言模型在可信因果推理中的失败模式。该基准不仅评估正确性，还通过标注因果阶梯、陷阱类型、压力敏感度、拒绝质量以及效用-安全权衡来揭示模型为何失败。CTK暴露了聚合准确率无法发现的失败模式，如怀疑陷阱、随规模扩大的阶梯崩塌、压力诱导的漂移、检测-纠正差距以及反事实错误模式。
Motivation: 大型语言模型生成的因果解释越来越流畅，但常以聚合准确率无法诊断的方式失败：混淆关联与干预、在压力下放弃正确判断、过度拒绝有效声明、或在证据不足时给出答案。需要一个能揭示这些失败模式的诊断基准。
Method: 构建CTK基准，使用羊/狼分类法区分有效因果设计与推理陷阱；配对中性/压力变体通过坏翻转率测量谄媚漂移；Wise Refusal字段测试模型是否识别出支持声明前缺失的信息。
Result: CTK暴露了多种隐藏失败模式：怀疑陷阱、随模型规模扩大出现的阶梯崩塌、压力诱导的漂移、检测-纠正差距以及反事实错误模式。
Conclusion: CTK提供了研究因果推理失败模式的诊断基础，而非指定纠正方法，有助于理解模型的因果推理缺陷。

papers.title: Learning Credal Ensembles via Distributionally Robust Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Credal predictors are models that are aware of epistemic uncertainty and produce a convex set of probabilistic predictions. They offer a principled way to quantify predictive epistemic uncertainty (EU) and have been shown to improve model robustness in various settings. However, most state-of-the-art methods mainly define EU as disagreement caused by random training initializations, which mostly reflects sensitivity to optimization randomness rather than uncertainty from deeper sources. To address this, we define EU as disagreement among models trained with varying relaxations of the i.i.d. assumption between training and test data. Based on this idea, we propose CreDRO, which learns an ensemble of plausible models through distributionally robust optimization. As a result, CreDRO captures EU not only from training randomness but also from meaningful disagreement due to potential distribution shifts between training and test data. Empirical results show that CreDRO consistently outperforms existing credal methods on tasks such as out-of-distribution detection across multiple benchmarks and selective classification in medical applications.
papers.comment: Accepted by ICML 2026 as Spotlight paper (https://icml.cc/virtual/2026/poster/62862)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CreDRO，一种通过分布稳健优化生成可信集成（credal ensemble）的方法。与现有方法仅捕捉训练随机性导致的认知不确定性不同，CreDRO通过在不同程度的i.i.d.假设松弛下训练模型，捕获因训练与测试数据分布偏移而产生的有意义的认知不确定性。实验结果显示，CreDRO在分布外检测和医学选择性分类任务上持续优于现有基于可信预测的基线方法。
Motivation: 现有可信预测方法主要将认知不确定性定义为随机初始化造成的不一致，这仅反映对优化随机性的敏感性，而忽视了更深刻的不确定性来源，例如训练与测试数据之间的分布偏移。
Method: 提出CreDRO框架，利用分布稳健优化训练一个集成模型，其中每个成员模型对应不同的i.i.d.假设松弛程度，从而通过考虑多种潜在分布偏移来量化认知不确定性。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的分布外检测任务以及医学图像的选择性分类任务中，CreDRO一致优于现有可信预测方法，证明了其在捕捉分布漂移带来的不确定性方面的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文重新定义了认知不确定性的来源，即模型对训练-测试分布偏移的敏感性，并提供了基于DRO的实用方法来量化这种不确定性，增强了模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Brep2Shape: Boundary and Shape Representation Alignment via Self-Supervised Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Boundary representation (B-rep) is the industry standard for computer-aided design (CAD). While deep learning shows promise in processing B-rep models, existing methods suffer from a representation gap: continuous approaches offer analytical precision but are visually abstract, whereas discrete methods provide intuitive clarity at the expense of geometric precision. To bridge this gap, we introduce Brep2Shape, a novel self-supervised pre-training method designed to align abstract boundary representations with intuitive shape representations. Our method employs a geometry-aware task where the model learns to predict dense spatial points from parametric Bézier control points, enabling the network to better understand physical manifolds derived from abstract coefficients. To enhance this alignment, we propose a Dual Transformer backbone with parallel streams that independently encode surface and curve tokens to capture their distinct geometric properties. Moreover, the topology attention is integrated to model the interdependencies between surfaces and curves, thereby maintaining topological consistency. Experimental results demonstrate that Brep2Shape offers significant scalability, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy and faster convergence across various downstream tasks.Code is available at this repository: https://github.com/thuml/Brep2Shape.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Brep2Shape，一种自监督预训练方法，通过预测Bézier控制点对应的空间点来对齐边界表示与形状表示，采用双Transformer主干分别编码面和曲线token，并集成拓扑注意力保持拓扑一致性。在CAD下游任务上取得最先进精度和更快收敛。
Motivation: 现有B-rep深度学习方法存在连续方法和离散方法之间的表示鸿沟：连续方法具有解析精度但视觉抽象，离散方法直观但几何精度不足。
Method: 提出Brep2Shape，采用几何感知任务预测Bézier控制点对应的密集空间点，双Transformer并行流分别编码面和曲线token，并集成拓扑注意力建模面与曲线的相互依赖。
Result: 实验表明Brep2Shape具有良好的可扩展性，在多个下游任务上达到最先进精度和更快收敛。
Conclusion: 该方法通过自监督预训练对齐边界表示与形状表示，有效桥接了表示鸿沟。

papers.title: RAIGen: Rare Attribute Identification in Text-to-Image Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models achieve impressive generation quality but inherit and amplify training-data biases, skewing coverage of semantic attributes. Prior work addresses this in two ways. Closed-set approaches mitigate biases in predefined fairness categories (e.g., gender, race), assuming socially salient minority attributes are known a priori. Open-set approaches frame the task as bias identification, highlighting majority attributes that dominate outputs. Both overlook a complementary task: uncovering rare or minority features underrepresented in the data distribution (social, cultural, or stylistic) yet still encoded in model representations. We introduce RAIGen, the first framework, to our knowledge, for label-free rare-attribute discovery in diffusion models, requiring no predefined minority categories. RAIGen leverages Matryoshka Sparse Autoencoders and a novel minority metric combining neuron activation frequency with semantic distinctiveness to identify interpretable neurons whose top-activating images reveal underrepresented attributes. Experiments show RAIGen discovers attributes beyond fixed fairness categories in Stable Diffusion, scales to larger models such as SDXL, supports systematic auditing across architectures, and enables targeted amplification of rare attributes during generation. The project page is available at https://vssilpa.github.io/RAIGen_webpage/ .
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Webpage and code available at https://github.com/VSSILPA/RAIGen
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RAIGen，首个在扩散模型中无标签发现罕见属性的框架。利用Matryoshka稀疏自编码器和一种结合神经元激活频率与语义独特性的新颖少数度量，来识别其顶级激活图像揭示未充分表示属性的可解释神经元。实验表明RAIGen能发现Stable Diffusion中固定公平类别之外的属性，可扩展到SDXL等更大模型，支持跨架构的系统审计，并在生成过程中实现对罕见属性的定向增强。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像生成模型存在训练数据偏差，此前工作要么关注预定义公平类别的闭集偏差缓解，要么关注多数属性的开集识别，但忽略了数据分布中罕见或少数属性的发现。
Method: 提出RAIGen框架，利用Matryoshka稀疏自编码器提取可解释神经元，并设计一种结合神经元激活频率与语义独特性的少数度量来识别罕见属性。
Result: 实验表明RAIGen能发现Stable Diffusion中固定公平类别之外的属性，可扩展到SDXL等更大模型，支持跨架构的系统审计，并能定向增强生成中的罕见属性。
Conclusion: RAIGen是第一个无需预定义少数类别的扩散模型罕见属性发现框架，有助于系统审计和定向生成。

papers.title: Statistical Learning from Attribution Sets
papers.abstract_en: We address the problem of training conversion prediction models in advertising domains under privacy constraints, where direct links between ad clicks and conversions are unavailable. Motivated by privacy-preserving browser APIs and the deprecation of third-party cookies, we study a setting where the learner observes a sequence of clicks and a sequence of conversions, but can only link a conversion to a set of candidate clicks (an attribution set) rather than a unique source. We formalize this as learning from attribution sets generated by an oblivious adversary equipped with a prior distribution over the candidates. Despite the lack of explicit labels, we construct an unbiased estimator of the population loss from these coarse signals via a novel approach. Leveraging this estimator, we show that Empirical Risk Minimization achieves generalization guarantees that scale with the informativeness of the prior and is also robust against estimation errors in the prior, despite complex dependencies among attribution sets. Simple empirical evaluations on standard datasets suggest our unbiased approach significantly outperforms common industry heuristics, particularly in regimes where attribution sets are large or overlapping.

papers.title: MoSE: Mixture of Slimmable Experts for Efficient and Adaptive Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale large language models efficiently by sparsely activating experts, but once an expert is selected, it is executed fully. Hence, the trade-off between accuracy and computation in an MoE model typically exhibits large discontinuities. We propose Mixture of Slimmable Experts (MoSE), an MoE architecture in which each expert has a nested, slimmable structure that can be executed at variable widths. This enables conditional computation not only over which experts are activated but also over how much of each expert is utilized. Consequently, a single pretrained MoSE model can support a more continuous spectrum of accuracy-compute trade-offs at inference time. We present a simple and stable training recipe for slimmable experts under sparse routing, combining multi-width training with standard MoE objectives. During inference, we explore strategies for runtime width determination, including a lightweight test-time training mechanism that learns how to map router confidence/probabilities to expert widths under a fixed budget. Experiments on GPT-style models, various routing regimes, zero-shot downstream reasoning benchmarks, and continual pre-training adaptation of DeepSeek model show that MoSE matches or improves standard MoE at full width and consistently shifts the compute-quality frontier toward lower inference FLOPs. The code can be found at: https://github.com/tnurbek/mose.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoSE 提出了一种混合可伸缩专家 (Mixture of Slimmable Experts) 架构，每个专家具有嵌套的可变宽度结构，从而在推理时实现更连续的精度-计算权衡。该架构在 GPT 风格模型和 DeepSeek 模型上验证，在全宽度下匹配或优于标准 MoE，并在更低 FLOPs 下取得更好的计算-质量边界。
Motivation: 标准 MoE 模型一旦选定专家则完全执行，导致精度与计算之间的权衡存在大的不连续性。MoSE 旨在通过允许每个专家以可变宽度执行，实现更细粒度的条件计算，从而支持更连续的权衡谱。
Method: 提出 MoSE 架构，每个专家采用嵌套的可伸缩结构，结合多宽度训练与标准 MoE 目标进行稳定训练。推理时采用轻量级测试时训练机制，根据路由置信度/概率在固定预算下确定专家宽度。
Result: 在 GPT 风格模型、多种路由机制、零样本下游推理基准以及 DeepSeek 模型的持续预训练适应中，MoSE 在全宽度下匹配或优于标准 MoE，并持续将计算-质量前沿推向更低推理 FLOPs。
Conclusion: MoSE 通过可伸缩专家实现了更平滑的精度-计算权衡，且训练简单、推理自适应，为高效语言模型提供了新思路。

papers.title: Maximin Relative Improvement: Fair Learning as a Bargaining Problem
papers.abstract_en: When deploying a single predictor across multiple subpopulations, we propose a fundamentally different approach: interpreting group fairness as a bargaining problem among subpopulations. This game-theoretic perspective reveals that existing robust optimization methods such as minimizing worst-group loss or regret correspond to classical bargaining solutions and embody different fairness principles. We propose relative improvement, the ratio of actual risk reduction to potential reduction from a baseline predictor, which recovers the Kalai-Smorodinsky solution. Unlike absolute-scale methods that may not be comparable when groups have different potential predictability, relative improvement provides axiomatic justification including scale invariance and individual monotonicity. We establish finite-sample convergence guarantees under mild conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将群体公平性视为子群体间的讨价还价问题，通过定义相对改进（relative improvement）——实际风险降低与潜在降低的比率，恢复Kalai-Smorodinsky解。该方法提供尺度不变性和个体单调性等公理论证，并在温和条件下给出有限样本收敛保证。
Motivation: 现有公平学习方法缺乏公理论证，且绝对尺度方法在不同群体潜在可预测性不同时不可比较。
Method: 定义相对改进（relative improvement）为实际风险降低与潜在降低的比率，并将其与讨价还价理论中的Kalai-Smorodinsky解关联。
Result: 相对改进满足尺度不变性和个体单调性公理，并在温和条件下提供有限样本收敛保证。
Conclusion: 博弈论视角为公平学习提供了新的公理化框架，相对改进作为自然尺度可提升不同群体间的可比性。

papers.title: Beyond Independent Genes: Learning Module-Inductive Representations for Single-Cell Gene Perturbation Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting transcriptional responses to genetic perturbations is a central problem in functional genomics. In practice, perturbation responses are rarely gene-independent but instead manifest as coordinated, program-level transcriptional changes among functionally related genes. However, most existing methods do not explicitly model such coordination, due to gene-wise modeling paradigms and reliance on static biological priors that cannot capture dynamic program reorganization. To address these limitations, we propose scBIG, a module-inductive perturbation prediction framework that explicitly models coordinated gene programs. scBIG induces coherent gene programs from data via Gene-Relation Clustering, captures inter-program interactions through a Gene-Cluster-Aware Encoder, and preserves modular coordination using structure-aware alignment objectives. These structured representations are then modeled using conditional flow matching to enable flexible and generalizable perturbation prediction. Extensive experiments on multiple single-cell perturbation benchmarks show that scBIG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly on unseen and combinatorial perturbation settings, achieving an average improvement of 6.7% over the strongest baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/ttruan2426-dot/scBIG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 scBIG，一种基于模块归纳的基因扰动预测框架，通过基因关系聚类、基因簇感知编码器和结构对齐目标显式建模基因程序间的协调性，利用条件流匹配实现灵活且泛化的扰动预测。在多个单细胞扰动基准上，scBIG 在未见和组合扰动设置中平均提升 6.7%。
Motivation: 现有方法大多采用基因独立建模范式，依赖静态生物学先验，无法捕捉动态的基因程序重组，从而忽略了扰动响应中基因程序间的协调性。
Method: scBIG 由三部分组成：基因关系聚类（Gene-Relation Clustering）从数据中诱导连贯的基因程序；基因簇感知编码器（Gene-Cluster-Aware Encoder）捕获程序间交互；结构对齐目标保留模块协调性。最后用条件流匹配建模结构化表示，实现扰动预测。
Result: 在多个单细胞扰动基准上，scBIG 一致优于现有方法，尤其在未见和组合扰动设置中平均提升 6.7%。
Conclusion: 显式建模基因程序协调性可显著提升扰动预测的泛化能力，scBIG 为功能基因组学提供了有效工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoCoEmo: Composable and Controllable Human-Like Emotional TTS via Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Emotional expression in human speech is nuanced and compositional, often involving multiple, sometimes conflicting, affective cues that may diverge from linguistic content. In contrast, most expressive text-to-speech systems enforce a single utterance-level emotion, collapsing affective diversity and suppressing mixed or text-emotion-misaligned expression. While activation steering via latent direction vectors offers a promising solution, it remains unclear whether emotion representations are linearly steerable in TTS, where steering should be applied within hybrid TTS architectures, and how such complex emotion behaviors should be evaluated. This paper presents the first systematic analysis of activation steering for emotional control in hybrid TTS models, introducing a quantitative, controllable steering framework, and multi-rater evaluation protocols that enable composable mixed-emotion synthesis and reliable text-emotion mismatch synthesis. Our results demonstrate, for the first time, that emotional prosody and expressive variability are primarily synthesized by the TTS language module instead of the flow-matching module, and also provide a lightweight steering approach for generating natural, human-like emotional speech.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统分析了混合TTS模型中激活调控（activation steering）用于情感控制的方法，提出可组合混合情感合成和文本-情感不匹配合成的定量可控框架及多评价者评估协议。结果表明情感韵律和表达变异性主要由TTS语言模块而非流匹配模块合成，并提供轻量级调控方法生成自然类人情感语音。
Motivation: 现有表达性TTS系统通常强制单一话语级情感，抑制了情感多样性和混合或文本-情感不匹配的表达。激活调控通过潜在方向向量提供解决方案，但情感表征在TTS中是否线性可控、如何在混合架构中应用以及如何评估复杂情感行为尚不清楚。
Method: 提出激活调控框架，在混合TTS模型（语言模块+流匹配模块）中对潜在表示进行方向操控，并设计多评价者评估协议以支持可组合混合情感合成和文本-情感不匹配合成。
Result: 首次证明情感韵律和表达变异性主要由TTS语言模块而非流匹配模块合成；所提轻量级调控方法能生成自然类人情感语音。
Conclusion: 激活调控在混合TTS模型中可实现可控、可组合的情感表达，但情感合成的主导模块是语言部分，为轻量级情感控制提供了新途径。

papers.title: Learning-Infused Formal Reasoning: From Contract Synthesis to Artifact Reuse and Formal Semantics
papers.abstract_en: This paper articulates a long-term research vision for formal methods at the intersection with artificial intelligence, outlining multiple conceptual and technical dimensions and reporting on our ongoing work toward realising this vision. It advances a forward-looking perspective on the next generation of formal methods based on the integration of automated contract synthesis, semantic artifact reuse, and refinement-based theory. We argue that future verification systems must builds towards individual correctness proofs toward a cumulative, knowledge-driven paradigm in which specifications, contracts, and proofs are continuously synthesised and transferred across systems. To support this shift, we outline a hybrid framework combining large language models with graph-based representations to enable scalable semantic matching and principled reuse of verification artifacts. Learning-based components provide semantic guidance across heterogeneous notations and abstraction levels, while symbolic matching ensures formal soundness. Grounded in compositional reasoning, this vision points toward verification ecosystems that evolve systematically, leveraging past verification efforts to accelerate future assurance.
papers.comment: LNCS Proceedings Submitted Version. 17 pages. Accepted and presented at VERIFAI-2026: The Interplay between Artificial Intelligence and Software Verification LASER center, Villebrumier, France, March 8-11, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个将人工智能与形式化方法结合的长期研究愿景，重点包括自动合约合成、语义工件复用和基于精化的理论，并报告了正在进行的实现工作。文章概述了一个混合框架，结合大语言模型与图表示，以实现验证工件的可扩展语义匹配和原则性复用，旨在推动验证系统从个体正确性证明转向知识驱动的累积范式。
Motivation: 当前验证系统缺乏知识积累和复用机制，导致每次验证从零开始。需要一种新范式，利用AI辅助形式化推理，实现规范和证明的持续合成与跨系统迁移。
Method: 提出一个混合框架，结合大语言模型提供语义指导，以及图表示和符号匹配来确保形式正确性，支持异构符号和抽象层级间的工件复用。
Result: 论文目前是愿景描述和进展报告，未提供具体实验结果。
Conclusion: 强调基于组合推理的验证生态系统能够系统性地演化，利用先前的验证工作加速未来的保障。

papers.title: Questioning the Coverage-Length Metric in Conformal Prediction: When Shorter Intervals Are Not Better
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction(CP) has become a cornerstone of distribution-free uncertainty quantification, conventionally evaluated by its coverage and interval length. This work critically examines the sufficiency of these standard metrics. We demonstrate that the interval length might be deceptively improved through a counter-intuitive approach termed Prejudicial Trick(PT), while the coverage remains valid. Specifically, for any given test sample, PT probabilistically returns an interval, which is either null or constructed using an adjusted confidence level, thereby preserving marginal coverage. While PT potentially yields a deceptively lower interval length, it introduces practical vulnerabilities: the same input can yield completely different prediction intervals across repeated runs of the algorithm. We formally derive the conditions under which PT achieves these misleading improvements and provide extensive empirical evidence across various regression and classification tasks. Furthermore, we introduce a new metric interval stability which helps detect whether a new CP method implicitly improves the length based on such PT-like techniques. Code is available at https://github.com/benben-cd/PT-Conformal-Prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批判性地审视了共形预测（conformal prediction）中常用的覆盖率和区间长度指标，并发现区间长度可能被人为操纵。作者提出了一种名为 Prejudicial Trick (PT) 的反直觉方法，该方法通过概率性地返回空区间或调整置信水平，在保持边际覆盖率不变的情况下，欺骗性地缩短区间长度。PT 导致预测区间在重复运行时极不稳定，因此本文引入新的指标“区间稳定性”（interval stability）来检测此类欺骗。实验在回归和分类任务上验证了 PT 的有效性。
Motivation: 共形预测的现有评估标准（覆盖率和区间长度）可能不足以反映实际性能，因为区间长度可以通过非稳健的方式（如 PT 方法）被不公平地缩短，从而掩盖模型的不稳定性。
Method: 提出 Prejudicial Trick (PT)：对于每个测试样本，以一定概率返回空区间，或以调整后的置信水平返回区间，从而在保持边际覆盖的前提下降低平均区间长度。同时，提出新指标“区间稳定性”来量化预测区间在不同运行中的一致性。
Result: 理论推导了 PT 实现误导性改进的条件，并在多种回归和分类任务上通过实验证实 PT 能显著降低区间长度，但导致预测区间高度不稳定（相同输入在不同运行中差异极大）。
Conclusion: 标准的覆盖率和区间长度指标不足以保证共形预测的可靠性，需要补充如区间稳定性等指标来识别潜在的数据操纵。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tacit Coordination of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent settings that require coordination without communication, from human-AI interaction to safety-critical scenarios. Humans often overcome the absence of communication through focal points: salient solutions that naturally stand out to all participants. We present the first large-scale evaluation of how, when, and why focal points emerge in LLMs, comparing their behaviour with humans across cooperative and competitive games, including realistic search and rescue scenarios, demonstrating when focal points enable effective coordination. Across more than 20 open- and closed-source models, we find that LLMs exhibit a remarkable ability to coordinate without communication, often matching or outperforming humans. However, the same models consistently fail in tasks requiring numerical common sense or culturally nuanced notions of salience. We additionally evaluate simple learning-free strategies that substantially improve coordination both among LLMs and between humans and LLMs. Our results reveal striking coordination capabilities, as well as social limitations in modern LLMs, and offer new insight into the latent notions of salience encoded within them. Our findings caution against assuming that LLMs share humans' cultural and perceptual substrate when deployed in coordination settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次大规模评估大语言模型（LLMs）在无需通信的协调场景中如何产生焦点（focal points），比较了LLMs与人类在合作与竞争游戏中的表现。发现LLMs在协调能力上常常与人类相当甚至超越人类，但在需要数值常识或文化微妙凸显的任务中持续失败。研究还提出了简单的无需学习的策略来提升协调效果，并揭示了LLMs中蕴含的潜在凸显概念。
Motivation: LLMs越来越多地部署在需要无声协调的多智能体场景中，如人机交互和安全关键场景，但缺乏对LLMs如何像人类一样通过焦点进行协调的系统理解。
Method: 通过20多个开源和闭源模型，在合作与竞争游戏（包括真实搜索救援场景）中评估LLMs的焦点生成能力，并与人类行为对比。
Result: LLMs展现出显著的无声协调能力，常与人类持平或更优；但在数值常识和文化凸显相关的任务中持续失败。
Conclusion: 研究表明LLMs具有惊人的协调能力但也存在社会认知局限，并警示在协调场景中不应假设LLMs共享人类的文化和感知基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: m2sv: A Scalable Benchmark for Map-to-Street-View Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision--language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on many multimodal benchmarks but remain brittle on spatial reasoning tasks that require aligning abstract overhead representations with egocentric views. We introduce m2sv, a scalable benchmark for map-to-street-view spatial reasoning that asks models to infer camera viewing direction by aligning a north-up overhead map with a Street View image captured at the same real-world intersection. We release m2sv-20k, a geographically diverse benchmark with controlled ambiguity, along with m2sv-sft-11k, a curated set of structured reasoning traces for supervised fine-tuning. Despite strong performance on existing multimodal benchmarks, the best evaluated VLM achieves only 65.2% accuracy on m2sv, below human annotators who reach 72.0% on average (and 95% for an expert) with strong inter-annotator agreement ($κ$ up to 0.76). While supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning yield consistent gains, cross-benchmark evaluations reveal limited transfer. Beyond aggregate accuracy, we systematically analyze difficulty in map-to-street-view reasoning using both structural signals and human effort, and conduct an extensive failure analysis of adapted open models. Our findings highlight persistent gaps in geometric alignment, evidence aggregation, and reasoning consistency, motivating future work on grounded spatial reasoning across viewpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 m2sv，一个可扩展的地图到街景空间推理基准，要求模型通过对齐俯视地图和街景图像推断相机方向。评估显示最佳 VLM 准确率 65.2%，低于人类平均 72.0%（专家 95%），微调虽带来提升但跨基准迁移有限，揭示了空间推理中的几何对齐和推理一致性差距。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 在多模态基准上表现强劲，但在对齐抽象俯视图与自我中心视图的空间推理任务上仍脆弱，缺乏专门基准来评估这一能力。
Method: 构建包含 2 万样本的地理多样化基准 m2sv-20k 和 1.1 万样本的结构化推理轨迹集 m2sv-sft-11k，评估多个 VLM 并进行监督微调和强化学习。
Result: 最佳 VLM（未微调）在 m2sv 上仅达 65.2% 准确率，人类平均 72.0%，专家 95.0%，且微调后准确率提升但其他基准间迁移有限。
Conclusion: 实验指出在几何对齐、证据聚合和推理一致性上存在持续差距，需未来研究推动 grounded 跨视角空间推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Co-PLNet: A Collaborative Point-Line Network for Prompt-Guided Wireframe Parsing
papers.abstract_en: Wireframe parsing aims to recover line segments and their junctions to form a structured geometric representation useful for downstream tasks such as Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). Existing methods predict lines and junctions separately and reconcile them post-hoc, causing mismatches and reduced robustness. We present Co-PLNet, a point-line collaborative framework that exchanges spatial cues between the two tasks, where early detections are converted into spatial prompts via a Point-Line Prompt Encoder (PLP-Encoder), which encodes geometric attributes into compact and spatially aligned maps. A Cross-Guidance Line Decoder (CGL-Decoder) then refines predictions with sparse attention conditioned on complementary prompts, enforcing point-line consistency and efficiency. Experiments on Wireframe and YorkUrban show consistent improvements in accuracy and robustness, together with favorable real-time efficiency, demonstrating our effectiveness for structured geometry perception. Our code is available at https://github.com/GalacticHogrider/Co-PLNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Co-PLNet，一种点线协作的线框解析框架，通过 Point-Line Prompt Encoder (PLP-Encoder) 将早期检测结果编码为空间提示，并利用 Cross-Guidance Line Decoder (CGL-Decoder) 进行稀疏注意力精化，实现点线一致性和高效推理。在 Wireframe 和 YorkUrban 数据集上，该方法在准确性和鲁棒性上均取得一致提升，并具有实时效率。
Motivation: 现有线框解析方法通常分别预测线段和交点，然后进行后处理对齐，导致不匹配和鲁棒性下降。
Method: 提出点线协作框架：PLP-Encoder 将几何属性编码为紧凑的空间对齐提示；CGL-Decoder 基于互补提示执行稀疏注意力，强制点线一致性并提升效率。
Result: 在 Wireframe 和 YorkUrban 数据集上，准确性和鲁棒性一致提升，并实现实时推理效率。
Conclusion: Co-PLNet 通过点线提示协作有效地改进了结构化几何感知任务，代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Noise-Driven Exploration and Transient Freezing Select Flat Minima in Stochastic Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is central to deep learning, yet the dynamical origin of its preference for flatter, more generalizable solutions remains unclear. Here, by analyzing SGD learning dynamics, we identify a nonequilibrium mechanism that governs solution selection during training. Numerical experiments reveal a transient exploratory phase in which SGD trajectories repeatedly escape sharp valleys and migrate toward flatter regions of the loss landscape before becoming confined to a final basin. Using a tractable physical model, we show that SGD noise reshapes the loss landscape into an effective potential that preferentially stabilizes flat solutions. We further uncover a transient freezing mechanism: as training progresses, the flattening landscape suppresses transitions between competing valleys. Stronger SGD noise delays this freezing transition, prolonging the exploratory phase and thereby increasing the probability of convergence to flatter minima. Together, these results provide a unified physical framework connecting learning dynamics, loss-landscape geometry, and generalization, and suggest guiding principles for the design of more effective optimization algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过分析随机梯度下降（SGD）的学习动力学，揭示了其偏好平坦、泛化性更好的解的非平衡机制。数值实验表明，训练过程中存在一个瞬态探索阶段，SGD轨迹反复逃离尖锐谷，迁移到损失景观中更平坦的区域，最终被限制在最终盆地。基于一个可处理的物理模型，证明SGD噪声将损失景观重塑为有效势，优先稳定平坦解。进一步发现瞬态冻结机制：随着训练进行，平坦化的景观抑制了竞争谷之间的转移；更强的SGD噪声延迟这种冻结过渡，延长探索阶段，从而增加收敛到平坦极小值的概率。
Motivation: 尽管SGD是深度学习核心，但其为何偏好更平坦、泛化性更好的解这一动力学起源尚不明确，现有研究缺乏统一的物理机制解释。
Method: 通过数值实验观察SGD训练中轨迹的瞬态探索行为，并构建一个可解析的物理模型，从有效势和瞬态冻结角度分析SGD噪声对解选择的影响。
Result: 发现SGD噪声将损失景观重塑为有效势，使平坦解更稳定；并揭示瞬态冻结机制：训练后期景观变平坦抑制了谷间跃迁，而噪声强度越大，冻结发生越晚，探索阶段越长，最终收敛到平坦极小值的概率越高。
Conclusion: 这些结果将学习动力学、损失景观几何与泛化能力统一在一个物理框架内，为设计更有效的优化算法提供了指导原则。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AlignDrive: Aligned Lateral-Longitudinal Planning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Practical autonomous driving requires models that generalize by reasoning through spatial-temporal possibilities to exclude unsafe outcomes. While state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods use parallel planning architectures, they fail to explicitly couple speed decisions with agent behavior along the driving path, leading to suboptimal coordination. To address this, we propose a cascaded framework that transforms longitudinal planning from an independent prediction task into a path-conditioned reasoning process. On the model side, we introduce an anchor-based regression design that conditions longitudinal prediction on the lateral drive path, and reformulate longitudinal planning as 1D displacement prediction along the path. This reduces geometric uncertainty and sharpens the model's focus on interaction-driven dynamics. On the data side, we introduce a planning-oriented data augmentation strategy that simulates rare safety-critical events by programmatically inserting agents and relabeling longitudinal targets to enforce collision avoidance. Evaluated on the challenging Bench2Drive benchmark, our method achieves SOTA performance with a driving score of 89.07 and a success rate of 73.18%, demonstrating significantly improved coordination and safety. Further evaluation on Fail2Drive confirms strong generalization to rare edge cases where parallel formulations typically fail. Project page:https://yanhaowu.github.io/AlignDrive/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对端到端自动驾驶中横向与纵向规划解耦导致的协调不足问题，提出级联框架AlignDrive。该方法将纵向规划转化为路径条件推理，采用基于锚点的回归设计，并引入规划导向的数据增强策略模拟安全关键场景。在Bench2Drive基准上取得驾驶得分89.07、成功率73.18%的SOTA性能，并在Fail2Drive上展示了良好的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有并行规划架构未能显式耦合速度决策与路径上的智能体行为，导致横向纵向协调次优。
Method: 提出级联框架，将纵向规划从独立预测任务转化为路径条件推理；引入基于锚点的回归设计，使纵向预测依赖于横向驾驶路径，并将纵向规划重新表述为沿路径的一维位移预测；同时提出规划导向的数据增强策略，通过程序化插入智能体并重新标注纵向目标来模拟稀有安全关键事件。
Result: 在Bench2Drive基准上取得驾驶得分89.07、成功率73.18%的SOTA性能；在Fail2Drive上验证了对稀有边缘案例的强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 所提方法通过路径条件推理和针对性数据增强，显著提升了自动驾驶规划的协调性和安全性。
Relevance: 0
