papers.title: FATE: Pillar Encoding and Frequency-Aware Training for Event-Based Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras are bio-inspired sensors that asynchronously capture logarithmic intensity changes, offering inherent advantages in high-speed and high-dynamic-range scenarios. However, the sparse and asynchronous nature of event streams poses a fundamental challenge for modern deep learning architectures. To enable compatibility with standard models, most existing approaches partition the accumulation window into fixed temporal sub-bins. While effective for spatial processing, this internal discretization discards fine-grained temporal structure and constrains inference to the low temporal frequencies imposed by training supervision. To address this limitation, we propose FATE, a unified framework built upon a novel Pillar Encoding (PE). While operating over discrete macro-accumulation windows dictated by the target frequency, PE avoids internal temporal sub-binning. It organizes events into spatial pillars and approximates their intra-window evolution via projection onto a continuous-time orthogonal polynomial basis. This formulation yields an L2-optimal representation that retains rich temporal dynamics in a dense pseudo-image, mitigating information loss under sparse event conditions. To fully leverage this representation, we introduce Frequency-Aware Training (FAT), a soft mean-teacher curriculum that generates temporally dense pseudo-labels, effectively bridging the mismatch between low-frequency supervision and high-frequency inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FATE generalizes across architectural paradigms and consistently outperforms strong baselines. It enables robust object detection at high temporal resolutions up to 200 Hz, while incurring minimal overhead in parameter count and inference latency
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FATE 框架，用于事件相机目标检测。FATE 包含新型 Pillar Encoding (PE)，通过连续时间正交多项式基近似事件流演化，避免内部分箱，保留细粒度时间信息；以及 Frequency-Aware Training (FAT)，利用软均值教师课程生成时间密集伪标签，缓解低频监督与高频推理的不匹配。实验表明 FATE 在高达 200 Hz 时间分辨率下实现鲁棒检测，参数和延迟开销小。
Motivation: 现有事件相机处理方法将累积窗口分成固定时间子箱，丢失了细粒度时间结构，且限制推理到训练监督的低时间频率。
Method: 提出 Pillar Encoding (PE)，将事件组织成空间柱子，通过连续时间正交多项式基投影近似窗内演变，得到密度伪图像表示；并提出 Frequency-Aware Training (FAT)，使用软均值教师课程生成时间密集伪标签，弥补低频监督与高频推理的差距。
Result: 在事件相机目标检测基准上，FATE 跨架构泛化且一致优于强基线，可在高达 200 Hz 时间分辨率下实现鲁棒检测，参数和推理延迟增量极小。
Conclusion: FATE 通过保留时间动力学和频率感知训练，有效提升了事件相机目标检测的时间分辨率和准确性，且算法开销低。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Decision-Driven Geosteering Under Uncertainty: A Unified Framework for Sequential Decision Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Geosteering requires navigating a well trajectory through an unknown geological configuration, while sequentially updating decisions based on indirect measurements acquired during drilling. This work presents an uncertainty-aware geosteering framework that tightly integrates particle filtering for probabilistic subsurface interpretation with value-based reinforcement learning for sequential decision-making. Geological uncertainty ahead of the drill bit is represented explicitly through a particle filter (PF), enabling belief-informed control rather than deterministic trajectory correction. The framework couples PF belief updates with belief-informed decision policies and evaluates three decision-making options that operate under identical uncertainty representations: an interpretable Approximate Dynamic Programming (ADP) scheme, a Deep Q-learning baseline, and a Dual Deep Reinforcement Learning (Dual DRL) architecture trained with a target Q-network scheme for stability, using a dueling (value/advantage) decomposition for Q-value parameterization. Beyond final placement performance, we assess policy behavior using stability-oriented metrics that quantify steering smoothness over time, providing additional operational insight into how decision policies respond as uncertainty evolves. The framework is integrated with an API for validation within an industrial geosteering simulator under realistic measurement noise and drilling constraints. Using identical geological realizations, operational limits, and reward definitions across methods, the experiments provide a controlled and high-fidelity evaluation of how alternative decision policies behave throughout the drilling process, rather than evaluating performance solely from the final well trajectory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个不确定性感知的地质导向框架，集成粒子滤波进行概率性地层解释，并采用基于价值的强化学习进行顺序决策。框架显式表示钻头前方的地质不确定性，通过粒子滤波更新信念，并结合信念感知的决策策略。评估了三种决策方案：可解释的近似动态规划、深度Q学习基线以及双深度强化学习架构，并使用稳定性指标衡量策略行为。框架与工业地质导向模拟器集成，在真实测量噪声和钻井约束下进行验证。
Motivation: 地质导向需要在未知地质构造中导航井轨迹，并根据钻井过程中获得的间接测量值顺序更新决策。现有方法通常依赖确定性轨迹校正，缺乏对地质不确定性的显式处理。
Method: 提出不确定性感知地质导向框架，包括：① 粒子滤波用于在线推断地层参数并更新信念状态；② 三种信念感知决策策略：可解释的近似动态规划、深度Q学习、双深度强化学习（采用目标Q网络和竞争分解）。
Result: 实验在工业级模拟器中，使用相同地质实现、操作限制和奖励定义，比较不同决策策略在整个钻井过程中的行为，不仅评估最终轨迹性能，还通过稳定性指标量化决策平滑度。
Conclusion: 该框架为地质导向中的顺序决策优化提供了一个统一且可比较的评估平台，强调信念感知决策的稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MemTrace: Probing What Final Accuracy Misses in Long-Term Memory
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly maintain long-term memory of user facts across sessions. Yet such memory is usually evaluated by aggregating accuracy over question rows or episodes. Because this approach scores question rows independently, even when several questions probe the same fact, it cannot show how that fact behaves as conditions change. We introduce MemTrace, a benchmark whose unit of measurement is the knowledge point: a single typed fact about the user, rather than an individual question. MemTrace probes each fact along three controlled dimensions: memory age, defined by how many sessions ago the fact appeared in the history; question type, covering current state, earlier state, and trajectory of change; and evidence condition, covering present, missing, and contradicted-by-false-premise settings. Evaluating 13 memory-system configurations across four paradigms, we find that similar pooled accuracy hides different failures: recovering a fact's current and earlier states does not imply tracking how it changed, and safe abstention does not imply correcting a false premise. The dominant bottleneck is evidence use, not retrieval: when systems fail, the evidence was retrievable 10 times more often than it was missing. These results suggest that improving long-term memory requires better use of reachable evidence, not simply more storage or retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MemTrace基准，以知识点（而非单个问题）为单位评估LLM代理的长期记忆。基准沿记忆年龄、问题类型和证据条件三个受控维度探测每个事实。对13种记忆系统配置的评估显示：相似的总准确率可能掩盖不同的失败模式，例如能够恢复事实的当前和早期状态并不代表能追踪其变化过程，安全拒答不代表能纠正错误前提。主要瓶颈在于证据使用而非检索：失败时，证据可检索到的次数是缺失次数的10倍以上。
Motivation: 现有长期记忆评估通过聚合问题行的准确率进行，但这种方式独立评分每个问题，无法揭示同一用户事实在不同条件下的行为变化。
Method: 构建MemTrace基准，以知识点为基本度量单元，沿三个维度（记忆年龄、问题类型、证据条件）系统探测每个事实。使用四种范式下的13种记忆系统配置进行实验。
Result: 相似的总准确率可能掩盖不同的失败模式；恢复事实的当前和早期状态不意味着能追踪其变化；安全拒答不代表能纠正错误前提。失败时，证据可检索到的次数是缺失次数的10倍以上。
Conclusion: 改善长期记忆的关键在于更好地利用可到达的证据，而非简单的存储或检索增强。

papers.title: ProCUA-SFT Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Training computer-use agents (CUAs) -- models that interact with graphical desktops through screenshots and keyboard/mouse actions -- requires large-scale, diverse trajectory data collected in full desktop environments. The largest public resource, AgentNet (22.5K human trajectories), leads to negative transfer when used for supervised fine-tuning (SFT): continuing training UI-TARS 7B on AgentNet causes OSWorld success rate to fall from 26.3% to 8-10%. We present ProCUA-SFT, a dataset of 3.1M step-level SFT samples distilled from 93K synthetic trajectories across 2,484 application combinations. The dataset is produced by a fully automated pipeline that (i) synthesizes grounded tasks on live desktops seeded with real-world content -- 912 spreadsheets from SpreadsheetBench, approximately 10K permissively-licensed presentations from Zenodo10K, and multi-application OSWorld configs -- and (ii) verifies each task's feasibility through binary precondition checking before rollout. A single VLM (Kimi-K2.5) serves as goal generator, precondition judge, and trajectory executor, eliminating planner-actor capability gaps. Each trajectory is expanded into step-prefix samples that exactly reproduce the context layout seen at inference time. Fine-tuning UI-TARS 7B on ProCUA-SFT for one epoch yields 45.0% on OSWorld -- an 18.7 percentage-point improvement over the base model and over 35% above AgentNet-trained counterparts. A subset of ProCUA was incorporated into the training data for the Nemotron 3 Nano Omni model, contributing to its computer-use capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对计算机使用代理（CUA）在大型桌面环境轨迹数据上的监督微调（SFT）导致负迁移的问题，提出了ProCUA-SFT数据集。该数据集包含从2,484种应用组合的93K合成轨迹中蒸馏出的310万步级SFT样本，通过自动化流水线生成，包括任务合成、前提条件检查以及单VLM（Kimi-K2.5）完成目标生成、前提判断和轨迹执行。微调UI-TARS 7B一个epoch后，在OSWorld上达到45.0%的成功率，比基线和AgentNet训练模型分别提升18.7和35个百分点以上。
Motivation: 现有最大公开数据集AgentNet（22.5K人类轨迹）用于SFT时导致负迁移，如UI-TARS 7B在OSWorld上的成功率从26.3%降至8-10%，因此需要更高质量、多样化的合成数据来改善CUA的微调效果。
Method: 提出全自动流水线：基于真实内容（如SpreadsheetBench的912个电子表格、Zenodo10K的约10K演示文稿、OSWorld多应用配置）在真实桌面上合成接地任务；通过二元前提条件检查验证任务可行性；使用单一VLM（Kimi-K2.5）作为目标生成器、前提判断器和轨迹执行器，消除规划-执行能力差距；将每条轨迹扩展为步骤前缀样本以精确复现推理时上下文布局。
Result: 使用ProCUA-SFT对UI-TARS 7B微调一个epoch后，在OSWorld上达到45.0%的成功率，比基线的26.3%提升18.7个百分点，比AgentNet训练模型（8-10%）提升超过35个百分点。部分数据还用于Nemotron 3 Nano Omni模型的训练，增强了其计算机使用能力。
Conclusion: 合成的高质量、多样化轨迹数据可以有效缓解CUA微调中的负迁移问题，显著提升模型在桌面环境任务上的性能。数据集的构建方法和流水线具有良好的扩展性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tight $L_\infty$ Sample Complexity for Low-Degree and Sparse Boolean Polynomials
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the optimization of bounded binary black-box functions, we study the problem of learning polynomial surrogates over the Boolean hypercube. To ensure that optimizing the surrogate yields good solutions for the underlying objective, we require uniform $L_\infty$-error guarantees rather than the usual $L_2$-type guarantees. We characterize the minimax sample complexity of uniform estimation under subgaussian noise for two classes of bounded polynomials. First, for polynomials of degree at most $d$ on $n$ variables, the sample complexity scales as $n^{d+1}$. Second, for $s$-sparse Fourier-Walsh polynomials with $s \leq n$, it scales as $ns^2$. These rates differ structurally from the noiseless setting, where uniform exact recovery scales as $n^d$ and $ns$, respectively. Our lower bounds hold even for arbitrary adaptive learners, showing that the additional factors are intrinsic to the noisy cases. Standard Fourier-analysis tools for the $L_2$-norm do not naturally extend to the $L_\infty$-setting in a way that yields uniform guarantees. Our proofs overcome this difficulty by relying on suitably chosen auxiliary norms that serve as proxies for controlling the $L_\infty$-error. Together, our results provide a tight characterization of the sample complexity of learning optimization-safe polynomial surrogates.

TL;DR: 本文针对有界布尔黑箱函数的优化问题，研究在布尔超立方体上学习多项式代理模型，要求均匀 $L_\infty$-误差保证而非通常的 $L_2$ 型保证。刻画了在次高斯噪声下两类有界多项式的极小极大样本复杂度：次数不超过 $d$ 的多项式样本复杂度为 $n^{d+1}$，$s$-稀疏傅里叶-沃尔什多项式样本复杂度为 $ns^2$，分别比无噪声情形多一个因子。下界对任意自适应学习器成立，表明额外因子是噪声情形固有的。
Motivation: 优化有界布尔黑箱函数时，需要代理模型在 $L_\infty$ 范数下均匀逼近真实函数，以确保优化代理能得到好的原问题解；而现有研究多关注 $L_2$ 型误差，缺乏 $L_\infty$ 误差下的样本复杂度刻画。
Method: 利用辅助范数作为控制 $L_\infty$ 误差的代理，结合极小极大分析，证明了下界与上界匹配，得到紧的样本复杂度界限。
Result: 低次多项式类样本复杂度为 $n^{d+1}$，稀疏傅里叶-沃尔什多项式类为 $ns^2$（在次高斯噪声下）。与无噪声情形（$n^d$ 和 $ns$）相比，各多出一个因子。
Conclusion: 本文给出了学习优化安全多项式代理的紧样本复杂度特征，揭示了噪声带来的额外代价。

papers.title: Transformer-Based Warm-Starting for Feasible and Optimal Terminal Approach to Tumbling Objects with Space Manipulators
papers.abstract_en: Real-time trajectory generation for on-orbit robotic servicing is challenging due to the nonlinear coupling between spacecraft bus motion, manipulator dynamics, visibility cone, and trajectory-level safety constraints. This paper studies learning-based warm-starting for sequential convex programming (SCP) in the terminal approach of a space manipulator toward a tumbling target. The proposed framework decomposes the problem into a system center-of-mass translational planning stage and a coupled attitude--manipulator torque-allocation stage, and applies a causal transformer warm-start to the latter, which constitutes the dominant computational bottleneck. Linear and flow matching action decoders are compared under different action-chunking and training dataset sizes, and the resulting warm-starts are evaluated under both cost-optimal and feasibility projection using SCP. Across 300 held-out scenarios, the learned warm-start reduces the second-stage SCP iteration count by up to 28% and the runtime by 23% while preserving the final control-cost distribution. When the learned warm-starts are used for nonconvex feasibility projection, they nearly halve the runtime relative to cost-optimal SCP, while avoiding the catastrophic high-cost tail behavior observed when initialized heuristically. These results indicate that sequence-model warm-starts can improve both the computational efficiency and trajectory robustness of optimization-based terminal guidance for space manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于因果Transformer的温启动（warm-start）方法，用于空间机械臂终端进近的实时轨迹生成。将问题分解为系统质心平移规划和姿态-机械臂扭矩分配两阶段，并在后一阶段应用Transformer温启动以减少顺序凸规划（SCP）迭代次数。在300个保留场景上，该方法将第二阶段SCP迭代次数减少28%，运行时间减少23%。
Motivation: 在轨服务中，航天器总线运动、机械臂动力学、可视锥和安全约束之间存在非线性耦合，实时轨迹生成具有挑战性，尤其是末端进近阶段的计算瓶颈。
Method: 将问题分解为系统质心平移规划阶段和耦合姿态-机械臂扭矩分配阶段，对后者使用因果Transformer进行温启动，比较了线性动作解码器和流匹配动作解码器，并在不同动作分块和训练数据集大小下评估。
Result: 在300个保留场景中，学习到的温启动将第二阶段SCP迭代次数减少28%，运行时间减少23%，同时保持最终控制成本分布。用于非凸可行性投影时，运行时间几乎减半，避免了启发式初始化时的高成本尾部行为。
Conclusion: 序列模型温启动可以改善空间机械臂优化制导的计算效率和轨迹鲁棒性。

papers.title: Quantifying Consistency in LLM Logical Reasoning via Structural Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can arrive at the same answer through reasoning paths that are unstable, contradictory, or difficult to rank consistently -- a failure mode especially prevalent in multi-step deductive reasoning. Existing methods assess reliability primarily through output dispersion -- measuring how much sampled answers differ -- but this discards a complementary signal: whether the model can consistently rank competing reasoning candidates. We propose structural uncertainty, a consistency-aware framework derived from the stability of self-preference-induced rankings over sampled reasoning solutions. Given a query, we generate multiple candidate solutions and ask the model to judge pairwise preferences among its own outputs. We aggregate self-preferences into ranking distributions via Bradley-Terry modeling with PageRank, and decompose the signal into two entropy-based components: across-trial ranking instability and within-trial candidate ambiguity. Across five LLMs and eight benchmarks, structural signals provide information complementary to answer dispersion: on logical and mathematical reasoning tasks, the combination improves identification of unreliable instances, while on factual retrieval the structural signal collapses toward uniformity, diagnosing a regime boundary where reasoning-level consistency evaluation is uninformative. The two components relate differently to accuracy: within-trial ambiguity correlates positively with correctness -- consistent with settings where multiple plausible solution paths remain competitive -- while across-trial instability correlates negatively, signaling unreliable reasoning. Structural uncertainty is best understood not as a universal confidence estimator, but as a regime-sensitive evaluator of logical reasoning consistency.
papers.comment: Published at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models. Accepted as best paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结构不确定性（structural uncertainty）框架，通过分析大语言模型（LLM）在逻辑推理中自我偏好排序的稳定性来衡量推理一致性。该方法利用Bradley-Terry模型和PageRank从模型自身输出的偏好判断中提取两种熵分量：跨试验排序不稳定性和试验内候选歧义性。在五个LLM和八个基准上，结构信号提供与答案分散度互补的信息，有助于识别不可靠推理实例，并揭示推理一致性评估的适用边界。
Motivation: 现有方法主要依赖输出分散度（答案差异）来评估LLM可靠性，忽略了模型能否一致地排序推理候选这一互补信号，尤其在多步演绎推理中，模型可能通过不稳定或矛盾的路径得出相同答案。
Method: 提出结构不确定性框架：为给定查询生成多个候选推理方案，让模型对自身输出的各方案进行成对偏好判断；通过Bradley-Terry模型和PageRank聚合自偏好为排序分布；再分解为跨试验排序不稳定性和试验内候选歧义性两种熵分量。
Result: 在五个LLM和八个基准上，结构信号与答案分散度互补：在逻辑和数学推理任务中，两者结合可提升不可靠实例的识别；在事实检索任务中，结构信号趋于均匀，表明推理一致性评估在该情境下无效。跨试验不稳定与正确率负相关，试验内歧义性与正确率正相关。
Conclusion: 结构不确定性不应被视为通用的置信度估计器，而是用于评估逻辑推理一致性的场景敏感工具。

papers.title: SierpinskiCam: Camera-Controlled Video Retaking with Sierpinski Triangle Pattern Cues
papers.abstract_en: Generating novel renderings of a scene along user-defined camera trajectories from a single monocular video, dubbed video retaking, is a compelling but difficult problem in content creation and visual effects. Existing geometry-guided approaches reconstruct a 4D representation from the source video and render it along the target trajectory to condition video diffusion models. However, this guidance degrades as the target camera departs from the source trajectory, leaving newly revealed regions sparse or entirely missing. We propose SierpinskiCam, which addresses this limitation by augmenting geometry-based guidance with Sierpinski dome texture cues that contains rich trackable features even under large viewpoint changes. We further introduce a reference video conditioning mechanism that appends source-video tokens to the target-token sequence and separates the two streams with negative RoPE indices, enabling appearance grounding without architectural modification or per-video adaptation. Extensive experiments show that SierpinskiCam achieves significant gains in camera controllability, geometric consistency, and video quality across diverse and challenging retaking scenarios. Project page: https://hyelinnam.github.io/SierpinskiCam/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出SierpinskiCam，通过将Sierpinski三角图案纹理提示与几何引导相结合，解决从单目视频沿用户定义相机轨迹生成新视图（视频重拍）时，目标轨迹偏离源轨迹导致新区域稀疏或缺失的问题。方法还包括参考视频条件机制，使用负RoPE索引分离源和目标令牌流，无需修改架构。实验表明在相机可控性、几何一致性和视频质量上取得显著提升。
Motivation: 现有基于几何的方法在目标相机偏离源轨迹时，新暴露区域的重建质量下降，因为几何引导变得稀疏或缺失。
Method: 提出几何引导结合Sierpinski穹顶纹理提示，该纹理包含在视角变化下仍可追踪的特征；并引入参考视频条件机制，将源视频令牌附加到目标令牌序列，并用负RoPE索引分离两流。
Result: 实验在多种具有挑战性的重拍场景下，在相机可控性、几何一致性和视频质量上取得显著增益。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该方法无需架构修改或逐视频适配，有效提升了相机控制下的视频重拍质量。

papers.title: Kernel-Based Functional Balancing for Causal Inference with Compositional Treatments
papers.abstract_en: We study causal effect estimation with compositional treatments, where the exposure lies on a simplex and the estimand is defined over compositions rather than scalar or binary values. By considering a projection of the average potential outcome onto the treatment space, a kernel-based covariate functional balancing approach is adopted for weight construction. The weights are obtained by directly minimizing a worst-case balancing error over a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) defined on the joint space of treatments and covariates, instead of being estimated under a treatment assignment model. Building on these weights, an augmented weighted estimator (AWE) is proposed, where the outcome function is estimated via kernel ridge regression and combined with a marginal augmentation over the covariate distribution. Despite the complex structure of the resulting objective, a finite-dimensional convex optimization problem is formulated via a representer theorem and a low-rank approximation. The proposed estimator achieves $\sqrt{n}$-consistency without requiring consistent estimation or smoothness of the weights. An asymptotic normality result is established around a sample-specific target. Empirical performance is demonstrated through simulation studies and a real data application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究组成治疗（compositional treatments）下的因果效应估计，其中暴露位于单纯形上，目标定义为成分而非标量或二元值。通过将平均潜在结果投影到治疗空间，采用基于核的协变量函数平衡方法构建权重，权重通过直接最小化治疗和协变量联合空间上再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）的最坏情况平衡误差获得，而非基于治疗分配模型。利用这些权重，提出增强加权估计量（AWE），通过核岭回归估计结果函数并结合协变量分布的边际增强。尽管目标函数结构复杂，通过表示定理和低秩近似得到有限维凸优化问题。所提议估计量达到√n一致性，无需权重的一致估计或光滑性，并建立了关于样本特定目标的渐近正态性。模拟研究和真实数据应用展示了实证性能。
Motivation: 现有因果推断方法多处理标量或二元治疗，而组成治疗（如饮食成分、污染物比例）的效应估计面临挑战，需要新的平衡方法以处理高维且受约束的治疗空间。
Method: 提出基于核的协变量函数平衡方法，在治疗和协变量的联合空间上定义RKHS，直接最小化最坏情况平衡误差得到权重。在此基础上，结合核岭回归估计结果函数和协变量边际分布增强，构建AWE估计量。通过表示定理和低秩近似将复杂优化转化为有限维凸问题。
Result: 理论证明估计量达到√n一致性，无需权重光滑性或一致估计，并建立了渐近正态性。模拟和真实数据应用验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法为组成治疗因果效应提供了有效的平衡估计框架，兼具理论保证和计算可行性。

papers.title: Turning music identification into a neural forward pass
papers.abstract_en: Search, a foundational operation in computer science, maps a query to a matching item in a collection. It is typically implemented as a System-2 like, rule-based pipeline in which a key is computed, an index is probed, and candidates are verified. By contrast, human recognition resembles a System-1 like, associative model of identity recovery, in which even partial cues can trigger a recall without explicitly enumerating, ranking, or even accessing discrete candidates. Here, we show that music sound identification, a difficult search problem, can be performed in a single neural feed-forward pass by a generative transformer. Trained on an audio dataset, the model predicts the corresponding track identifier from a short audio excerpt. This approach surpasses state-of-the-art acoustic fingerprinting, with the largest gains for short audio segments (1 second), demonstrating the method is not only viable but advantageous. Moreover, it reduces external storage to 0.33% of the baseline footprint and improves inference latency by 2.3x (p95). Furthermore, the model can reject queries for unseen tracks, supporting open-set operation while reducing misattribution risk. Using music track identification as an example, this work reframes search, bringing it closer in spirit to human associative recognition and away from algorithmic database lookup.

papers.title: Reasoning Text-to-Video Retrieval for Operating Room Clips via Action-Driven Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-video retrieval in operating rooms (OR) is an enabling technology for OR safety, as it allows stakeholders to retrieve and inspect recordings of specific events. However, because the most safety-critical events may not follow the common structure, to unlock its full potential text-to-video retrieval must be able to handle implicit queries that require reasoning to identify the right video (e.g., the step right before clipping). However, existing methods rely on global embeddings that cannot reason over such queries. We propose OR3, a text-to-video retrieval method that converts clips into action-driven digital twins (ActDTs), grouping concurrent subject-action-object triplets under non-overlapping temporal intervals. Moreover, rather than cross-modal matching through paired encoders, OR3 performs imagination-based retrieval where an LLM generates hypothetical ActDTs from queries. This enables intra-modal matching via a single encoder trained with ActDT-tailored hard negatives. Finally, evidence-grounded refinement revises imagined ActDTs based on discrepancies with top candidates to capture procedure-specific patterns. We construct a benchmark from MM-OR with 276 implicit queries across four reasoning categories over 386 clips from robotic knee procedures. OR3 achieves 57.6 R@1 and 77.3 R@5, outperforming the strongest baseline. These results demonstrate that OR3 enables fine-grained discrimination between visually similar OR video clips through temporal action reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OR3，一种用于手术室视频的文本到视频检索方法，通过动作驱动的数字孪生（ActDTs）和基于想象力的检索，处理需要推理的隐式查询。在MM-OR基准上，OR3在276个隐式查询上达到57.6 R@1和77.3 R@5，优于最强基线。
Motivation: 现有文本到视频检索方法依赖全局嵌入，无法处理需要推理的隐式查询（如“切割前一步”），而手术室安全关键事件可能不遵循常见结构。
Method: OR3将视频片段转换为动作驱动的数字孪生（ActDTs），按时间间隔分组并发的主语-动作-宾语三元组。通过LLM从查询生成假设的ActDTs，实现模态内匹配，并使用针对ActDT的硬负样本训练单一编码器。最后，基于证据的细化根据与顶级候选的差异修正假设的ActDTs。
Result: 在MM-OR基准上，对386个机器人膝关节手术视频片段的276个隐式查询，OR3达到57.6 R@1和77.3 R@5，优于最强基线。
Conclusion: OR3通过时间动作推理实现了视觉相似手术室视频片段之间的细粒度区分。

papers.title: Pareto LoRA: Mitigating Modality Imbalance in Unified Multimodal Models via Pareto-Optimal Gradient Integration
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for integrating multimodal understanding and generation within a single autoregressive transformer. However, during multimodal instruction tuning, these models often exhibit pronounced modality imbalance: language gradients dominate optimization, thus leading to lower image generation quality, especially under parameter-efficient fine-tuning such as LoRA. In this work, we systematically analyze modality imbalance in LoRA-based fine-tuning of UMMs for interleaved text-image generation. We show that vision modality performance degrades substantially more than text modality performance when compared to unimodal counterparts, and that modality-specific gradients can differ by orders of magnitude across various tasks and layers. Motivated by this observation, we reformulate the multimodal instruction tuning as a bi-objective optimization problem and propose Pareto LoRA, a Pareto-optimal gradient integration strategy that balances the text and image objectives by modulating the gradient direction and strength. Experiments on the CoMM benchmark with Emu2 demonstrate that Pareto LoRA consistently improves multimodal generation balance, achieving up to 44.9% gains in perceptual image quality over vanilla LoRA while maintaining comparable text performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对统一多模态模型（UMM）在LoRA微调中出现的模态不平衡问题，提出Pareto LoRA方法，通过帕累托最优梯度整合策略平衡文本和图像目标。实验表明，在CoMM基准上使用Emu2，该方法将图像感知质量提升最高44.9%，同时保持文本性能不变。
Motivation: 统一多模态模型在多模态指令微调中，语言梯度主导优化导致图像生成质量严重下降，特别是使用LoRA等参数高效微调时，视觉模态性能比单模态模型退化更显著。
Method: 将多模态指令微调重新表述为双目标优化问题，提出Pareto LoRA，一种通过调节梯度方向和强度实现帕累托最优梯度整合的策略，以平衡文本和图像目标。
Result: 在CoMM基准上使用Emu2，Pareto LoRA在图像感知质量上取得最高44.9%的提升，同时文本性能与原始LoRA相当。
Conclusion: 作者指出，通过帕累托最优梯度整合有效缓解了模态不平衡，为多模态模型微调提供了新的平衡方案。

papers.title: Phenotyping TPF via Self-Supervised Learning: A Label-Agnostic Framework with Expert Validation
papers.abstract_en: The full potential of artificial intelligence in tibial plateau fracture characterisation remains unrealised, constrained by a fundamental dependency on labelled datasets whose consistency cannot be guaranteed: conventional classification schemes such as Schatzker and AO/OTA suffer from inter-observer variability, causing supervised models to learn human disagreement rather than stable fracture morphology. We design, implement, and validate a label-agnostic framework that eliminates this constraint by learning fracture representations directly from imaging data without observer-assigned labels. A RadImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 encoder is fine-tuned on 154 cleaned knee radiographs using the SimCLR contrastive objective, preceded by a data cleaning protocol and followed by UMAP dimensionality reduction and k-means clustering to discover four imaging-derived phenotypes. Phenotype validity is assessed through a blinded expert review protocol administered to two independent clinicians. The four phenotypes demonstrate robust stability (bootstrap ARI = 0.319 +/- 0.041), strong internal cohesion (silhouette = 0.511), and coherence ratings of 3-5/5 from both reviewers under blinded conditions; one phenotype was unanimously identified as exhibiting comminution -- a high-complexity feature isolated without any supervisory signal. Inter-partition comparison against Schatzker labels yields ARI = 0.013, confirming orthogonality to conventional classification boundaries. Notably, expert reviewers anchored to established classification vocabularies perceived imaging-derived groups as heterogeneous precisely where Schatzker alignment was lowest, suggesting that Schatzker-trained perception and label-agnostic embedding geometry measure orthogonal dimensions. These findings establish label-agnostic SSL phenotyping as a reproducible and clinically interpretable complement to conventional classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种标签无关的自监督学习框架，用于胫骨平台骨折的表型分析。方法基于SimCLR对比学习在154张膝关节X光片上微调ResNet-50，结合UMAP降维和k-means聚类得到四个影像学表型，并通过双盲专家评审验证。结果表明表型稳定且与常规Schatzker分类正交，其中一个表型被一致识别为粉碎性骨折。
Motivation: 传统胫骨平台骨折分类方案（如Schatzker、AO/OTA）存在观察者间变异性，导致监督学习模型学习到人类分歧而非稳定骨折形态。
Method: 采用RadImageNet预训练的ResNet-50编码器，在154张清洁膝关节X光片上使用SimCLR对比目标进行微调，随后进行UMAP降维和k-means聚类得到四个影像学表型。
Result: 四个表型具有稳健稳定性（bootstrap ARI=0.319±0.041）、强内聚性（silhouette=0.511），双盲专家评审一致性评分3-5/5，与Schatzker标签的ARI为0.013，表明两者正交。
Conclusion: 标签无关的自监督学习表型可作为常规分类的可重复且临床可解释的补充。

papers.title: VISTA: Scale-Aware Visual Navigation via Action History Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Vision Navigation Foundation Models (VNMs) promise end-to-end learned navigation policies capable of zero-shot deployment across diverse embodiments and environments. To maintain generality, many vision-based navigation models predict normalized actions. However, this normalization introduces a critical deployment vulnerability: applying different scaling factors to the same normalized trajectory alters its physical geometry, which degrades navigation performance and increases collision risks. We address this vulnerability by conditioning the model on normalized action histories alongside image observations, providing explicit context on the relationship between the model's predictions and the robot's actual physical displacement. Furthermore, current VNMs often struggle in visually repetitive environments that lack distinct features. To resolve this issue, we integrate a DINOv3 encoder, whose richer representations enable our model to capture both spatial and geometric dimensions between observations. VISTA generalizes robustly to out-of-distribution environments, achieving 100% goal prediction accuracy in zero-shot, real-world deployment in Outdoor, Forest and Office settings, and an average of 95% checkpoints crossed, demonstrating consistent path following in unseen environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VISTA，一种尺度感知的视觉导航模型，通过条件化动作历史解决归一化动作在不同缩放因子下导致的几何畸变问题。引入 DINOv3 编码器增强对视觉重复环境的特征提取。实验表明，VISTA 在户外、森林和办公室等未见环境中零样本部署达到 100% 目标预测准确率，平均 95% 检查点穿越。
Motivation: 现有视觉导航基础模型预测归一化动作，但不同缩放因子会改变物理几何，导致性能下降和碰撞风险增加；同时在视觉重复环境中缺乏区分性特征。
Method: 将模型条件化于归一化动作历史与图像观测，并集成 DINOv3 编码器以捕获观测间的空间和几何维度。
Result: 在零样本真实世界部署中，VISTA 在户外、森林和办公室场景达到 100% 目标预测准确率，平均 95% 检查点穿越，验证了分布外泛化能力。
Conclusion: VISTA 通过动作历史条件化和 DINOv3 编码器有效提升了视觉导航的尺度鲁棒性和环境泛化性，实现了可靠的零样本路径跟踪。

papers.title: Nothing from Something: Can a Language Model Discover 0?
papers.abstract_en: AI systems based on artificial neural networks are being developed with aspirations of pushing the boundary of human mathematical knowledge. A key question for these systems is how much they can reach beyond their training data. Mathematical discovery requires a strong form of out of distribution generalization; the ability to hypothesize genuinely new - and potentially logically more powerful - mathematical structures. It has been hypothesized that language abilities support such generalizations in human cognition. In this work, we use simple arithmetic as a case study for examining how modern AI models could expand their mathematical horizons, evaluating whether these models can independently discover the concept of "zero". We show that We show that (1) language models of a GPT-2 size are unable to perform this generalization at test time regardless of language pretraining, but (2) models can improve substantially after training on tens or hundreds of examples of zero. Additionally, we find that language pretraining reduces the number of required examples by approximately $50\%$, showing that language abilities can scaffold mathematical discovery in neural models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型能否独立发现数字'0'的概念，以简单算术为案例。实验表明，GPT-2大小的模型在测试时无法泛化出新概念，但经过少量（数十或数百个）零示例训练后，模型表现显著提升，且语言预训练可将所需示例数量减少约50%。
Motivation: 探索AI系统能否超越训练数据进行数学发现，特别是需要强分布外泛化能力的场景。以算术中'零'的概念作为案例，检验现代语言模型是否具备独立发现新数学结构的能力。
Method: 使用简单算术任务，比较有无语言预训练的GPT-2大小模型在测试时对'零'概念的泛化能力，并评估不同训练样本量（数十到数百个零示例）的影响。
Result: GPT-2大小模型在测试时无法泛化出零概念；经过数十或数百个零示例训练后，模型能显著改善；语言预训练减少约50%的所需示例数。
Conclusion: 语言能力可以辅助神经网络模型进行数学发现，但模型需要一定的训练样本才能超越训练数据。

papers.title: From Democracies to Autocracies: How AI Systems Enable Authoritarianism by Design
papers.abstract_en: AI-enabled authoritarianism is not confined to autocracies. In this paper, we provide greater transparency by investigating and mapping the lifecycles of six AI systems deployed in different political regimes, ranging from the US to China. By drawing on an extensive range of sources (academic publications, investigative research reports, third-party evaluations, media interviews, government procurement notices), we conduct a systematic, qualitative comparison across systems to identify the critical technical and operational features that enable authoritarianism within their respective political contexts. We find that enabling features include the centralization and co-optation of administrative data for law enforcement and political punishment, regulatory gaps that fail to deter misuse, weak user compliance that nullifies human oversight mechanisms, and the encoding of protected group traits that identify members of vulnerable populations. We find that these features are present across systems deployed in autocratic and democratic regimes, albeit in varying configurations. We also find that both centralized and fragmented AI systems can contribute to authoritarianism by exploiting governance gaps: centralized systems directed by executive authorities, particularly within security and military institutions, are often not subjected to formal oversight mechanisms, while fragmented systems diffuse accountability between stakeholders, paving the way for entrenchment. These findings reveal that AI-enabled authoritarianism is distributed, resulting from design and operational choices made by developers, administrators, and users alike. We conclude with recommendations for developers and policymakers to mitigate these risks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过系统比较美国到中国六个AI系统的生命周期，揭示威权主义特征如何在不同政治体制的AI系统中出现，包括数据集中化用于执法与政治惩罚、监管漏洞、用户合规性弱、保护群体编码等。
Motivation: 现有研究多关注AI在民主体制下的风险，但AI助长威权主义的现象不仅限于专制国家，需要跨体制的系统性分析。
Method: 采用定性比较方法，基于学术出版物、调查报告、第三方评估、媒体访谈和政府采购公告等多元来源，分析六个AI系统的技术及运营特征。
Result: 发现威权主义特征在专制与民主体制的系统中均有出现，但配置不同；集中式和碎片化系统均可能通过利用治理漏洞助长威权。
Conclusion: AI助长的威权主义是分布式的，源于开发者、管理者和用户的决策，并给出开发者与政策制定者的缓解建议。

papers.title: ARVO: Atlas of Reproducible Vulnerabilities for Open-Source Software
papers.abstract_en: Achieving reproducibility, quantity, and diversity in vulnerability datasets has long been viewed as an inherent three-way trade-off, where improving one dimension often comes at the cost of the others. In practice, reproducibility has been the dimension most often neglected. This has limited what can be automatically extracted from historical bug datasets, and has reduced their utility for downstream security research. In this work, we propose a method to produce a new security dataset which ensures reproducibility for diverse vulnerabilities at scale by identifying the key obstacles to large-scale bug reproduction and addressing them with general solutions. Using this method, we introduce full reproducibility to the largest open source software vulnerability dataset (OSS-Fuzz) and construct the ARVO dataset (an Atlas of Reproducible Vulnerabilities in Open-source software). ARVO is a large-scale dataset consisting of over 6,100 real-world vulnerabilities across 311 projects. Focusing on reproducibility, ARVO differs from existing datasets by providing each vulnerability in a form that can be consistently rebuilt, triggered, and analyzed across versions. Reproducibility also enables automatic identification of the corresponding patch for each vulnerability and supports direct interaction with vulnerabilities after code changes, capabilities that existing large-scale datasets do not provide. In our evaluation, ARVO successfully reproduces 81% of vulnerabilities and achieves 89.4% accuracy on the located patches. We also discuss ARVO's influence on both upstream practices and downstream security research.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种方法，在保证可复现性的前提下，大规模构建多样化漏洞数据集，克服了传统三个维度（可复现性、数量、多样性）的权衡。通过识别大规模漏洞复现的关键障碍并给出通用解决方案，将最大的开源软件漏洞数据集OSS-Fuzz实现完全可复现，构建了ARVO数据集，包含来自311个项目的6100多个真实漏洞。ARVO提供可一致重建、触发和分析的漏洞形式，并自动识别对应补丁，准确率89.4%，成功复现81%的漏洞。
Motivation: 现有的漏洞数据集在可复现性、数量和多样性之间存在权衡，而可复现性往往被忽视，限制了历史漏洞数据集的自动化提取和下游安全研究的效用。
Method: 通过识别大规模漏洞复现的关键障碍并提出通用解决方案，将OSS-Fuzz数据集转为完全可复现形式，构建ARVO数据集。
Result: ARVO包含超过6100个真实漏洞（311个项目），成功复现81%的漏洞，在定位补丁上达到89.4%的准确率。
Conclusion: ARVO的可复现性使其能够支持跨版本的重建、触发和分析，自动识别补丁，对上游实践和下游安全研究均有影响。

papers.title: Training LLMs with Reinforcement Learning over Digital Twin Representations for Reasoning-Intensive Surgical VideoQA
papers.abstract_en: Surgical video question answering requires multi-step reasoning across semantic, spatial, and temporal dimensions. Existing methods architecturally compress videos into discrete token representations and couple visual perception with reasoning. This approach fragments continuous spatial-temporal relationships and has been shown to restrict multi-step reasoning capabilities. We introduce a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that trains large language models (LLMs) to decouple perception from reasoning by operating over digital twin representations constructed from surgical foundation models. Additionally, we introduce hierarchical representations across frame, temporal window, and procedure levels with probabilistic uncertainty estimates. Finally, we propose a novel reward that combines format validation with accuracy assessment through clinical plausibility evaluation and uncertainty-aware calibration for training. To demonstrate the capabilities of this approach, we introduce REAL-Colon-Reason, a colonoscopic benchmark with 2000 question-answer pairs across three complexity levels. We achieve state-of-the-art performance on REAL-Colon-Reason and two existing surgical VideoQA benchmarks REAL-Colon-VQA and EndoVis18-VQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对手术视频问答中的多步推理挑战，提出一种基于强化学习（RL）的框架，训练大语言模型（LLM）在由手术基础模型构建的数字孪生表示上进行推理，从而将感知与推理解耦。该方法引入跨帧、时间窗口和手术流程层级的分层表示，并结合概率不确定性估计。作者还提出一种结合格式验证和临床合理性评估的新型奖励函数。在自建基准REAL-Colon-Reason以及两个现有基准REAL-Colon-VQA和EndoVis18-VQA上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有方法将手术视频压缩为离散词元表示，割裂了连续时空关系，限制了多步推理能力。需要一种解耦感知与推理的方法。
Method: 使用强化学习训练LLM在数字孪生表示上推理，数字孪生由手术基础模型构建。引入分层表示（帧、时间窗口、手术流程）和概率不确定性估计。设计结合格式验证、临床合理性评估和不确定性校准的奖励函数。
Result: 在REAL-Colon-Reason（2000个问答对，三个复杂度级别）和两个现有基准REAL-Colon-VQA、EndoVis18-VQA上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确强调局限性，但方法在手术视频问答任务上有效，展示了强化学习结合数字孪生表示提升多步推理能力的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Memorization Behavior of LLMs in Generative Recommendation: Observations, Implications, and Training Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommendation (GR) has emerged as a promising direction for recommender systems. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly adopted for GR, as their rich pretrained knowledge is expected to help them generalize beyond common user behavior patterns that traditional memorization-oriented baselines can capture. However, existing LLM-based GR works largely ignore LLMs' well-known tendency to memorize, which, if present in LLMs fine-tuned for GR, would restrict their utilization of pretrained knowledge. In this work, we investigate this concern by examining one-hop memorization, where a model recommends items that are direct successors of items in the training data. We show that LLMs do this more than non-LLM-based GR models-in fact, the vast majority of their gains over GR baselines are actually on users whose target items can be predicted through one-hop memorization. We intuit that improving performance on the remaining users requires LLMs to learn richer item-item relations beyond one-hop transitions. To achieve this, we propose IIRG, a novel training strategy that teaches LLMs to capture: (1) collaborative relations derived from item co-occurrences across multiple hops in user sequences, and (2) semantic relations among items with similar themes, both of which can serve as useful recommendation signals. We show that IIRG significantly improves over LLMs trained solely with standard next-item prediction, with especially large gains for users whose test items are not covered by train-time one-hop transitions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）在生成式推荐（GR）中的记忆行为，发现LLM比非LLM模型更倾向于单跳记忆（one-hop memorization），即推荐训练数据中直接后继项目。多数性能提升来自可被单跳记忆预测的用户。为此提出IIRG训练策略，教导LLM捕获多跳合作关系和语义关系，显著提升非单跳记忆用户的推荐效果。
Motivation: 现有LLM-based GR忽视LLM的记忆倾向，可能限制其利用预训练知识进行泛化。论文验证了单跳记忆现象，并指出提升剩余用户性能需要更丰富的项目关系。
Method: 提出IIRG训练策略，通过两类关系学习：1）用户序列中多跳项目共现的协作关系；2）相似主题项目间的语义关系，作为推荐信号。
Result: 摘要显示IIRG相比标准下一个项目预测训练显著提升，尤其在测试项目未被训练时单跳记忆覆盖的用户上。
Conclusion: LLM在GR中的记忆行为需关注，IIRG通过增强项目关系学习可缓解记忆依赖并提升泛化。

papers.title: Skill-Constrained Model Predictive Control for Resilient Manufacturing Supply Chains
papers.abstract_en: In skill-constrained production-inventory systems, the qualified human capacity available tomorrow depends on training decisions made today: production requires certified workers, certifications decay unless maintained, and training consumes the same scarce worker hours that production needs now. We study a closed-loop skill-constrained model predictive controller that, at every shift, solves a finite-horizon mixed-integer program over production, inventory, backlog, and training, with binary predicted certification, hard production eligibility, and an interpretable terminal value that prices certified-capacity gaps at the horizon boundary; only the first-period action is applied before replanning. On synthetic, seed-controlled SkillChain-Gym scenarios - announced and surprise new-skill shocks, demand shocks, absenteeism, forecast- and availability-quality modes, capacity-boundary and training-rate sweeps, and negative controls - we evaluate the controller against production-only and maintenance-only ablations, static cross-training insurance plans, and a strong reactive heuristic, under an ex-ante locked configuration and paired statistics. The result is regime dependence, not superiority: no policy class dominates. Predictive control helps when skill or labor bottlenecks are forecastable early enough for training to complete; lean static insurance remains hard to beat under surprise shocks, near the demand-capacity boundary, and wherever pre-shock slack makes insurance cheap. Attribution ablations separate certification maintenance, re-acquisition of lapsed certifications, and greenfield skill acquisition. Forecastability, not adaptivity per se, decides when predictive control pays.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究技能受限的制造供应链中的模型预测控制，通过求解有限时域混合整数规划来联合优化生产、库存、缺货和培训决策。在合成场景中，预测控制并不总是优于其他策略，其有效性取决于瓶颈的可预测性而非适应性本身。
Motivation: 在技能受限的生产库存系统中，工人培训决策与当前生产争夺稀缺工时，且认证会过期，需要优化联合决策以提高供应链韧性。
Method: 提出一种闭环模型预测控制，每个班次求解一个有限时域混合整数规划，包含生产、库存、缺货和培训，并采用可解释的终端价值函数来定价认证能力缺口。
Result: 在合成场景中，没有策略类别占优；预测控制仅在技能或劳动力瓶颈可提前预测且培训能在截止前完成时有效，而静态保险在意外冲击下表现稳健。
Conclusion: 可预测性而非适应性本身决定了预测控制的价值；论文强调无策略在各类场景中普遍最优。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bayesian Poisson-Randomized Gamma Tensor Factorization with Application to International Trade Flows
papers.abstract_en: We study sparse semi-continuous tensor data with excess zeros, heavy right tails, and slice-specific dispersion. Such features arise naturally in monetary-valued multi-way data, such as international trade, where most exporter--importer--product--year cells are zero while positive values are continuous and highly variable. To model these data, we propose a Bayesian hierarchical tensor factorization model that places a low-rank CP structure on a latent Poisson rate tensor and couples it with a conditional Gamma model for positive outcomes, with rate parameters that can vary across slices within a mode. The model therefore separates the occurrence and magnitude of positive observations while borrowing strength across all tensor dimensions through a shared low-rank latent structure. To scale posterior inference to large arrays, we develop a hybrid variational--Monte Carlo algorithm that combines efficient coordinate ascent updates with a partially collapsed augmented-data sampler. Applied to approximately 60 million trade flows, the method surfaces multiway dependence across exporters, importers, products, and years that is difficult to recover from gravity-type or pairwise network analyses, which do not jointly model the product and temporal dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏半连续张量数据（大量零值、重右尾、切片特定离散度）提出贝叶斯泊松-随机化伽马张量分解模型。模型在潜泊松率张量上施加低秩CP结构，并与条件伽马模型耦合，分离观测的发生与幅度。混合变分-蒙特卡洛算法可扩展至大规模数组，在约6000万国际贸易流上揭示了难以从引力模型或成对网络分析中恢复的多维依赖关系。
Motivation: 国际贸易流等多维货币数据具有稀疏、半连续、重尾和切片异质离散度等特征，现有引力模型或成对网络分析无法联合建模产品和时间维度，难以捕捉跨维度依赖。
Method: 提出贝叶斯层次张量分解：将低秩CP结构置于潜泊松率张量，各模式内切片可有不同离散参数；通过条件伽马模型区分零与非零观测；开发混合变分-蒙特卡洛算法实现后验推断。
Result: 在约6000万条贸易流数据上，该方法揭示了出口国、进口国、产品和年份之间的多维依赖关系，这些关系难以通过引力模型或成对网络分析恢复。
Conclusion: 模型有效建模稀疏半连续张量数据，未来可推广至其他货币计值的多路数据，但需注意计算成本和超参数选择。

summary_sections.motivation: 国际贸易流等多维货币数据具有稀疏、半连续、重尾和切片异质离散度等特征，现有引力模型或成对网络分析无法联合建模产品和时间维度，难以捕捉跨维度依赖。
summary_sections.method: 提出贝叶斯层次张量分解：将低秩CP结构置于潜泊松率张量，各模式内切片可有不同离散参数；通过条件伽马模型区分零与非零观测；开发混合变分-蒙特卡洛算法实现后验推断。
summary_sections.result: 在约6000万条贸易流数据上，该方法揭示了出口国、进口国、产品和年份之间的多维依赖关系，这些关系难以通过引力模型或成对网络分析恢复。
summary_sections.conclusion: 模型有效建模稀疏半连续张量数据，未来可推广至其他货币计值的多路数据，但需注意计算成本和超参数选择。

papers.title: SkillChain-Gym: A Benchmark for Reskilling-Aware Production-Inventory Control under Disruptions
papers.abstract_en: Production planning increasingly has to treat workforce capability as a decision variable: certifications lapse when skills are not maintained, new products require skills the current workforce does not hold, and reskilling competes for the same worker hours needed for production. Existing operations benchmarks usually treat labor as exogenous, while workforce-planning models with skills and learning are rarely released as reusable testbeds. We introduce SkillChain-Gym, a benchmark specification for reskilling-aware production-inventory control: a single-site environment with stylized worker skill-state dynamics, hard threshold certification, forgetting, and capacity-consuming training actions constrained by the same per-worker time budget as production. The benchmark includes seed-controlled disruption scenarios, three feasibility modes with projection diagnostics, deterministic replay, and metrics covering operations, resilience, capability growth, and training-access distribution. We evaluate production-only, reactive adaptive, water-filling adaptive, and static-insurance policies with budget variants over 60-shift horizons with paired statistical tests. The results are regime-dependent rather than a ranking. Training-capable policies dominate the production-only baseline, and maintenance training is necessary under forgetting even without disruptions. Among training-capable classes, adaptive training helps when bottlenecks are visible in the forecast, while a lean static cross-training plan, a deliberately favorable comparator whose structure encodes relevant skill contingencies, acts as strong insurance under surprise shocks and absenteeism. Capacity slack and the forgetting rate govern the boundary between these regimes. No policy class dominates across regimes, motivating forecast-driven controllers that decide when to buy skill insurance and when to react.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillChain-Gym，一个用于再技能培训意识的生产库存控制的基准测试环境。该环境包含工人技能状态动态、硬阈值认证、遗忘以及受时间约束的培训动作，并提供了中断场景、可行性模式等。实验评估了多种策略，发现不同策略在不同场景下各有优劣，没有单一策略能主导所有场景。
Motivation: 现有生产规划基准通常将劳动力视为外生变量，而考虑技能和学习的劳动力规划模型很少作为可复用的测试平台，因此需要这样一个基准来支持相关研究。
Method: 提出 SkillChain-Gym 基准，包括单站点环境、工人技能状态动态、硬阈值认证、遗忘、与生产共享时间预算的培训动作等，并提供了种子控制的中断场景、三种可行性模式、确定性重放以及涵盖运营、韧性、能力增长和培训访问分布的指标。
Result: 实验表明，有培训能力的策略优于纯生产基线，且在没有中断的情况下，遗忘机制下维护性培训是必要的。在培训能力策略中，适应性培训在瓶颈可见时有效，而静态交叉培训在意外冲击和缺勤下表现稳健。没有策略类能在所有场景下占优。
Conclusion: 该基准揭示了策略性能的依赖场景特性，激励开发基于预测的控制器来决定何时购买技能保险和何时反应。

papers.title: Accelerated Convex Optimization via Hamiltonian Dynamics with Deterministic Integration Time
papers.abstract_en: We develop Hamiltonian dynamics-based algorithms for smooth convex optimization that achieve accelerated rates of convergence. By exploiting contraction of averaged Hamiltonian flow trajectories rather than requiring contraction at trajectory endpoints, we show that Hamiltonian dynamics-based optimization methods admit deterministic and accelerated convergence guarantees, extending prior work that is limited to quadratic objectives or holds only in expectation. We analyze an idealized continuous-time algorithm and derive practical discrete-time implementations with optimal first-order complexity, thereby establishing Hamiltonian dynamics as a useful algorithmic primitive for deterministic accelerated convex optimization.
papers.comment: 51 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to the 39th Annual Conference on Learning Theory (COLT 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对光滑凸优化问题，提出基于哈密顿动力学（Hamiltonian dynamics）的算法，实现确定性的加速收敛。通过利用平均哈密顿流轨迹的收缩性而非终点收缩，证明了加速收敛保证，并推导出具有最优一阶复杂度（optimal first-order complexity）的离散实现，将哈密顿动力学确立为确定性加速凸优化的有效算法原语。
Motivation: 现有基于哈密顿动力学的优化方法仅限于二次目标或仅在期望意义上保证加速，缺乏确定性的加速收敛理论。
Method: 提出连续时间理想算法，利用平均哈密顿流轨迹的收缩性推导加速收敛，并给出实用离散时间实现，保持最优一阶复杂度。
Result: 摘要声明该方法在光滑凸优化上达到加速收敛率，且离散实现具有最优一阶复杂度。
Conclusion: 哈密顿动力学可作为确定性加速凸优化的通用算法原语，扩展了其适用性。

papers.title: Pulling The REINS: Training-Free Safety Alignment of Video Diffusion Models via Representation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight video diffusion models can generate photorealistic unsafe content, from violence to misinformation, yet existing defenses either require expensive safety fine-tuning that degrades general capability, or apply external filters that are trivially bypassed by adversarial prompts. We present REINS (REpresentation-space INference-time Safety steering), a training-free method that aligns video diffusion models at inference time by steering their internal representations toward safe generation. Our key finding is that safety-relevant structure is linearly encoded in the hidden-state activations of video diffusion transformers, and a single direction, discovered via Supervised PCA on binary safety labels, suffices to separate safe from unsafe generation trajectories. At inference, adding this direction to hidden states at an intermediate transformer layer redirects generation from harmful content to semantically related safe alternatives, with no weight updates, no concept enumeration, and negligible computational overhead. Through mechanistic analysis, we reveal that while safety information accumulates monotonically with transformer depth, steering effectiveness peaks at intermediate layers (~50% depth), exposing a fundamental tradeoff between information availability and downstream propagation capacity. We evaluate REINS across 9 video diffusion models, multiple parameter scales (1.3B-5B), and both text-to-video and image-to-video generation, to our knowledge, the broadest safety evaluation suite in the video generation literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REINS，一种无需训练的视频扩散模型安全对齐方法，通过在推理时干预内部表示（representation steering）来引导生成安全内容。核心发现是安全相关信息线性编码在隐藏层激活中，使用监督PCA可找到单一方向区分安全与不安全生成轨迹。该方法在9个视频扩散模型（1.3B-5B参数）上验证，包括文本到视频和图像到视频生成，是视频生成领域最广泛的安全评估套件。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型可生成暴力、虚假信息等不安全内容，但防御方法要么需要昂贵的微调且降低通用能力，要么使用易被对抗提示绕过外部过滤器。
Method: 提出REINS，在推理时对视频扩散Transformer的中间隐藏层添加一个由监督PCA从二元安全标签学到的方向向量，引导生成从有害内容转向语义相关的安全替代内容，无需权重更新、概念枚举或显著计算开销。
Result: 在9个视频扩散模型（1.3B-5B参数）上，包括文本到视频和图像到视频任务，REINS有效减少不安全生成，且机制分析显示安全信息随深度单调积累，但转向有效性在中间层（约50%深度）达到峰值，揭示了信息可用性与下游传播能力之间的基本权衡。
Conclusion: REINS提供了一种轻量级、无需训练的视频扩散模型安全对齐方案，适用于多种模型规模和生成模式，但安全性可能依赖于方向向量的泛化能力，且未讨论对抗性攻击的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Contrastive Action-Image Pre-training for Visuomotor Control
papers.abstract_en: Existing vision encoders for robotics face a fundamental bottleneck: robotic datasets lack the scale necessary for large-scale pre-training. Prior work circumvents this data scarcity by turning to internet-scale image and language data or egocentric human video. While these models show promise, neither paradigm learns from paired vision and action data, which downstream visuomotor control policies require. However, robot trajectories, the most direct source of this paired signal, are not available at pre-training scale, motivating us to extract action signals from abundant human video instead. To this end, we introduce CAIP (Contrastive Action-Image Pre-training), a vision encoder that treats human hand poses from large-scale egocentric video as a proxy for end-effector actions. By extracting 3D hand keypoints, a representation that aligns naturally with downstream robot action spaces, CAIP learns a unified action-image representation through a contrastive objective. Leveraging 32,041 hours of egocentric human video and only 88 hours of robotic manipulation data, CAIP outperforms state-of-the-art vision encoders including DINOv2, SigLIP, MVP, and R3M. Evaluated on a challenging real-world dexterous manipulation setup using Dexmate Vega and Sharpa Wave hands, CAIP yields performance gains of more than 30% on tasks involving folding, pouring, and fine-grained manipulation. Our results show that our method of contrastive action-centric pre-training yields a scalable path to achieving robust visual representations better suited for physical interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAIP，一种对比动作-图像预训练方法，利用大规模自我中心视频中的3D手部关键点作为机器人末端执行器动作的代理，通过对比学习学习统一的动作-图像表示。在仅使用88小时机器人数据的情况下，结合32041小时人类视频预训练，CAIP在真实世界灵巧操作任务（如折叠、倾倒、精细操作）上相比DINOv2、SigLIP、MVP和R3M等现有视觉编码器实现了超过30%的性能提升。结果表明，这种对比动作中心预训练为机器人视觉表示提供了一条可扩展的途径。
Motivation: 机器人数据集缺乏大规模预训练所需的规模，而现有工作使用的互联网图像或人类视频并未学习与下游操作策略配对的视觉-动作信号，导致视觉表示不适用于物理交互。
Method: 从大规模自我中心视频中提取3D手部关键点作为动作代理，通过对比损失学习图像与动作表示的联合嵌入，将手部姿态对齐到机器人动作空间。
Result: 在真实世界灵巧操作设置（Dexmate Vega和Sharpa Wave手）上，CAIP在折叠、倾倒和精细操作任务中性能增益超过30%，显著优于DINOv2、SigLIP、MVP和R3M。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，对比动作中心预训练是一种可扩展的方法，能够获得更适合物理交互的鲁棒视觉表示，为机器人学习提供了新的方向。

papers.title: MLLP-VRAIN UPV system for the IWSLT 2026 Simultaneous Speech Translation task
papers.abstract_en: This work describes the participation of the MLLP-VRAIN research group in the shared task of the IWSLT 2026 Simultaneous Speech Translation track. Our submission utilizes the recently released Parakeet and Qwen 3.5 models to create a robust, cascaded solution for long-form SimulST through the use of adaptive "black-box" policies. We explore relaxations of these policies to achieve better quality-latency trade-offs. Compared to last year, we participate on all language directions. In addition to this, for the En$\rightarrow${De, It, Zh} directions we also participate in this year's new context track employing a combination of ASR word-boosting and a RAG mechanism of offline pre-translated exemplars to guide generation and enrich our system with domain-specific context. Finally, we provide a detailed latency analysis of our system. Compared to last year, results on the MCIF En$\rightarrow$De test set shows a substantial quality improvement of +5.82 XCOMET-XL. Our context track processing further improves performance by +1.03.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文描述了MLLP-VRAIN研究组在IWSLT 2026同声传译任务中的系统。该系统采用级联架构，结合Parakeet和Qwen 3.5模型，并利用自适应“黑盒”策略实现长语音的实时翻译。相比去年，系统在MCIF En→De测试集上取得+5.82 XCOMET-XL的质量提升，并通过上下文跟踪进一步提高了+1.03。
Motivation: 同声传译任务需要平衡翻译质量和延迟，而现有级联系统在长语音场景下存在性能瓶颈。本文旨在通过自适应策略和上下文增强机制提升翻译质量，同时保持可接受的延迟。
Method: 提出级联SimulST系统，使用Parakeet进行ASR，Qwen 3.5进行翻译，并采用自适应“黑盒”策略（如放松约束）来优化质量-延迟权衡。对于上下文跟踪，使用ASR词增强和基于RAG的离线预翻译示例。
Result: 在MCIF En→De测试集上，相比去年系统获得+5.82 XCOMET-XL的改进；上下文跟踪进一步带来+1.03的提升。论文还提供了详细的延迟分析。
Conclusion: 自适应策略和上下文增强能有效提升同声传译的质量，未来可探索更复杂的策略和更丰富的上下文融合方式。

summary_sections.result: 在MCIF En→De测试集上，相比去年系统获得+5.82 XCOMET-XL的改进；上下文跟踪进一步带来+1.03的提升。论文还提供了详细的延迟分析。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自适应策略和上下文增强能有效提升同声传译的质量，未来可探索更复杂的策略和更丰富的上下文融合方式。

papers.title: Rethinking Groups in Critic-Free RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a central paradigm for post-training large language models. Existing critic-free RL methods typically generate a group of rollouts for the same question to estimate value baselines for advantage computation. However, this design suffers from data inefficiency, group synchronization barriers, and inflexibility with structured rollouts. In this work, we revisit the role of the ``group'' and show that its underlying function is not merely to estimate baselines but to prevent false penalties on negative samples. Building on this insight, we propose negative token filtering, a simple and effective strategy that enables stable single-rollout training. We apply it to two batch-level advantage methods, achieving comparable performance on reasoning tasks and stronger performance on agentic tasks relative to group-based RL techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无评论家强化学习（critic-free RLVR）中现有方法依赖多rollout估计基线的低效问题，重新审视‘组’的作用，提出负标记过滤（negative token filtering）策略，仅需单rollout即可稳定训练。在推理任务上达到与组基线方法相当的性能，在代理任务上表现更强。
Motivation: 现有无评论家RL方法对同一问题生成多个rollout以估计价值基线，导致数据利用率低、同步开销大，且难以支持结构化rollout。
Method: 提出负标记过滤策略，通过识别并避免对负样本的错误惩罚，使得单rollout训练稳定可行；将该策略应用于两种批级优势计算方法。
Result: 在推理任务上取得与基于组的RL技术相当的性能，在代理任务上取得更强的性能。
Conclusion: 组在无评论家RL中的核心功能并非基线估计，而是防止负样本被错误惩罚；负标记过滤可有效替代组机制，提升效率与灵活性。

papers.title: From Compression to Deployment: Real-Time and Energy-Efficient FastGRNN on Ultra-Constrained Microcontrollers
papers.abstract_en: The dominant trajectory of modern machine learning has been to scale up: larger models, larger accelerators, larger memory budgets. Yet a multi-year global semiconductor supply constraint and the growing energy and carbon cost of always-online inference expose the fragility of this trajectory and motivate the opposite direction: refactoring AI and ML algorithms to fit the small, ubiquitous microcontrollers already in mass production in wearables, sensors, and edge appliances. We present an end-to-end open-source reproduction of FastGRNN, a compact gated recurrent cell, deployed on two bare-metal targets: the 8-bit Arduino (ATmega328P) and the 16-bit MSP430 (no hardware multiplier; 16 KB Flash; 512 B SRAM). Our compression pipeline combines low-rank weight factorization, iterative hard-thresholding sparsity, and per-tensor Q15 post-training quantization with explicit activation calibration. The deployed model occupies 566 bytes of weights and achieves macro F1 = 0.918 (seed 0; five-seed Q15 mean 0.853+-0.107) on the HAPT test set. It matches a PyTorch reference at 100% prediction agreement across 3,399 test windows (MCU seed 0; 99.91-100% C-equivalent across five seeds). Both platforms sustain real-time 50 Hz streaming inference (9.21 ms per sample on Arduino; 13 ms on MSP430), where a 256-entry sigmoid/tanh look-up table delivers a 30.5x speedup on the multiplier-less MSP430. Four contributions extend the original FastGRNN paper: (i) cross-platform bit-equivalent deterministic inference; (ii) characterization of recurrent warm-up latency (median 74 samples, 1.48 s; worst-case 125 samples, 2.50 s over 100 test windows); (iii) a deployable look-up-table recipe for multiplier-less embedded targets; and (iv) hardware energy characterization showing 17.7 mW active inference power, <0.09 mW idle power, and 96.7% energy reduction with the LUT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文复现和部署了压缩的FastGRNN模型在8位和16位微控制器上，实现实时50Hz流式推理，权重仅占566字节，HAPT测试集上宏F1=0.918，与PyTorch参考模型100%预测一致。
Motivation: 现代机器学习趋势是扩大模型规模，但在半导体供应约束和能源成本压力下，需要将AI算法适配到资源受限的微控制器上。
Method: 开发端到端开源压缩流程，包括低秩权重分解、迭代硬阈值稀疏化、逐张量Q15后训练量化以及显式激活校准，并利用查找表加速乘法器缺失平台。
Result: 在Arduino (ATmega328P) 和 MSP430 (无硬件乘法器) 上实现566字节权重的模型，宏F1=0.853±0.107（5种子），50Hz流式推理延迟分别为9.21ms和13ms，查找表带来30.5倍加速。
Conclusion: 证明在极端受限的微控制器上可以实现实时、能量高效的循环神经网络推理，并提供了跨平台确定性推理、预热延迟、查找表配方和能耗表征等贡献。

papers.title: GeoDisaster: Benchmarking Orchestrated Agents for Operational Disaster Geo-Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Remote-sensing vision-language models (RS-VLMs) have advanced Earth-observation analysis toward visual interpretation and instruction-following, yet fall short of operational geo-intelligence, which demands tool-grounded spatial reasoning and structured, evidence-backed decisions. We introduce GeoDisaster, an operational geospatial disaster reasoning benchmark with 2,921 verified instances across 43 question types and five task families: deforestation monitoring, multi-hazard analysis, building-damage assessment, flood-safe routing, and Sentinel-1 SAR flood monitoring. Instances integrate heterogeneous EO/GIS evidence-optical and SAR imagery, raster masks, vector geometries, road networks, and exposure layers-spanning hazard detection, damage assessment, exposure estimation, and diagnostic report generation. Ground-truth answers are grounded in executable geospatial workflows and deterministic consistency checks, removing the need for language-model annotation. We further propose an orchestrated multi-agent framework with 18 disaster-oriented tools, where role-specialized agents coordinate through explicit execution contracts, aligned via Role-Contract Expectation Alignment (RCEA): failure-aware supervised fine-tuning combined with contract-grounded reinforcement learning over dense step-level signals. Experiments show that GeoDisaster challenges existing RS-VLMs and agentic systems, while RCEA improves tool use, evidence grounding, state consistency, and decision generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoDisaster 是一个面向操作化地理空间灾害推理的基准，包含 2,921 个实例、43 种问题类型和五个任务族，整合多源遥感与 GIS 数据。论文还提出一种多智能体框架 RCEA，通过角色契约期望对齐来改进工具使用和证据关联。实验表明现有 RS-VLM 和智能体系统在该基准上表现不足，而 RCEA 提升了决策质量。
Motivation: 现有遥感视觉语言模型在操作化地理空间情报方面不足，缺乏基于工具的推理和结构化决策能力，需要专门的灾害推理基准和更有效的多智能体协调方法。
Method: 构建 GeoDisaster 基准（2,921 个实例、43 种问题类型、五个任务族），并提出多智能体框架 RCEA，结合失败感知的监督微调和基于契约的强化学习，在密集步骤信号上进行对齐。
Result: GeoDisaster 对现有 RS-VLM 和智能体系统构成挑战；RCEA 改善了工具使用、证据关联、状态一致性和决策生成。
Conclusion: 该工作强调了操作化地理空间灾害推理的复杂性，并展示了通过角色契约对齐可以提升多智能体系统的性能。

papers.title: Landsat-Sentinel-2 Algal Bloom Mapping Using Vision Transformers: Model Description, Implementation, and Examples
papers.abstract_en: Coastal algal bloom monitoring requires frequent, spatially detailed, and globally consistent observations, provided by Landsat-8/9 and Sentinel-2 A/B/C. Together, these missions offer over a decade of medium-resolution multispectral imagery with near-global coverage every 2-3 days, enabling the detection of fragmented bloom structures not resolvable by coarse ocean-color sensors. However, their use in aquatic environments remains challenging due to limited spectral coverage and a lack of harmonized reflectance products. As an alternative to traditional bio-optical methods, deep learning-based image classification offers a data-driven approach that can overcome many of these limitations. This study presents the first successful implementation of vision transformer-based coastal algal bloom mapping using 30-m Landsat-Sentinel-2 images. A globally distributed bloom patch dataset was generated across bloom-prone coastal hotspots worldwide. Four transformer-based architectures were compared against a standard convolutional baseline for fine-scale bloom detection, and assessed under different optical water types and atmospheric and surface conditions. All deep learning models showed strong capabilities in detecting floating bloom areas, with omission and commission errors of 8-65%. Under cloud and glint stress in a time series, the Swin Transformer outperformed traditional spectral-index approaches, which produced widespread false positives, effectively avoiding cloud- and glint-affected pixels. Comparisons with MODIS-derived products further highlighted the benefits of higher spatial resolution in detecting fragmented and irregularly affected blooms. Our findings support deep learning as a reliable tool for medium-resolution, consistent monitoring of floating algal blooms in dynamic coastal environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将视觉Transformer应用于基于Landsat-Sentinel-2影像的沿海藻华制图。研究构建了全球分布式藻华斑块数据集，比较了四种Transformer架构与卷积基线在精细尺度藻华检测中的表现。Swin Transformer在云和耀斑干扰下优于传统光谱指数方法，减少了误报。结果表明深度学习可用于中等分辨率下动态沿海环境中浮游藻华的可靠监测。
Motivation: 沿海藻华监测需要高频、高空间分辨率的观测，但Landsat和Sentinel-2的有限光谱覆盖和缺乏归一化反射率产品使其在水体应用面临挑战。传统生物光学方法存在局限，深度学习提供了一种数据驱动替代方案。
Method: 使用30米Landsat-Sentinel-2影像，生成全球藻华斑块数据集，并训练四种视觉Transformer（包括Swin Transformer）进行浮游藻华检测，与标准卷积基线对比。评估在不同光学水体类型及大气/表面条件下的表现，并与MODIS产品比较。
Result: 所有深度学习模型在检测浮游藻华方面表现出色，遗漏和误判误差在8-65%之间。Swin Transformer在云和耀斑干扰下有效避免了误报，优于传统光谱指数方法。高空间分辨率相比MODIS能检测到更破碎和不规则的藻华区域。
Conclusion: 研究支持深度学习作为中等分辨率、一致监测动态沿海环境中浮游藻华的可靠工具。

papers.title: Beyond Benchmarks: Continuous Edge Inference for Fine-Grained Roadside Perception
papers.abstract_en: Continuous AI inference on resource-constrained edge hardware introduces deployment effects that are largely invisible to conventional benchmark evaluation, including temporal instability in streaming video, thermal throttling under sustained load, and workload-dependent performance variability. We present Edge-TSR, a deployment-oriented continuous edge inference system for sustained roadside perception on the NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano. Edge-TSR integrates detection, tracking, fine-grained classification, and a lightweight track-aware temporal stabilization mechanism that improves streaming inference consistency with negligible computational overhead. Our central finding is that benchmark-centric evaluation systematically overstates deployed edge inference performance. Across three state-of-the-art baselines, we observe consistent 20-30% relative degradation when transitioning from static-image evaluation to real-world streaming deployment. Edge-TSR addresses this gap through temporal inference stabilization, recovering up to 10.16% classification accuracy over per-frame inference baselines while maintaining sustained real-time performance under continuous operation. We evaluate the complete system under diverse real-world deployment conditions, jointly characterizing inference quality, latency, throughput, and thermal behavior during long-duration operation. A 55-minute vehicular deployment over a 26 km route demonstrates sustained operation at 16.18 FPS within safe thermal limits on a single embedded device without cloud offload. Our findings show that deployment-aware evaluation and temporal inference stabilization are necessary components of continuously operating edge AI systems intended for real-world sensing deployments. We release a sample annotated streaming video evaluation dataset and full system implementation to support reproducible deployment-centric evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对资源受限边缘硬件上的连续AI推理面临的部署效应（如流视频时域不稳定、热节流、工作负载相关性能变化）提出Edge-TSR系统，用于持续的道路感知。系统集成检测、跟踪、细粒度分类和轻量级跟踪感知时域稳定机制，在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上实现16.18 FPS的持续运行。核心发现是基准中心评估系统性地高估了部署性能（20-30%下降），而Edge-TSR通过时域稳定恢复最多10.16%的分类准确率。
Motivation: 传统基准评估忽略了边缘设备上连续推理的部署效应（如时域不稳定、热效应），导致性能高估，亟需部署感知的评估方法和稳定性优化。
Method: Edge-TSR系统包括检测、跟踪、细粒度分类，以及一种轻量级的跟踪感知时域稳定机制，用于改善流推理一致性，并在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上实现持续运行。
Result: 在三个基线对比中，从静态图像评估到真实流部署时性能下降20-30%；Edge-TSR相比逐帧推理基线恢复最多10.16%的分类准确率，并在55分钟26公里车载部署中实现16.18 FPS的持续运行，且未超出热限制。
Conclusion: 部署感知评估和时域推理稳定是连续运行边缘AI系统在真实传感部署中的必要组成部分。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Attention Mechanism and Generalization Capability of Deep Learning-Based Grain Growth Evolution Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Machine Learning (ML) models for grain growth prediction are typically trained on idealized synthetic data, yet practical applications require generalization to conditions outside the training distribution. This study evaluated the Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) generalization capability of the trained model from our previous study across three test cases, including experimental microstructures, microstructures characterized by a bimodal grain size distribution, and abnormal grain growth. To further probe whether physics-informed architectural design could improve robustness under these different conditions, a boundary-masked attention mechanism was proposed specifically for grain growth, constraining attention to grain boundary pixels. Both the baseline and the proposed physics-informed attention model were evaluated without retraining or fine-tuning on the OOD data. Both models successfully generalized to all three test cases, yet the boundary-masked attention mechanism provided substantial improvements, with the most notable gains for microstructures characterized by a bimodal grain size distribution, where Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) improved from \num{0.6221} to \num{0.7609} and mean grain size ($\overline{R}$) error decreased from \SI{8.75}{\percent} to \SI{3.57}{\percent}. The attention heatmap analysis revealed that the boundary-masked attention model learned to concentrate attention on large grain boundaries in a manner consistent with curvature-driven grain growth physics, emerging from training without being explicitly encoded into the architecture. These results indicate that models trained on synthetic data can generalize to diverse OOD conditions without retraining, and that physics-informed attention may improve accuracy when the boundary morphology matches the training domain.

TL;DR: 本文评估了深度学习模型在晶粒生长预测中的分布外泛化能力，提出了一种边界掩码注意力机制，显著提升了双峰晶粒尺寸分布下的预测精度。实验表明，模型无需重新训练即可泛化到实验微观结构、异常晶粒生长等OOD条件，且注意力热图分析显示模型学习到了与曲率驱动晶粒生长物理一致的注意力模式。

Method: 提出边界掩码注意力机制，将注意力限制在晶界像素上，无需对OOD数据重新训练或微调。与基线模型在三个OOD测试案例（实验微观结构、双峰晶粒尺寸分布、异常晶粒生长）上对比。
Result: 边界掩码注意力模型在双峰晶粒尺寸分布下SSIM从0.6221提升至0.7609，平均晶粒尺寸误差从8.75%降至3.57%。两种模型均成功泛化到所有OOD案例，但改进模型提升显著。
Conclusion: 合成数据训练的模型可无需重新训练泛化到多种OOD条件，物理信息注意力机制在边界形态与训练域匹配时能提升精度。

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification of Engineering Structures by Polynomial Chaos Expansion and Multivariate Active Learning
papers.abstract_en: In many engineering applications, a single high-fidelity model produces multiple quantities of interest (QoIs) under the same input parameters, e.g. finite element models of complex physical systems. To alleviate the high computational cost of direct model evaluations, surrogate models are widely used to construct efficient approximations of model responses. Naturally, the accuracy of surrogates strongly depends on the quality of the experimental design (ED). However, a single ED may not provide an adequate representation for all outputs simultaneously, especially when different outputs exhibit varying sensitivities to the input variables. A straightforward solution is to perform separate sampling for each output, but this results in increased sampling complexity and computational cost. From a statistical perspective, such an approach also ignores potential correlations among all outputs and may compromise data consistency. To address this issue, an adaptive sequential sampling method for constructing polynomial chaos expansion surrogate models is generalized for vector valued QoIs. The method sequentially selects new samples from a candidate pool based on their local contribution to the output variance, while balancing distance-based exploration of the input space and exploitation of aggregated variance information across all outputs. Its performance is compared with non-sequential Latin Hypercube Sampling through several numerical examples from engineering problems. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed strategy improves both surrogate accuracy and stability, and provides a more reliable estimation of second-order statistics.

TL;DR: 本文针对工程中多输出量的代理模型构建问题，提出了一种基于多项式混沌展开和多元主动学习的自适应顺序采样方法。该方法通过考虑所有输出方差来平衡探索与利用，提高了代理模型的精度和稳定性。
Motivation: 单个实验设计难以同时充分表示多个输出量，单独采样则增加成本且忽略输出间相关性。
Method: 提出自适应顺序采样方法，从候选池中根据样本对输出方差的局部贡献依次选择新样本，同时平衡距离基础的探索和聚合方差信息的利用。使用多项式混沌展开构建代理模型。
Result: 通过工程问题的数值示例与拉丁超立方采样比较，表明所提策略提高了代理模型的精度和稳定性，并提供更可靠的二阶统计量估计。
Conclusion: 该方法能够有效处理多输出量的代理模型构建，提高计算效率。

papers.title: Rift: A Conflict Signature for Deception in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A model that lies while knowing the truth is the central case ELK cannot handle with behavioral evaluation alone. We ask whether such deception leaves an internal signature distinguishing it from honest error. Our key move is a control for wrongness: we contrast a sleeper agent (knows the truth, lies on trigger) against a naive liar (fine-tuned to emit the same wrong answers with no honest training). Both produce identical wrong outputs; any difference is about knowledge conflict, not incorrectness. We find deceptive forward passes carry a conflict signature - 2.1-2.3x higher residual rank than naive-liar passes on the same wrong answer - strong enough to identify which of two responses is the lie with 100% accuracy and no labels, across GPT-2 small/medium (three seeds) and three instruct models. Across Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B and Phi-3-mini, instructed deception raises residual rank on every tested fact (18/18, 40/40, 34/34); on Phi-3, lies separate perfectly from both honest answers and hallucinations (AUC 1.0, Wilcoxon p~6e-11). The signature survives strategic self-constructed deception (model invents its own lie, AUC 1.0), active concealment attempts (AUC 1.0), and length-controlled replication (20/20, AUC 1.0, p~1e-6). Using basis-free relative representations, a probe trained on one model family detects deception in two other families zero-shot (mean AUC 0.933), surviving simultaneous architecture and format change (AUC 0.821), and transfers across five languages (AUC 1.000, length-controlled). The signature is read-only: detectable but not injectable (0/8 both directions). Honest limitations and six negative experiments are documented in full.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Code and experiment logs: https://github.com/Omibranch/Rift
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种检测语言模型中故意欺骗的内部签名，通过对比知情说谎者（sleeper agent，知道真相但触发时撒谎）与不知情说谎者（naive liar，微调输出相同错误答案但无诚实训练）的残差秩（residual rank），发现欺骗性前向传播的残差秩比不知情说谎者高2.1-2.3倍，从而在无需标签的情况下以100%准确率识别谎言。该签名在GPT-2 small/medium、Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B、Phi-3-mini等多种模型上验证有效，能抵御主动隐藏尝试，并跨模型族、跨语言零样本迁移（平均AUC 0.933）。
Motivation: 现有行为评估（ELK）无法区分模型明知真相却故意说谎的情况，需要寻找内部信号来检测这种欺骗。
Method: 通过控制‘错误’变量，设计两类模型：知情说谎者（sleeper agent，基于诚实模型添加触发撒谎行为）和不知情说谎者（naive liar，直接微调输出相同错误答案但无诚实训练），比较两者在相同错误输出上的内部表示差异，重点分析残差秩（residual rank）。
Result: 欺骗性前向传播的残差秩比不知情说谎者高2.1-2.3倍；在GPT-2 small/medium（三个随机种子）上无标签区分谎言准确率100%；在Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B和Phi-3-mini上，每个测试事实均观察到残差秩升高，Phi-3上谎言与诚实回答、幻觉完全分离（AUC 1.0）。签名在模型自建谎言、主动隐藏、长度控制等设置下依然有效，跨模型族零样本检测平均AUC 0.933，跨语言AUC 1.0，且签名只读不可注入。
Conclusion: 该内部冲突签名可可靠检测语言模型中的有意欺骗，具有强鲁棒性和迁移能力，为ELK问题提供新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Enchanced Multi-Scale CNN with Bi-directional Mamba for Crop Field Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral image (HSI) crop analysis is essential for precision agriculture because it captures rich spectral and spatial information for accurate crop monitoring and assessment. However, HSI classification remains challenging due to high spectral dimensionality, spatial complexity, class imbalance, and limited labeled samples. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a BiSpectral Mamba-based framework that combines multi-scale convolutional feature extraction, spectral attention, bidirectional state-space modeling, and quantum-inspired learning. A multi-scale CNN backbone first extracts hierarchical spatial-spectral representations through feature fusion across multiple resolutions. A spectral attention mechanism then emphasizes informative bands while suppressing redundant and noisy channels. The refined features are processed by a BiSpectral Mamba module that captures long-range dependencies in both forward and backward directions by modeling hyperspectral feature maps as sequential tokens. In addition, class-weighted optimization and feature fusion strategies are incorporated to improve training stability and mitigate class imbalance. Experimental evaluation on the UAVHSI-Crop dataset demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed framework, achieving an overall accuracy of 84.83%. The results show that integrating convolutional, attention-based, and state-space modeling components enables robust spatial-spectral feature learning for crop classification. The proposed framework also shows potential for broader agricultural and remote sensing applications, including crop disease detection, yield prediction, and soil moisture estimation, while highlighting the effectiveness of structured state-space and quantum-inspired architectures for hyperspectral image analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于BiSpectral Mamba的高光谱图像作物分析框架，结合多尺度CNN、光谱注意力、双向状态空间建模和量子启发学习，在UAVHSI-Crop数据集上达到84.83%的总体分类精度。该框架旨在解决高光谱图像分类中的高维性、类别不平衡和标注样本有限等问题。
Motivation: 高光谱图像作物分析面临光谱维度高、空间复杂度大、类别不平衡和标签稀缺等挑战，现有方法难以充分提取鲁棒的空间-光谱特征。
Method: 提出BiSpectral Mamba框架：多尺度CNN主干提取层次化空间-光谱表示；光谱注意力机制强调信息波段、抑制冗余；BiSpectral Mamba模块将特征图作为序列令牌进行双向状态空间建模；同时引入类别加权优化和特征融合策略缓解类别不平衡。
Result: 在UAVHSI-Crop数据集上达到84.83%的总体精度，验证了卷积、注意力和状态空间组件的有效性。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了结构状态空间和量子启发架构在高光谱图像分析中的潜力，并有望扩展至作物病害检测、产量预测和土壤湿度估计等农业遥感应用。

papers.title: When Rules Learn: A Self-Evolving Agent for Legal Case Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Legal case retrieval remains challenging due to the complexity of legal language and the need for precise lexical alignment between queries and relevant cases. Although dense retrieval models have achieved notable progress, empirical studies show that BM25 continues to serve as a strong baseline in this domain. It motivates us to propose a self-evolving framework for rule-driven query rewriting that enhances BM25 without any parameter training. The framework equips an LLM-based agent with an automatic evaluation environment, enabling it to iteratively create rewriting rules, plan validation experiments over rule combinations, and eliminate ineffective rules based on historical feedbacks. We evaluate our method on the Chinese legal case retrieval benchmark LeCaRD-v2. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms non-evolutionary baselines, including human-designed rules and greedy rule selection, particularly when powered by a highcapacity core LLM. We also conduct detailed analyses to investigate the mechanisms underlying self-evolution. Our findings reveal that LLM's capabilities to leverage previous experimental results and its intrinsic knowledge of rule elimination play critical roles in refining the rule set via self-evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对法律案例检索中BM25仍作为强基线但缺乏自动查询重写规则的问题，提出一个无需参数训练的自进化框架。该框架基于LLM agent自动生成重写规则，通过迭代实验验证和无效规则消除来自我优化。在中文法律基准LeCaRD-v2上，该方法优于人工设计规则和贪婪规则选择等非进化基线。
Motivation: 法律案例检索中，尽管稠密检索模型有进展，BM25仍表现强劲，但现有查询重写依赖人工规则，缺乏自动化与自优化能力。
Method: 提出一个LLM驱动的自进化框架，包含自动评估环境，agent可迭代创建规则、设计组合验证实验、并根据历史反馈淘汰无效规则，整个过程无需任何参数训练。
Result: 在LeCaRD-v2基准上，该方法（尤其是使用高容量核心LLM时）在检索性能上超过人工设计规则和贪婪规则选择等非进化基线。
Conclusion: 自进化的关键机制在于LLM能够利用先前实验结果和内在知识有效消除无效规则，从而迭代改进规则集。
