papers.title: Know Thy Reasoner: Not All Language Models Explore Alike
papers.abstract_en: Compute scaling for LLM reasoning trades off exploring solution approaches (\emph{breadth}) against refining promising ones (\emph{depth}), yet why a given trade-off works, and why it often fails to transfer across models, remains unclear. We argue that \textbf{the optimal strategy depends on the model's \emph{diversity profile}, the spread of probability mass across solution approaches, and that this must be characterized before any exploration strategy is adopted.} We formalize this with a framework decomposing reasoning uncertainty, deriving when depth-based refinement outperforms parallel sampling, and validate it across three model families at both inference and training. Our central finding is that the diversity regime dictates the strategy: low-diversity aligned models benefit from depth-based refinement with lightweight intrinsic signals, whereas high-diversity base models are often harmed by it, and instead need breadth or stronger signals to compensate.
papers.comment: This is a full-length extension of the workshop paper that appeared in the ICLR 2026 Workshop on LLM Reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大语言模型推理时探索（广度）与精炼（深度）之间的权衡，指出最优策略取决于模型的多样性特征。作者提出一个框架来分解推理不确定性，推导出何时深度精炼优于并行采样，并在三个模型家族上进行了验证。核心发现是：低多样性的对齐模型受益于基于深度精炼的轻量级内在信号，而高多样性的基础模型则可能受损，需要广度或更强的信号来补偿。
Motivation: 现有研究对LLM推理中探索-精炼权衡为何有效以及为何难以跨模型迁移缺乏清晰解释。
Method: 提出一个框架来分解推理不确定性，形式化多样性特征与探索策略的关系，并推导深度精炼优于并行采样的条件。
Result: 在三个模型家族上验证发现：低多样性对齐模型受益于深度精炼（使用轻量级内在信号），高多样性基础模型则更适合广度探索或更强信号。
Conclusion: 多样性特征是决定LLM推理策略选择的关键因素，需要在采用任何探索策略前对其进行刻画。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型推理时探索（广度）与精炼（深度）之间的权衡，指出最优策略取决于模型的多样性特征。作者提出一个框架来分解推理不确定性，推导出何时深度精炼优于并行采样，并在三个模型家族上进行了验证。核心发现是：低多样性的对齐模型受益于基于深度精炼的轻量级内在信号，而高多样性的基础模型则可能受损，需要广度或更强的信号来补偿。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有研究对LLM推理中探索-精炼权衡为何有效以及为何难以跨模型迁移缺乏清晰解释。
summary_sections.method: 提出一个框架来分解推理不确定性，形式化多样性特征与探索策略的关系，并推导深度精炼优于并行采样的条件。
summary_sections.result: 在三个模型家族上验证发现：低多样性对齐模型受益于深度精炼（使用轻量级内在信号），高多样性基础模型则更适合广度探索或更强信号。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多样性特征是决定LLM推理策略选择的关键因素，需要在采用任何探索策略前对其进行刻画。

papers.title: Like a Hammer, It Can Build, It Can Break: Large Language Model Uses, Perceptions, and Adoption in Cybersecurity Operations on Reddit
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as promising tools for augmenting Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows, with vendors increasingly marketing autonomous AI solutions for SOCs. However, there remains a limited empirical understanding of how such tools are used, perceived, and adopted by real-world security practitioners. To address this gap, we conduct a mixed-methods analysis of discussions in cybersecurity-focused forums to learn how a diverse group of practitioners use and perceive modern LLM tools for security operations. More specifically, we analyzed 892 posts between December 2022 and September 2025 from three cybersecurity-focused forums on Reddit, and, using a combination of qualitative coding and statistical analysis, examined how security practitioners discuss LLM tools across three dimensions: (1) their stated tools and use cases, (2) the perceived pros and cons of each tool across a set of critical factors, and (3) their adoption of such tools and the expected impacts on the cybersecurity industry and individual analysts. Overall, our findings reveal nuanced patterns in LLM tools adoption, highlighting independent use of LLMs for low-risk, productivity-oriented tasks, alongside active interest around enterprise-grade, security-focused LLM platforms. Although practitioners report meaningful gains in efficiency and effectiveness in LLM-assisted workflows, persistent issues with reliability, verification overheads, and security risks sharply constrain the autonomy granted to LLM tools. Based on these results, we also provide recommendations for developing and adopting LLM tools to ensure the security of organizations and the safety of cybersecurity practitioners.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过混合方法分析Reddit上三个网络安全论坛的892条帖子（2022年12月至2025年9月），研究安全从业者如何使用、感知和采用大语言模型（LLM）工具进行安全运营。发现从业者倾向于独立使用LLM处理低风险、生产力导向的任务，同时对企业级安全专用LLM平台有浓厚兴趣；虽然LLM辅助工作流在效率和有效性上有显著提升，但可靠性、验证开销和安全风险等问题严重限制了赋予LLM工具的自主权。
Motivation: 目前缺乏对真实安全从业者如何使用、感知和采用LLM工具的实证理解，而供应商正积极推广面向安全运营中心（SOC）的自主AI解决方案。
Method: 对Reddit上三个网络安全论坛在2022年12月至2025年9月期间的892条帖子进行定性编码和统计分析，从工具与用例、感知优缺点、采用与预期影响三个维度考察。
Result: 从业者报告LLM辅助工作流在效率和有效性上有显著提升，但可靠性、验证开销和安全风险等问题限制了LLM工具的自主权；同时发现对低风险生产力任务的独立使用与企业级安全专用平台的兴趣并存。
Conclusion: 基于发现，为开发和安全采用LLM工具提出了建议，以确保组织安全和从业者安全。

papers.title: Riemann-Bench: A Benchmark for Moonshot Mathematics
papers.abstract_en: Recent AI systems have achieved gold-medal-level performance on the International Mathematical Olympiad, demonstrating remarkable proficiency at competition-style problem solving. However, competition mathematics represents only a narrow slice of mathematical reasoning: problems are drawn from limited domains, require minimal advanced machinery, and can often reward insightful tricks over deep theoretical knowledge. We introduce Riemann-Bench, a private benchmark of expert-curated problems designed to evaluate AI systems on research-level mathematics that goes far beyond the olympiad frontier. Problems are authored by Ivy League mathematics professors, graduate students, and PhD-holding IMO medalists, and routinely took their authors weeks to solve independently. Each problem undergoes double-blind verification by two independent domain experts who must solve the problem from scratch, and yields a unique, closed-form solution assessed by programmatic verifiers. We evaluate frontier models as unconstrained research agents, with full access to coding tools, search, and open-ended reasoning, using an unbiased statistical estimator computed over 100 independent runs per problem. Our results reveal that all frontier models currently score below 10%, exposing a substantial gap between olympiad-level problem solving and genuine research-level mathematical reasoning. By keeping the benchmark fully private, we ensure that measured performance reflects authentic mathematical capability rather than memorization of training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Riemann-Bench，一个由专家策划的私有基准，用于评估 AI 系统在超越奥林匹克数学竞赛的研究级数学问题上的表现。问题由常春藤盟校数学教授、研究生和拥有博士学位的 IMO 奖牌得主编写，每个问题需要作者数周独立解决，并经双盲验证。评估显示，前沿模型在基准上得分低于 10%，揭示了奥林匹克水平问题解决与研究级数学推理之间的巨大差距。
Motivation: 现有 AI 在奥林匹克数学竞赛上表现出色，但竞赛数学仅涵盖有限领域，缺乏深度理论要求。需要能够衡量 AI 系统在研究级数学推理上真实能力的基准。
Method: 构建私有基准 Riemann-Bench，问题由数学专家编写，经双盲独立求解验证，通过程序化验证器评估唯一闭式解。评估设置为无约束研究代理，可使用编码工具、搜索和开放式推理，每个问题进行 100 次独立运行以获取无偏估计。
Result: 所有前沿模型在 Riemann-Bench 上的得分低于 10%，表明与研究级数学推理之间存在显著差距。
Conclusion: Riemann-Bench 作为私有基准，能够避免训练数据记忆，真实反映 AI 的数学推理能力，当前模型远未达到研究级水平。

papers.title: Evaluating Intersectional Fairness across Clinical Machine Learning Use Cases using Fairlogue and the All of Us Research Program
papers.abstract_en: Intersectional biases in healthcare data can produce compound disparities in clinical machine learning models, yet most fairness evaluations assess demographic attributes independently. FairLogue, a toolkit for intersectional fairness auditing, was applied across multiple clinical prediction tasks to evaluate disparities across combined demographic groups. Using the All of Us dataset, two published models were selected for replication and evaluation: (A) prediction of selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor associated bleeding events and (B) two-year stroke risk in patients with atrial fibrillation. Observational fairness metrics were computed across race, gender, and intersectional subgroups, followed by counterfactual analysis to evaluate whether disparities were attributable to group membership. Intersectional evaluation revealed larger disparities than single-axis analyses; however, counterfactual diagnostics indicated that most observed disparities were comparable to those expected under randomized group membership. These results highlight the importance of intersectional fairness auditing and demonstrate how FairLogue provides deeper insight into bias in clinical machine learning systems.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, Accepted at the AMIA Annual Symposium 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文使用 FairLogue 工具包对两个临床机器学习模型（SSRI相关出血事件预测和房颤患者两年卒中风险预测）进行交叉公平性审计。基于All of Us数据集，在种族、性别及其交叉子组上计算观察性公平性指标，并进行反事实分析。结果表明交叉评价比单轴分析揭示出更大的差异，但反事实诊断显示大多数观察到的差异与随机分组下的期望相当。
Motivation: 医疗数据中的交叉偏见可能产生复合不公，但现有公平性评估通常仅考虑单一人口属性，缺乏对交叉子组的系统评估。
Method: 应用 FairLogue 工具包，在 All of Us 数据集上对两个已发表模型进行复制和评估；对种族、性别及其交叉子组计算观察性公平性指标，并结合反事实分析判断差异是否可归因于群体成员身份。
Result: 交叉评价比单轴分析发现更大的差异；但反事实诊断表明大多数观察到的差异与随机分组下的期望相当。
Conclusion: 研究强调了交叉公平性审计的重要性，并展示 FairLogue 能为临床机器学习系统中的偏见提供更深入的洞察。

papers.title: Olmo Hybrid: From Theory to Practice and Back
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has demonstrated the potential of non-transformer language models, especially linear recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and hybrid models that mix recurrence and attention. Yet there is no consensus on whether the potential benefits of these new architectures justify the risk and effort of scaling them up. To address this, we provide evidence for the advantages of hybrid models over pure transformers on several fronts. First, theoretically, we show that hybrid models do not merely inherit the expressivity of transformers and linear RNNs, but can express tasks beyond both, such as code execution. Putting this theory to practice, we train Olmo Hybrid, a 7B-parameter model largely comparable to Olmo 3 7B but with the sliding window layers replaced by Gated DeltaNet layers. We show that Olmo Hybrid outperforms Olmo 3 across standard pretraining and mid-training evaluations, demonstrating the benefit of hybrid models in a controlled, large-scale setting. We find that the hybrid model scales significantly more efficiently than the transformer, explaining its higher performance. However, its unclear why greater expressivity on specific formal problems should result in better scaling or superior performance on downstream tasks unrelated to those problems. To explain this apparent gap, we return to theory and argue why increased expressivity should translate to better scaling efficiency, completing the loop. Overall, our results suggest that hybrid models mixing attention and recurrent layers are a powerful extension to the language modeling paradigm: not merely to reduce memory during inference, but as a fundamental way to obtain more expressive models that scale better during pretraining.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论和实践两方面论证了混合模型（混合线性循环神经网络与注意力机制）相比纯Transformer的优势。理论证明混合模型能表达纯Transformer和纯线性RNN无法表达的任务（如代码执行）。实践上，训练了7B参数的Olmo Hybrid模型，用Gated DeltaNet层替换滑动窗口层，在标准预训练和中期评估中 outperforms Olmo 3。混合模型在扩展效率上显著优于Transformer，解释了其更高性能，并理论论证了更强的表达能力如何转化为更好的扩展效率。
Motivation: 尽管非Transformer语言模型（尤其是线性RNN和混合模型）展现出潜力，但对其规模化收益和风险尚无共识。本文旨在为混合模型相对纯Transformer在多方面的优势提供证据。
Method: 理论证明混合模型的表达能力超越纯Transformer和线性RNN；实践上，训练7B参数的Olmo Hybrid，将Olmo 3的滑动窗口层替换为Gated DeltaNet层，进行大规模受控对比。
Result: Olmo Hybrid在标准预训练和中期评估中优于Olmo 3；混合模型在扩展效率上显著更高，从而获得更高性能。
Conclusion: 混合模型不仅是推理时减少内存的手段，更是获得更强大可扩展模型的基本途径。更强的表达能力能转化为更好的扩展效率。

papers.title: Learning and Generating Mixed States Prepared by Shallow Channel Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Learning quantum states from measurement data is a central problem in quantum information and computational complexity. In this work, we study the problem of learning to generate mixed states on a finite-dimensional lattice. Motivated by recent developments in mixed state phases of matter, we focus on arbitrary states in the trivial phase. A state belongs to the trivial phase if there exists a shallow preparation channel circuit under which local reversibility is preserved throughout the preparation. We prove that any mixed state in this class can be efficiently learned from measurement access alone. Specifically, given copies of an unknown trivial phase mixed state, our algorithm outputs a shallow local channel circuit that approximately generates this state in trace distance. The sample complexity and runtime are polynomial (or quasi-polynomial) in the number of qubits, assuming constant (or polylogarithmic) circuit depth and gate locality. Importantly, the learner is not given the original preparation circuit and relies only on its existence. Our results provide a structural foundation for quantum generative models based on shallow channel circuits. In the classical limit, our framework also inspires an efficient algorithm for classical diffusion models using only a polynomial overhead of training and generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从测量数据学习并生成浅通道电路制备的混合态，证明了平凡相中的混合态可以通过多项式（或拟多项式）样本复杂度和时间复杂度高效学习，并输出近似生成该态的浅局域通道电路。
Motivation: 学习量子态是量子信息和计算复杂性的核心问题，现有工作多关注纯态，而混合态的学习与生成缺乏系统研究，特别是受混合态物质相进展的启发。
Method: 提出一种算法，仅通过测量访问未知平凡相混合态的副本，输出一个浅局域通道电路，在迹距离上近似生成该态；算法不依赖原始制备电路，仅依赖其存在性。
Result: 在常数（或对数）电路深度和门局域性下，样本复杂度和运行时间为量子比特数的多项式（或拟多项式），且能将方法推广到经典扩散模型。
Conclusion: 为基于浅通道电路的量子生成模型提供了结构基础，并在经典极限下启发了多项式开销的经典扩散模型训练与生成算法。

papers.title: findsylls: A Language-Agnostic Toolkit for Syllable-Level Speech Tokenization and Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Syllable-level units offer compact and linguistically meaningful representations for spoken language modeling and unsupervised word discovery, but research on syllabification remains fragmented across disparate implementations, datasets, and evaluation protocols. We introduce findsylls, a modular, language-agnostic toolkit that unifies classical syllable detectors and end-to-end syllabifiers under a common interface for syllable segmentation, embedding extraction, and multi-granular evaluation. The toolkit implements and standardizes widely used methods (e.g., Sylber, VG-HuBERT) and allows their components to be recombined, enabling controlled comparisons of representations, algorithms, and token rates. We demonstrate findsylls on English and Spanish corpora and on new hand-annotated data from Kono, an underdocumented Central Mande language, illustrating how a single framework can support reproducible syllable-level experiments across both high-resource and under-resourced settings.

papers.title: Can Vision Foundation Models Navigate? Zero-Shot Real-World Evaluation and Lessons Learned
papers.abstract_en: Visual Navigation Models (VNMs) promise generalizable, robot navigation by learning from large-scale visual demonstrations. Despite growing real-world deployment, existing evaluations rely almost exclusively on success rate, whether the robot reaches its goal, which conceals trajectory quality, collision behavior, and robustness to environmental change. We present a real-world evaluation of five state-of-the-art VNMs (GNM, ViNT, NoMaD, NaviBridger, and CrossFormer) across two robot platforms and five environments spanning indoor and outdoor settings. Beyond success rate, we combine path-based metrics with vision-based goal-recognition scores and assess robustness through controlled image perturbations (motion blur, sunflare). Our analysis uncovers three systematic limitations: (a) even architecturally sophisticated diffusion and transformer-based models exhibit frequent collisions, indicating limited geometric understanding; (b) models fail to discriminate between different locations that are perceptually similar, however some semantics differences are present, causing goal prediction errors in repetitive environments; and (c) performance degrades under distribution shift. We will publicly release our evaluation codebase and dataset to facilitate reproducible benchmarking of VNMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对五种最新的视觉导航模型（GNM, ViNT, NoMaD, NaviBridger, CrossFormer）在真实世界机器人平台上进行了系统评估，涵盖室内外环境。除成功率外，还引入路径指标和视觉目标识别分数，并通过图像扰动测试鲁棒性。发现模型普遍存在频繁碰撞、在重复环境中无法区分感知相似但语义不同的位置、以及在分布偏移下性能下降等系统性局限。
Motivation: 现有视觉导航模型评估几乎只依赖成功率，忽略了轨迹质量、碰撞行为和对环境变化的鲁棒性，无法全面揭示模型实际性能。
Method: 在两种机器人平台和五种室内外环境中，对五个SOTA VNM进行真实世界评估，结合路径指标、基于视觉的目标识别分数，以及运动模糊和太阳耀斑等图像扰动测试。
Result: 发现三个系统性局限：架构先进的模型仍频繁碰撞（几何理解有限）；无法区分感知相似但语义不同的位置，导致重复环境中的目标预测错误；在分布偏移下性能显著下降。
Conclusion: 公开评估代码和数据集，以促进可重复的VNM基准测试，并呼吁更全面的评估指标。

papers.title: Amortizing Maximum Inner Product Search with Learned Support Functions
papers.abstract_en: Maximum inner product search (MIPS) is a crucial subroutine in machine learning, requiring the identification of a vector taken within a database (the keys) that best aligns with a given query. We propose amortized MIPS: a regression-based approach that trains neural networks to directly predict MIPS solutions, amortizing the cost of repeatedly solving MIPS for queries drawn from a known distribution over a fixed key database. Our key insight is that the MIPS value function is the \emph{support} function of the set of keys, a well-studied convex function whose gradient yields the optimal key. This motivates two complementary amortized models: SupportNet, an input-convex neural network trained to regress the support function, and KeyNet, a vector-valued network that directly regresses the optimal key. SupportNet can serve as a cluster router, steering queries toward relevant database partitions, while KeyNet can be used as a drop-in replacement for the original query, fed directly to off-the-shelf indexing pipelines. Our experiments on the BEIR benchmark show that, for document embeddings, learned \SupportNet{}s and \KeyNet{}s significantly improve IVF match rates when accounting for compute effort, whether measured in FLOPs, number of probes, or wall-clock time. Our code is available at: https://github.com/apple/ml-amips.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出摊销最大内积搜索（MIPS）方法，通过训练神经网络直接预测MIPS解，从而摊销重复查询的成本。关键洞察是MIPS值函数是键集的支撑函数，其梯度给出最优键。基于此提出两个互补模型：SupportNet（输入凸神经网络回归支撑函数）和KeyNet（向量值网络直接回归最优键）。在BEIR基准上，对于文档嵌入，学习到的SupportNet和KeyNet在计算量（FLOPs、探测次数或实际时间）下显著提升了IVF匹配率。
Motivation: MIPS是机器学习中的关键子程序，重复对固定键数据库上的查询进行MIPS求解成本高昂。现有方法无法有效摊销这一成本。
Method: 利用支撑函数的凸性，提出两种神经网络：SupportNet回归支撑函数（输入凸网络），KeyNet直接回归最优键。SupportNet可作为聚类路由器引导查询到相关分区，KeyNet可直接替代原始查询输入现成的索引管道。
Result: 在BEIR基准上，文档嵌入实验表明，在考虑计算量（FLOPs、探测次数或实际时间）时，SupportNet和KeyNet显著提升IVF匹配率。
Conclusion: 本文展示了通过回归支撑函数来摊销MIPS的可行性，方法既可作为路由器也可作为替代查询，在计算预算下提高检索效率。

papers.title: On Randomized Algorithms in Online Strategic Classification
papers.abstract_en: Online strategic classification studies settings in which agents strategically modify their features to obtain favorable predictions. For example, given a classifier that determines loan approval based on credit scores, applicants may open or close credit cards and bank accounts to obtain a positive prediction. The learning goal is to achieve low mistake or regret bounds despite such behavior. While randomized algorithms have the potential to offer advantages to the learner in strategic settings, they have been largely underexplored. In the realizable setting, no lower bound is known for randomized algorithms, and existing lower bound constructions for deterministic learners can be circumvented by randomization. In the agnostic setting, the best known regret upper bound is $O(T^{3/4}\log^{1/4}T|\mathcal H|)$, which is far from the standard online learning rate of $O(\sqrt{T\log|\mathcal H|})$. In this work, we provide refined bounds for online strategic classification in both settings; our bounds depend on the Littlestone dimension $\mathrm{Ldim}(\mathcal H)$ of the hypothesis class $\mathcal H$ and the maximum degree $Δ$ of the manipulation graph. In the realizable setting, we extend, for $T > \mathrm{Ldim}(\mathcal H) Δ^2$, the existing lower bound $Ω(\mathrm{Ldim}(\mathcal H) Δ)$ for deterministic learners to all learners. This yields the first lower bound that applies to randomized learners. We then provide the first randomized learner that improves the known (deterministic) upper bound of $O(\mathrm{Ldim}(\mathcal H) \cdot Δ\log Δ)$. In the agnostic setting, we give an improper randomized learner that improves the regret upper bound to $O(\sqrt{T\log|\mathcal H|})$, matching the standard online learning rate. We also show a larger lower bound for all proper learning rules, demonstrating that improperness is necessary to achieve the optimal rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线策略分类中的随机化算法，在可实现设定下首次给出适用于所有学习器的下界Ω(Ldim(H)Δ)，并提供了优于确定性上界的随机化学习器；在不可知设定下，通过不当随机学习器将遗憾上界改进至O(√(T log|H|))，同时证明不当性对最优率是必要的。
Motivation: 在线策略分类中，随机化算法的优势尚未被充分探索；现有确定性学习器的下界可能被随机化规避，且不可知设定下的遗憾上界远未达到标准在线学习率。
Method: 在可实现设定中，基于Littlestone维度和操纵图最大度Δ给出下界，并设计随机化学习器改进上界；在不可知设定中，提出不当随机学习器实现标准遗憾率，并证明恰当学习器的下界更大。
Result: 可实现设定下，对T>Ldim(H)Δ²，下界为Ω(Ldim(H)Δ)，上界从O(Ldim(H)·Δ logΔ)改进；不可知设定下，遗憾上界达到O(√(T log|H|))，匹配标准率。
Conclusion: 随机化算法在策略分类中能显著提升性能，不当性是达到最优遗憾率的必要条件。

papers.title: Optimism Stabilizes Thompson Sampling for Adaptive Inference
papers.abstract_en: Thompson sampling (TS) is widely used for stochastic multi-armed bandits, yet its inferential properties under adaptive data collection are subtle. Classical asymptotic theory for sample means can fail because arm-specific sample sizes are random and coupled with the rewards through the action-selection rule. We study adaptive inference for Thompson sampling with Gaussian randomized indices in $K$-armed stochastic bandits with independent sub-Gaussian reward noises, and identify \emph{optimism} as a key mechanism for restoring \emph{stability}, meaning that each arm's pull count concentrates around a deterministic scale. This stability yields asymptotically valid Wald inference despite adaptive sampling. First, we prove that variance-inflated TS is stable for any $K \ge 2$, including the challenging regime where multiple arms are optimal, with asymptotically uniform allocation over optimal arms and sharp logarithmic pull-count asymptotics for suboptimal arms. This resolves the $K$-armed extension question raised by \citet{halder2025stable}, using new winner-map and Lyapunov-drift techniques to control allocation among multiple optimal arms. Second, we analyze an alternative optimistic modification that keeps the Gaussian index variance unchanged but adds an explicit mean bonus to the index center, and establish a similar stability conclusion. In summary, suitably implemented optimism stabilizes Thompson sampling and enables asymptotically valid Wald inference in multi-armed bandits, while incurring only a mild additional regret cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究汤普森采样（Thompson sampling）在自适应数据收集下的推断性质，提出乐观性（optimism）机制可稳定汤普森采样，使得各臂的拉取次数集中于确定性尺度，从而实现渐近有效的 Wald 推断。论文证明了方差膨胀的 TS 对任意 K≥2 臂稳定，并针对多最优臂情形给出了渐近均匀分配和次优臂对数拉取次数渐近结果。
Motivation: 经典汤普森采样在自适应数据收集下，样本均值的渐近理论失效，因为臂的样本量随机且与奖励通过动作选择规则耦合。此外，现有工作对 K≥2 臂多最优情形的稳定性问题尚未解决。
Method: 提出两种乐观修改：一是方差膨胀的 TS，二是保持高斯索引方差不变但给索引中心添加显式均值奖励的修改。使用新的 winner-map 和 Lyapunov-drift 技术控制多最优臂间的分配。
Result: 证明了方差膨胀的 TS 对任意 K≥2 臂稳定，包括多最优臂情形，最优臂得到渐近均匀分配，次优臂具有尖锐的对数拉取次数渐近性。第二种乐观修改也得到类似稳定性结论。
Conclusion: 适当实现的乐观性可以稳定汤普森采样，使得多臂赌博机中可实现渐近有效的 Wald 推断，且仅付出轻微额外遗憾成本。该工作解决了 halder2025stable 提出的 K 臂扩展问题。

papers.title: Price of metric universality in vector quantization is at most 0.11 bit
papers.abstract_en: Fast computation of a matrix product $W^\top X$ is a workhorse of modern LLMs. To make their deployment more efficient, a popular approach is that of using a low-precision approximation $\widehat W$ in place of true $W$ (``weight-only quantization''). Information theory demonstrates that an optimal algorithm for reducing precision of $W$ depends on the (second order) statistics of $X$ and requires a careful alignment of vector quantization codebook with PCA directions of $X$ (a process known as ``waterfilling allocation''). Dependence of the codebook on statistics of $X$, however, is highly impractical. This paper proves that there exist a universal codebook that is simultaneously near-optimal for all possible statistics of $X$, in the sense of being at least as good as an $X$-adapted waterfilling codebook with rate reduced by 0.11 bit per dimension in the case when $W$ is Gaussian. Such universal codebook would be an ideal candidate for the low-precision storage format, a topic of active modern research, but alas the existence proof is non-constructive. Equivalently, our result shows existence of a net in $\mathbb{R}^n$ that is a nearly-optimal covering of a sphere simultaneously with respect to all Hilbert norms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明存在一个通用的向量量化码本，对于所有可能的输入统计量都接近最优，最差情况仅比输入自适应码本多消耗0.11比特每维。该结果等价于存在一个在不同希尔伯特范数下同时几乎最优的球面覆盖网。这是针对权重量化场景的理论结果，但码本的存在性是非构造性的。
Motivation: 现代LLM依赖快速矩阵乘法，权重量化是提高部署效率的常用方法。信息论表明最优量化依赖于输入X的统计量，但依赖统计量的码本在实际中不可行。
Method: 利用存在性证明，展示存在一个通用码本，对任意X的统计量（特别是高斯W）的性能至少与速率减少0.11比特每维的X自适应码本相当。
Result: 存在通用码本使得在所有可能的X统计量下，量化误差不超过自适应码本在速率减少0.11比特每维时的误差。
Conclusion: 该结论表明低精度存储格式可能无需依赖输入分布，但存在性是非构造性的，尚需进一步研究显式构造。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文证明存在一个通用的向量量化码本，对于所有可能的输入统计量都接近最优，最差情况仅比输入自适应码本多消耗0.11比特每维。该结果等价于存在一个在不同希尔伯特范数下同时几乎最优的球面覆盖网。这是针对权重量化场景的理论结果，但码本的存在性是非构造性的。
summary_sections.motivation: 现代LLM依赖快速矩阵乘法，权重量化是提高部署效率的常用方法。信息论表明最优量化依赖于输入X的统计量，但依赖统计量的码本在实际中不可行。
summary_sections.method: 利用存在性证明，展示存在一个通用码本，对任意X的统计量（特别是高斯W）的性能至少与速率减少0.11比特每维的X自适应码本相当。
summary_sections.result: 存在通用码本使得在所有可能的X统计量下，量化误差不超过自适应码本在速率减少0.11比特每维时的误差。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该结论表明低精度存储格式可能无需依赖输入分布，但存在性是非构造性的，尚需进一步研究显式构造。

papers.title: Partial Ring Scan: Revisiting Scan Order in Vision State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: State Space Models (SSMs) have emerged as efficient alternatives to attention for vision tasks, offering lineartime sequence processing with competitive accuracy. Vision SSMs, however, require serializing 2D images into 1D token sequences along a predefined scan order, a factor often overlooked. We show that scan order critically affects performance by altering spatial adjacency, fracturing object continuity, and amplifying degradation under geometric transformations such as rotation. We present Partial RIng Scan Mamba (PRISMamba), a rotation-robust traversal that partitions an image into concentric rings, performs order-agnostic aggregation within each ring, and propagates context across rings through a set of short radial SSMs. Efficiency is further improved via partial channel filtering, which routes only the most informative channels through the recurrent ring pathway while keeping the rest on a lightweight residual branch. On ImageNet-1K, PRISMamba achieves 84.5% Top-1 with 3.9G FLOPs and 3,054 img/s on A100, outperforming VMamba in both accuracy and throughput while requiring fewer FLOPs. It also maintains performance under rotation, whereas fixed-path scans drop by 1~2%. These results highlight scan-order design, together with channel filtering, as a crucial, underexplored factor for accuracy, efficiency, and rotation robustness in Vision SSMs. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视视觉状态空间模型（Vision SSMs）中的扫描顺序问题，发现扫描顺序严重影响性能，特别在旋转等几何变换下。提出PRISMamba，采用部分环形扫描（Partial Ring Scan），将图像划分为同心环，在环内进行顺序无关聚合，并通过短径向SSM跨环传播上下文，同时利用部分通道过滤提高效率。在ImageNet-1K上达到84.5% Top-1准确率、3.9G FLOPs和3054 img/s吞吐量，优于VMamba，且在旋转下保持性能，而固定路径扫描下降1~2%。
Motivation: 现有Vision SSMs将2D图像序列化为1D时采用固定扫描顺序，该顺序被忽视但实际影响空间邻接性、破坏对象连续性，并在旋转等变换下放大退化。
Method: 提出PRISMamba，包含部分环形扫描：将图像划分为同心环，每个环内进行顺序无关聚合（如平均池化），并通过一组短径向SSM在环间传递上下文；部分通道滤波将最信息量通道路由到循环路径，其余通道走轻量残差分支。
Result: 在ImageNet-1K上，PRISMamba达到84.5% Top-1准确率，仅3.9G FLOPs，吞吐量3054 img/s（A100），在准确率和吞吐量上均优于VMamba，且所需FLOPs更少；在旋转测试中性能稳定，而固定路径扫描下降1~2%。
Conclusion: 扫描顺序设计和通道滤波是Vision SSMs中提高准确性、效率和旋转鲁棒性的关键且未被充分探索的因素。

papers.title: PLATE: Plasticity-Tunable Efficient Adapters for Geometry-Aware Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: We develop a continual learning method for pretrained models that \emph{requires no access to old-task data}, addressing a practical barrier in foundation model adaptation where pretraining distributions are often unavailable. Our key observation is that pretrained networks exhibit substantial \emph{geometric redundancy}, and that this redundancy can be exploited in two complementary ways. First, redundant neurons provide a proxy for dominant pretraining-era feature directions, enabling the construction of approximately protected update subspaces directly from pretrained weights. Second, redundancy offers a natural bias for \emph{where} to place plasticity: by restricting updates to a subset of redundant neurons and constraining the remaining degrees of freedom, we obtain update families with reduced functional drift on the old-data distribution and improved worst-case retention guarantees. These insights lead to \textsc{PLATE} (\textbf{Pla}sticity-\textbf{T}unable \textbf{E}fficient Adapters), a continual learning method requiring no past-task data that provides explicit control over the plasticity-retention trade-off. PLATE parameterizes each layer with a structured low-rank update $ΔW = B A Q^\top$, where $B$ and $Q$ are computed once from pretrained weights and kept frozen, and only $A$ is trained on the new task. The code is available at https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/PLATE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PLATE，一种无需旧任务数据的持续学习方法，利用预训练网络的几何冗余性来构造保护更新子空间和塑性放置。通过结构化低秩更新ΔW = B A Q^T，其中B和Q来自预训练权重并冻结，只训练A，实现了对塑性-保留权衡的显式控制。该方法不需要访问过去任务数据，适用于预训练分布不可用的场景。
Motivation: 在基础模型适配中，预训练分布通常不可用，现有持续学习方法常需要旧任务数据，这是一个实际障碍。作者观察到预训练网络存在大量几何冗余，可被利用来构建保护更新子空间和指导塑性放置，从而减少功能漂移。
Method: PLATE参数化每层为结构化低秩更新ΔW = B A Q^T，其中B和Q从预训练权重一次性计算并冻结，只有A在新任务上训练。该设计利用冗余神经元作为预训练特征方向的代理，并限制更新到冗余子集以降低旧数据分布上的漂移。
Conclusion: PLATE是一种无需过去任务数据的持续学习方法，通过几何冗余性实现塑性可调的高效适配器，提供显式的塑性-保留权衡控制。

papers.title: R1-SyntheticVL: Is Synthetic Data from Generative Models Ready for Multimodal Large Language Model?
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we aim to develop effective data synthesis techniques that autonomously synthesize multimodal training data for enhancing MLLMs in solving complex real-world tasks. To this end, we propose Collective Adversarial Data Synthesis (CADS), a novel and general approach to synthesize high-quality, diverse and challenging multimodal data for MLLMs. The core idea of CADS is to leverage collective intelligence to ensure high-quality and diverse generation, while exploring adversarial learning to synthesize challenging samples for effectively driving model improvement. Specifically, CADS operates with two cyclic phases, i.e., Collective Adversarial Data Generation (CAD-Generate) and Collective Adversarial Data Judgment (CAD-Judge). CAD-Generate leverages collective knowledge to jointly generate new and diverse multimodal data, while CAD-Judge collaboratively assesses the quality of synthesized data. In addition, CADS introduces an Adversarial Context Optimization mechanism to optimize the generation context to encourage challenging and high-value data generation. With CADS, we construct MMSynthetic-20K and train our model R1-SyntheticVL, which demonstrates superior performance on various benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出集体对抗数据合成（CADS），一种新的多模态数据合成方法，通过集体智能与对抗学习生成高质量、多样化且具挑战性的训练数据。基于CADS构建的MMSynthetic-20K数据集训练的R1-SyntheticVL模型，在多个基准上表现优越。
Motivation: 现有方法缺乏有效的数据合成技术来自动生成多模态训练数据，以提升多模态大语言模型在复杂真实任务上的表现。
Method: CADS包含两个循环阶段：Collective Adversarial Data Generation（CAD-Generate）利用集体知识联合生成新数据，Collective Adversarial Data Judgment（CAD-Judge）协同评估数据质量；并引入Adversarial Context Optimization机制优化生成上下文，鼓励生成挑战性高价值数据。
Result: 通过CADS构建了MMSynthetic-20K数据集，训练的R1-SyntheticVL模型在多个基准上取得优越性能。
Conclusion: CADS能够有效合成高质量、多样化和具有挑战性的多模态数据，推动多模态大语言模型性能提升。

papers.title: Clarify Before You Draw: Proactive Agents for Robust Text-to-CAD Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have recently enabled text-to-CAD systems that synthesize parametric CAD programs (e.g., CadQuery) from natural-language prompts. In practice, however, geometric descriptions can be under-specified or internally inconsistent: critical dimensions may be missing and constraints may conflict. However, existing fine-tuned models tend to reactively follow the user instructions and hallucinate dimensions when the text is ambiguous. To address this, we propose a proactive agentic framework for text-to-CadQuery generation, named as ProCAD, that resolves specification issues before code synthesis. Our framework pairs a proactive clarifying agent, which audits the prompt and asks targeted clarification questions only when necessary to produce a self-consistent specification, with a CAD coding agent that translates the specification into an executable CadQuery program. We fine-tune the coding agent based on a curated high-quality text-to-CadQuery dataset and train the clarifying agent via agentic SFT on clarification trajectories. Experiments show that proactive clarification significantly improves robustness to ambiguous prompts while keeping interaction overhead low. ProCAD outperforms frontier closed-source models, including Claude Sonnet 4.5, reducing the mean Chamfer distance by 79.9% and lowering the invalidity ratio from 4.8% to 0.9%. Our code and datasets are made publicly available on https://github.com/BoYuanVisionary/Pro-CAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ProCAD，一个主动式代理框架，用于文本到CadQuery程序生成。该框架包含一个澄清代理（clarifying agent），在代码合成前审查提示并询问针对性问题以解决规格歧义；以及一个CAD编码代理（coding agent），将规范翻译为可执行程序。实验表明，主动澄清显著提升了对模糊提示的鲁棒性，在Chamfer距离上比Claude Sonnet 4.5降低79.9%，无效率从4.8%降至0.9%。
Motivation: 现有文本到CAD系统在用户描述模糊或不一致时，倾向于盲目遵循指令并幻觉尺寸，导致生成不可靠的几何模型。
Method: 提出ProCAD框架，由两个代理组成：1）主动澄清代理，通过代理式监督微调（agentic SFT）训练，能自动检查提示并仅在必要时提出澄清问题以生成自洽的规格；2）CAD编码代理，基于高质量文本到CadQuery数据集微调，将规格转换为可执行程序。
Result: 在模糊提示测试中，ProCAD的Chamfer距离比Claude Sonnet 4.5降低79.9%，无效比率从4.8%降至0.9%。
Conclusion: 主动澄清策略能有效提升文本到CAD生成的鲁棒性，且交互开销低。

papers.title: Gradual Fine-Tuning for Flow Matching Models
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning flow matching models is a central challenge in settings with limited data, evolving distributions, or computational constraints. While recent work has produced significant advances, particularly in the area of reward-based fine-tuning, current methods fail to demonstrate both theoretical correctness as well as strong empirical results in terms of stability, efficiency, and diversity preservation. In this work, we propose Gradual Fine-Tuning (GFT), a simple yet principled annealing-based framework for fine-tuning flow generative models when only samples from the target distribution are available. For stochastic flows, GFT defines a temperature-controlled sequence of intermediate objectives that smoothly interpolate between the pretrained and target drifts, provably approaching the true target as the temperature approaches zero. We analytically demonstrate that sample generation after GFT can be made substantially more efficient with the use of arbitrary (e.g., optimal transport) couplings, as well as by utilizing few-step inference methods. Empirically, GFT significantly improves convergence stability, while maintaining or improving generation quality, training speed, and generation diversity compared to other fine-tuning methods. Our results position GFT as a simple yet theoretically grounded and practically effective alternative for scalable adaptation of flow matching models under distribution shift.
papers.comment: Preprint. Added methodology and experimental sections
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Gradual Fine-Tuning (GFT)，一种基于退火的框架，用于在只有目标分布样本的情况下微调流匹配模型。GFT定义温度控制的中间目标序列，平滑插值预训练和目标的漂移，理论保证当温度趋于零时逼近真实目标。实验表明GFT在收敛稳定性、生成质量、训练速度和多样性方面优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有微调方法在稳定性、效率、多样性保持方面缺乏理论正确性和强实证结果。
Method: 提出GFT框架，定义温度控制的目标序列，利用任意耦合（如最优传输）和少步推理提高生成效率。
Result: 实验表明GFT显著改善收敛稳定性，同时保持或提升生成质量、训练速度和多样性。
Conclusion: GFT是一种简单、理论扎实且实际有效的微调替代方案，适用于分布漂移下的流匹配模型自适应。

papers.title: LVLMs and Humans Ground Differently in Referential Communication
papers.abstract_en: For generative AI agents to partner effectively with human users, the ability to accurately predict human intent is critical. But this ability to collaborate remains limited by a critical deficit: an inability to model common ground. We present a referential communication experiment with a factorial design involving director-matcher pairs (human-human, human-AI, AI-human, and AI-AI) that interact with multiple turns in repeated rounds to match pictures of objects not associated with any obvious lexicalized labels. We show that LVLMs cannot interactively generate and resolve referring expressions in a way that enables smooth communication, a crucial skill that underlies human language use. We release our corpus of 356 dialogues (89 pairs over 4 rounds each) along with the online pipeline for data collection and the tools for analyzing accuracy, efficiency, and lexical overlap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过指称通信实验对比人类与LVLM在多轮交互中生成和解析指称表达的能力，发现LVLM无法像人类一样有效建模共同基础（common ground），导致交流效率低下。研究发布了包含356个对话的语料库及分析工具。
Motivation: 生成式AI代理需要准确预测人类意图以有效协作，但当前缺乏对共同基础的建模能力，限制了人机协作效果。
Method: 采用因素实验设计，包含人类-人类、人类-AI、AI-人类和AI-AI四种配对，每对进行多轮交互以匹配没有标准化标签的图片对象。
Result: LVLM无法交互式地生成和解决指称表达以达成顺畅交流，与人类表现存在显著差距。
Conclusion: 强调了共同基础建模对AI与人类协作的重要性，并发布了对话语料库及分析工具以供进一步研究。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文通过指称通信实验对比人类与LVLM在多轮交互中生成和解析指称表达的能力，发现LVLM无法像人类一样有效建模共同基础（common ground），导致交流效率低下。研究发布了包含356个对话的语料库及分析工具。

papers.title: Learning QoE from Packet-Level Measurements in Encrypted Video Conferencing Traffic
papers.abstract_en: The quality of the user experience has become one of the most important aspects in todays world, as it directly influences individuals willingness to continue using or abandon a product or service. In this context, video conferencing applications (VCAs), which experienced widespread adoption following the COVID-19 pandemic, must deliver excellent performance to remain competitive in an increasingly crowded market. Although content providers (CPs) such as Zoom, WhatsApp, Telegram, and Google Meet can assess conversation quality by comparing transmitted and received data. The widespread use of end-to-end encryption in VCAs makes quality-of-experience (QoE) evaluation by internet service providers (ISPs) far more challenging. Since ISPs do not have access to the encrypted content, they must rely on passive measurements of unencrypted traffic characteristics on the data path. In this work, we present a simple yet effective QoE prediction framework based on an almost stock convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture that uses only the packet sizes extracted from the communication between two participants in a video conferencing (VC) call to predict two QoE metrics: BRISQUE and MOS. The proposed framework is simple, easy to implement, and does not require high-end computational resources, yet it provides superior prediction performance, as shown in our experiments on two custom datasets collected from WhatsApp and Zoom, which achieve substantial improvements over previous models for the QoE prediction task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对加密视频会议流量中ISP难以评估QoE的问题，提出一个基于CNN的预测框架，仅使用包大小特征预测BRISQUE和MOS指标。在WhatsApp和Zoom两个自定义数据集上的实验表明，该框架性能优于以往模型。
Motivation: 端到端加密使得ISP无法直接访问视频会议内容，传统的QoE评估方法失效，需要依靠被动测量未加密流量特征。
Method: 采用几乎现成的卷积神经网络（CNN）架构，输入两方通信的包大小序列，输出BRISQUE和MOS两个QoE指标。
Result: 在WhatsApp和Zoom数据集上，该框架的预测性能大幅超过先前模型。
Conclusion: 该框架简单、易部署、无需高端计算资源，为ISP提供了一种有效的加密视频会议QoE评估方案。

papers.title: Disentangling Perception and Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs via Reward Design
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has driven major gains in LLM reasoning, and it is intuitive to assume this recipe will transfer well to multimodal models. However, multimodal models do two things: first, perceive what is in an image, then reason about what it implies. Because these stages are graded jointly, it is hard to tell how much room reasoning alone has to grow. We study this on algorithmic visual puzzles, where both components are necessary and show that perception, not reasoning, is the binding constraint. Replacing images with simple textual descriptions raises performance by over 20 points on average for Claude models. We then evaluate six reward designs aimed at inducing visual grounding during reasoning without chain-of-thought supervision. Training Qwen-2.5-VL-7B with GRPO, reward design induces long, structured reasoning with self-reflection and visual references, yielding a 5.56-point gain over the base model. These gains are, however, uneven; no single reward improves all categories, and rewards with verifiable accuracy signals trade out-of-domain transfer for in-domain accuracy. These results point to perception-aware reward design as a path forward, so that signals correct perception at its source rather than the reasoning that inherits its errors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究多模态大语言模型中感知与推理的解耦，通过奖励设计探讨视觉推理的瓶颈。实验表明，感知而非推理是主要约束，将图像替换为文字描述可提升Claude模型性能超过20点。在Qwen-2.5-VL-7B上使用GRPO训练，奖励设计引导出长序列结构化推理，带来5.56个百分点的提升，但增益不均匀且存在域内精度与跨域迁移的权衡。
Motivation: 现有强化学习奖励机制在LLM推理上有效，但多模态模型同时涉及感知和推理，难以区分两者的贡献，导致无法确定推理能力的真实增长空间。
Method: 在算法视觉谜题上，对比图像输入与文本描述的性能，并设计六种奖励方案（如视觉接地奖励）在无思维链监督下诱导推理，使用GRPO训练Qwen-2.5-VL-7B。
Result: 文本描述比图像输入提升Claude模型平均20+百分点；奖励设计使模型产生长程结构化推理和自反思，带来5.56个百分点的增益，但不同类别提升不均，且可验证准确性奖励会削弱跨域迁移。
Conclusion: 感知是当前多模态推理的瓶颈，未来应设计面向感知的奖励机制，从源头纠正感知错误，而非仅优化推理。

papers.title: Dropout Neural Network Training Viewed from a Percolation Perspective
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we investigate the existence and effect of percolation in training deep Neural Networks (NNs) with dropout. Dropout methods are regularisation techniques for training NNs, first introduced by G. Hinton et al. (2012). These methods temporarily remove connections in the NN, randomly at each stage of training, and update the remaining subnetwork with Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD). The process of removing connections from a network at random is similar to percolation, a paradigm model of statistical physics. If dropout were to remove enough connections such that there is no path between the input and output of the NN, then the NN could not make predictions informed by the data. We study new percolation models that mimic dropout in NNs and characterise the relationship between network topology and this path problem. The theory shows the existence of a percolative effect in dropout. We also show that this percolative effect can cause a breakdown when training NNs without biases with dropout; and we argue heuristically that this breakdown extends to NNs with biases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从渗流理论视角研究神经网络中dropout机制的本质。研究者发现dropout随机移除连接的过程类似于统计物理中的渗流模型，并建立新模型刻画网络拓扑与连接路径的关系。理论证明dropout存在渗流效应，且当无偏置网络训练时会导致训练崩溃。
Motivation: 现有dropout训练方法缺乏对随机移除连接后网络连通性（是否仍存在输入到输出路径）的理论理解，该问题直接影响神经网络能否基于数据做出预测。
Method: 提出模仿dropout的渗流模型，利用统计物理中的渗流理论分析网络拓扑与路径存在性的关系，证明渗流效应的存在并推导崩溃条件。
Result: 理论证明dropout存在渗流效应：当移除足够多连接时，输入输出路径消失导致网络无法预测。在无偏置神经网络中，该效应必然导致训练崩溃；并启发式论证有偏置网络同样存在此问题。
Conclusion: dropout训练存在渗流相变现象，网络设计需避免因过度失活导致连通性丧失。该工作为理解dropout的失效边界提供了理论框架。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A geometric and deep learning reproducible pipeline for monitoring floating anthropogenic debris in urban rivers using in situ cameras
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of floating anthropogenic debris in rivers has emerged as a pressing environmental concern, exerting a detrimental influence on biodiversity, water quality, and human activities such as navigation and recreation. The present study proposes a novel methodological framework for the monitoring the aforementioned waste, utilising fixed, in-situ cameras. This study provides two key contributions: (i) the continuous quantification and monitoring of floating debris using deep learning and (ii) the identification of the most suitable deep learning model in terms of accuracy and inference speed under complex environmental conditions. These models are tested in a range of environmental conditions and learning configurations, including experiments on biases related to data leakage. Furthermore, a geometric model is implemented to estimate the actual size of detected objects from a 2D image. This model takes advantage of both intrinsic and extrinsic characteristics of the camera. The findings of this study underscore the significance of the dataset constitution protocol, particularly with respect to the integration of negative images and the consideration of temporal leakage. In conclusion, the feasibility of metric object estimation using projective geometry coupled with regression corrections is demonstrated. This approach paves the way for the development of robust, low-cost, automated monitoring systems for urban aquatic environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合几何模型和深度学习的可复现流程，用于利用固定现场摄像头监测城市河流中的漂浮人为碎片。研究对比了多种深度学习模型在不同环境条件下的准确率和推理速度，并分析了数据泄漏等训练配置的影响。几何模型通过相机内外参数从二维图像估计物体实际尺寸，结合回归校正实现公制估计。实验表明数据集构建协议（特别是负样本整合和时间泄漏处理）对模型性能至关重要。
Motivation: 城市河流中漂浮人为碎片对生物多样性、水质和人类活动造成负面影响，但目前缺乏低成本、自动化的连续监测方法。
Method: 提出一个方法论框架，包括：1）使用深度学习模型（如目标检测网络）对固定摄像头图像中的漂浮碎片进行连续量化和监测；2）基于相机内外参数建立几何模型，通过投影几何和回归校正从二维图像估计物体实际尺寸。
Result: 报告了深度学习模型在多种环境条件和学习配置下的比较结果，强调了数据集构成（尤其是负样本和时间泄漏）的重要性，并验证了结合投影几何与回归校正的度量估计可行性。
Conclusion: 该研究展示了构建鲁棒、低成本、自动化城市水体监测系统的可行性，为后续实际应用提供了方法论基础。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Advances in 4D Representation: Geometry, Motion, and Interaction
papers.abstract_en: We present a survey on 4D generation and reconstruction, a fast-evolving subfield of computer graphics whose developments have been propelled by recent advances in neural fields, geometric and motion deep learning, as well as 3D generative artificial intelligence (GenAI). While our survey is not the first of its kind, we build our coverage of the domain from a unique and distinctive perspective of 4D representations, to model 3D geometry evolving over time while exhibiting motion and interaction. Specifically, instead of offering an exhaustive enumeration of many works, we take a more selective approach by focusing on representative works to highlight both the desirable properties and ensuing challenges of each representation under different computation, application, and data scenarios. The main take-away message we aim to convey to the readers is on how to select and then customize the appropriate 4D representations for their tasks. Organizationally, we separate the 4D representations based on three key pillars: geometry, motion, and interaction. Our discourse will not only encompass the most popular representations of today, such as neural radiance fields (NeRFs) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), but also bring attention to relatively under-explored representations in the 4D context, such as structured models and long-range motions. Throughout our survey, we will reprise the role of large language models (LLMs) and video foundational models (VFMs) in a variety of 4D applications, while steering our discussion towards their current limitations and how they can be addressed. We also provide a dedicated coverage on what 4D datasets are currently available, as well as what is lacking, in driving the subfield forward. Project page:https://mingrui-zhao.github.io/4DRep-GMI/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于4D生成与重建的综述，从4D表示（几何、运动、交互）的独特视角组织内容，重点讨论神经辐射场（NeRF）、3D高斯散射（3DGS）等流行表示以及结构化模型、长程运动等较少探索的表示，同时评述大语言模型（LLM）和视频基础模型（VFM）在4D应用中的角色与局限，并梳理现有4D数据集。
Motivation: 4D生成与重建领域快速发展，但缺乏从表示角度系统梳理的综述，特别是针对不同计算、应用和数据场景下如何选择和定制4D表示。
Method: 采用选择性综述方法，围绕几何、运动、交互三个支柱对4D表示进行分类讨论，并结合代表性工作分析各表示的属性与挑战。
Result: 总结了当前主流4D表示（如NeRF、3DGS）的优缺点，指出结构化模型和长程运动表示尚待深入探索，并列出可用4D数据集及其不足。
Conclusion: 强调选择合适的4D表示需根据任务需求定制，并指出LLM和VFM在4D应用中的当前局限性及后续改进方向。

papers.title: Adversarial Attacks Leverage Interference Between Features in Superposition
papers.abstract_en: Why do adversarial examples exist, and why do they transfer between models? Existing explanations appeal to high-dimensional geometry, non-robust patterns in the input, and decision boundary structure, but none provides a representation-level mechanism that explains why specific perturbations succeed and why attacks transfer between models. In this paper, we show that adversarial vulnerability can stem from efficient information encoding in neural networks. Specifically, vulnerability can arise from superposition - the phenomenon where networks represent more concepts than they have dimensions, forcing non-orthogonal representation and thus interference. This interference causes perturbations targeting one representation to affect others, creating vulnerabilities determined by interference patterns. In synthetic settings with precisely controlled superposition, we establish that superposition suffices to create adversarial vulnerability. The resulting attacks are predictable: PGD-discovered perturbations align with theoretically optimal perturbations derived from the interference geometry. Models trained on similar data develop similar interference patterns, explaining attack transferability. We then show that successful attacks on image classifiers exhibit the structure predicted by our proposed mechanism. These findings reveal that adversarial vulnerability can be a byproduct of networks' representational compression, complementing existing explanations based on data properties or architectural factors.
papers.comment: Forty-third International Conference on Machine Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对抗性脆弱性可能源于神经网络中的叠加现象（superposition），即网络用少于概念数量的维度表示多个概念，导致非正交表示和干扰。在合成控制实验中验证了叠加足以产生对抗性脆弱性，攻击扰动与干扰几何导出的理论最优扰动一致。在图像分类器上，成功攻击表现出该机制预测的结构。
Motivation: 现有解释未能从表示层面解释对抗样本为何存在及为何跨模型迁移。
Method: 通过合成设置精确控制叠加程度，比较PGD发现扰动与基于干扰几何的理论最优扰动；在图像分类器上检验攻击结构是否与预测一致。

papers.title: Breaking the Code: Security Assessment of AI Code Agents Through Systematic Jailbreaking Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Code-capable large language model (LLM) agents are embedded in software engineering workflows where they can read, write, and execute code, raising "jailbreak" stakes beyond text-only settings. Prior evaluations emphasize refusal or harmful-text detection, leaving open whether agents compile and run malicious programs. We present JAWS-Bench (Jailbreaks Across WorkSpaces), a benchmark spanning three escalating workspace regimes mirroring attacker capability: empty (JAWS-0), single-file (JAWS-1), and multi-file (JAWS-M). We pair this with a hierarchical, executable-aware Judge Framework that tests (i) compliance, (ii) attack success, (iii) syntactic correctness, and (iv) runtime executability, to measure deployable harm. Across seven LLM backends from five families, prompt-only attacks in JAWS-0 achieve 61% compliance; 58% are harmful, 52% parse, and 27% run end-to-end. In JAWS-1, compliance reaches ~100% for stronger models with a mean ASR (Attack Success Rate) ~71%; JAWS-M raises mean ASR to ~75%, with 32% runnable attack code. Wrapping an LLM in an agent increases ASR by 1.6$\times$, by overturning initial refusals during planning and tool use. Similar trends hold for OpenHands, SWE-Agent, and OpenAI Codex, suggesting our JAWS-Bench is agent-agnostic. Category analyses identify which attack classes are most vulnerable and deployable, motivating execution-aware defenses and refusal-preserving agent designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出JAWS-Bench基准测试，用于评估面向代码的大语言模型(LLM)智能体在面对越狱攻击时的安全性。基准涵盖三个工作区场景（空、单文件、多文件），并配以可执行感知的评判框架。实验表明，仅使用提示攻击即可实现较高成功率，且将LLM封装为智能体会使攻击成功率提升1.6倍。该基准适用于多种智能体框架。
Motivation: 现有安全评估主要关注拒绝回答或有害文本检测，未能评估代码智能体是否会编译和执行恶意程序。
Method: 提出JAWS-Bench基准，包含JAWS-0（空工作区）、JAWS-1（单文件）和JAWS-M（多文件），并结合层次化、可执行感知的评判框架，从合规性、攻击成功、语法正确性和运行时可执行性四个方面评估。
Result: 在JAWS-0中，仅提示攻击的合规率为61%，其中58%为有害，52%可解析，27%可端到端运行。在JAWS-1中，较强模型的合规率接近100%，平均攻击成功率(ASR)约71%；JAWS-M平均ASR约75%，其中32%可运行攻击代码。将LLM封装为智能体使ASR提升1.6倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调需执行感知的防御和拒绝保持的智能体设计，以应对代码智能体的安全性威胁。

papers.title: OmniRetarget: Interaction-Preserving Data Generation for Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation and Scene Interaction
papers.abstract_en: A dominant paradigm for teaching humanoid robots complex skills is to retarget human motions as kinematic references to train reinforcement learning (RL) policies. However, existing retargeting pipelines often struggle with the significant embodiment gap between humans and robots, producing physically implausible artifacts like foot-skating and penetration. More importantly, common retargeting methods neglect the rich human-object and human-environment interactions essential for expressive locomotion and loco-manipulation. To address this, we introduce OmniRetarget, an interaction-preserving data generation engine based on an interaction mesh that explicitly models and preserves the crucial spatial and contact relationships between an agent, the terrain, and manipulated objects. By minimizing the Laplacian deformation between the human and robot meshes while enforcing kinematic constraints, OmniRetarget generates kinematically feasible trajectories. Moreover, preserving task-relevant interactions enables efficient data augmentation, from a single demonstration to different robot embodiments, terrains, and object configurations. We comprehensively evaluate OmniRetarget by retargeting motions from OMOMO, LAFAN1, and our in-house MoCap datasets, generating over 8-hour trajectories that achieve better kinematic constraint satisfaction and contact preservation than widely used baselines. Such high-quality data enables proprioceptive RL policies to successfully execute long-horizon (up to 30 seconds) parkour and loco-manipulation skills on a Unitree G1 humanoid, trained with only 5 reward terms and simple domain randomization shared by all tasks, without any learning curriculum.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniRetarget，一种基于交互网格（interaction mesh）的运动重定向数据生成引擎，用于人形机器人全身操控与场景交互。该方法通过保留智能体、地形和操作对象之间的空间与接触关系，生成运动学上可行的轨迹，并支持数据增强。实验在 OMOMO、LAFAN1 和自采 MoCap 数据集上进行，生成超过 8 小时轨迹，在运动学约束满足和接触保留方面优于基线，并用仅 5 个奖励项和简单域随机化训练 Unitree G1 人形机器人执行长达 30 秒的跑酷和操控技能。
Motivation: 现有运动重定向方法难以处理人-机器人之间巨大的具身差异，产生脚滑、穿透等物理不可行的伪影，且忽视了丰富的人-物、人-环境交互，无法表达复杂的运动和操控行为。
Method: 引入交互网格显式建模智能体、地形和操作对象之间的空间与接触关系，通过最小化人体与机器人网格之间的拉普拉斯变形并施加运动学约束，生成运动学可行的轨迹，并利用交互保留实现数据增强。
Result: 摘要报告在多个数据集上生成的轨迹在运动学约束满足和接触保留上优于广泛使用的基线，并能用于训练人形机器人执行长达 30 秒的跑酷与操控技能，仅需 5 个奖励项和无学习课程的简单域随机化。
Conclusion: OmniRetarget 通过保留交互关系生成高质量数据，使人形机器人能够学习长时间范围的复杂全身运动与操控技能。

papers.title: BioArtlas: Computational Clustering of Multi-Dimensional Complexity in Bioart
papers.abstract_en: Bioart brings living material into artistic practice, where a single work can be at once an aesthetic object, a scientific instrument, and an ethical provocation. Traditional categories sort such works along one axis at a time, which flattens the very hybridity that defines the field and leaves curators no way to compare works across many dimensions together. I introduce BioArtlas, a computational atlas that represents each bioartwork along many curated dimensions at once and organizes the field by conceptual similarity rather than by medium or chronology. My method embeds the keywords of all 81 works on each of thirteen interpretive axes, groups related concepts into a shared codebook that tames inconsistent terminology, and then searches systematically for a clustering that is both statistically clean and interpretable. Among the methods that place every work on the map, agglomerative clustering separates the field far more cleanly than the usual k-means baseline (silhouette 0.664 versus 0.483), whereas density-based methods reach higher scores only by discarding most of the corpus as noise. By separating rigorous analysis from public storytelling, BioArtlas turns the tangled complexity of bioart into a navigable landscape, openly available as an interactive interface (https://www.bioartlas.com) and dataset (https://github.com/joonhyungbae/BioArtlas).
papers.comment: Bae, J. BioArtlas: Computational Clustering of Multi-Dimensional Complexity in Bioart. In The Thirty-ninth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems Creative AI Track: Humanity
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BioArtlas，一个计算图谱，将生物艺术作品沿13个解释轴嵌入关键词，通过统一术语的码本和层次聚类实现多维度分类。在81件作品上，层次聚类的轮廓系数达0.664，优于k-means的0.483，并公开了交互界面与数据集。
Motivation: 传统生物艺术分类仅沿单一轴进行，忽略了其跨美学、科学和伦理的混合性，导致策展人无法进行多维比较。
Method: 将81件作品的关键词嵌入13个预定义解释轴，通过共享码本统一不一致术语，然后系统搜索统计清洁且可解释的聚类结构。
Result: 层次聚类（轮廓系数0.664）显著优于k-means基线（0.483），而基于密度的方法虽得分更高但需丢弃大部分数据。
Conclusion: BioArtlas通过分离严谨分析与公共叙事，将生物艺术的复杂复杂性转化为可导航的景观，并提供开放访问的交互界面和数据集。

papers.title: HeteRo-Select: Informativeness as the Participation Driver in Heterogeneous Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning systems typically allocate gradient compression by link speed. This is sensible when bandwidth and data informativeness align. However, under non-IID data, these signals often decorrelate or invert. A bandwidth-driven allocator then risks compressing the most informative gradients hardest. We propose HeteRo-Select, a framework that replaces bandwidth with a per-client informativeness score as the primary driver of compression. The score jointly governs three decisions per round: client selection, compression ratio, and server aggregation weight, with bandwidth retained only as a hard ceiling. Score-proportional selection provably reduces the effective heterogeneity of the chosen subset; score-proportional compression provably lowers aggregate top-$k$ error at fixed traffic. Under the exact FedCG simulation protocol, HeteRo-Select delivers a $1.78\times$ speedup and an $18.2\%$ reduction in traffic on CIFAR-10. The same configuration, unchanged, scales from a $7{,}850$-parameter logistic regression to an $11.27$M-parameter ResNet-18, hitting the accuracy target on three of four benchmarks. When bandwidth and informativeness are deliberately anti-correlated, the method still achieves the target accuracy with less traffic than the normal-bandwidth run.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HeteRo-Select 框架，以客户端信息性分数替代带宽作为梯度压缩的驱动因素，联合控制客户端选择、压缩比和聚合权重。在非独立同分布数据下，带宽与信息性可能脱钩，该框架通过分数比例选择和信息比例压缩，降低聚合 top-k 误差并减少流量。在 FedCG 模拟协议下，CIFAR-10 上实现 1.78 倍加速和 18.2% 流量减少，可扩展至 ResNet-18，并在带宽与信息性反相关时仍保持效率。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习系统按链路速度分配梯度压缩，但在非独立同分布数据下带宽与数据信息性可能脱钩或反转，导致最有信息量的梯度被压缩最重，影响训练效率和模型性能。
Method: 提出 HeteRo-Select 框架，为每个客户端计算信息性分数，并用该分数同时决定客户端选择概率、压缩比和服务器聚合权重，带宽仅作为硬性上限。分数比例选择保证所选子集异质性降低，分数比例压缩保证固定流量下聚合 top-k 误差降低。
Result: 在 FedCG 模拟协议下，CIFAR-10 上实现 1.78 倍加速和 18.2% 流量减少；方法从 7,850 参数逻辑回归扩展到 11.27M 参数 ResNet-18，在四个基准中的三个达到精度目标；即使带宽与信息性反相关，仍以少于正常带宽运行的流量达到目标精度。
Conclusion: 摘要结果表明，以信息性分数驱动压缩的框架可有效解决非独立同分布场景下带宽与信息性不一致的问题，并具有良好的可扩展性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Moving Out: Physically-grounded Human-AI Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: The ability to adapt to physical actions and constraints in an environment is crucial for embodied agents (e.g., robots) to effectively collaborate with humans. Such physically grounded human-AI collaboration must account for the increased complexity of the continuous state-action space and constrained dynamics caused by physical constraints. However, most existing collaboration benchmarks are discrete or do not consider physical attributes and constraints. To address this, we introduce Moving Out, a human-AI collaboration benchmark that resembles a wide range of collaboration modes affected by physical attributes and constraints, such as moving heavy items together and coordinating actions to move an item around a corner. Moving Out consists of two challenges and human-human interaction data to comprehensively evaluate models' abilities to adapt to diverse human behaviors and unseen physical attributes. To give embodied agents the capability to collaborate with humans under physical attributes and constraints, we propose a novel method, BASS (Behavior Augmentation, Simulation, and Selection), to enhance the diversity of agents and their understanding of the outcome of actions. We systematically compare BASS and state-of-the-art models in AI-AI and human-AI experiments, showing that BASS can effectively collaborate with both unseen AI and humans. The project page is available at https://live-robotics-uva.github.io/movingout_ai/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Moving Out，一个物理基础的人机协作基准，模拟搬重物、绕过角落等需要协调动作的连续物理任务。该基准包含两个挑战和人人交互数据，用于评估模型适应不同人类行为和物理属性的能力。作者进一步提出 BASS 方法，通过行为增强、模拟和选择提升智能体与人类协作的效率，在 AI-AI 和人机实验中优于现有模型。
Motivation: 现有协作基准大多基于离散动作或忽略物理属性与约束，无法真实评估机器人在连续状态-动作空间中与人类协作的能力。
Method: 提出 Moving Out 基准和 BASS 方法：BASS 通过行为增强（Behavior Augmentation）、模拟（Simulation）和选择（Selection）增强智能体行为多样性及对动作后果的理解。
Result: 在 AI-AI 和人机实验中，BASS 与未见过的 AI 及人类协作效果均优于现有最先进模型。
Conclusion: Moving Out 基准和 BASS 方法为物理基础的人机协作提供了更全面的评估框架和有效的协作策略，但摘要未明确提及泛化至真实机器人场景的局限性。

papers.title: AnalogFed: Privacy-Preserving Discovery of Analog Circuits at Scale with Federated Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative AI (GenAI) have shown transformative potential for modern hardware design. However, existing GenAI-driven approaches fall short of enabling large-scale electronic design automation (EDA) due to the proprietary and siloed nature of hardware datasets, which cannot be centralized for model training. Achieving at-scale GenAI-driven EDA, therefore, requires a novel privacy-preserving framework that can leverage distributed data without compromising confidentiality. This work introduces AnalogFed, the first privacy-preserving framework for large-scale analog circuit topology discovery using federated learning (FedL) and GenAI. AnalogFed establishes the feasibility of collaborative analog topology design while addressing key security challenges: it mitigates membership inference attacks (MIAs) through a novel input perturbation strategy based on dummy token injection, and defends against model inversion attacks with customized, efficient homomorphic encryption. Extensive experiments demonstrate AnalogFed's effectiveness and efficiency, achieving strong privacy protection without degrading model utility. This framework lays the foundation for scalable, multi-party collaboration in next-generation hardware design automation with GenAI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnalogFed，首个利用联邦学习 (FedL) 和生成式 AI 实现大规模模拟电路拓扑发现的隐私保护框架。它通过虚拟令牌注入对抗成员推理攻击，并使用定制同态加密防御模型逆向攻击。实验表明该方法在保持模型效用前提下实现强隐私保护。
Motivation: 现有生成式 AI 驱动的电子设计自动化 (EDA) 因硬件数据集专有且分散，无法集中训练，阻碍大规模应用。需要隐私保护框架以利用分布式数据。
Method: 提出 AnalogFed 框架，结合联邦学习与生成式 AI，采用虚拟令牌注入 (dummy token injection) 抵御成员推理攻击，并引入高效同态加密抵抗模型逆向攻击。
Result: 大量实验证明 AnalogFed 在强隐私保护下不降低模型效用，实现有效且高效的协作模拟电路拓扑设计。
Conclusion: 该框架为下一代硬件设计自动化中可扩展的多方协作奠定基础，但当前仅针对模拟电路拓扑发现，其他类型电路或更复杂场景有待探索。

papers.title: BusterX++: Towards Unified Cross-Modal AI-Generated Content Detection and Explanation with MLLM
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of generative AI has substantially improved image and video synthesis, amplifying the risk of multimodal visual misinformation. Recent MLLMs have shown promise for transparent AI-generated content detection through reasoning and explanation, yet existing approaches largely treat image and video forensics as isolated tasks, leaving cross-modal synergies underexplored. To address this, we present \textbf{BusterX++}, a unified MLLM for joint image and video detection with interpretable reasoning. We also introduce \textbf{GenBuster-Bench++}, a meticulously curated, difficulty-aligned benchmark containing balanced image and video samples spanning recent generation models and diverse real-world scenarios. Using this controlled setting, we revisit the widely adopted $SFT \rightarrow RL$ post-training paradigm. Notably, our findings demonstrate that a single-stage, pure RL strategy driven strictly by sparse outcome rewards consistently matches or surpasses a strong SFT+RL baseline across both unified and single-modality settings. Our key insight reveals that SFT imposes lower policy entropy, which restricts the policy search space and dampens exploratory freedom. In contrast, single-stage pure RL maintains higher policy entropy throughout training, effectively unlocking the spontaneous emergence of cross-modal capability transfer between image and video forensics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BusterX++ achieves state-of-the-art performance, highlighting the powerful potential of RL for unified cross-modal visual reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BusterX++，一个统一的多模态大语言模型，用于联合图像和视频的AI生成内容检测与可解释推理。同时引入GenBuster-Bench++基准，通过纯强化学习策略实现跨模态能力迁移，在统一和单模态设置下均达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有方法将图像和视频取证视为孤立任务，缺乏跨模态协同；且监督微调加强化学习的后训练范式限制了探索自由度。
Method: 提出单一阶段纯强化学习策略，仅使用稀疏结果奖励，避免监督微调导致的策略熵降低，从而保持高策略熵并促进图像与视频取证间的跨模态能力迁移。
Result: 在统一和多模态设置下，纯强化学习策略一致匹配或超越强监督微调加强化学习基线，实现最先进性能。
Conclusion: 纯强化学习能有效激发跨模态视觉推理的涌现能力，为统一检测与解释提供新范式。

papers.title: SPATIA: Multimodal Generation and Prediction of Spatial Cell Phenotypes
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how cellular morphology, gene expression, and spatial context jointly shape tissue function is a central challenge in biology. Image-based spatial transcriptomics technologies now provide high-resolution measurements of cell images and gene expression profiles, but existing methods typically analyze these modalities in isolation or at limited resolution. We address the problem by introducing SPATIA, a multi-level generative and predictive model that learns unified, spatially aware representations by fusing morphology, gene expression, and spatial context from the cell to the tissue level. SPATIA also incorporates a spatially conditioned generative framework with confidence-aware OT reweighting and morphology-profile alignment for modeling target-state morphology distributions. Specifically, we propose a confidence-aware flow matching objective that reweights weak optimal-transport pairs based on uncertainty. We further apply morphology-profile alignment to encourage biologically meaningful image generation, enabling the modeling of microenvironment-dependent phenotypic transitions. We assembled a multi-scale dataset consisting of 25.9 million cell-gene pairs across 17 tissues. We benchmark SPATIA against 18 models across 12 tasks, spanning categories such as phenotype generation, annotation, clustering, gene imputation, and cross-modal prediction. SPATIA achieves improved performance over state-of-the-art models, improving generative fidelity by 8% and predictive accuracy by up to 3%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPATIA，一个多层级生成与预测模型，融合细胞形态、基因表达和空间上下文，从细胞到组织水平学习统一的空间感知表示。模型包含空间条件生成框架、置信感知最优传输重加权以及形态-表达对齐，用于建模目标状态形态分布。在 17 种组织的 2590 万细胞-基因对数据集上，SPATIA 在 12 个任务中与 18 个模型对比，生成保真度提升 8%，预测准确率提升最高 3%。
Motivation: 现有方法通常孤立分析细胞形态、基因表达和空间上下文，或分辨率有限，难以联合理解这些模态如何塑造组织功能。
Method: SPATIA 通过融合形态、表达和空间上下文的统一表示学习，结合基于不确定性的置信感知流匹配目标（重削弱最优传输对）以及形态-表达对齐，实现生物有意义的图像生成和微环境依赖的表型转换建模。
Result: 在包含 2590 万细胞-基因对的 17 种组织数据集上，SPATIA 在表型生成、注释、聚类、基因插补和跨模态预测等 12 个任务中优于 18 个基线模型，生成保真度提升 8%，预测准确率最高提升 3%。
Conclusion: SPATIA 通过融合多模态空间信息和置信感知生成框架，为空间细胞表型建模提供了统一且有效的方案。

papers.title: EmoFSM: A Finite State Machine for Emotional Support Conversation
papers.abstract_en: Emotional support conversation (ESC) aims to alleviate people's emotional distress through effective conversations. Although large language models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress in ESC, most of these studies may not define the diagram from a state-model perspective, thereby providing a suboptimal solution for long-term satisfaction. To address such an issue, we leverage the Finite State Machine (FSM) on LLMs, and propose a framework called EmoFSM. Our framework allows a single LLM to bootstrap the planning during ESC, and self-reason the seeker's emotion, support strategy, and the final response upon each conversation turn. Substantial experiments in ESC datasets suggest that EmoFSM outperforms many baselines, including direct inference, self-fine, chain of thought, finetuning, and externally supported methods, even those with many more parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EmoFSM 框架，将有限状态机（FSM）与大语言模型（LLM）结合，用于情感支持对话（ESC）。该框架允许单个 LLM 在每轮对话中自主推理求助者的情绪、支持策略并生成回应。实验表明，EmoFSM 在多个 ESC 数据集上优于直接推理、思维链（CoT）、微调等方法。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的情感支持对话研究大多未从状态模型角度定义对话图，导致在长期满意度上表现次优。
Method: 利用有限状态机（FSM）引导 LLM 进行对话规划，使模型在每轮对话中自推理情绪状态、支持策略和最终回应。
Result: 在 ESC 数据集上，EmoFSM 优于直接推理、自微调、思维链、微调以及外部支持的方法，甚至超过参数量更大的模型。
Conclusion: EmoFSM 通过状态机建模有效提升了情感支持对话的长期满意度，但论文未讨论其在其他对话任务或更复杂场景下的泛化性。

papers.title: Algorithmic Prompt Generation for Diverse Human-like Teaming and Communication with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how humans collaborate and communicate in teams is essential for improving human-agent teaming and AI-assisted decision-making. However, relying solely on data from large-scale user studies is impractical due to logistical, ethical, and practical constraints, necessitating synthetic models of multiple diverse human behaviors. Recently, agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to emulate human-like behavior in social settings. But, obtaining a large set of diverse behaviors requires manual effort in the form of designing prompts. On the other hand, Quality Diversity (QD) optimization has been shown to be capable of generating diverse Reinforcement Learning (RL) agent behavior. In this work, we combine QD optimization with LLM-powered agents to iteratively search for prompts that generate diverse team behavior in a long-horizon, multi-step collaborative environment. We first show, through a human-subjects experiment, that humans exhibit diverse coordination and communication behavior in this domain. We then present a series of experiments showing that our approach captures behaviors that are difficult to observe without large-scale data collection, and a follow-up user study to show that these generated behaviors are human-like. Our findings highlight the combination of QD and LLM-powered agents as an effective tool for studying teaming and communication strategies in multi-agent collaboration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文结合质量多样性优化（QD）和大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体，迭代搜索能生成多样化团队协作行为的提示词。通过人类受试者实验验证了人类在长期多步协作环境中表现出的多样协调与通信行为，并展示该方法能捕获难以通过大规模数据收集观察到的行为，后续用户研究表明生成行为具有人类相似性。
Motivation: 依赖大规模用户研究收集人类团队协作数据存在逻辑、伦理和实践上的困难，需要合成多种多样的人类行为模型。现有LLM智能体能模拟社交环境中的人类行为，但获取多样化行为需要手动设计提示词，效率低。
Method: 提出将QD优化与LLM智能体结合，在长期多步协作环境中迭代搜索提示词，以生成多样化的团队行为。
Result: 通过人类受试者实验表明人类在该环境中展现多样协调与通信行为；方法能生成难以通过大规模数据收集观察到的行为；后续用户研究表明生成行为具有人类相似性。
Conclusion: 结合QD和LLM智能体是研究多智能体协作中团队协作与通信策略的有效工具。

papers.title: The Morse Transform for Discrete Shape Analysis
papers.abstract_en: The geometry of an object plays a vital role in modulating its interactions with the physical world. It nevertheless remains difficult to describe geometric information numerically for the purposes of statistical inference or classification tasks. Here, we introduce a new topological transform which leverages directional piecewise-linear Morse theory to quantify the geometry of an embedded object by cataloguing critical points across multiple height-functions. The output of this Morse transform records both the heights and the local topological type (peak, trough or saddle) of the critical points that characterise the underlying shape, retaining finer information than the Euler characteristic transform whilst naturally prioritising a shape's outermost regions. Crucially, this output can be further compressed into a rich but compact feature vector. We benchmark the Morse feature vector as a descriptor for ligand-based virtual screening (LBVS), which intrinsically depends on the shape of molecules. Under a common gradient-boosted tree classification pipeline, Morse descriptors achieve the highest mean AUROC when compared to other topological transform descriptors and to standard shape-based LBVS descriptors.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于离散分段线性 Morse 理论的新型拓扑变换，通过记录多个高度函数下的临界点（峰、谷、鞍点）来量化嵌入物体的几何形状。该变换的输出比欧拉特征变换保留更细粒度的形状信息，并自然优先考虑形状的最外层区域，且可压缩为紧凑的特征向量。在配体虚拟筛选任务中，该 Morse 描述符在梯度提升树分类器下取得了最高的平均 AUROC，优于其他拓扑变换描述符和标准形状描述符。
Motivation: 物体几何信息对于统计推断和分类任务至关重要，但难以数值化描述。现有拓扑描述符（如欧拉特征变换）丢失了细节，需要一种保留更丰富几何信息的表示。
Method: 引入 Morse 变换，利用离散分段线性 Morse 理论，从多个方向的高度函数中提取临界点（峰、谷、鞍点）的位置和局部拓扑类型，并将这些信息压缩为特征向量。
Result: 在配体虚拟筛选 (LBVS) 基准测试中，Morse 特征向量在梯度提升树分类下实现了最高的平均 AUROC，优于其他拓扑变换描述子和标准形状描述子。
Conclusion: Morse 变换提供了一种保留形状外层细节的几何量化方法，可有效用于形状比较和分类任务，尤其适用于分子形状的虚拟筛选。

papers.title: Conditional Local Importance by Quantile Expectations
papers.abstract_en: Global variable importance measures are commonly used to interpret the results of machine learning models. Local variable importance techniques assess how variables contribute to individual observations. Current, popular methods, including LIME and SHAP, provide useful measures of feature contribution in the prediction space, while leaving opportunities for improved characterization of local structure in the model loss space. Additionally, they are not natively adapted for multi-class classification problems. We propose a new model-agnostic method for calculating local variable importance, CLIQUE, that highlights locally dependent relationships, provides improved stability over permutation-based methods, and can be directly applied to multi-class classification problems. Simulated and real-world examples show that CLIQUE emphasizes locally dependent information, captures interaction behavior beyond what can be evaluated by correlations, and assigns zero importance in regions where the response is invariant to changes in variables.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的模型无关的局部变量重要性方法 CLIQUE，用于在模型损失空间中表征局部结构，并直接适用于多类分类问题。模拟和真实数据实验表明，CLIQUE 能突出局部依赖关系，捕获超出相关性的交互行为，并在变量变化不影响响应的区域赋予零重要性。
Motivation: 现有局部变量重要性方法（如 LIME、SHAP）主要在预测空间中评估特征贡献，但在模型损失空间中表征局部结构的能力不足，且不原生支持多类分类。
Method: 提出 CLIQUE，一种基于分位数期望的条件局部重要性方法，通过计算变量对预测损失的条件贡献来度量局部重要性，具有模型无关性和多类适用性。
Result: 模拟和真实示例显示，CLIQUE 能强调局部依赖信息，捕获超越相关性的交互行为，并在响应不变区域赋予零重要性，且稳定性优于基于置换的方法。
Conclusion: CLIQUE 为局部变量重要性提供了一种新的视角，尤其突出了局部依赖关系和交互效应，可直接应用于多类分类问题。

papers.title: Moderating Illicit Online Image Promotion for Unsafe User-Generated Content Games Using Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Online user generated content games (UGCGs) are increasingly popular among children and adolescents for social interaction and more creative online entertainment. However, they pose a heightened risk of exposure to explicit content, raising growing concerns for the online safety of children and adolescents. Despite these concerns, few studies have addressed the issue of illicit image-based promotions of unsafe UGCGs on social media, which can inadvertently attract young users. This challenge arises from the difficulty of obtaining comprehensive training data for UGCG images and the unique nature of these images, which differ from traditional unsafe content. In this work, we take the first step towards studying the threat of illicit promotions of unsafe UGCGs. We collect a real-world dataset comprising 2,924 images that display diverse sexually explicit and violent content used to promote UGCGs by their game creators. Our in-depth studies reveal a new understanding of this problem and the urgent need for automatically flagging illicit UGCG promotions. We additionally create a cutting-edge system, UGCG-Guard, designed to aid social media platforms in effectively identifying images used for illicit UGCG promotions. This system leverages recently introduced large vision-language models (VLMs) and employs a novel conditional prompting strategy for zero-shot domain adaptation, along with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning for contextual identification. UGCG-Guard achieves outstanding results, with an accuracy rate of 94% in detecting these images used for the illicit promotion of such games in real-world scenarios.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次研究社交媒体上针对不安全用户生成内容游戏（UGCGs）的非法图像推广威胁，收集了包含性暴露和暴力内容的真实数据集（2,924张图像），并提出了UGCG-Guard系统。该系统利用大型视觉语言模型（VLM）结合条件提示策略进行零样本域适应，并使用链式思维（CoT）推理进行上下文识别，在真实场景中实现94%的检测准确率。
Motivation: 儿童和青少年在UGC游戏中面临接触不当内容的风险，但现有研究缺乏对社交媒体上非法推广不安全UGCG的关注，且获取训练数据困难。
Method: 收集包含性暴露和暴力内容的真实图像数据集（2,924张）；提出UGCG-Guard系统，采用大型视觉语言模型（VLM），使用新颖的条件提示策略进行零样本域适应，并结合链式思维（CoT）推理进行上下文识别。
Result: 在真实场景中检测用于非法推广的图片，准确率达到94%。
Conclusion: 该工作首次系统地研究该威胁，并展示了VLM在自动审核中的有效性。

papers.title: Models Take Notes at Prefill: KV Cache Can Be Editable and Composable
papers.abstract_en: Prefix caching reuses prefill only across an exactly shared prefix, so one changed field invalidates the entire downstream cache. Yet overwriting the field's own key/value vectors and reusing the rest leaves the model acting on the old value. The reason, established causally across four model families: at prefill the model has already written the field-conditioned conclusion onto downstream notes; the field's own key/value drives under 1% of the decision. Read as a notebook of memoized conclusions, two capabilities follow. (1) It is editable. A salient erratum amends the notes; and with chain-of-thought, editing the field alone recovers the decision (1.00 at 8B, ~1% compute), while without CoT it is ignored. (2) It is composable. The notes are position-portable, so a precompiled skill can be RoPE-repositioned and spliced into any context, indistinguishable from full recompute (logit cosine 0.90-0.999, twelve models) at O(L) rather than O(L^2) time-to-first-token. A unified edit+compose agent stays decision-identical to recompute at up to 14.9x lower latency. The approach applies to any per-token attention KV cache, validated across scale, quantization, Mixture-of-Experts, and multimodal caches, and extends to several attention variants through small adapters. Because the erratum is append-only, it composes with production prefix caching: in an online vLLM benchmark it keeps the prefix cache-aligned (98.5% hit-rate), cutting p90 time-to-first-token by 53-398x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现前缀缓存对共享前缀的重用严格依赖于完全相同的字段，但模型在预填充阶段已将基于字段条件的结论写入下游笔记（KV缓存），而字段自身的key/value对决策贡献极小（<1%）。基于此观察，论文提出KV缓存可编辑（通过修正词条修改笔记，结合思维链可在极低计算下恢复决策）和可组合（笔记位置可移植，预编译技能可通过RoPE重定位拼接，与完整重计算几乎无异，首token延迟从O(L²)降至O(L)）。集成编辑+组合的代理在保持决策一致性的同时，延迟降低至1/14.9。该方法适用于多种注意力变体，并在vLLM在线基准测试中保持98.5%的前缀缓存命中率，p90首token延迟降低53-398倍。
Motivation: 现有前缀缓存要求完全相同的共享前缀才能重用，即使单个字段变化也会导致整个下游缓存失效；而直接覆盖字段的key/value向量并重用其余部分会导致模型仍基于旧值决策。这限制了长序列推理的效率。
Method: 将KV缓存视为记录已推导结论的笔记，修正词条（erratum）以追加方式修改笔记，并结合思维链（chain-of-thought）使字段编辑影响决策；利用笔记的位置可移植性，通过RoPE重定位将预编译技能拼接到任意上下文，实现O(L)的首token延迟。
Result: 编辑字段结合思维链在8B模型上以约1%的计算量完美恢复决策；组合技能与完整重计算的logit余弦相似度达0.90-0.999（12个模型）；统一代理在保持决策一致性的同时实现高达14.9x的延迟降低；vLLM基准测试中保持98.5%前缀缓存命中率，p90首token延迟降低53-398倍。
Conclusion: KV缓存可以像笔记一样被编辑和组合，这适用于任何逐token的注意力KV缓存，包括多模型规模、量化、混合专家和多模态缓存，并通过小适配器扩展到多种注意力变体。该方法与生产级前缀缓存兼容，可显著降低推理延迟。

papers.title: Informative Missingness to Generate Irregular Clinical Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Laboratory tests in electronic health records are collected irregularly, and the absence of a test order can be as informative as the measurement itself. Such missingness reflects clinicians' decisions and patient physiology, making it important to model it directly rather than treat it as a preprocessing artifact. Here we present a diffusion-based approach for generating clinical time series that jointly models laboratory values and their observation patterns using the public Data Analytics Challenge on Missing Data Imputation (DACMI) benchmark derived from MIMIC-III. To preserve realistic sampling, we align chart times into 4-hour intervals and segment admissions into 7-day windows, producing trajectories that pair each lab value with a corresponding observation indicator. Standard transformations and normalization are applied to stabilize training. Our method extends the TimeDiff framework to learn continuous lab values and discrete missingness patterns through complementary diffusion objectives. Experiments show that the generated data closely match real patient trajectories across individual lab distributions and joint value-missingness embeddings, demonstrating that diffusion models can capture clinically meaningful dependencies between patient physiology and clinicians' testing behavior under MNAR-like (missing-not-at-random) missingness. These preliminary results indicate that our model can serve as an initial component toward developing clinical foundation models. By producing synthetic priors that preserve key physiology-missingness relationships, this work motivates the subsequent training of Prior-Data Fitted Networks capable of leveraging informative missingness, which we will investigate in the extended work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的临床时间序列生成方法，联合建模实验室检验值及其缺失模式。利用MIMIC-III的DACMI基准，将任意时间点对齐到4小时间隔，并采用7天窗口生成轨迹。方法扩展TimeDiff框架，通过互补扩散目标学习连续值和离散缺失模式。实验表明生成数据在个体分布和联合嵌入上接近真实病人轨迹，能够捕捉MNAR缺失下的临床依赖关系。
Motivation: 电子健康记录中实验室检验的观测时间不规则，且检验缺失本身可能反映临床决策和患者生理状态，现有方法常将缺失视为预处理伪影，未能直接建模。
Method: 基于扩散模型，扩展TimeDiff框架，通过互补扩散目标联合建模连续实验室值和离散缺失模式；数据预处理将图表时间对齐至4小时间隔，入院分割为7天窗口。
Result: 生成数据在个体实验室分布和联合值-缺失嵌入上紧密匹配真实病人轨迹，表明扩散模型能捕捉临床上有意义的依赖关系。
Conclusion: 该模型可作为临床基础模型开发的初始组件，生成保留生理-缺失关系的合成先验，为后续训练Prior-Data Fitted Networks提供基础。
